patterns.context: 类型声明或类型转换附近出现 byte；第 5 段为 Go 字节切片转换，第 8 段为 Go 数据库支持类型说明。

patterns.name: 数学实部符号
patterns.context: 公式中出现表示复数实部的 Re，处于乘积与三角函数构成的数学表达式内。

patterns.name: 正则表达式编译
patterns.context: Python 代码中调用 re.compile 编译正则表达式，模式匹配 .xml 后缀。

en.description: Activations occur across several kinds of code and a mathematical formula: prominent log calls and their contents, method/function definitions, and pagination UI updates. There is also a formula for the cosine of a phase and the real part of a complex number; these have no clear common trigger feature.

patterns.name: Log calls and log content
patterns.context: Code calls a logging interface and passes a string, format placeholder, or variable; text about logging-related questions may also trigger.
patterns.domain: Objective-C, Python code, and programming Q&A

patterns.name: Method or function definitions in programming languages
patterns.context: Near class method or function definitions, commonly in object-oriented code; the passage may also contain other initialization or rendering logic.
patterns.domain: Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, and other code

patterns.name: Pagination UI and page number display
patterns.context: A method receives the current page and total page count, then updates page-control text or color.

patterns.name: Mathematical expression for complex phase and cosine
patterns.context: The formula writes the cosine of the sum of several phases as the real part of a product of complex numbers.

2_149.concept: 代码结构与日志相关 token
2_149.description: 激活见于多类代码和一段数学公式：突出日志调用及其内容、方法/函数定义，也覆盖分页界面更新；另有余弦相位与复数实部公式，彼此缺乏明确共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 日志调用与日志内容
patterns.context: 代码中调用日志接口并传入字符串、格式占位符或变量；日志相关问题文本也可能触发。

patterns.name: 编程语言中的方法或函数定义
patterns.context: 类方法或函数定义附近，常见于面向对象代码；片段中也可能含其他初始化或渲染逻辑。

patterns.name: 分页界面与页码显示
patterns.context: 方法接收当前页和总页数，并更新页面控件文本或颜色。

patterns.name: 复数相位与余弦的数学表达式
patterns.context: 公式中将多个相位之和的余弦写成复数乘积的实部。

en.description: Most spans activate on the word-initial substring «Ne», but the following words and domains vary widely; one span also activates on a period. A more specific shared semantic pattern cannot be determined from context.

patterns.name: Ne subword at the start of a sentence or word
patterns.context: The letter sequence Ne is at the activation site, usually at the beginning of a following full proper name or term; subsequent characters vary.
patterns.domain: Multidomain English corpora, including medicine, law, and news

patterns.name: Specific sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: A period appears after the phrase “Film thickness of die coating agents”, followed by a line break and a repetition of the phrase.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstract titles or formatted text

2_258.concept: 词首子串 Ne
2_258.description: 绝大多数片段激活在词首子串«Ne»，但其后词语与领域差异很大；另有一段激活句号。无法从上下文确定更具体的共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 句首或词首的 Ne 子词
patterns.context: 字母串 Ne 位于激活位置，通常是后续完整专名或术语的开头；周围后续字符各异。
patterns.domain: 多领域英文语料，包括医学、法律、新闻等

patterns.name: 特定句末标点
patterns.context: 句号出现在短语“Film thickness of die coating agents”之后，接着换行并重复短语。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要标题或排版文本

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to the word-initial subword «Ne», covering neuroscience vocabulary as well as different word beginnings such as Nebraska, Neisseria, and Neulasta; also includes a word-initial fragment of Madin and one period activation.

patterns.name: Word-initial Ne subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the initial subword fragment spelled Ne, with subsequent characters belonging to different complete words; it occurs at sentence beginnings, word beginnings, or in titles.
patterns.domain: Medicine, biology, law, news, and general text

patterns.name: Word beginnings of neuro-related words
patterns.context: The word-initial «Ne» continues into words related to neurons, neurofilaments, neuropeptides, or neuropathology; subsequent subword fragments activate separately across different words.

patterns.name: Neisseria word beginning
patterns.context: The opening portion of the complete bacterial name Neisseria gonorrhoeae.

patterns.name: Nebraska name beginning
patterns.context: The word beginning of the proper noun Nebraska, appearing in a court library title.

patterns.name: Drug-name beginning fragment
patterns.context: The initial substring of the drug name Neulasta, in a commercial context involving a competitor and Teva approval.

patterns.name: Madin-Darby cell-line name
patterns.context: In “synchronozing Madin-Darby bovine kidney cells,” the opening fragment of the proper noun Madin activates; this differs from the dominant «Ne» pattern.

patterns.name: Period after a preposition
patterns.context: A period immediately follows agents near the beginning of a sentence about dental die coating agents; it has no apparent commonality with the word-initial activations in the other segments.

2_258.concept: 词首 Ne 子词片段
2_258.description: 主要对词首子词 «Ne» 强烈响应，涵盖神经科学词汇，也出现在 Nebraska、Neisseria、Neulasta 等不同词首；另有 Madin 的词首片段及一个句点激活。

patterns.name: 词首 Ne 子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在大小写为 Ne 的开头子词片段，后续字符属于不同完整词；出现在句首、词首或标题中。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学、法律、新闻及一般文本

patterns.name: Neuro 相关词词首
patterns.context: 词首 «Ne» 后继续构成神经元、神经丝、神经肽或神经病理学相关词；不同词中后续子词片段各自激活。

patterns.name: Neisseria 词首
patterns.context: 完整菌名 Neisseria gonorrhoeae 的开头部分。

patterns.name: Nebraska 名称词首
patterns.context: 专名 Nebraska 的词首，出现在法院图书馆标题中。

patterns.name: 药名词首片段
patterns.context: 药名 Neulasta 的词首子串，处于竞争者及 Teva 获批的商业语境。

patterns.name: Madin-Darby 细胞系名称
patterns.context: 在“synchronozing Madin-Darby bovine kidney cells”中，专名 Madin 的开头片段激活；与主导的 «Ne» 模式不同。

patterns.name: 介词标点句点
patterns.context: 句点紧接 agents，位于关于牙科代型涂层剂的句子开头附近；与其他段的词首激活无明显共同点。

en.concept: Word-initial «Ne» fragment and sporadic word-form features
en.description: Most high activations fall on the word-initial fragment «Ne», which can continue into neuroscience-related words and also appears in Nebraska, Neulasta, and Neisseria; there are also an internal fragment in gonorrhoeae and isolated activations on a period and a cell-line name fragment.

patterns.name: Word-initial Ne- subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the word-initial substring “Ne” beginning with a capital N; subsequent spellings vary, possibly reflecting a token boundary or a word-initial fragment trigger.
patterns.domain: Multidomain text, including legal, pharmaceutical news, and biomedical text

patterns.name: Continuation into neuroscience vocabulary
patterns.context: After the word-initial Ne come neuron(s), neurofilament, neuropeptide, neuropathologically, and other neuroscience-related words; the trigger position is word-initial in each case.

patterns.name: Neisseria name
patterns.context: Appears in the scientific name of gonorrhoeae; Ne is the word-initial fragment, and an internal fragment in gonorrhoeae is also marked in the same segment.

patterns.name: Nebraska name
patterns.context: Ne and subsequent fragments form the place name Nebraska, which appears in a court website name.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment
patterns.context: Ne and subsequent fragments form the drug name Neulasta, near pharmaceutical-news wording such as “rival from Teva cleared”.

patterns.name: Period in a sentence about die coating
patterns.context: A period immediately follows agents and is followed by a newline; its activation pattern differs from the other word-initial Ne instances.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in Madin
patterns.context: Mad in the cell-line name Madin-Darby is marked, with no Ne-related trigger.

2_258.concept: 词首«Ne»片段及零散词形特征
2_258.description: 多数高激活落在词首片段«Ne»，后续可组成神经相关词，也包括 Nebraska、Neulasta 和 Neisseria；另有 gonorrhoeae 内部片段，以及孤立的句点和细胞系名片段激活。

patterns.name: 词首 Ne- 子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在以大写 N 开头的词首子串“Ne”；后续拼写各异，可能是分词边界或词首片段触发。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本，包括法律、药品新闻、生物医学

patterns.name: 神经科学词汇续接
patterns.context: 词首 Ne 后续构成 neuron(s)、neurofilament、neuropeptide、neuropathologically 等神经相关词；触发位置均在词首。
patterns.domain: 神经科学与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 奈瑟菌名称
patterns.context: 出现在淋病奈瑟菌的学名中，Ne 是词首片段；同段还标记了 gonorrhoeae 内部片段。

patterns.name: Nebraska 名称
patterns.context: Ne 与后续片段组成地名 Nebraska，位于法院网站名称中。

patterns.name: 药名片段
patterns.context: Ne 与后续片段组成药名 Neulasta，邻近“rival from Teva cleared”等药品新闻用语。

patterns.name: Die 涂层句中的句点
patterns.context: 句点紧接 agents，后接换行；激活模式与其余 Ne 词首实例不同。

patterns.name: Mad 前的词形片段
patterns.context: 细胞系名称 Madin-Darby 中的 Mad 被标记，未见 Ne 相关触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验方法摘要

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on the word-initial subword fragment “Ne”, in words including Madin, Nebraska, Neisseria, neurons, neurofilament, Neuropeptide, and Neuropathologically; one instance falls on the word-initial fragment of “Die”.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment “Ne”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the first subword fragment of words beginning with Ne; subsequent word meanings and contexts vary widely.
patterns.domain: Multidomain, primarily biomedicine, also law and general text

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment “Die”
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase “Die coating agents” as the beginning of the word Die; the following text discusses plaster models for dental restorations.

2_258.concept: 词首子词片段识别
2_258.description: 激活主要集中在词首子词片段“Ne”，涵盖 Madin、Nebraska、Neisseria、neurons、neurofilament、Neuropeptide、Neuropathologically 等不同词；另有一次落在“Die”的词首。

patterns.name: 词首片段“Ne”
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Ne 开头的词的首个子词片段；后续词义和上下文差异很大。
patterns.domain: 多领域，主要为生物医学，也见法律和一般文本

patterns.name: 词首片段“Die”
patterns.context: 出现在短语“Die coating agents”中，作为单词 Die 的开头；后文谈牙科修复用石膏模型。

en.description: Most segments show strong activation on word-initial Ne, followed by neuroscience or medical terms, as well as Neisseria; word-initial Ne also appears in Nebraska and Neulasta. Segment 1 does not show this pattern; activation is scattered across words and punctuation in a dental abstract.

patterns.name: Ne- prefix in medical terms
patterns.context: The word-initial substring Ne is marked as strongly activating; subsequent text forms neuroscience or medical terms such as neurons, neurofilament, neuropeptide, neuropathologically, and neuroblastoma, as well as Neisseria

patterns.name: Nebraska word beginning
patterns.context: Ne and braska combine to form the proper noun Nebraska, appearing before a court name

patterns.name: Neulasta drug-name beginning
patterns.context: Ne and a subsequent subword fragment combine to form the drug name Neulasta, preceding rival

patterns.name: Dental context unrelated to word-initial activation
patterns.context: No Ne is marked; activation falls on sentence-final punctuation and multiple words in a dental materials description

2_258.concept: 词首 Ne 子串
2_258.description: 多数段在词首 Ne 上强激活，后接神经科学或医学术语，也有 Neisseria；另见 Nebraska、Neulasta 的词首 Ne。第1段不呈现该模式，激活分散于牙科摘要词语及标点。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 Ne- 前缀
patterns.context: 词首子串 Ne 被标记为强激活；后续拼成神经科学或医学术语，如 neurons、neurofilament、neuropeptide、neuropathologically、neuroblastoma，也包括 Neisseria

patterns.name: Nebraska 词首
patterns.context: Ne 与 braska 合为专名 Nebraska，出现在法院名称前

patterns.name: Neulasta 药名词首
patterns.context: Ne 与后续子词片段合为药名 Neulasta，置于 rival 之前

patterns.name: 与词首激活无关的牙科语境
patterns.context: 没有标记 Ne；激活落在句末标点及牙科材料描述中的多个词上

en.concept: Mixed: mathematical symbols and local word forms
en.description: Strong activation is concentrated in algebra problems containing 102, operators, and instructions involving derivatives or expansions; activation also occurs in Mad-initial drug names, cell lines, and place names, and on process in a patent chemical-preparation context.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and differentiation exercises
patterns.context: Occurs in math problems involving polynomials, variables, powers, or derivative instructions; several math passages also contain “102” in a formula-number-like format
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, algebra problems and differentiation exercises

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments beginning with Mad
patterns.context: Activation falls on the token “Mad” at the beginning of a proper name, followed respectively by “opar”, “in-Darby”, or “ras”; the contexts differ
patterns.domain: Biomedical drug/cell-line names and historical place names

patterns.name: Process terminology in patent chemistry text
patterns.context: A patent background passage discusses known methods for preparing compounds of a general formula, with nearby words including “formula” and “producing”

2_258.concept: 混合：数学符号与局部词形
2_258.description: 强激活主要集中于含102、运算符及导数或展开指令的代数题；另在Mad开头的药物、细胞系和地名中激活，并在专利化学制备语境的process上激活。

patterns.name: 数学符号与微分练习
patterns.context: 出现在多项式、变量、幂次或导数指令组成的数学题中；多个数学段还出现公式编号式的“102”
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，代数题及微分练习

patterns.name: Mad 开头的专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名开头的 token“Mad”，后续分别接“opar”“in-Darby”或“ras”；语境并不相同
patterns.domain: 生物医学药物/细胞系名称及历史地名

patterns.name: 专利化学表述中的过程词
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中，谈及制备通式化合物的已知方法，附近还有“formula”“producing”等词
patterns.domain: 专利、化学与法律技术文本

en.description: The digit string “102” appears and is marked in all passages. It can occur independently in mathematical expressions or as part of a longer number, name, or citation; other contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Digit string 102
patterns.context: The digit string 102 occurs; no specific syntax or neighboring words are required. In math problems it is often embedded in sequences, coefficients, or algebraic expressions; in other contexts it appears in patent numbers, experimental line names, or literature citations.
patterns.domain: Primarily DM Mathematics; also patent backgrounds, NIH biomedical text, and PubMed Central articles

2_258.concept: 数字串 102
2_258.description: 各段都出现并标记了数字串“102”，既可独立出现在数学表达式中，也可作为更长编号、名称或引用的一部分；其他上下文差异较大。

patterns.name: 数字串 102
patterns.context: 出现数字串 102；不要求特定句法或邻近词。数学题中常嵌在数列、系数或代数式里，其他语境中嵌在专利号、实验线名称或文献引用中。
patterns.domain: 主要为 DM Mathematics；也见于专利背景、NIH 生物医学文本和 PubMed Central 文献

en.concept: Word-internal fragments and heterogeneous text features
en.description: Activation is primarily associated with the Mad string fragment and the word-internal clim fragment in climatic/climates; there are also sporadic activations on numeric/alphanumeric strings and the phrase Neural network, as well as several annotations that are difficult to summarize.

patterns.name: Madras/Madr- place-name fragments
patterns.context: The trigger is the word-internal Mad string fragment; it occurs in Madras, Madzh…, Madop… ([3]), and Madagascar, among other continuations, and does not always refer to the same place.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in climatic
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-internal prefix fragment in climatic/climates; contexts discuss climate variables, seasons, or tropical climates.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts and PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Numeric/alphanumeric identifier fragments
patterns.context: Triggers within alphanumeric strings such as cell-line names or literature citations; local evidence is weak, so it is unclear whether they share a mechanism.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Neural network phrase
patterns.context: Triggers at the beginning of the phrase Neural network AI; no clear connection to the place-name or climatic fragments in other passages.

patterns.name: Other sporadic in-text highlights
patterns.context: These annotations appear near dosage/word strings in Madopar, Haskovo after a place name, and an article in election text; available context is insufficient to identify a distinct, stable trigger condition.

2_258.concept: 词内片段与异质文本特征
2_258.description: 主要对 Mad 字符串片段和 climatic/climates 的 clim 词内片段起反应；另有数字/字母数字串及 Neural network 短语的零散激活，还有若干难以归纳的标记。

patterns.name: Madras／Madr- 地名片段
patterns.context: 触发点是词内的 Mad 字符串片段；出现在 Madras、Madzh…、Madop…（[3]）和 Madagascar 等不同续接中，并非都指同一地点。

patterns.name: climatic 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 climatic/climates 的词内前缀片段；上下文讨论气候变量、季节或热带气候。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要及 PubMed Central 论文

patterns.name: 数字／字母数字标识符片段
patterns.context: 在细胞系名称或文献引用等字母数字串中触发；局部证据较弱，不能确定是否是同一机制。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、PubMed Central 论文

patterns.name: Neural network 短语
patterns.context: 触发于 Neural network AI 这一短语开头；与其他段落的地名或 climatic 片段无明显联系。

patterns.name: 文内其他零散高亮
patterns.context: 这些标记出现在 Madopar 附近的剂量/词串、地名后的 Haskovo，以及选举文本中的冠词；现有上下文不足以确定独立且稳定的触发条件。

en.description: The primary pattern is parsing-related word fragments beginning with Pars, found in Q&A, code, entries, and error logs; there are also the clim stem, formula commands, and multiple local activations in single passages that cannot all be grouped into one semantic class.

patterns.name: Parsing identifiers or words beginning with Par-
patterns.context: The trigger is a word or identifier fragment beginning with Pars, especially parsing/parser-related terms; it can occur in questions, code, error text, or category names.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, source code, software error messages, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Parsing-related parse word family
patterns.context: Forms of parse/parsing occur in identifiers or prose; in passage 7 it is part of a Java class name, in passage 4 it appears in SkipFlagParsing, and in passages 1 and 2 it appears as Parsing in questions.

patterns.name: clim- stem
patterns.context: The clim stem occurs in climate-related words concerning climate adaptation or climate factors.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting commands
patterns.context: Typesetting commands in formula environments and mathematical expressions; activation is distributed around formula symbols and commands.

patterns.name: Other local word fragments
patterns.context: These word fragments occur in ordinary biomedical discussion, with no clear shared morphological or semantic connection.

patterns.name: Command- and parameter-related words
patterns.context: Code comments describe command-line subcommands, how flags are parsed, and parameter handling; these appear in the same passage as the Pars word family, but the words themselves are also marked.

patterns.name: Category and person-classification terms
patterns.context: A category list in an encyclopedia entry includes birth years, people, and football-player categories; these occur near Pars in the same category entry.

patterns.name: Facebook SDK error fields
patterns.context: The SDK name, error code, and hexadecimal user-information field in an error message; these occur in the same passage as ParsedJSONResponseKey.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments with no shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: These occur in hierarchical descriptions, questions, or command-line error messages; aside from appearing in the same passage as Pars-initial words, no consistent condition is evident.

patterns.name: Formula fragments with no shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: Local symbols or words in physics formulas and surrounding discussion; no clear trigger condition shared with other passages is apparent.

2_258.concept: Pars/parse 词片段及杂项
2_258.description: 主模式是 Pars 开头的解析相关词片段，见问答、代码、条目及错误日志；另有 clim 词干、公式命令及多种单段局部激活，无法都归入同一语义类。

patterns.name: Par- 开头的 parsing 标识符或词语
patterns.context: 触发点是以 Pars 开头的词或标识符片段，尤其是 parsing/parser 相关词；可以出现在问句、代码、报错文本或类别名称中。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、源代码、软件错误信息及百科条目

patterns.name: 解析相关的 parse 词族
patterns.context: 在标识符或正文中出现 parse/parsing 形式；第7段为 Java 类名的一部分，第4段为 SkipFlagParsing，第1、2段为问句中的 Parsing。

patterns.name: clim- 词干
patterns.context: 气候相关词中出现 clim 词干，涉及气候适应或气候因素。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版命令
patterns.context: 公式环境和数学表达式中的排版命令；激活分散在公式符号与命令周围。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、LaTeX 数学公式

patterns.name: 其他局部词片段
patterns.context: 这些词片段出现在普通生物医学论述中，没有明显共同的词形或语义联系。

patterns.name: 命令与参数相关词
patterns.context: 代码注释描述命令行子命令、flags 的解析方式及参数处理；与 Pars 词族同段出现，但这些词自身也被标记。

patterns.name: 类别与人物分类词
patterns.context: 百科条目的分类列表，包含出生年份、人物和足球运动员类别；与 Pars 出现在同一分类条目附近。

patterns.name: Facebook SDK 错误字段
patterns.context: 错误消息中的 SDK 名称、错误码及十六进制用户信息字段；与 ParsedJSONResponseKey 同处一段。

patterns.name: 未能归入共同触发模式的零散片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在层级描述、问句或命令行错误信息中；除与 Pars 开头词同段外，看不出一致条件。

patterns.name: 未能归入共同触发模式的公式片段
patterns.context: 物理公式及其周围论述中的局部符号或词语；未见与其他段共享的清晰触发条件。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the same word-initial fragment “clim”, covering different continuations such as climatic/climates, climacteric, climbers, and climactic; the spelling cue is shared, but semantics and styles vary.

patterns.name: Climate-word stem
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of weather data, northern greenhouse cultivation, processing in warm regions, paleoclimate, climate conditions at tourist destinations, or disease-transmission forecasts; activation falls on the stem fragment
patterns.domain: Meteorology, agriculture, environmental science, travel information, epidemiology

patterns.name: Menopause-word stem
patterns.context: Medical titles or abstracts discuss menopausal symptoms, quality of life, and assessment scales

patterns.name: Social-climber-word stem
patterns.context: In sentences describing social mobility, the upper class, and Franklin’s association with them, referring to social climbers rather than mountaineers
patterns.domain: Online commentary, discussions of social class

patterns.name: Mountaineer-word stem
patterns.context: Refers to mountaineers active in mountainous areas and associated with tourism development

patterns.name: Climax-word stem
patterns.context: Occurs in negative reviews of climactic scenes at the end of a story or work

2_258.concept: clim-词首片段
2_258.description: 激活集中在同一词首片段“clim”，覆盖 climatic/climates、climacteric、climbers、climactic 等不同续词；共享拼写线索，但语义与文体分散。

patterns.name: 气候词词干
patterns.context: 出现在天气数据、北方温室种植、温暖地区处理工艺、古气候、旅游地气候条件或疾病传播预测中；激活落在词干片段
patterns.domain: 气象、农业、环境科学、旅游说明、流行病学

patterns.name: 更年期词词干
patterns.trigger: «clim»，续接“acter”组成“climacteric”，或与后续片段组成“climacteric symptoms”“climacteric women”
patterns.context: 医学标题或摘要中讨论更年期症状、生活质量及其评估量表

patterns.name: 社交攀升者词词干
patterns.context: 在描述社会阶层流动、上层阶级及 Franklin 与其交往的句子中，指向社会攀升者，而非登山者
patterns.domain: 网络评论、社会阶层讨论

patterns.name: 登山者词词干
patterns.context: 指在高山地区活动、与旅游开发相关的登山者

patterns.name: 高潮词词干
patterns.trigger: «clim»，续接“actic”组成“climactic”，描述善恶机器人之间的战斗
patterns.context: 出现在对故事或作品结尾高潮场面的负面评价中

en.description: Strong activation is concentrated on the English word normalization and recurring Russian subword fragments beginning with пос; two other passages about food concern cream cheese and marshmallows, respectively. The examples span a wide range of contexts, with no shared semantic trigger condition evident.

patterns.name: Normalization-related terminology
patterns.context: The English word normalization occurs in different contexts, including database design, loudness processing, data processing, medical experiments, and distance measurement.
patterns.domain: Technical, scientific, and general expository text

patterns.name: Russian «после» and its subword fragment
patterns.context: A subword fragment beginning with пос occurs in Russian words; examples appear in quotations, punctuation questions, and programming Q&A.

patterns.name: Cream cheese
patterns.context: A sandwich-making instruction mentions cream cheese as an ingredient.

patterns.name: Marshmallows
patterns.context: Discusses adding marshmallows to ice cream and their texture.

2_258.concept: none
2_258.description: 强激活集中在英文单词 normalization，也反复出现在俄语以 пос 开头的子词片段；另有两段食物文本分别涉及奶油奶酪和棉花糖。各例语境跨度大，未见共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: normalization 相关术语
patterns.context: 英文文本中出现单词 normalization；涵盖数据库设计、响度处理、数据处理、医学实验和距离度量等不同语境。
patterns.domain: 技术、科学与一般说明文

patterns.name: 俄语「после」及其分词片段
patterns.context: 俄语词中出现以 пос 开头的子词片段；在引文、标点问题及编程问答等语境中均有。

patterns.name: 奶油奶酪
patterns.context: 三明治制作说明中提到奶油奶酪作为配料。

patterns.name: 棉花糖
patterns.context: 谈论冰淇淋中加入棉花糖及其口感。

en.concept: HTML table formatting and normalization term
en.description: Primarily responds to HTML table code with a top vertical-alignment attribute and its indentation and newlines; also matches CCCC background-color styles. It also strongly activates on normalization in database/research contexts and in a passage of IRC encoded text.

patterns.name: HTML table-cell alignment attribute
patterns.context: Vertical alignment is set in an HTML table row or cell tag; the attribute can occur in formatted code, email templates, or document code.

patterns.name: HTML table markup with indentation and newlines
patterns.context: Table tags appear densely, especially in HTML fragments with indentation, newlines, and cell attributes; some activation falls on the tags themselves or on newlines and whitespace.

patterns.name: CCCC color value and table styling
patterns.context: A repeated CCCC color-value fragment appears in a background-color or row-style attribute of a table tag.

patterns.name: Normalization term
patterns.context: Normalization of data, databases, or experimental results appears in an English sentence; it is a noun in context, not an HTML tag.
patterns.domain: Database discussions, research abstracts, and data processing

patterns.name: Specific character in non-Latin text
patterns.context: A specific character substring activates in the garbled/encoded non-Latin text of an Ubuntu IRC excerpt, adjacent to an emoticon and a Flickr link.

patterns.name: Whitespace and line boundaries
patterns.context: Activation occurs at formatting boundaries in HTML table code; it may co-occur with the tag pattern, but these samples alone do not establish whether it is an independent trigger.

2_258.concept: HTML表格格式与 normalization 词项
2_258.description: 主要响应带 top 垂直对齐属性的 HTML 表格代码及其缩进换行，也命中 CCCC 背景色样式；另在数据库/科研语境的 normalization 和一段 IRC 编码文本中强烈激活。

patterns.name: HTML表格单元格对齐属性
patterns.context: HTML表格行或单元格标签中设置垂直对齐；属性可出现在格式化、邮件模板或文档代码中。

patterns.name: HTML表格标记与缩进换行
patterns.context: 表格标签密集出现，尤其是带缩进、换行和单元格属性的 HTML 片段；部分激活落在标签本身或换行、空白上。

patterns.name: CCCC 色值与表格样式
patterns.context: 表格标签的背景色或行样式属性中出现重复的 CCCC 色值片段。

patterns.name: normalization 术语
patterns.context: 英文句子中出现数据、数据库或实验结果的 normalization；在上下文中是名词，不是 HTML 标记。
patterns.domain: 数据库讨论、科研摘要及数据处理

patterns.name: 非拉丁文字中的特定字符
patterns.context: Ubuntu IRC 片段的乱码/编码形式非拉丁文字中，特定字符子串获得激活，邻接表情和 Flickr 链接。

patterns.name: 空白与行边界
patterns.context: HTML 表格代码的格式化边界处出现激活；可能与标签模式并存，但仅凭这些样本无法确定它是独立触发因素。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the past-tense form figured: technical Q&A often uses “I figured it out”-style statements about solving a problem; a few personal narratives use it to express expectation or conjecture.

patterns.name: “I figured it out” in Q&A
patterns.context: In StackExchange answers, usually after a problem or failure is described, the past tense states that a solution has been found; sometimes preceded by “Finally”, “Well”, or “I think”.

patterns.name: Conjecture or plans
patterns.context: First-person past tense expresses an expectation, conjecture, or explanation of behavior rather than reporting a solution to a technical problem.

2_258.concept: 过去时 figured
2_258.description: 主要对过去时 figured 敏感：技术问答中多见“I figured it out”式解决问题陈述；少数个人叙述中表示预期或推测。

patterns.name: 问答中的“我弄明白了”
patterns.context: StackExchange 回答部分，通常在前文提出问题或描述故障后，用过去时说明已经找到解决办法；有时前置“Finally”“Well”或“I think”。

patterns.name: 推测或计划中的设想
patterns.trigger: «figured»，如“I figured it would be a hit”“I figured that gave me…”
patterns.context: 第一人称过去时表达预期、推测或对行为的解释，而非报告解决技术问题。

en.description: The strongest and most consistent activations occur on asterisk divider lines and continuation of the adip subword; other activations include conversational email notices, Q&A solution language, indented whitespace, HTML closing tags, table symbols, and phone-number digit groups.

patterns.name: Continuation of adip… in placeholder text
patterns.context: The trigger is continuation after the subword adip, forming “adipisicing” (in the original Lorem ipsum placeholder text) or “adipokines” (a biomedical term).
patterns.domain: Lorem ipsum placeholder text, medical abstracts; segments 1, 3, 6, 7

patterns.name: Long asterisk divider line
patterns.context: Consecutive asterisks form a horizontal divider in email or table/text examples; spaces or asterisk strings of varying lengths may also occur.
patterns.domain: Email formatting, StackExchange text examples; segments 2, 4, 5, 9

patterns.name: Notice or confirmation in email body
patterns.context: The email body uses conversational language to notify, confirm, or ask about arrangements, often near the email signature or a divider.

patterns.name: Expressions describing a solution in Q&A
patterns.context: In StackExchange Q&A, the poster describes finding a solution or adds a contrast in the question to explain what they have tried.

patterns.name: Indented whitespace in code/text
patterns.context: Long indents of spaces appear in code or formatting examples; activation is weaker and often adjacent to a newline or content-block boundary.
patterns.domain: HTML, Java code, and table examples; segments 4, 6, 7

patterns.name: Addresses and salutations in email correspondence
patterns.context: Email headers or closing formats appear near quoted messages, signatures, or addresses; the specific triggering fragments vary.

patterns.name: HTML closing-tag fragment
patterns.context: A partial token from a closing tag in HTML code, near a tag boundary.

patterns.name: Table borders and row layout
patterns.context: Text tables or diagrams made of vertical bars, spaces, and asterisks, with repeated rows and horizontal dividers.

patterns.name: Digit groups in phone numbers
patterns.context: A digit group beginning with a space within a phone number, appearing on a contact-information line.

2_258.concept: 格式边界与片段续写
2_258.description: 激活最强且最稳定地出现在星号分隔线，以及 adip 子词续写；另见邮件口语告知、问答解决语、缩进空白、HTML闭合标签、表格符号和电话号码数字组。

patterns.name: 占位文本中的 adip… 续写
patterns.context: 触发点是子词 adip 后接续写，形成“adipisicing”（原始占位文本中的 Lorem ipsum）或“adipokines”（生物医学术语）。
patterns.domain: Lorem ipsum 占位文本、医学摘要；段 1、3、6、7

patterns.name: 长串星号分隔线
patterns.context: 在邮件或表格/文本示例中，连续星号构成横向分隔线；可伴随空格或不同长度的星号串。
patterns.domain: 邮件格式、StackExchange 文本示例；段 2、4、5、9

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的告知或确认语
patterns.trigger: «Just»1« wanted»7 to let you know；« just»3 confirming；« tonight»7
patterns.context: 邮件正文以口语化表达告知、确认或询问安排，常接近邮件签名或分隔线。

patterns.name: 问答中的解决过程表达
patterns.context: StackExchange 问答中，发帖者描述自己找到解决办法，或在提问中转折说明已尝试的做法。

patterns.name: 代码/文本中的缩进空白
patterns.context: 代码或排版示例中出现较长空格缩进，激活较弱，常与换行或内容块边界相邻。
patterns.domain: HTML、Java 代码及表格示例；段 4、6、7

patterns.name: 邮件往来中的地址与称呼
patterns.context: 邮件引用、署名或地址附近出现邮件头/结尾格式；具体触发片段各异。

patterns.name: HTML 标签闭合片段
patterns.context: HTML 代码中闭合标签的部分 token，处于标签边界附近。

patterns.name: 表格边框与行布局
patterns.context: 用竖线、空格和星号构成的文本表格或图示，包含重复行与横向分隔。

patterns.name: 电话号码中的数字组
patterns.context: 电话号码中以空格开头的数字组，位于联系信息一行。

en.description: Activation is distributed across email separator lines and forwarding formats, Briefly, medical terminology, webpage/name fragments, and several ordinary words; these trigger forms span domains and lack a unified semantic or stable syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Dash separator
patterns.context: Long dashes in email bodies, especially in forwarded messages or at email endings; passage 1 also includes a repeated alphanumeric decorative string.

patterns.name: Forwarded-email marker
patterns.context: A forwarding notice in an email header or record, often immediately following a dash separator.

patterns.name: Briefly term
patterns.context: Briefly introduces a short explanation in a sentence, following a methods description or an explanation of a rule change.

patterns.name: Medical term hypox-
patterns.context: Hypoxia-related words occur in medical contexts, involving nocturnal symptoms in one instance and pregnancy research in another.

patterns.name: Special proper names or word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on a character in a Chinese name, a word-internal fragment in a URL/domain, and a proper-name fragment in legal text; no shared semantics or stable contextual condition is evident.

patterns.name: Common words in email bodies
patterns.context: Narrative wording in ordinary business emails; activation is distributed across different words, with no clear shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Email sign-off
patterns.context: A polite sign-off at the end of an email.

patterns.name: Entry line break and separator
patterns.context: An email record has a line break followed by a long separator line and then forwarding information.

patterns.name: Author name in a literature citation
patterns.context: A fragment of an author’s surname in a citation in an experimental methods section.

patterns.name: Words in legal discussion
patterns.context: Connectives or references to preceding statements in legal narrative; a marked proper-name fragment also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Medical term oxytocin
patterns.context: A pregnancy study describes conditions such as maternal exercise, hypoxia, or oxytocin infusion.

patterns.name: Time expression in email
patterns.context: An email states when a rule revision takes effect.

patterns.name: Name fragment in email
patterns.context: The sender’s name in a forwarded email header.

patterns.name: Local expressions in business email
patterns.context: A brief email subject or opening-style record, followed by a forwarding marker and separator line.

patterns.name: Chinese characters in a Chinese name
patterns.context: The Chinese characters in the Chinese name Jawshing Arthur Liou are marked separately.

2_258.concept: none
2_258.description: 激活分散在邮件横线与转发格式、Briefly、医学术语、网页/人名片段及若干普通词上；这些触发形式跨域且缺少统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 横线分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的长横线，尤见转发/邮件尾部；第1段还伴随重复的字母数字装饰串。

patterns.name: 转发邮件标记
patterns.context: 邮件头或邮件记录中出现转发说明，常紧跟横线分隔符。

patterns.name: Briefly 词项
patterns.context: 句中以 Briefly 引出简要说明，位于方法描述或规则变更说明之后。

patterns.name: 医学术语 hypox-
patterns.context: 缺氧相关词出现在医学语境；分别涉及夜间症状和孕期研究。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、医学项目描述

patterns.name: 特殊专名或词内片段
patterns.trigger: «»劉«»肇«»、«興»；« mov»abletype、« text»pattern、« ell»« isl»ab、« hab»ariproject；O«asis»
patterns.context: 激活落在中文姓名的字、网址/域名的词内片段及法律文本中的专名片段，未见共同语义或稳定上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、网页链接、法律文书

patterns.name: 邮件正文常见词
patterns.context: 普通商务邮件中的叙述性措辞；激活分散于不同词，未显示明确共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 邮件署名
patterns.context: 邮件结尾的礼貌署名。

patterns.name: 条目换行与分隔线
patterns.context: 邮件记录中换行后接长分隔线，再出现转发信息。

patterns.name: 文献引用中的作者名
patterns.context: 实验方法段中引用文献的作者姓氏片段。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的词语
patterns.context: 法律叙述中连接或指代前述陈述；同段还出现被标记的专名片段。

patterns.name: 医学词项 oxytocin
patterns.context: 孕期研究中描述母体运动、缺氧或催产素输注等条件。

patterns.name: 邮件时间表达
patterns.context: 邮件说明规则修订的生效时间。

patterns.name: 邮件人名片段
patterns.context: 转发邮件头中的发送者姓名。

patterns.name: 商务邮件局部表达
patterns.context: 简短邮件主题或开头式记录，后接转发标记与分隔线。

patterns.name: 中文人名字符
patterns.context: 中文姓名 Jawshing Arthur Liou 的汉字部分被分别标记。

en.concept: hypox word fragment and miscellaneous patterns
en.description: Primarily responds to hypox-/hyp- medical word fragments; it also activates on the Antar substring, Cyrillic word fragments, and sporadic words and markers in recipes, paper formatting, and sports entries, with no consistent trigger for the latter categories.

patterns.name: Hypoxia-related medical terms
patterns.context: A medical passage contains physiological or clinical terms beginning with hypox-/hyp-; contexts include hypoxia, sleep breathing, and metabolites.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patent background, life sciences papers

patterns.name: Specific subword fragment Antar
patterns.context: The Antar substring appears across token boundaries in a place name and a religious ritual name.

patterns.name: Cyrillic word-initial fragment
patterns.context: A list contains consecutive words beginning with the Cyrillic letters з or иб; activation falls on word-initial or internal fragments.
patterns.domain: Multilingual vocabulary lists in code repositories

patterns.name: Local activation on common nouns or adjectives
patterns.context: Several everyday words are marked in a cooking narrative, with no clear shared semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Common words, numbers, and formatting markers
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across paper conclusion formatting, player names, rule titles, and sports-rule narratives, with no unified local context.
patterns.domain: Papers, encyclopedia entries, and sports event entries

2_258.concept: hypox词片段及杂项模式
2_258.description: 主要响应 hypox-/hyp- 医学词片段；另对 Antar 子串、西里尔词片段及食谱、论文格式和体育条目中的零散词与标记激活，后几类缺乏一致触发条件。

patterns.name: hypoxia 相关医学术语
patterns.context: 医学段落中出现以 hypox-/hyp- 开头的生理或临床术语；涉及低氧、睡眠呼吸、代谢物等不同语境
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利背景、生命科学论文

patterns.name: 特定子词片段 Antar
patterns.context: 词语跨切分 token 呈现 Antar 子串，分别出现在地名和宗教仪式名称中

patterns.name: 西里尔字母词首片段
patterns.context: 列表中连续出现以西里尔字母 з 或 иб 开头的词，激活落在词首或词内片段
patterns.domain: 代码仓库中的多语言词汇列表

patterns.name: 一般名词或形容词的局部激活
patterns.context: 烹饪叙述中若干日常词被标记，缺少明显共同语义或句法触发条件

patterns.name: 普通词、数字及格式标记
patterns.context: 激活分散于论文结论格式、球员姓名、规则标题及体育规则叙述，未见统一局部上下文
patterns.domain: 论文、百科及体育赛事条目

en.description: Strong triggers cluster in words ending in -ation and the hypoxemia root; others occur in fragments of Restriction, whipped, reserved, documentclass, and similar words. Contexts span experiments, medicine, code, email, and everyday text.

patterns.name: The suffix “ation” within words
patterns.context: Trigger words end in -ation, including whole words and word fragments; examples occur in experimental procedures, statistical parameters, and automotive care contexts
patterns.domain: Biological experiments, machine-learning Q&A, automotive care

patterns.name: The medical root “hypox”
patterns.context: Medical or physiological texts mention hypoxemia; the activation marker falls on the root

patterns.name: Possible intraword trigger in “restriction”
patterns.context: Class-restriction elements in OWL/XML code; the marker falls only on a fragment of the word spelled Restriction

patterns.name: A wh- fragment in a phrase
patterns.context: A recipe review describes making a sauce; the marker covers whipped

patterns.name: reserved in a travel email
patterns.context: The email body mentions a reserved one-way ticket; activation falls on reserved

patterns.name: documentclass in a LaTeX command
patterns.context: A StackExchange answer shows a LaTeX command; activation covers the command name

2_258.concept: 词内特定片段触发
2_258.description: 强触发集中在以 -ation 结尾的词及 hypoxemia 词根；其余分别落在 Restriction、whipped、reserved、documentclass 等词片段，语境横跨实验、医学、代码、邮件和生活文本。

patterns.name: 词中后缀“ation”
patterns.context: 触发词以 -ation 结尾，涵盖完整词或词的一部分；分别出现在实验步骤、统计参数、汽车护理语境
patterns.domain: 生物实验、机器学习问答、汽车护理

patterns.name: “hypox”医学词根
patterns.context: 医学或生理学文本中提到低氧血症；激活标记落在词根部分

patterns.name: 疑似“restriction”词内触发
patterns.context: OWL/XML 代码中的类限制元素；标记只落在拼写为 Restriction 的词内片段

patterns.name: 短语中的 wh-词片段
patterns.context: 食谱评论中描述制作酱料，标记覆盖 whipped

patterns.name: 旅行邮件中的 reserved
patterns.context: 邮件正文提及预订单程机票；激活落在 reserved

patterns.name: LaTeX 命令中的 documentclass
patterns.context: StackExchange 回答中展示 LaTeX 命令；激活覆盖命令名

en.concept: Document templates and formatting boundary markers
en.description: The neuron primarily responds to two types of templates: the Forwarded forwarding footer and its address, phone number, and divider formatting in Enron emails; and cycling and denaturation steps in PCR methods. It also responds to newlines, horizontal lines, and a few biomedical headings and music catalog formats.

patterns.name: “Forwarded” email divider line
patterns.context: After an email body or signature, a line of hyphens identifies the forwarder; activation is concentrated mainly on Forwarded, with hyphens also activating.

patterns.name: Denaturation in PCR amplification cycles
patterns.context: Experimental PCR methods describe temperature, duration, and cycling steps; especially denaturation, accompanied by cycles.

patterns.name: Houston address and phone number
patterns.context: A Houston, Texas mailing address in an address or signature, and a 713 area-code phone number; these may co-occur with the email-forwarding template.

patterns.name: Newlines and horizontal-line dividers
patterns.context: Newlines and horizontal-line dividers near email forwarding markers, document paragraphs, or section headings.

patterns.name: Tibetan band discography entry
patterns.context: An album title is adjacent to the year and related release information in a music entry or discography.

patterns.name: Western blot section heading
patterns.context: A Western blot analysis section heading in an experimental paper, appearing after descriptions of primers and reference genes.

2_258.concept: 文档模板与格式边界标记
2_258.description: 神经元主要响应两类模板：Enron 邮件中的 Forwarded 转发尾行及其地址、电话、分隔排版；PCR 方法中循环与变性步骤。另对换行、横线及少数生物医学标题和音乐目录格式有响应。

patterns.name: “Forwarded” 邮件分隔行
patterns.context: 邮件正文或签名之后，以连字符分隔并标示转发者；激活主要集中在 Forwarded 一词，连字符也会激活。

patterns.name: PCR 扩增循环中的变性
patterns.context: PCR 实验方法中，描述温度、时长及循环步骤；尤其是 denaturation（变性），并伴随 cycles。

patterns.name: 休斯敦地址及电话号码
patterns.context: 地址或签名中的 Houston, Texas 邮政地址，及 713 区号电话号码；可能与邮件转发模板同现。

patterns.name: 换行及横线分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件转发标记、文档段落或章节标题附近的换行和横线分隔符。

patterns.name: 西藏乐队唱片目录条目
patterns.context: 音乐条目标题或唱片目录中，专辑名、年份与相关发行信息相邻。

patterns.name: Western blot 章节标题
patterns.context: 实验论文中，在引物和内参描述之后出现 Western blot 分析章节标题。

en.description: Activations are scattered across metabolic indicators, code formatting, legal documents, PCR steps, recipe narratives, multilingual lists, and email signatures; no single word sense or context spans all passages.

patterns.name: Blood lipids and metabolic indicators
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts listing, measuring, and statistically analyzing blood or metabolic indicators; especially triglycerides, but also related indicators such as glucose, insulin, and cholesterol.

patterns.name: Structural boundaries and comments in code
patterns.context: Activation falls near comment markers, whitespace and line breaks, and structural tags in code or configuration files; segment 2 also contains mixed Chinese tokens, while segment 4 has XML/plist structure.

patterns.name: Legal document layout and dates
patterns.context: Near centered text, column labels, and date information on the first page of court decisions or legal documents.

patterns.name: PCR procedures and cycling conditions
patterns.context: Specific temperatures, durations, and cycle steps appear together in descriptions of PCR amplification methods.

patterns.name: Recipes and food reviews
patterns.context: Personal narratives describe making or using sauces, preparing dinner, and evaluating nutritional value or food preservation.

patterns.name: Cyrillic script in lists of language names
patterns.context: In lists of multilingual names or language codes, Cyrillic spellings alternate with Latin-letter codes in parentheses.

patterns.name: Email forwarding and contact information
patterns.context: Office address, telephone, and fax signatures in an email body, followed by a forwarded-message marker.

2_258.concept: none
2_258.description: 激活分散于代谢指标、代码排版、法律文书、PCR步骤、食谱叙述、多语种列表及邮件签名；未见能覆盖各段的单一词义或语境。

patterns.name: 血脂与代谢指标
patterns.context: 出现在血液或代谢指标列举、测量及统计分析的语境中；尤其是甘油三酯，也包括葡萄糖、胰岛素、胆固醇等相关指标。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构边界与注释
patterns.context: 激活落在代码或配置文件的注释标记、空白换行及结构标签附近；第2段还包含混杂的中文 token，第4段是 XML/plist 结构。

patterns.name: 法律文书排版与日期
patterns.context: 法院判决或法律文件首页的居中排版、栏目标签和日期信息附近。

patterns.name: PCR 实验流程与循环条件
patterns.context: PCR 扩增方法描述中，具体温度、时间和循环步骤相邻出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学方法

patterns.name: 食谱与食物评价
patterns.context: 个人叙述自制或使用酱料、准备晚餐，并评价营养价值或保存食物。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 论坛或博客式文本

patterns.name: 语言名称列表中的西里尔字母
patterns.context: 多语种名称或语言代码列表中，西里尔字母拼写与括号内拉丁字母代码交替出现。
patterns.domain: GitHub 多语言数据或列表

patterns.name: 邮件转发与联系信息
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的办公地址、电话和传真签名，随后出现转发邮件标记。

en.concept: Specific word fragments and subword patterns
en.description: Activation is concentrated on several local word fragments: freakonomics in URLs, synthesis/synthesizer in music lists, and triglycerides and denaturation in medical contexts. There are also sporadic activations on webpage CSS properties and some title words, entry titles, and narrative words, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: freakonomics string in a domain name
patterns.context: Appears in a URL or blog domain; after tokenization, activation falls on the freak part.

patterns.name: synthesis suffix fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a list of musicians, referring to a synthesizer or performer; activation is concentrated near the synthesis/synthes stem.

patterns.name: triglycerides word-ending fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a medical abstract on baseline measures and genetic and environmental correlations.

patterns.name: denaturation word-ending fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a PCR procedure describing denaturation during each cycle after Taq polymerase activation.

patterns.name: Webpage styling and line-height property
patterns.context: In inline CSS in an HTML button tag; tokens near the refresh button text also activate.

patterns.name: Near the Raw Nerve program name
patterns.context: A TV-program narrative about watching a show to relax and mentioning William Shatner; activation is scattered across common words, with no clear shared word form.

patterns.name: Local word fragments in titles
patterns.context: Appear separately in words in news headlines, with no stable shared word form or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Unclear title or list fragments
patterns.context: Appear separately in musician names and entry subtitles; the specific shared trigger cannot be determined from the available samples.

2_258.concept: 特定词片段与子词模式
2_258.description: 激活较集中于若干局部词片段：URL 中 freakonomics、音乐名单中的 synthesis/synthesizer、医学词 triglycerides 与 denaturation；另有网页 CSS 属性及若干标题词、条目标题和叙述词的零散激活，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 域名中的 freakonomics 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在 URL 或博客域名中；分词后激活落在 freak 部分。

patterns.name: synthesis 后缀片段
patterns.context: 出现在乐器人员名单中，指合成器或演奏者；激活集中在 synthesis/synthes 词干附近。

patterns.name: triglycerides 词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在基线指标及遗传、环境相关性的医学摘要中。

patterns.name: denaturation 词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在 PCR 流程中，描述 Taq 聚合酶激活后各循环中的变性步骤。

patterns.name: 网页样式与行高属性
patterns.context: HTML 按钮标签的内联 CSS 中；同时激活了刷新按钮文字附近的 token。

patterns.name: Raw Nerve 节目名附近
patterns.context: 电视节目叙述中，观看节目放松并提及 William Shatner；激活分散在普通词语上，缺乏明确共同词形。

patterns.name: 标题中的局部词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在新闻标题中的标题词，未显示稳定的共同词形或句法条件。

patterns.name: 未明的标题或名单片段
patterns.context: 分别位于音乐人员名称及条目小标题中；无法从现有样本确定具体共同触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered: many hit the letter string upp (including Wuppertal and Yuppie), as well as URLs, names, ordinary words, musical terms, and medical/biological paper fragments. Apart from upp, no stable, unified contextual condition is evident.

patterns.name: The string fragment in Wuppertal
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter string upp across word boundaries or within words; examples include the proper name Wuppertal, the username Yuppie, and spellings related to uppercase.
patterns.domain: Forum text, railway encyclopedia, mathematics papers, technical discussion

patterns.name: Domain fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Activation occurs within URL domain/path strings, especially the continuous letter string freakonomics.

patterns.name: Fragments of the name OASIS
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across the name OASIS, its variants, or related URLs; it does not fall only on the complete word OASIS.

patterns.name: Fragments of proper names and common words
patterns.context: Within the same passage, multiple markers fall on different subword fragments of common words and proper names; there is no obvious consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Case-related fragments in software/terminology
patterns.context: In forum discussions of proper-name spelling or capitalization, activation falls on local letter fragments; these share a formal overlap with other upp examples.

patterns.name: Fragments of musical terms
patterns.context: Occurs in lists of instruments and vocal roles by member; markers involve musical roles and instrument words.

patterns.name: Fragments in medical image captions
patterns.context: In medical figure captions and accompanying article identifiers, activation involves both caption words and digit strings.

patterns.name: Fragments in nucleic acid hybridization contexts
patterns.context: In sentences explaining sequence matching, label colors, and whether hybridization occurs, activation falls on experimental-description words.

2_258.concept: none
2_258.description: 激活较分散：多处命中 upp 字母串（含 Wuppertal、Yuppie），也命中网址、名称、普通词、音乐术语及医学/生物论文片段；除 upp 外未见稳定统一的上下文条件。

patterns.name: Wuppertal 字符串片段
patterns.trigger: «upp»，出现在 “DamnYuppie” 的 «upp»9、“W«upp»ertal” 的 «upp»9、“W«upp»ertal” 的 «upp»8，以及 “MTorrent though («upp»«ercase»)” 中的 «upp»9
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词或词内的字母串 upp；包括专名 Wuppertal、用户名 Yuppie，以及与 uppercase 相关的拼写。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、铁路百科、数学论文、技术讨论

patterns.name: 网址中的域名片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 URL 的域名/路径字符串内部，尤其是 freakonomics 这一连续字母串。

patterns.name: OASIS 名称片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在 OASIS 名称、其变体或相关网址的片段上；并非只落在完整单词 OASIS。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、系统/网站名称

patterns.name: 专名及常见词片段
patterns.trigger: «night»、«habit»、«put»、«relax»、«nodding»、«off»、«On»、«Raw»、«ole»、«sw»，位于 “last night”“habitually put on”“relax … nodding off”“Raw Nerve”“ole’ Bill”“swashbuckling” 中
patterns.context: 同一段内多个标记落在普通词和专名的不同子词片段；没有明显一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 电视节目及随笔式叙述

patterns.name: 软件/术语中的大小写相关片段
patterns.context: 论坛讨论中说明专名拼写或大小写，激活落在局部字母片段；与其他 upp 例子有形式上的重合。

patterns.name: 音乐术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在按成员列出的乐器与演唱分工中，标记涉及音乐角色和器乐词。

patterns.name: 医学图像说明片段
patterns.trigger: «Summary»、«Plain»、«1471»，位于 “Summary of the radiographic findings”“Plain radiographs” 及文献编号中
patterns.context: 医学图注及其后附带的文章编号，激活同时涉及图注词语和数字串。

patterns.name: 核酸杂交语境词片段
patterns.trigger: «strands»、«marked»，位于 “red labeled strands”“green labeled strands”“marked with X’s” 中
patterns.context: 在解释序列匹配、标记颜色及是否杂交的句子中，激活落在实验描述词语上。

en.description: All segments come from Preliminaries/Prelims headings or section anchors in ArXiv papers, and activation is concentrated on a local fragment of “Preliminaries”; other activated words are scattered across mathematical terms, formulas, and section navigation and vary in topic.

patterns.name: Fragment in the Preliminaries heading
patterns.context: Appears in an ArXiv paper section heading or section anchor, often followed by a newline, an underline beneath the heading, or the section body; some instances are spelled “Prelims”.
patterns.domain: Academic paper structure and section headings

patterns.name: Paper structure and section navigation
patterns.context: The paper body summarizes where results appear, the arrangement of proofs, special cases, or conclusions; activation is distributed over these words, and the same words do not necessarily occur in every segment.

patterns.name: Mathematical proper nouns and symbol fragments
patterns.context: Appear in technical statements, formulas, or subsection headings in mathematical papers; activation falls on local tokens within terms that are not semantically consistent with one another.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Nonconvex optimization and Lipschitz gradients
patterns.context: Discusses potentially nonconvex objective functions, gradient conditions, and constant lower bounds, and cites a theorem.
patterns.domain: Optimization and theoretical machine learning papers

patterns.name: Closed-set construction
patterns.context: In a formal mathematical statement, a set is closed under a function, i.e. f[M^{<ω}] ⊆ M.

patterns.name: Hypercube partitioning of graphs
patterns.context: Introduces the problem of partitioning a hypercube into copies of a graph and related work.

patterns.name: Boundary-condition and source-term framework
patterns.context: A subsection citation notes that multivalued boundary conditions and source terms are special cases of a general framework and mentions numerical examples.

patterns.name: Optimal estimates on an interval
patterns.context: Summarizes that later sections of the paper will examine the one-dimensional case and optimal estimates on a bounded interval.
patterns.domain: Analysis or partial differential equations research

patterns.name: Primes and quadratic-field results
patterns.context: Involves prime splitting, quadratic fields, and congruences modulo primes; triggering fragments are scattered across formulas and subsection headings.

patterns.name: Odd case in a section heading
patterns.context: Part of a paper subsection heading, following an introduction to related work on the hypercube partition problem.

patterns.name: Citations of results
patterns.context: A section opens by listing prior results with citations; the activated fragment is the section-heading marker, not the cited material itself.

2_258.concept: Preliminaries章节标记
2_258.description: 所有片段都来自 ArXiv 论文的 Preliminaries/Prelims 标题或章节锚点，且激活集中在“Preliminaries”的局部片段；其余激活词分散于数学术语、公式及章节导览，主题各异。

patterns.name: Preliminaries 标题中的片段
patterns.trigger: “Prelim”或“Preliminaries”，激活具体落在“Prelim”及“relim”片段上（如 «relim»10inaries）
patterns.context: 出现在 ArXiv 论文的章节标题或章节锚点中，常紧接换行、标题下划线或章节正文；个别实例拼作“Prelims”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文结构与章节标题

patterns.name: 论文结构与章节导航
patterns.trigger: “Section”“paper”“proved”“present”“remarks”“estimates”等章节指引或论文组织用语
patterns.context: 论文正文概述结果所在章节、证明安排、特例或结论；激活分布在这些词上，未必每段都出现相同词。
patterns.domain: 学术论文写作，尤其章节导览

patterns.name: 数学专名与符号片段
patterns.trigger: “qubit”“Lipschitz”“bound”“subset”“mathbb”“sqrt”“Jacob”等数学术语、符号或名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学论文的技术陈述、公式或小节标题中；激活落在术语内部的局部 token，彼此语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 非凸优化与 Lipschitz 梯度
patterns.context: 讨论可能非凸的目标函数、梯度条件和常数下界，并引用定理。
patterns.domain: 优化与理论机器学习论文

patterns.name: 封闭集构造
patterns.context: 形式化数学陈述中，集合在函数作用下闭合，即 f[M^{<ω}] ⊆ M。

patterns.name: 图的超立方体划分
patterns.context: 介绍把超立方体划分为某图副本的问题及相关研究。

patterns.name: 边界条件与源项框架
patterns.context: 小节引用指出多值边界条件和源项是一般框架的特例，并提及数值例子。

patterns.name: 区间上的最优估计
patterns.context: 总结论文后续章节将考察一维情形和有界区间上的最优估计。
patterns.domain: 分析或偏微分方程研究

patterns.name: 素数与二次域结果
patterns.context: 涉及素数分裂、二次域以及模素数同余；触发片段分散在公式与小节标题中。

patterns.name: 章节标题中的 odd case
patterns.context: 作为论文小节标题的一部分，紧接对超立方体划分问题相关工作的介绍。

patterns.name: 结果文献引用
patterns.trigger: “results have been obtained”及后续参考文献标记
patterns.context: 章节开头用引文列举已有结果；激活片段是章节标题标记，而非引文内容本身。

en.description: Activations concentrate primarily on intraword fragments in Slavic languages; others occur in XML build attributes, C/C++ preprocessor directives, OASIS/URLs, LaTeX commands, and structural terms in English forums and papers. No unified semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: Marked subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on consecutive letter fragments within words, rather than whole words; primarily in Polish and Russian texts.
patterns.domain: Slavic parliamentary texts and Russian web content

patterns.name: XML tags and build attributes
patterns.context: Occurs in tags, attributes, or configuration expressions in XML-style project files.

patterns.name: C/C++ preprocessor directives
patterns.context: Occurs in C/C++ preprocessor directives beginning with #.

patterns.name: OASIS name and internal fragments
patterns.context: Around the name of the OASIS organization/site and test URLs; activation fragments include both the complete word and substrings within it.
patterns.domain: Technical organizations and URLs in Enron email

patterns.name: Mathematical typesetting commands
patterns.context: Occurs in LaTeX mathematical formulas, especially commands for labels and typesetting commutative diagrams.

patterns.name: English function words and specific word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in English accounts of privacy, secure versions, and continued use of old versions; activation is scattered across words.

patterns.name: Paper structure markers
patterns.context: Occurs near section references, titles, or body terminology in papers on quantum bits.

2_258.concept: 混合的词片段与标记
2_258.description: 激活最集中于斯拉夫语词内片段；另见 XML 构建属性、C/C++ 预处理指令、OASIS/网址、LaTeX 命令及英语论坛和论文结构用词，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 被标记的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的连续字母片段上，而非完整词；主要出现在波兰语、俄语文本中。
patterns.domain: 斯拉夫语议会文本及俄语网页内容

patterns.name: XML 标签与构建属性
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 风格的项目文件标签、属性或配置表达式中。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的项目/构建配置代码

patterns.name: C/C++ 预处理指令
patterns.context: 出现在以 # 开头的 C/C++ 预处理指令中。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 C/C++ 源码

patterns.name: OASIS 名称及其内部片段
patterns.context: 围绕 OASIS 组织/站点名称及测试网址；激活片段包含完整词和词内子串。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的技术组织与网址

patterns.name: 数学排版命令
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学公式中，尤其是标签及交换图排版命令。

patterns.name: 英语功能词与特定词形
patterns.context: 出现在关于隐私、安全版本及长期使用旧版本的英语叙述中；激活分散在词上。

patterns.name: 论文结构标记
patterns.context: 出现在量子比特论文的章节引用、标题或正文术语附近。

en.concept: Local string fragments across multiple corpora
en.description: Activation is scattered across several local forms: numbers and reference identifiers, XML configuration tags, fragments within Polish words, several English word fragments, and whitespace formatting in email; the domains and semantics vary widely.

patterns.name: Numbers, identifiers, and reference identifiers
patterns.context: Appear in compact numeric strings such as chemical formulas, DOIs, journal volume and page numbers, or reference numbers; a fragment within or adjacent to the numeric string can trigger.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, references, and supplementary-material links

patterns.name: XML/project configuration syntax
patterns.context: Appears in angle-bracketed XML tags or Visual C++ project configuration, especially closing tags, attribute names, and configuration conditions.

patterns.name: Polish morphological fragments
patterns.context: These fragments are embedded in Polish word forms; some occur in polite forms of address, inflections, or words containing diacritics.
patterns.domain: European Parliament Polish speeches and translations

patterns.name: Specific English word fragments
patterns.context: Appear in English sentences or figure captions, distributed across different word classes and contexts; no unified local semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Biochemistry and materials science papers, and news emails

patterns.name: Whitespace and layout placeholders
patterns.context: Appear in image placeholders and irregular whitespace and newline formatting in news emails.
patterns.domain: Enron email and embedded news briefs

2_258.concept: 多语料局部字符串片段
2_258.description: 激活分散在多类局部形式：数字及文献编号、XML 配置标签、波兰语词内片段、若干英语词片段，以及邮件中的空白排版；学科与语义跨度很大。

patterns.name: 数字、编号与文献标识符
patterns.context: 出现在化学式、DOI、期刊卷页号或文献编号等紧凑数字串中；数字串内部或相邻数字片段会触发
patterns.domain: 学术论文、参考文献与补充材料链接

patterns.name: XML/项目配置语法
patterns.context: 出现在带尖括号的 XML 标签或 Visual C++ 项目配置中，尤其是闭合标签、属性名和配置条件

patterns.name: 波兰语形态片段
patterns.context: 这些片段嵌在波兰语词形中；部分出现在礼貌称呼、变格或含变音符号的词中
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会波兰语发言与译文

patterns.name: 特定英语词片段
patterns.context: 出现在英语句子或图注中，分布于不同词类和语境；未见统一的局部语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 生物化学、材料科学论文及新闻邮件

patterns.name: 空白与排版占位
patterns.context: 出现在新闻邮件的图片占位符和不规则空白、换行排版中
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及嵌入式新闻简报

en.description: Activations involve structural markers and boundaries, technical identifiers, paper citations, and intraword fragments in Russian and Polish. They span multiple corpora, with no single semantic theme explaining all instances.

patterns.name: XML/HTML markup
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on tag names or attribute fragments enclosed in angle brackets; occurs in webpage body markup and project configuration XML.

patterns.name: Newline token
patterns.context: The newline itself is marked in text after a heading, source-code comment sections, and paper paragraph boundaries; the trigger is not specific to one genre.

patterns.name: Substrings within technical identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs in source-code tool names or URL parameters and paths, often as part of a technical compound word.
patterns.domain: Go source code, IUCr data links

patterns.name: English paper citation markers
patterns.context: Occurs in bracketed citations followed by numbers; both instances are in mathematical paper statements or proofs.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Russian
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across Russian words or near word boundaries; the same passage also contains HTML tags, so it is unclear whether Russian morphological fragments or adjacent markup jointly trigger it.

patterns.name: Fragment within a personal name
patterns.context: Occurs within the personal name Benjamin Guigonnet in an English sentence.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Polish
patterns.context: Occurs in Polish parliamentary speech, distributed across forms of address and within words.

patterns.name: Build configuration value fragments
patterns.context: Located in paths, conditional expressions, and configuration values in Visual C++ project XML.

2_258.concept: 文本结构与标识符片段
2_258.description: 激活涉及结构标记与边界、技术标识符、论文引文，以及俄语和波兰语词内片段；跨多种语料，未见单一语义主题能解释全部现象。

patterns.name: XML/HTML 标记
patterns.context: 激活集中于尖括号包围的标签名或属性片段；出现于网页正文标记及项目配置文件 XML。

patterns.name: 换行符 token
patterns.context: 换行符本身被标记，分别出现在标题后的文本、源码注释区和论文段落边界；触发不依赖单一文体。

patterns.name: 技术标识符内部子串
patterns.context: 出现在源码工具名或 URL 参数、路径中，常为技术复合词的一部分。
patterns.domain: Go 源码、IUCr 数据链接

patterns.name: 英文论文引文标记
patterns.context: 出现在方括号引用中，后接编号；两处均为数学论文陈述或证明语境。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在俄语词或词边界附近；同段还出现 HTML 标签，无法确定是俄语形态片段本身还是邻近标记共同触发。

patterns.name: 人名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在英文句子中的人名 Benjamin Guigonnet 内部。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语议会发言中，分布于称呼及词语内部。

patterns.name: 构建配置值片段
patterns.context: 位于 Visual C++ 项目 XML 的路径、条件表达式和配置值中。

en.concept: Text structure and technical terminology markers
en.description: Activations appear across code and build/dependency markers, Wikipedia table-row markers, line-break boundaries, expressions of concern and persistence in forums, and biomedical metrics and laboratory terminology; these patterns cannot all be attributed to one specific semantic category.

patterns.name: Code and configuration markers
patterns.context: Appears in source-code comments, XML project files, npm lock files, or code copyright headers; often adjacent to identifiers for files, builds, dependencies, and package registries.

patterns.name: Structured table markers
patterns.context: A table-row boundary in Wikipedia markup, within a ranking or statistics table.

patterns.name: Line-break boundaries
patterns.context: Appears at blank lines or paragraph separators in context; one occurs between sentences in a version discussion, and another before a laboratory subsection heading.

patterns.name: Concern-related wording
patterns.context: Refers to concern about privacy in “a lot of worry about privacy”.

patterns.name: Adherence or persistence expressions
patterns.context: “stuck with 1.6.1” means continuing to use a particular version for years.

patterns.name: Medical metrics and measurement terminology
patterns.context: Appears in research abstracts or methods sections, involving blood lipids, blood pressure, body measurements, exercise interventions, sample collection and processing, and laboratory tests.

2_258.concept: 文本结构与专业术语标记
2_258.description: 激活散见于代码与构建/依赖标记、维基表格行标记、换行边界、论坛中的担忧与坚持用语，以及生物医学指标和实验室术语；这些模式并不都能归为同一具体语义。

patterns.name: 代码与配置标记
patterns.context: 出现在源码注释、XML 项目文件、npm 锁文件或代码版权头中；常邻接文件、构建、依赖、包注册表等标识符。

patterns.name: 结构化表格标记
patterns.context: 维基标记语言中表格行的边界，位于排名或统计表格内。

patterns.name: 换行边界
patterns.context: 出现在上下文中的空行或段落分隔处；一处位于版本讨论的句间，另一处位于实验室小节标题前。

patterns.name: 担忧相关词
patterns.context: 在“a lot of worry about privacy”中指对隐私的担忧。

patterns.name: 黏附或坚持表达
patterns.context: “stuck with 1.6.1”表示多年继续使用某一版本。

patterns.name: 医学指标与测量术语
patterns.trigger: « controls»、« plasma»、« triglycerides»、« fatty»；« physiological»、« blood»、« density»、« lipoprotein»、«HDL»、« cholesterol»、« waist»、« hip»；« exercise»、« adherence»、« diastolic»；« Laboratory»、« EDTA»、« centrifuged»
patterns.context: 出现在研究摘要或方法部分，涉及血脂、血压、体型指标、运动干预、样本采集处理及实验室检测。

en.description: Activations are distributed across local subwords, markers, and string fragments in various texts, especially ACS Supporting Information URLs; there are also line breaks, dates, and scattered English words, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Split subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls in the middle of words or on subword fragments in XML/code markers, URLs, and foreign-language words; surrounding text provides spelling or grammatical context, but no fixed semantic meaning is required
patterns.domain: Mixed: code, XML, technology article titles, papers, Russian webpages, and reviews

patterns.name: Supporting Information URL format
patterns.context: Link to Supporting Information in an ACS paper citation; the URL contains a journal domain, a suppl path, and a DOI

patterns.name: Line-break marker
patterns.context: Activation corresponds to a newline character, occurring at paragraph breaks in source-code comments or webpage reviews

patterns.name: Year digits
patterns.context: Digits form part of a date in a news-link URL

patterns.name: Emphatic evaluative words
patterns.context: When discussing software-version security and privacy concerns, activation falls on words related to concern

patterns.name: Trailing tone or structural fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on ordinary English function words, occurring in a subordinate clause and near a sentence-initial adverbial; no clear, stable semantic condition is evident

2_258.concept: 字符串与局部文本片段
2_258.description: 激活分布于多种文本中的局部子词、标记和字符串片段，尤见 ACS 补充材料 URL；另有换行、日期及零散英语词，未显示统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 拆分子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词中间或 XML/代码标记、网址、外语词的子词片段上；周围文本提供拼写或语法上下文，不要求某一固定语义
patterns.domain: 混合：代码、XML、科技文章标题、论文、俄语网页和评论

patterns.name: 补充材料网址格式
patterns.context: ACS 论文引用 Supporting Information 的链接，URL 含期刊域名、suppl 路径及 DOI

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 激活标记对应换行符，出现在源码注释或网页评论的段落分隔处

patterns.name: 年份数字
patterns.context: 数字作为新闻链接 URL 的日期组成部分

patterns.name: 强调性评价词
patterns.context: 谈及软件版本安全性与隐私顾虑时，激活落在担忧相关词上

patterns.name: 尾部语气或结构片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英语功能词上，分别处于句中从句及句首状语附近；没有明显稳定的语义条件

en.description: Activations are distributed across word-internal fragments in URLs/identifiers, blood centrifugation and lipid terminology in medical papers, Russian subword fragments, code and typesetting boundary markers, and privacy-discussion wording; no single semantic trigger explains all samples.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of towards
patterns.context: The domain towardsdatascience.com in a URL is tokenized as tow + ards; activation concentrates on the initial word fragment in the URL.

patterns.name: System-call identifier fragment
patterns.context: Appears in Go/C source identifiers mksyscall and sfsyscall; the trigger is the internal syscall fragment, not general natural language.

patterns.name: Blood centrifugation processing
patterns.context: Laboratory method descriptions of blood collection, fasting tests, adding EDTA anticoagulant tubes, and centrifugation; the centrifugation term activates most strongly.
patterns.domain: Methods sections of medical papers on PubMed

patterns.name: In-word segmentation of lipid terminology
patterns.context: Medical indicator names hypertriglyceridemia and high density lipoprotein-cholesterol are split into tokens; activation falls on multiple fragments within the terms.
patterns.domain: PubMed clinical studies and diagnostic criteria

patterns.name: DOI fragment in an academic supplementary-material link
patterns.context: A tokenized fragment in an ACS Supporting Information URL/DOI; it does not show the same trigger as blood testing content.
patterns.domain: Supplementary-material citations in PubMed chemistry papers

patterns.name: Russian in-word fragment
patterns.context: Internal fragments of Cyrillic words in Russian sentences are marked; no clear semantic condition shared with the other patterns is apparent.
patterns.domain: Russian text and code comments on GitHub

patterns.name: Line breaks and code delimiters
patterns.context: Formatting tokens such as line breaks, comment terminators, or long dividers; may reflect formatting/boundary responses, but the specific mechanism is unclear.

patterns.name: Privacy-concern narratives
patterns.context: Forum narratives discussing privacy controversies, whether software versions are safe, and staying on an old version for a long time; triggers are sporadic.

patterns.name: Patient and sample vocabulary in papers
patterns.context: Clinical-study descriptions mention patients, disease criteria, or trial tests; apart from specific blood-processing and lipid terms, this may reflect only a weak association with medical context.

2_258.concept: 词片段与格式边界响应
2_258.description: 激活分散在 URL/标识符的词内片段、医学论文的血样离心与血脂术语、俄语词片段、代码及排版边界标记，以及隐私讨论用词；不存在能解释全部样本的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: towards 的分词片段
patterns.context: URL 中域名 towardsdatascience.com 被分词为 tow + ards；触发集中在 URL 的词首片段。

patterns.name: 系统调用标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Go/C 源码标识符 mksyscall、sfsyscall 中；触发的是 syscall 内部片段，而非一般自然语言。

patterns.name: 血液离心处理
patterns.trigger: « Blood»／« blood»、« EDTA»、« centrifuged»；另有« Fasting»
patterns.context: 血样采集、空腹检测、加入 EDTA 抗凝管并离心的实验室方法描述；离心词激活最强。
patterns.domain: PubMed 中的医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 血脂术语的词内分片
patterns.context: 医学指标名称 hypertriglyceridemia、high density lipoprotein-cholesterol 被拆分标记，激活落在术语内部多个片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 临床研究与诊断标准

patterns.name: 学术补充材料链接中的 DOI 片段
patterns.context: ACS Supporting Information URL/DOI 中的分词片段；未显示与血液检测内容相同的触发条件。
patterns.domain: PubMed 化学论文的补充材料引用

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 俄语句子中西里尔字母词语的内部片段被标记，未见明显与其他模式相同的语义条件。
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的俄语文本与代码注释

patterns.name: 换行及代码分隔符
patterns.context: 换行、注释结束符或长分隔线等格式 token；可能是格式/边界响应，具体机制不明确。

patterns.name: 隐私担忧相关叙述
patterns.context: 谈及隐私争议、软件版本是否安全以及长期停留在旧版本的论坛叙述；触发较分散。

patterns.name: 论文中的病患与样本词汇
patterns.trigger: « presenting»、« patients»（未标记）及医学样本语境
patterns.context: 临床研究描述中出现患者、疾病标准或试验检测；除具体血液处理和血脂术语外，可能只是较弱的医学语境关联。

en.description: Activations are scattered: source-code syscall, the Towards Data Science domain, and multilingual in-word subwords, field names, entities, and LaTeX/TikZ markers all occur; no single semantic pattern explains all samples.

patterns.name: syscall identifier
patterns.context: Identifiers containing syscall in source code related to system calls or generator documentation; the former is in Go comments, the latter in a C header filename.

patterns.name: Towards Data Science link
patterns.context: towardsdatascience.com appears in a news-link URL; activation falls on tokenized fragments of the domain.

patterns.name: English in-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur within English words, compound identifiers, or LaTeX commands, with no unified semantic context apparent.
patterns.domain: License text, JSON, biomedical patent text, mathematical LaTeX

patterns.name: Multilingual subword fragments
patterns.context: In-word fragments in Russian text; the same passage also contains a Creative Commons URL, delimiters, and Russian comments, so it is unclear whether activation comes from the same feature.

patterns.name: Location and relation word fragments
patterns.context: Appear respectively in a JSON field name and the word toward(s) in NIH text; both contexts express or denote location/direction, but examples are limited.

patterns.name: Affix and subword fragments
patterns.context: In NIH text, falls on English word fragments with spaces omitted; may correspond to subwords of words such as learn, inspiring, them to, better, and others. The pattern is sporadic.

patterns.name: Entity-noun plural fragments
patterns.context: In narratives about corporate acquisitions and transfers, activations fall on people/company names, transaction verbs, and years; no clear common lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Numbering and marker symbols
patterns.context: A long slash-delimited string appears in a Russian Github passage, possibly as a formatting or comment marker.

patterns.name: General mathematical/typesetting modifiers
patterns.context: Activates in drawing options in TikZ graphics code; these are typesetting parameters.

2_258.concept: 零散的词内片段与标识符
2_258.description: 激活较分散：源码 syscall、Towards Data Science 域名，以及多语种词内子词、字段名、实体和 LaTeX/TikZ 标记均出现；没有能解释全部样本的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: syscall 标识符
patterns.context: 系统调用相关的源码或生成工具说明中，标识符包含 syscall；前者在 Go 注释里，后者在 C 头文件名中。

patterns.name: Towards Data Science 链接
patterns.context: 新闻链接 URL 中出现 towardsdatascience.com，激活落在域名的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 英文词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在英文单词、复合标识符或 LaTeX 命令的内部片段，未见统一语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 许可证文本、JSON、专利生物医学文本、数学 LaTeX

patterns.name: 多语种子词片段
patterns.context: 俄语文本中的词内片段；同段还包含 Creative Commons URL、分隔符及俄语注释，无法确认激活是否来自同一特征。

patterns.name: 位置与关系词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 JSON 字段名和 NIH 文本的 toward(s) 一词中；这两种上下文都表达或标注位置/方向，但例子有限。

patterns.name: 词缀与子词片段
patterns.context: 在 NIH 文本中落于被空格省略的英文词内片段，可能对应 learn、inspiring、them to、better 等词的子词；模式较零散。

patterns.name: 实体名词复数片段
patterns.context: 企业收购与转让叙述中，激活分别落在人名/公司名、交易动词和年份上；无明显共同词法触发。

patterns.name: 编号与标记符
patterns.context: 俄语 Github 片段中出现长串斜杠分隔符，可能是格式或注释标记。

patterns.name: 一般数学/排版修饰词
patterns.context: TikZ 图形代码的绘图选项中激活，属于排版参数。

en.description: Activations fall on intraword fragments such as tow in towards, bage in Garbage, and leep in sleep, as well as nude and tikzpicture. These examples come from links, titles, comments, medical texts, and LaTeX, with no unified semantics or stable context.

patterns.name: tow in towards
patterns.context: In a URL, towards is split into tow and ards, with activation concentrated on tow; the two segments point to a Towards Data Science link and towards the end in body text, respectively.

patterns.name: bage in Garbage
patterns.context: The word Garbage is split, with activation on bage; one instance is in a C++ output example and another in a news headline byline.

patterns.name: leep in sleep
patterns.context: The latter part of sleep is marked, preceded by the cross-line letter sequence tos; occurs in playful or onomatopoeic text in a comment.

patterns.name: The intraword substring nude
patterns.context: nude is marked in athymic (nude) mice, referring to the strain/phenotype of experimental animals.

patterns.name: TikZ environment name
patterns.context: The tikzpicture environment name in LaTeX mathematical text; nearby are drawing syntax terms such as begin, thick, and baseline.

2_258.concept: none
2_258.description: 激活落在 tow（towards）、bage（Garbage）、leep（sleep）等词内片段，以及 nude 和 tikzpicture；这些实例分属链接、标题、评论、医学和 LaTeX 文本，未见统一语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: towards 中的 tow
patterns.context: URL 中的 towards 被分成 tow 和 ards，激活集中在 tow；两段分别指向 Towards Data Science 链接和正文中的 towards the end。
patterns.domain: 科技文章链接、评论文字

patterns.name: Garbage 中的 bage
patterns.context: 单词 Garbage 被拆分，激活落在 bage；一处是 C++ 输出示例，一处是新闻标题署名。

patterns.name: sleep 中的 leep
patterns.context: sleep 的后半部分被标记，前面有跨行的字母序列 tos；出现在评论中的拟声/玩笑式文本。

patterns.name: 词内 nude 子串
patterns.context: athymic (nude) mice 中的 nude 被标记，指实验动物的品系/表型。

patterns.name: TikZ 环境名
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学文本中的 tikzpicture 环境名；附近还出现 begin、thick、baseline 等绘图语法。

en.concept: Detection of multiple high-frequency text fragments
en.description: Activations concentrate on denaturation and cycles in PCR methods; there are also sporadic responses to in-word fragments in Polish, technical blog links, JSON keys, and two types of biomedical figure-caption paths.

patterns.name: PCR denaturation-step terminology
patterns.context: Appears in PCR/thermal cycling descriptions, usually followed by the number of cycles or temperature and duration.

patterns.name: PCR cycle count
patterns.context: Listed alongside denaturation steps, temperature, and duration to describe PCR thermal cycling.

patterns.name: Polish word-final fragments
patterns.context: Appears within Polish words, such as “wystarczającego” and “występują”; other distinct word-final or in-word fragments include “«zez»2” and “«ają»1”.

patterns.name: towardsdatascience link fragments
patterns.context: Located in towardsdatascience.com links in HackerNews posts; one example has a headline mentioning neural networks, while another discusses explainable AI.

patterns.name: JSON field keys
patterns.context: Appears in JSON-like code/configuration text; activation falls on field names or fragments of field names.

patterns.name: Metabolomics figure-caption fragment
patterns.context: Appears in an image filename or caption link path describing a targeted metabolomics analysis workflow.

patterns.name: IGHV figure-caption path fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a figure-caption file path related to tumor IGHV gene sequences.

2_258.concept: 多种高频文本片段检测
2_258.description: 激活集中于 PCR 方法中的 denaturation 和 cycles；另对波兰语词内片段、技术博客链接片段、JSON 键及两类生物医学图注路径有零散反应。

patterns.name: PCR 变性步骤术语
patterns.context: 出现在 PCR/热循环流程描述中，通常紧接循环次数或温度、时长。

patterns.name: PCR 循环次数
patterns.context: 与变性步骤、温度及时长并列，描述 PCR 热循环。

en.concept: Triggers from specific word fragments and code/text markers

patterns.context: The trigger is a sequence of spaces at the start of a code line, adjacent to a method call; it has no apparent connection to the other patterns.

patterns.name: towards in a web title
patterns.context: Appears in a link title/URL text as part of an ordinary English word; no context linking it to cholesterol or code patterns is apparent.

patterns.name: Table marker
patterns.context: Appears in the XML/Markdown-style paper table reference marker “ref-type="table"”.

patterns.name: 空白缩进
patterns.context: 触发位置是代码行开头的一段空格缩进，紧邻方法调用语句；与其他模式无明显关系。

patterns.name: 网页标题中的 towards
patterns.context: 出现在链接标题/网址文本中，作为普通英文词的一部分；未见与胆固醇或代码模式相连的上下文。

patterns.name: 表格标记

en.description: Activations occur primarily in cholesterol-related medical terms and consistently in the chron fragment of synchronized in code; they also respond to whitespace in some lists and scattered word fragments, indicating multiple heterogeneous patterns.

patterns.name: Cholesterol-related medical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on intraword fragments of cholesterol, especially alongside hypercholesterolemia, cholesterol-lowering effects, and lipid indicators

patterns.name: Other scattered word fragments
patterns.context: Occur in numbers and ordinary English words in forum posts, and in intraword fragments of JSON keys; no obvious semantic condition is shared

patterns.name: 胆固醇相关医学术语
