en.description: Activations mainly fall on the lif substring within English words, and also occur in fragments of the name Nikola, the Chinese character “络” in internet domain names, and several Chinese tokens in webpages or code; these cases span multiple styles, with no unifying semantic condition.

patterns.name: lif substring in English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on the consecutive characters lif within words; word meaning and part of speech vary, and the surrounding context is not a necessary condition.
patterns.domain: English prose, encyclopedic text, forums, code, and technical text

patterns.name: In-word fragment of the proper name Nikola
patterns.context: Appears in the name “Nikolai Maximov”, used in a net-worth search headline; activation covers name fragments split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Chinese internet text
patterns.context: Appears in the domain-style string photosoft.网«络»; adjacent Chinese fragments are also marked, but activation here is concentrated on “络”.
patterns.domain: Web domain lists, mixed Chinese-English text

patterns.name: Chinese interface and code-comment fragments
patterns.context: Chinese tokens appear in HTML interface text or Android code comments; specific activations occur on fragments such as “系、统、启、动、和、绑、定、服、务”.
patterns.domain: Web templates, software code, and Chinese comments

2_696.description: 激活主要落在英语词内的 lif 子串，也出现在 Nikola 姓名片段、网络域名中的中文“络”，以及网页或代码里的若干中文 token；这些情况跨越多种文体，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 英语词中 lif 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的连续字符 lif 上；词义和词性不统一，前后文不是必要条件。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、百科、论坛、代码及技术文本

patterns.name: 专名 Nikola 的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «Nik»；相邻的 “«ol»” 和 “«ov»” 也标记为正激活
patterns.context: 出现在名字 “Nikolai Maximov” 中，且该名字被用于净资产搜索标题；激活覆盖被分词拆开的姓名片段。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、人物信息搜索文本

patterns.name: 中文网络字样
patterns.context: 出现在 photosoft.网«络» 这一域名样式字符串中；相邻的其他中文片段也有标记，但此处激活集中于“络”。
patterns.domain: 网页域名列表、混合中英文文本

patterns.name: 中文界面及代码注释片段
patterns.trigger: “«系»统消息”中的“«系»”，以及注释“跨应«用»启«动»和«»绑定«服»务”中的多个中文 token
patterns.context: 中文 token 出现在 HTML 界面文本或 Android 代码注释中；具体激活分布于“系、统、启、动、和、绑、定、服、务”等片段。
patterns.domain: 网页模板、软件代码及中文注释

en.description: Activations are scattered across words such as covenant, reaction, and pathway, and fragments of French incompréhensible: they concern covenants in legal and religious contexts, chemical reaction labels, pathways in different fields, and allergic reactions. No unified semantic or stylistic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Contract and legal language
patterns.context: Legal opinions or rulings discuss promises not to prosecute, leases, or lease renewal terms.

patterns.name: Covenant narrative
patterns.context: Religious narrative about Moses making a covenant with God.

patterns.name: Chemical reaction labels
patterns.context: Placeholder labels for reaction schemes in chemistry paper abstracts, or references to reactions in the body text.

patterns.name: Pathway collocations
patterns.context: The word appears in contexts involving immune mechanisms, metaphorical life paths, or fluid transfer channels; activation falls on the word pathway.

patterns.name: Judgment that something is incomprehensible
patterns.context: French description of a decision as difficult to understand; activation is concentrated on an in-word fragment of incompréhensible.

patterns.name: General allergic reaction
patterns.context: A drug causes an allergic reaction in the account of facts in a legal case.

2_696.description: 激活分散在 covenant、reaction、pathway 等词及法语 incompréhensible 的片段：涉及法律与宗教中的盟约、化学反应标签、不同领域的通道，以及过敏反应；未见统一语义或文体。

patterns.name: 化学反应标签

patterns.name: Legal litigation and ruling language

patterns.name: Interjection AH

patterns.name: AHK name and forum abbreviation

patterns.name: In-word fragments in French
patterns.context: In French political text, markers are scattered within and between words, with no stable single semantic trigger condition apparent.

patterns.name: Sporadic short words or in-word fragments
patterns.context: Highlights fall on in-word fragments or common short words in different languages; the available context is insufficient to determine a shared trigger condition.

en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual natural language, legal and parliamentary texts, and code. Local patterns include the Italian word segments “iz” and “ries”, the Latvian “str”, the title/name fragment “ED”, as well as CSS properties, code identifiers, function names, and assembly registers; there is no single stable shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Romance-language “iz” stem
patterns.context: The trigger falls on a segment beginning with “iz” in Italian words, especially the noun “iniziativa” and inflected forms of the verb “analizzare”; the segment itself is marked as a split token.

patterns.name: Latvian “str” segment
patterns.context: Occurs inside the Latvian word “ izstrādā” (drafts, formulates), in formal statements about parliamentary bodies and treaties.

patterns.name: Italian “ries” segment
patterns.context: The segment “ries” is activated in inflected forms of the Italian verb “riuscire”; it appears in an academic book review and a chat conversation.

patterns.name: “ED” in a court title
patterns.context: Appears in the title of a U.S. court appeal case as the beginning of the name EDWARD; the title is in all caps.

patterns.name: right in code identifiers
patterns.context: Appears as a right-coordinate variable in a Java method parameter list; there is also CSS property «right»8 (6), but the two code contexts and uses differ.

patterns.name: CSS positioning property position
patterns.context: Used as a property name in a CSS declaration, followed by a colon and the value “absolute”; appears alongside positioning properties such as top, right, and bottom in the same passage.

patterns.name: puts in code
patterns.context: A puts function call that outputs a string in C/C++-style code; nearby are code comments and statements for thread joining and handler allocation.

patterns.name: Assembly register ah
patterns.context: The 8-bit register ah used as an operand in x86 assembly instructions; repeated in adjacent and, xor, and other instructions.

patterns.name: Identifiers and syntax fragments in other code
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across Java method structures, code comments, and assembly opcodes; there is no clear shared local trigger word.

2_696.description: 激活分布在多语种自然语言及法律、议会文本和代码中。可见局部模式包括意大利语词段“iz”“ries”、拉脱维亚语“str”、标题人名“ED”，以及 CSS 属性、代码标识符、函数名和汇编寄存器；没有单一稳定的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 罗曼语词干“iz”
patterns.context: 触发点落在意大利语词中以“iz”开头的词段，尤其是名词“iniziativa”和动词“analizzare”的屈折形式；词段本身被拆分标注。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语“str”词段
patterns.context: 位于拉脱维亚语“ izstrādā”（拟定、制定）一词内部，出现在议会机构及条约的正式陈述中。

patterns.name: 意大利语“ries”词段
patterns.context: 意大利语动词“riuscire”的屈折形式中，词段“ries”被激活；分别出现在学术书评与聊天对话中。
patterns.domain: 意大利语散文与网络聊天

patterns.name: 法院标题中的“ED”
patterns.context: 出现在美国法院上诉案件标题中，作为人名 EDWARD 的开头部分，标题为全大写格式。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 right
patterns.context: 出现在 Java 方法参数列表中的 right 坐标变量；另有 CSS 属性 «right»8（6），但两处代码语境和用途不同。

patterns.name: CSS 定位属性 position
patterns.context: 作为 CSS 声明中的属性名，后接冒号和值“absolute”；与同段的 top、right、bottom 等定位属性并列。

patterns.name: 代码中的 puts
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中输出字符串的函数调用 puts；附近是线程加入和处理程序分配的代码注释与语句。
patterns.domain: 软件代码 / 线程处理

patterns.name: 汇编寄存器 ah
patterns.context: x86 汇编指令中作为操作数的 8 位寄存器 ah；在相邻 and、xor 等指令里重复出现。

patterns.name: 其他代码中的标识符与语法片段
patterns.context: 激活散落在 Java 方法结构、代码注释和汇编操作码等不同程序文本片段中；没有明确共享的局部触发词。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在“achievable”一词内部，无明显独立语义或稳定句法触发条件

patterns.name: 论坛抱怨/编辑留言中的“ugh”
patterns.context: 出现在反馈或隐私讨论之后的独立感叹词，附近有分隔线或引用回复

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于跨成员国医疗待遇的句子中，嵌于“ubezpieczenia”一词

en.concept: Local subword fragments and formal text markers
en.description: Activations occur on subword fragments in multilingual parliamentary text, court names and personal names in court headers, and local fragments in insurance, reviews, and business emails. There is no shared semantic trigger across corpora.

patterns.name: Continuation of tokenized “-ta/-ra” in European Parliament speeches
patterns.context: In multilingual European Parliament speech text, activations land on split subword fragments, especially word-final or intraword fragments; formal forms of address, policy content, or speech transitions often appear nearby.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, formal parliamentary speeches in French, Dutch, Italian, and other languages

patterns.name: OF / OF APPEALS in court names
patterns.context: A U.S. court document title or header prints the court level and name in uppercase; activations concentrate on fragments of the court name.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in insurance-related terms
patterns.context: A Polish sentence discusses the insurance scheme covering someone who works in another member state; the trigger fragment occurs in “ubezpieczenia” (insurance).
patterns.domain: EuroParl, social security / cross-border employment policy

patterns.name: “inc” in newspaper or war-reporting language
patterns.context: Italian academic or critical prose discusses a workplace becoming an information center and mentions the concerning “incidenza” (impact / incidence).

patterns.name: English word ending “ach” / achieve
patterns.context: A business email discusses the feasibility of an outsourcing model; the activation lands on the fragment at the start of “achievable.”

patterns.name: Initial ED- fragment in a name
patterns.context: A U.S. federal or state appellate court document prints a party’s name in uppercase; the activation lands on a name fragment beginning with ED.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, legal case headers and party names

2_696.concept: 局部词片段与正式文本标记
2_696.description: 激活分布于多语种议会文本的词片段、法院页眉中的法院名称与姓名，以及保险、评论和商业邮件中的局部词片段。跨语料没有统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会发言中的分词「-ta/-ra」续接
patterns.context: 多语种欧洲议会演讲正文中，激活落在被拆分的词片段上，尤其是词尾或词内片段；周围常有正式称呼、政策内容或讲话衔接。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，法语、荷兰语、意大利语等正式议会发言

patterns.name: 法院名称中的 OF / OF APPEALS
patterns.context: 美国法院文件的标题或页眉，以大写格式排印法院层级和名称；激活集中在法院名称片段。

patterns.name: 保险制度相关词片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子谈及在另一成员国工作者的保险所属制度；触发片段位于「ubezpieczenia」（保险）一词中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，社会保障／跨境就业政策

patterns.name: 报刊或战争报道用语中的「inc」
patterns.context: 意大利语学术或评论性文字中，谈工作场所成为信息发布中心，并提及令人担忧的「incidenza」（影响／发生率）。

patterns.name: 英语词尾「ach」/ achieve
patterns.context: 商业邮件讨论外包模式的可行性，激活落在英语「achievable」词首的词片段。

patterns.name: 姓名中 ED- 的开头片段
patterns.context: 美国联邦或州上诉法院文件中，大写排印当事人姓名；激活落在以 ED 开头的姓名片段。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，法律案件页眉及当事人姓名

en.description: The clearest pattern is the standalone interjection “ugh” in English forums or blogs; other strong activations are scattered across word-internal fragments in multiple languages, such as inc, anc, cin, ube, and ied, in ordinary words in parliamentary texts, without a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: English interjection “ugh”
patterns.context: A standalone interjection, often appearing at the beginning of a comment or forum reply to express annoyance, aversion, or displeasure.
patterns.domain: English blogs and HackerNews forum texts

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in French “incendie”
patterns.context: Appears in a French sentence about whether buildings meet legal health, safety, and fire-protection requirements; it is a word-internal fragment in “incendie” (fire).

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in Italian “incidenza”
patterns.context: Appears in an Italian sentence about war bulletins and a concerning incidence rate; it is the initial fragment of “incidenza” (incidence rate).

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in Polish “ubezpieczenia”
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about cross-member-state medical services and insurance countries; it is a word-internal fragment in “ubezpieczenia” (insurance).

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in French “ancienne”
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about the difficulty of restoring the old growth model and the need to find a new path; it is a word-internal fragment in “ancienne” (old).

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in French “cinq”
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about the new European Parliament and the number of member states; it is a word-internal fragment in “cinq” (five).

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in Dutch “iedere”
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about a newly established institution and research conducted every five years; it is a word-internal fragment in “iedere” (every).

patterns.name: Other cross-lingual word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall within ordinary words in multiple languages; the contexts shown by the fragments have no apparent shared semantic condition, and these markers are mostly weaker activations.
patterns.domain: Italian, French, Polish, Dutch, and other parliamentary or academic texts

patterns.name: Weak markers without clear semantics
patterns.context: Appear in forum replies or English narratives, but do not form a stable trigger pattern like the strong activation for “ugh”.

2_696.description: 最明确的模式是英语论坛或博客中独立感叹词“ugh”；其余强激活分散在多语种词内片段，如 inc、anc、cin、ube、ied，涉及议会文本中的普通词，缺乏统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 英文感叹词“ugh”
patterns.context: 作为独立感叹词，常出现在评论或论坛回复的段落开头，表达厌烦、反感或不满。
patterns.domain: 英语博客与 HackerNews 论坛文本

patterns.name: 法语“incendie”词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在法语关于建筑是否满足法律规定的健康、安全和防火条件的句子中，属于“incendie”（火灾）一词的词内片段。

patterns.name: 意大利语“incidenza”词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语关于战争公报及令人担忧的发生率的句子中，是“incidenza”（发生率）一词的开头片段。
patterns.domain: 意大利语学术或评论文本

patterns.name: 波兰语“ubezpieczenia”词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在跨成员国医疗服务与保险国家相关的句子中，是“ubezpieczenia”（保险）的词内片段。

patterns.name: 法语“ancienne”词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于旧增长模式难以恢复、需要寻找新道路的句子中，是“ancienne”（旧的）的词内片段。

patterns.name: 法语“cinq”词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在新一届欧洲议会及成员国数量的句子中，是“cinq”（五）的词内片段。

patterns.name: 荷兰语“iedere”词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于新设机构及每五年进行一次研究的句子中，是“iedere”（每个／每一）的词内片段。

patterns.name: 其他跨语言词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多种语言的普通词内部；各片段所示上下文没有明显共同语义条件，且这些标记多为较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 意大利语、法语、波兰语、荷兰语等议会或学术文本

patterns.name: 未见清晰语义的弱标记
patterns.context: 出现在论坛回复或英文叙述中，但不足以形成与强激活“ugh”相同的稳定触发模式。
patterns.domain: 英语 HackerNews 论坛文本

en.description: The first four passages share the English interjection “ugh,” with a few activations on common English words as well; the remaining passages are in Dutch, French, Italian, and Polish, with activations scattered across intraword fragments, function words, and punctuation. No clear, consistent cross-language semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: English conversational interjection “ugh”
patterns.context: A standalone interjection, often in forum replies or personal narratives; in passage 4 it is embedded in a quotation.

patterns.name: Common words and word boundaries in English phrases
patterns.context: Common words in continuous English text; trigger locations vary, including complete words and fragments adjoining surrounding text.

patterns.name: Dutch intraword fragments and word endings
patterns.context: Activations occur on intraword fragments, complete short words, and punctuation in Dutch political sentences.

patterns.name: French intraword fragments and grammatical connectives
patterns.context: Occurs in French political or parliamentary sentences; activations cover intraword fragments, common function words, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Italian intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activations mostly land on fragments within longer Italian words, as well as common short words.

patterns.name: Polish intraword fragments and inflectional markers
patterns.context: Occurs in Polish sentences, triggering intraword fragments and letter sequences related to inflection.

2_696.description: 前四段共同出现英语“ugh”感叹词，另有少量英语常见词激活；其余段落分属荷兰语、法语、意大利语、波兰语，激活散布于词内片段、功能词和标点，未见跨语种一致的明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语口语感叹“ugh”
patterns.context: 独立感叹词，常出现在论坛回复或个人叙述中；第4段嵌在引语里。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 论坛文本、个人博客

patterns.name: 英语短语中的常见词与词边界
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中的常见词；触发位置并不一致，既有完整词，也有与周围文本相接的词。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段与词尾
patterns.context: 激活分布于荷兰语政治句子中的词内片段、完整短词及标点。

patterns.name: 法语词内片段与语法连接词
patterns.context: 出现在法语政治或议会语句中，激活涵盖词内片段、常见功能词和标点。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活多落在意大利语较长词的内部片段，也包括常见短词。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 意大利语学术文本

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段与词形标记
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语句子中，触发词内片段以及词形变化相关的字母片段。

en.description: The strongest and recurring pattern is “ugh” appearing alone after a forum comment divider; other activations are scattered across word-internal fragments in multiple languages, involving parliamentary texts and English online content, with no stable semantic or grammatical commonality.

patterns.name: Comments beginning with “ugh”
patterns.context: An independent comment opening after a divider or quote, often followed by an evaluation, suggestion, or reply; activation is concentrated on “ugh” itself.

patterns.name: Italian word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on character fragments inside Italian words, scattered through formal parliamentary texts; the word forms vary and lack a shared meaning.

patterns.name: Irish-related word fragment
patterns.context: Embedded in “l’«ir»8land«ais»”, referring to “Irish”; the surrounding discussion concerns parliamentary translation and language recognition.

patterns.name: French word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal or initial fragments of French words in formal parliamentary narratives; no unified semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: English word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Embedded respectively in “ranting” and “encyclopedia”; one occurs in a forum comment and the other in a legal webpage link, with inconsistent conditions.

2_696.description: 最强且重复的模式是论坛评论分隔后单独出现“ugh”；其余激活零散落在多语种词内部片段，涉及议会文本及英语网络内容，未显示稳定的语义或语法共性。

patterns.name: “ugh”开头的评论
patterns.context: 作为分隔符或引用后的独立评论开头，后面常接评价、建议或回复；激活集中在“ugh”本身。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语单词内部的字符片段，分布于正式议会文本；不同词形，缺少共同词义。

patterns.name: 爱尔兰语相关词片段
patterns.context: 嵌在“l’«ir»8land«ais»”中，指“爱尔兰语”；周围讨论议会翻译及语言承认。

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在法语词的内部或开头片段，出现在正式议会叙述中；未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 英语词内片段
patterns.context: 分别嵌在“ranting”和“encyclopedia”中；一处是论坛评论，一处是法律网页链接，条件不一致。

en.description: The clearest high-activation patterns are the expression of disgust “ugh” and complaint-related “rant”; other passages include fragments within French words in European Parliament text and one Spanish “ries,” alongside scattered English function words and punctuation that do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Interjection “ugh”
patterns.context: A standalone interjection in comments or reposts, often in contexts of complaint, disappointment, or disgust; sometimes followed by the target of the evaluation or a reason.

patterns.name: Forms related to “rant”
patterns.context: The stem rant appears in contexts of complaint or criticism, including noun and verb forms and phrases in titles.

patterns.name: French intraword subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations land on subword fragments within French words in parliamentary speeches, debates, explanations, policy, and economic texts; the triggered fragments do not appear to share a clear pattern.

patterns.name: Spanish intraword subword fragment
patterns.context: An activation occurs on an intraword fragment in the Spanish word «riesgos»; the sentence discusses risks.

patterns.name: Scattered English function words and punctuation
patterns.context: These fragments are scattered across ordinary English sentences, punctuation, and line breaks; no stable shared semantic or contextual condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: HackerNews posts and comments, Pile-CC book reviews

2_696.description: 最明确的高激活模式是表达嫌弃的“ugh”和抱怨相关的“rant”；另有多段欧盟议会文本中落在法语词内的片段及一处西语“ries”，以及分散的英语功能词和标点，后者难以归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: ugh 感叹
patterns.context: 作为评论或转帖中的独立感叹词，常出现在抱怨、失望、嫌弃的语境中；有时后接评价对象或理由。

patterns.name: rant 相关词形
patterns.context: 词干 rant 出现在抱怨或批评的语境中，包括名词、动词形式，以及标题中的短语。

patterns.name: 法语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在法语词内部的子词片段，涉及议会发言、辩论、解释、政策与经济文本；触发片段彼此不明显统一。

patterns.name: 西语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在西语单词 «riesgos» 的词内片段，句子讨论风险。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 西班牙语议会记录

patterns.name: 零散英语功能词与标点
patterns.context: 这些片段分散在普通英文句子及标点、换行中，未见稳定的共同语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 帖文与评论、Pile-CC 书评

en.concept: Mixed: negative interjection and word fragments
en.description: Strongly responds to the negative interjection “ugh” in English discussions; it also activates on various word-internal subword fragments in legal English and French, Dutch, and Italian parliamentary corpora, with no unified meaning explaining these cross-lingual cases.

patterns.name: “ugh” in English texts
patterns.context: An interjection appearing alone on a line or after a topic/reply divider, expressing annoyance, displeasure, or a negative reaction.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in English legal texts
patterns.context: Ordinary English words in contracts or judicial narratives; the strongest activation falls on the word-final subword fragment in “alleys”, with no nearby “ugh”-like interjection.

patterns.name: Split word fragments in French
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple tokens in French parliamentary speeches; strong activations occur on word-internal fragments, often in words with accents or longer words.

patterns.name: Split word fragments in Dutch
patterns.context: Word-internal subword fragments in Dutch parliamentary texts, including ordinary words and compounds.

patterns.name: Split word fragments in Italian
patterns.context: In Italian parliamentary texts, strong activations fall on word-internal fragments after tokenization.

2_696.concept: 混合：负面感叹与词片段
2_696.description: 对英语讨论中的负面感叹“ugh”强烈响应；另在法律英语及法、荷、意议会语料中激活于多种词内子词片段，尚无统一词义可解释这些跨语种实例。

patterns.name: 英語文本中的“ugh”
patterns.context: 独立成行或作为话题/回复分隔后的感叹语，表达厌烦、不满或负面反应。

patterns.name: 英语法律文本中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 合同或判决叙述中的普通英文词汇；最强处落在“alleys”的词尾子词片段，周边没有“ugh”式感叹。

patterns.name: 法语拆分词片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中，词被分成多个 token；强激活出现在词内片段，常见于带重音或较长词。

patterns.name: 荷兰语拆分词片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会文本中的词内子词片段，包含普通词和复合词。

patterns.name: 意大利语拆分词片段
patterns.context: 意大利语议会文本中，强激活落在分词后的词内片段。

en.description: Strong responses include the expression of disgust “ugh” in comments, but also occur on English function words, Italian and French subword fragments, and punctuation; these fragments alone do not indicate a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Interjection “ugh”
patterns.context: Used alone at the start after a comment divider, or in a quotation as a reaction of disgust or surprise; no specific topic is required.

patterns.name: English function words and common word fragments
patterns.context: In continuous English text, triggers occur in ordinary syntactic structures; no unified semantic pattern or fixed phrase is apparent.

patterns.name: English adverb ever
patterns.context: Appears in the superlative evaluation “pieces ... I ever read.”

patterns.name: Italian intraword fragments
patterns.context: Triggers land within Italian words or on common short words, with no apparent shared meaning or syntactic position.

patterns.name: French fragments and parliamentary formulas
patterns.context: In French parliamentary speeches, covering punctuation, forms of address, and intraword fragments; some fragments occur near applause markers and the presiding officer’s title.

2_696.concept: 多语言词片段与感叹词
2_696.description: 强响应包含评论中的厌恶感叹词“ugh”，但也分散触发于英语功能词、意大利语和法语词片段及标点；仅凭这些片段看不出统一语义。

patterns.name: ugh 感叹词
patterns.context: 单独作为评论分隔线后的开头或引述中的厌恶、惊讶反应；不要求特定主题

patterns.name: 英语功能词与常见词片段
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中，触发点分布在普通句法结构里；未见统一语义或固定短语
patterns.domain: 网络评论、法律文本、博客

patterns.name: 英语副词 ever
patterns.context: 出现在“pieces ... I ever read”这一最高级评价表达中

patterns.name: 意大利语内部词片段
patterns.context: 触发点落在意大利语词内部或常见短词上，未显示统一词义或句法位置

patterns.name: 法语词片段与议会套语
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中，覆盖标点、称谓和词内片段；部分片段处在掌声标记及议长称呼附近

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on within-word substrings in different languages, especially in-iz in Italian iniziativa/inizio; also found in Slovenian iz, English word-final ys, names, and Latvian word forms, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Italian “inizio/iniziativa” stem
patterns.context: Words beginning with inizio or iniziativa appear in Italian texts; activation falls on the in-iz substring within the word.

patterns.name: iz in Slovenian names
patterns.context: iz appears in the spelling of the name Deiz.

patterns.name: iz in a place/institution name
patterns.context: iz appears within the Slovenian word turizem (tourism).

patterns.name: iz substring in other words
patterns.context: iz appears in the proper name Weizhe; there is insufficient context to explain the semantic role of the substring itself.

patterns.name: Deakins spelling fragment in a name
patterns.context: The letter fragment ak in the English name Deakins is marked; no semantic or syntactic condition consistent with other triggers is apparent.

patterns.name: Plural ending -eys
patterns.context: ys appears near the endings of the English plural nouns alley(s) and abbey(s); the marker may cross a word-ending boundary.

patterns.name: Letter string within a Latvian word
patterns.context: The ā and šanas fragments are marked within a Latvian word form meaning to establish/found; its relation to other patterns is unclear.

2_696.description: 强激活主要落在不同语言的词内子串，尤其是意大利语 iniziativa/inizio 的 in-iz；另见斯洛文尼亚语 iz、英文词尾 ys、人名与拉脱维亚语词形片段，缺乏统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 意大利语“inizio/iniziativa”词干
patterns.context: 意大利语文本中出现以 inizio 或 iniziativa 开头的词；激活落在词内的 in-iz 子串。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语姓名中的 iz
patterns.context: 姓名 Deiz 的拼写中出现 iz。

patterns.name: 地名/机构名中的 iz
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语中的 turizem（旅游）一词内出现 iz。

patterns.name: 其他词内的 iz 子串
patterns.context: 专名 Weizhe 中出现 iz；缺少足够语境说明该子串本身的语义作用。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Deakins 拼写片段
patterns.context: 英文人名 Deakins 中的 ak 字母片段被标记，未见与其他触发一致的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 复数词尾 -eys

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内的字母串
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语中表示建立/创立的词形内，ā 与 šanas 片段被标记；与其他模式的关系不明确。

en.description: Activations occur across mathematical terminology, legal titles and narrative, multilingual European Parliament text, and conflict reporting. Many markers are intraword fragments or ordinary function words; apart from mathematical terminology, they do not form a unified semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: English Weyl / group theory terminology
patterns.context: Mathematical papers contain terms such as Weyl group, Heisenberg groups, or related representation theory terminology; activations sometimes land on subword fragments within terms.

patterns.name: Legal document title and fees
patterns.context: The legal document title “DECISION ON ATTORNEYS’ FEES,” especially its uppercase words and intraword fragments.

patterns.name: English function words and intraword fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary conjunctions, modal verbs, prepositions, articles, or sentence-final punctuation in English legal narrative; the fragments shown are insufficient to determine a specific syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Multilingual intraword subword fragments
patterns.context: Intraword fragments in Romance and Slavic languages, often within longer words; the triggered meanings and positions vary.

patterns.name: Common word fragments in European Parliament text
patterns.context: Short function words and initial fragments of longer words in French debate speeches.

patterns.name: English reporting on conflict or the Islamic State
patterns.context: News narratives about Syrian cities, conflict, and ISIL; activations include proper-name abbreviations, common words, and punctuation.

2_696.description: 激活分布于数学术语、法律标题及叙述、欧洲议会多语种文本和冲突新闻。许多标记是词内片段或普通功能词，除数学术语外难以归为统一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 英语 Weyl / 群论术语
patterns.context: 数学论文中出现 Weyl group、Heisenberg groups 或相关表示论术语；激活有时落在术语内部的子词片段。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与费用
patterns.context: 法律文件标题“DECISION ON ATTORNEYS’ FEES”，尤其是标题中的大写词及其词内片段。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及词内片段
patterns.context: 英语法律叙述中普通连接词、情态词、介词、冠词或句末标点；可见片段不足以确定具体句法条件。

patterns.name: 多语种词内子词片段
patterns.context: 罗曼语族及斯拉夫语族文本中的词内片段，常落在较长词语内部；触发词义和位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会文本中的常见词片段
patterns.context: 法语辩论发言中短功能词及较长词的开头片段。

patterns.name: 涉及冲突或伊斯兰国的英语报道
patterns.context: 报道叙利亚城市、冲突与 ISIL 的新闻叙述；激活包括专名缩写、普通词和标点。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on short letter fragments within words, especially «iz» and «ap», appearing across languages, meanings, and styles; there are also isolated cases of «ne» and «bat». Strong activation fragments not marked in segment 6 can be summarized.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment «iz»
patterns.context: Activation is marked inside words rather than on standalone words, appearing across various word forms and contexts; there is no consistent meaning or syntactic position
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary texts and English legal quotations

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment «ap»
patterns.context: An intra-word letter fragment appearing in an Italian date, a French connective, and an English proper-name adjective

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment «ne»
patterns.context: Embedded in a Slovenian verb form; this is the only example in the current material

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment «bat»
patterns.context: Inside a French word, referring to the ending of the word for debate; surrounding text discusses parliamentary procedure

patterns.name: Other strength variants of intra-word fragment «iz»
patterns.context: Appearing in English legal quotations of personal names and in Latvian word forms; the same fragment also activates in words from other languages

2_696.description: 强激活多落在词内的短字母片段，尤其 «iz» 与 «ap»，跨语种、词义和文体出现；另有 «ne»、«bat» 个例。第6段没有标出的强激活片段可归纳。

patterns.name: 词内片段 «iz»
patterns.trigger: 意大利语、斯洛文尼亚语、拉脱维亚语和法律引文中的词内 «iz»；如 «iz»10、«iz»9
patterns.context: 激活标在词内部而非独立词上，出现在多种词形与语境中；没有统一的词义或句法位置
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本及英语法律引文

patterns.name: 词内片段 «ap»
patterns.context: 词内部字母片段；分别出现在意大利语日期、法语连接语和英语专名形容词中
patterns.domain: 议会文本、百科全书英语

patterns.name: 词内片段 «ne»
patterns.context: 嵌在斯洛文尼亚语动词词形中；当前材料仅此一例

patterns.name: 词内片段 «bat»
patterns.context: 法语词内部，指辩论一词的词尾部分；周围谈论议事程序

patterns.name: 词内片段 «iz» 的其他强度变体
patterns.context: 跨英语法律人名引文及拉脱维亚语词形出现；同一片段也在其他语种词中激活

en.description: Activations mostly land on letter fragments within words in different languages, often z/iz and adjacent characters; Italian iz/inizio and English inqui also appear. Samples are scattered across parliamentary and legal texts, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Italian intraword iz/inizio
patterns.context: Activations occur in Italian words, especially forms such as iniziare and inizio meaning “to begin”; nearby text describes parliamentary procedure.

patterns.name: Multilingual intraword spelling fragments such as z/ž
patterns.context: Within words in Slovak, Slovenian, Latvian, Danish, Romanian, and other languages, activations land on z, iz, or adjacent letter fragments; there is no shared semantic context.

patterns.name: Italian intraword forms related to intensification / -ization
patterns.context: Activations occur inside Italian nouns, including modernamento and uguaglianza; there is only one instance, so it is unclear whether meaning or morphology triggers it.

patterns.name: English intraword inqui
patterns.context: An activation lands on the initial intraword fragment in English inquiry; the context concerns a formal investigation, but there are no repeated examples.

2_696.description: 激活多落在不同语言词内部的字母片段，常见 z/iz 及其邻近字符，也见意大利语 iz/inizio、英语 inqui；样本分散于议会与法律文本，未见稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内 iz/inizio
patterns.context: 激活出现在意大利语词中，尤其是表示开始的 iniziare、inizio 一类形式；周围是议会发言中的程序叙述。

patterns.name: 多语种词内 z/ž 等拼写片段
patterns.context: 在斯洛伐克语、斯洛文尼亚语、拉脱维亚语、丹麦语、罗马尼亚语等词内部，激活落在 z、iz 或与其相邻的字母片段上；没有统一语义环境。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内强化/化类词形
patterns.context: 激活位于意大利语名词内部，涉及 modernamento、uguaglianza 等词；仅有单例，无法确认是否由词义或词形触发。

patterns.name: 英语词内 inqui
patterns.context: 激活位于英语 inquiry 一词开头的词内片段；上下文谈及正式调查，但缺乏重复例证。

en.description: Activations concentrate on short substrings inside words in multiple languages, often at the beginning or middle of a word; they span Slavic, Romance, and Nordic languages and English proper names, with scattered meanings and topics and no stable semantic or syntactic conditions.

patterns.name: Token fragments around the “be/ub…” boundary in intra-word substrings
patterns.context: Activations fall on intra-word fragments in Scandinavian and Polish words beginning with “ube”; [5] is “ubegrundede forsinkelser” (unfounded delays), and [9] is “ubezpieczenia” (insurance).
patterns.domain: European Parliament legal and policy texts

patterns.name: Multilingual intra-word fragment “ir”
patterns.context: In a French sentence discussing recognition of Irish as a language, activation falls on the initial fragment of “irlandais”.
patterns.domain: European Parliament interpretation and language-policy speech

patterns.name: Multilingual intra-word fragment “iz”
patterns.context: Activations fall on intra-word fragments in Italian “iniziativa” and Latvian “aizsardzību”; neither belongs to the same word or semantic domain.

patterns.name: Multilingual intra-word fragment “z”
patterns.context: Activations fall on initial or internal fragments of Romanian “dezastru” and Polish “zdrowotnej”.

patterns.name: Multilingual intra-word fragment “ne/na”
patterns.context: In a Slovak sentence, activation concentrates on an intra-word fragment of “neoznačuje”; the context concerns names for historical centuries.

patterns.name: Multilingual intra-word fragment “am”
patterns.context: In an Italian policy list, activation falls on the initial fragment of “ammodernamento” (modernization).

patterns.name: English proper-name intra-word fragment “iz”
patterns.context: The name “ Weizhe Lin” in English legal narrative is split into intra-word fragments; nearby text concerns investigations, criminal charges, and companies.

patterns.name: Swedish agenda intra-word fragment “utt”
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary proceedings, activation falls on the initial fragment of “uttalandet” (statement), followed by an agenda item for committee statement debate.

2_696.description: 激活集中在多语种词内部的短子串，常位于词首或词中；涵盖斯拉夫语、罗曼语、北欧语及英语专名，语义和主题分散，未见稳定的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 词内子串“be/ub…”边界处的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在斯堪的纳维亚语、波兰语中以“ube”开头的词内片段；[5]为“ubegrundede forsinkelser”（无根据的延误），[9]为“ubezpieczenia”（保险）。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会法律、政策文本

patterns.name: 多语种词内片段“ir”
patterns.context: 在讨论爱尔兰语获得语言承认的法语句子中，激活落在“irlandais”的词首片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会口译与语言政策发言

patterns.name: 多语种词内片段“iz”
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语“iniziativa”和拉脱维亚语“aizsardzību”的词内片段，二者都不是同一词或同一语义领域。

patterns.name: 多语种词内片段“z”
patterns.context: 激活落在罗马尼亚语“dezastru”和波兰语“zdrowotnej”的词首或词内片段。

patterns.name: 多语种词内片段“ne/na”
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语句子中，激活集中于“neoznačuje”的词内片段；上下文谈及历史世纪的称谓。

patterns.name: 多语种词内片段“am”
patterns.context: 意大利语政策清单中，激活落在“ammodernamento”（现代化）的词首片段。

patterns.name: 英语专名词内片段“iz”
patterns.context: 英语法律叙述中的人名“ Weizhe Lin”被分成词内片段；紧邻的是调查、刑事指控及公司相关内容。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议程词内片段“utt”
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会会议程序中，激活落在“uttalandet”（声明）的词首片段，随后是委员会声明辩论议程。

en.description: Triggers mainly fall on medial positions in words or subword fragments across languages, especially z/iz spellings; the English article a, Italian og, and several scattered Slovak fragments also occur. The word meanings and styles vary widely, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: z-syllable fragments across word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on medial positions in words or adjacent subword fragments, often across tokenization boundaries; they are not limited to one language. The complete words differ, so a shared meaning cannot be inferred.

patterns.name: English article a
patterns.context: The single-letter article a is marked in English passages; the contexts concern noun phrases.

patterns.name: Intra-word medial fragment in Italian
patterns.context: Appears inside an Italian verb, near topics of road transport and livestock transport; the fragment alone does not establish a broader pattern.

patterns.name: Scattered triggers across languages and positions
patterns.context: Within the same fragment, activations occur at multiple positions in Slovak words and phrases. Some may resemble intra-word fragments in other segments, but no single word form or meaning explains them.

2_696.description: 触发主要落在多语种词中部或子词片段上，尤其是 z/iz 等字形；另见英语冠词 a、意大利语 og 和斯洛伐克语多个分散片段。所涉词义与文体差异很大，无法归纳为稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 跨词边界的 z 音节片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词中部或相邻子词片段上，常跨分词边界；并非只限某种语言。各处完整词不同，不能据此断定共同词义。

patterns.name: 英语冠词 a

patterns.name: 意大利语词内中间片段

en.description: Activations mostly land on short subword fragments within words across languages, including Central European z/az, Italian iz, Romanian ose, yl in Weyl, and ube in insurance-related terms. No unified semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Other scattered intraword fragments

2_696.description: 激活多落在多语种词语内部的短子词片段；包括中欧语 z/az、意大利语 iz、罗马尼亚语 ose、Weyl 的 yl及保险词 ube。未见统一语义或句法条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across intra-word letter fragments in multiple languages, often on z/iz sequences, with isolated cases in inquiry, Neapolitan, and Europas; no stable semantic or syntactic theme is apparent.

en.concept: Intra-word letter z and scattered word fragments
en.description: Activations span multiple European languages; the most prominent recurring cue is the Latin letter z inside words, especially in Slavic word forms and Italian iniziativa. Many other isolated word-fragment activations are difficult to explain through shared meaning or style.

patterns.name: Subword fragments beginning with Latin character z
patterns.context: The neuron mainly activates on the letter z inside words in multiple Slavic and Baltic languages; following letters are sometimes marked too, but strength and intra-word position vary.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European Parliament corpus; parliamentary debates, policy, and legal texts

patterns.name: Italian word segment izia
patterns.context: The intra-word iz fragment in Italian «iniziativa» has extremely strong activation; another part of the same word is also marked more weakly.

patterns.name: Possible non-Latin-script word fragment
patterns.context: The consecutive letters iz appear in a Latvian word; this is compatible with the pattern for Latin letter z, but it is a word form in a different language and cannot alone establish the trigger condition.

patterns.name: Other intra-word triggers without marked Latin z
patterns.context: A few activations fall on word fragments without an obvious z, distributed across multiple languages and word positions; the current sample is insufficient to infer a shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Scattered activations not classifiable under the patterns above
patterns.context: Marks are scattered across ordinary words and affixes, with no stable shared morphological or semantic features.

2_696.concept: 词内字母 z 及零散词片段
2_696.description: 激活跨多种欧洲语言，最突出的重复线索是词内拉丁字母 z，尤其在斯拉夫语词形及意大利语 iniziativa 中；另有不少孤立的词片段激活，难以用共同语义或文体解释。

patterns.name: 拉丁字符 z 起始的子词片段

patterns.domain: 多语种欧洲议会语料；议会辩论、政策和法律文本

patterns.name: 意大利语 izia 词段
patterns.context: 在意大利语「iniziativa」中，词内 iz 片段出现极强激活；同一词的另一处也有较弱标记。

patterns.name: 疑似非拉丁文字词片段
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语词中出现 iz 连续字母片段；与对拉丁字母 z 的模式相容，但属于不同语言中的词形，不能由此单独确定触发条件。

patterns.name: 未标记拉丁 z 的其他词内触发
patterns.context: 少数激活落在不含明显 z 的词片段中，分布在多种语言及词形位置；当前样本不足以归纳共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 未能归入上述模式的零散激活
patterns.context: 标记分散在普通词语和词缀中，未显示稳定的词形或语义共同点。

en.description: Activations are associated mainly with individual intraword fragments in different languages. “iz” recurs in Italian “iniziativa” and in Latvian and Slovenian words; the other fragments are scattered and do not share meanings.

patterns.name: Slovak “oz”
patterns.context: The Slovak word “označuje”; the activation occurs in a passage about the previous century.

patterns.name: Czech “z”
patterns.context: The Czech word “nezávislý” in a context of resolving conflicts according to rules.

patterns.name: “iz” in iniziativa
patterns.context: Occurs in a fragment of the word “iniziativa” in a discussion of the Commission and its initiative.

patterns.name: “iz” in other Slavic words
patterns.context: Parts of words meaning proposing proposals and production; they share no meaning with Italian “iniziativa”.

patterns.name: French “ions”
patterns.context: A French subjunctive form of the verb “avoir” in a sentence about unwanted events.

patterns.name: “ap” in “Neapolitan”
patterns.context: A fragment of a proper or derived name in a description of a musical work and dance.

patterns.name: “ir” in “irlandais”
patterns.context: Part of a language name in a discussion of Gaelic and interpretation.

patterns.name: “ose” in “deosebită”
patterns.context: Part of a Romanian adjective in an appeal to pay particular attention to problems.

2_696.description: Aktivácia sa viaže najmä na jednotlivé vnútroslovné fragmenty v rôznych jazykoch. „iz“ sa opakuje v talianskom „iniziativa“ aj v lotyšskom a slovinskom slove; ostatné fragmenty sú roztrúsené a ich významy sa nezhodujú.

patterns.name: Slovak „oz“
patterns.context: Slovak slovo „označuje“; aktivácia sa vyskytuje v úseku o minulom storočí.

patterns.name: České „z“
patterns.context: České slovo „nezávislý“ v kontexte riešenia konfliktov podľa pravidiel.

patterns.name: „iz“ v iniciatíve
patterns.context: Vyskytuje sa vo fragmente slova „iniziativa“ v diskusii o Komisii a jej iniciatíve.

patterns.name: „iz“ v iných slovanských slovách
patterns.context: Časti slov oznaczających opracowywanie propozycji oraz produkcję; brak wspólnego znaczenia z włoskim „iniziativa“.

patterns.name: Francuskie „ions“
patterns.context: Francúzsky podmieňovací tvar slovesa „avoir“ vo vete o nežiadaných udalostiach.

patterns.name: „ap“ v „Neapolitan“
patterns.context: Úsek vlastného/odvodeného názvu v opise hudobného diela a tanca.

patterns.name: „ir“ v „irlandais“
patterns.context: Časť názvu jazyka v diskusii o gaelčine a tlmočení.

patterns.name: „ose“ v „deosebită“
patterns.context: Časť rumunského prídavného mena vo výzve venovať osobitnú pozornosť problémom.

en.description: Activations mainly fall on short fragments inside words across multiple languages; high-response fragments vary between languages and word forms and occur in parliamentary texts and a passage describing music, with no single semantic or grammatical condition explaining them.

patterns.name: Intra-word or word-boundary letter string “iz”
patterns.context: Activations often fall on short fragments inside words across multiple languages rather than on stable complete words; their positions and surrounding letters vary by word form.
patterns.domain: Mainly multilingual EU parliamentary political texts; also English Wikipedia music text.

patterns.name: Romanian “ză” and adjacent intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across different fragments inside Romanian words, especially near “az”, though other intra-word fragments also occur in the same segment.

patterns.name: Italian intra-word fragment “ose”
patterns.context: High activation concentrates on a short fragment inside a word, with no confirmed shared semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Romanian parliamentary text in a context containing Italian names and diplomatic content.

patterns.name: Danish intra-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside the word meaning “unfounded”; there is no evidence of other triggers in the same segment to support a broader pattern.

2_696.description: 激活主要落在多语种词内部的短字母片段；高响应片段在语言和词形间不一致，且分布于议会文本及一段音乐描述，无法由单一语义或语法条件解释。

patterns.name: 词内或词界处的“iz”字母串
patterns.trigger: 如 «iz»8（[3] «iz»8voda、[6] in«iz»8«iat»1iva、[7] in«iz»8iativa、[9] Ne«ap»8olitan）；也有 [1] «oz»10«na»1、[2] «z»8«á»1、[5] «iz»8 等近似片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在多语种词内部的短字母片段，而非稳定的完整词；其位置及周围字母随词形变化。
patterns.domain: 主要是欧盟议会多语种政治文本；另有英语维基百科音乐文字。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语“ză”及相邻词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于罗马尼亚语词内部的不同片段，尤其在“az”附近，但同段也出现其他词内片段。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内“ose”片段
patterns.context: 高激活集中在一个词内部的短片段，未见可确认的共同语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语议会文本中含意大利语姓名及外交内容的语境。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在表示“无根据的”一词内部；没有其他同段触发证据可支持更广模式。

en.description: Highlights are broadly distributed across ten multilingual texts, mainly on short intra-word fragments or morphemes across tokens; they cover proper names, ordinary words, and varied topics, with no stable semantic or syntactic conditions.

patterns.name: Internal morpheme boundaries across languages
patterns.context: Regardless of meaning or syntax, activations often fall inside words or near morpheme boundaries across multiple languages; specific word forms vary considerably, with no unified meaning condition
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary texts and English Wikipedia; mainly EuroParl

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names or language names
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur inside personal names, language names, place names, or proper names; however, similar fragments also occur in ordinary words, so the proper-name condition is not a sufficient explanation
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches and music encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in abstract-topic vocabulary
patterns.context: The words containing the fragments concern varied topics such as history, musical keys, rules, transport, trade, and economics, with no consistent semantic field

patterns.name: Short subword fragments in mixed-language text
patterns.context: They occur inside ordinary words in different languages and may reflect common letter strings or subword tokenization; these examples alone cannot establish a more specific trigger condition

2_696.description: 高亮广泛分布于十段多语种文本，主要落在词内短片段或跨 token 词素处；覆盖专名、普通词及多种议题，未见稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 多语种内部词素边界
patterns.trigger: 高亮集中在词语内部的跨 token 片段，如斯洛伐克语«na»、«oz»，法语«ir»、«inter»，英语«Ap»，捷克语«nik»、«zá»，罗马尼亚语«ose»、«ac»，意大利语«in»、«iz»，拉脱维亚语«iz»、«pri»，瑞典语«rask»，斯洛文尼亚语«iz»
patterns.context: 无论词义或句法，激活常落在多种语言的词内部或词素边界附近；各例具体词形差异较大，未见统一的词义条件
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本及英语维基百科；主要是 EuroParl

patterns.name: 专名或语言名称中的片段
patterns.context: 触发片段位于人名、语言名称、地名或专名内部；但同类片段也见于普通词，专名条件并非充分解释
patterns.domain: 议会发言及音乐百科文本

patterns.name: 抽象议题词汇的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «minor»、«Neap»；«poz»/«iz»等分别出现在历史、规则、运输、贸易、危机相关词语中
patterns.context: 片段所在词涉及历史、音乐调性、规则、运输、贸易或经济等不同议题，没有一致的语义场

patterns.name: 混合语种中的短子词片段
patterns.context: 在不同语言的普通词内部出现，可能反映常见字母串或子词切分；单凭这些实例无法确定更具体的触发条件

en.description: Activations mainly fall on specific subword fragments inside words across multiple languages, especially «iniz» in Italian iniziativa/inizio and «ap» in English Neapolitan; other activations are distributed across languages, word forms, and meanings, with no unified theme.

patterns.name: Subword activations at intra-word subword boundaries
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on specific subword fragments inside words, often at the beginning, middle, or end; they occur not only in complete words but also in inflected forms and words from different languages
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, especially Slavic and Romance languages and English

patterns.name: Italian iniziativa and related word family
patterns.context: The Italian noun iniziativa (initiative) and related forms or words with the same root; appearing in EU policy discussion

patterns.name: Words related to Neapolitan
patterns.context: The adjective Neapolitan appears in an English sentence, referring to a musical dance or mode

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in multiple languages
patterns.context: Activations fall on local letter/subword sequences inside words in Slovak, Czech, Romanian, Latvian, Slovenian, and other languages; there is no shared meaning or fixed word class

patterns.name: Other Italian intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Local subword fragments in Italian word forms are marked, with varied meanings and syntactic functions

2_696.description: 激活主要落在多语言词内部的特定子词片段，尤以意大利语 iniziativa/inizio 中的「iniz」及英语 Neapolitan 的「ap」突出；其他激活分布于多种语言、词形和语义，无统一主题。

patterns.name: 词内子词段边界处的子词激活
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内部特定子词片段，常处于词首、词中或词尾；不仅是完整词，也有词形变化和不同语言中的词
patterns.domain: 多语言文本，尤其是斯拉夫语、罗曼语及英语

patterns.name: 意大利语 iniziativa 及词族
patterns.context: 意大利语名词 iniziativa（倡议、举措）及其相关词形或同词根词；出现在欧盟政策讨论中
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语政治文本

patterns.name: Neapolitan 相关词
patterns.context: 英语句子中出现形容词 Neapolitan，指音乐舞曲或调式

patterns.name: 多种语言的词内片段
patterns.context: 在斯洛伐克语、捷克语、罗马尼亚语、拉脱维亚语、斯洛文尼亚语等词中，激活落在词内的局部字母/子词序列；并无共同语义或固定词类

patterns.name: 意大利语其他词内片段
patterns.context: 意大利语词形中局部子词片段被标记，语义和句法功能不一
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语政治文本

en.description: Most strong activations land on iz fragments within words across languages; there are also the musical term Neapolitan, scattered intraword fragments, and the answer label A. No stable semantic or syntactic connection is apparent among the scattered fragments.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment iz
patterns.context: Highlighted fragments occur inside words in different languages, often as part of an affix or stem in longer words; surrounding meanings and parts of speech vary.
patterns.domain: Primarily multilingual European Parliament text, also English legal and musical text.

patterns.name: Musical term Neapolitan
patterns.context: Occurs in the musical mode or form term Neapolitan; one instance discusses minuets and Italian dances, another introduces the Neapolitan Minor scale.

patterns.name: Other intraword fragments
patterns.context: Each is embedded in a different word, with no clearly shared meaning or syntactic condition; in passage 10, the two «a»4 instances are the Romanian preposition a.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or paragraph label A
patterns.context: A label for an answer in StackExchange Q&A, followed by a colon.

2_696.concept: 词内 iz 片段偏好
2_696.description: 多数强激活落在多语种词内的 iz 片段；另有 Neapolitan 音乐术语、零散词内片段及答案标签 A。零散片段间看不出稳定语义或句法联系。

patterns.name: 词内片段 iz
patterns.context: 高亮片段出现在不同语言词语内部，常见于较长词的词缀或词干部分；周围语义和词类并不固定。
patterns.domain: 以欧洲议会多语种文本为主，也见于英语法律文本和音乐文本。

patterns.name: 音乐术语 Neapolitan
patterns.context: 出现在音乐调式或曲式术语 Neapolitan 中；一处谈小步舞曲与意大利舞曲，一处介绍 Neapolitan Minor 音阶。

patterns.name: 其他词内碎片
patterns.context: 各自嵌在不同单词中，没有清楚可见的共同词义或句法条件；第 10 段两个 «a»4 位于罗马尼亚语介词 a。

patterns.name: 句首或段落标记 A
patterns.context: 作为 StackExchange 问答中答案的标签，后接冒号。

en.concept: Intra-word «iz» letter fragment, with scattered word fragments
en.description: The most consistent cue is the «iz» letter fragment inside words across multiple languages, but activations also fall on unrelated word fragments and Swedish agenda formatting; they do not form a consistent semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Intra-word «iz» fragment in orthography
patterns.context: Activations fall on the «iz» letter fragment inside words in multiple languages; they are not limited to a fixed meaning and often occur in affixes or cross-linguistic spellings.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European Parliament texts and an English legal text

patterns.name: Parliamentary speech and agenda formatting
patterns.context: In parliamentary minutes, formulaic agenda text follows a line break, with the chair’s title and the next item; this segment also contains ««utt»8».

patterns.name: Other scattered intra-word fragments
patterns.context: A small number of activations are distributed inside ordinary words in different languages, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition; some do not fit the main iz letter-fragment pattern.

2_696.concept: 词内「iz」字母片段，伴随零散词片段
2_696.description: 最稳定的线索是多语种词内含「iz」字母片段，但激活也落在多种无明显关联的词片段及瑞典议程格式上；不构成一致的语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 正字法中的词内「iz」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多种语言词语内部的「iz」字母片段；并不限于固定词义，常见于词缀或跨语言拼写。
patterns.domain: 多语种欧洲议会文本及一段英语法律文本

patterns.name: 议会发言与议程格式
patterns.context: 议会记录中换行后出现主席称谓及下一议题的程式化议程文字；本段同时含「«utt»8」。

patterns.name: 零散其他词内片段
patterns.context: 少量激活分布在不同语言的普通词内部，未显示统一的词义或句法条件；其中部分与主要的 iz 字母片段模式不一致。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本及法律文本

en.concept: Tokenized subword fragments in formal text
en.description: Primarily occurs in formal multilingual European Parliament text concerning policy, governance, legislation, and institutional affairs; activations often land on intraword fragments or short function words. Another passage is an English music entry, with activations on fragments in minor and Neapolitan.

patterns.name: European Parliament multilingual administrative, policy, and legislative text
patterns.context: Formal EU parliamentary discussion of EU institutions, resolutions, policy implementation, governance, finance, agriculture, or member-state affairs; activations often land on split intraword fragments, as well as short function words.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, multilingual formal political and administrative text

patterns.name: Music genres and dance names
patterns.context: Describes musical keys, movement structure, and music such as the Roman saltarello and Neapolitan tarantella.

2_696.concept: 正式文本中的切分词片段
2_696.description: 主要出现在多语种欧盟议会正式文本，涉及政策、治理、立法及机构事务，激活常落在词内片段或短功能词；另有一段英语音乐条目，激活于 minor 与 Neapolitan 的片段。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会多语种行政、政策与立法文本
patterns.trigger: 多段在斯洛伐克语、拉脱维亚语、斯洛文尼亚语、意大利语、捷克语、罗马尼亚语、丹麦语中激活；包括词内的«iz»、«pr»、«dom»等片段，以及« a»、« na»、« do»等短词片段
patterns.context: 欧盟议会正式论述中，讨论欧盟机构、决议、政策执行、治理、财政、农业或成员国事务；激活常落在被切分的词内片段，也有短功能词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，多语种正式政治与行政文本

patterns.name: 音乐体裁与舞曲名称
patterns.context: 介绍小调、乐章结构及罗马盐塔雷洛舞和那不勒斯塔兰泰拉舞等音乐内容。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科，音乐描述

en.description: All examples contain the Apache 2.0 license’s “AS IS” disclaimer. “BASIS” shows especially consistent strong activation; paths, version numbers, and comment formatting also occur but have weaker effects.

patterns.name: Apache 2.0 disclaimer text
patterns.context: Fixed wording in the Apache License 2.0 disclaimer, with strongest activation around “BASIS” and the subsequent “WITHOUT WARRANTIES”; no specific comment marker or indentation is required.

patterns.name: License path and version number
patterns.context: Often appears alongside the disclaimer text; the path fragment itself shows some activation, but much less than “BASIS” in the text.
patterns.domain: GitHub file paths and license references

patterns.name: Comment formatting and layout
patterns.context: Appears when the license text is embedded in code comments or uses different formatting; these symbols activate weakly, and formatting changes do not prevent the text pattern from appearing.

2_778.description: 所有样例都含 Apache 2.0 许可证的“AS IS”免责声明，尤其“BASIS”稳定强激活；路径、版本号及注释排版伴随出现但作用较弱。

patterns.name: Apache 2.0 免责声明正文
patterns.trigger: “Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing”及“distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS”
patterns.context: Apache License 2.0 免责声明中的固定措辞，尤其在“BASIS”及后续“WITHOUT WARRANTIES”附近激活最强；不要求特定注释符或缩进。

patterns.name: 许可证路径与版本号
patterns.context: 常与免责声明正文并列出现；路径片段本身有一定激活，但强度远低于正文中的“BASIS”。
patterns.domain: GitHub 文件路径、许可证引用

patterns.name: 注释格式与排版
patterns.context: 许可证正文被嵌入代码注释或采用不同排版时出现；这些符号只弱激活，格式变化并未阻止正文模式。

en.description: All snippets contain BASIS from “distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS” in the Apache 2.0 license disclaimer; although comment markers, spacing, and line-break formatting vary, the activation position is consistent.

patterns.name: BASIS in the Apache 2.0 disclaimer
patterns.context: Apache License 2.0 disclaimer paragraph; the preceding text states that the software is provided as-is, followed by “WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS”.
patterns.domain: Open-source license text on GitHub, including Markdown and code comments

2_778.concept: Apache 2.0 免责声明中的 BASIS
2_778.description: 所有片段都包含 Apache 2.0 许可证免责声明中 “distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS” 的 BASIS；虽然注释符、空格和换行格式不同，激活位置一致。

patterns.name: Apache 2.0 免责声明中的 BASIS
patterns.trigger: «BASIS»，尤其是其前的 “distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS”
patterns.context: Apache License 2.0 免责声明段落；前文说明软件按现状提供，后接 “WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS”。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的开源许可证文本，含 Markdown、代码注释等格式

en.description: All paragraphs are the same disclaimer from Apache License 2.0. The strongest trigger is “BASIS”, placed between “AS IS” and “WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS”; changes in paths, comment markers, indentation, and capitalization do not alter the pattern.

patterns.name: AS IS BASIS in the disclaimer
patterns.context: In the Apache License 2.0 disclaimer clause, software is distributed on an “AS IS” basis, followed by a no-warranty statement; indentation, punctuation, and capitalization vary slightly between paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Open-source license text on GitHub, including Markdown, comments, and license file paths

2_778.description: 所有段落都是 Apache License 2.0 的同一免责声明。最强触发点是“BASIS”，置于“AS IS”与“WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS”之间；路径、注释符、缩进和大小写变化均不改变模式。

patterns.name: 免责声明中的 AS IS BASIS
patterns.context: Apache License 2.0 免责声明条款中，软件按“AS IS”基础分发，后接无担保声明；不同段落缩进、标点及大小写略有差异。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的开源许可证文本，含 Markdown、注释及许可证文件路径

en.description: All segments concern open-source software license disclaimers, especially “AS IS” and warranty disclaimers; most also contain a legal exception clause. Paths, versions, comment markers, and formatting vary by file; the second segment additionally mentions preserving license notices.

patterns.name: License disclaimer text
patterns.context: Appears in software license disclaimers, typically following “software distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS”, and listing warranty disclaimers.
patterns.domain: GitHub open-source license files (Apache License 2.0 style)

patterns.name: License legal-conditions clause
patterns.context: Legal exception conditions at the beginning of the disclaimer text, explaining that applicable law or a written agreement may provide an exception.

patterns.name: License file path and version

patterns.name: 许可证文件路径与版本

en.description: This neuron activates strongly on recurring license disclaimers on GitHub, especially “AS IS” and “WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS”; it also responds to variations in license paths, versions, and comment formatting, and occasionally to instructions to retain the license notice.

patterns.name: License disclaimer body

patterns.domain: Software license text in GitHub projects, mainly license files or license notices embedded in source code

patterns.name: License paths and version numbers

patterns.name: Comment markers and formatting variants

patterns.domain: Code comments and repository file formats

patterns.name: Instructions to retain the license notice
patterns.context: Appears as a license-related note, followed by the same “AS IS” disclaimer; this sentence is distinctive in this context.
patterns.domain: License files or legal notices in repositories

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the “as-is” distribution and warranty disclaimer in Apache-2.0-style licenses; paths, comment markers, and formatting vary. Two other examples—literary statements about fate and a clinical home-rehabilitation context—cannot be explained by the license pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed wording in license disclaimers

patterns.name: Use of destiny in Homeric works

patterns.name: Home-rehabilitation context in a medical paper
patterns.context: In the Background section of a medical paper, describes the benefits of early supported discharge and ongoing rehabilitation at home; strong activation occurs on “the”.

2_778.description: 主要对 Apache-2.0 风格许可证中的“按现状”分发及无担保免责声明强烈响应，路径、注释符和排版可变。另有文学命运表述与临床居家康复背景两例，均无法由许可证模式解释。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明固定措辞

patterns.domain: GitHub 软件仓库中的许可证文件或源代码注释，主要是 Apache-2.0 风格法律文本。

patterns.name: 荷马作品中的 destiny 表述

en.description: All segments are repeated text near version 2.0 license disclaimers on GitHub: after the path and version identifier, they first state legal or written-agreement exceptions, then provide the software “as is” with no warranty; comment markers vary by file format.

patterns.name: License disclaimer phrase

patterns.name: License file path and version

patterns.name: Legal exception conditions
patterns.context: Exception conditions preceding the disclaimer, stating that applicable law or a written agreement may provide an exception.

patterns.name: Comment-format markers
patterns.context: The same license text is formatted in different repositories as a Markdown heading, comment lines, or plain text; these markers appear alongside the text.

2_778.description: 所有片段均为 GitHub 上 2.0 版许可证免责声明附近的重复文本：路径与版本标识之后，先写法律或书面约定例外，再写“按现状”提供及不作担保；注释符号随文件格式变化。

2_778.concept: 特定字符串片段与代码标记
