en.description: Activation is scattered across several local letter fragments: within-word spellings such as rew, ice, and ful, as well as legal names, medical terminology, and square-bracket markers. Cross-context recurrence is limited, with no stable semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Shrewsbury
patterns.context: Activation falls inside a proper name or common word containing the letter sequence rew, rather than at a complete word boundary; the two examples have the same spelling but different contexts.

patterns.name: Spelling fragment ice
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending spelling fragment in Twice; [2] is an award entry, while [4] is narrative text.

patterns.name: English word endings or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on local letter fragments in different English words, spanning word-final and within-word positions, with inconsistent semantic and syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative; species lists; energy news; scientific records

patterns.name: Letter sequence NEIGHBORHOOD
patterns.context: In an all-caps legal case name, adjacent fragments jointly spell NEIGHBORHOOD; activation concentrates in the middle of the word.

patterns.name: Local fragment in bleed
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal spelling fragment in the medical compound rebleeding; the surrounding text discusses bleeding-related outcome measures.

patterns.name: Square brackets and unreadable marker
patterns.context: Activation appears near crystallographic data bracket markers; the same segment also contains Useful, but there is insufficient evidence to connect them.

2_778.description: 激活分散于若干局部字母片段：rew、ice、ful等词内拼写，以及法律名称、医学术语和方括号标记；跨语境重复有限，未见稳定语义或领域规律。

patterns.name: Shrewsbury 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在含字母序列 rew 的专名或普通词内部，而非完整词边界；两个例子拼写相同但语境不同。
patterns.domain: 地名条目；书目/小说标题

patterns.name: ice 拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词 Twice 的词尾拼写片段；[2]为奖项条目，[4]为叙事正文。

patterns.name: 英文词尾或内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在不同英文词中的局部字母片段，跨越词尾及词内位置，语义和句法条件不一致。
patterns.domain: 文学叙事；物种清单；能源新闻；科研记录

patterns.name: 字母串 NEIGHBORHOOD
patterns.context: 在全大写法律案件名称中，邻接片段共同拼出 NEIGHBORHOOD；激活集中于词中部。

patterns.name: bleed 局部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学复合词 rebleeding 的内部拼写片段，周围讨论出血相关结局指标。

patterns.name: 方括号与 unreadable 标记
patterns.context: 在晶体学数据括号标记附近激活；同一段还包含 Useful，但没有足够证据说明两者相关。

en.description: Activation concentrates on several within-word fragments or complete short words: Shrewsbury/Shrewdness, Evil, Receives, Interpreting, Last, prescient, swans, and Twice. They occur across various genres, with no unified semantic or contextual condition.

patterns.name: Word-internal string “shrew”
patterns.context: Appears inside a complete word in a place name or book title; in both segments it is adjacent to a proper name, but the word forms differ.

patterns.name: String “evil”
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a username in a comment post, followed by another word to form the handle.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in “receive”
patterns.context: The sentence-initial capitalized verb “Receives” reports a bid announcement.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in “interpreting”
patterns.context: In a legal text, the present participle introduces an institution's interpretation of a regulation.

patterns.name: “last”
patterns.context: “Last year” refers to the previous year, followed by the number of research projects and a new process.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in “prescient”
patterns.context: Describes an early theory as prescient, in an academic discussion sentence.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in “swans”
patterns.context: A plural noun in the logical analysis example “some swans are blue.”

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in “twice”
patterns.context: Indicates that an honor was received twice in an awards list.

2_778.description: 激活集中在若干词内片段或完整短词上：Shrewsbury/Shrewdness、Evil、Receives、Interpreting、Last、prescient、swans、Twice。它们分布于多种文体，未见统一语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 词尾「shrew」字符串
patterns.context: 出现在地名或书名中的完整词内部；两段中都紧邻专名，词形不同。

patterns.name: 「evil」字符串
patterns.context: 评论帖中作为用户名开头，后接另一个词组成网名。

patterns.name: 「receive」词内片段
patterns.context: 大写句首动词“Receives”内，报道竞标消息。

patterns.name: 「interpreting」词内片段
patterns.context: 法律文本中以现在分词引出机构对法规的解释。

patterns.name: 「last」
patterns.context: “Last year”表示上一年度，后接研究项目数量及新增流程。

patterns.name: 「prescient」词内片段
patterns.context: 描述早期理论具有先见之明，位于学术论述句中。

patterns.name: 「swans」词内片段
patterns.context: 逻辑分析例句中，“some swans are blue”里的复数名词。

patterns.name: 「twice」词内片段
patterns.context: 奖项列表中表示获得某荣誉两次。

en.description: Strong activations mostly fall on within-word character fragments: rew, ceives, it, ical, cient, ans, uel/ty, as well as name fragments and sporadic common words. Semantics and styles are varied and cannot be explained by a single theme.

patterns.name: Within-word token fragment shrew
patterns.context: Activation falls on the «rew» character fragment inside a word; it appears in the place name Shrewsbury and the adjective shrewdness, with different surrounding characters

patterns.name: ceives character fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the news headline Norway Receives Bids, with activation concentrated on a consecutive within-word character fragment

patterns.name: Within-word it character fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls inside a name, not on an independent word; the surname appears in both email recipient/CC lists

patterns.name: Within-word ruelty character fragment
patterns.context: Appears within the fixed institution name Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals; activation is within the word

patterns.name: Within-word ical character fragment
patterns.context: The word describes the comedic nature of a performer or person; both examples occur in evaluative narratives

patterns.name: Within-word cient character fragment
patterns.context: Describes a theoretical prediction as far-sighted; activation occurs inside the adjective

patterns.name: Within-word swan character fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a philosophical logic example about possible worlds and blue swans

patterns.name: Sporadic within-word fragments
patterns.context: These activations occur in email names, technical text, review narratives, and ordinary sentences; they share no obvious local semantic or syntactic condition
patterns.domain: Emails, technical writing, reviews, and general prose

2_778.description: 强激活多落在词内字符片段：rew、ceives、it、ical、cient、ans、uel/ty，另有姓名片段及零散普通词。语义与文体分散，无法由单一主题解释。

patterns.name: 词内分词片段 shrew
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的 «rew» 字符片段；分别出现在地名 Shrewsbury 和形容词 shrewdness 中，周围字符不同
patterns.domain: 地理条目、书目/作品标题

patterns.name: ceives 字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻标题 Norway Receives Bids 中，激活集中在词内连续字符片段

patterns.name: 词内 it 字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名内部，而非独立词；两段邮件收件人/抄送名单中均出现该姓氏

patterns.name: 词内 ruelty 字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在固定机构名称 Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals 中，激活位于词内

patterns.name: 词内 ical 字符片段
patterns.context: 该词用于描述表演者或人物的喜剧性；两处均为评价性叙述

patterns.name: 词内 cient 字符片段
patterns.context: 描述理论预测具有先见之明，激活位于形容词内部

patterns.name: 词内 swan 字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于可能世界及蓝色天鹅的哲学逻辑例句中

patterns.name: 零散词内片段
patterns.trigger: «usc»、«R»、«it»等姓名或词内片段；另有 «non»、«mu»、«near»、«much»、«easier» 等普通词/词片段
patterns.context: 这些激活分别出现在邮件姓名、技术文本、评论叙述及普通语句中；彼此没有明显共同的局部语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术文、评论及一般散文

en.description: In every segment, high activation falls on character fragments within words or proper names, spanning place names, book titles, personal names, terminology, and foreign-language words. Only two segments share il in the Evil username; the other trigger fragments differ.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in Shrewsbury
patterns.context: In the place name Shrewsbury River, activation concentrates on the within-word character fragment «rew».

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in Shrewdness
patterns.context: In the bibliographic title Shrewdness, activation concentrates on «rew» and extends to an adjacent affix fragment.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in Receive
patterns.context: The verb receives in a news headline activates on an internal word fragment.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in Inflorescences
patterns.context: In the botanical morphology term inflorescences, activation falls on a single-letter fragment within the word.

patterns.name: Name fragment Crescen-
patterns.context: In the personal name Crescenzio, activation falls on an internal name fragment.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in Crucially
patterns.context: The within-word fragment in the adverb crucially activates in recruitment copy.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in Suffice
patterns.context: In the legal discussion, suffice activates on a word-final fragment.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in Pequeña
patterns.context: In Spanish-language Q&A, activation falls on a fragment within pequeña.

patterns.name: Evil username fragment
patterns.context: In the forum username EvilTerran, activation concentrates on il at the start of the username.

patterns.name: Evil username fragment
patterns.context: In the forum username EvilTrout, activation concentrates on il at the start of the username.

2_778.description: 各段高激活都落在词或专名的内部字符片段，覆盖地名、书名、人名、术语及外语词；只有两段共享 Evil 用户名中的 il，其余触发片段各异。

patterns.name: Shrewsbury 词形片段
patterns.context: 地名 Shrewsbury River 中，激活集中在词内的 «rew» 字符片段。

patterns.name: Shrewdness 词形片段
patterns.context: 书目标题 Shrewdness 中，激活集中在 «rew»，并延伸至相邻词缀片段。

patterns.name: Receive 词形片段
patterns.context: 新闻标题中的动词 receives，激活落在词内部片段。

patterns.name: Inflorescences 词形片段
patterns.context: 植物形态描述中的术语 inflorescences，激活落在词内单字母片段。

patterns.name: Crescen- 名字片段
patterns.context: 人名 Crescenzio 中，激活落在姓名内部片段。

patterns.name: Crucially 词形片段
patterns.context: 招聘文案中副词 crucially 的词内片段激活。

patterns.name: Suffice 词形片段
patterns.context: 法律论述中的 suffice，激活落在词尾片段。

patterns.name: Pequeña 词形片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语问答中，激活落在 pequeña 的词内片段。

patterns.name: Evil 用户名片段
patterns.context: 论坛用户名 EvilTerran 中，激活集中在用户名开头的 il。

patterns.name: Evil 用户名片段
patterns.context: 论坛用户名 EvilTrout 中，激活集中在用户名开头的 il。

en.description: Activations most prominently fall on the “rew” character fragment in words such as Shrewsbury; other activations are distributed across spelling fragments within words, common legal-document words, formatting symbols, and abbreviations, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Letter-fragment rearrangement/completion into a word initial
patterns.context: Activation falls on a letter fragment within a word; “rew” recurs with the highest strength in the place name Shrewsbury and the title Shrewdness.

patterns.name: Within-word spelling fragments
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on a character sequence within a word or proper noun; forms and contexts vary, with no evidence of shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus: bibliographies, papers, legal texts, news, plant descriptions, and names

patterns.name: Fixed expressions and function words in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in arguments or procedural explanations in decisions or litigation documents; several common words activate weakly, along with within-word activations in the fixed phrase “Suffice it to say”.

patterns.name: Common relational and determiner words between words
patterns.context: Mostly common function words or words in common collocations; sentences concern papers, plant descriptions, project reports, and other topics, with no uniform semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, botanical descriptions, research project reports, etc.

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Markers fall on line breaks, whitespace, divider lines, or page breaks; concentrated in court docket title pages and list formatting.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic formatting, legal dockets, and electronic text formats

patterns.name: Uppercase letter combinations in abbreviations or proper nouns
patterns.context: Character fragments occur in the insurance institution abbreviation FSL-IC, the compliance abbreviation CLIA, or name spellings; they are sporadic and lack a shared context.
patterns.domain: Legal insurance documents, research reports, names

2_778.description: 激活最突出地落在 Shrewsbury 等词中的「rew」字符片段；其余激活分散于词内拼写片段、法律文书常用词、版式符号及缩写，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 字母片段重排/补全为词首
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的字母片段；「rew」在地名 Shrewsbury 及书名 Shrewdness 中重复出现，强度最高。

patterns.name: 词内拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内或专名内部的一段字符，词形和语境各异；没有证据表明它们共享特定语义。
patterns.domain: 混合语料：书目、论文、法律、新闻、植物描述及人名

patterns.name: 法律文书中的固定表达与功能词
patterns.context: 出现在判决或诉讼文件的论证、程序说明中；多个常见词获得较弱激活，另有「Suffice it to say」这一固定表达的词内激活。

patterns.name: 词间常见关系词及限定词
patterns.context: 多为普通功能词或常见搭配中的词；所在句子分别涉及论文叙述、植物描述、项目报告等，语义条件不统一。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、植物学描述、科研项目报告等

patterns.name: 换行与版式符号
patterns.context: 标记落在换行、空白、分隔线或分页符上；集中于法院案卷标题页及列表排版。
patterns.domain: 书目排版、法律案卷及电子文本格式

patterns.name: 缩写或专名中的大写字母组合
patterns.context: 字符片段处于保险机构缩写 FSL-IC、合规缩写 CLIA 或姓名拼写中；零散出现，缺少共同语境。
patterns.domain: 法律保险文件、科研报告、人名

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the word form conflict across academic, legal, patent, and war contexts; also shows subword-fragment activations for Stayton and Wayne, plus secondary markers such as bloody in war narratives.

patterns.name: Conflict-related noun
patterns.context: The word form conflict itself is the most stable trigger. It can refer to disagreement between opinions, interests, requirements, events, or formal systems, as well as armed conflict.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patents, legal texts, news, and historical narratives

patterns.name: Stayton in a proper name
patterns.context: Appears in the U.S. case name “United States v. Stayton”; no conflict-related meaning is required.

patterns.name: Name fragment of a hockey player
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the name “Wayne Simpson”; no conflict-related meaning is required.

patterns.name: Words associated with conflict
patterns.context: Appears in the context of war narratives alongside conflict, but war is unmarked in [8][10], so it cannot be considered an independent trigger. These markers are more likely local associations or secondary patterns.

2_809.description: 主要对词形 conflict 强烈响应，覆盖学术、法律、专利及战争语境；另有 Stayton、Wayne 的词片激活，以及战争叙述中的 bloody 等次要标记。

patterns.name: 冲突相关名词
patterns.trigger: «conflict»（[1][3][5][6][7][8][9][10]）；在[6]为“they conflict with”，在[9]为“conflict hypergraphs / conflict graph”
patterns.context: 词形 conflict 本身是最稳定的触发点；可指意见、利益、要求、事件或形式系统之间的不一致，也可指武装冲突。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、法律文本、新闻及历史叙述

patterns.name: 专名中的 Stayton
patterns.context: 出现在美国诉讼案名“United States v. Stayton”中；不要求有 conflict 语义。

patterns.name: 冰球运动员姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名“Wayne Simpson”开头；不要求有 conflict 语义。

patterns.name: 近冲突的议题词
patterns.context: 与 conflict 同处战争叙述语境，但 war 在[8][10]未标记，不能据此认定其单独触发；这些标记更可能是局部关联或次要模式。

en.description: Primarily activates on conflict and its phrasal or technical compound uses, covering conflicts of interest, disagreement, war, and conflict graphs; also includes sporadic activation on name fragments, function words, sentence-initial words, and local narrative words, with no unified interpretation.

patterns.name: conflict word forms
patterns.context: The noun conflict itself or a compound containing it is marked; it may refer to a dispute, opposition, or war, or serve as a technical term.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, academic abstracts, film and historical narratives, patents, law, news, computer science

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within names or words and does not clearly depend on conflict semantics; segment [2] also activates on a complete component of a personal name.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, encyclopedia entries, legal case names

patterns.name: Function words and sentence-initial words
patterns.context: In addition to adjacent conflict activations, ordinary words or boundary tokens also activate; the triggering conditions are unclear.

patterns.name: Narrative vocabulary
patterns.context: These occur respectively in parenthetical remarks after names and in academic narration introduced by a contrast; their relation to conflict is unclear.

patterns.name: Other local collocates
patterns.context: These occur respectively in historical contexts of escalating conflict and in legal quotations. They may relate to syntax or neighboring words, but evidence is insufficient to infer a shared condition.

patterns.name: Subword fragments without the main pattern
patterns.context: Activations occur on personal names and headings; conflict also appears in the same passage, but the semantic relationship between the marked words themselves and conflict is unclear.

2_809.description: 主要对 conflict 及其短语或技术复合用法激活，涵盖利益冲突、意见对立、战争及冲突图；另有零散姓名片段、功能词、句首词和局部叙述词激活，缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: conflict 词形
patterns.context: 名词 conflict 本身或其复合词中被标记；可指争议、对立、战争，也可作技术术语。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、学术摘要、影视与历史叙述、专利、法律、新闻、计算机科学

patterns.name: 专名内部的词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名或词语内部的子词片段，并不明显依赖 conflict 语义；段[2]还激活完整人名组成部分。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、百科条目、法律案件名称

patterns.name: 功能词与句首词
patterns.context: 在相邻的 conflict 激活之外，普通词或边界 token 也有激活，触发条件不明确。

patterns.name: 叙述性词汇
patterns.context: 分别出现在人名后的括注以及转折引出的学术叙述中；与 conflict 的关系不清楚。

patterns.name: 其它局部搭配词
patterns.context: 分别出现在冲突升级的历史语境和法律引述中，可能与句法或邻近词有关，但证据不足以归纳共同条件。

patterns.name: 未见主模式的词片段
patterns.context: 激活位于人物名及小标题；同段也出现 conflict，但这些被标记词本身与其语义关系不明。

en.description: The most stable pattern is sensitivity to conflict and its compounds or inflected forms, covering conflicts of interest, disagreements, wars, and technical terms; two instances of activation on proper-name fragments are also present, but do not directly correspond to this pattern.

patterns.name: conflict and its word forms
patterns.context: The noun conflict refers to a dispute, conflict, or conflicting relationship; it appears in fixed expressions, event narratives, legal opinions, and technical terms.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: academic papers, law, news, history, technical texts

patterns.name: Fragment activation in proper names
patterns.context: Occurs in the personal name Way ne Simpson and the case name United States v. Stayton; activation falls on fragments within proper names, not on clearly identifiable conflict semantics.

2_809.description: 最稳定的模式是对 conflict 及其复合词或词形敏感，涵盖利益冲突、意见分歧、战争冲突和技术术语；另有两例专名片段激活，难与此模式直接对应。

patterns.name: conflict 词及其词形
patterns.context: 名词 conflict 指争端、冲突或冲突关系；出现在固定搭配、事件叙述、法律意见和技术术语中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：学术论文、法律、新闻、历史、技术文本

patterns.name: 专名中的片段激活
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Way ne Simpson 与案件名 United States v. Stayton 中；激活落在专名内部片段，而非明确的 conflict 语义上。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律案件标题

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the word conflict, covering interpersonal/interest conflicts, war, mathematical terminology, and scheduling conflicts; also includes proper-name fragments such as Way and Stay, plus a few sporadic markers with unclear patterns.

patterns.name: Way/Stay syllables in proper names
patterns.context: Appears as part of a person’s name or case name, without an obvious shared semantic cue in the surrounding text.

patterns.name: conflict and its word forms
patterns.context: The word conflict appears directly, referring to conflicts of interest, disagreement, armed conflict, graph-theoretic conflict, or personal scheduling conflicts; the specific meaning depends on context.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, law, patents, news, email, mathematical texts

patterns.name: Subword in the string Charuga
patterns.context: The activation marker falls near a garbled string or word beginning, followed by the movie title Charuga; the local context does not establish a stable lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on ordinary words
patterns.context: These markers do not show consistent triggers recurring across passages and may be sporadic activations or tokenization-boundary effects.

2_809.description: 主要对 conflict 一词有强反应，涵盖人际/利益冲突、战争、数学术语及日程冲突；另有 Way、Stay 等专名片段及少量零散标记，模式不明。

patterns.name: 专名中 Way/Stay 音节
patterns.context: 出现在人名或案件名称中，作为专名的一部分；周围没有明显共同语义线索。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律案件名称

patterns.name: conflict 及其词形
patterns.trigger: « conflict»（2、4–10）；« conflict» 出现在多个语义搭配中
patterns.context: 直接出现 conflict 一词，表示利益冲突、意见不一致、武装冲突、图论中的冲突，或个人日程安排冲突；具体含义由上下文决定。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律、专利、新闻、邮件、数学文本

patterns.name: Charuga 字符串中的子词
patterns.context: 激活标记落在乱码/词首附近，后文是电影名 Charuga；无法从局部上下文确定是否为稳定词义模式。

patterns.name: 通常词语的零星激活
patterns.trigger: « We»（2）、« Recent»（4）、«»1▯aruga（5）中的非 conflict 标记
patterns.context: 这些标记未呈现出跨段重复且一致的触发条件，可能是零散激活或分词边界效应。

en.concept: Heterogeneous triggers across vocabulary and proper-name fragments
en.description: Triggers are distributed: they include several proper names or word-final splits, simultaneous in a medical title, sentence-initial We, and uses of conflict for academic contradictions, scheduling conflicts, technical incompatibility, and armed conflict; the trigger in the final segment appears to be garbled text.

patterns.name: Word-final segmentation in “Wayne”
patterns.context: A proper name is split into subword tokens; it is followed by a parenthetical description of identity or field.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial word in a statistics article
patterns.context: After a transition, the sentence begins with “We should...” and discusses how to interpret a statistical measure.

patterns.name: “Stayton” in a case name
patterns.context: A person’s name in a U.S. court case title is split, followed by a date.

patterns.name: “simultaneous” in a test title
patterns.context: Describes simultaneous testing of two related measures in a medical test title.

patterns.name: “conflict” meaning contradiction
patterns.context: Describes functions reported in research literature as contradicting one another.

patterns.name: “Grimes” in a surname
patterns.context: A personal name is tokenized, with activation concentrated at the end of the surname.

patterns.name: Scheduling conflict
patterns.context: A first-person statement explains an inability to attend because of a prior commitment.

patterns.name: “conflict” meaning incompatibility
patterns.context: A patent text explains that an optical design is incompatible with the requirements of thin lenses.

patterns.name: Armed-conflict context
patterns.context: Discusses the Syrian civil war and its casualties.

patterns.name: War-escalation context
patterns.context: The visible trigger occurs in corrupted or garbled text; the context discusses the breakup of Yugoslavia and the escalation of conflict into the Croatian War of Independence.

2_809.concept: 词汇与专名片段的异质触发
2_809.description: 触发分布分散：包括若干专名或词尾切分、医学标题中的simultaneous、句首We，以及conflict在学术矛盾、日程不合、技术不相容和武装冲突中的用法；末段触发字符疑似乱码。

patterns.name: 词尾切分“Wayne”
patterns.context: 专名被分成子词 token；后接括号中的身份或领域说明。

patterns.name: 统计文章中的句首词
patterns.context: 句子转折后以“We should...”开头，讨论如何理解统计指标。

patterns.name: 判例名称中的“Stayton”
patterns.context: 美国诉讼案名称中的人名被拆分，后接日期。

patterns.name: 检测标题中的“simultaneous”
patterns.context: 医学检测标题中描述同时检测两种相关指标。

patterns.name: “conflict”表示相互矛盾
patterns.context: 描述研究文献所报告的功能彼此矛盾。

patterns.name: 姓氏中的“Grimes”
patterns.context: 人名被分词，激活集中于姓氏末尾。

patterns.name: 日程冲突
patterns.context: 第一人称说明因已有安排而无法赴约。

patterns.name: “conflict”表示不相容
patterns.context: 专利文本说明光学设计与薄型镜片的要求不相容。

patterns.name: 武装冲突语境
patterns.context: 谈论叙利亚内战及其伤亡。

patterns.name: 战争升级语境
patterns.context: 可见触发位于字符损坏或乱码处；上下文谈及南斯拉夫解体及冲突升级为克罗地亚独立战争。

en.description: Activations are distributed across fragments of various medical terms, particularly the suffix -ologically; there are also activations for names, conflict, simultaneous, Plasmodium, varicose veins, and statistical-indicator contexts, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: -ologically suffix in biomedical words
patterns.context: The activation falls on the spelling fragment -ologically, in words related to morphology, neuropathology, histology, and immunology.

patterns.name: Person name Bernard Grimes
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across token fragments of the name Bernard Grimes; the following text gives the nickname “Bernie”.

patterns.name: Name Wayne Simpson and hockey parenthetical
patterns.context: Activation appears on fragments of the name Wayne Simpson; the parenthetical connects him with hockey.

patterns.name: Conflict collocations
patterns.context: Conflict appears in statements of competing interests or descriptions of reports whose functions contradict one another.
patterns.domain: Medical paper disclosures and academic discussion

patterns.name: The word simultaneous
patterns.context: Used to describe simultaneous detection of antigens and antibodies; the word itself is the main activation location.

patterns.name: Plasmodium in a parasite name
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across the genus-name fragment in Plasmodium yoelii, in a context of mouse infection and circulating antigens.

patterns.name: Varicose veins and related anatomical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on the Latin anatomical description of the testicular veins and the word fragment varicocele.

patterns.name: Discussion of statistical indices
patterns.context: Discusses the properties and meaning of statistical indices; activation is weak and not clearly connected to the other patterns in this example.

2_809.description: 激活分散于多种医学术语片段，尤见 -ologically 词尾；另对人名、冲突、simultaneous、Plasmodium、静脉曲张及统计指标语境有激活，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 生物医学词中的 -ologically 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在拼写片段 -ologically 上；出现在形态学、神经病理学、组织学及免疫学相关词中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与项目摘要

patterns.name: Bernard Grimes 人名
patterns.context: 激活分散在人名 Bernard Grimes 的分词片段上，后文给出昵称 “Bernie”。

patterns.name: Wayne Simpson 姓名及冰球括注
patterns.context: 激活出现在 Wayne Simpson 的名字片段；括号将其与冰球联系起来。

patterns.name: 冲突搭配
patterns.context: conflict 出现在利益冲突声明或描述报告功能彼此矛盾的语境中。
patterns.domain: 医学论文声明与学术讨论

patterns.name: simultaneous 一词
patterns.context: 用于描述检测抗原与抗体的同步检测；该词本身是主要激活位置。

patterns.name: 寄生虫名称中的 Plasmodium
patterns.context: 激活分布在 Plasmodium yoelii 的属名片段中，语境为小鼠感染及循环抗原。
patterns.domain: 寄生虫免疫学研究摘要

patterns.name: 静脉曲张及相关解剖词
patterns.context: 激活落在睾丸静脉的拉丁解剖描述和 varicocele（精索静脉曲张）词片段中。

patterns.name: 统计指数讨论
patterns.context: 讨论统计指标的性质与含义；激活较弱，且与本例其他模式不明显相连。

en.concept: conflict token and occasional local features
en.description: The most stable pattern is the token conflict, covering conflicts of interest, facts, theories, designs, and biological competition. Other sporadic activations fall on proper names, company codes, group, workable, development, graphs, citation numbers, and place names.

patterns.name: conflict token
patterns.context: The word form conflict appears in different semantic collocations: conflicts of interest, disagreements between opinions or facts, incompatibility of theories or designs, and competitive relationships. It does not depend on a single fixed phrase.
patterns.domain: Law, academic papers, patents, and biology

patterns.name: Beginning fragment of a place/proper name
patterns.context: In the name Wayne Simpson, activation is concentrated on the initial proper-name token; subsequent text is weakly marked.

patterns.name: Arabic proper-name fragment
patterns.context: An Arabic letter in an Iranian company stock code, adjacent to other Arabic letters, with the strongest activation on one of the letters.

patterns.name: Medical group phrasing
patterns.context: The word group appears after a statistical proportion in a sentence reporting a value for an early male group.

patterns.name: Fragment within workable
patterns.context: Occurs within the word “workable hypotheses,” meaning feasible hypotheses; the surrounding text discusses research literature and function.

patterns.name: Business phrasing about development
patterns.context: Occurs with property in a list of business areas for corporate expansion.

patterns.name: Graph theory terminology
patterns.context: Appears in the technical term “conflict hypergraphs”; the same passage also contains highly activated conflict.

patterns.name: Numeric fragment in a legal citation
patterns.context: Within the page number of a Florida case citation; conflict also appears in the surrounding context, but the number itself is marked as well.

patterns.name: Place name Florida
patterns.context: Appears in a species-distribution context to indicate a study location; activation is weak.

2_809.concept: conflict 词元及偶发局部特征
2_809.description: 最稳定模式是词元 conflict：涵盖利益、事实、理论、设计及生物竞争等冲突。另有零散激活落在专名、公司代码、group、workable、development、graphs、引证数字及地名上。

patterns.name: conflict 词元
patterns.context: 词形 conflict 出现在不同语义搭配中：利益冲突、意见/事实矛盾、理论或设计不相容、竞争关系；并非依赖单一固定短语。
patterns.domain: 法律、学术论文、专利及生物学

patterns.name: 地名/专名开头片段
patterns.context: 名字 Way ne Simpson 中，激活集中在专名首 token；后文标注较弱。

patterns.name: 阿拉伯文专名片段
patterns.context: 伊朗公司股票代码中的阿拉伯文字母，邻接其他阿拉伯字母，但最强激活落在其中一个字母。

patterns.name: 医学分组表述
patterns.context: 统计比例后出现 group；句中报告早期男性某组的数值。

patterns.name: workable 词内片段
patterns.context: 位于“workable hypotheses”一词内部，意为可行的假设；周边谈研究文献与功能。

patterns.name: 开发业务表述
patterns.context: 与 property 连用，列举企业扩张的业务领域。

patterns.name: 图论术语
patterns.context: 出现在“conflict hypergraphs”这一技术术语中；同段也含高激活 conflict。

patterns.name: 文献引证中的数字片段
patterns.context: 佛罗里达州判例引证的页码数字内部；上下文同时出现 conflict，但该数字本身也被标记。

patterns.name: 地点名 Florida
patterns.context: 出现在物种分布语境中，表示研究地点；激活较弱。

en.description: Activations center on the token cell: primarily in biomedical contexts involving cells and their compound expressions, but also in the non-biological senses fuel cell and cell phone; context distinguishes the meanings.

patterns.name: cell token in biology
patterns.context: Part of a biological noun referring to a cell, cell type, or cellular entity; appears in compounds, noun phrases, and life-science discussion.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, cell biology, and biochemistry abstracts/research plans

patterns.name: cell in fuel cell
patterns.context: Cell refers to a fuel cell, not a biological cell; it appears with words such as fuel, system, stack, and electrode.

patterns.name: cell in cell phone
patterns.context: Cell is part of cellular phone and refers to a mobile phone; nearby are consumer electronics such as mobile devices and media players.
patterns.domain: Patent background, electronic devices and mobile communications

2_809.description: 激活集中于词元 cell：主要出现在生物医学语境的细胞及其复合表达，也见于 fuel cell 和 cell phone 两种非生物义；语义由上下文区分。

patterns.name: 生物学中的 cell 词元
patterns.context: 作为生物学名词的一部分，指细胞、细胞类型或细胞实体；出现在复合词、名词短语及生命科学论述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、细胞生物学与生物化学摘要/研究计划

patterns.name: 燃料电池中的 cell
patterns.trigger: «cell»7、«cell»8、«cell»10；如 «fuel»1« cell»7« system»3 与 «fuel»1« cell»8« stack»
patterns.context: cell 指燃料电池，而非生物细胞；与 fuel、system、stack、electrode 等词共同出现。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，燃料电池技术

patterns.name: 手机中的 cell
patterns.context: cell 是 cellular phone 的组成部分，指移动电话；邻近 mobile devices、media players 等消费电子设备。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，电子设备与移动通信

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the token “cell,” across contexts including cell membranes, cell–matrix relationships, development and cell types, cell synthesis, and immunity; also responds to a word segment in “cell phones.” No corresponding trigger is apparent in paragraph 1, so it cannot be explained.

patterns.name: cell and cell-related words
patterns.context: The direct trigger is cell, commonly appearing in descriptions of cells, cell membranes, cell types, or cell–matrix relationships; paragraph 7 contains the compound cell phones.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, research abstracts; also consumer-electronics background text

patterns.name: cell and membranes/membrane proteins
patterns.context: Discusses components on malignant-cell membranes or hydrophobic membrane proteins in cells and their functions.

patterns.name: cell and cell–matrix interactions
patterns.context: Extracellular matrix proteins regulate cell–matrix interactions and cell function.

patterns.name: cell and development, fate, or cell type
patterns.context: Describes cell fate specification, retinal cell-type organization, or stem cells and hematopoiesis.
patterns.domain: Developmental biology, hematopoiesis, and vision research

patterns.name: cell as the subject of cellular processes
patterns.context: Cells synthesize ribosomes, or cell is used as a modifier in a cell-mediated immunity test.

patterns.name: cell in cell phones
patterns.context: Cell is part of the name cell phones for a mobile device, not a biological cell.

patterns.name: Other biomedical contexts unrelated to cell
patterns.context: Discusses feed for weaned piglets, diarrhea, and gastrointestinal microbial ecology; cell is not present in the shown fragment.

2_809.description: 主要对 token“cell”强烈响应，涵盖细胞膜、细胞—基质关系、发育与细胞类型、细胞合成及免疫等语境；也响应“cell phones”中的词段。第1段未见相应触发词，无法解释。

patterns.name: cell及细胞相关词
patterns.context: 直接触发词为 cell，常见于描述细胞、细胞膜、细胞类型或细胞与基质的关系；第7段为复合词 cell phones
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、科研摘要；另有消费电子背景文本

patterns.name: cell与膜/膜蛋白
patterns.context: 讨论恶性肿瘤细胞膜上的成分，或细胞中的疏水膜蛋白及其功能

patterns.name: cell与细胞—基质相互作用
patterns.context: 细胞外基质蛋白调节细胞—基质相互作用及细胞功能
patterns.domain: 心脏生物学、细胞外基质研究

patterns.name: cell与发育、命运或细胞类型
patterns.context: 说明细胞命运指定、视网膜细胞类型组织，或干细胞及血细胞生成
patterns.domain: 发育生物学、造血与视觉研究

patterns.name: cell作为细胞过程的主体
patterns.context: 细胞合成核糖体，或作为细胞介导免疫测试的限定语
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、免疫学科研摘要

patterns.name: cell phones中的cell
patterns.context: cell 是 cell phones 这一移动设备名称的一部分，而非生物学细胞

patterns.name: 其他与cell无关的生物医学语境
patterns.trigger: « starch»、« pig»、« diets»、« scours»、« digestive»« tract»
patterns.context: 讨论断奶仔猪饲料、腹泻及消化道微生物生态；所示片段中未见 cell

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on cell: this includes biological cells and their types, functions, and interactions, as well as notebook code cells and memory storage cells. The commonality is cell as a basic unit in different fields.

patterns.name: “cell” and cell types
patterns.context: Cell refers to a biological cell; it appears in collocations involving cell types, cell–matrix interactions, cell function, adhesion and proliferation, or cell deposition.

patterns.name: cell in computational notebooks
patterns.context: Cell refers to a code unit in an interactive computing environment such as a notebook, rather than a biological cell.

patterns.name: cell in memory devices
patterns.context: Cell refers to a data-storage unit in MRAM or flash memory, often associated with magnetic layers, resistance states, storage density, or multilevel operation.
patterns.domain: Patent background, semiconductors and data storage

2_809.description: 激活主要集中在 cell：既包括生物细胞及其类型、功能和相互作用，也包括 notebook 代码单元和存储器存储单元；共同点是 cell 作为不同领域中的基本单元。

patterns.name: “cell”及细胞类型
patterns.trigger: «cell»10« types»1；«cell»10-«matrix»1« interactions»3；«cell»9« function»2；«cell»9« attachment»2 and «proliferation»5；«cell»9« deposition»1
patterns.context: cell 指生物细胞；出现在细胞类型、细胞与基质作用、细胞功能、黏附增殖或细胞沉积等搭配中。

patterns.name: 计算笔记本中的 cell
patterns.context: cell 指交互式计算环境（如 notebook）中的代码单元，而非生物细胞。

patterns.name: 存储器件中的 cell
patterns.context: cell 指 MRAM 或 flash memory 中存储数据的单元，常与磁层、电阻状态、存储密度或多电平相关。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、半导体与数据存储

en.concept: word forms containing stem and sporadic terms
en.description: Responds primarily to word forms of stem and compounds containing it, covering patent components, plant stems, stem cells, and stem rust; also includes isolated triggers such as basket, OpenGL, and spindle-cell, with little apparent semantic connection among them.

patterns.name: stem and its compounds
patterns.context: The word form stem appears by itself or as part of a compound; its semantic and syntactic roles vary, referring to a component, plant stem, cell, or rust.

patterns.name: Section heading Stem at the beginning of a line
patterns.context: Appears in parallel headings or table entries separated by line breaks; the word form is marked as split.

patterns.name: basket
patterns.context: Describes the structure and use of a collapsible shopping basket; basket is repeated in adjacent sentences.

patterns.name: OpenGL
patterns.context: Appears in a Q&A about C# graphics programming, depth peeling, and transparency effects.

patterns.name: spindle-cell compound
patterns.context: Part of a disease name, immediately followed by the term rhabdomyosarcoma.

2_809.concept: 包含 stem 的词形与零散词项
2_809.description: 主要响应 stem 的词形及其复合词，涵盖专利部件、植物茎、干细胞和茎锈病；另有 basket、OpenGL 和 spindle-cell 等孤立触发，彼此缺少明显语义联系。

patterns.name: stem 词及其复合词
patterns.trigger: «stem»（如 «stem»9、«stem»8、«stem»7），以及 «Stem»；包括 «stem head»、«pull-stem»、«flowering stem»、«stem cells»、«stem rust»
patterns.context: 词形 stem 本身或作为复合词成分出现；语义和句法角色不固定，既可指部件、植物茎、细胞，也可指锈病
patterns.domain: 专利、植物学、医学、生物学

patterns.name: 句首 Stem 小节标题
patterns.context: 出现在换行分隔的并列标题或表格项目中；词形被拆分标记

patterns.name: basket
patterns.context: 描述可折叠购物篮的结构和使用方式，basket 在相邻句中重复出现

patterns.name: OpenGL
patterns.context: 出现在关于 C# 图形编程、深度剥离和透明效果的问答中

patterns.name: spindle-cell 复合词
patterns.context: 作为疾病名称的一部分，紧接横纹肌肉瘤词项

en.description: Strong activations often fall on mark/marked/markdown and brush/brushless, and also appear in stem, shaft/clutch, and conveyor contexts; the texts are mostly technical descriptions, but the activating words do not form a single semantic category.

patterns.name: mark and its compounds
patterns.context: Occurs in words meaning a mark, a positioning mark, or a markup language; also appears in the fixed expression “freezing mark”.
patterns.domain: Technical patent texts, lifestyle blogs, software documentation

patterns.name: brush-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in words containing brush, such as brush, brush strip, and brushless motor.

patterns.name: stem
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of elongated or D-shaped stems in semiconductor laser packaging.

patterns.name: Shaft and clutch descriptions
patterns.context: Describes connections between shafts, releasable clutches, and a zero-position reference; the passage also contains “«mark»9”.

patterns.name: Conveying and stacking
patterns.context: Describes a conveyor operating at a constant speed and forming a package stack.

2_809.description: 强激活常落在 mark/marked/markdown 与 brush/brushless 等词上，也见于 stem、shaft/离合器及输送机语境；文本多为技术描述，但激活词并非单一语义类别。

patterns.name: mark 及其复合形式
patterns.context: 出现在表示标记、定位标记或标记语言的词中；也见于“freezing mark”这一固定表达。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、生活博客、软件文档

patterns.name: brush 相关词
patterns.context: 出现在刷子、刷条或无刷电机等含 brush 的词语中。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、材料研究

patterns.name: stem
patterns.context: 出现在半导体激光器封装的细长或 D 形 stem 描述中。

patterns.name: 轴与离合器描述
patterns.context: 描述轴之间的连接、可释放离合器及零位基准；本段同时出现“«mark»9”。

patterns.name: 输送与堆叠
patterns.context: 描述输送机以恒定速度运行并形成包装堆叠。

en.description: Activations are distributed across patents and code, involving device handles/end caps, electronic switch control, optical signals and LEDs, detection shielding structures, and path-spline data structures; their commonality is weak.

patterns.name: Device ends, handles, and end caps
patterns.context: Describes an elongated device handle or its end structure, mounting, and components; commonly appears in patent background or statements of the invention’s purpose.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent text; cosmetic applicators, pickers, and appliance control panels

patterns.name: Switches and control circuits
patterns.context: Mentions electronic switches and their circuit connections, control functions, or load-switching capabilities.

patterns.domain: Consumer electronics news, Q&A, device specifications

patterns.name: Word ending in headrest
patterns.context: When headrest is split, rest activates strongly; it refers to both a seat headrest and an automotive interior component.

patterns.name: Word ending in sapphire
patterns.context: When sapphire is split into subwords, the final fragment hire activates strongly; used in descriptions of substrates or laser materials.

patterns.name: Camera specification terms
patterns.context: Multiple device terms or their components activate in lists of camera features and specifications.

patterns.name: Device specification and accessory terms
patterns.context: Device, interface, or accessory names and their split forms; related to headphone jacks, but standalone specification terms also activate.

patterns.name: Mobile device feature lists
patterns.context: Activates when network, storage, sensor, and other terms appear in lists of phone features or hardware specifications.

patterns.name: Seat adjustment terminology

patterns.name: Optical and laser terminology

patterns.name: Automotive interiors and components

patterns.name: Optical fiber cable materials
