patterns.name: Legacy storage media
patterns.context: Discusses emulators and early computer storage media, especially the difficulty of obtaining usable media.

2_809.concept: 技术词中的特定子词片段
2_809.description: 激活集中于耳机及接口相关词，也出现在 keyboard、clipboard 的 board 子词，以及蓝宝石材料和旧式存储介质等技术词中；不同片段未显示统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 耳机插孔与适配器
patterns.context: 在讨论手机或音频设备的耳机接口、转接器，或耳机阻抗与失真时激活。
patterns.domain: 消费电子、音频技术及问答

patterns.name: keyboard 的 board 子词
patterns.context: 出现在内存地址映射及键盘按键的技术描述中。
patterns.domain: 计算机硬件说明、百科条目

patterns.name: clipboard 的 board 子词
patterns.context: 出现在“复制到剪贴板”的界面或记录文本中。
patterns.domain: 网页界面文本、媒体资料

patterns.name: 蓝宝石基底
patterns.context: 蓝宝石作为半导体器件生长基底，讨论光的俘获、氮化物及器件结构。
patterns.domain: 半导体与发光二极管专利文本

patterns.name: 蓝宝石晶体作激光介质
patterns.context: 讨论掺杂蓝宝石晶体作为可调谐激光介质的性质。

patterns.name: 旧式存储介质
patterns.context: 谈论模拟器及早期电脑存储介质，尤其是取得可用介质的困难。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several word fragments: table in rotating devices, device component terms, code identifiers and style values, electronic accessories, and substrates and sapphire in semiconductor and optical patents; there is no single clear shared semantic category.

patterns.name: table in compound words
patterns.context: Appears in compound words related to turntables or rotary devices, referring respectively to a machining-equipment turntable, a turntable in an animation device, and a turntable in polishing equipment.
patterns.domain: Mechanical patent descriptions, popular science explanations

patterns.name: Handle assembly
patterns.context: Describes the handle assembly of a vacuum cleaner and its structure.

patterns.name: Java identifier fragments
patterns.context: The trigger falls in class or package name fragments in Java import statements, especially Android UI-related identifiers.

patterns.name: ASP.NET style attribute values
patterns.context: Appears as a color value or color name in XML-style web control style tags.

patterns.name: Headphone jack and adapter
patterns.context: Mentions a headphone jack adapter in a discussion of connecting an iPad Pro to a digital AV adapter.

patterns.name: Sapphire substrates
patterns.context: Sapphire is used as a substrate for nitride or GaN light-emitting devices; discussions cover layer structures, light trapping, or device fabrication.

patterns.name: Transparent substrates and sapphire lasers
patterns.context: Describes a thin film on a transparent glass substrate and mentions a titanium-sapphire laser light source; this shares an optical materials context with the sapphire-substrate pattern, but the specific trigger combination differs.
patterns.domain: Optical and laser recording technology patents

2_809.description: 激活分布在若干词片段上：旋转装置中的table、装置组件词、代码标识符和样式值、电子配件，以及半导体和光学专利中的衬底与蓝宝石；没有单一明确的共同语义。

patterns.name: 复合词中的 table
patterns.context: 出现在转台或旋转装置相关复合词中；分别指加工设备的转台、动画装置中的转台，以及抛光设备中的转台。
patterns.domain: 专利机械描述、科普说明

patterns.name: 把手组件
patterns.context: 描述吸尘器的把手组件及其结构。

patterns.name: Java 标识符片段
patterns.context: 触发点落在 Java 导入语句的类名或包名片段中，尤其是 Android UI 相关标识符。

patterns.name: ASP.NET 样式属性值
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 风格的网页控件样式标签中，作为颜色值或颜色名称。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、ASP.NET 标记

patterns.name: 耳机接口与适配器
patterns.context: 在 iPad Pro 与数字 AV 适配器的连接问题中，提及耳机插孔适配器。

patterns.name: 蓝宝石衬底
patterns.context: 蓝宝石作为氮化物或 GaN 发光器件的衬底，讨论层结构、光俘获或器件制造。
patterns.domain: 专利半导体与光电子技术

patterns.name: 透明衬底与蓝宝石激光器
patterns.context: 描述玻璃透明衬底上的薄膜，并提及钛蓝宝石激光光源；与蓝宝石衬底模式同属光学材料语境，但具体触发组合不同。
patterns.domain: 专利光学与激光记录技术

en.concept: Possible preference for subword boundaries/compound words
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in head-phone/jack and headphone-related interfaces and specifications; fragments at segmentation boundaries also respond in headrest, vacuum cleaner, dumpster, clipboard, and other terms, across several domains and genres.

patterns.name: Headphone interfaces and related devices
patterns.context: Discusses headphone jacks, headphone impedance and distortion, external adapters, or headphone jacks listed in device specifications.
patterns.domain: Consumer electronics, phone specifications, electronics Q&A, and patent background descriptions

patterns.name: Head-support components
patterns.context: Descriptions of seat components and their adjustable tilt.

patterns.name: Vacuum cleaner handle components
patterns.context: Describes a vacuum cleaner handle assembly and its duct structure.

patterns.name: Dumpster-related terms
patterns.context: Discusses dumpster diving, whether it constitutes trespassing, and materials in dumpsters.

patterns.name: Clipboard-related terms
patterns.context: The term clipboard refers both to a physical clipboard beside a hospital bed and to copying to the clipboard in an interface.
patterns.domain: Medical terminal patent text, web field text

2_809.concept: 可能偏好词片段边界/复合词
2_809.description: 激活主要集中于 head-phone/jack 及耳机相关接口和规格；另对 headrest、vacuum cleaner、dumpster、clipboard 等分词边界处的词片段也有反应，覆盖多种领域与文体。

patterns.name: 耳机接口与相关设备
patterns.context: 谈及耳机插孔、耳机阻抗与失真、外接适配器，或设备规格中列出耳机插孔。
patterns.domain: 消费电子、手机规格、电子问答与专利背景

patterns.name: 头部支撑部件
patterns.context: 座椅部件及其可调节坡度的描述。

patterns.name: 吸尘器手柄部件
patterns.context: 描述吸尘器手柄组件及其通道结构。

patterns.name: 垃圾箱相关词
patterns.context: 讨论翻垃圾箱、是否擅闯及垃圾箱内的材料。

patterns.name: 剪贴板相关词
patterns.context: 出现剪贴板一词，分别指病床边的实体夹板和界面中的复制到剪贴板。
patterns.domain: 医疗终端专利文本、网页字段文本

en.description: Activations mainly occur in fragments within split words: le in pestle, ster in dumpster, ters in shutters, as well as the complete phrase headphone jack and vacuum cleaner; other fragments are scattered, with no common semantics evident.

patterns.name: Headphone jack phrase
patterns.context: “headphone jack” is annotated as split tokens; appears in discussions of device accessories, phone specifications, or whether a device has a headphone jack.
patterns.domain: Consumer electronics, product reviews, and Q&A

patterns.name: Final subword in pestle
patterns.context: The final le in “pestle” is annotated; it refers to the pestle used with a mortar to crush or grind food or samples.

patterns.name: Final subword in cleaner
patterns.context: Cleaner in “vacuum cleaner” is annotated; appears in patent descriptions and fault lists.

patterns.name: Word ending in roller shutters
patterns.context: The ters in roller shutters, referring to shutters on residential windows, is annotated.

patterns.name: Word ending in dumpster
patterns.context: The ster in dumpster is annotated in discussions of dumpster diving and specific building or scrap-metal dumpsters.
patterns.domain: Online discussions, legal boundaries, and scrap recycling

patterns.name: Sporadic annotations with limited explanation
patterns.context: Appear in descriptions of vacuum cleaner structures, vehicle fault lists, phone specifications, and dessert descriptions; their relation to the repeated word-ending pattern above is unclear.
patterns.domain: Patents, fault reports, electronics products, recipes

2_809.description: 主要激活于拆分词内部的片段：pestle 的 le、dumpster 的 ster、shutters 的 ters，也包括完整短语 headphone jack、vacuum cleaner；另有若干零散片段，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 耳机插孔短语
patterns.context: “headphone jack”被拆分标注；出现在设备配件、手机规格或是否配备耳机插孔的讨论中。
patterns.domain: 消费电子、产品评测与问答

patterns.name: pestle 的末尾子词
patterns.context: 单词“pestle”的末尾 le 被标注；指与 mortar 搭配使用的研杵，用于捣碎或研磨食材、样本。

patterns.name: cleaner 的末尾子词
patterns.context: “vacuum cleaner”中 cleaner 被标注；分别出现在专利描述和故障清单中。

patterns.name: roller shutters 的词尾
patterns.context: 住宅窗户上的 roller shutters 一词中，ters 被标注。

patterns.name: dumpster 的词尾
patterns.context: 谈论翻找垃圾箱及特定建筑或废金属垃圾箱时，ster 被标注。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、法律边界与废品回收

patterns.name: 未充分解释的零散标注
patterns.context: 分别出现在 vacuum cleaner 的结构描述、汽车故障清单、手机规格和甜点描述中；与上述重复词尾模式的关系不明确。
patterns.domain: 专利、故障叙述、电子产品、食谱

en.concept: Mixed responses to specific word segments and endings
en.description: Responses involve various segmented word units: headphone-related head/phone/jack/adapter/impedance, headrest, mechanical turntable, and roller shutters, the ending of sapphire, and dumpster. The patterns are not unified.

patterns.name: Headphone interfaces and headphones
patterns.context: Discusses headphones, headphone jacks/adapters, or headphone impedance and audio output; activations cluster on tokenized segments such as head, phone, and jack.
patterns.domain: Consumer electronics, audio technology; Q&A or comments

patterns.name: Headrest
patterns.context: Refers to a component that supports the head on a seat or treatment chair.

patterns.name: head segment outside headphone
patterns.context: The neuron responds to the head segment itself, but adjacent segments and semantics must be considered for disambiguation; in headphone contexts it also responds to components such as phone/jack.

patterns.name: Mechanical turntable
patterns.context: A workpiece or polishing cloth is placed on a rotatable table for processing or polishing.

patterns.name: Roller shutters
patterns.context: A home has roller shutters on its windows.

patterns.name: Sapphire
patterns.context: Discusses sapphire substrates used to grow GaN devices and light trapping in the substrate.

patterns.name: Dumpster
patterns.context: Discusses dumpster diving, whether it constitutes trespassing, or types of dumpsters.

2_809.concept: 特定词段与词尾的混合响应
2_809.description: 响应多种被切分的词段：耳机相关 head/phone/jack/adapter/impedance、headrest、机械 turntable，以及 roller shutters、sapphire 词尾和 dumpster。主要模式并不统一。

patterns.name: 耳机接口与耳机
patterns.context: 讨论耳机、耳机插孔/转接头，或耳机阻抗与音频输出；激活集中在被分词标记的 head、phone、jack 等词段。
patterns.domain: 消费电子、音频技术；问答或评论

patterns.name: 头枕
patterns.context: 指座椅或治疗椅上支撑头部的部件。

patterns.name: headphone 以外的拆分词段 head
patterns.trigger: «head» 与 «phone» 不构成 headphone，如 «head»«rest»；另有 «head»«phone» 的词段切分
patterns.context: 神经元对 head 这一词段本身有响应，但相邻词段和语义需结合区分；在耳机语境中也会响应 phone/jack 等组成部分。

patterns.name: 机械转台
patterns.context: 工件或抛光布置于可旋转的转台上，进行加工或抛光。

patterns.name: 卷帘百叶窗
patterns.context: 住宅窗户配有卷帘式百叶窗。

patterns.name: 蓝宝石
patterns.context: 讨论 GaN 器件生长所用的蓝宝石衬底及光在衬底中的俘获。

patterns.name: 垃圾箱
patterns.context: 讨论翻垃圾箱、是否构成擅闯或垃圾箱类型。

en.concept: Subword fragments in compound equipment-part terms
en.description: Activations often fall on local fragments in compound equipment or component names, such as rest, phone, saw, and swivel; cleaner, incline, key, player, table, pestle, and others trigger sporadically. No single semantic pattern covers all samples.

patterns.name: rest in compounds or word endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on rest or component names ending in rest, including headrests, leg rests, and armrests; the word forms and preceding components differ.
patterns.domain: Patent descriptions of furniture and body-support components

patterns.name: Interfaces or end components in compound words
patterns.context: Appears in names of electronic-device connections or adapter components; activation concentrates in parts of words such as headphone and adapter.

patterns.name: saw in tool names
patterns.context: Activation falls on saw and compound tool names in lists of machining tools used for cutting, drilling, and similar operations.

patterns.name: Compound endings in machine-part names
patterns.context: Appears in names of mechanical structures or mounting components; activation involves internal fragments of swivel and trunnion.
patterns.domain: Drilling equipment and industrial machinery patents

patterns.name: Word endings or fragments containing le
patterns.context: In experimental-method descriptions, activation falls only on the final fragment of pestle; no clear semantic condition is shared with other paragraphs.

patterns.name: Other sporadic lexical fragments
patterns.context: Appear in contexts involving vacuum cleaners, incline, keyboards, players, and turntables, with no shared local word-form or semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including patents and Q&A

2_809.description: 激活多落在复合设备或部件名称的局部片段，如 rest、phone、saw、swivel，也有 cleaner、incline、key、player、table、pestle 等零散触发；没有覆盖全部样本的统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 合成词或词尾中的 rest
patterns.context: 激活落在 rest 或以 rest 结尾的部件名称上，包括头枕、腿托、扶手；词形和前置部件不同。
patterns.domain: 家具、人体支撑部件的专利描述

patterns.name: 复合词中的接口或末端部件
patterns.context: 出现在电子设备连接或转接部件的名称中；激活集中于 headphone、adapter 等词的局部。

patterns.name: 工具名称中的 saw
patterns.context: 列举切削、钻孔等加工工具时，激活落在 saw 及复合工具名中。

patterns.name: 机器部件名称中的复合词尾
patterns.context: 出现在机械结构或安装部件名称中；激活涉及 swivel 及 trunnion 的内部片段。

patterns.name: 带 le 的词尾或片段
patterns.context: 实验方法叙述中，激活只落在 pestle 的末尾片段；无明显与其他段共享的语义条件。

patterns.name: 其他零散词汇片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在吸尘器、倾斜、键盘、播放器及转台等语境，缺乏共同的局部词形或语义模式。
patterns.domain: 专利与问答等多种文体

en.concept: English compound component names and device terminology
en.description: Activations are distributed across mechanical, electronic, seating, appliance, housing, and fastener texts, often falling on compound component names or word endings after segmentation; no single trigger pattern unifies these semantic categories.

patterns.name: Component names ending in “er” in compounds
patterns.context: Multiple activation points fall on the ending or second half of English compounds or derived component names, such as headphone, adapter, stopper, headrest, shutters, and fastener; words are sometimes split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Patent specifications, Q&A, property descriptions; cross-domain

patterns.name: Mechanical component and machining-equipment terms
patterns.context: Located in descriptions of mechanical devices, workpieces, or components, often in noun phrases; «piece» activates repeatedly in workpiece contexts.

patterns.name: Electronic-device and feature nouns
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of portable electronic devices, interfaces, display technology, or device features; activated words are often device categories or their components.
patterns.domain: Consumer electronics Q&A and patent background descriptions

patterns.name: Adjustable seat components
patterns.context: Activates when describing seat height, backrest tilt, and headrest adjustment.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of seat structures in patents

patterns.name: Vacuum cleaner components
patterns.context: Triggered by patent descriptions of a vacuum cleaner handle assembly and its airflow path.
patterns.domain: Patent descriptions of household appliance structures

patterns.name: Electronic-device appearance and materials
patterns.context: Involves customization of an electronic device’s surface color, appearance, or display technology.

patterns.name: Furniture and housing fixtures
patterns.context: Descriptions of room use and window fixtures in residential listings; «area» and «shutters» activate.

patterns.name: Fasteners and connection structures
patterns.context: Describes structures and operations in which a spring pushes a nut into position and threaded fasteners are connected.

2_809.concept: 英文复合部件名与设备术语
2_809.description: 激活分布于机械、电子、座椅、家电、房屋及紧固件文本，常落在复合部件名或分词后的词尾；未见足以统一这些语义类别的单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 复合词末尾的“er”类部件名
patterns.context: 多个激活点落在英语复合词或派生部件名的词尾/后半部分，如 headphone、adapter、stopper、headrest、shutters、fastener；有时词被切成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、问答、房产描述；跨领域

patterns.name: 机械部件与加工装置术语
patterns.context: 位于机械装置、工件或部件的描述中，常出现在名词短语里；其中 «piece» 在工件语境中重复激活。
patterns.domain: 机械加工及专利背景技术

patterns.name: 电子设备及功能名词
patterns.context: 出现在便携电子设备、接口、显示技术或设备功能的描述中；激活词多为设备类别或其组成部分。
patterns.domain: 消费电子问答与专利背景技术

patterns.name: 可调座椅部件
patterns.context: 描述座椅高度、靠背倾斜度及头枕调整时激活。
patterns.domain: 专利中的座椅结构说明

patterns.name: 真空吸尘器组件
patterns.context: 触发于吸尘器手柄组件及其风道的专利描述。
patterns.domain: 专利中的家用设备结构

patterns.name: 电子设备外观与材料
patterns.context: 涉及电子设备表面颜色、外观或显示技术的个性化。

patterns.name: 家具与房屋设施词
patterns.context: 住宅介绍中，房间用途和窗户设施的叙述；«area» 与 «shutters» 激活。

patterns.name: 紧固件与连接结构
patterns.context: 描述弹簧将螺母推入位置以及螺纹紧固件连接的结构和操作。
patterns.domain: 专利中的机械连接说明

en.description: Activations concentrate on specific devices and their components: headphone jacks, dumpsters, laptop components, vacuum cleaner handles, lighting fixtures, seat components, and semiconductor substrates; they span domains but are mostly technical terms or compound-word fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments of headphone-related words
patterns.context: When terms such as headphone/headphone jack appear, activation mainly falls on the split phone and jack; common in device descriptions or audio circuit discussions.

patterns.name: Fragments of dumpster
patterns.context: When discussing dumpster diving, dumpsters, or related places, activation falls on split fragments of dumpster.

patterns.name: Device components and disassembly terminology
patterns.context: Repair steps for laptops describe components, connections, and disassembly operations; activation occurs on component names or objects of the operation.

patterns.name: Cleaning equipment components
patterns.context: Patent-style sentences describe the handle assembly and structure of a vacuum cleaner.

patterns.name: Lighting terminology
patterns.context: Introduces low-profile lighting and fixture types; activation falls on terms such as lighting/light fixtures.

patterns.name: Seat structure components
patterns.context: Patents explain the relative positions or adjustability of the seat, backrest, and headrest.

patterns.name: Semiconductor materials and light
patterns.context: Discusses light trapping in material substrates; activation falls on split fragments of sapphire and words such as substrate.

2_809.description: 激活集中于具体设备及其部件名称：耳机插孔、dumpster、笔记本组件、吸尘器手柄、灯具、座椅部件和半导体基底；跨领域但多为技术名词或复合词片段。

patterns.name: headphone 词语片段
patterns.context: 出现 headphone/headphone jack 等词组时，主要激活落在拆分的 phone、jack 上；常见于设备描述或音频电路讨论。

patterns.name: dumpster 词语片段
patterns.context: 讨论 dumpster diving、dumpster 或相关场所时，激活落在被分词拆开的 dumpster 片段上。

patterns.name: 设备部件与拆装术语
patterns.context: 笔记本维修步骤中描述部件、连接和拆卸操作；激活出现在部件名称或操作对象上。

patterns.name: 清洁设备部件
patterns.context: 专利句式中描述真空吸尘器的手柄组件及其结构。

patterns.name: 照明术语
patterns.context: 介绍低矮型照明及灯具类型，激活落在 lighting/light fixtures 一类术语上。

patterns.name: 座椅结构部件
patterns.context: 专利中说明座椅、椅背和头枕的相对位置或可调性。

patterns.name: 半导体材料与光
patterns.context: 讨论材料基底中光的捕获；激活落在 sapphire 的拆分片段及 substrate 等词上。

en.description: Responds to nominal compounds, equipment and component names, and intra-word segmentation in texts from various domains; equipment- and lighting-related words are more concentrated, but dumpster and pestle also trigger, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Word endings or internal segmentation in English compounds
patterns.context: Activations fall on compounds, noun phrases, or intra-word subword fragments, especially word components rather than complete words; the trigger words vary widely in meaning across examples.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, patents, repair instructions, forums, research papers, recipes, and more

patterns.name: Equipment and component names
patterns.context: Appears when describing electronic products, mechanical equipment, furniture, or their parts, structures, and uses.
patterns.domain: Consumer electronics Q&A, patent background sections, repair steps

patterns.name: Light- and illumination-related words
patterns.context: Discusses light sources, light, and light retention in a substrate in lighting design or semiconductor devices.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in dumpster
patterns.context: When discussing dumpster diving and construction debris or metal dumpsters, activations fall on a segment of dumpster.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in pestle
patterns.context: When a pestle is used to grind experimental samples or in a recipe, activations fall on an intra-word segment of pestle.

2_809.description: 对多种领域文本中的名词性复合词、设备与部件名称，以及词内分段有反应；设备/照明相关词较集中，但 dumpster、pestle 等也触发，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语复合词中的词尾或词内分段
patterns.context: 激活落在复合词、名词短语或词内子词片段上，尤其是词的组成部分，不一定是完整词；触发词在各段中的语义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、专利、维修说明、论坛、科研论文和食谱等

patterns.name: 设备与部件名称
patterns.context: 描述电子产品、机械设备、家具或其零件、结构与用途时出现。
patterns.domain: 消费电子问答、专利背景、维修步骤

patterns.name: 光与照明相关词
patterns.context: 照明设计或半导体器件中讨论光源、光线及光在基板中的滞留。

patterns.name: dumpster 的词内片段
patterns.context: 在谈论翻找垃圾箱及建筑废料或金属垃圾箱时，激活落在 dumpster 的分段上。

patterns.name: pestle 的词内片段
patterns.context: 在实验样品研磨或食谱中使用研杵时，激活落在 pestle 的词内分段上。

en.concept: Subword fragments at the ends of concrete object names
en.description: Activations often fall on endings or split fragments of concrete nouns for tools, devices, and materials, commonly in compound names; there are also fragments within tool names, sliding components, and abrasive, spanning Q&A, patents, and research papers.

patterns.name: Endings in tool or device component names
patterns.context: Activation falls on following words in multiword tool, device, or material names, especially technical terms or compound-word endings; examples: head«phone», head«rest», vacuum«cleaner».
patterns.domain: Consumer electronics, furniture, industrial equipment, waste processing, biological experiments, semiconductor materials; Q&A, patents, and research papers

patterns.name: Morphemes within tool names
patterns.context: Activation appears in split fragments of tool names, especially wrench and angle grinder, which are compounds or longer tool names; repair tools are often listed in the same sentence.

patterns.name: Word endings in sliding-component names
patterns.context: In patent descriptions of mechanical structures, activation is triggered by split forms denoting sliding components, near structural terms such as groove and cartridge case.

patterns.name: Noun ending at the marked position
patterns.context: When listing attempted tools, activation falls on strap; this example does not fit the preceding clear pattern of long compound device endings.

patterns.name: Common morpheme fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on a split fragment of abrasive in a description of industrial wear; its connection to device-name endings is unclear.

2_809.concept: 具体器具名词的词尾片段
2_809.description: 激活多落在器具、设备、材料等具体名词的末尾或分词片段，常见于复合名称；另有工具名、滑动部件及 abrasive 的词内片段，领域横跨问答、专利与论文。

patterns.name: 器具或设备部件名称中的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在多词器具、设备或材料名称的后续词上，尤其是专用名词或复合词的词尾；例：head«phone»、head«rest»、vacuum«cleaner»。
patterns.domain: 消费电子、家具、工业设备、废料处理、生物实验、半导体材料；问答、专利及论文

patterns.name: 工具名称内部词素
patterns.context: 激活出现在工具名的分词片段中，尤其是 wrench、angle grinder 等复合或较长工具名；同句常列举修理工具。

patterns.name: 滑动部件名称的词尾
patterns.context: 在专利机械结构描述中，触发于表示可滑动部件的分词词形，附近有 groove、cartridge case 等结构术语。

patterns.name: 标记位置的物品名词词尾
patterns.context: 在列举尝试过的工具时，激活落在 strap 一词；该例中不属于前述明显的长复合设备词尾模式。

patterns.name: 单词内部的常见词素片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 abrasive 的分词片段中，处于工业磨损描述；与设备名称词尾的联系不明显。

en.description: Activations are scattered across local fragments in compounds or equipment and mechanical terms: headrest/headphone, pestle, sliders, turntable, and nut; there is also a Chinese serial-port comment. No unified semantics or stable word-form pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: “rest” words and component nouns
patterns.context: rest appears as part of a compound, especially referring to head support; there is also one example of headphone in an equipment name.

patterns.name: “pestle” fragment in tool names
patterns.context: Appears in the word “pestle,” referring to a tool for grinding or crushing materials; the contexts are experimental sample preparation and cooking.

patterns.name: “sliders” fragment in mechanical sliding mechanisms
patterns.context: Refers to mechanical components that slide along a structure, near descriptions of mechanisms such as a groove and cartridge case.

patterns.name: “table” fragment in machining terminology
patterns.context: Part of the name for a turntable; describes rotating a workpiece or arranging equipment.

patterns.name: Chinese characters in serial-port output text
patterns.context: Appears in code comments describing serial-port output and string reception; activations fall on Chinese characters and a null-character marker.

patterns.name: “nut” in nut and fastener names
patterns.context: Describes a round nut pressed into place by a spring and connected to a threaded fastener.

2_809.description: 激活分散于复合词或设备、机械术语的局部片段：headrest/headphone、pestle、sliders、turntable、nut；另有中文串口注释。未见统一语义或稳定词形规律。

patterns.name: “rest”词及其构件名词
patterns.context: rest 作为复合词的一部分，尤其是指头部支撑；另有 headphone 一例，处于设备名称中。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、电子产品问答

patterns.name: 工具名称中的“pestle”片段
patterns.context: 出现在“pestle”一词中，涉及研磨或捣碎材料的工具；上下文分别是实验样品处理和烹饪。

patterns.name: 机械滑动机构中的“sliders”片段
patterns.context: 指可沿结构滑动的机械部件，邻近 groove、cartridge case 等机构描述。

patterns.name: 机械加工术语中的“table”片段
patterns.context: 作为转台名称的一部分，描述工件旋转或设备布置。

patterns.name: 串口输出文本中的中文字符
patterns.context: 出现在描述串口输出、接收字符串的代码注释中；激活落在中文字符和一个空字符标记上。

patterns.name: 螺母及连接件名称中的“nut”
patterns.context: 描述圆头螺母被弹簧压入位置，并与螺纹紧固件连接。

en.description: The dominant pattern is sensitivity to the letter string air: it occurs across English words, place names, and Latvian word forms. Hart as a proper-name fragment, 2017, year numerals, and sporadic common words also trigger activation, with no clear semantic relationship among them.

patterns.name: air string
patterns.context: The subword fragment air is tokenized as a standalone token or occurs within longer words; it appears in repair, Cairngorms, Kairat, vairākās, Wairarapa, and Hair, whose surrounding semantics vary widely.
patterns.domain: English proper nouns and common words, Latvian political texts, medical titles

patterns.name: Hart string
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of the proper names Hartlib Circle and Hartvig Nielsen; there is no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: 2017 date
patterns.context: Appears in a list of foreign ministers’ term years; the year is repeated.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia chronology or list of political figures

patterns.name: Numeric fragments in names
patterns.context: Appears in the digit segmentation of the birth year 1846, followed by 486–1977; may be triggered by a numeric substring.

patterns.name: Generalized word fragments
patterns.context: These words are marked only in isolated fragments and do not form a confirmed shared trigger condition; they may also co-occur with the main character fragment by chance.

2_984.description: 主导模式是对字母串 air 的敏感：它横跨英语词、地名及拉脱维亚语词形；另有 Hart 专名、2017、年份数字和零散常见词触发，彼此缺乏明确语义联系。

patterns.name: air 字符串
patterns.context: 子词片段 air 被切分为独立 token 或处在较长词内部；出现于 repair、Cairngorms、Kairat、vairākās、Wairarapa、Hair 等词中，周围语义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 英语专名与普通词、拉脱维亚语政治文本、医学标题

patterns.name: Hart 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Hartlib Circle 与 Hartvig Nielsen 的开头；没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 2017 日期
patterns.context: 出现在外交部长任期年份列表中；该年份重复出现。
patterns.domain: 百科年表或政治人物列表

patterns.name: 姓名中的数字片段
patterns.context: 出现在出生年份 1846 的数字切分中，后接 486–1977；可能是数字子串触发。

patterns.name: 泛化词片段
patterns.context: 这些词只在个别片段被标记，未形成可确认的共同触发条件；也可能与主要字符片段偶然共现。

en.concept: the letter sequence air and the Hart spelling fragment
en.description: Most passages activate the letter sequence air in different languages or proper names, including repair, Hair, place names, and Latvian forms; a Hart heading fragment also activates strongly, indicating that the pattern is not fully uniform.

patterns.name: Words or letter strings containing air
patterns.context: Activation marks the letter sequence air inside words; it appears in English and Latvian words, with no fixed boundary or meaning.
patterns.domain: Multilingual: news, encyclopedias, parliamentary texts, medical abstracts

patterns.name: In-word segmentation of repair
patterns.context: air occurs inside repair, preceded by Rep and followed by ing; the context discusses encouraging repairs of old items through tax incentives.

patterns.name: Proper names or surnames containing air
patterns.context: air occurs inside the spelling of place names or personal names, including Cairngorms, Kairat, and Wairarapa.

patterns.name: v + air sequence in Latvian
patterns.context: air is preceded by v and followed by ā, embedded in Latvian word forms; parliamentary contexts have varied meanings, possibly related to forms meaning “more / multiple times.”

patterns.name: Hart terms and following fragments
patterns.context: Activation covers the spelling fragment Hart, followed by different terms; it appears in paragraph headings or names, with no air present.

patterns.name: In-word English hair
patterns.context: air follows H to form Hair, occurring in the negative form of the compound adjective Hair-Bearing; the context concerns measurement regions for brain-computer interfaces.

2_984.concept: air 字母序列及 Hart 拼写片段
2_984.description: 多数段落在不同语言或专名中激活字母序列 air，含 repair、Hair、地名及拉脱维亚语词形；另有 Hart 标题片段也强激活，显示模式并非完全统一。

patterns.name: 含 air 的词根或字母串
patterns.context: 激活标在单词内部的 air 字母序列；该序列出现在英语词和拉脱维亚语词中，边界与词义并不固定。
patterns.domain: 多语种：新闻、百科、议会文本、医学摘要

patterns.name: repair 的词内切分
patterns.context: air 位于 repair 的词内，前接 Rep、后接 ing；上下文谈及通过税收优惠鼓励修理旧物。

patterns.name: 带 air 的专名或姓氏
patterns.context: air 位于地名或人名拼写内部，分别见 Cairngorms、Kairat、Wairarapa。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、外交官员列表

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语中的 v + air 序列
patterns.context: air 前接 v，后接 ā，嵌在拉脱维亚语词形中；议会语境，意义各异，可能与“更多／多次”等词形有关。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 拉脱维亚语议会文本

patterns.name: Hart 词项及其后续片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖 Hart 这一拼写片段，后接不同词项；段落标题或名称中出现，未见 air。

patterns.name: 英语词内 hair
patterns.context: air 紧接 H 构成 Hair，位于复合形容词 Hair-Bearing 的否定形式中；与研究脑机接口测量区域有关。

en.concept: Spelling detection for the strings “air” and “Hart”
en.description: Primarily activates the string “air” embedded in different words, including English, Latvian, and proper names; it also activates “Hart” at the beginning of a name. The examples lack shared semantic conditions.

patterns.name: The string “air”
patterns.context: The string is embedded in English words, proper names, or Latvian words; no clear shared semantic or syntactic condition is apparent
patterns.domain: News headlines, encyclopedias, European Parliament texts, medical abstracts

patterns.name: The string “Hart”
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a personal name or other name; activation is concentrated on this spelling fragment

2_984.description: 主要对嵌在不同词语中的字母串“air”激活，涵盖英语、拉脱维亚语和专名；另对名称开头的“Hart”激活。各例缺少共同语义条件。

patterns.name: “air”字母串
patterns.context: 该字母串嵌在英语词、专名或拉脱维亚语词中；未见明显统一的语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 新闻标题、百科、欧洲议会文本、医学摘要

patterns.name: “Hart”字母串
patterns.context: 作为人名或名称的开头；激活集中在该拼写片段

en.concept: Detection of character fragments within specific words
en.description: The most stable visible activation cue is the character fragment «air» within words, across multiple languages. Sporadic activations also occur for Hart, numbers, common English words, and short Latvian fragments, without a unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: Word fragments containing air
patterns.context: The marked character sequence occurs inside a word and need not be a standalone word; it is distributed across different languages and word forms

patterns.name: Hart word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs as a word-initial fragment in proper names or combinations of proper names

patterns.name: English function words and affix fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in titles, including whole words and fragments within words

patterns.name: Numeric years
patterns.context: Embedded in year, date, or term-of-office information

patterns.name: Common English word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in biographical sentences, with activations at scattered positions

patterns.name: Short Latvian fragments
patterns.context: Short character fragments are marked in Latvian words; they co-occur with «air» in the same passage

patterns.name: Biomedical abbreviations and word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in abbreviations, prepositions, hyphens, and compound words in paper titles

2_984.concept: 特定词内字符片段检测
2_984.description: 激活最稳定的可见线索是词内字符片段 «air»，横跨多语文本；另有 Hart、数字、常见英语词及拉脱维亚语短片段等零散激活，未显出统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 包含 air 的词片段
patterns.context: 被标记的字符序列位于单词内部，不要求其为独立词；分布在不同语言和词形中
patterns.domain: 英语、拉脱维亚语及人名

patterns.name: Hart 词片段
patterns.context: 作为词首片段，出现在专名或专名组合中

patterns.name: 英语功能词与词缀片段
patterns.context: 出现在标题中，涵盖完整词及词内片段

patterns.name: 数字年份
patterns.context: 嵌在年代、日期或人物任期信息中

patterns.name: 英语常见词片段
patterns.context: 出现在传记式句子中，激活位置分散

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语短片段
patterns.context: 在拉脱维亚语词中标记短字符片段；与同段 «air» 同现

patterns.name: 生物医学缩写与词片段
patterns.context: 出现在论文标题的缩写、介词、连字符和复合词中

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on in-word fragments such as air/Hair and their occurrences across languages or in proper names; there is also a Hart proper name and a chemical identifier. The commonality may be only a substring or local spelling, with no consistent semantics or genre.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in repairing
patterns.context: Occurs inside the English word repair, segmented as «Rep»«air»«ing»; strong activation is concentrated on the substring air.

patterns.name: Hart at the beginning of a word
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper names Hartlib and Hartvig; Circle also follows Hartlib, but the activation core is Hart.

patterns.name: air in Cairngorms
patterns.context: Occurs inside the place name Cairngorms, in a biography of a naturalist in the Scottish Highlands.

patterns.name: air in Hair-bearing
patterns.context: Occurs in the compound Non-Hair-Bearing, in a paper title mentioning measurement regions for brain-computer interfaces.

patterns.name: Fragment in a compound name
patterns.context: Appears near a chemical number or compound identifier; the fragment is incomplete, so the specific term cannot be determined.

patterns.name: In-word fragment Air / air
patterns.context: Occurs inside the proper names Kairat and Wairarapa and the Latvian words vārākās and vairākkārt; these are cross-lingual in-word fragments with inconsistent meanings.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia lists and biographies, EU parliamentary texts

2_984.concept: 含 air 的词内片段
2_984.description: 激活最一致地落在 air/Hair 及其跨语言或专名中的词内片段；另有 Hart 专名和一段化学编号。共同点可能只是子串或局部拼写，语义与文体不统一。

patterns.name: repairing 中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在英语 repair 的词内，被拆分标记为 «Rep»«air»«ing»；强激活集中于 air 子串。

patterns.name: Hart 词首
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Hartlib、Hartvig 中；Hartlib 后还出现 Circle，但激活核心是 Hart。

patterns.name: Cairngorms 中的 air
patterns.context: 出现在地名 Cairngorms 的词内，描述苏格兰高地自然主义者的生平。

patterns.name: Hair-bearing 中的 air
patterns.context: 出现在复合词 Non-Hair-Bearing 中，论文标题提及脑机接口的测量区域。

patterns.name: 化合物名称中的片段
patterns.context: 化学编号或化合物标识符附近；片段形式不完整，无法确定具体词项。

patterns.name: Air / air 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Kairat、Wairarapa 以及拉脱维亚语 vārākās、vairākkārt 的词内；均为跨语言词内片段，词义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 百科全书列表与传记、欧盟议会文本

en.concept: Detection of letter fragments and proper-name spellings
en.description: Activation mainly falls on the letter fragment air, including across subword boundaries and within foreign-language words. Strong responses also occur to the Hart name fragment, the chemical symbol Cr, and uppercase fragments in organization names, with no shared semantic requirement.

patterns.name: air letter string
patterns.context: The letter sequence air occurs inside English words, across subword boundaries, or within foreign-language words; no fixed word meaning is required, and capitalization and segmentation vary
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: news headlines, physics, parliamentary texts, personal names and place names, medical texts

patterns.name: Proper name or root Hart
patterns.context: Activation falls on the spelling fragment Hart in personal names, entry titles, or related names

patterns.name: Cr(VI) chemical symbol
patterns.context: Cr occurs in Cr(VI) and in contexts concerning chromium reduction in industrial wastewater

patterns.name: Uppercase fragment in an organization name
patterns.context: The uppercase letter fragment occurs in the organization name “GRAY WOLF COMMITTEE”
patterns.domain: Organizations or institutions listed in legal texts

2_984.concept: 字母片段与专名拼写检测
2_984.description: 激活主要落在字母片段 air（含跨子词边界及外语词中）；另对 Hart 人名片段、Cr 化学符号及大写组织名片段有强响应，均无统一语义要求。

patterns.name: air 字母串
patterns.context: 字母序列 air 出现在英语词内部、跨子词边界或外语词内部；不要求固定词义，大小写与分词方式不一
patterns.domain: 跨领域：新闻标题、物理学、议会文本、人名与地名、医学文本

patterns.name: 专名或词根 Hart
patterns.context: 激活落在 Hart 这一拼写片段上，出现在人名、条目标题或相关名称中

patterns.name: Cr(VI) 化学符号
patterns.context: Cr 出现在 Cr(VI) 及工业废水中铬还原的语境
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要；环境生物技术

patterns.name: 组织名称中的大写片段
patterns.context: 大写字母片段位于 “GRAY WOLF COMMITTEE” 这一组织名称中
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的组织或机构列举

en.concept: Cr subword and the element chromium
en.description: The primary response is to the subword Cr, usually referring to the element chromium, especially in chemical and biomedical texts. It also responds to Hart in Hartlib/Hartvig, and to Cr in Crouch, Crude, and CrAT, suggesting sensitivity to character fragments rather than a single semantic meaning.

patterns.name: Chemical element symbol Cr
patterns.context: Activation falls on the element symbol Cr or an adjacent subword fragment; it occurs in varied contexts, including hexavalent chromium, metal-element measurement, and crystal chemical formulas.
patterns.domain: Chemistry, environmental science, materials science, and related biomedical papers

patterns.name: Hartlib name fragment
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of the proper names Hartlib or Hartvig; both fragments are in short encyclopedia titles or entry-style text.

patterns.name: Cr in the word Crouch, referring to gait
patterns.context: Activation falls only on the initial subword Cr in Crouch; the context discusses gait patterns.

patterns.name: Cr in the word Crude
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial subword Cr in Crude; the context concerns extract preparation methods.

patterns.name: Cr in the abbreviation CrAT
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial Cr in the biological abbreviation CrAT; the context discusses mitochondrial metabolism and regulation of pyruvate dehydrogenase.

2_984.description: 主要响应子词 Cr：多指元素铬，尤其出现在化学与生物医学文本；也响应 Hartlib/Hartvig 的 Hart，以及 Crouch、Crude、CrAT 中的 Cr，提示对字符片段而非单一语义的敏感。

patterns.name: 化学元素符号 Cr
patterns.context: 激活落在元素符号 Cr 上或紧邻其子词片段；出现在六价铬、金属元素测定、晶体化学式等不同语境中。
patterns.domain: 化学、环境科学、材料科学及相关生物医学论文

patterns.name: Hartlib 名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Hartlib 或 Hartvig 的开头；两个片段均为简短的百科标题或条目式文本。

patterns.name: Crouch 步态词中的 Cr
patterns.context: 激活仅落在单词 Crouch 的开头子词 Cr；上下文讨论步态模式。

patterns.name: Crude 词中的 Cr
patterns.context: 激活落在单词 Crude 的开头子词 Cr；上下文为提取物制备方法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: CrAT 缩写中的 Cr
patterns.context: 激活落在生物学缩写 CrAT 的开头；上下文讨论线粒体代谢与丙酮酸脱氢酶调控。

en.concept: Uppercase letter combinations Cr and Hart
en.description: Activation primarily responds to the case-sensitive token “Cr,” covering chromium valence states, detection, and related abbreviations. It also responds to “Hart” in Hartlib and Hartvig, and to “Circle” in one passage.

patterns.name: Cr element symbol
patterns.context: The exact-case chemical element symbol Cr; the context may refer to chromium valence states, chromium-containing compounds, related enzyme abbreviations, or element detection

patterns.name: Hartlib word-initial fragment
patterns.context: The word Hartlib or Hartvig is tokenized; Hart alone activates strongly and occurs in two Wikipedia passages

2_984.concept: 大写字母组合 Cr 与 Hart
2_984.description: 主要对大小写敏感的 token “Cr” 激活，涵盖铬的价态、检测及相关缩写；另对 Hartlib、Hartvig 中的 “Hart” 激活，并在一段中响应 “Circle”。

patterns.name: Cr 元素符号
patterns.context: 大小写完全匹配的化学元素符号 Cr；上下文可指铬的价态、含铬化合物、相关酶缩写或元素检测
patterns.domain: 化学、生物医学、环境科学

patterns.name: Hartlib 词首片段
patterns.context: 词项 Hartlib 或 Hartvig 被拆分为 token；Hart 单独强激活，且在两个 Wikipedia 片段中出现

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical word fragments (méd, incontinence, urinary), Cr(VI), the -itarian suffix, repair, port in a patent, and words in philosophical and legal contexts. Sporadic word fragments also occur in parliamentary texts.

patterns.name: medull- spelling fragment
patterns.context: In French medical text, the fragment méd is followed by words such as médical and médull-; passage 1 contains a term related to the adrenal medulla, and passage 2 contains médicales.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, medical discussions in parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Cr(VI) chemical formula fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in Cr(VI) or in the Cr…(VI) spelling used in related regulatory texts; Cr fragments activate under different tokenizations.

patterns.name: English -itarian suffix
patterns.context: Occurs in words ending in -itarian, such as utilitarian, Unitarian, and Humanitarian; activation falls on the same spelling fragment within the words.
patterns.domain: Ethical, religious, and political issues; parliamentary texts

patterns.name: rep- fragment related to repair
patterns.context: The product title or advertising copy contains Leather and Vinyl Repair Kit; activation concentrates on a fragment within Repair.

patterns.name: switching in a control-device context
patterns.context: Describes monitoring equipment connected to a control switching center or remote monitoring point; the activation token port occurs in this technical description.

patterns.name: Incontinence-related words
patterns.context: Incontinence and urinary symptoms occur in the same sentence, describing symptoms such as frequent and urgent urination.

patterns.name: fervent disagreement context
patterns.context: Discusses controversial ethical issues and mistaken or unjustified immoral beliefs; the passage also contains utilitarianism, triggering the suffix pattern.

patterns.name: Legal argument connective
patterns.context: The phrase The defendant contends introduces an argument for applying precedent, followed by discussion of regulations and legislative history.

patterns.name: Sporadic common-word activations
patterns.context: In passage 2, only a few common English and French word fragments receive low-intensity markings; no shared context that consistently corresponds to other passages is apparent.

2_984.description: 激活分散在医学词片段（méd、incontinence、urinary）、Cr(VI)、-itarian 词尾、repair、专利中的 port 及哲学和法律语境词；另有议会文本零散词片段。

patterns.name: medull- 拼写片段
patterns.context: 法语医学文本中，片段 méd 后接 médical、médull- 等词；第1段是肾上腺髓质相关词，第2段是 médicales。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、议会文本中的医疗讨论

patterns.name: Cr(VI) 化学式片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Cr(VI) 或相关法规文本的 Cr…(VI) 写法中；不同 token 切分下均有 Cr 片段激活。
patterns.domain: 环境微生物学摘要、法律文本

patterns.name: 英语 -itarian 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 utilitarian、Unitarian、Humanitarian 等以 -itarian 结尾的词中；激活落在词内相同拼写片段。
patterns.domain: 伦理学、宗教与政治议题、议会文本

patterns.name: rep- repair 相关片段
patterns.context: 产品标题或宣传语中出现 Leather and Vinyl Repair Kit；激活集中在 Repair 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 控制设备语境中的 switching
patterns.context: 描述监听设备连接到控制交换局或远程监听点；激活 token port 出现在该技术说明语境。

patterns.name: 失禁相关词语
patterns.context: Incontinence 与 urinary symptoms 同句出现，描述尿频、尿急等症状。

patterns.name: fervent disagreement 语境
patterns.context: 谈论争议性伦理议题及错误或无正当依据的非道德信念；该段另有 utilitarianism 触发词尾模式。

patterns.name: 法律论证连接语
patterns.context: 以 The defendant contends 引出适用判例的主张，随后讨论法规及立法背景。

patterns.name: 零散普通词激活
patterns.trigger: « indispensable»（分词 « indisp»）；« measures»、« professions»、« considered»、« highest» 等
patterns.context: 第2段仅若干普通英语、法语词片段有低强度标记，未见可与其他段稳定对应的共同语境。

en.concept: Angle symbols and technical word-form fragments
en.description: Activation is most clearly biased toward angles and degree symbols in mathematical expressions. Sporadic responses also occur to the word-form fragments collider and polarization in physics texts, PHP method names, and LaTeX document-ending markers. These triggers do not all share the same word meaning.

patterns.name: Angles and degree symbols
patterns.context: In mathematical or physics papers, numerical angles appear in LaTeX degree notation, often alongside superscripts and formula markers; activation falls on degree symbols and related formula tokens.
patterns.domain: ArXiv, StackExchange science and technology texts

patterns.name: collider word-form fragment
patterns.context: Words such as collider/colliding occur in high-energy physics contexts; activation corresponds to fragments of the tokenized forms and co-occurs with contexts involving particles, lasers, or astrophysical impacts.

patterns.name: polarization word-form fragment
patterns.context: When discussing photon-beam polarization or synchrotron polarization, a stem fragment of polarizations/polarisation activates.

patterns.name: PHP mail MIME subpart call
patterns.context: PHP code calls the MIMEMessage addSubpart method; activation concentrates on contiguous word fragments in the method name.

patterns.name: Document-ending marker
patterns.context: A LaTeX document-ending command appears in a corpus passage, near typesetting artifacts and table text.

2_984.concept: 角度符号与技术词形片段
2_984.description: 激活首先明显偏向数学表达中的角度及度数符号；另对物理文中的 collider、polarization 词形片段，以及 PHP 方法名和 LaTeX 文档结束标记有零星响应。各类触发并非完全同一词义。

patterns.name: 角度与度数符号
patterns.context: 数学或物理论文中，数值角度以 LaTeX 度数形式出现，常伴随上标和公式标记；激活落在度数符号及相关公式 token 上。

patterns.name: collider 词形片段
patterns.context: 高能物理语境中出现 collider/colliding 等词；激活对应拆分词形的片段，并与粒子、激光或天体冲击等语境共现。

patterns.name: polarization 词形片段
patterns.context: 涉及光子束偏振或同步辐射偏振时，词语 polarizations/polarisation 的词干片段激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 物理与天体物理文本

patterns.name: PHP 邮件 MIME 子部件调用
patterns.context: PHP 代码中调用 MIMEMessage 的 addSubpart 方法，激活集中在方法名的连续词片段。

patterns.name: 文档结束标记
patterns.context: LaTeX 文档结束命令出现在语料片段中，附近有排版残片和表格文本。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文档抽取文本

en.concept: Specific English substrings and word fragments
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on over (switch over, cloverleaf, carryover, leftover, failover) and ToLower. Weaker activation also occurs on abbreviations, words, or names beginning with Int, across code, legal, and academic medical texts.

patterns.name: switch over
patterns.context: Occurs in switch«over», operational frequency ranges, or contexts involving transformer switching.

patterns.name: cloverleaf option
patterns.context: The string value of a command-line option is "cloverleaf", located in a shell case branch.

patterns.name: Lower in a proper name
patterns.context: Appears as part of the method name ToLower(), which processes a connection information string.

patterns.name: carryover
patterns.context: In a tax context, an operating loss from the previous year is carried forward to the current year.

patterns.name: leftover
patterns.context: In code, refers to the number of bytes remaining after reading or processing, and is used in a conditional check.

patterns.name: failover
patterns.context: The failover host parameter in a SQL Server connection exception stack trace.

patterns.name: Int prefix
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of abbreviations, words, or names; here these are Int. (journal abbreviation), Introductory, Intrauterine, and Intimal.
patterns.domain: Academic titles, medical abstracts, and paper excerpts

2_984.concept: 特定英文子串与词片段
2_984.description: 激活主要集中于 over（switch over、cloverleaf、carryover、leftover、failover）及 ToLower；另对 Int 开头的缩写、单词或名称有较弱激活，跨代码、法律与学术医学文本。

patterns.name: switch over
patterns.context: 出现在 switch«over»、operational frequency ranges 或 transformers 的切换语境中。

patterns.name: cloverleaf 选项
patterns.context: 命令行选项参数的字符串值为 "cloverleaf"，位于 shell case 分支中。

patterns.name: 专有名词中的 Lower
patterns.context: 作为方法名 ToLower() 的组成部分，处理连接信息字符串。

patterns.name: carryover
patterns.context: 税务语境中，上一年度的经营亏损结转至本年度。

patterns.name: leftover
patterns.context: 代码中指读取或处理后剩余的字节数量，并用于条件判断。

patterns.name: failover
patterns.context: SQL Server 连接异常堆栈中的 failover host 参数。

patterns.name: Int 前缀
patterns.context: 出现在缩写、单词或名称的开头；这里分别为 Int.（期刊缩写）、Introductory、Intrauterine、Intimal。
patterns.domain: 学术标题、医学摘要及论文片段

en.description: Activation centers on Pareto front/frontier and fragments adjacent to to in code; sugar-chemistry morphemes and biomedical title/term fragments also appear. Trigger forms are not uniform, and some may simply be subword fragments in code or technical terms.

patterns.name: Front / Pareto frontier
patterns.context: Discusses a subset that outperforms the remaining items in multi-objective optimization, or describes a frontier between speed and compression ratio; contains the phrase Pareto front/frontier.
patterns.domain: Optimization, algorithms, and software performance documentation

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax adjacent to to
patterns.context: In code, to occurs inside identifiers, string/regex constructs, or variable names, often adjacent to capitalized word segments, numbers, or underscores; several other code tokens are marked, not all of which contain to.
patterns.domain: VB, Python, C/C++ and other code and snippets

patterns.name: Morphemes in maltose and oligosaccharide terminology
patterns.context: Marks fall on fragments of sugar-chemistry terms, in contexts discussing transglycosylation and oligosaccharide formation.

patterns.name: Term fragments in analytical chemistry method descriptions
patterns.context: Activation falls on analytical or material chemistry terms or pharmacokinetic title words; contexts differ and no shared local trigger word is apparent.

2_984.description: 激活集中在 Pareto front/frontier 及代码中的 to 邻接片段；另见糖化学词素和生物医学标题/术语。各模式的触发形式并不统一，部分可能只是代码或专业词中的子词片段。

patterns.name: Front / Pareto frontier
patterns.trigger: « multi» objective optimization problems；p«are»«to» front；p«are»to frontier
patterns.context: 讨论多目标优化中优于其余项目的子集，或描述速度与压缩比之间的前沿；含短语 Pareto front/frontier。
patterns.domain: 优化、算法与软件性能文档

patterns.name: to 邻接的代码标识符与语法
patterns.context: 代码中 to 出现在标识符、字符串/正则构造或变量名内部，常邻接大写词段、数字或下划线；另有若干被标记的代码 token，并非都含 to。
patterns.domain: VB、Python、C/C++ 等代码及代码片段

patterns.name: 麦芽糖与低聚糖术语中的词素
patterns.context: 标记落在糖类化学名词的片段中，周围讨论转糖基化及低聚糖形成。

patterns.name: 分析化学方法描述中的术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在分析物/材料化学术语或药代动力学标题词中；各处语境不同，未见共同的局部触发词。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目标题

en.concept: Specific word fragments and subword boundaries
en.description: Activation is concentrated on several word fragments spanning token boundaries: Pareto front/frontier, Java identifier subwords, and several fragments in legal texts or proper names. These fragments occur in optimization, code, legal, and encyclopedia contexts, with no shared semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Pareto frontier term boundary
patterns.context: The term Pareto front/frontier occurs across token boundaries; it describes a set of options not simultaneously outperformed across multiple objectives, or a trade-off between speed and compression ratio
patterns.domain: Multi-objective optimization, algorithm compression technology discussions

patterns.name: Specific letter sequence within Java identifiers
patterns.context: CamelCase identifiers or method names in code; activation falls on segmented case-sensitive subwords, especially Of and adjacent identifier fragments

patterns.name: Word fragment in the proper name Tempeln
patterns.context: The proper name appears in case-separated form and is repeated twice consecutively

patterns.name: endorsement word fragment in legal texts
patterns.context: endorsement / endorse occurs in contract clauses or software licenses; the former names an endorsement clause, while the latter appears in a restriction against endorsing or promoting products

patterns.name: merchandise subword in commercial regulations
patterns.context: The statute title or provision contains “Concealment of Merchandise”; activation concentrates on an internal fragment of merchandise
patterns.domain: State statutes cited in case law

patterns.name: Leven surname fragment in a legal judgment citation
patterns.context: Occurs when a judgment lists precedent cases and parties’ names

patterns.name: Internal fragment of premium in an insurance provision
patterns.context: Regulatory provision describing proportional payment of insurance premiums by depository institutions and related periods

2_984.concept: 特定词片段与子词边界
2_984.description: 激活集中于若干跨 token 边界的词片段：Pareto front/frontier、Java 标识符子词，以及法律或专名中的若干词片段；这些词片段分别处于优化、代码、法律和百科语境，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: Pareto frontier 术语边界
patterns.context: 术语 Pareto front/frontier 跨 token 边界出现；描述一组在多个目标上不被其他选项同时优越的方案，或速度与压缩率的权衡
patterns.domain: 多目标优化、算法压缩技术讨论

patterns.name: Java 标识符内部的特定字母序列
patterns.context: 代码中的驼峰式标识符或方法名，激活落在切分后的大小写子词上，尤以 Of 及其邻近标识符片段突出

patterns.name: Tempeln 专名的词片段
patterns.context: 专名以大小写分词形式出现，连续重复两次

patterns.name: 法务文本中的 endorsement 词片段
patterns.context: endorsement / endorse 出现在合同条款或软件许可中，前者为背书条款名称，后者为禁止背书或推广产品的限制

patterns.name: 商业法规中的 merchandise 子词
patterns.context: 法条标题或条文中出现“Concealment of Merchandise”，激活集中于 merchandise 的内部片段

patterns.name: 法律判决引文中的 Leven 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 判决中列举先例案件及当事人姓名时出现

patterns.name: 保险条文中 premium 的内部片段
patterns.context: 描述存款机构保险费按比例支付及相关期间的监管条文

en.description: Activation is scattered across the Pareto frontier, Double lumen, medical terminology, and various code and technical texts; there is no consistent semantic or domain pattern, though some highlights cluster on specific word fragments.

patterns.name: Pareto frontier terminology
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of multi-objective optimization or tradeoffs between speed and compression ratio, referring to the Pareto front/frontier.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, optimization and compression algorithms

patterns.name: Double lumen medical phrase
patterns.context: “Double lumen” begins a medical noun phrase, followed by content about catheter placement or intussusception.

patterns.name: Double-precision numeric conversion code
patterns.context: Code contains the double type or converts input to Double; nearby logic also includes input validation and boundary comparisons.

patterns.name: Medical descriptions related to metastasis and overgrowth
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes greater trochanter metastasis surgery, follow-up, and causes of overgrowth.

patterns.name: Julia types and function signatures
patterns.context: Type annotations, parameters, and line continuations in Julia function declarations; activation also occurs near function names and parameters.

patterns.name: Symbol-stream signal processing
patterns.context: Describes a transmitter splitting a symbol stream into real and imaginary parts, then filtering, upsampling, or padding with zeros.
patterns.domain: Patent background, communications and signal processing

patterns.name: Spreadsheet ranges and row-insertion code
patterns.context: VBA-style variable declarations involving cell ranges, search values, and row insertion.

patterns.name: Bacteria and antimicrobial susceptibility
patterns.context: Discusses bacteria, MIC testing, and the effect of inoculum size on antimicrobial activity.

2_984.description: 激活分散于 Pareto 前沿、Double lumen、医学术语及多种代码和技术文本；没有一致的语义或领域模式，部分高亮集中在特定词片段。

patterns.name: Pareto 前沿术语
patterns.context: 出现在多目标优化或速度与压缩比权衡的讨论中，指 Pareto front/frontier。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、优化与压缩算法

patterns.name: Double lumen 医学短语
patterns.context: “Double lumen”作为医学名词短语开头，后接导管位置或肠套叠相关内容。

patterns.name: 双精度数值转换代码
patterns.context: 在代码中出现 double 类型或将输入转换为 Double；同时附近有输入验证、边界比较等逻辑。

patterns.name: 转移与过度生长相关医学表述
patterns.context: 医学摘要叙述大转子转移手术、随访及过度生长原因。

patterns.name: Julia 类型与函数签名
patterns.context: Julia 函数声明中的类型注解、参数及换行续写；激活也出现在函数名和参数附近。

patterns.name: 符号流信号处理
patterns.context: 描述发射端将符号流拆分为实部和虚部，并进行滤波、上采样或补零。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，通信与信号处理

patterns.name: 电子表格范围与插入行代码
patterns.context: VBA 风格变量声明，涉及单元格范围、搜索值和插入行。

patterns.name: 细菌与抗菌药物敏感性
patterns.context: 讨论细菌、MIC 测定及接种量对抗菌药物活性的影响。

en.concept: Within-word substrings and the to fragment
en.description: Activation often falls on within-word fragments such as to, other, phone, and om, and also involves legal words, variable names, and formatting markers. It is scattered across corpora, with no unified semantic trigger condition apparent.

patterns.name: “to” and following fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the to fragment within words or at word boundaries: for example, «to»10« front»2, «to»10«Search»3, «to»10-oligosaccharides, «to»7«-»1oligosaccharide; it also occurs between words in phrases such as to produce, applied to, and performed in.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains; optimization, code, patents, medical texts

patterns.name: Telephone-related word endings
patterns.context: Occurs in telephone/telecommunications forms in the names of cooperatives, companies, or municipalities; activation concentrates on phone and adjacent word fragments.

patterns.name: ot/om fragments within technical terms
patterns.context: Occurs within technical terms such as maltose, isomalto-oligosaccharides, and sternotomy/sternotomies; activation falls on subword fragments such as to, not, and om, with no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in perturbation / repertoire
patterns.context: Fragments occur in tokenized technical forms: Perthes disease as «Per»«the»«s», and re«per»«to»10ire.

patterns.name: Legality and marital-condition terms
patterns.context: Discusses whether a married owner may transfer homestead rights; activation is located on alienated and accompanied by legal terms such as homestead and cannot.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in thermodynamic terms
patterns.context: Occurs in the contrast between exothermic and endothermic reactions; activation clusters on the fragment other.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in merchandise
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the and substring in merchandise in the legal provision title Concealment of Merchandise.

patterns.name: Phrase about the frontier set
patterns.context: Internal fragments of Pareto front in an optimization problem; the passage also contains «multi» and «objective», but activation is pronounced near Pareto/front.

patterns.name: VBA identifiers and variable declarations
patterns.context: In consecutive VBA Dim declarations, there are scattered activations on fragments of camel-case variable names.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous legal formatting markers
patterns.context: A few activations occur near judgment footnotes and regulatory citations, with no established shared word-meaning pattern.

2_984.concept: 词内子串与 to 片段
2_984.description: 激活多落在词内的 to、other、phone、om 等片段，也涉及法律词、变量名和格式标记；跨语料分散，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: “to”及其后续片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在词内或词边界的 to 片段：如 «to»10« front»2、«to»10«Search»3、«to»10-oligosaccharides、«to»7«-»1oligosaccharide；也出现在短语 to produce、applied to、performed in 等词间位置。
patterns.domain: 多领域；优化、代码、专利、医学文本

patterns.name: 电话相关词尾
patterns.context: 出现在合作社、公司或市镇名称中的 telephone/telecommunications 词形，激活集中在 phone 及相邻词片段。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的机构名称

patterns.name: 术语内部的 ot/om 片段
patterns.context: 出现在 maltose、isomalto-oligosaccharides、sternotomy/sternotomies 等专业术语内部；激活落在 to、not、om 等子词片段，并无明显共同语义。

patterns.name: perturbation / repertoire 词内片段
patterns.context: 词片段落在拆分后的专业词形中：Perthes disease 的 «Per»«the»«s»，以及 re«per»«to»10ire。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、免疫学专利背景

patterns.name: 合法性与婚姻条件词
patterns.context: 讨论已婚所有者能否转让宅地权益时，激活位于 alienated，并伴随 homestead、cannot 等法律语汇。

patterns.name: 热力学词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 exothermic、endothermic 反应对举中，激活聚集在 other 片段。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的热力学说明

patterns.name: merchandise 内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在法律条文标题 Concealment of Merchandise 中 merchandise 的 and 子串。

patterns.name: 前沿集合短语
patterns.context: 优化问题中 Pareto front 一词的内部片段；该段还含 «multi»、«objective»，但激活突出在 Pareto/front 附近。

patterns.name: VBA 标识符与变量声明
patterns.context: 在连续的 VBA Dim 声明中，对驼峰式变量名的片段有零散激活。

patterns.name: 杂项法律格式标记
patterns.context: 判决尾注及法规引用附近出现少量激活，未见可确立的共同词义模式。

en.description: Activation marks often fall on short in-word fragments: ash, and, not/om in medical terms, as well as to, prim, and low; genres and contexts are scattered, with no stable theme or shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Word-final or medial fragment “ash”
patterns.context: The substring occurs inside complete words in varied contexts: “leash,” “backsplash,” and the code method name “trimSlash.”

patterns.name: Fragment “and”
patterns.context: Appears as an in-word fragment in the proper name “Stockholm-Strandburg” and the common word “ampersand”; the contexts have no clear shared theme.
patterns.domain: Legal lists, code or data text

patterns.name: Complete “not” and nearby word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in medical-text word forms related to “sternotom(y/ies),” with the trigger position inside a segmented medical term.

patterns.name: Complete “to”
patterns.context: The substring “to” is marked in the term Pareto front; the context discusses multi-objective optimization and dominance relations.

patterns.name: Fragments “prim” and “and”
patterns.context: Occur inside the word “reprimand,” in a context about a lawyer’s disciplinary decision.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in “Barlow”
patterns.context: Triggered in the name “Barlow,” in a citation in research on anxiety and mood disorders.

2_984.description: 激活标记多落在词内短片段：ash、and、医学术语中的 not/om，以及 to、prim、low；跨文体且语境分散，未见稳定主题或共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 词尾或词中片段“ash”
patterns.context: 该子串出现在完整单词内部，邻近语境各不相同；分别是“leash”“backsplash”和代码方法名“trimSlash”。
patterns.domain: 小说叙事、论坛讨论、代码

patterns.name: “and”片段
patterns.context: 以词内片段形式出现于专名“Stockholm-Strandburg”和普通词“ampersand”中；所在语境没有明显共同主题。
patterns.domain: 法律名单、代码或数据文本

patterns.name: 完整的“not”及其邻近词形
patterns.context: 出现在医学文本的“sternotom(y/ies)”相关词形中，触发位置落在被拆分标注的医学术语内部。

patterns.name: 完整的“to”
patterns.context: 在 Pareto front 一词中，子串“to”被标记；语境讨论多目标优化与支配关系。

patterns.name: “prim”和“and”片段
patterns.context: 出现在“reprimand”一词内部，语境为律师纪律处分结论。

patterns.name: “Barlow”中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 触发于人名“Barlow”，出现在焦虑与情绪障碍研究的引文中。

en.description: Strong activations mostly fall on the spelling fragment and (including andburg, Crandall, ampersand, operand, a drug name, Upland, and polyurethane). Other intraword fragments include slash, _BCL, and leash. These span domains and vary widely in context.

patterns.name: Strandberg fragment in a name
patterns.context: Appears in a company's formal name, near several telecommunications company names; strong activation falls on the proper-name spelling fragment “andburg”.

patterns.name: Path or slash-handling code
patterns.context: Java-style code calls trimSlash with a system page operation path as an argument; a fragment of the slash-related method name is strongly activated.

patterns.name: Crandall in an author name
patterns.context: The surname Crandall appears in a mathematics reference; activation falls on and within the spelling of the name.

patterns.name: Local variable and underscore identifier
patterns.context: A Subtract call in low-level code; identifier _BCL ends with Of. Activation is concentrated on Of.

patterns.name: Ampersand in a unit name
patterns.context: The word ampersand appears near electrical measurements in a tabular equipment or specification record; activation falls on the final and.

patterns.name: Leash in a physical-action description
patterns.context: A novel describes a character losing emotional control in the phrase “A leash within him snapped”; activation falls on the final fragment of leash.

patterns.name: Operand in a type error
patterns.context: A compiler error message lists a type mismatch between operator and operand; activation falls on the final and in operand.

patterns.name: Cefamandole in a drug name
patterns.context: A medical abstract discusses an antimicrobial drug and inoculum effects; activation falls on the internal fragment and in cefamandole.

patterns.name: Upland in a school name
patterns.context: A legal case describes a school district and schools; the and fragment in the proper name Upland is strongly activated.

patterns.name: Polyurethane in a polymer term
patterns.context: A patent background describes polymer composition; activation falls on the final and fragment in polyurethane.

2_984.description: 各段强激活多落在拼写片段 and（含andburg、Crandall、ampersand、operand、药名、Upland、polyurethane），另有 slash、_BCL 与 leash 等词内片段，跨领域且上下文差异大。

patterns.name: 名字中的斯特兰堡片段
patterns.context: 出现在公司正式名称中，附近有多个电信公司名称；高激活落在专名的拼写片段“andburg”。

patterns.name: 路径或斜杠处理代码
patterns.context: Java 风格代码中调用 trimSlash，参数是系统页面操作路径；斜杠相关方法名的片段强激活。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Crandall
patterns.context: 数学文献参考文献中的作者姓氏 Crandall；激活落在人名拼写内部的 and。

patterns.name: 局部变量与下划线标识符
patterns.context: 低级代码中的 Subtract 调用，标识符 _BCL 以 Of 结尾；激活集中在 Of。

patterns.name: 单位名称中的 ampersand
patterns.context: 表格式设备或规格记录中，单词 ampersand 出现在电气量值附近；激活落在词尾 and。

patterns.name: 人物身体动作词中的 leash
patterns.context: 小说叙述人物情绪失控，短语“A leash within him snapped”；激活落在 leash 的词尾片段。

patterns.name: 类型错误中的 operand
patterns.context: 编译器错误信息列出 operator 与 operand 的类型不匹配；激活落在 operand 的词尾 and。

patterns.name: 药名中的 cefamandole
patterns.context: 医学摘要讨论抗菌药物及接种量效应；激活落在 cefamandole 的内部片段 and。

patterns.name: 学校名称中的 Upland
patterns.context: 法律案件叙述学区及学校，专名 Upland 中的 and 片段强激活。

patterns.name: 聚合物术语中的 polyurethane
patterns.context: 专利背景描述聚合物组成；激活落在 polyurethane 末尾的 and 片段。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on the subword fragments “ash” and “and” in strings, appearing across word forms, code, and proper names; an internal fragment in the optimization term “Pareto front” also appears. No shared semantics or stable context is evident.

patterns.name: “ash” at the end of a word
patterns.context: Mainly appears at the end of English words or identifiers; sometimes the prefix itself forms a complete word, as in “leash” and “backsplash,” and sometimes it is part of a code identifier.
patterns.domain: Narrative, home-improvement reviews, technical discussions, and code

patterns.name: Word-final fragment “and”
patterns.context: Activation falls inside or at the end of different words, including reprimand, ampersand, and a spelling fragment in the place name Brandenburg; no unified contextual condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, technical data, organization names

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the Pareto phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the optimization term “Pareto front”; the trigger is concentrated on an in-word substring of the term, rather than on “to” or “front” generally.

2_984.description: 激活主要落在字符串中的子词片段“ash”和“and”，可跨词形及代码、专名出现；另见优化术语“Pareto front”内部片段，未呈现共同语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: 单词末尾的“ash”
patterns.context: 主要出现在英语单词或标识符的结尾；有时前缀本身构成完整词，如“leash”“backsplash”，有时是代码标识符的一部分。
patterns.domain: 叙事、家居评论、技术讨论与代码

patterns.name: “and”词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同词内部或末尾，分别涉及 reprimand、ampersand、地名 Brandenburg 的拼写片段；未见统一上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、技术数据、机构名称

patterns.name: Pareto 短语内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在优化术语“Pareto front”中，触发集中于术语的词内子串，而不是普遍的“to”或“front”。

en.concept: Narrative word forms and use as a section label
en.description: The most consistent trigger is narrative/Narrative: it appears both in the fixed “Project Narrative” section of NIH abstracts and legal documents, and in ordinary use in historical narratives and online discussion. Other activations occur on intraword fragments in plague and imperative, and at the end of the code identifier trimSlash; no clear shared semantics are evident.

patterns.name: Narrative label or concept
patterns.context: “Narrative” appears as a fixed section label in project abstracts (e.g., “PUBLIC HEALTH RELEVANCE: Project Narrative”) or as an ordinary concept referring to narrative, discussion, historical narrative, and similar uses; it occurs with varying capitalization and subword segmentation.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, legal attachments, academic writing, online commentary

patterns.name: Internal morphemes in compound words
patterns.context: Activation falls within a word or on a morpheme; the former occurs in literary text, the latter in a comparison of programming paradigms.

patterns.name: Word-final segment of a Java identifier
patterns.context: A code identifier is segmented into subwords, with activation covering its final “Slash” portion.

2_984.concept: Narrative 词形及其栏目用法
2_984.description: 最一致的触发是 narrative/Narrative：既包括 NIH 摘要、法律文件中的固定“Project Narrative”栏目，也包括历史叙事和网络论述中的普通用法。另有 plague、imperative 词内片段及代码标识符 trimSlash 的词尾激活，缺少明确共同语义。

patterns.name: Narrative 标签或概念
patterns.context: “Narrative”作为项目摘要的固定栏目标签（如“PUBLIC HEALTH RELEVANCE: Project Narrative”），或作为叙事、论述、历史叙事等普通概念；大小写及词内切分均有出现。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、法律附件、学术写作、网络评论

patterns.name: 复合词中的内部词素
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部或词素上；前者处于文学文本中，后者出现在编程语言范式对比中。

patterns.name: Java 标识符的词尾
patterns.context: 代码标识符按子词切分，激活覆盖标识符末尾的“Slash”部分。

en.description: Activation falls on in-word substrings across a range of terms: plague-related words, the blink word family, and fragments in names, technical terms, error terms, email disclaimers, pathogen names, and programming paradigm terms. Most occur only once or twice, with no unified semantics or context.

patterns.name: plague and related forms
patterns.context: An internal substring of a word is marked; examples occur in historical plague narratives, local legends, and pathogen lists.

patterns.name: blink word family
patterns.context: Describes blinking, blink tests, or control of flashing patterns.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal -mer
patterns.context: Occurs in author names and email addresses, with no clear semantic or syntactic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Setter and backsplash
patterns.context: Discusses using a robot to install a kitchen backsplash; two marked substrings occur in the same passage.

patterns.name: blunder
patterns.context: Comments on the impact of a policy or bill, calling it a major blunder.

patterns.name: Word forms related to representatives and recipients
patterns.context: Appears in boilerplate wording in email confidentiality notices about intended recipients, authorized representatives, and handling misdirected messages.

patterns.name: ella
patterns.context: Occurs in pathogen names, listed alongside anthrax, plague, and other pathogens.

patterns.name: imperative
patterns.context: Discusses programming paradigms, alongside functional and object-oriented languages.

2_984.description: 激活落在多种词内部子串上：鼠疫相关词、眨眼词族，以及姓名、技术词、失误词、邮件免责声明词、病原体名和编程范式词；多数只出现一两次，缺乏统一语义或上下文。

patterns.name: plague 及相关词形
patterns.context: 词形内部的子串被标记；在历史瘟疫叙述、地方传说、病原体列表中出现。
patterns.domain: 历史叙事、百科、医学研究

patterns.name: blink 词族
patterns.context: 描述眨眼动作、眨眼测试或控制闪烁模式。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、电子技术问答

patterns.name: 词尾或词内的 -mer
patterns.context: 出现在作者姓名及邮箱地址中，未见明确的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: Setter 与 backsplash
patterns.context: 谈及用机器人完成厨房瓷砖挡水板施工；两个被标记子串出现在同一段。

patterns.name: blunder
patterns.context: 在对政策或法案影响的评论中，将其称作重大失误。

patterns.name: 代表及收件人相关词形
patterns.context: 出现在邮件保密声明关于预期收件人、授权代表及误收处理的固定措辞中。

patterns.name: ella
patterns.context: 出现在病原体名称中，和炭疽、鼠疫等病原体并列。

patterns.name: imperative
patterns.context: 讨论编程语言范式，与函数式、面向对象语言并列。

en.description: The main activations fall on the intraword substring lash, found in lash, backsplash, leash, and other spellings, without a consistent meaning. A few other activations occur on mer in Palmer, ague in plague, and final fragments in imperative and determinative; no shared semantics or domain are evident.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment lash
patterns.context: Activation falls on the consecutive intraword letters lash, with varied meanings and syntactic positions; examples include the verb phrases lash together / lash out and the words backspl«ash» and le«ash».
patterns.domain: Novels, technical discussion, Q&A, web text

patterns.name: Intraword fragment mer
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final fragment of the name Palmer; it appears in author affiliations and email addresses.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment an
patterns.context: Activation falls within the word plague; the context mentions plague and its being inflicted by God.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment ive
patterns.context: Activation falls within imperative in a programming context; the same passage also has separately marked «only», «were», and similar tokens.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment ive
patterns.context: Activation falls within determinative in a legal document, where it means decisive for an appeal; nearby, «Since» is separately marked.

2_984.description: 主要激活于词内子串 lash：出现在 lash、backsplash、leash 等拼写中，词义并不统一。另有少量激活落在 Palmer 的 mer、plague 的 ague、imperative 与 determinative 的词尾片段，缺乏共同语义或领域。

patterns.name: 词内片段 lash
patterns.context: 激活落在词内连续字母片段 lash 上，词义和句法位置各异；包括动词短语 lash together / lash out，以及单词 backspl«ash»、le«ash»。
patterns.domain: 小说、技术讨论、问答、网页文本

patterns.name: 词内片段 mer
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名 Palmer 的末尾片段；出现在作者署名和邮箱地址中。

patterns.name: 词内片段 an
patterns.context: 激活落在 plague 一词中；语境提到瘟疫及其被上帝施加的情形。

patterns.name: 词内片段 ive
patterns.context: 激活落在 programming 语境中的 imperative 一词内；同段还出现单独标记的 «only»、«were» 等。

patterns.name: 词内片段 ive
patterns.context: 激活落在法律文书中的 determinative 一词内，表示对上诉具有决定性；附近还有单独标记的 «Since»。

en.description: Activation strongly falls on plague, leash/lash, and several in-word fragments, with sporadic coverage of function words, typographic symbols, and technical-term fragments; semantics and syntactic conditions vary across passages.

patterns.name: plague and related words
patterns.context: The meaning concerns plague or disease, especially alongside epidemics, historical disasters, or pathogens; segment 2 also contains «Almighty», segment 4 mentions Great Plague, and segment 6 lists pathogens.

patterns.name: leash / lash word forms
patterns.context: The complete word leash or a fragment containing lash inside a word; contexts involve pipe configurations, a character’s emotional outburst, or walking a dog.

patterns.name: Local characters in word fragments and proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on substrings in names, email addresses, formatting marks, or words, without a unified meaning.
patterns.domain: Paper formatting and author information, philosophy bibliographies

patterns.name: Function words in sentence constructions
patterns.context: A few common function words are marked in narrative or explanatory sentences; there is no clear stable syntactic position or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Literature, encyclopedias, technical discussions, research and online texts

patterns.name: Local word-form fragments and technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on parts of image-processing terminology, in-word fragments, or components of puzzle phrases, without clear semantic correspondence across passages.

2_984.description: 激活较强地落在 plague（瘟疫）、leash/lash 及若干词内片段，也零散覆盖功能词、排版符号和技术术语片段；跨段语义与句法条件不统一。

patterns.name: plague 及相关词
patterns.context: 词义涉及瘟疫或疾病，尤其与疫情、历史灾难或病原体并列出现；段 2 还出现 «Almighty»，段 4 提及 Great Plague，段 6 列举病原体。

patterns.name: leash / lash 词形
patterns.context: 完整词 leash，或单词中包含 lash 的片段；语境涉及管线组合、人物情绪爆发或牵狗。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、小说、日常叙事

patterns.name: 词内片段与专名中的局部字符
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名、邮箱、格式标记或单词内部的子串，并不构成统一词义。
patterns.domain: 论文排版与作者信息、哲学书目

patterns.name: 组合句法中的功能词
patterns.context: 叙述或说明句中，少量常见功能词被标记；没有明显稳定的句法位置或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 文学、百科、技术讨论、科研文本与网络文本

patterns.name: 局部词形片段与技术术语
patterns.context: 激活落在图像处理术语、词内片段或谜题短语的组成部分，缺少跨段对应的明确语义。
patterns.domain: 计算机视觉论文、文字谜题

en.description: Strong activations mostly fall on intraword character fragments: IST in LIST and mer in Palmer are the clearest examples. Other intraword fragments and sporadic activations on common words have no obvious semantic connection and span domains.

patterns.name: Character fragment in LIST
patterns.context: The IST substring in the English word LIST is highlighted; meanings and grammatical environments vary.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, Hacker News, business email

patterns.name: Character fragment in Palmer
patterns.context: The mer substring within the name Palmer appears in author email addresses and astronomy citations.

patterns.name: Intraword mor/mer-like fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls inside longer English words rather than on standalone words; correspondence with substrings in other segments is uncertain.

patterns.name: Other intraword fragments
patterns.context: Marked letter fragments are embedded in different complete words, with no apparent shared meaning or context.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, business email, puzzle text

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on common words or phrases
patterns.context: These low-to-moderate-strength marks occur across varied syntactic positions and word classes, without a stable shared trigger.

2_984.description: 强激活多落在词内字符片段：LIST 中 IST、Palmer 中 mer 最明显；另有多种无明显语义关联的词内片段及零散常见词激活，跨领域分布。

patterns.name: LIST 的字符片段
patterns.context: 英文单词 LIST 中的 IST 子串被突出；词义和语法环境各异。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、黑客新闻、商务邮件

patterns.name: Palmer 的字符片段

en.description: All fragments show in-word segmentation or local string activation, but the marked portions span stems, affixes, abbreviations, identifiers, and ordinary words, with substantial semantic and stylistic variation. Local word-form patterns are visible, but no shared semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: In-word or affix boundary
patterns.context: Activation falls inside segmented or marked words and may involve stems, affixes, capitalization fragments, or numeric fragments; meanings and positions vary.

patterns.name: Decorative and descriptive word forms

patterns.name: Fragments in legal identifiers and abbreviations

patterns.name: Fragments in personal or proper names
patterns.context: Fragments occur within proper names or other names; only isolated examples are available, so no stable preference for proper names can be established.

patterns.name: Fragments in medical morphology terms
patterns.context: In lymphoma medical texts, terms related to blastoid / blastic are segmented; the in-word fragments covered by activation are not identical.

patterns.name: Code identifier fragments
patterns.context: Morpheme fragments occur inside Java package names or class identifiers, especially identifiers such as tracing and decorator.

patterns.name: Fragments in uppercase abbreviations or code output
patterns.context: Uppercase English identifiers are segmented in network diagnostic output or R code comments in forums; the fragments occur in different strings.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in literary vocabulary

patterns.name: Functional word fragments in patent text
patterns.context: When describing the separation of a shotgun wad from a projectile, multiple common function and content words are marked, making it difficult to attribute activation to a single semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Relational word fragments in legal narratives
patterns.context: When recounting a police investigation, evidence, and locations, local fragments from several parts of speech are marked; no single clear semantic condition is evident.

2_984.description: 所有片段均出现词内切分或局部字符串激活，但被标记部分横跨词干、词缀、缩写、编号和普通词，且语义与文体差异很大；可见局部词形模式，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内或词缀边界
