en.description: The most prominent recurring activations fall on LIST or the final IST fragment. Code punctuation, line breaks, and several seemingly unrelated intraword fragments also activate across Q&A, email, papers, legal, historical, patent, and medical texts.

patterns.name: LIST subword fragment
patterns.context: In the uppercase word LIST or words ending in LIST, activation falls on the subword fragment IST; examples occur in ordinary sentences, code comments, document headings, and email bodies.

patterns.name: Fragments in numeric and punctuation formats
patterns.context: Short tokens such as parentheses, equals signs, commas, line breaks, and Boolean values also activate in code or formatted text. They often occur alongside IST/LIST in the same segment but are not limited to it.
patterns.domain: StackExchange code; legal citations and formatted text

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper names or words
patterns.context: Activations correspond to subword fragments inside words or at their beginnings or ends, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Paper affiliations, legal texts, historical catalogs, medical papers

patterns.name: Slug fragment in a firearm description
patterns.context: A shotgun ammunition description says plastic-coated pellets form a slug; this fragment is among the most prominent activations in the segment.

patterns.name: ANG fragment in a meeting notice
patterns.context: A possible word-final or truncated-word fragment appears in a meeting schedule notice; surrounding text mentions a room, time, and attendee list.

patterns.name: Calmed fragment in a medical context
patterns.context: Describes a study finding that prefrontal activity decreases after touching wood; activation falls on an intraword subword fragment.

2_984.description: 激活最显著地反复落在 LIST/词尾 IST 片段；此外代码标点、换行及若干互不明显相关的词内片段也会激活，跨越问答、邮件、论文、法律、历史、专利和医学文本。

en.description: Activations fall on local fragments of several words: atin in the drug name oxaliplatin, slug, LIST/LISTEN, lash, and marble. They occur in distinct contexts and styles, with no stable shared semantics or contextual conditions beyond their respective word forms.

patterns.name: Oxaliplatin-related word
patterns.context: The fragment «atin» in the drug name oxaliplatin is marked; it appears in contexts involving drug combinations or cancer treatment.

patterns.name: slug
patterns.context: slug appears in code or text; one instance refers to a shotgun wad and projectile combining into a dangerous object, while another is a slug field in a database query.

patterns.name: list/listen
patterns.context: A marked fragment appears in uppercase LISTEN or LIST; these are used, respectively, for a network port listening state and a request to provide a list of attendees.

patterns.name: lash
patterns.context: A fragment of the word lash is marked; one instance means to criticize harshly, while another refers to chaining or combining elements in a workflow.

patterns.name: marble
patterns.context: When comparing the effects of materials on autonomic nervous activity, a fragment in the material name marble is marked.

2_984.description: 激活落在若干词的局部片段上：药名 oxaliplatin 中的 atin、slug、LIST/LISTEN、lash 和 marble。它们出现在彼此不同的语境与文体中，除各自词形外看不出稳定的共同语义或上下文条件。

en.concept: Word-internal fragments and a fixed title trigger

patterns.name: Word-internal suffix or affix fragments

en.description: Activations are distributed across word fragments, code identifiers, sporadic function words, and technical terms in cross-domain texts. Individual passages also concern ship conversions, legal citations, and drunk-driving facts. The triggering conditions are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Stressed syllables at word segmentation points
patterns.context: Activations fall on marked, segmented word fragments involving linguistic terminology, code identifiers, chemical terminology, legal language, and common words. They are especially visible in word-final or internal syllables, but have no consistent meaning-based condition.

patterns.name: Named code identifiers and code formatting
patterns.context: In C/C++ header files, macros, and Objective-C interface declarations, activations fall on identifier fragments, class names, property types, or newline characters.

patterns.name: Function words and grammatical structures
patterns.context: In ordinary narrative or legal factual statements, sporadic activations occur on articles, pronouns, prepositions, and auxiliary verbs; no stable syntactic position or semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Military ship and landing craft narrative
patterns.context: Describes a ship converted into an Australian Royal Navy landing craft during World War II, mentioning the removal of armaments and the conversion.

patterns.name: Legal citation format
patterns.context: Near statutory provisions, federal regulation citations, and case narrative headings; numeric references and citation formatting are dense.

patterns.name: Chemical and biomedical word fragments in technical terminology
patterns.context: Appear respectively in specialist contexts involving natural product synthesis and bioactive compounds, and cytokine research; activations are on internal term fragments rather than a clearly shared domain concept.

patterns.name: Narrative label in project abstracts
patterns.context: Appears in the “Narrative” label of research project abstracts or public-health-related project descriptions.

patterns.name: Traffic violation and signs of intoxication statements
patterns.context: After an officer stops a driver, the narrative describes speeding, erratic lane control, and observations suggesting intoxication.

2_984.description: 激活分布于跨领域文本中的词片段、代码标识符、零散功能词和专业词；个别段落还涉及舰船改装、法律引注及醉驾事实。各处触发条件不统一。

en.description: Activations often fall on intraword or word-final fragments (such as IST, lash, ative, ze, and orial), across different meanings, domains, and styles. Many other weak activations are sporadic, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Intraword or word-final fragment in armorial
patterns.context: Appears in “armorial bearings” describing room decor; activation is concentrated on a spelling fragment rather than an obvious complete semantic concept.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment -IST
patterns.context: Occurs within or at the end of uppercase words: the network service status “LISTEN” and the appendix heading “LIST”.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment -lash
patterns.context: Embedded in “lash together” or “lash out,” referring to combining components or an emotional outburst; the shared trigger is the word fragment lash, despite different meanings and syntax.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment -ative
patterns.context: Occurs at the ends of adjectives: imperative (programming paradigm) and neurorestorative (therapeutic effect).

patterns.name: Word-final fragment -ze
patterns.context: Occurs in address text containing the Polish place name Wrocław; it is an intraword spelling fragment.

patterns.name: Other intraword/word-final fragments
patterns.context: Fragments occur in different complete words: the material name marble, LISTEN, armament, ship, and neurorestorative. No unified semantic or domain condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Medical research, technical Q&A, historical text, biomedicine

patterns.name: Other weak activations
patterns.context: These are marked weaker or secondary activations scattered across common words, proper names, abbreviations, and uppercase contents text; beyond local spelling fragments, there is no stable shared context.

2_984.description: 激活多落在词内或词尾碎片（如 IST、lash、ative、ze、orial），跨越不同词义、领域和文体；另有大量分散的弱激活，未见一致语义条件。

patterns.context: 出现在描述房间装饰的 “armorial bearings” 中，激活集中于拼写片段，而非明显的完整语义概念。
patterns.domain: 文学小说、室内装饰描写

patterns.name: 词尾片段 -IST
patterns.context: 出现在大写词的内部或末尾，分别是网络服务状态 “LISTEN” 和附录标题 “LIST”。
patterns.domain: 技术问答；历史书籍目录

patterns.name: 词尾片段 -lash
patterns.context: 嵌在 “lash together” 或 “lash out” 中，分别表示组件组合、情绪发作；共同触发形式是词片段 lash，语义与句法并不相同。

patterns.name: 词尾片段 -ative
patterns.context: 出现在形容词末尾：imperative（编程范式）和 neurorestorative（疗效）。
patterns.domain: 编程讨论；生物医学研究

patterns.name: 词尾片段 -ze
patterns.context: 出现在波兰地名 Wrocław 的地址文字中，是词内拼写片段。

patterns.name: 其他词内/词尾片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在不同完整词中：材料名 marble、LISTEN、armament、ship、neurorestorative；没有统一的语义或领域条件。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、技术问答、历史文本、生物医学

patterns.name: 其余弱激活碎片
patterns.context: 这些是标注出的较弱或次强激活，分散在普通词、专名、缩写与大写目录文字中；除局部拼写片段外，看不出稳定共同上下文。

en.concept: Word fragments and specific orthographic forms
en.description: Activations mainly occur on several internal or final word fragments, especially the all-caps LIST substring and Macros in code identifiers; the remaining fragments span domains and meanings, making them difficult to group into a unified semantic category.

patterns.name: Uppercase LIST substring
patterns.context: Appears in the all-caps table-of-contents heading “THE LIST OF REGIMENTS” and the port status “LISTEN” in an online answer.

patterns.name: Macros identifier
patterns.context: Appears in identifiers in code or project configuration, such as PFMacros.h and UserMacros.

patterns.name: Word-final or suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on final word segments, affixes, or internal word fragments, with inconsistent word meanings and parts of speech; they occur in material names, abstract nouns, medical terms, programming terms, and proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, medical texts, encyclopedias, forums, mathematics papers

patterns.name: Lowercase ze fragment
patterns.context: Both are letter fragments within longer words, appearing respectively in an SQL analysis command and a Polish place name; they differ from the uppercase LIST pattern.

2_984.description: 主要激活于若干词内片段或后段，尤其是全大写 LIST 子串及代码标识符中的 Macros；其余片段跨领域、词义分散，难归为统一语义类别。

patterns.name: 大写 LIST 子串
patterns.context: 出现在全大写的目录标题“THE LIST OF REGIMENTS”及网络答复的端口状态“LISTEN”中。
patterns.domain: 历史书籍标题；技术问答

patterns.name: Macros 标识符
patterns.context: 出现在代码或项目配置的标识符中，如 PFMacros.h、UserMacros。

patterns.name: 词内后段或后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词的后段、词缀或词内切分片段，词义与词类不统一；分别出现在材料名称、抽象名词、医学术语、编程术语及专名中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学文本、百科、论坛、数学论文

patterns.name: 小写 ze 片段
patterns.context: 均为较长词内部的字母片段，分别出现在 SQL 分析命令和波兰地名中；与大写 LIST 模式不同。

en.description: Activations are distributed across English words, code identifiers, legal abbreviations, and fragments of name spellings. Code naming is somewhat more common, but the triggering substrings and semantics differ markedly, making a unified condition difficult to identify.

patterns.name: Specific fragments in segmented words
patterns.context: Activations fall on local substrings within English words, proper names, code identifiers, or personal names. Most token boundaries align with word-form fragments, but fragment meanings and positions vary widely.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: biomedicine, build configuration, Python/Qt, law, Objective-C, fiction, database discussions, Lisp, mathematics papers, musician lists

patterns.name: Fragments in case-sensitive and code-style identifiers
patterns.context: In code, configuration files, or programming discussions, activations fall on components of camel-case names, macros, type names, or uppercase identifiers; not every naming component activates.

patterns.name: Word-internal morphological or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Located inside or at the end of ordinary English words, which occur in contexts involving nerve repair descriptions, legal documents, query optimization discussions, and Lisp code; no consistent meaning or affix condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in personal and place names
patterns.context: Activations occur within the spellings of personal or place names, including Palmer, Taipei, and Polish names; the contexts are paper bylines or band member lists.

patterns.name: Abbreviation fragment in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in the legal citation “40 C«FR» 86.1”, near a USC statutory reference.

patterns.name: Local fragments in program syntax/output
patterns.context: Appear respectively in the SQL statement EXPLAIN ANALYZE, the Lisp function parameters operator/operand, and the Lisp REPL prompt CL-USER; triggering positions are scattered and cannot be grouped into a single syntactic function.

2_984.concept: 局部词片段与标识符片段
2_984.description: 激活分散在英文词内、代码标识符、法规缩写及姓名拼写片段中；代码命名略多，但触发子串和语义差异明显，难以确定统一条件。

patterns.name: 拆分词中的特定片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词、专名、代码标识符或姓名内部的局部子串上；多数 token 边界与词形片段相符，但片段语义和位置差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：生物医学、构建配置、Python/Qt、法律、Objective-C、小说、数据库讨论、Lisp、数学论文、音乐家名单

patterns.name: 大小写与代码式标识符片段
patterns.context: 在代码、配置文件或编程讨论中，激活落于驼峰式名称、宏、类型名或全大写标识符的组成部分；并非每个命名片段都激活。

patterns.name: 词内形态/词尾片段
patterns.context: 位于普通英文词内部或词尾，词语分别处于神经修复描述、法律文书、查询优化讨论和 Lisp 代码语境；尚无一致的词义或词缀条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、法律、数据库、编程

patterns.name: 姓名与地名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在人名或地名的拼写内部，包括 Palmer、Taipei 及波兰姓名；上下文是论文署名或乐队成员名单。
patterns.domain: 学术署名、音乐人物名单

patterns.name: 法律引用中的缩写片段
patterns.context: 出现在法规引注“40 C«FR» 86.1”中，邻近还有 USC 法条编号。

patterns.name: 程序语法/输出中的局部片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 SQL 语句 EXPLAIN ANALYZE、Lisp 函数参数 operator/operand，以及 Lisp REPL 提示符 CL-USER 中；触发位置分散，不能归为单一语法功能。
patterns.domain: 数据库与 Lisp 编程

en.description: Activations are mainly scattered across subword fragments within words such as marble and narrative, and also include sporadic word fragments, punctuation, and newlines in code, research, legal, encyclopedic, and nautical texts. Aside from a few recurring word forms, no unified semantic or contextual pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: marble word form
patterns.context: Activations fall on the ble subword fragment in marble, across different capitalization and contexts; [1] is a material name, while the other two instances are a filename and a place name.
patterns.domain: Research papers, code file lists, encyclopedia text

patterns.name: narrative word form
patterns.context: Activation is in the latter part of narrative; one instance is a legal document heading, and another is a section label in an NIH project description.

patterns.name: Specific segmentation fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on internal subword fragments of different words; one appears in a widget name in Qt code, and the other in a list of sailboat components.

patterns.name: Biomedical word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Two consecutive fragments in the same word, restorative, activate while describing the efficacy of nerve repair.

patterns.name: Sporadic word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur respectively on internal or final word fragments in coated, SCF, reversioner, DSASubprime, and Jackie's; there is no obvious shared semantic or contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Research papers, encyclopedias, code, news headlines

patterns.name: sail in nautical vocabulary
patterns.context: In a consecutively numbered list of sail types or sailboat components, sail and the punctuation after it show weak activation.

patterns.name: Symbol and grammatical fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic punctuation, newlines, and short grammatical fragments are marked, with no stable shared context.

2_984.description: 激活主要散落在 marble、narrative 等词的内部子词片段，也见于代码、科研、法律、百科和航海文本中的零散词片段、标点与换行；除少数重复词形外，未见统一语义或上下文模式。

patterns.name: marble 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 marble 的 ble 子词片段上，大小写和上下文不同；[1] 是材料名，其他两处分别是文件名和地名。
patterns.domain: 科研论文、代码文件列表、百科文本

patterns.name: narrative 词形
patterns.context: 激活位于 narrative 的后半部分；一处是法律材料标题，一处是 NIH 项目描述中的栏目标签。
patterns.domain: 法律文件、科研项目摘要

patterns.name: 特定切分片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在不同词的内部子词片段；前者出现在 Qt 代码中的控件名，后者出现在帆船部件列表。

patterns.name: 生物医学词内片段
patterns.context: 同一单词 restorative 中连续两个片段被激活，修饰神经修复疗效。

patterns.name: 零散词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分别出现在 coated、SCF、reversioner、DSASubprime、Jackie's 中的词内或词尾片段；没有明显共同语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 科研论文、百科、代码、新闻标题

patterns.name: 帆船词汇中的 sail
patterns.context: 在连续编号的帆型或帆船部件清单中，sail 及其后的标点有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 符号与语法碎片
patterns.context: 零星标点、换行及短语法片段被标记，未见稳定的共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 代码、法律引文、评论标题

en.description: Activations often fall on intraword substrings or segmented word fragments, including Polish diacritics and inflected forms; sporadic hits also occur on marble, blade, SUPERIOR, neurorestorative, behave, and Deleting. Semantic domains vary widely.

patterns.name: Polish character fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within Polish words, including diacritics and segmented inflected forms; examples occur in sentences, parliamentary forms of address, and names.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary text and biographical entries

patterns.name: marble subword
patterns.context: The complete English word marble is marked; it refers to experimental material in one case and a resource file in a filename in another.

patterns.name: Anatomical blade
patterns.context: In anatomical descriptions of the jaw and tongue, blade refers to the front part of the tongue.

patterns.name: Superior legal term
patterns.context: The uppercase court name SUPERIOR is marked in segments, within case party and court names.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in restorative
patterns.context: An internal fragment in the medical term neurorestorative, referring to neurorestorative efficacy, is marked.

patterns.name: Word ending in behave
patterns.context: The verb be-have is marked within the word; the context discusses whether a stock trend is behaving as expected.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in delete
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intraword fragment of Deleting in a technical discussion of deleting elements from a JavaScript array.

2_984.description: 激活常落在词内子串或被拆分的词片段上，涵盖波兰语变音与词形，也零散命中 marble、blade、SUPERIOR、neurorestorative、behave、Deleting；语义领域差异很大。

patterns.name: 波兰语字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语单词内部的子词片段，包含变音符号及被拆分的词形；出现在句子、议会称呼及人名中。
patterns.domain: 波兰语议会文本与人物条目

patterns.name: marble 子词
patterns.context: 完整英文词 marble 被标记；分别指实验材料和文件名中的资源文件。

patterns.name: 解剖学 blade
patterns.context: jaw 与 tongue 部位的解剖描述中，blade 指舌头前部。

patterns.name: Superior 法律词
patterns.context: 大写法院名称 SUPERIOR 被拆分标记，处于案件当事方和法院名称中。

patterns.name: restorative 词尾片段
patterns.context: 神经修复疗效的医学术语 neurorestorative 内部片段被标记。

patterns.name: 行为词尾
patterns.context: be-have 这一动词被标记在词内，语境讨论股票走势是否如预期。

patterns.name: delete 词内片段
patterns.context: JavaScript 数组删除的技术讨论中，激活落在 Deleting 的词内片段。

en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual, cross-domain text, often on word-internal fragments, common words, punctuation, or newlines. They also cover path variables, proper nouns, technical terms, and research terminology, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments or subwords of longer words across different languages and word forms, without showing a stable condition tied to the complete word’s meaning.
patterns.domain: Mixed: biomedicine, code, Polish parliamentary text, scientific papers

patterns.name: Short common words or affix fragments
patterns.context: Common words, affixes, or subword fragments in Polish sentences; also a single-letter fragment in a biomedical abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary text and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: File paths and list markers
patterns.context: Variables, paths, and file lists in code/configuration text; a filename fragment «ble» also activates in the same passage.

patterns.name: Local fragments in names or proper nouns
patterns.context: Appear in proper nouns, filenames, or abbreviations, with no shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Newline characters
patterns.context: Marked activations correspond to the newline itself, appearing at title/body boundaries or paragraph openings.
patterns.domain: News webpage text, PubMed Central paper text

patterns.name: Biomedical abbreviations and technical terms
patterns.context: In a nerve repair research context, describing the effects of SCF and G-CSF; activations fall on abbreviations or word-internal fragments.

patterns.name: Polish parliamentary expressions and lexical fragments
patterns.context: Polish parliamentary speech concerning goals, legal transition, historical compromise, and related topics; activations are mainly on internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Word-internal «string»
patterns.context: A compound term in a string theory context, with activation covering a complete English word fragment within the term.

patterns.name: Word-internal «blade»
patterns.context: Describes the anatomical location of the median sulcus of the tongue, alongside location words such as body and posterior.

patterns.name: Word-internal «commercial»
patterns.context: Describes the source and breed of experimental animals; nearby context includes age, quantity, and location.

patterns.name: Word-internal «induced»
patterns.context: Describes laser-induced damage and the development of research on it.

2_984.description: 激活分散在多语种与多领域文本中，常落在词内片段、常见词或标点/换行上；另覆盖路径变量、专名、专业术语及论文术语，缺乏统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.trigger: «or» in “neurorest«or»ative”, «zy»/«ne»/«prze» in Polish words, «der» in “FOLDER”, «body» in “body”
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词的内部片段或子词上；跨不同语言和词形，未显示稳定的完整词义条件
patterns.domain: 混合：生物医学、代码、波兰语议会文本、科学论文

patterns.name: 短常见词或词缀片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中常见的词、词缀或子词片段；另有生物医学缩写中的单字母片段
patterns.domain: 波兰语议会文本及生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 文件路径和列表标记
patterns.context: 代码/配置文本中的变量名、路径与文件列表；同一段也激活文件名片段 «ble»

patterns.name: 名称或专名中的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名、文件名或缩写形式中，未见共同语义条件
patterns.domain: 代码文件列表、新闻标题

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 激活标记对应换行本身，出现在标题/正文分隔或段落起始处
patterns.domain: 新闻网页文本、PubMed Central 论文文本

patterns.name: 生物医学缩写与专业术语
patterns.context: 神经修复研究语境，描述 SCF 与 G-CSF 的疗效；但激活落在缩写或词内片段
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 波兰语议会表达与词汇片段
patterns.trigger: «prze» in “przejrzysty”/“przekształcenia”、«prze»/«ze» in “przeze mnie”, 以及 «komprom» in “kompromis”
patterns.context: 波兰语议会发言，涉及目标、法律转型、历史性妥协等；激活主要是词内片段

patterns.name: 词内 «string»
patterns.context: 弦理论语境中的复合术语，激活覆盖术语中的完整英语词片段

patterns.name: 词内 «blade»
patterns.context: 描述舌头中线沟槽的解剖位置，与 body、posterior 等位置词并列

patterns.name: 词内 «commercial»
patterns.trigger: «commercial» in “commercial crossbred rabbits”及重复的“commercial farm”
patterns.context: 实验动物来源与品种描述；相邻上下文包含年龄、数量、地点
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 词内 «induced»
patterns.context: 描述激光诱导损伤及其研究发展

en.description: Activations often fall on word-internal subword fragments, such as “pre”-like fragments in Polish words, “and” in the technical term operand, and “lash,” “my,” and “ble.” These fragments occur across languages, code, and prose, with inconsistent semantics and contexts. Other code markers and paper vocabulary show only sporadic activation.

patterns.name: Subword fragment “pre”
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword tokens segmented from within words; the instances have no shared syntactic or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary text and English Q&A

patterns.name: Subword fragment “and”
patterns.context: Triggered only within the term operand in programming text.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, code, and technical documentation

patterns.name: Subword fragment “ble”
patterns.context: Appears within a proper noun in a path or filename.
patterns.domain: Build configuration and resource file lists

patterns.name: Subword fragment “lash”
patterns.context: In English phrasal verbs, it means either to criticize harshly or to combine/connect; the meanings differ.

patterns.name: Subword fragment “my”
patterns.context: One is an internal fragment of a natural-language word, while the other is within a hyphenated identifier; there is no obvious shared context.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary text and Lisp code

patterns.name: Special character or short subword triggers
patterns.context: Activations are scattered within Polish words, at the start of sentence-initial words, and at structural newlines; there is no consistent context.

patterns.name: Code and formatting markers
patterns.context: A few activations occur around code, paths, HTML tags, and identifiers, with no stable syntactic or formatting-marker pattern.

patterns.name: Word fragments in experimental conditions narrative
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur in the materials and methods section of a rabbit experiment, with no clear shared trigger token or specific semantic pattern.

2_984.description: 激活多落在词内子词片段：如波兰语词中的「pre」类片段、技术术语 operand 中的「and」、以及「lash」「my」「ble」等；这些片段跨语言、代码和散文出现，语义与上下文不统一。其余代码标记及论文词语仅呈零散激活。

patterns.name: 子词片段「pre」
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部被切分出来的子词 token 上；各处并无共同句法或语义条件
patterns.domain: 波兰语议会文本及英语问答

patterns.name: 子词片段「and」
patterns.context: 只在编程文本中的术语 operand 内触发
patterns.domain: 编程问答、代码与技术文档

patterns.name: 子词片段「ble」

patterns.domain: 构建配置与资源文件清单

patterns.name: 子词片段「lash」
patterns.context: 英语短语动词中，分别表示猛烈抨击与组合连接；语义不同

patterns.name: 子词片段「my」

patterns.context: 一个是自然语言词形内部片段，另一个是连字符标识符内部；无明显共同上下文

「_FOLDER」「${ASSET_FOLDER}」「_PATH」「_DIR」「FILE_LIST」「

」「

」等；但主要激活仍落在局部子词上

patterns.name: 实验条件叙述中的词片
patterns.context: 兔子实验材料与方法段落中有零散激活，没有明确共同触发 token 或特定语义模式

en.description: Activations fall on word-internal fragments in texts from different languages: the English passages involve common words, affixes, stems, and code identifiers, while the Polish passages involve internal fragments of inflected words. There is no stable semantic theme; the pattern may favor particular subword fragments.

patterns.name: English word-internal suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on complete words or parts of words, including common affixes, stem fragments, and ordinary words; contexts have no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Email, research papers, code, news, legal texts, and comments; passages 1–6, 9

patterns.name: Polish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In Polish parliamentary speech, activations are distributed within inflected words and also occur on common word segments; no stable single meaning or grammatical function is apparent.

2_984.description: 激活落在不同语言文本中的词内片段：英语段涉及普通词、词缀、词干及代码标识符；波兰语段涉及屈折词的内部片段。没有稳定的语义主题，可能偏向特定子词片段。

patterns.name: 英语词内后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词或词的一部分上，包含常见词缀、词干片段及普通词；上下文并无一致语义条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、科研论文、代码、新闻、法律文本及评论；段1–6、9

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 在波兰语议会发言中，激活分布于带变格/屈折形式的词内部，也包括常见词段；未见稳定的单一词义或语法功能。

en.description: Activations often fall on local fragments within words or compound identifiers: names, inflected Polish words, code identifiers, and uppercase fragments in legal titles. Other activations occur on common words, punctuation, and materials-testing terms, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Names or word-final fragments in embedded strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on specific fragments of names or longer words; sometimes it is an internal substring in a proper name, sometimes an ordinary word ending.
patterns.domain: Email, news/fiction, code comments or identifiers

patterns.name: Polish word-form fragments
patterns.context: In Polish names and sentences, activation is distributed within words containing diacritics and inflected forms; it does not consistently correspond to the same complete word.
patterns.domain: Polish speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: In code or configuration text, triggers occur in compound identifiers, syntax symbols, and identifier substrings; the specific triggering fragments vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Github configuration / Objective-C and HackerNews Lisp code

patterns.name: Common function words and sentence-initial markers
patterns.context: Short common words and punctuation in natural language or code contexts; examples are sporadic and provide no clear consistent syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Web headings, narrative text, academic abstracts, and code

patterns.name: Fragments within domain vocabulary or entities
patterns.context: In materials-testing abstracts, local fragments of material names, experimental description words, and general modifiers are marked; their correspondence with other segments is unclear.

patterns.name: Uppercase letter fragments in legal titles
patterns.context: In fully capitalized court titles and party names, activation covers fragments within state names, place names, and personal names.

2_984.description: 激活多落在词内或复合标识符中的局部片段：姓名、波兰语屈折词、代码标识符及法律标题大写片段；另有常见词、标点和材料实验词，未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 嵌入式字符串中的姓名/词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名或较长词语的特定片段上；有时是专名中的内部子串，有时是普通词尾。
patterns.domain: 邮件、新闻/小说、代码注释或标识符

patterns.name: 波兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 波兰语姓名与句子中，激活分布在含变音符号的词及屈折词形内部；并非稳定对应同一个完整词。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码或配置文本中，触发点位于复合标识符、语法符号及标识符子串；各例具体触发片段不同。
patterns.domain: Github 配置/Objective-C 与 HackerNews Lisp 代码

patterns.name: 常见功能词及句首标记
patterns.context: 自然语言或代码上下文中的短常见词、标点；例子零散，难以确定一致的句法条件。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、叙事文本、学术摘要及代码

patterns.name: 领域词汇或实体内部片段
patterns.context: 材料实验摘要中，材料名、实验描述词及一般修饰词的局部片段被标记；与其他段的对应关系不明显。

patterns.name: 法律标题中的大写字母片段
patterns.context: 全大写法院标题及当事人姓名中，激活覆盖州名、地名和姓名的内部片段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-internal substrings, word endings, and short words in multiple languages; they also include the biomedical abbreviation HMW and “and” in the code identifier operand. No unified semantic or contextual condition is apparent; the pattern may favor local subword/character features.

patterns.name: Word-final or word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall inside or at the end of words in different languages; English nouns/proper names also show «ie» (e.g., Jack«ie», Les«lie»), while Polish includes various inflectional or spelling fragments. The surrounding content is not consistent.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, especially Polish; news, parliamentary records, fiction, and email

patterns.name: HMW abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears in the protein/biochemistry terms HM«W»C, HM«W»1, HM«W»2; the trigger is a letter within the abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and grant project text

patterns.name: and in a code identifier
patterns.context: In the Lisp function parameter identifier operand, activation falls on the substring and; the surrounding context is a code definition.

patterns.name: High-frequency short words at word boundaries
patterns.context: Sporadically appear in headings, technical discussion, and narrative text, with no stable syntactic or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Single-character or short morpheme fragments
patterns.context: Activations can fall within proper nouns/abbreviations, code symbols, or Polish words; these fragments have no evident shared context.

2_984.description: 激活分散在多语种词内子串、词尾和短词上；另有生物医学缩写HMW及代码标识符operand中的and。未见统一语义或上下文条件，似偏向局部子词/字符模式。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语言词的内部或词尾；英语名词/专名中也出现 «ie»（如 Jack«ie»、Les«lie»），波兰语中则出现多种屈折或拼写片段。各例周围内容并不固定。
patterns.domain: 多语言文本，尤其波兰语；新闻、议会记录、小说及邮件

patterns.name: HMW缩写
patterns.context: 出现在蛋白质/生物化学术语 HM«W»C、HM«W»1、HM«W»2 中；触发点是缩写内部字母。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与资助项目文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的and
patterns.context: 在 Lisp 函数参数标识符 operand 内，激活落在 and 子串；周围是代码定义。

patterns.name: 词语边界处的高频短词
patterns.context: 零散出现在标题、科技论述和叙事文本中，未见稳定的句法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 单字符或短语素片段
patterns.context: 激活可落在专名/缩写、代码符号或波兰语词内部；这些片段彼此缺乏可见共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、代码、多语言文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across intraword fragments in different domains: blade, Leslie, Polish proper names, email addresses, Objective-C identifiers, and Jackie. Apart from some word forms or names, there is no unified semantic concept or clear shared context.

patterns.name: blade word form or substring
patterns.context: Activation falls on blade and the blade substring in compounds; contexts include anatomical terminology and a record product description.

patterns.name: Leslie in a personal name
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the beginning or within the name Leslie; examples appear in a novel and in an email recipient's name.

patterns.name: Intraword Polish fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intraword fragment of the Polish name Trzetrzelewska and a word-final fragment of the organization name Sojuszu; both contexts involve lists of names or proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia band personnel list, European Parliament records

patterns.name: Local strings in Enron email addresses
patterns.context: Activation falls on local character fragments in email addresses, near usernames, periods, or domains; no single complete string is shared.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Objective-C code
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across class-name and property-type fragments in Objective-C declarations; multiple nonadjacent triggers occur in the same code segment.

patterns.name: Jackie in a comment heading
patterns.context: Activation falls on the end of Jackie in a comment heading introduced by “Now Commenting On:”.

2_984.description: 激活散布于不同领域的词内片段：blade、Leslie、波兰语专名、邮件地址、Objective-C 标识符及 Jackie。除部分词形或人名外，缺少统一语义或明确共同上下文。

patterns.name: blade 词形或子串
patterns.context: 激活落在 blade 及其复合词中的 blade 子串；语境包括人体解剖术语和唱片产品描述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、音乐产品介绍

patterns.name: 人名中的 Leslie
patterns.context: 激活位于人名 Leslie 的开头或内部；分别出现在小说叙述和邮件收件人姓名中。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语人名 Trzetrzelewska 的词内片段，以及政治组织名称 Sojuszu 的词尾片段；上下文都是人名或专名列表。
patterns.domain: 维基百科乐队人员列表、欧洲议会记录

patterns.name: Enron 邮件地址中的局部字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在邮件地址的局部字符片段中，涉及用户名、点号或域名附近；不是同一个完整字符串。

patterns.name: Objective-C 代码中的词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在 Objective-C 声明中的类名和属性类型片段；同一代码段内出现多个不相邻触发处。

patterns.name: 评论标题中的 Jackie
patterns.context: 激活位于 Jackie 的词尾，出现在以“Now Commenting On:”引出的评论标题中。
patterns.domain: 网页评论/体育新闻标题

en.description: Activation concentrates on “NI” in uppercase proper names: it occurs mainly in NIH and related institutional acronyms, the name of Judge Niemeyer, and also the NI 43-101 mining standard and Nietzsche titles; legal opinion headers and research funding contexts have additional formatting features.

patterns.name: Court opinion header
patterns.context: The title/docket information area of a federal court opinion, often appearing alongside the judge’s name, docket number, and filing/decision date

patterns.name: NI in institution names such as NIH/NIEHS
patterns.context: In biomedical, public health, or research funding texts, NI is part of an institutional acronym; it also occurs in the surname NIEMEYER in legal texts

patterns.name: Research projects and funding descriptions
patterns.context: Describes research projects, institutional collaborations, funding sources, or research plans, often with institutional acronyms
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, medical paper acknowledgments, and research reports

patterns.name: NI 43-101 in resource/mining technical disclosures
patterns.context: In mineral resource estimates or press releases, NI 43-101 appears as the name of a qualified-person and technical disclosure standard

patterns.name: Nietzsche’s name and titles
patterns.context: NI is the opening part of Nietzsche’s name in philosophy paper titles

2_1005.description: 激活集中在大写专名中的“NI”：主要出现在 NIH 及相关机构缩写、法官 Niemeyer 姓名，也见 NI 43-101 矿业规范和 Nietzsche 标题；法律判决页眉与科研资助语境另有格式特征。

patterns.name: 法院判决页眉
patterns.context: 联邦法院判决的标题/案卷信息区，常与法官姓名、案号和提交/裁决日期同现

patterns.name: NIH/NIEHS 等机构名中的 NI
patterns.trigger: “NI”后接被拆分标记的机构名称，如“NI»10EME…”“NI»10OS…H”“NI»10AMS”“NI»10HR”
patterns.context: 生物医学、公共卫生或研究资助文本中，NI 是机构缩写的一部分；也见法律文本中的法官姓氏 NIEMEYER
patterns.domain: 科研/生物医学及法律专名

patterns.name: 科研项目与资助说明
patterns.context: 描述研究项目、机构合作、资助来源或研究计划，常伴随机构缩写
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、医学论文致谢与研究报告

patterns.name: 资源/矿业技术披露中的 NI 43-101
patterns.context: 矿产资源估算或新闻稿中，NI 43-101 作为合格人士及技术披露规范的名称出现

patterns.name: 尼采姓名及标题
patterns.context: 哲学论文标题中，NI 是 Nietzsche 姓名的开头部分

en.description: The most stable signal is the string prefix NI, especially when the legal judge’s surname NIEMEYER is split into tokens; it also appears in various institutional abbreviations, standard numbers, and philosophy titles. Legal heading punctuation and a few academic function words also activate, but the trigger mechanism is uncertain.

patterns.name: NIEMEYER surname tokenization
patterns.context: In lists of judges in legal rulings, the surname NIEMEYER is split by tokenization, with the highest activation on the prefix «NI».

patterns.name: NI abbreviation prefix
patterns.context: NI appears at the start of institutional abbreviations, regulatory standards, or names, with following characters attached to NI or split by tokenization; these examples alone make it difficult to determine whether the same lexical trigger is involved.
patterns.domain: Biomedical institutions, mining standards, philosophy titles

patterns.name: Document-format punctuation
patterns.context: Periods, line breaks, and spaces in ruling headings and fixed formats such as filing and decision dates also activate, but not all occurrences are equally prominent.

patterns.name: Common function words in academic contexts
patterns.context: Function words and prepositions sporadically activate in NIH project or medical research narratives, without showing a stable, independent semantic condition.

2_1005.description: 最稳定的信号是字符串前缀 NI，尤其法律法官姓氏 NIEMEYER 被切分时；也见于多种机构缩写、标准编号及哲学标题。法律抬头标点和少量学术连接词亦激活，触发机制不确定。

patterns.name: NIEMEYER 姓氏分词
patterns.context: 法律判决的法官名单中，姓氏 NIEMEYER 被分词切开，最高激活落在前缀 «NI»。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院判决抬头

patterns.name: NI 缩写前缀
patterns.context: NI 出现在机构缩写、监管标准或人名拼写中，后续字符与 NI 相连或被分词切开；仅凭这些例子难以确认是否是同一词汇触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学机构、采矿标准、哲学标题

patterns.name: 文书格式标点
patterns.context: 判决书抬头和提交/裁决日期等固定格式中的句点、换行或空格也有激活，但并非所有出现处都同等突出。

patterns.name: 学术语境中的常见连接词
patterns.context: NIH 项目或医学研究叙述中，连接词和介词零星激活，未显示稳定的独立语义条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学资助与研究文本

en.description: Activations concentrate at the beginnings of uppercase NI strings: Judge Niemeyer’s surname, NIH-related institutional abbreviations, the mining standard NI 43-101, and the name Nietzsche. Their commonality is primarily orthographic, not a unified meaning.

patterns.name: NIEMEYER in judge surnames styled in italics
patterns.context: In lists of judges on the first page of U.S. federal appellate court rulings, NIEMEYER is split into multiple tokens; it is often preceded by Before and followed by other judges’ names

patterns.name: NI in NIH/NIAMS and other institutional abbreviations
patterns.context: NI begins abbreviations of U.S. National Institutes of Health-related institutions such as NIH, NIAMS, NIAID, and NIEHS; subsequent letters are tokenized
patterns.domain: Medical, public health, and research funding texts

patterns.name: NI 43-101 mining disclosure standard
patterns.context: Appears in the context of regulatory disclosures about a Qualified Person in mining press releases

patterns.name: NI in Nietzsche’s name
patterns.context: Appears in titles/bibliographies of works related to Nietzsche, with the name split into tokens

2_1005.concept: 大写 NI 开头字符串
2_1005.description: 激活集中在大写 NI 字符串开头：法院法官姓 Niemeyer、NIH 系机构缩写、矿业标准 NI 43-101，以及 Nietzsche 姓名；共同点主要是拼写形态，而非统一语义。

patterns.name: 斜体式法官姓氏中的 NIEMEYER
patterns.context: 美国联邦上诉法院判决首页的法官名单中，NIEMEYER 被拆分成多个 token；此前常有 Before，后接其他法官姓名

patterns.name: NIH/NIAMS 等机构缩写中的 NI
patterns.context: NI 是 NIH、NIAMS、NIAID、NIEHS 等美国国立卫生研究院相关机构缩写的开头，后续字母被分词
patterns.domain: 医学、公共卫生、科研资助文本

patterns.name: NI 43-101 矿业披露标准
patterns.context: 出现在矿业新闻稿关于 Qualified Person 的规范性披露语境中

patterns.name: Nietzsche 姓名中的 NI
patterns.context: 出现在 Nietzsche 相关作品标题/书目中，名字被拆分拼写

en.description: Activation concentrates on the “NI” fragment within uppercase proper names or acronyms: the surnames of court judges NIEMEYER and NIETZSCHE, as well as NI-initial institutional acronyms and the Canadian mining standard NI 43-101; it occurs mostly in formal documents or academic texts.

patterns.name: Fragment in the name of a chief judge in a court of appeals caption
patterns.context: Appears within uppercase names: the first three segments are the judge’s surname NIEMEYER, and segment [10] is a tokenized fragment of Nietzsche; the former often follows “Before” in a list of judges.
patterns.domain: Federal court opinion captions, academic titles

patterns.name: NI in NIH/U.S. institutional acronyms
patterns.context: NI begins an institutional acronym, followed by uppercase letters split by tokenization; institutions include NIOSH, NIAMS, NIHR, NIAAA.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, public health, research funding texts

patterns.name: NI in the Canadian mining disclosure standard
patterns.context: NI is followed by the number 43-101, referring to the technical disclosure standard in mining press releases.

2_1005.description: 激活集中于大写专名或缩写内部的“NI”片段：法院法官姓氏NIEMEYER、NIETZSCHE，以及NI开头的机构缩写和加拿大矿业标准NI 43-101；多出现在正式文书或学术文本。

patterns.name: 法院上诉案首席法官姓名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在大写姓名内部：前三段是法官姓氏 NIEMEYER，段[10]是 Nietzsche 的分词片段；前者常接在“Before”后的法官名单中。
patterns.domain: 联邦法院判决案首、学术标题

patterns.name: NIH/美国机构缩写中的NI
patterns.context: NI作为机构缩写开头，后接被分词拆开的大写字母；机构包括NIOSH、NIAMS、NIHR、NIAAA。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、公共卫生、科研资助文本

patterns.name: 加拿大矿业披露标准中的NI
patterns.context: NI后接编号43-101，指矿业新闻稿中的技术披露标准。

en.description: Activations concentrate on strings beginning with NI in uppercase abbreviations or names: the judge NEYER, institutions such as NIH/NIEHS/NIOSH, NI 43-101, and Nietzsche’s name; the trigger position often coincides with a token boundary.

patterns.name: NI/NEYER spelling in names
patterns.context: Uppercase NI is followed by a letter sequence marked as split into tokens; mainly appears in judge names in court documents and in Nietzsche’s name.

patterns.name: NI in NIH/institution names
patterns.context: NI occurs at the beginning of institutional abbreviations, with subsequent letters possibly marked as segmented; appears in the names of research institutions, programs, or funding agencies.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts and funding texts

patterns.name: NI 43-101 regulatory number
patterns.context: NI is followed by a space and a numeric designation; the context mentions Qualified Persons and press releases.

2_1005.description: 激活集中于大写缩写或姓名中以 NI 开头的字符串：法官 NEYER、NIH/NIEHS/NIOSH 等机构、NI 43-101，以及尼采姓名；触发位置常有分词边界。

patterns.name: 人名中的 NI/NEYER 拼写
patterns.context: 大写的 NI 后接被拆分标记的字母串；主要出现在法院文书的法官姓名及尼采姓名中。

patterns.name: NIH/NIH机构名称中的 NI
patterns.context: NI 位于机构缩写开头，后续字母可能被分段标记；出现在研究机构、项目或资助机构名称中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要与资助文本

patterns.name: NI 43-101 法规编号
patterns.context: NI 后接空格及数字编号，语境提及合格人士和新闻稿。

en.concept: NI fragment in uppercase letter strings
en.description: Responds strongly mainly to “NI” and following letter fragments in uppercase acronyms or proper names, including court judge names, NIH/NIOS​​H/NCI and Nietzsche titles; it also responds more weakly to XML key tags and Res in the C# method name OnResize.

patterns.name: NI/NIH letter-string fragments
patterns.context: In uppercase acronyms or proper names, activation concentrates on NI and subsequent split letter fragments; these may belong to a full institution or person name, or to a title spelling
patterns.domain: Legal texts, research funding, medical papers, philosophy titles

patterns.name: XML key tags
patterns.context: Appears in XML plist-style key-value structures, with fields such as string, Category, or title following the tag

patterns.name: Case-sensitive fragments in C# method names
patterns.context: Appears in C# event-handler method names, surrounded by method declarations, braces, and component initialization code

2_1005.concept: 大写字母串中的 NI 片段
2_1005.description: 主要对大写缩写或专名中的“NI”及其后续字母片段强烈反应，涵盖法院法官姓名、NIH/NIOS​​H/NCI 等机构与 Nietzsche 标题；另对 XML 的 key 标签和 C# 方法名 OnResize 中的 Res 有较弱反应。

patterns.name: NI/NIH 字母串片段
patterns.trigger: “NI”后紧接分词标记的字母片段，如“NI»10EME”“NI»10OS”“NI»10AAA”“NI»9ET”
patterns.context: 大写字母缩写或专名中，激活集中在 NI 及后续被切分的字母片段；有时属于完整机构名或人名，有时是标题拼写
patterns.domain: 法律、科研资助、医学论文、哲学标题

patterns.name: XML 键标签
patterns.context: 出现在 XML plist 风格的键值结构中，标签后接 string、Category、title 等字段

patterns.name: C# 方法名中的大小写片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C# 事件处理方法名中，周围有方法声明、花括号与组件初始化代码

en.concept: Local word and format fragments such as key/NI
en.description: Activation is scattered across XML key tags, the surname Atkey, the ordinary word key, NI institutional acronyms, and the table abbreviation NI; there are also sporadic triggers such as number?, fragmented spellings, and numbers, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: XML/PLIST key tags
patterns.context: Appears in paired XML tags, especially the <key> field name and nearby text

patterns.name: key as part of a personal name
patterns.context: In the proper name Alfred Atkey / Alfred Clayburn Atkey, activation concentrates at the end of the surname

patterns.name: key as an ordinary word or morpheme
patterns.context: Used lexically in ordinary English phrases; segment 3 may fall on a spelling or tokenization boundary, and the precise trigger is unclear

patterns.name: NIH/NIH-related acronym fragments
patterns.context: In institutional names or funding agency acronyms, NI is followed by the remaining letters of the acronym
patterns.domain: Medical research abstracts and funding descriptions

patterns.name: Table abbreviation NI
patterns.context: In a table footnote, NI is explicitly defined as not investigated

patterns.name: Question mark and number field
patterns.context: A short math-problem-style line: number? followed by False, then Is and a number

patterns.name: Token fragments and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Activation falls within tokenized spellings, numbers, or acronyms; aside from the identifiable Nietzsche, the specific trigger relationship is unclear

patterns.name: Opaque field values and supplementary content
patterns.context: Appears in structured fields, numeric lines, or clinical tables, but activation cannot be explained by the same identifiable term
patterns.domain: Configuration files, math data, medical tables

2_1005.concept: key/NI等局部字词与格式片段
2_1005.description: 激活分散在 XML 的 key 标签、姓氏 Atkey、普通词 key、NI 机构缩写及 NI 表格释义；另有 number?、碎片化拼写和数字等零散触发，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: XML/PLIST 键标签
patterns.trigger: “<key>”中的“key”激活最强；同段还有“</”“string”“>”等 XML 标记
patterns.context: 出现在成对 XML 标签中，尤其是 <key> 字段名及其附近

patterns.name: key 作为人名组成部分
patterns.context: 专名 Alfred Atkey / Alfred Clayburn Atkey 中，激活集中在姓氏末尾

patterns.name: key 作为普通词或词素
patterns.trigger: “key problem”中的“key”；另有“...« key»10”处的 key 片段
patterns.context: 普通英文短语中作为词汇使用；段 3 的切分可能落在拼写或分词边界，具体触发不清楚

patterns.name: NIH/NIH 相关缩写片段
patterns.context: 机构名称或资助机构缩写中，NI 后接机构缩写的其余字母
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要及资助说明

patterns.name: 表格缩写 NI
patterns.context: 表格脚注中，NI 被明确解释为 not investigated

patterns.name: 问号与 number 字段
patterns.context: 数学题样式的短行：number? 后接 False，再接 Is 和数字
patterns.domain: 数学问答 / 数据集样例

patterns.name: 分词片段与字母数字串
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的拼写、数字或缩写内部；除可辨认的 Nietzsche 外，具体触发关系不明

patterns.name: 不透明的字段值与补充内容
patterns.context: 出现在结构化字段、数值行或临床表格中，但激活无法由同一明确词项解释
patterns.domain: 配置文件、数学数据、医学表格

en.concept: Initial fragments in uppercase proper names or words
en.description: Activation concentrates on NI at the beginning of uppercase acronyms or proper names (NIAMS, NIOSH, NIHR, NI 43-101, NI-DAQ, Nietzsche), and also on Att at the beginning of Attitudes/Attention; it spans institutions, standards, software, names, and ordinary words, with broad semantic variation.

patterns.name: NIAMS acronym
patterns.context: NIAMS, the acronym for the U.S. National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases, appears in research collaborations or lists of funding institutions; adjacent NIH institution names such as «NI»10«OS»H also occur.

patterns.name: NIOSH acronym
patterns.context: NIOSH appears as part of a research institution name in occupational and environmental health projects or institutional lists; the tokenized form in segment 2 is «NI»10«OS»1H, and in segment 4 it is «NI»10«OS»2H.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, occupational health research

patterns.name: NIHR acronym
patterns.context: NIHR appears in a list of UK medical research funding institutions, adjacent to institutions such as Oxford BRC.

patterns.name: NI 43-101 standard number
patterns.context: NI is followed by 43-101, referring to the Canadian mining disclosure standard, in descriptions of qualified persons and press releases.

patterns.name: NI-DAQ software name
patterns.context: NI-DAQ is given as an example of driver software for measurement hardware; the preceding text discusses DAQ driver-level software.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of the name Nietzsche
patterns.context: Appears in an unusually segmented spelling of Nietzsche’s name and related titles; the same segment also contains title text such as «FRIEDRICH», «FLIRT», «PARADOXEN».

patterns.name: Tokenized Att at the beginning of a segment
patterns.context: High activation falls on the initial token «Att» of an English word at the beginning of a segment; subsequent tokens form attitudes and attention, respectively, in different semantic and contextual settings.

2_1005.description: 激活集中于大写缩写或专名开头 NI（NIAMS、NIOSH、NIHR、NI 43-101、NI-DAQ、Nietzsche），另在段首 Attitudes/Attention 的 Att 上激活；覆盖机构、规范、软件、姓名与普通词，语义跨度大。

patterns.name: NIAMS 缩写
patterns.context: NIAMS 作为美国国立关节炎、肌肉骨骼和皮肤病研究所的缩写，出现在研究合作或资助机构名单中；另见相邻的「«NI»10«OS»H」等 NIH 机构名称。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、医学研究

patterns.name: NIOSH 缩写
patterns.context: NIOSH 作为研究机构名称的一部分，出现在职业与环境健康项目或机构名单中；段 2 的分词形式为「«NI»10«OS»1H」，段 4 为「«NI»10«OS»2H」。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、职业健康研究

patterns.name: NIHR 缩写
patterns.context: NIHR 出现在英国医学研究资助机构名单中，紧邻 Oxford BRC 等机构名称。

patterns.name: NI 43-101 标准编号
patterns.context: NI 后接 43-101，指加拿大矿业披露规范，出现在合格人士及新闻稿说明中。

patterns.name: NI-DAQ 软件名
patterns.context: NI-DAQ 作为测量硬件的驱动软件示例，前文讨论 DAQ 驱动级软件。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、测量仪器

patterns.name: Nietzsche 姓名拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在尼采姓名及相关标题的异常分块拼写中；同段还出现「FRIEDRICH」「FLIRT」「PARADOXEN」等标题文字。

patterns.name: 段首 Attitudes 分词
patterns.context: 高激活落在段首英文词的首块「Att」；后续分别组成 attitudes 与 attention，语义及上下文不同。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要（态度研究）；Enron 邮件（公告）

en.concept: Name usage of the word form Living
en.description: Activation is concentrated almost entirely on the word form Living. It occurs in titles, proper names, and fixed names, and occasionally continues into Livingston/Livingstone. The pattern is consistent across domains, but the specific semantics and naming functions differ.

patterns.name: Livingston / Livingstone in proper names or titles
patterns.context: The fragment occurs in a person’s name, place name, or publisher name; the context supplies the rest of the proper-name spelling.

patterns.name: Phrase Living + following word
patterns.context: Living is an independent word in a title or fixed name; activation concentrates on Living, while the following word is not marked.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia, song title, survey name, album title

patterns.name: Living in proper names
patterns.context: Living occurs in the name of an institution, organization, book, or business, usually as part of the name.
patterns.domain: Religious organizations, medical institutions, literary and business texts

patterns.name: Surveyor Living font name
patterns.context: Living is part of a magazine’s name, appearing in a font-design entry’s description of the client.

2_1005.concept: 词形 Living 的名称用法
2_1005.description: 激活几乎都集中在词形 Living；它出现在标题、专名和固定名称中，也有少数词形延续为 Livingston/Livingstone。跨领域一致，但具体语义和名称功能不同。

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的 Livingston / Livingstone
patterns.trigger: «Living»9/10 接续未标记的 “ston” 或 “stone”；如 “Living»10ston” “Churchill»2« Living»9stone”
patterns.context: 该词片段处于人名、地名或出版机构名中；上下文提供专名拼写的后半部分。
patterns.domain: 百科、书目或医学参考文献

patterns.name: 短语 Living + 后续词
patterns.trigger: «Living»9/10 后接未标记的普通词；如 “Ain't Living»10 Long” “Quality of Living»10 Survey” “Living»9 in a Spanish Town”
patterns.context: Living 是标题或固定名称中的独立词，激活集中在 Living，后续词本身未标记。
patterns.domain: 百科、歌曲名、调查名称、专辑名

patterns.name: 专名中的 Living
patterns.trigger: «Living» 后接未标记的名称成分；如 “Mindful Living»9” “Community Living»9 Centers” “We the Living»9” “Living»9 & Wellness Centers”
patterns.context: Living 位于机构、组织、书名或商业名称中，通常是名称的组成部分。
patterns.domain: 宗教组织、医疗机构、文学与商业文本

patterns.name: 字体名称 Surveyor Living
patterns.context: Living 是杂志名称的一部分，出现在字体设计条目对委托方的描述中。

en.description: Mainly responds to the Ful and Gold fragments within words, which occur in different proper names or identifiers; there are also several scattered proper-name fragments, list formatting, and a few function words and newline activations, with no stable semantics or domain conditions.

patterns.name: Ful subword fragment
patterns.context: The initial fragment is followed by different letters, forming Fulham, Fulfilment, Fulghieri, and Fulford; no fixed context is required.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including football news, training materials, and biographies

patterns.name: Gold-related words
patterns.context: Appears in the code-imported identifier GoldCorpus or the membership tier name Gold; Gold also appears repeatedly in segment 7.

patterns.name: Specific nouns and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Colchester appears as part of a football club name; other activation fragments include «Pal»2, «Kon»2, «Lab»1, «All»4, «Folk»10, «SER»10, «Gree»10, etc., embedded in proper names or titles, with no shared context.
patterns.domain: Football reports, lists of people or works, product titles, competition results

patterns.name: Function words and format boundaries
patterns.context: A few newlines, common function words preceded by spaces, or words in sentence-medial positions are marked; triggering is unstable, and they all co-occur in the same segments as stronger within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Numbering and alphabetic formatting
patterns.context: In lists or directories, single-letter group headings appear after a newline; similar unmarked entries also occur, so the pattern is weak.

2_1005.description: 主要响应词内的 Ful 与 Gold 片段，分别出现在不同专名或标识符中；另有若干分散的专名片段、列表格式及少量功能词和换行激活，未呈现稳定语义或领域条件。

patterns.name: Ful-子词片段
patterns.context: 词首片段后接不同字母，分别构成 Fulham、Fulfilment、Fulghieri、Fulford；不要求固定上下文。
patterns.domain: 足球新闻、培训材料、人物条目等多种文体

patterns.name: Gold 相关词
patterns.context: 出现在代码导入的标识符 GoldCorpus，或会员等级名称 Gold；第7段还重复出现 Gold。

patterns.name: 特定名词与专名片段
patterns.context: 作为足球俱乐部名称的一部分 Colchester；另有激活片段 «Pal»2、«Kon»2、«Lab»1、«All»4、«Folk»10、«SER»10、«Gree»10 等，分别嵌在专名或标题中，未见共同语境。
patterns.domain: 足球报道、人物或作品列表、商品标题、竞赛结果

patterns.name: 功能词及格式边界
patterns.context: 少量换行、空格前置的常见功能词或句中词被标记；触发不稳定，且都与更强的词内片段同段共现。

patterns.name: 序号及字母表格式
patterns.context: 列表或目录中，换行后出现单字母分组标题；同时有未标记的类似条目，规律较弱。

en.description: Activation is distributed across code indentation and identifier boundaries, “some” in technical text, and several unrelated programming, mathematical, and technical contexts; the latter are mostly isolated and difficult to group under one semantic theme.

patterns.name: Code indentation and structural separators
patterns.context: In code blocks, tabs appear after newlines, especially between statements, objects, or function calls; many activations fall on structural whitespace rather than adjacent identifiers.
patterns.domain: Github source code and StackExchange code examples

patterns.name: Code markers and variable-name boundaries
patterns.context: In code, identifiers or their components occur in syntactic positions such as assignments, parameters, property names, or function calls; activation may also fall on common code words or identifier boundaries.
patterns.domain: JavaScript/HTML, Python, and other source code or programming Q&A

patterns.name: Generic some in technical text
patterns.context: In English technical descriptions, some introduces an unspecified object, data, variable, or situation; this pattern occurs in multiple unrelated programming questions and source-code comments.

patterns.name: JavaScript and global variables
patterns.context: Discusses user controls, third-party JavaScript APIs, initializing global variables, and their scope.

patterns.name: Chinese characters and regular expressions
patterns.context: Character-handling issues arise when describing regular expressions processing Chinese strings.

patterns.name: GUI and data updates
patterns.context: Discusses displaying plotted data in a Tkinter interface and updating it when new data arrives.

patterns.name: Specific algebraic terminology
patterns.context: A math paper discusses Mackey algebras, bilinear forms, and Mackey functors; activation falls on tokenized fragments of the terms.

patterns.name: Threads and writing computation results
patterns.context: The questioner describes a C++ multithreaded program writing computation results to a text file.

patterns.name: Language matcher and labels
patterns.context: Go test code creates a language matcher and constructs a slice of language labels.

patterns.name: DNS zone file information
patterns.context: Explains DNS zone files and information such as the serial number in an SOA record.

patterns.name: Web player control markup
patterns.context: HTML defines jPlayer player controls, buttons, and accessibility attributes.

2_1005.description: 激活分布于代码缩进和标识符边界、技术文本中的“some”，以及若干互不相同的编程、数学和技术语境；后几类多为孤立内容，难以归并为同一语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码缩进与结构分隔
patterns.context: 代码块中换行后出现制表符缩进，尤其在语句、对象或函数调用之间；多段激活落在结构性空白上，而非紧邻的标识符上。
patterns.domain: Github 源码及 StackExchange 代码示例

patterns.name: 代码标记与变量名边界
patterns.context: 代码中标识符或其组成部分处于赋值、参数、属性名、函数调用等语法位置；激活也可能落在常见代码词或标识符边界上。
patterns.domain: JavaScript/HTML、Python 与其他源码或编程问答

patterns.name: 技术文本中的泛指 some
patterns.context: 英语技术描述中用 some 引出未具体说明的对象、数据、变量或情况；此模式在多个不同编程问题及源码注释中出现。
patterns.domain: Github 注释、StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: JavaScript 与全局变量
patterns.context: 讨论用户控件、第三方 JavaScript API、初始化全局变量及其作用域时。

patterns.name: 中文字符与正则表达式
patterns.context: 描述正则表达式处理中文字符串时出现的字符问题。

patterns.name: 图形界面与数据更新
patterns.context: 讨论 Tkinter 界面展示绘图数据及新数据到来后的更新。

patterns.name: 特定代数术语
patterns.context: 数学论文中谈及 Mackey 代数、双线性形式与 Mackey 函子；激活落在术语的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 线程与计算结果写入
patterns.context: 提问者描述 C++ 多线程程序将计算结果写入文本文件。

patterns.name: 语言匹配器与标签
patterns.context: Go 测试代码中创建 language matcher 并构造语言标签切片。

patterns.name: DNS 区域文件信息
patterns.context: 解释 DNS zone 文件及 SOA 记录中的序列号等信息。

patterns.name: 网页播放器控件标记
patterns.context: HTML 中定义 jPlayer 播放器控件、按钮及无障碍属性。

en.concept: Sporadic subword fragments and formatting structures
en.description: Activations mainly fall on subword fragments such as along, Graves, and Brow(s)e, and also cover line breaks in model lists, code indentation and braces, technical identifiers, and several common words and punctuation marks; these triggers are disparate.

patterns.name: along as an adverb/preposition
patterns.context: Appears in continuous phrases indicating movement along a path/axis, or meaning “continue” in comments; activation falls on along
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, code comments, web documents

patterns.name: Graves surname
patterns.context: Used as a person’s surname, preceded by a first name or name-related context

patterns.name: Braces/indentation structures in code
patterns.context: PHP code blocks contain line breaks, indentation, and braces; activations concentrate on formatted structural symbols

patterns.name: Honda TRX model-list formatting
patterns.context: Honda TRX models are listed line by line, with the X in the models and line breaks between entries recurring

patterns.name: Browse-related word fragments
patterns.context: The word Brow is split and highlighted in Browse-related interfaces or web phrases

patterns.name: Tags and directory terminology
patterns.context: Compound identifiers in technical text or code are split into tokens, with some fragments activating

patterns.name: Local code syntax and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Keywords, variable names, or identifier fragments in code activate sporadically, without a unified semantic condition

patterns.name: Sporadic activation of common function words and punctuation
patterns.context: Appears sporadically in their respective sentence or code contexts, without a stable collocation

2_1005.concept: 零散词片段与格式结构
2_1005.description: 激活主要落在 along、Graves、Brow(s)e 等词片段，也覆盖型号列表换行、代码缩进括号、技术标识符及若干常见词和标点；这些触发条件分散。

patterns.name: along 作副词/介词
patterns.context: 出现在连续短语中，表示沿着路径/轴线移动，或用于注释中的“继续”；激活落在 along 上
patterns.domain: 技术说明、代码注释、网页文档

patterns.name: Graves 姓氏
patterns.context: 作为人名姓氏，前面是名或名的上下文
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、能源行业访谈

patterns.name: 代码中的大括号/缩进结构
patterns.context: PHP 代码块中出现换行、缩进及花括号，激活集中于格式化的结构符号

patterns.name: Honda TRX 型号列表格式
patterns.context: Honda TRX 型号逐行列举，型号中的 X 与条目换行反复出现

patterns.name: 浏览相关词片段
patterns.context: 词 Brow 在 Browse/Browse 相关界面或网页短语中被切分突出
patterns.domain: 软件操作说明、代码错误消息

patterns.name: 标签与目录术语
patterns.context: 技术文本或代码中的复合标识符被分词切开，部分片段激活
patterns.domain: 网络专利、构建配置代码

patterns.name: 局部代码语法与标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码中的关键字、变量名或标识符片段，零散激活且缺少统一语义条件

patterns.name: 普通功能词和标点的零散激活
patterns.context: 在各自句子或代码上下文中零星出现，未见稳定搭配

en.description: Activation spans software instructions, Swedish parliamentary text, physics and quantum computing papers, patents, and various code; local cues include key/key names, Browse, DRAM, skogsdegradering, phase transitions, algorithm performance, and configuration filters, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Key names, indexes, and keyCode identifiers
patterns.context: Activation occurs near key and its case variants; it appears in variable names, object properties, or compound identifiers, without requiring a specific syntactic position.

patterns.name: File browsing operation in settings interface
patterns.context: Software instructions guide users to select a default folder for a file type and browse to the target location; the peak falls within Browse.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Swedish
patterns.context: Appears in Swedish parliamentary speeches or debate titles, with multiple within-word fragments marked, especially in skogsdegradering.

patterns.name: Function arguments and indentation in code
patterns.context: Activation covers indentation after newlines and areas near function arguments; the same segment also contains keyCode and object/converter code, but this does not establish a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Random-access memory terminology
patterns.context: In the full term Dynamic Random Access Memory (DRAM), Random is especially prominent; no broader interpretable context is available.

patterns.name: Physics transitions and crossover-transition phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses phase-transition lines in different parameter regions, their disappearance, and entry into a crossover transition; markers are distributed over adjacent physics terms and connecting words.

patterns.name: File-type configuration and filter options
patterns.context: Code or Q&A content separately discusses disabling syntax checking by filetype and configuring query-parameter filters; the contexts differ and should not be forced into one function.

patterns.name: Quantum walks and algorithm performance
patterns.context: The superposition and interference effects of quantum-walk algorithms, as well as exponential speedup over classical algorithms; activation falls on related effects and performance descriptions.

patterns.name: Iteration over merged key-value pairs in code
patterns.context: PHP code checks whether a value is an array and iterates over key-value pairs to be merged; markers include indentation, braces, and loop variables.

2_1005.description: 激活跨软件说明、瑞典语议会文本、物理与量子计算论文、专利和多种代码；可见局部线索包括 key/键名、Browse、DRAM、skogsdegradering、相变、算法性能及配置过滤器，未呈现统一语义。

patterns.name: 键名、索引与 keyCode 标识符
patterns.context: 激活落在 key 及其大小写变体附近；出现在变量名、对象属性或复合标识符中，不要求特定句法位置。

patterns.name: 设置界面的文件浏览操作
patterns.trigger: « Brow»10se（[1]）；附近有 « File»3« Loc»3«ations»1 和 « default folder»6
