patterns.context: Knight 作为人名姓氏的一部分出现，激活落在 night 子串；不要求特定句法位置。

patterns.name: 专名中的拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在人名或专名内部的特定字母片段；片段形态并不一致。
patterns.domain: 新闻、学术引用、百科与法律引文

patterns.name: Fellow 词尾
patterns.context: 在 fellow 单独成词或作为复合人名后缀时激活。
patterns.domain: 技术论坛与邮件通讯录

patterns.name: while 的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在短语 “all the while” 中，激活集中于 while。

patterns.name: 复杂排版中的 wording
patterns.context: 在批评性表达 “semantic weasel-wording” 中，激活落在连字符后缀 wording。

en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments, function words, punctuation, and line breaks in multiple languages and genres; the night substring recurs, alongside Swedish word fragments, code fragments, and sporadic fragments in article/government texts, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: English subword night
patterns.context: Split and activated within Knight; when concatenated, [1] forms Willis-Knighton, while [7] is the surname of the performer of Erica Hayden.

patterns.name: Swedish suffixes and function words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across subword fragments at the beginnings, middles, or ends of Swedish words, including common function words and fragments within lexical words; no single stable morphological position or semantic category is evident.
patterns.domain: Swedish parliamentary speeches and formal prose

patterns.name: Code punctuation and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Identifier fragments, line breaks, and punctuation activate in code contexts; the two code samples do not show consistent identifier semantics.
patterns.domain: Github source code and code comments

patterns.name: Article layout and news reading
patterns.context: Describes the experience of reading newspaper pages, headlines, and captions; activation falls on punctuation and words related to page content.

patterns.name: Sporadic English subwords
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across English word fragments or common words; the content separately discusses Cortana, keyboard scanning and recording, and the Libyan government and officials, with no shared topic or stable trigger condition.

2_1005.concept: 跨语种局部子串与边界
2_1005.description: 激活散布于多种语言与体裁的词内子串、功能词、标点和换行；可见 night 子串重复出现，另有瑞典语词片段、代码片段及文章/政府类文本中的零散片段，整体缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文子词 night
patterns.context: 字符串 Knight 中间切分并激活 night；[1] 拼接后为 Willis-Knighton，[7] 为人名 Erica Hayden 的饰演者姓氏。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾与功能词
patterns.trigger: [3] “alla« än» så … så« l»…”, “« ll»ande”, “s«ätt»”, “« tro»ts”, “« att»”；[4] “« social»”, “k«ulture»”, “« syn»…«punk»”, “« lab»…«yr»…«l»…«ill»”；[5] “Ger«not»”, “« Er»”, “«Vi»”, “natur«ligt»…«vis»”, “ar«beta»”, “« en»”, “« led»…«amöter»”, “hå«ll»”, “nö«j»”
patterns.context: 激活散布在瑞典语词的词首、词中或词尾子串，包含常见功能词，也包含词汇词内部片段；未见单一稳定词法位置或语义类别。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语议会发言与正式书面语

patterns.name: 代码标点与标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码上下文中激活了标识符的局部片段、换行符及标点；两处代码样本并未呈现一致的标识符语义。

patterns.name: 文章版面与新闻阅读
patterns.context: 描述报纸页面、标题与图片说明的阅读体验；激活落在标点及与页面内容相关的词上。

patterns.name: 英文零散子词
patterns.context: 激活分布于英文词片段或常见词，内容分别谈 Cortana、键盘扫描与录音，以及利比亚政府和官员；没有共同主题或稳定触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across recording-related words, proper names and word fragments, code whitespace and indentation, paragraph line breaks, and a passage of Swedish text. Apart from recording-related word forms, no stable semantic trigger across the corpus is apparent.

patterns.name: Recording-related word forms
patterns.context: Appears in contexts discussing audio/phone recording, event logs, or audit credibility; it may also be listed alongside keyboard scanning and voice recording.
patterns.domain: Technology discussions, news commentary, business email

patterns.name: Hits on word endings or stems
patterns.context: Activations fall on local substrings within different word forms, proper names, or identifiers; no stable semantic context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Entertainment commentary, Windows technical documentation, legal documents, code

patterns.name: Indentation and whitespace formatting
patterns.context: Activations concentrate after code comments, in long whitespace regions, and near line breaks and indentation in HTML/JavaScript.

patterns.name: Line breaks at sentence openings and text boundaries
patterns.context: Appears at paragraph or item boundaries before comments or link titles; this formatting marker occurs in multiple passages, but with varying strength.

patterns.name: Fragments within Swedish words
patterns.context: Activations fall on characters or word fragments in continuous Swedish text; the context is a sentence about biodiversity policy.

2_1005.description: 激活分散于录制相关词、专名和词内片段、代码空白缩进、段落换行及一段瑞典语文本；除录制词形外，未见跨语料稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: recording 相关词形
patterns.context: 出现在讨论语音/电话录制、事件记录或审计可信度的语境；也可能与键盘扫描、语音录制并列。
patterns.domain: 科技讨论、新闻评论、商务邮件

patterns.name: 词尾或词干片段命中
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词形、专名或标识符内部的局部子串上；未见稳定的语义上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 娱乐评论、Windows 技术说明、法律文书、代码

patterns.name: 缩进与空白格式
patterns.context: 激活集中在代码注释后、长空白区域和 HTML/JavaScript 的换行缩进附近。

patterns.name: 句首换行与文本结构边界
patterns.context: 出现在评论或链接标题前的段落/条目边界；该格式标记在多段中出现，但强度不一致。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语连续文本中的字符或词内片段；上下文是关于生物多样性政策的句子。

en.description: Activations are distributed across letter fragments within words, proper-name fragments, Swedish word forms, and long whitespace in code; there is no stable semantic theme, with code whitespace and several cross-lingual word fragments particularly prominent.

patterns.name: Substring night within words
patterns.context: Appears within a personal or proper name, often directly following the beginning of a name in the preceding text; does not require the complete word night
patterns.domain: Legal case texts, news reporting, and plot summaries

patterns.name: Substrings ales/ale within words
patterns.context: Appears in fragments within surnames or Swedish word forms, such as Zalevsky, Zaleski, Zales...; forms are not entirely consistent
patterns.domain: Legal texts, sports news, Swedish parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Swedish word-final/in-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within tokenized Swedish words, involving stem or affix boundaries; several fragments occur in the same parliamentary sentence

patterns.name: Whitespace padding in English programming code
patterns.context: Long whitespace padding occurs in code or interactive notebooks; whitespace activates strongly, while a few ordinary code/English words activate more weakly

patterns.name: Sant/igg fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Appears within the names of wrestling figures Santino and Ziggler, followed by ordinary narrative text

patterns.name: Zones in a Windows registry path
patterns.context: Appears in the registry path Internet Settings\Zones\{Zone ID}

2_1005.description: 激活分布于词内字母片段、专名片段、瑞典语词形及代码中的长空白；没有稳定的语义主题，代码空白和若干跨语种词片段尤为显著。

patterns.name: 词内字母片段 night
patterns.context: 出现在人名或专名内部，常紧接前文的名字首部；不要求完整单词 night
patterns.domain: 法律案件文本、新闻报道及剧情梗概

patterns.name: 词内字母片段 ales/ale
patterns.context: 出现在姓氏或瑞典语词形的词内片段中，如 Zalevsky、Zaleski、Zales...；形态并不完全一致
patterns.domain: 法律文本、体育新闻、瑞典语议会文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾/词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的瑞典语词内部，涉及词干或词缀边界；多个片段同处议会句子

patterns.name: 英文编程代码中的空白填充
patterns.context: 代码或交互式笔记本中出现长空格填充；空白强激活，少量普通代码/英文词也有较弱激活
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、JavaScript/Python 代码

patterns.name: 专名中的 Sant/igg 片段
patterns.context: 出现在摔角人物姓名 Santino、Ziggler 内部，后接普通叙述文字

patterns.name: Windows 注册表路径中的 Zones
patterns.context: 出现在注册表路径 Internet Settings\Zones\{Zone ID} 中

en.description: The most prominent activations cluster on the word fragment gjor within Swedish gjorde. Other sporadic activations fall on code identifiers, registry paths, personal-name fragments, and line-break markers, with no unified semantics or context.

patterns.name: “gjor” fragment within a Swedish word
patterns.context: Activation falls on the fragment gjor within the Swedish verb gjorde, in sentence narration or parliamentary speech; surrounding words and semantics are not fixed.

patterns.name: Word fragments in code or paths
patterns.context: Activations fall within English identifiers or Windows registry paths; there is no evidence that these positions share the same semantic function.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur separately in personal names, fragments of wrestler names, and mathematicians' names; there is no stable shared context or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Line-break markers
patterns.context: Marks line breaks; appears in parliamentary speeches, code, and instructions, with substantially varying contexts.

2_1005.concept: 词内片段检测，主为瑞典语 gjor
2_1005.description: 最显著激活集中在瑞典语 gjorde 的词内片段 gjor；此外，零散激活落在代码标识符、注册表路径、人名片段和换行标记上，未见统一语义或语境。

patterns.name: 瑞典语单词内部的“gjor”片段
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语动词 gjorde 的词内片段，出现在句子叙述或议会发言中；周围词语和语义并不固定。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语，主要是欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 代码或路径中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文标识符或 Windows 注册表路径的词内部分；没有证据表明这些位置共享同一语义功能。
patterns.domain: Swift 代码、Windows 技术说明

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 激活分别出现在人名、摔角手姓名片段及数学家姓名中；缺少稳定的共同上下文或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网络娱乐评论、数学论文

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 标记换行；分别出现在议会发言、代码和操作步骤中，语境差异较大。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、代码、技术说明

en.description: The strongest activations cluster on subword fragments within words across multiple languages: especially Swedish gjor, as well as Slovak konal, English successive, and several sporadic fragments. Overall, there is no consistent semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: “gjor” fragment in Swedish word forms
patterns.context: Swedish word forms containing gjor; often used as predicates in sentences, in forms such as gjorde or möjliggjorde

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Slavic words
patterns.context: In Slovak parliamentary speeches, the activation falls within the word konal

patterns.name: Letter sequence in an English compound word
patterns.context: Describes the successive evolution of integrated circuit technology in a technical explanation

patterns.name: Sporadic strong activations in other languages
patterns.context: Fall within an English proper-name fragment and a Swedish common-word fragment, respectively; no stable shared word meaning or syntactic condition is evident
patterns.domain: Wrestling commentary and European Parliament debates

2_1005.description: 最强激活集中在多语种词内子串：瑞典语 gjor 尤强，另有斯洛伐克语 konal、英语 successive 和若干零散片段；整体未显示统一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形中“gjor”子串
patterns.trigger: «g»1«jor»9，尤其是嵌在 «möjligg»1«jor»9de、«röstade vi som vi g»jor»9de 和 «föredraganden g»jor»9de 中
patterns.context: 瑞典语中包含 gjor 的词形；常见于句中谓语，形式如 gjorde 或 möjliggjorde

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内子串
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语议会发言中，触发落在 konal 词内

patterns.name: 英语复合词中的字母序列
patterns.context: 技术说明中描述集成电路技术逐代演进

patterns.name: 其他语言中的零散强激活
patterns.context: 分别落在英语专名片段及瑞典语普通词片段中；未见稳定共同词义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 摔角评论与欧洲议会辩论

en.description: The most prominent patterns are val within the Swedish word kvalitet and NR within the technical-paper abbreviation SNR. Other activations are scattered across word-internal fragments in multiple languages and styles, with no common meaning or context to explain them.

patterns.name: Swedish word for quality
patterns.context: In Swedish, the stem val occurs within the word kvalitet (quality); paragraphs 2 and 4 have k-val-itet, while paragraph 7 has an inflected variant of k-val-itet.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, public services, fisheries, information accessibility

patterns.name: Signal-to-noise ratio abbreviation
patterns.context: In an English technical paper, NR is part of the abbreviation SNR (signal-to-noise ratio).
patterns.domain: ArXiv, signal processing and wireless communications

patterns.name: Syllable/subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal fragments across different languages and domains; there is no consistent meaning, grammatical position, or stable contextual condition.
patterns.domain: English sports commentary, Danish and Swedish parliamentary text, ArXiv papers, and US legal documents

2_1005.description: 最显著模式是瑞典语 kvalitet 中的 val，以及科技论文缩写 SNR 中的 NR；其余激活分散在多种语言和文体的词内片段，难以由共同词义或上下文解释。

patterns.name: 瑞典语质量词
patterns.context: 瑞典语中，词干 val 出现在 kvalitet（质量）一词内；第2、4段为 k-val-itet，第7段为 k-val-itet 的词形变体。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，公共服务、渔业、信息可及性

patterns.name: 信噪比缩写
patterns.context: 英语科技论文中，NR 是缩写 SNR（signal-to-noise ratio）的一部分。

patterns.name: 词中间的音节/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语言、不同领域的词内部片段上；没有一致的词义或语法位置，也没有稳定的上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 英语体育评论、丹麦语和瑞典语议会文本、ArXiv论文及美国法律文书

en.concept: Word-form fragments and quality root val
en.description: The most consistent strong activations fall on the quality root val (kvalitet) across several languages. English land and zigg fragments also occur; the remaining highlights are scattered across multilingual word fragments, abbreviations, and academic text, making them difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: English word-final -land / land
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of “Westland” and “woodland”; also appears in the place name Leicester and in an accident-headline context, though it is unclear whether a shared substring triggers it

patterns.name: Subword fragment in English ziggurat
patterns.context: Occurs within the proper name Ziggler and the noun ziggurat; both examples are in fantasy/pop-culture contexts

patterns.name: Swedish kvalit(et) root
patterns.context: Within the Swedish word kvalit(et) (quality), in contexts involving public-service information or fishery product quality

patterns.name: Danish kvalitet root
patterns.context: Within Danish kvalitet(en) (quality), in discussions of health issues and inspection quality

patterns.name: Danish kvalitet root (resources and information context)
patterns.context: In “information af høj kvalitet” (high-quality information)

patterns.name: Unstable boundaries of highlighted positions and word fragments
patterns.context: Highlights cover word-initial or internal fragments and abbreviations across several languages, without a shared semantic trigger condition that can be confirmed from context
patterns.domain: Swedish, Danish, Khmer, and English academic text

2_1005.concept: 词形片段与质量词根 val
2_1005.description: 强激活最稳定地落在多种语言的质量词根 val（kvalitet），另见英文 land 与 zigg 片段；其余高亮分散于多语种词段、缩写及学术文本，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -land / land
patterns.context: 在“Westland”“woodland”中位于词尾；也出现在地名 Leicester 和事故标题语境中，是否由共同子串触发不确定

patterns.name: 英语 ziggurat 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Ziggler 和名词 ziggurat 的词内；两例均为奇幻/流行文化语境
patterns.domain: 英语娱乐评论、奇幻小说

patterns.name: 瑞典语 kvalit(et) 词根
patterns.context: 在瑞典语词 kvalit(et)（质量）内部，涉及公共服务信息或渔业产品质量

patterns.name: 丹麦语 kvalitet 词根
patterns.context: 在丹麦语 kvalitet(en)（质量）内部，讨论健康问题与检查质量

patterns.name: 丹麦语 kvalitet 词根（资源与信息语境）
patterns.context: 在“information af høj kvalitet”（高质量信息）中

patterns.name: 高亮位置与词段边界不稳定
patterns.context: 高亮覆盖多语种词首、词内片段或缩写，缺乏可由上下文确认的共同语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 瑞典语、丹麦语、高棉语及英语学术文本

en.description: High activations occur within quality (kvalitet) and management (förvaltning) words in European Parliament text, as well as in English Traverse and elliptic, the wrestling name Ziggler, and Khmer fragments. No unified semantics or reliable shared context is evident.

patterns.name: Word “kvalitet”
patterns.context: The word is split into subword tokens, with the trigger falling on the stem kval; appears in sentences discussing quality, control, or information.

patterns.name: Word “förvaltning”
patterns.context: The word is tokenized, with val within förvaltning; examples concern forest management and good governance, respectively.

patterns.name: Traverse in a code comment
patterns.context: In a C code comment describing traversal of a module list; activation is concentrated within the English verb Traverse.

patterns.name: elliptic in mathematical text
patterns.context: In a mathematical abstract, modifying operators in a discussion of elliptic operators and eigenvalue problems.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in Khmer
patterns.context: Appears in a key-value-like fragment surrounded by Khmer strings; its specific meaning and trigger condition are unclear.

patterns.name: Ziggler in wrestling text
patterns.context: In English wrestling commentary, the name Ziggler is split, with activation inside it; the same passage also contains fl«ing».

2_1005.description: 高激活散见于欧洲议会文本中质量（kvalitet）和管理（förvaltning）词内，也见于英语 Traverse、elliptic、摔角人名 Ziggler 及高棉语片段，未见统一语义或可靠共同上下文。

patterns.name: 词语“kvalitet”
patterns.context: 词被分成子词 token，触发点落在词干 kval 上；出现在讨论质量、控制或信息的语句中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本：丹麦语、瑞典语

patterns.name: 词语“förvaltning”
patterns.context: 词被分词，val 位于 förvaltning 内；分别涉及森林管理、善治。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的 Traverse
patterns.context: C 代码注释中，描述遍历模块列表的动作；激活集中在英语动词 Traverse 的词内。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 elliptic
patterns.context: 数学摘要中，修饰 operators，讨论椭圆算子与特征值问题。

patterns.name: 高棉语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在类似键值数据的片段中，周围包含高棉语字符串；具体词义和触发条件不明。

patterns.name: 摔角文本中的 Ziggler
patterns.context: 英文摔角评论中，名字 Ziggler 被拆分，激活落在其内部；同段还出现 fl«ing»。

en.concept: Local character fragments and formatting markers across corpora
en.description: Most high activations fall on the phonetic fragment val, especially in Nordic-language kvalit(et), and also in förvaltning. Others fall on the Khmer characterើ, the igg in Ziggler, line breaks in legal text, and whitespace formatting markers; they do not share a clear semantic function.

patterns.name: Cross-linguistic morpheme sequence «val»
patterns.context: High activations often fall on the val/val phonetic fragment within words. In Nordic-language text it often occurs in kvalit(et), meaning “quality”; in Swedish it can also occur in förvaltning. It is not triggered only by one complete word.
patterns.domain: European Parliament multilingual text; also an English ArXiv paper and Hungarian parliamentary text

patterns.name: Highlighted character «ើ» in code
patterns.context: The highlighted character occurs in a Khmer string, surrounded by quoted code key-value pairs and a preview field.

patterns.name: «igg» fragment in a wrestler's name
patterns.context: An English sentence mentions the plot relationship between a character and wrestler Dolph Ziggler.

patterns.name: Formatting control characters in court citations
patterns.context: A legal decision uses indented formatting to introduce a test standard, quotations, and case names.

2_1005.concept: 多语料中的局部字形片段与格式标记
2_1005.description: 多数高激活落在 val 音形片段，尤其北欧语 kvalit(et)，也见 förvaltning；其余分别落在高棉字形ើ、Ziggler 的 igg、法律文本换行及空白排版标记，难以归为同一语义功能。

patterns.name: 跨语言词素序列 «val»
patterns.context: 高强度多落在词内的 val/val 音形片段；在北欧语文本中常处于 kvalit(et)“质量”词中，在瑞典语中也可处于 förvaltning 中；并非只由同一个完整词触发
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种文本；另有一段 ArXiv 英文论文和匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 代码中的高亮字形「ើ」
patterns.context: 高亮落在高棉语字符串中，周围是带引号的代码键值与 preview 字段

patterns.name: 摔角人名片段 «igg»
patterns.context: 英文句子中提到角色与摔角手 Dolph Ziggler 的剧情关系

patterns.name: 法院引文中的排版控制符
patterns.trigger: «\r\n»4 及引文中的空白/下划线标记 « »9
patterns.context: 法律判决文本以缩进排版引入测试标准、引文和判例名称

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on several intra-word fragments in Swedish parliamentary text: jor (especially gjor/möjliggjor), kval, hel, and sekt. Substrings also occur in the English proper names Karg- and Ziggler. The different roots have no clear unified semantics across languages.

patterns.name: Swedish word-final -ör/-örande fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the jor substring within Swedish verb stems or word forms, often in göra/gjorde or möjliggöra; it is not a complete word boundary.

patterns.name: Swedish quality root kval
patterns.context: Occurs in Swedish words describing quality, standards, or control, possibly across word-internal segmentations.

patterns.name: Swedish hel root
patterns.context: Occurs in forms such as helhet (whole) or hela (entire), both expressing scope or entirety.

patterns.name: Swedish sekt/sector root
patterns.context: Embedded in sector/Swedish sektor (sector), referring to an industrial field; activations are distributed across multiple subwords within the word.

patterns.name: arg substring in English proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal substrings of the proper names Kargil/Kargiule; neither the semantics nor the word forms indicate a clear shared word class.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia biographies and film articles

patterns.name: Internal substring in English word Ziggler
patterns.context: Activation occurs on an internal letter sequence in the name Ziggler, in a passage about wrestling characters and storylines.

2_1005.description: 激活主要集中于瑞典语议会文本中若干词内片段：jor（尤其 gjor/möjliggjor）、kval、hel、sekt；另见英语专名 Karg-、Ziggler 中的子串。不同词根跨语言并无明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾 -ör/-örande 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语中动词词干或词形中的 jor 子串，常见于 göra/gjorde 或 möjliggöra；不是完整词边界。

patterns.name: 瑞典语质量词根 kval
patterns.context: 出现在描述质量、标准或控制的瑞典语词中，可能跨词内切分。

patterns.name: 瑞典语 hel 词根
patterns.context: 出现在 helhet（整体）或 hela（整个）等词形中，均与整体范围表达有关。

patterns.name: 瑞典语 sekt/sector 词根
patterns.context: 嵌在 sector/瑞典语 sektor（部门）一词中，指产业领域；激活分布在词内多个子串。

patterns.name: 英语专名中的 arg 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在专名 Kargil/Kargiule 的内部子串，语义和词形均不构成明显共同词类。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科人物及电影条目

patterns.name: 英语单词 Ziggler 内部子串
patterns.context: 激活位于人名 Ziggler 的内部字母串，周围谈及摔角角色及剧情。

en.description: Activations are distributed across Hungarian and Swedish, English papers, proper names, and code, including word-internal fragments, function words, symbols, and line breaks. There is no stable cross-domain meaning or shared grammatical trigger condition.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Hungarian
patterns.context: Triggers occur within Hungarian words, often adjacent to word endings, stems, or affix boundaries, in surrounding parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Swedish
patterns.context: Triggers occur within Swedish words, especially inflected or derived forms; no single complete word consistently triggers them.

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal fragments and syntactic context
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments appear in sentences about mediation, circumstances, or completion; the highlighted fragments are not all from the same word.

patterns.name: English function words or common-word fragments
patterns.context: Appear in sentences from scientific papers, spanning prepositions, technical terms, and common nouns; there is no clear shared word form among these triggers.

patterns.name: Fragments within personal or proper names
patterns.context: Appear in author names, citations, and proper names such as the Korteweg–de Vries equation; highlights concentrate on word-internal fragments.

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Highlights are embedded in Swedish words, such as “för«val»8«t»2ning”, “stormak«tern»3as”, and “g«jor»9de”; “«god»” also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Swedish word-final and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in Swedish words, in a parliamentary speech where an MP describes applause and gestures.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in English academic text
patterns.context: Fragments appear in the mineral name herbertsmithite and in author surnames in references; these include both internal fragments of proper names and complete surnames.
patterns.domain: ArXiv, English academic papers and citations

patterns.name: Code markers and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Appear in JavaScript-style code, object properties, strings, and chained calls; activation points span line breaks, syntax symbols, and identifiers.

2_1005.description: 激活分布在匈牙利语、瑞典语、英语论文、专名与代码中，包含词内片段、功能词、符号和换行；没有稳定的跨领域词义或统一语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内切分片段
patterns.context: 触发位于匈牙利语词内部；常与词尾、词干或词缀边界相邻，周围是议会发言文本。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发位于瑞典语单词内部，尤其见于屈折或派生词；不是统一的完整词触发。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段及句法上下文
patterns.context: 词内片段出现在谈及调解、情势或完成状态的句子中；多个被标记片段并非同一词。

patterns.name: 英语功能词或普通词片段
patterns.context: 科技论文句子中出现，涵盖介词、术语及一般名词；这些触发点之间没有明显共同词形。

patterns.name: 人名或专名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在作者姓名、引文及 Korteweg–de Vries 方程名称等专名中；标记集中于词内片段。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 标记嵌在瑞典语词中，如“för«val»8«t»2ning”“stormak«tern»3as”“g«jor»9de”；同段还出现“«god»”。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾和词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在瑞典语词语中，出现在议员描述鼓掌及手势的议会讲话里。

patterns.name: 英语学术文本中的零散片段
patterns.context: 片段出现于矿物名 herbertsmithite 及参考文献中的作者姓氏；包括专名内部和完整姓氏。

patterns.name: 代码标记及标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript 风格代码、对象属性、字符串及链式调用中；激活点横跨换行符、语法符号和标识符。

en.description: Activations often fall on subword fragments within words rather than on complete words. They occur across languages and domains, including word-final fragments in parliamentary text, Khmer fragments, and fragments within English, German, and technical proper names. There is no stable shared semantic or topical feature.

patterns.name: Specific word endings across word boundaries
patterns.context: Highlights are often embedded within segmented words, especially in Swedish word forms, affixes, or stems; however, these fragments do not share a unified meaning, and the same fragment also occurs in different contexts.
patterns.domain: Primarily multilingual European Parliament text; also English forum text.

patterns.name: Highlighted subword fragments in Slavic-language text
patterns.context: The highlight is within a Khmer string, surrounded by content resembling interface configuration or title fields; neither occurrence has enough context to determine the trigger's word meaning or morphological function.

patterns.name: Internal letter sequence in a chemical word
patterns.context: The highlight is a word-internal fragment in the name Ziggler, appearing in wrestling commentary; ordinary English narration also occurs nearby, with no clear topical connection.

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names or technical terms
patterns.context: The highlight occurs within the word Korteweg in a paper sentence introducing perturbations to spherical shapes and the Korteweg–de Vries equation; it is unclear whether the response is to the word onset, a proper-name fragment, or another letter pattern.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a long word in a report title
patterns.context: The highlight is embedded in the German compound Lebensmittel­sicherheit (food safety), in a parliamentary report title; it may be a word-internal character or subword fragment rather than a topical semantic feature.

2_1005.description: 激活多落在词内子串而非完整词上：跨语种、跨领域出现，含议会文本中的词尾片段，也有高棉语片段及英语、德语和技术专名内部片段。没有稳定的语义或主题共同点。

patterns.name: 跨词边界的特定词尾
patterns.context: 高亮常嵌在被拆分的词内部，尤其是瑞典语词形、词缀或词干的一部分；但这些片段并不构成统一词义，且同一片段也出现在不同语境。
patterns.domain: 主要是欧洲议会多语种文本；也出现在英语论坛文本。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语文本中的高亮子词片段
patterns.context: 高亮位于高棉文字串内部，周围是类似界面配置或标题字段的内容；两处都没有足够上下文确定触发的词义或形态功能。
patterns.domain: GitHub 配置文本／多语种代码库内容。

patterns.name: 化学词中的内部字母序列
patterns.context: 高亮是人名 Ziggler 的词内片段，出现在摔角评论中；周围另有普通英文叙述，未见明显主题联系。

patterns.name: 专名或技术词内部片段
patterns.context: 高亮出现在 Korteweg 一词内部，位于介绍球形形状扰动及 Korteweg–de Vries 方程的论文句子中；无法判断是对词首、专名片段还是其他字母模式的响应。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，流体力学／数学物理。

patterns.name: 报告标题中长词的内部片段
patterns.context: 高亮嵌在德语复合词 Lebensmittel­sicherheit（食品安全）内部，出现在议会报告标题中；可能是词内字符或子词片段，而非主题语义。

en.description: Activates on heterogeneous token fragments, often within words and names, and sometimes on formatting marks and ordinary function words. No stable semantic or thematic pattern is evident across the examples.

patterns.name: Segmented token within a word
patterns.context: Activations often fall on parts of words rather than whole words; in some cases, the fragment is within a morphologically complex word. No common linguistic or semantic function is apparent.

patterns.name: Names, surnames, and their parts
patterns.context: Fragments occur in bibliographic citations, personal names, place names, and other named entities; some examples overlap with common words or word parts.
patterns.domain: Academic text, IRC, news, medicine, law

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting
patterns.context: Some activations fall on a comma in text and on a line-break marker before a heading/link.

patterns.name: Common English function words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across ordinary English prose and dialogue, without a single stable syntactic environment.
patterns.domain: Source code with comments, IRC, medical text, legal text

patterns.name: Word fragments in a Russian sorting query
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on fragments of Russian words in a question about reading a file and sorting people by their city of residence.

patterns.name: Legal list of restrictions
patterns.context: Several activated fragments occur in a list of rules for tenants and restrictions on importing property.

2_1005.description: Срабатывает на разнородные фрагменты токенов, часто внутри слов и имён, а также иногда на знаки форматирования и обычные служебные слова. Устойчивой семантической или тематической закономерности по примерам не видно.

patterns.name: Сегментированный токен внутри слова
patterns.context: Активации часто приходятся на части слов, а не на целые слова; в ряде случаев фрагмент находится внутри морфологически сложного слова. Общая языковая или семантическая функция не прослеживается.

patterns.name: Имена, фамилии и их части
patterns.context: Фрагменты встречаются в библиографических ссылках, именах людей, названиях мест и других именованных сущностях; часть примеров совпадает с обычными словами или частями слов.
patterns.domain: Научный текст, IRC, новости, медицина, право

patterns.name: Пунктуация и форматирование
patterns.context: Отдельные активации приходятся на запятую в тексте и на маркер переноса строки перед заголовком/ссылкой.

patterns.name: Общие английские служебные слова
patterns.context: Срабатывания разбросаны по обычной английской прозе и диалогу, без единого устойчивого синтаксического окружения.
patterns.domain: Исходный код с комментариями, IRC, медицинский текст, судебный текст

patterns.name: Части слов в русскоязычном запросе о сортировке
patterns.context: Активации сосредоточены на фрагментах русских слов в вопросе о чтении файла и сортировке людей по городу проживания.

patterns.name: Юридический список ограничений
patterns.context: Несколько активированных фрагментов встречаются в перечислении правил для арендаторов и ограничений на ввоз имущества.

en.concept: Multilingual word fragments and proper names
en.description: Activations span Hungarian, Polish, Swedish, Greek, Khmer, and English academic text, falling on word-internal fragments, common words, proper names, and technical terms across different scripts and languages. Local topics include the KdV equation, minerals, parliamentary debate, and addresses, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-final and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within words or near word boundaries in continuous Hungarian text, including articles, case/word-form fragments, and words with diacritics. No single fixed word explains all triggers.

patterns.name: Polish personal names, place names, and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Characters or word-internal fragments in Polish names, addresses, and institution names; the second passage is letter-signature/address-like text.

patterns.name: Korteweg–de Vries term
patterns.context: Triggers are concentrated near the mathematical-physics term Korteweg–de Vries and its abbreviations; nearby text discusses equations, models, and literature.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, hydrodynamics and partial differential equations

patterns.name: Local fragments in English scientific words
patterns.context: In the fourth passage, which introduces a paper's methods and deviations in spherical shape, activation covers several ordinary English function words and scientific descriptive terms; it occurs in the same passage as the KdV topic, but not all triggers are specific to that term.

patterns.name: Mineral names and citation fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on the mineral name herbertsmithite and fragments of author names/citations, in a discussion of candidate quantum spin-liquid materials.

patterns.name: Substrings in Khmer script
patterns.context: Activations occur in Khmer text and field values resembling markers or parser syntax; tokens fall within Khmer strings, making more specific semantics difficult to infer from a single instance.

patterns.name: Swedish word forms and phrases
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across word-internal fragments and common words in coherent Swedish sentences discussing mediation, circumstances, and effectiveness; there is no single proper name.

patterns.name: Greek characters and railway-related word fragments
patterns.context: Several word-internal substrings are highlighted in Greek sentences; identifiable meanings include terrorists, bombs, airports, and railways, but a single instance cannot determine whether the activations correspond to semantics or script form.

2_1005.description: 激活跨匈牙利语、波兰语、瑞典语、希腊语、高棉语及英语学术文本，落在不同文字和语言中的词内片段、常见词、专名与术语；局部主题包括KdV方程、矿物、议会辩论和地址，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在匈牙利语连续文本的词内部或词边界附近；包括冠词、格/词形片段及带变音符号的词。没有单一固定词能解释全部触发。

patterns.name: 波兰语人名、地名与词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰姓名、地址和机构名称中的字符或词内片段；第2段是信件签名/地址式文本。

patterns.name: Korteweg–de Vries 术语
patterns.context: 触发集中在数学物理术语 Korteweg–de Vries 及缩写附近；邻近文本讨论方程、模型和文献。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，水动力学与偏微分方程

patterns.name: 英语科学词中的局部片段
patterns.context: 第4段在介绍论文方法和球形形状偏差时，激活覆盖若干普通英语功能词与科学描述词；与 KdV 主题同段，但触发并非都专属该术语。

patterns.name: 矿物名称与文献引用片段
patterns.context: 激活落在矿物名 herbertsmithite 及作者姓名/引文标记片段，处于量子自旋液体候选材料的讨论中。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理论文及引用

patterns.name: 高棉文字中的子串
patterns.context: 激活出现在高棉语文本和类似标记/解析器语法的字段值中；token 分布在高棉文字串内部，难以从单例确定更具体语义。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形与短语
patterns.context: 激活分散在瑞典语连贯句子的词内片段和常见词上，谈及调解、情况及有效性；不是单一专名。

patterns.name: 希腊语字符与铁路相关词片段
patterns.context: 希腊语句子中多个词内子串被标记；可辨词义涉及恐怖分子、炸弹、机场与铁路，但激活是否对应语义或文字形式无法由单例确定。

en.concept: Multilingual word fragments and miscellaneous text
en.description: Activations are scattered across subwords within words, inflected words, proper names, and common words in multiple languages, spanning parliamentary text, law, email, code, and forums; no stable unified semantic or syntactic condition is evident.

patterns.name: Word-internal subword fragments and endings
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal fragments of words split into multiple tokens, often in proper names, compounds, or inflected words; there is no clear shared meaning requirement.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: mineral names and citations in papers, Hungarian and Swedish parliamentary text, Danish text

patterns.name: Hungarian parliamentary word-form fragments
patterns.context: In Hungarian parliamentary speeches, several activation fragments are embedded within words; some occur in forms of address, references to members, or expressions of requests.

patterns.name: Swedish inflected words and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments in Swedish parliamentary text, in sentences about biodiversity, policy, mediation, and other topics; fragments occur in different word forms.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Swedish policy and parliamentary text

patterns.name: Proper names, locations, and organization names
patterns.context: Fragments occur in mineral names, place names, and email recipient names or organization addresses, usually as part of longer proper names.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase linking
patterns.context: In English prose or legal provisions, activations fall on common words and linking elements; examples occur in contexts describing lease rules and discussing skill practice, respectively.

patterns.name: Discussion of practice and skills
patterns.context: Compares reading about programming methods with practicing skills, using martial arts and music as examples; triggers are scattered across related English words.

patterns.name: Ideas and derogatory evaluative words
patterns.context: Discusses national decline and the evaluation of people within a theory; activations fall on evaluative words, theory-related words, and their subword fragments.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and acknowledgments
patterns.context: In code comments and acknowledgments lists, activations occur on ordinary English words, macro names, and contributor-name fragments.

patterns.name: Goods and place names in parliamentary text
patterns.context: Discusses rules for selling mineral water in several European countries; activations include beverage-related words, place names, and their word-internal fragments.

2_1005.concept: 多语种词片段与文本杂项
2_1005.description: 激活分散在多语种词内子词、屈折词、专名及普通词上，覆盖议会文本、法律、邮件、代码与论坛等；未见稳定统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段与词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分为多个 token 的词内部片段，常见于专名、复合词或屈折变化词；没有明显统一的词义要求。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：论文中的矿物名与引文、匈牙利语和瑞典语议会文本、丹麦语文本

patterns.name: 匈牙利语议会词形片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语议会发言中，多个激活片段嵌在词语内部；有些片段出现在称谓、议员或请求表达中。

patterns.name: 瑞典语屈折词及词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中的词内片段，涉及生物多样性、政策、调解等语句；片段分布在不同词形中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，瑞典语政策与议会文本

patterns.name: 专名、地点与组织名称
patterns.context: 片段出现在矿物名、地名以及邮件收件人姓名或组织地址中，通常是较长专名的一部分。

patterns.name: 英语功能词与短语衔接
patterns.context: 英语散文或法律条文中，激活落在普通词及连接成分上；分别处于租赁规则描述、技能练习论述等上下文。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、HackerNews 论坛文章

patterns.name: 涉及练习与技能的论述
patterns.context: 讨论阅读编程方法与练习技能的比较，并举武术、音乐为例；触发分散在相关英语词语中。

patterns.name: 思想观点与贬义评价词
patterns.context: 谈论国家衰退及某种理论中对人的评价，激活落在评价词、理论相关词及其子词片段上。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与致谢条目
patterns.context: 代码注释和致谢列表中，激活出现在普通英语词、宏名及贡献者姓名片段上。

patterns.name: 议会文本中的商品与地名
patterns.context: 讨论矿泉水在多个欧洲国家销售的规则；激活包括饮品相关词、地名及其词内片段。

en.description: Activations span multiple languages and genres, often falling on word-internal substrings and also including commas. Some cluster around the Korteweg–de Vries term and academic citations; the rest do not fit a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Multilingual word-internal fragment “z/ź”
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal substrings in non-English text; there is no clear shared word meaning across different languages, word forms, and contexts.

patterns.name: Comma punctuation
patterns.context: A comma follows a word; examples include Hungarian forms of address, bibliographic citations, and email address lists.

patterns.name: Korteweg–de Vries term
patterns.context: The Korteweg–de Vries equation or related researchers' names occur in mathematical-physics text; activation positions fall within proper names.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in proper names or addresses
patterns.context: Fragments within English proper names occur in mineral-literature citations and a residential community name, in different contexts.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in email addresses
patterns.context: An Enron email recipient list consists of names and organization paths; activation occurs within names.

patterns.name: Fragments within ordinary English words
patterns.context: Several ordinary words in continuous English narration of technical equation derivations show internal activations, but there is no stable single word form or semantic category.

patterns.name: Fragments within English legal phrases
patterns.context: Legal provisions list items tenants may bring and related restrictions; activations fall within different common words.

patterns.name: English citation markers and bibliographic strings
patterns.context: An ArXiv author-year or abbreviated citation list; activation positions are scattered within citation strings.

patterns.name: Contextual residue for unexplained
patterns.context: Activations occur within ordinary Hungarian or Swedish words; apart from multilingual word-internal activations, no more specific shared trigger condition can be inferred from the fragments.

patterns.name: Local forms of highlighted Russian words
patterns.context: In the same problem description, different internal substrings of several Russian words are activated; there is no evidence that these substrings share a meaning or morphological function.

2_1005.concept: 多语言文本片段与标点
2_1005.description: 激活跨多种语言和文体，常落在词内子串，也包括逗号；部分集中于 Korteweg–de Vries 术语和学术引文，其余难归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 多语言词内片段“z/ź”
patterns.trigger: 匈牙利语的 “ass«z»ony” / “k«ép»viselők” / “k«oll»égám”；瑞典语的 “möj«lig»g«jor»de”；斯拉夫语的 “г«ор»оду” / “пр«ож»ивания”
patterns.context: 激活落在非英语文本中的词内子串；不同语言、词形和上下文之间没有明显共同词义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会语料、俄语 StackExchange

patterns.name: 逗号标点
patterns.context: 逗号紧跟在词后；见于匈牙利语称呼、文献引用和邮件地址列表等不同场景。

patterns.name: Korteweg–de Vries 术语
patterns.context: 数学物理文本中出现 Korteweg–de Vries 方程或相关研究者姓名；激活位置落在专名内部。

patterns.name: 专名或地址中的词内片段
patterns.context: 英语专名内部的片段，分别出现在矿物文献引用和房屋社区名称中；语境不同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 引文、FreeLaw 法律文本

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的词内片段
patterns.context: 姓名与组织路径组成的 Enron 邮件收件人列表；激活位于姓名内部。

patterns.name: 英文普通词内部片段
patterns.context: 技术性方程推导的连续英文叙述中，多个普通词内部出现激活，但未见稳定的单一词形或语义类别。

patterns.name: 英文法律词组内部片段
patterns.context: 法律条文列举租户可携带的物品及限制；激活落在不同普通词内部。

patterns.name: 英语引用标记及书目字符串
patterns.context: ArXiv 文本中作者—年份或缩写形式的引用列表；激活位置分散在引用字符串内。

patterns.name: unexplained 的语境残余
patterns.context: 激活位于匈牙利语或瑞典语普通词内部；除多语言词内激活外，无法从片段确认更具体的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 俄语词内高亮的局部形式
patterns.context: 同一问题描述中，多个俄语词的不同内部子串被激活；尚无证据表明这些子串共享词义或形态功能。

en.description: Activations often fall on word-internal fragments across different languages and domains. Clear local patterns include Swedish fragments, proper names such as Korteweg, and fragments in personal names and watercraft. They are difficult to summarize as a single semantic or syntactic feature.

patterns.name: Hungarian word endings and internal fragments
patterns.context: These fragments are embedded within words in continuous Hungarian text; in paragraph 1, activations concentrate on internal substrings, especially «éri».
patterns.domain: European Parliament speeches or meeting records

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations cover word-internal fragments in continuous Swedish text; paragraphs 2 and 7 have different vocabulary and grammatical contexts, while «Korte» may also occur in a proper name.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text; paragraph 8 also contains a proper name in scientific literature

patterns.name: Proper name Korteweg-de Vries
patterns.context: Activation falls within the mathematician's surname “Korteweg” and related citation names; in paragraphs 4 and 5, the context is the KdV equation and related research literature, while paragraph 8 concerns a galaxy-cluster survey citation.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and physics papers, astronomy paper references

patterns.name: Name fragment in herbertsmithite
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the mineral's proper name “herbertsmithite”; nearby text discusses QSL candidates and experimental realization.

patterns.name: Name and address fragments in email
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal fragments in email recipient names, addresses, or signatures; the different fragments show no consistent name category or position.
patterns.domain: Enron emails and personal contact information

patterns.name: Watercraft word ending
patterns.context: Activates within the token “watercraft” in a sentence listing items tenants may bring.

2_1005.description: 激活多落在不同语言及领域的词内片段；明显局部模式包括瑞典语片段、Korteweg 等专名，以及姓名和 watercraft。难以归纳为单一语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语连续文本中，这些片段嵌在词内；段1的激活集中于词内子串，尤其是«éri»。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会发言或会议记录

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中，激活覆盖词内片段；段2、7的词汇和语法环境不同，«Korte»也可能出现在专名中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本；段8另见科学文献中的专名

patterns.name: Korteweg-de Vries 专名
patterns.context: 激活落在数学家姓氏“Korteweg”及相关引用名的词内；在段4、5处于 KdV 方程及其研究文献语境，段8处于星系团调查引用中。
patterns.domain: 数学与物理学论文、天文学论文的参考文献

patterns.name: herbertsmithite 名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在矿物专名“herbertsmithite”的开头；邻近 QSL 候选体及实验实现的讨论。

patterns.name: 邮件姓名与地址片段
patterns.context: 激活落在邮件收件人姓名、地址或署名中的词内片段；不同片段未显示一致的名字类别或位置。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件与个人联系信息

patterns.name: 水上交通工具词尾
patterns.context: 在“watercraft”中分词内激活，句子列举租客可携入的物品。

en.description: Activations often fall on word-internal or word-final subword fragments in continuous text, spanning multilingual parliamentary documents, academic proper names, Bengali script, transliterated Russian names, and email contacts. The different contexts show no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal subword fragments within sentences
patterns.context: In continuous natural-language text, activations fall on local subword fragments rather than usually covering entire words; the same type of fragment occurs in different word forms
patterns.domain: Hungarian and Swedish parliamentary text; also English and other-language text

patterns.name: Fragments in the name Korteweg–de Vries
patterns.context: When the Korteweg–de Vries equation and related literature names or abbreviations appear in mathematical papers, activations concentrate on local fragments of proper names or abbreviations

patterns.name: Bengali script fragments
patterns.context: Appear in code- or configuration-style field values, with the script split into multiple fragments

patterns.name: Transliterated Russian name fragments
patterns.context: A list of people contains Russian names transliterated into the Latin alphabet; activation falls on local letter sequences within names

patterns.name: Local fragments in names and email addresses
patterns.context: In email recipient lists, activations fall within components of names or email addresses

2_1005.description: 激活多落在连续文本中的词内或词尾子词片段，覆盖多语种议会文、学术专名、孟加拉文、俄语转写姓名及邮件联系人；不同上下文未显现统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 句内词尾或词中亚词片
patterns.trigger: 突出部分包括 «n»، «z»، «ép»، «oll»، «ám»، «éri»، «jor»، «ge»، «dan»، «fall»、«lik»、«men»、«z»；多出现在普通单词内部或词尾
patterns.context: 自然语言连续文本中，激活落在词的局部子词片段上，通常不覆盖整个词；同一类片段出现在不同词形中
patterns.domain: 匈牙利语、瑞典语议会文本；也包括英文和其他语言文本

patterns.name: Korteweg–de Vries 名称中的片段
patterns.context: 数学论文中出现 Korteweg–de Vries 方程及相关文献姓名、缩写时，激活集中于专名或缩写的局部片段

patterns.name: 孟加拉文字形片段
patterns.trigger: «ক»、«স»、«ত»、«চ»、«ল»等被标记的孟加拉文字符片段，尤其«ল»
patterns.context: 出现在代码或配置样式的字段值中，文字被拆成多个脚本片段
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码或结构化文本

patterns.name: 俄语人名转写片段
patterns.context: 人物名单中出现俄语姓名的拉丁字母转写，激活位于姓名内部的局部字母串
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物名单

patterns.name: 姓名与邮件地址中的局部片段
patterns.context: 邮件往来收件人列表中，激活落在姓名或邮箱地址组成部分内

en.description: Activations primarily fall on word-internal subword fragments across different languages and styles, including names, citation abbreviations, morphologically rich long words, and a few common words. There is no stable semantic or grammatical theme.

patterns.name: Token fragments at the ends of personal names or surnames
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within proper names or abbreviations, often in paper-author citations and also in email names; tokenization of names in different languages may affect triggering.
patterns.domain: Paper citations, email, and proper names

patterns.name: Token fragments within long words
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across subword tokens within long words rather than obvious complete words; especially prominent in Hungarian agglutinative words, German compounds, and other morphologically rich vocabulary.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, especially Hungarian, German, and academic terminology

patterns.name: Word fragments related to cities or place names
patterns.context: Appears in a Russian programming question asking how to sort people by their city of residence; triggering may relate to place names or their internal tokenization.

patterns.name: English subword in a common word
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal tokenization of the English word “ballast,” in a sentence describing a person as a burden; its relationship to the other patterns is unclear.

2_1005.description: 激活主要落在不同语言和文体中的词内子词片段，涵盖姓名、引文缩写、形态丰富的长词及少数普通词；没有稳定的语义或语法主题。

patterns.name: 人名或姓氏末尾的 token 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或缩写内部的子词片段，常见于论文作者引文，也见于邮件姓名；不同语言的姓名切分可能影响触发。

patterns.name: 长词内部的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于长词内部的子词 token，而非明显的完整词；匈牙利语黏着词、德语复合词及其他形态丰富词汇中尤其突出。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本，尤其匈牙利语、德语及学术术语

patterns.name: 城市或地名相关的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在要求按居住城市对人员排序的俄语编程问题中；触发可能与地点词或其词内切分有关。
patterns.domain: 俄语 StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 常见词内部的英语子词
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词“ballast”的内部切分上，所在句子把人称为负担；难以确认与其他模式的联系。

en.description: Strong activations occur mainly in the multilingual stem “pers” and the English word “once”; the former appears across multiple languages and genres, while the latter occurs in dosing frequency or “once again.” No clear corresponding trigger is observed in segment 1.

patterns.name: perso- stem
patterns.context: The stem is followed by different endings to form words such as “persoană,” “perspectivas,” “persistent,” “persigue,” “persoane,” and “personeelsleden”; no fixed syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Multilingual texts in Romanian, Portuguese, Spanish, English, Dutch, and other languages, covering parliamentary, medical, academic, and general narrative contexts.

patterns.name: once-related words
patterns.context: The English word once appears in oral dosing frequency expressions “once orally” and “once-daily,” as well as in the narrative phrase “once again.”
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and general English narrative.

2_1034.description: 强激活主要出现在多语种词干“pers”，以及英文“once”中；前者跨多种语言和文体，后者见于给药频率或“once again”。第1段未见明确对应触发。

patterns.name: perso-词干
patterns.context: 词干后续接不同词尾，组成“persoană”“perspectivas”“persistent”“persigue”“persoane”“personeelsleden”等词；不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、英语、荷兰语等多语种文本，涉及议会、医学、学术和一般叙述。

patterns.name: once 相关词
patterns.context: 出现英文词 once，分别用于口服给药频率“once orally”和“once-daily”，以及叙述“once again”。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与一般英文叙述。

en.concept: pers stem and local word-form fragments
en.description: The most stable fragment is the in-word “pers” stem, appearing across several languages in word forms related to people, perspectives, or pursuits; in the medical segment, activation also occurs at “once” and in dosage expressions. The rest consists of sporadic proper nouns or local subword fragments that are difficult to attribute to a single mechanism.

patterns.name: perso stem
patterns.context: Triggered inside words, with following characters forming pers-oană, pers-pectivas, pers-istant, pers-igue, pers-oane, and pers-oneelsleden; these are not independent complete words.
patterns.domain: Romanian, Portuguese, Spanish, English, and Dutch texts

patterns.name: once
patterns.context: Appears in dosing regimens: a single oral dose or once daily; the same segment also contains a “-” marker, but evidence comes from only two dosing contexts.

patterns.name: Name character fragments
patterns.context: Appears in the byline “NANCY ARMOUR,” where NANCY is split into multiple subword fragments; there is no clear repetition with other segments.

patterns.name: Number and hyphen formats
patterns.context: Activations occur in combinations of numbers, units, or hyphens; these markers may also be affected by subword tokenization or adjacent medical terms, so the pattern is uncertain.

patterns.name: Other locally highlighted fragments
patterns.context: Appear separately in basketball reporting, Romanian, Portuguese, and a Romanian plane-crash account; no shared word form or stable context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Sports news and multilingual parliamentary texts

2_1034.concept: pers 词干及局部词形片段
2_1034.description: 最稳定的片段是词内「pers」词干，跨多种语言出现在人物、观点或追求等相关词形中；医学段另在「once」及剂量表达处激活。其余为分散的专名或局部子词片段，难归为同一机制。

patterns.name: perso 词干
patterns.context: 在词内部触发，后续字符分别接成 pers-oană、pers-pectivas、pers-istant、pers-igue、pers-oane、pers-oneelsleden；并非独立完整词。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、英语及荷兰语文本

patterns.name: once
patterns.context: 出现在给药方案中：一次口服或每日一次；同一段还出现“-”标记，但证据只来自两个给药语境。

patterns.name: 人名字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在署名行“NANCY ARMOUR”中，NANCY 被拆成多个子词片段；与其他段无明显重复。

patterns.name: 数字与连字符格式
patterns.context: 数字、单位或连字符组合中出现激活；这些标记也可能受子词切分或相邻医学术语影响，规律不确定。

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在篮球报道、罗马尼亚语、葡萄牙语及罗马尼亚语空难叙述中；未见共同词形或稳定上下文。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻与多语种议会文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across Portland, once, in-word pers fragments across languages, and local word forms or vocabulary from clinical dosing, ventilator weaning, sports webpages, and antiques articles; these triggers do not show a stable, unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Portland
patterns.context: The place name Portland appears in sentences referring to the city where a team is based in sports coverage and to a conference location.

patterns.name: once
patterns.context: Once indicates frequency or recurrence, followed by a verb or a hyphenated frequency expression.

patterns.name: pers- stem
patterns.context: The in-word fragment pers appears inside complete words in different languages: persoana, perspectivas, persigue.

patterns.name: Medical weaning
patterns.context: Medical discussion of mechanical ventilation weaning failure, weaning time, and patient outcomes; high activation falls on an in-word fragment of persistent.

patterns.name: Specific drug dosage expressions
patterns.context: Drug trial abstracts describe dosage, route of administration, and dosing frequency.

patterns.name: Insulin trial frequency expressions
patterns.context: In clinical abstracts comparing insulin regimens, once and daily occur together to describe dosing frequency.

patterns.name: Golf and author byline
patterns.context: A sentence about Jordan follows a golf headline, along with an author byline; no clear link to other trigger fragments is apparent.

patterns.name: Antiques and household items
patterns.context: Lists antique collectibles and household items, describing objects commonly collected in the past.

2_1034.description: 激活分散于 Portland、once、跨语言 pers 词内片段，以及临床给药、撤机、体育网页和古董文章等局部词形或词汇；这些触发未显示稳定统一的语义模式。

patterns.name: Portland
patterns.context: 地名 Portland 出现在句中，分别指体育报道中的球队所在城市和会议地点。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、科技会议公告

patterns.name: once
patterns.context: once 表示频率或再次发生，后接动词或连字符构成的频率表达。

patterns.name: pers- 词干
patterns.context: 词内片段 pers 出现在不同语言中的完整词内部：persoana、perspectivas、persigue。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语文本

patterns.name: 医学 weaning
patterns.context: 围绕机械通气撤机失败、撤机时间及患者结局的医学论述；高激活落在 persistent 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 特定药物剂量表达
patterns.context: 药物试验摘要中出现剂量、给药途径和给药频率的描述。

patterns.name: 胰岛素试验频率表达
patterns.context: 比较胰岛素治疗方案的临床摘要中，once 与 daily 连用描述给药频率。
patterns.domain: PubMed 糖尿病临床研究摘要

patterns.name: 高尔夫与人名署名
patterns.context: 高尔夫标题后接关于 Jordan 的句子及作者姓名署名；未见与其他触发片段的明确关联。
patterns.domain: 体育或生活类网页文本

patterns.name: 古董与家居物品
patterns.context: 列举古董收藏品及家居用品，描述过去常见的收藏对象。

en.concept: Multilingual subword fragments and specific strings
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on word fragments beginning with pers in multilingual text; there are also strong responses to the English word once and the proper noun Portland, along with several sporadic intraword fragments. The triggers lack consistent semantic or stylistic conditions.

patterns.name: Portuguese personal stem pers
patterns.context: Activations fall on stems beginning with pers in Portuguese/Romance words; the words differ in meaning and part of speech, and the activations cross intraword token boundaries.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Portuguese, Romanian, and Spanish academic text from PhilPapers

patterns.name: once
patterns.context: The English word once appears in oral dosing frequency, an expression about accompanying someone again, and the clinical term once-daily; the trigger position is the same, but the meanings and contexts differ.

patterns.name: Portland
patterns.context: The English proper noun Portland; one instance is in a Portland Trail Blazers news item, and another refers to a conference location.

patterns.name: Other sporadic multilingual word fragments

patterns.domain: Biomedical text, multilingual EuroParl text, Spanish academic text

2_1034.concept: 多语言词片段与特定字符串
2_1034.description: 激活主要集中于多语言文本中以 pers 开头的词片段；另对英语 once、专名 Portland 有强响应，并出现若干分散的词内片段。各触发之间缺乏一致语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语人称词干 pers

patterns.name: once

patterns.name: Portland

patterns.name: 其他多语言零散词片段

en.description: Activations are scattered across Portland, once, years, medical dosages, event titles, code comments, names, and in-word fragments in multilingual parliamentary texts; no stable, unified semantic or formatting pattern emerges.

patterns.name: Place name Portland
patterns.context: Appears in English sentences as the location of a sports team or a conference; activation is concentrated on the place name itself.

patterns.name: once as a repeated-frequency adverb
patterns.context: In English prose, means “formerly/again” or “a single dose” in dosing contexts; in both examples, it is adjacent to an action or treatment description.

patterns.name: Numbers and years
patterns.context: Appears as a year in English text; another example is the year in a snooker event title.

patterns.name: Medical terms and dosage units
patterns.context: In medical contexts, involves smoking, disease treatment, patients, drug dosages, and routes of administration; the dosage unit kg also activates strongly.

patterns.name: Snooker event title
patterns.context: A year immediately follows the event name, in an encyclopedia-entry title format.

patterns.name: Split fragments in Romanian
patterns.context: In Romanian parliamentary speeches, the fragment is embedded within ordinary words (e.g., „persoană”); there are no clear semantic or syntactic trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Split fragments in Dutch
patterns.context: In Dutch parliamentary texts, the fragment occurs inside the word „personeelsleden”; the same segment also contains multiple in-word split fragments.

patterns.name: Code comment opening
patterns.context: Appears in a code comment near version information for a JavaScript graphics library; activation falls on the comment marker and following letters.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in the name Gregory Smirnov
patterns.context: Appears in an encyclopedia name heading, where the name is split into multiple subword fragments; several name fragments activate consecutively.

2_1034.description: 激活分散于 Portland、once、年份、医学剂量、赛事标题、代码注释、人名及多语议会文本中的词内片段，未呈现稳定统一的语义或格式模式。

patterns.name: 地名 Portland

patterns.name: once 的重复频率副词

patterns.name: 数字与年份

patterns.name: 医学术语与剂量单位
patterns.context: 医学语境中，涉及吸烟、疾病治疗、患者、药物剂量及给药途径；剂量单位 kg 也有较强激活。

patterns.name: 斯诺克赛事标题

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语中的切分片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会发言中，片段嵌在普通单词内部（如 „persoană”）；没有明显的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 荷兰语中的切分片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会文本中，片段出现在 „personeelsleden” 一词内部；同段还有多个词内切分片段。

patterns.name: 代码注释开头

patterns.name: 人名 Gregory Smirnov 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在百科人名标题中，姓名被拆成多个子词片段；多个姓名片段连续激活。

en.description: Activations concentrate on several local substrings: Portland, once (including once pragma and once_differentiable), Grig, ig, and jq in code comments; there is no stable, unified semantic condition across texts.

patterns.name: Portland place name
patterns.context: The complete proper noun Portland (the city in Oregon); it appears in event descriptions and sports reporting.

patterns.name: Once / single-occurrence contexts
patterns.context: The word once appears in contexts meaning “again” or “to execute once after everything is complete”; segment 7 contains the phrase “at once.”

patterns.name: once as an identifier substring
patterns.context: The code identifier once_differentiable contains once; this is not the natural-language word once.

patterns.name: once pragma in code
patterns.context: The C++ preprocessor directive #pragma once, used for header protection.

patterns.name: Name fragment Grig
patterns.context: The fragment Grig at the start of the name Gregory Smirnov; segment 10 repeats the beginning of this name.

patterns.name: Name fragment Jig
patterns.context: The character fragment jq in a code comment, in the jQPlot project header; it may be part of a specific identifier or name.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in Cigarette
patterns.context: The letter fragment ig in the word Cigarette, followed by a statement about the harms of smoking.

patterns.name: Remaining source-code markers
patterns.context: Local code fragments in header filenames, preprocessor macros, and project comments; their trigger pattern is uncertain and may relate to proper names or substrings.

2_1034.description: 激活集中在若干局部子串：Portland、once（含 once pragma 和 once_differentiable）、Grig、ig 与代码注释中的 jq；不同文本中没有稳定统一的语义条件。

patterns.name: 波特兰地名
patterns.context: 专名 Portland（俄勒冈州城市）的完整词；分别出现在活动介绍和体育报道中

patterns.name: 一次性／单次语境
patterns.context: 单词 once 出现在表示“再次”或“全部完成后执行一次”等语境中；第7段则是短语“at once”

patterns.name: once 作为标识符子串
patterns.context: 代码中的标识符 once_differentiable 内含 once；并非自然语言中的 once

patterns.name: 代码中的 once pragma

patterns.name: 姓名片段 Grig

patterns.name: 姓名片段 Jig
patterns.context: 代码注释中的字符片段 jq，位于 jQPlot 项目标头中；可能是特定标识符或名称的一部分

patterns.name: Cigarette 词内片段
patterns.context: 单词 Cigarette 内的 ig 字母片段，后接关于吸烟危害的陈述

patterns.name: 剩余源码标记
patterns.context: 头文件名、预处理宏及项目注释中的局部代码片段；其触发规律不确定，可能与专名或子串有关

en.description: Strong triggers are concentrated on Portland, C/C++ pragma once, and Height; other sporadic patterns include a public-health sentence about smoking, an Android ListView stack trace, game configuration, and test assertions, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial definite article The
patterns.context: The capitalized sentence-initial definite article The appears in English sentences or comments, but its strength and position are unstable.

patterns.name: Portland place name
patterns.context: The English place name Portland appears in team names, company names, or addresses; it is a strong trigger in all three segments.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, business email, address/search data

patterns.name: C/C++ pragma once
patterns.context: The C/C++ header-file preprocessor directive combines pragma and once; nearby code also contains include and conditional compilation directives.

patterns.name: Height string
patterns.context: Height appears in the configuration field gridHeight or the class name CGHeightDetails; nearby content concerns grid dimensions or graphics code.

patterns.name: Android ListView stack trace
patterns.context: The Java stack trace in an AndroidRuntime log includes the ListView.fillGap method and source-file line number.

patterns.name: Smoking and preventable risk
patterns.context: A public-health statement describes smoking as a preventable factor; beyond this, there is no clear shared orthographic cue.

patterns.name: Game unit configuration fields
patterns.context: JSON-like game unit configuration containing ship types and grid width and height; it overlaps with other segments only in Height.

patterns.name: Code naming and assertions
patterns.context: Assertions and comments in C++ test code; apart from occasional The/once, there is no clear consistency with other trigger patterns.

2_1034.description: 强触发集中于 Portland、C/C++ 的 pragma once，以及 Height；另有吸烟公共卫生句、Android ListView 堆栈、游戏配置和测试断言等零散模式，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 句首定冠词 The
patterns.context: 英文句子或注释中出现大写句首定冠词 The；但强度和位置不稳定。
patterns.domain: 新闻/体育叙述、代码注释

patterns.name: Portland 地名
patterns.context: 英文地名 Portland，出现在球队名称、公司名称或地址中；该词在三段里均是强触发。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、商务邮件、地址/搜索数据

patterns.name: C/C++ pragma once
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件预处理指令中，pragma 与 once 连用；相邻代码还含 include、条件编译指令。

patterns.name: Height 字符串
patterns.context: 配置字段 gridHeight 或类名 CGHeightDetails 中出现 Height；周围涉及网格尺寸或图形代码。

patterns.name: Android ListView 堆栈
patterns.context: AndroidRuntime 日志的 Java 堆栈中，ListView.fillGap 方法及源文件行号。

patterns.name: 吸烟与可预防风险

patterns.name: 游戏单位配置字段
patterns.context: 类似 JSON 的游戏单位配置，含舰船类型与网格宽高；与其他段仅部分重合于 Height。

patterns.name: 代码中的命名与断言
patterns.context: C++ 测试代码的断言和注释；除偶见 The/once 外，没有与其他触发模式明显一致的内容。

en.description: The most stable trigger pattern is `#pragma once` in C/C++ header files, which also activates on `once` in comments. Other activations are scattered across text containing Portland, address lists, health sentences, email phrasing, and JSON fields, with no evident shared semantics.

patterns.name: C/C++ header single-inclusion directive
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++ header files, usually after `#include` or at the start of a file; it can also occur next to include-guard conditional compilation structures such as `#ifndef` and `#if !defined`.

patterns.name: once in comments
patterns.context: Appears in comments requesting that an operation be performed “only ... once,” rather than in a preprocessor directive.

patterns.name: Portland place name
patterns.context: Appears as a place name in sports news sentences or emails; it also occurs in address lists.

patterns.name: Formatting signal other than once in address or postal-code lists
patterns.context: Occurs in a repeated list made up of Oregon address records and the `Exact Match` label.

patterns.name: cigarette in tobacco-health text
patterns.context: Appears as the opening word of a sentence linking smoking to its preventability.

patterns.name: Selection expressions other than once in document options and paragraph phrasing
patterns.context: Phrasing in an email discussing parts of document generation and choosing which version of a paragraph to use.

patterns.name: Grid dimensions in JSON fields
patterns.context: Appears in a list of JSON fields describing a game object, with value `16`, preceded by fields such as `gridWidth`.

2_1034.description: 最稳定的触发模式是 C/C++ 头文件中的 `#pragma once`，也会触发于注释里的 `once`。其余激活分散在含 Portland 的文本、地址列表、健康句子、邮件措辞和 JSON 字段中，未见共同语义。

patterns.name: C/C++ 头文件单次包含指令
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 头文件中，通常位于 `#include` 后或文件开头；也可与 `#ifndef`、`#if !defined` 等 include guard 条件编译结构相邻。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C/C++ 源码

patterns.name: 注释中的 once
patterns.context: 出现在要求某项操作“only ... once”的注释中，而非预处理指令。

patterns.name: Portland 地名
patterns.context: 作为地名出现在体育新闻句子或邮件中；也出现在地址列表里。

patterns.name: 地址或邮政编码列表中的 once 之外的格式信号
patterns.context: 处于多条俄勒冈州地址记录及 `Exact Match` 标签构成的重复列表中。

patterns.name: 烟草健康文本中的 cigarette
patterns.context: 作为句首词，连接 smoking 与其可预防性论述。

patterns.name: 文档选项与段落措辞中的 once 之外的选择表达

patterns.name: JSON 字段中的网格尺寸
patterns.context: 出现在描述游戏对象的 JSON 字段列表中，值为 `16`，前有 `gridWidth` 等字段。

en.description: Activation peaks often fall on short character fragments in words across languages, especially fragments such as ene, but there is no stable meaning or grammatical condition; they also occur in local fragments of lucene and the product name Get Together, which are difficult to group into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “ene” fragment at word ends/in subwords
patterns.context: Activation peaks often fall on several character fragments at the end or within Germanic or Romance words; they are not stable complete words or fixed meanings, and the precise segmentation varies by context.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, primarily EuroParl, also including parliamentary speeches, geographical descriptions, and Estonian fragments

patterns.name: lucene in a structured JSON field
patterns.context: Appears in the value "lucene" of a JSON language field, surrounded by search-query configuration.

patterns.name: Tg ether fragment in a product name

2_1034.description: 激活峰值常落在跨语言词语中的短字符片段，尤以 ene 一类片段显著，但没有稳定词义或语法条件；另在 lucene 和产品名 Get Together 的局部片段中出现，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 句末/子词中的“ene”片段
patterns.context: 高亮峰值多落在德语或罗曼语词尾/词内的若干字符片段；并非稳定的完整词或固定语义，且具体切分随上下文而变。

patterns.name: 产品名中的 Tg ether 片段
patterns.context: 出现在产品名 “Get Together” 中，处于标题或宣传语开头。

en.description: The most salient pattern is the ene substring appearing within words across languages and genres: it recurs in the Italian word viene and also occurs in code, Turkish, and English words. Other activations are scattered across Italian passages and are difficult to group into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: vene in Italian verb inflections
patterns.context: Activation falls on the substring ene in Italian verb forms, especially viene; in segment 4 the word form is split, with punctuation immediately following.
patterns.domain: Italian legal text, philosophical discussion, and forum text

patterns.name: Non-Italian word-final ene

patterns.name: Other unmarked activations
patterns.context: In segment 1, ene is highlighted in lucene; segments 2 and 10 contain strong activations scattered across various Italian word fragments, lacking a clear local trigger consistent with viene.
patterns.domain: JSON configuration, Italian European Parliament text

2_1034.description: 最醒目的是跨语言、跨文体出现在词内的 ene 子串：意大利语 viene 中反复出现，也见于代码、土耳其语和英文词；另有意大利语段落中的其他分散激活，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 意大利语动词变位中的 vene
patterns.trigger: «vi«ene»10»、«ven«e»10»；可见完整形式包括 «viene»（段 6、8）、«viene» 的分词/变位语境 «vi«ene»10,»（段 4），以及段 2 的 «ottenere» 不属于该触发
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语动词形式中的子串 ene，尤其是 viene；段 4 中词形被切分且标点紧随其后

patterns.name: 非意大利语词尾 ene

patterns.name: 未标记的其余激活

patterns.context: 段 1 的 lucene 中 ene 被标出；段 2、10 则有强激活分散在多种意大利语词片段上，缺少与 viene 一致的明确局部触发

en.description: The most prominent repeated cue is the English word gay (in literary, sexual-orientation, or identity contexts); other activations are scattered across code, mathematics, Slovenian policy text, and email lists, with no obvious shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: The word gay
patterns.context: The English word gay appears directly; it is used to describe a person's identity, discuss the sexual orientation of a fictional character, describe a parade or scene, and also appears in poetry.

patterns.name: C# property and SQL Server generation strategy
patterns.context: C# code annotates entity properties with a SQL Server value generation strategy (IdentityColumn).

patterns.name: Structured field declarations in code
patterns.context: A C/C++-like struct field list contains field names, array lengths, and integer types; other code snippets involve objects or buffer-related calls.

patterns.name: Buffer copying and setting in code
patterns.context: The processedCopy object is used to set buffer space or usage, with positional arguments such as Top and Bottom.

patterns.name: Matrix and composition terminology

patterns.name: Slovenian innovation-policy phrase

patterns.name: Email addresses and domain list

2_1034.description: 最突出的重复线索是英文 gay（文学、性取向或身份语境）；其余激活分散在代码、数学、斯洛文尼亚语政策文本和邮箱列表中，缺少共同的明显触发模式。

patterns.name: gay 一词

patterns.name: C# 属性与 SQL Server 生成策略

patterns.name: 代码中的结构化字段声明
patterns.context: 类似 C/C++ 的结构体字段列表中出现字段名、数组长度和整数类型；其他代码片段则是对象或缓冲区相关调用。

patterns.name: 代码中的缓冲区复制与设置

en.description: Activations occur in code identifiers, configuration key-value pairs, UI code, build conditions, paper terminology, and email headers. Their commonality is weak; they mainly favor split proper nouns, field names, and technical tokens in structured text.

patterns.name: Internal tokens in code identifiers and camel case
patterns.context: In program code, configuration, or API names, identifiers are split into multiple tokens; activation often falls on the middle or end of these tokens rather than ordinary grammatical words.
patterns.domain: Software code, API documentation, and configuration

patterns.name: Attribute keys and structured configuration values
patterns.context: In key-value pairs, arrays, or JSON-like structures, activation is concentrated on fragments of field names, Boolean values, or configuration options.

patterns.name: Mathematical paper terminology and cited author names
patterns.context: Author surnames, mathematical/physical terms, and their derived forms appear in paper prose and citations.

patterns.name: Email addresses, organization names, and recipient lists
patterns.context: In email headers, multiple recipients are separated by commas and line breaks; addresses include organization or department names.

patterns.name: UI button text and event-handling code
patterns.context: In HTML/JSX form interfaces, button labels, click handlers, and user-facing action text occur together.

patterns.name: SQL mapping and attribute configuration
patterns.context: An entity attribute configuration chain defines column types, computed-column SQL, and generation timing.

patterns.name: Specific build configuration markers
patterns.context: In XML project files, conditional expressions match build configurations and platforms such as debug/static.

2_1034.concept: 结构化文本中的技术词元
2_1034.description: 激活分布于代码标识符、配置键值、UI 代码、构建条件、论文术语及邮件头。共同点较弱，主要偏向结构化文本中被拆分的专名、字段名和技术词元。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与驼峰命名中的内部词元
patterns.context: 在程序代码、配置或 API 名称中，标识符被拆成多个词元；激活常落在这些词元的中后部，而非普通语法词。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、API 文档与配置

patterns.name: 属性键与结构化配置值
patterns.context: 键值对、数组或 JSON 式结构中，激活集中在字段名、布尔值或配置选项的词元片段。

patterns.name: 数学论文术语及引文作者名
patterns.context: 论文行文和引用中出现作者姓氏、数学/物理术语及其派生形式。

patterns.name: 邮件地址、组织名与收件人列表
patterns.context: 邮件头部中，多个收件人以逗号和换行分隔，地址包含组织或部门名称。

patterns.name: 界面按钮文本及事件处理代码
patterns.context: HTML/JSX 表单界面中，按钮标签、点击处理器与面向用户的操作文本相邻。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的前端代码示例

patterns.name: SQL 映射与属性配置
patterns.context: 实体属性配置链中，定义列类型、计算列 SQL 与生成时机。

patterns.name: 特定构建配置标记
patterns.context: XML 项目文件中，以条件表达式匹配 debug/static 等构建配置和平台。
patterns.domain: Github 中的构建配置 XML

en.description: Activations often fall on internal morphemes, word endings, and segmentation boundaries in longer words or code identifiers, especially CamelCase names, types, and APIs in source code. They also occur in inflected German words and a few proper names and CSS selectors. There is no evidence that the feature encodes only one semantic topic.

patterns.name: Word endings/morpheme boundaries within identifiers
patterns.context: Activations often fall on final morphemes within longer identifiers or words. In code these include tokenized Spine, Subroutine, Expired, Suite, and Rotate; in text they also occur in werden, Fragen, and Frieden. The trigger is not limited to one fixed suffix.

patterns.name: Types, APIs, and structured names in code
patterns.context: In CamelCase or segmented identifiers such as class names, method signatures, API names, XML configuration, and member names, activations are distributed across name components or their endings; these fragments alone do not identify a fixed semantic category.

patterns.name: Word forms in German text
patterns.context: Appears in German sentences involving verb forms and plural or inflected nouns; activation is concentrated in part of a word rather than in a single identifiable German semantic topic.

patterns.name: Biochemical enzyme name
patterns.context: Activation falls on a proper-name/compound fragment in a PubMed abstract; this example is insufficient to infer a general biochemical topic.

patterns.name: Karma testing-related identifiers
patterns.context: In code accessing Karma test results, activation highlights Karma and related name fragments; this may be a specific instance of the internal-morpheme pattern in identifiers.

patterns.name: CSS menu selectors and styles
patterns.context: In CSS selectors and style rules, activation falls on fragments of selectors such as menu/menu-tab; this is a singleton and does not appear in other segments.

2_1034.concept: 词素片段与标识符边界
2_1034.description: 激活多落在较长词或代码标识符的内部词素、词尾及分段边界，尤其常见于源码中的 CamelCase 名称、类型和 API；也出现于德语屈折词与少数专名、CSS 选择器。没有证据表明它只编码某个语义主题。

patterns.name: 标识符内部的词尾/词素边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在较长标识符或单词内部的末尾词素上；程序代码中包括被拆分标记的 Spine、Subroutine、Expired、Suite、Rotate，文本中也见于 werden、Fragen、Frieden。触发并非只限某一个固定词尾。
patterns.domain: 代码标识符与自然语言文本

patterns.name: 代码中的类型、API 与结构化名称
patterns.context: 在类名、方法签名、API 名称、XML 配置和成员名等 CamelCase 或分词标识符中，激活分布在名称的组成部分或其词尾；仅凭这些片段无法确定固定的语义类别。

patterns.name: 德国文本中的词形
patterns.context: 出现在德语句子中，涉及动词形式与名词复数或屈折词形；激活集中于词的一部分，而非可确认的单一德语语义主题。

patterns.name: 生化酶名称
patterns.context: 激活落在 PubMed 摘要中的专名/化合物名称片段；该例不足以推断一般生化主题。

patterns.name: Karma 测试相关标识符
patterns.context: 在访问 Karma 测试结果的代码中，激活突出 Karma 及相关名称片段；可能是标识符内部词素模式的具体实例。

patterns.name: CSS 菜单选择器与样式
patterns.context: CSS 选择器和样式规则中，激活落在 menu/menu-tab 一类选择器名称的片段；单例且未见于其他段。

en.description: Activations are mainly scattered in-word fragments, especially ine/Sine/Se-en; there are also isolated responses to specific code identifiers, Slovenian inflected words, German honorifics, and Italian bibliographic proper nouns, with no unified semantics or domain.

patterns.name: ine substring inside English tokens
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in parts of English words or proper nouns containing the adjacent fragments ine/ine; capitalization varies, and surrounding context and word meaning are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Code, web text, music entries, encyclopedia articles

patterns.name: MSBuild XML test target
patterns.context: Target/Condition configuration in XML project files; triggers are concentrated on target names such as TestSuited and surrounding tags and build configurations.

patterns.name: Karma score code
patterns.context: Karma-related DOM element IDs or variable names recur in jQuery selectors and append calls.

patterns.name: Slovenian inflected words
patterns.context: In continuous Slovenian sentences, activation falls on word stems or suffix fragments split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Scheler bibliography and publication information
patterns.context: Proper nouns such as Italian book titles, authors, publishers, and places of publication appear in book records; there is no notable shared English word form.

patterns.name: Honorifics and religious figure names
patterns.context: A German sentence introduces Satguru Baba Ji, with an honorific and its possessive form; the word-form connection to other activation fragments is unclear.

2_1034.description: 激活以分散的词内片段为主，尤见 ine/Sine/Se-en；另对特定代码标识符、斯洛文尼亚语屈折词、德语尊称及意大利语书目专名有孤立响应，缺少统一语义或领域。

patterns.name: 英文 token 内部的 ine 子串
patterns.context: 激活集中在英语单词或专名中含有 ine/ine 相邻片段的部分；大小写可变，周围上下文和词义不固定。
patterns.domain: 代码、网页文本、音乐条目、百科词条

patterns.name: MSBuild XML 测试目标
patterns.context: XML 项目文件中的 Target/Condition 配置；触发集中在 TestSuited 一类目标名及其周边标签、构建配置。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 XML/MSBuild 配置代码

patterns.name: Karma 分数代码
patterns.context: jQuery 选择器和 append 调用中，Karma 相关 DOM 元素 ID 或变量名反复出现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 JavaScript 代码

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语屈折词
patterns.context: 连续的斯洛文尼亚语句子中，激活落在被分词拆开的词干或词尾片段上。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: Scheler 书目与出版信息
patterns.context: 书籍题录中的意大利语书名、作者、出版社与出版地等专名；没有显著的共同英语词形。

patterns.name: 尊称与宗教人物姓名
patterns.context: 德语句子介绍 Satguru Baba Ji，尊称及其所有格形式出现；与其他激活片段的词形联系不明显。

en.description: Activations fall mainly on short subword fragments inside words across languages and domains, especially around “en/ine/ene”; similar fragments also occur in code identifiers. Other local formatting patterns include XML configuration and song lists, with no unified semantic topic.

patterns.name: “ene” syllable/subword fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on short subword fragments across word boundaries or within words; the specific word meanings vary widely.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: English, German, Dutch, Slovenian, code, and patent text

patterns.name: Identifier suffix fragments in code
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++ or similar code identifiers, attribute assignments, and near header files/namespaces; it co-occurs with code formatting and CamelCase naming.

patterns.name: XML/MSBuild test target tags
patterns.context: Test targets and configuration conditions in MSBuild XML, including debug/static/platform attributes.

patterns.name: Album or song title lists
patterns.context: A newline-separated list of musical work titles; activations fall on fragments within the titles.

patterns.name: Romanian-related word forms in parliamentary text
patterns.context: A European Parliament sentence contains word forms such as a country name, delegation, or honorific; activation lies on intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Slovenian
