patterns.context: Activations are distributed within consecutive Slovenian words in a sentence about transportation and its consequences.

patterns.name: Name/greeting-like fragments in email
patterns.context: An ordinary email exchange asks whether someone has been seen recently; activation is limited to intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Fragment in a mythological figure’s name
patterns.context: The title and opening description of an encyclopedia entry give an alternate name for the moon goddess.

2_1034.description: 激活主要落在跨语言、跨领域词语内部的短子词片段，尤其是“en/ine/ene”一带；代码标识符中也出现类似片段。另有 XML 配置、歌曲列表等局部格式模式，缺少统一语义主题。

patterns.name: “ene”音节/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词边界或词内部的短子词片段；具体词义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：英语、德语、荷兰语、斯洛文尼亚语、代码及专利文本

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符尾部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 或类似代码的标识符、属性赋值和头文件/命名空间附近；与代码格式及驼峰式命名共现。

patterns.name: XML/MSBuild 测试目标标签
patterns.context: MSBuild XML 中测试目标及配置条件，包含 debug/static/平台等属性。

patterns.name: 专辑或歌曲标题列表
patterns.trigger: «↵»后的歌曲名片段，如“«I»«'ve»« Se»«en»« All»« Good»« People»”，以及“«Make»« It» Easy”
patterns.context: 换行分隔的音乐作品标题列表；激活落在标题中的词片段。

patterns.name: 议会文本中的罗马尼亚相关词形
patterns.context: 欧洲议会语句中出现国家名、代表团或敬称等词形；激活位于词内部片段。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在连续的斯洛文尼亚语词语内部，句子谈及交通及其后果。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 邮件中的人名/问候式片段
patterns.context: 普通邮件对话中询问是否最近见过某人；激活仅体现为词内片段。

patterns.name: 神话人物名中的片段
patterns.context: 百科条目标题及开头介绍月神的别名。

en.description: Activations span code, lists, parliamentary sentences, and web text, often falling on short in-word substrings (especially en/word-final fragments), but trigger positions and semantics vary widely; code also shows activations on proper nouns, identifiers, and formatting structures.

patterns.name: “en” substring
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter sequence en across words; it may depend on capitalization, token boundaries, and following letters, and occurs in varied contexts.
patterns.domain: English technical texts, Dutch and German parliamentary texts, Portuguese department descriptions

patterns.name: Automated testing XML fragment
patterns.context: TestSuite items and TargetName recur in MSBuild/XML configuration; high activation is concentrated on the split ending of “Suite”.

patterns.name: Worksop word form
patterns.context: Activation falls mainly on the substring hop in Worksop; it is followed by “on microbial growth control”.

patterns.name: FusionDaleMessenger identifier
patterns.context: The same long identifier and variants recur, combining natural-language fragments with CMake/code identifiers; activation is especially strong at the end of Messenger.

patterns.name: Track title list
patterns.context: In a Yes album/track list, activation falls on Seen in “I've Seen All Good People”; surrounding entries are newline-separated titles.

patterns.name: KarmaGive/KarmaTake code identifiers
patterns.context: jQuery code repeatedly accesses KarmaGiveScore and KarmaTakeScore elements and attributes.

patterns.name: Dutch inflectional endings
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across en/related word-form fragments inside Dutch words, appearing in sentences rather than proper nouns or code.

patterns.name: In-word German fragments
patterns.context: Multiple in-word fragments activate in German formal address and parliamentary narration, especially the repeated phrase Seine Heiligkeit.

patterns.name: Teens forms in pornographic text
patterns.context: Teen/Teens-related forms recur in adult pornographic descriptions and category tags.

patterns.name: Portuguese endings in names and institutional fields
patterns.context: Form-style fields in a Portuguese department description; fragments inside multiple ordinary words and names activate.

2_1034.description: 激活横跨代码、列表、议会语句与网页文本，常落在词内短子串（尤见 en/词尾片段），但触发位置与语义差异很大；代码中也出现专名、标识符及格式结构激活。

patterns.name: “en”子串
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词内的字母序列 en 上；可能受大小写、分词边界及后续字母影响，包含多种语境。
patterns.domain: 英语技术文本、荷兰语与德语议会文本、葡萄牙语院系介绍

patterns.name: 自动化测试 XML 片段
patterns.context: MSBuild/XML 配置中重复出现 TestSuite 项与 TargetName；高激活集中在被拆分的“Suite”结尾。

patterns.name: Worksop 词形
patterns.context: 激活主要落在拼作 Worksop 的子串 hop；后接“on microbial growth control”。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 科技或生物技术文本

patterns.name: FusionDaleMessenger 标识符
patterns.context: 同一长标识符及其变体重复出现，混合自然语言残片与 CMake/代码标识符；激活尤其落在 Messenger 末尾。

patterns.name: 曲目标题列表
patterns.context: Yes 专辑/曲目列表中，激活落在“I've Seen All Good People”里的 Seen；周围是换行分隔的标题。

patterns.name: KarmaGive/KarmaTake 代码标识符
patterns.context: jQuery 代码中重复访问 KarmaGiveScore 与 KarmaTakeScore 元素及属性。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词尾变化
patterns.context: 激活分布于荷兰语词内部的 en/相关词形片段，出现在句子中而非专名或代码中。

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 德语正式称谓与议会叙述中，多个词内部片段激活，尤其是重复出现的 Seine Heiligkeit。

patterns.name: 色情文本中的 teens 词形
patterns.context: 成人色情描述及分类标签中，teen/Teens 相关词形重复出现。

patterns.name: 姓名与机构字段中的葡语词尾
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语院系简介的表单式字段；多个普通词及人名内部片段均有激活。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on tokenized teen/teens/teenagers forms and also broadly hit local subword fragments in ordinary words and code identifiers; across topics, languages, and styles, no stable semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: teen/teenagers forms
patterns.context: When forms such as teen, teens, and teenagers appear, especially when split into multiple subword tokens; includes plural, possessive, and capitalization variants.
patterns.domain: News, medical abstracts, adult websites, and other text

patterns.name: en subword in split words
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments in common words, with no requirement for semantic or syntactic similarity; the word may be a variable name, foreign-language text, or ordinary English.
patterns.domain: Code, Swedish parliamentary text, Spanish strings, and headings

patterns.name: Fragments in names or identifiers
patterns.context: Mixed-case identifiers such as code class names, macros/variable names, and test targets; may co-occur with activations on ordinary word forms.

2_1034.description: 激活主要落在被分词拆开的 teen/teens/teenagers 词形上，也广泛命中普通词和代码标识符中的局部子词片段；跨主题、跨语种及多种文体，未见稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: teen/teenagers 词形
patterns.context: 出现 teen、teens、teenagers 等词形时，尤其是词被拆成多个子词 token；涵盖复数、所有格及大小写变化。
patterns.domain: 新闻、医学摘要、成人网页及其他文本

patterns.name: 拆分词中 en 子词
patterns.trigger: «de»、«it»、«and»、«art»、«line»、«hop» 等词内部或词尾被标记的子词
patterns.context: 激活落在常见词的子词片段上，不要求语义或句法相似；词本身可属于变量名、外语文本或普通英文。
patterns.domain: 代码、瑞典语议会文本、西班牙语字符串及标题

patterns.name: 名称或标识符中的碎片
patterns.trigger: «Messenger»、«Commands»、«Factory» 等拆分的标识符片段，以及 «Su»«ited»
patterns.context: 代码中的类名、宏/变量名、测试目标等混合大小写标识符；可能与普通词形激活并存。

en.description: Activations often fall on the en/ens letter sequences in English words: they occur in teen/teens/teenagers and Queens, as well as code identifiers, query parameters, and academic vocabulary. Across corpora, meanings are not consistent, suggesting a local character or subword feature.

patterns.name: English plural suffix -ens
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in words such as teen/teens/teenagers and Queens; it occurs across word forms and capitalization patterns, primarily on the in-word en/ens letter fragments rather than a stable complete-word meaning.
patterns.domain: Various styles including pornographic text, medical abstracts, music titles, and encyclopedia categories

patterns.name: Plural word endings in code identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in code, XML tags, or identifiers containing plural nouns or similar word-final fragments; activation sometimes falls inside the stem rather than on the plural ending.
patterns.domain: Github source code and configuration text

patterns.name: In-word en/ens letter sequences in English
patterns.context: In query parameters and academic text, activation fragments are embedded in longer words; their similarity to the teens/Queens pattern is limited to the letter sequence.

2_1034.concept: 英语 en/ens 子词片段
2_1034.description: 激活多落在英语词中的 en/ens 字母序列：见于 teen/teens/teenagers、Queens，也见于代码标识符、查询参数和学术词汇。跨语料而词义不统一，像是局部字母或子词特征。

patterns.name: 英语复数后缀 -ens
patterns.context: 激活集中在 teen/teens/teenagers、Queens 等词中；跨词形和大小写出现，触发位置主要是词内的 en/ens 字母片段，并非稳定的完整词义。
patterns.domain: 色情文本、医学摘要、音乐标题、百科分类等多种文体

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的复数词尾
patterns.context: 出现在代码、XML 标签或标识符中，包含复数名词或类似的词尾片段；激活有时落在词干内部，不总是落在复数词尾。

patterns.name: 英语词内部的 en/ens 字母序列
patterns.context: 在查询参数及学术文本中，激活片段嵌在较长词内；与 teens/Queens 的模式仅有字母序列层面的相似。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 查询字符串、数学论文

en.description: Activations primarily fall on intra-word subword fragments resembling en/ten in multilingual text and proper names, often coinciding with subword segmentation or word-form boundaries; semantic, syntactic, and stylistic contexts vary widely, with no stable function apparent.

patterns.name: English -en/-ent morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments corresponding to the letter sequence en in English words; meanings and grammatical contexts vary. In some examples, the fragment coincides with a word ending or stem boundary.
patterns.domain: English text in code/XML, webpage titles, medical abstracts, lists, and other sources

patterns.name: Intra-word letter fragments in European languages
patterns.context: Activations occur inside words in Lithuanian, Swedish, Hungarian, and other languages, often coinciding with inflection or subword segmentation; there is no consistent lexical or syntactic function.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activations occur inside the spellings of personal names, club names, or place names, especially proper names split into multiple subword tokens; not every entire proper name is marked.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia lists, place names, and entity articles

2_1034.description: 激活主要落在多语种文本和专名中形似 en/ten 等的词内子词片段，常与子词切分或词形边界重合；所处语义、语法及文体差异很大，未见稳定功能。

patterns.name: 英文 -en/-ent 形态片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词中 en 字母序列对应的子词片段上；词义和语法环境各异。部分实例中该片段与词尾或词干边界重合。
patterns.domain: 代码/XML、网页标题、医学摘要、名单等英文文本

patterns.name: 欧洲语言词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在立陶宛语、瑞典语、匈牙利语等词的内部，常与词形变化或子词切分重合；没有一致的词义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 专名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在人名、俱乐部名或地名的拼写内部，尤其是拆分成多个子词 token 的专名；并非专名整体都被标记。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 名单、地名与实体条目

en.description: All fragments occur in tokens containing the letter sequence en, such as Mendocino, Guénée, Koenraad, Roemenië, AlexExtreme, WebView, computer, menu, and Teens. Activation appears related to this substring rather than a unified semantic theme or style.

patterns.name: en in strings
patterns.context: In vocabulary from other languages, proper nouns, category labels, chat text, or HTML/CSS strings, the character sequence en is tokenized into marked tokens; it need not form an independent English word.

2_1034.description: 所有片段都出现包含字母序列 en 的标记：如 Mendocino、Guénée、Koenraad、Roemenië、AlexExtreme、WebView、computer、menu、Teens。激活似乎与该子串有关，而非统一语义或文体。

patterns.name: 字符串中的 en
patterns.context: 在其他语言词汇、专名、分类标签、聊天文本或 HTML/CSS 字符串中，字符序列 en 被切分成标记 token；不要求它构成独立英文单词。

en.description: Activations are broadly distributed across words and proper names in multiple languages, often around the letter sequence en (e.g., Koenraad, Roemenië, Guénée, Seen, ontvangen), and also appear in list text; some marked spans do not clearly correspond to this sequence.

patterns.name: Dutch committee-member name fragment
patterns.context: Activations concentrate near the Dutch letter sequence “en”; the name Koenraad Dillen appears in the same form in two passages, while passage 9 also contains the common word geen.
patterns.domain: European Parliament records; passages 4 and 5 contain the same letter sequence in English content

patterns.name: Intra-word en letter sequence
patterns.context: Activations fall on the letter sequence en inside words in several European languages, including proper names, place names, and word endings or medial positions; no particular semantics are required.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary text and English encyclopedia and music lists

patterns.name: Hungarian word-final en
patterns.context: Passages 6 and 7 are in Hungarian; prominent activations occur on en in “együttesen,” possibly related to the same letter sequence in Hungarian word forms.
patterns.domain: Hungarian text from the European Parliament

patterns.name: en in lists and proper names
patterns.context: Activations also appear in English list text, including category labels, place names, and song titles, suggesting that triggering does not depend on connected prose or parliamentary context.

patterns.name: Local activations without consistent substring evidence
patterns.context: Several activation sites do not clearly correspond to en, or the marked spans fall on other parts of words; these short excerpts alone do not establish whether the same letter sequence triggers them.

2_1034.concept: 多语种 en 字母序列
2_1034.description: 激活广泛分布于多语种词语及专名中，常见 en 字母序列（如 Koenraad、Roemenië、Guénée、Seen、ontvangen），也出现在列表文本；部分标记与该序列对应不明确。

patterns.name: 荷兰语委员姓名片段
patterns.trigger: 荷兰语片段中的「Ko«en»raad Dill«en»」；另有「Ge«en» bezwaren」
patterns.context: 激活集中在荷兰语字母序列「en」附近；姓名 Koenraad Dillen 在两段中以相同形式出现，而第9段也有普通词 geen。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录；第4、5段则是在英文内容中出现相同字母序列

patterns.name: 词内 en 字母序列
patterns.context: 激活落在多个欧洲语言词语内部的 en 字母序列上，包括专名、地名、词尾或词中；并不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本及英文百科、音乐列表

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词尾 en
patterns.context: 第6、7段为匈牙利语；显著激活出现在「együttesen」的 en，可能与该语言词形中的相同字母序列有关。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会匈牙利语文本

patterns.name: 列表与专名中的 en
patterns.context: 在类别标签、地名及歌曲名等英文列表文本中也出现激活，提示触发不依赖连贯句子或议会语境。

patterns.name: 缺乏一致子串证据的局部激活
patterns.context: 若干激活处与 en 的对应不够明确，或标记落在词的其他部分；仅凭这些短片段无法确定是否由同一字母序列触发。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual parliamentary texts, code, encyclopedias, Q&A, and advertisements, mainly falling on in-word substrings, word endings, proper nouns, or identifier fragments; there is no stable cross-segment semantic theme.

patterns.name: Polish word endings and in-word fragments
patterns.context: In Polish body text or titles, activation falls on split word fragments; these often occur in expressions related to EU legislation and voting.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Central European and Baltic languages
patterns.context: In Slovak or Lithuanian body text and near names, activation occurs on in-word substrings, with no single stable meaning apparent.

patterns.name: Dutch body text and proper noun endings
patterns.context: In Dutch sentences, word endings or in-word fragments activate; the passage discusses sugar imports from third countries into Bulgaria and Romania.

patterns.name: Java package names and identifier fragments
patterns.context: In code or license files, activation falls inside recurring package paths and identifiers.
patterns.domain: Github, Java code and license text

patterns.name: English category labels and name endings
patterns.context: In encyclopedia category lists, titles, or names, activation occurs on substrings of proper nouns or labels.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia (en), category lists and ancient Roman family name articles

patterns.name: Russian in-word fragments
patterns.context: In Russian Q&A text, activation occurs on in-word fragments; the context involves mailing, signing, or decrypting text.

patterns.name: Product names in imitation drug advertisements
patterns.context: English spam-like text discusses buying drugs, over-the-counter medicines, and promotions; activation is concentrated on recurring fragments of apparent product names.

2_1034.description: 激活分散在多语种议会文本、代码、百科、问答和广告中，主要落于词内子串、词尾、专名或标识符片段；没有跨段稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 波兰语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语正文或标题中，激活落在被切分的词语片段上；片段常处于欧盟立法、投票相关表达中。

patterns.name: 中东欧及波罗的海语言词内片段
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语或立陶宛语正文、姓名附近；激活出现在词内子串，未显示单一稳定词义。

patterns.name: 荷兰语正文与专名词尾
patterns.context: 荷兰语句子中，词尾或词内片段被激活；段落谈及从第三国向保加利亚和罗马尼亚进口蔗糖。

patterns.name: Java 包名及标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码或许可文件中，激活落在反复出现的包名路径及标识符内部。
patterns.domain: Github，Java 代码与许可证文本

patterns.name: 英文分类标签与人名词尾
patterns.context: 百科条目的分类列表或标题、人名中，激活出现在专名或标签词的子串上。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia (en)，分类与古罗马家族名条目

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 俄语问答文本中，激活出现在词内片段；上下文涉及寄信、签名或解密文字。

patterns.name: 仿药品广告中的产品名
patterns.context: 英文垃圾广告式文本以购买药品、非处方药和促销为话题；激活集中在重复出现的疑似产品名片段。

en.description: Activations mostly occur on intra-word fragments, word endings, or compound identifiers in different languages. Clear local patterns include Dutch word endings, code directory/frequency variables, and name fragments such as Suen and Guénée, but the passages share no uniform lexical or semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Dutch word endings and segmentation boundaries
patterns.context: In continuous Dutch text, activations fall near suffixes, word endings, or word boundaries; -en is common, but other intra-word fragments also occur.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment in Dutch
patterns.context: In commercial or pharmaceutical advertising text, the brand/drug name Somine is followed by x or pills.

patterns.name: Path and directory identifier DIR
patterns.context: A script uses a directory variable to locate the project directory and change paths; activations are scattered around identifiers and commands.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Italian
patterns.context: In Italian prose, activations occur inside or at the ends of different words; no single stable root is apparent.

patterns.name: Suen in a personal name
patterns.context: A legal judgment cites a party's name, with Suen forming part of the surname.

patterns.name: The lunar deity Suen
patterns.context: An encyclopedia article introduces the Mesopotamian deity Nanna/Suen/Sin.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Polish
patterns.context: In Polish parliamentary text, activations are distributed across intra-word fragments in multiple words, with no consistent lexical or affix pattern.

patterns.name: French surname ending
patterns.context: A category entry names the taxonomist Achille Guénée; the activation falls inside the surname.

patterns.name: Frequency variable identifier
patterns.context: A shell script repeatedly uses variable names containing freq, adjacent to performance/frequency calculations.

2_1034.description: 激活多出现在不同语言的词内片段、词尾或复合标识符中；明确局部模式包括荷兰语词尾、代码目录/频率变量及 Suen、Guénée 等专名片段，但各段无统一词汇或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词尾与分词边界
patterns.trigger: “«en»”“«en»9”“«he»”“«lijk»”“«lijk»”等位于荷兰语词内或词尾的片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语连续文本中，激活落在词的后缀、词尾或词边界附近；常见 -en，但也包括其他词内片段

patterns.name: 荷兰语中的药名片段
patterns.context: 商品或药品广告文本中，品牌/药名 Somine 后接 x 或 pills

patterns.name: 路径与目录标识符 DIR
patterns.trigger: “«Dir»”“«DIR»”，以及“«EN»”出现在 MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR 标识符中
patterns.context: 脚本通过目录变量定位项目目录并切换路径，激活散布于标识符和命令附近

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 意大利语散文中，激活出现在不同词的词内或词尾；未见单一稳定词根
patterns.domain: 哲学/学术意大利语文本

patterns.name: 人名中的 Suen
patterns.context: 法律判决引述案件当事人姓名，Suen 为姓氏的一部分

patterns.name: 月神名 Suen
patterns.context: 介绍美索不达米亚神祇 Nanna/Suen/Sin 的百科条目

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语议会文本中，激活分布在多个词的词内片段，未形成一致的词汇或词缀模式

patterns.name: 法语姓氏词尾
patterns.context: 分类条目中出现分类群命名者 Achille Guénée，激活在姓氏内部

patterns.name: 频率变量标识符
patterns.context: shell 脚本中反复出现包含 freq 的变量名，并与性能/频率计算相邻

en.concept: Multilingual in-word fragments and local code patterns
en.description: Activations occur mainly on short in-word fragments in multilingual European parliamentary texts; a few occur in the product name SomineX, JavaScript DOM identifiers, code newline characters, and PHP email library code.

patterns.name: Multilingual European parliamentary text
patterns.context: Appears in continuous, formal European parliamentary speeches or policy discussions involving trade, fisheries, political initiatives, negotiations, and other topics. Activation falls on in-word fragments in words from multiple European languages, not on a fixed word or single language.
patterns.domain: EuroParl; formal parliamentary texts in Dutch, Lithuanian, Swedish, Italian, Polish, and other languages

patterns.name: String fragment in a product name
patterns.context: Appears in the brand/product name “SomineX” in English product promotions or search-like text, surrounded by mentions of medication, purchasing, or discounts.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC; e-commerce or advertising-style web text

patterns.name: Identifier fragment in JavaScript DOM code
patterns.context: Appears in JavaScript examples that manipulate webpage elements, add event listeners, or read DOM attributes; activation is distributed across identifier fragments, method names, and code formatting.

patterns.name: Code newline and carriage return markers
patterns.context: Appears near multiline source code or code block boundaries; it recurs in code examples but also occurs in other segments, and does not appear to be an independent cross-domain semantic trigger.

patterns.name: PHP dependency and library name fragments
patterns.context: Appears in PHP comments and code that uses require_once to include a mail MIME parsing library file.

2_1034.concept: 多语种词内片段与代码局部模式
2_1034.description: 主要激活于多语种欧洲议会文本中词内的短片段；少数激活出现在商品名 SomineX、JavaScript DOM 标识符、代码换行符及 PHP 邮件库代码中。

patterns.name: 多语种欧洲议会正文
patterns.trigger: 如 «omen», «ent», «en», «er», «i», «u», «in», «ia», «it», «ione», «ist», «anie» 等被标记的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在连续、正式的欧洲议会发言或政策讨论中；涉及贸易、渔业、政治倡议、协商等主题。激活落在多种欧洲语言单词的内部片段，并非固定词或单一语言。
patterns.domain: EuroParl；荷兰语、立陶宛语、瑞典语、意大利语、波兰语等正式议会文本

patterns.name: 商品名中的字符串片段
patterns.context: 出现在英语商品宣传或搜索式文本中的品牌/商品名称“SomineX”，周围提及药品、购买或优惠。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC；电商或广告式网页文本

patterns.name: JavaScript DOM 代码中的标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在操作网页元素、添加事件监听器或读取 DOM 属性的 JavaScript 示例中；激活分布在标识符片段、方法名和代码排版处。

patterns.name: 代码换行与回车标记
patterns.context: 出现在多行源代码或代码块边界附近；在代码示例中反复出现，但也见于其他片段，未显示为跨领域的独立语义触发因素。

patterns.name: PHP 依赖与库名片段
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP 注释及 require_once 引入邮件 MIME 解析库文件的代码中。

en.description: Overall, activations favor multilingual intra-word substrings rather than stable meanings, often in inflected words, institutional terms, and proper names in formal European parliamentary text; repeated fragments also occur in drug/product names and code identifiers.

patterns.name: Frequent suffixes or morphemes at intra-word segmentation points in EU/political text
patterns.context: Across multiple languages in EU parliamentary corpora, activations fall inside segmented whole words, often on inflectional endings, derivational parts, or stem fragments; no single suffix is consistent.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European parliamentary debates, policy, and political text

patterns.name: Parliamentary procedure and member titles
patterns.context: Occurs in speeches by members, parliamentary procedure, or formal institutional titles; activations are distributed across fragments within parliament-related words.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in proper names or place names
patterns.context: Triggering fragments are embedded in proper names such as countries, cities, or personal names; not all proper names activate in the same way.
patterns.domain: Countries, locations, and personal names in parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Internal segmentation in drug/product words
patterns.context: Activations fall within apparent drug/product names, surrounded by text about purchasing, over-the-counter drugs, pills, and promotional copy.
patterns.domain: Web commercial advertisements and pharmaceutical sales text

patterns.name: Code package-name and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur inside dot-separated identifiers such as Java package and class names, recurring across adjacent identifiers.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Latvian political words
patterns.context: In formal historical or institutional narratives, activations fall on internal fragments of inflected Latvian words.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Slovenian institutional terms
patterns.context: In contexts involving reform, reports, and committees, activations fall on stem or ending fragments.

2_1034.description: 激活总体偏向多语种词内子串而非稳定词义，常见于欧洲议会正式文本中的屈折词、机构词及专名；另见药品商品名和代码标识符中的重复片段。

patterns.name: 词内切分处的欧盟/政治文本高频后缀或词素
patterns.context: 多种欧盟议会语料语言中，激活落在被切分的完整词内部，常见于屈折词尾、派生部分或词干片段；没有一致的单一后缀。
patterns.domain: 多语种欧洲议会辩论、政策与政治文本

patterns.name: 议会程序与成员称谓
patterns.context: 在议员发言、议会程序或正式机构称谓中出现；激活分布于议会相关词的内部片段。

patterns.name: 专名或地名内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在国家、城市或人名等专名中；并非每个专名都以相同方式激活。
patterns.domain: 议会发言中的国家、地点及人名

patterns.name: 药品商品词中的内部分段
patterns.context: 激活落在疑似药品/商品名的词中，周围是购买、非处方药、药片及促销文案。
patterns.domain: 网页商业广告与药品销售文本

patterns.name: 代码包名与标识符片段
patterns.context: 激活发生在 Java 包名、类名等点分隔标识符内部，重复出现在相邻标识符中。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与许可证注释

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语政治词中的词内片段
patterns.context: 在正式历史或制度性叙述中，激活落在拉脱维亚语屈折词的内部片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语制度词中的词内片段
patterns.context: 在改革、报告及委员会等制度性语境中，激活落于词干或词尾片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会斯洛文尼亚语政策文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across en within words, semen and its derived proper names, and line breaks, carriage returns, braces, and slashes in code and links; the Romanian parliamentary passage has no clear corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: -en/en fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on en letter strings within tokenized words, especially near word endings or affix boundaries; no specific semantics are required.
patterns.domain: Dutch, Italian, and other texts; email filenames; segments 1, 2, 3

patterns.name: semen and related words
patterns.context: Hits the stem of semen; also occurs in the proper name SemanticScholar, derived from it.
patterns.domain: Reproductive medicine abstracts and technology news; segments 5, 9

patterns.name: CSS code formatting and boundaries
patterns.context: Formatting tokens such as line breaks, carriage returns, indentation, and rule closures activate repeatedly in code blocks; specific CSS properties vary.

patterns.name: GitHub paths and markers
patterns.context: Path separators and line endings near GitHub project links and license text.

2_1034.concept: 文本边界与 en 字符串
2_1034.description: 激活分散于词内 en、semen/其派生专名，以及代码和链接中的换行回车、花括号与斜杠；罗马尼亚语议会段无明确对应模式。

patterns.name: 英文词内的 -en/en 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的词内 en 字母串，尤其是词尾或词缀边界附近；并不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语、意大利语等文本及邮件文件名；段 1、2、3

patterns.name: semen 及相关词
patterns.context: 命中 semen 这一词的词干；也见于由它构成的专名 SemanticScholar。
patterns.domain: 生殖医学摘要与科技新闻；段 5、9

patterns.name: CSS 代码格式与边界
patterns.trigger: «»、«↵»、«}»，以及 CSS 声明附近的空格
patterns.context: 代码块中换行、回车、缩进、规则闭合等格式 token 多次激活；具体 CSS 属性各异。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 的 CSS 代码；段 6、8、10

patterns.name: GitHub 路径与标记
patterns.context: GitHub 项目链接及许可证文本附近的路径分隔符和行结束符。

en.description: Most passages activate the letter sequence en in words across multiple languages, sometimes across morpheme boundaries; activations also occur on ens in the code identifier consenSys and ine in a repeated name in advertising text, the latter two possibly being local coincidences.

patterns.name: en in nouns or word endings
patterns.context: The character sequence en appears in whole words, word endings, or medial positions across several languages; activation positions do not always match morpheme boundaries and do not depend on a single language.
patterns.domain: Multilingual news, parliamentary text, emails, and academic text

patterns.name: ens in a software identifier
patterns.context: Occurs in a Go code import path, surrounded by package names and import syntax.

patterns.name: ine in an obfuscated drug name
patterns.context: Two repeated apparent drug or product names both contain ine, appearing in drug-promotion spam; other words such as medicine, generic, and pills may provide local context.

2_1034.description: 多数片段在多语种词中激活字母序列 en，位置可跨词素边界；另见代码标识符 consenSys 中的 ens，以及广告文本重复名称中的 ine，后两者可能是局部巧合。

patterns.name: 名词或词尾中的 en
patterns.context: 多种语言中，字符序列 en 出现在完整词、词尾或词内；激活位置不总与词素边界吻合，也不依赖单一语言。
patterns.domain: 多语种新闻、议会文本、邮件及学术文本

patterns.name: 软件标识符中的 ens
patterns.trigger: [4] «cons«ens»9«ys»，即标识符 consenSys 的 en/ens 字符序列
patterns.context: 出现在 Go 代码的导入路径中，周围为包名与导入语法。

patterns.name: 被混淆药品词中的 ine
patterns.context: 两个重复的疑似药品或商品名称均含 ine，见于药品促销式垃圾文本；其他词如 medicine、generic、pills 可能构成局部语境。

en.description: Activations do not correspond to a single semantic theme: several segments center on explicit carriage-return/line-break boundaries; the rest are distributed across multilingual within-word fragments, English semen/proper names, JavaScript and PHP identifiers, and a French castle name.

patterns.name: Line breaks and carriage returns in corpus markers
patterns.context: Activations cluster on explicit carriage-return or line-break markers, often around source code, licenses, document paragraphs, or record boundaries; this is the clearest cross-domain commonality.
patterns.domain: Multidomain text, code, and formatted corpora

patterns.name: Within-word fragments of English semen
patterns.context: The triggering fragment is a character sequence in English spelling and does not require a meaning related to semen; it occurs in both reproductive medicine terms and product names.

patterns.name: Within-word Hungarian fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subwords within Hungarian words or words containing Hungarian characters in European Parliament text; the words differ in meaning and part of speech.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Hungarian and EU trade texts

patterns.name: Within-word Italian fragments
patterns.context: In coherent Italian prose, activations are distributed across within-word fragments, with no single meaning or fixed syntactic position.

patterns.name: JavaScript and DOM code fragments
patterns.context: JavaScript examples that manipulate DOM elements, retrieve tags, or set events; activations fall on several identifiers and code structures.

patterns.name: PHP include/require and filenames
patterns.context: PHP source loading the PEAR Mail_MIME component, accompanied by comments, carriage returns, and line breaks.

patterns.name: License and project metadata
patterns.context: MIT license and Source metadata in a GitHub page excerpt; strong activations fall mainly on line breaks/carriage returns rather than semantically distinctive content.

patterns.name: Fragments in French castle names
patterns.context: Activations fall on French proper names in English encyclopedia sentences and their repetitions, especially within château.

2_1034.description: 激活并非单一语义主题：若干段集中在显式回车/换行边界；其余分散于多语种词内片段、英文 semen/专名、JavaScript 与 PHP 标识符，以及法语城堡专名。

patterns.name: 语料标记中的换行与回车
patterns.trigger: «\r»、«↵»，常伴随行尾或代码/文件块边界
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在显式回车或换行标记上，周围常是源码、许可证、文档段落或记录边界；是跨领域最明显的共同点
patterns.domain: 多领域文本、代码与格式化语料

patterns.name: 英语 semen 的词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段是英语拼写中的连续字符，不要求语义上指精液；既见于生殖医学术语，也见于产品名
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科技评论

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在匈牙利语或含匈牙利语字符的词内子词上，处于欧洲议会文本；各词的语义与词性不统一
patterns.domain: EuroParl，匈牙利语及欧盟贸易文本

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 在意大利语连贯散文中，激活分布于词内片段，未见单一词义或固定句法位置

patterns.name: JavaScript 与 DOM 代码片段
patterns.context: 处于操作 DOM 元素、获取标签或设置事件的 JavaScript 示例；激活落在若干标识符及代码结构上

patterns.name: PHP include/require 与文件名
patterns.context: 处于 PHP 源码中加载 PEAR Mail_MIME 组件的语句，并伴随注释、回车和换行

patterns.name: 许可证与项目元数据
patterns.trigger: «License»及项目 URL、来源说明附近的格式标记
patterns.context: 处于 GitHub 页面摘录中的 MIT 许可证和 Source 元数据；强激活主要落在换行/回车而非专有语义内容

patterns.name: 法语城堡名称中的词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文百科句子中的法语专名及其重复出现处，尤其是 château 一词内部

en.description: Activations mainly fall on code line breaks/carriage returns and code tokens, with additional coverage of Romanian-related word forms, Hungarian endings, and Italian expressions of consequences; these phenomena belong to different languages and code syntaxes.

patterns.name: Line breaks and carriage-return/line-feed code
patterns.context: Code text contains line endings or blank lines; activations are strongest at consecutive line breaks in several cases, but also occur on ordinary code lines.
patterns.domain: Programming text, code repositories, and Q&A code snippets

patterns.name: Romanian-related word forms
patterns.context: Romanian place names and their inflected forms, or political and trade texts discussing Romania; activations fall on different within-word subword fragments.

patterns.name: Specific Hungarian endings
patterns.context: In Hungarian sentences, activations cluster within words, especially on inflected or derived word-form fragments.

patterns.name: Italian expressions of results/consequences
patterns.context: In Italian discussion, noun phrases followed by negative outcomes; multiple within-word subword fragments also activate.

patterns.name: JavaScript DOM code fragments
patterns.context: Browser-side scripts involving DOM element selection, event listeners, list links, or video sources; co-occurs with line-break activations.

patterns.name: PHP include statements and documentation comments
patterns.context: A PHP file includes a mail MIME library and then enters a comment or documentation block; activations also cover line separators.

patterns.name: CSS background and layout declarations
patterns.context: CSS rule blocks set background images, sizes, and positions; nearby closing braces and line breaks also activate.

patterns.name: HTML document header and footer strings
patterns.context: C# string constants construct an HTML document header and footer, near a method signature and response content-type setting.

2_1034.concept: 多语文本与代码边界片段
2_1034.description: 激活主要落在代码换行/回车及代码 token 上，另覆盖罗马尼亚相关词形、匈牙利语词尾和意大利语后果表达；各现象分属不同语言与代码语法。

patterns.name: 换行符及回车换行代码
patterns.context: 代码文本中出现行尾或空行；多处在连续换行处激活最强，但也见于普通代码行
patterns.domain: 编程文本、代码仓库与问答代码片段

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚相关词形
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语地名及其形态变化，或讨论罗马尼亚的政治、贸易文本；激活落在词内不同子词片段

patterns.name: 匈牙利语特定词尾
patterns.context: 匈牙利语句中，激活集中在词内部、尤其屈折或派生词形片段
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会匈牙利语文本

patterns.name: 意大利语结果/后果表达
patterns.context: 意大利语论述中，后接负面结果的名词短语；另有词内多个子词片段激活

patterns.name: JavaScript DOM 代码片段
patterns.context: 浏览器端脚本，涉及 DOM 元素选择、事件监听、列表链接或视频源；与换行激活同时出现

patterns.name: PHP 引入语句及文档注释
patterns.context: PHP 文件中引入邮件 MIME 库后进入注释或文档块；激活也覆盖行分隔符

patterns.name: CSS 背景与布局声明
patterns.context: CSS 规则块中设置背景图片、尺寸与位置，邻近闭合花括号和换行也激活

patterns.name: HTML 文档头尾字符串
patterns.context: C# 字符串常量中构造 HTML 文档的头部和尾部，附近有方法签名及响应内容类型设置

en.description: Activations broadly fall on subword fragments within words in different languages, often near word endings; they also hit name fragments and short function words. The GitHub passage instead highlights carriage returns, list markers, and paths. No stable semantic or syntactic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Suffix-like or word-final fragments at intra-word subword boundaries
patterns.context: Activations usually fall on final segments or suffix-like fragments inside whole words; however, the fragments span languages and do not always share the same morphological function.
patterns.domain: Narrative and formal text in Italian, Estonian, English, Hungarian, Slovenian, Swedish, and other languages

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in multilingual European Parliament text
patterns.context: Markers most often occur inside words in EU policy, question-and-answer, or argumentative prose; languages and word forms vary, with no stable syntactic position.

patterns.name: Proper names and their internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments inside personal names, rather than clearly marking a category of proper names.
patterns.domain: Academic introductions and legal case citations

patterns.name: Formatting markers in code repository change logs
patterns.context: Concentrated around GitHub PR lists, line breaks, and project paths, clearly distinct from natural-language intra-word fragments.

patterns.name: Short function words or common fragments between adjacent words
patterns.context: Markers sometimes cover a preceding space and short word, or fall inside a common word; this occurs in only a few passages and cannot independently explain the overall activation.
patterns.domain: English legal text, Swedish text, and Slovenian text

2_1034.concept: 跨语言子词与格式片段
2_1034.description: 激活广泛落在不同语言词内的子词片段，常靠近词尾，也会命中姓名片段、短功能词；GitHub 段则突出回车换行、列表符和路径。没有稳定的语义或句法主题。

patterns.name: 词内子词边界上的后缀或词尾
patterns.trigger: 多种语言中被标记的词内片段，如«en»10、«ali»3、«jan»2、«ir»2、«ge»9、«an»7、«li»5、«gen»9
patterns.context: 激活通常落在完整词内部的末段或后缀样子片段；但片段跨语言、并不总是同一形态功能。
patterns.domain: 意大利语、爱沙尼亚语、英语、匈牙利语、斯洛文尼亚语、瑞典语等叙述与正式文本

patterns.name: 欧洲议会多语种正文中的词内片段
patterns.context: 标记多出现在欧盟政策、问答或论述正文的词内；语言与词形各异，未见稳定的句法位置。

patterns.name: 专名及其内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人物姓名内部的子词片段，而非显然的专名类别标记。
patterns.domain: 学术介绍、法律判例引述

patterns.name: 代码仓库变更记录中的格式标记
patterns.context: 集中出现在 GitHub PR 列表、换行和项目路径附近，明显不同于自然语言词内片段。

patterns.name: 相邻词间短功能词或常见片段
patterns.context: 标记有时覆盖词前空格及短词，或落在常见词的内部；仅少数段出现，不能单独解释整体激活。
patterns.domain: 英语法律文本、瑞典语与斯洛文尼亚语正文

en.description: Activations are distributed across within-word subword fragments in multilingual text, especially en/guen; fragments also occur in the Latvian phrase 「Eiropas Savienība」, alongside a few unrelated lexical activations.

patterns.name: Subword fragments ending in -en/-guen
patterns.context: Activations fall on spelling fragments containing en or guen across different languages and words; sometimes they are word-final, sometimes merely part of a word, and do not depend on a single semantic or syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, including Italian, English, Latvian, Estonian, and proper names

patterns.name: Fragments in the EU name
patterns.context: In Latvian EuroParl contexts, the trigger falls within inflected forms of 「Eiropas Savienība」 (European Union); this name appears in segments 3, 4, 5, and 6.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text on animal welfare, parliamentary commemorations, agriculture, and fire-service cooperation

patterns.name: Other fragmented within-word triggers
patterns.context: Triggers fall within words or near affix boundaries, with no shared semantics; each occurs in only a few word forms.
patterns.domain: Latvian EuroParl texts and Estonian news snippets

patterns.name: Semantic vocabulary and common function words
patterns.context: These passages contain several scattered lexical activations; trigger words differ in meaning and syntax, with no consistent contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Italian reviews, English academic writing, Italian parliamentary speeches, English product descriptions

2_1034.description: 激活分散在多语文本的词内子词片段上，尤其是 en/guen；另有拉脱维亚语「Eiropas Savienība」中的片段，以及少量彼此无关的词汇激活。

patterns.name: 词尾 -en/-guen 的次词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语言和词汇中包含 en 或 guen 的拼写片段上；有时它是词尾，有时只是词内的一部分，并不依赖单一语义或句法位置。
patterns.domain: 意大利语、英语、拉脱维亚语、爱沙尼亚语及专名等多语言文本

patterns.name: 欧盟名称中的词片段
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语 EuroParl 语境中，触发点位于「Eiropas Savienība」（欧洲联盟）的格变化形式内；段3、4、5、6均出现此名称。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，涉及动物福利、议会纪念、农业、消防合作

patterns.name: 其他片段化的词内触发
patterns.context: 触发位于词内或词缀边界附近，未显示出共同语义；各自只见于少数词形。
patterns.domain: 拉脱维亚语 EuroParl 文本及爱沙尼亚语新闻片段

patterns.name: 语义词汇及常见功能词
patterns.context: 这些段落有若干分散的词汇性激活，触发词在语义和句法上差异明显，未见一致上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 意大利语评论、英语学术文字、意大利语议会发言、英语商品描述

en.description: Activations often fall on en and related spelling fragments within words, especially Baltic-language forms and European proper names in European Parliament texts; they also occur sporadically in names, common words, legal texts, code URLs, and encyclopedia text. Some markers have no apparent shared semantics.

patterns.name: Within-word en subword fragments
patterns.context: Relatively consistently occurs inside words, especially spelling fragments in European-language place names, proper names, or common words; activations may span languages and do not correspond only to a complete word.
patterns.domain: Multilingual corpora, including philosophy, European Parliament texts, legal documents, and encyclopedias.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments in Baltic languages
patterns.context: Activations fall within or at the ends of Latvian or Estonian words, often in inflected forms and proper names; they are not limited to a single word meaning.

patterns.name: European Parliament proper names and institutional expressions
patterns.context: Within-word fragments in proper names or institution names are marked; the same kinds of European institutional names recur across several passages, but markers do not consistently fall at whole-name boundaries.

patterns.name: en-like forms in proper names or words
patterns.context: Occurs in spellings of names, places, common words, or divine names across languages; it is not always linked to a European Parliament theme.
patterns.domain: Philosophical discussions, Italian, European Parliament texts, law, and encyclopedias.

patterns.name: Other sporadic within-word fragments
patterns.context: A small number of markers fall within words related to accident casualties, names in legal citations, code URLs, or encyclopedia entries; apart from being within-word substrings, they show no shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: News commentary, law, programming Q&A, encyclopedias.

patterns.name: Residual activations without a unified trigger
patterns.context: Scattered across different languages, formats, and word classes; these fragments do not reveal a consistent contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Law, Q&A, European Parliament texts, and other sources.

2_1034.description: 激活常落在词内的 en 及相关拼写片段，尤其见于欧洲议会文本中的波罗的海语词形与欧洲专名；也零散出现于姓名、普通词、法律、代码网址和百科文本。部分标记无明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段 en
patterns.trigger: «en»10（[1] Gu«en»gu«en»；[2] Sav«ien»；[3] Conse«gu»en«ze»；[4][5] E«i»rop«as» Sav«ien»；[6] Rume«en»；[8] Su«en»；[10] Su«en»）
patterns.context: 较稳定地出现在词内部，尤其是欧洲语言地名、专名或普通词的拼写片段；激活位置可能跨语言，且并非只对应一个完整词。
patterns.domain: 多语种语料，包括哲学、欧洲议会文本、法律文书和百科。

patterns.name: 波罗的海语种中的拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活落在拉脱维亚语或爱沙尼亚语词的内部或词尾，常见于屈折形式与专名；不局限于单个词义。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会专名及机构表述
patterns.context: 专名或机构名称中的词内片段被标记；同一类欧洲机构名称在多个片段反复出现，但标记并不固定落在完整名称边界。

patterns.name: 专名或词语中出现的 en 音形
patterns.context: 出现在不同语言的姓名、地名、普通词或神名拼写中；与“欧洲议会”主题并不总是相连。
patterns.domain: 哲学论述、意大利语、欧洲议会文本、法律与百科。

patterns.name: 其他零散词内片段
patterns.context: 少量标记落在事故伤亡相关词、法律引文中的人名、代码网址或百科条目词语内部；除词内子串外看不出共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、法律、编程问答、百科。

patterns.name: 未见统一触发的残余激活
patterns.context: 散见于不同语种、格式和词类；难以从这些片段判断一致的上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 法律、问答、欧洲议会文本及其他。

en.description: Activations mostly fall on within-word subword fragments in multilingual text, especially Latvian morphological fragments; they also respond to template code markers, indentation and line breaks, and several proper-name or term fragments. The examples lack a stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Token activations at within-word splits
patterns.context: Activations fall within words across languages rather than on whole words or fixed semantic concepts; word boundaries and subword tokenization appear important.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, including Italian, Latvian, Estonian, and English

patterns.name: Latvian morphology and spelling fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on subword fragments in Latvian words, often in words with inflectional or derivational suffixes; some examples involve the EU, animal welfare, agriculture, and other topics.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual name and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on subword fragments within proper names or terms, including author, place, and personal names, as well as drug names; no stable shared semantic category is evident.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, parliamentary records, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Template syntax and code delimiters
patterns.context: In template code, activations cluster on Jinja-style control syntax, bracket markers, and line breaks/indentation rather than ordinary code identifiers.

patterns.name: English word-final or within-word fragments
patterns.context: Within-word fragments activate in English scientific and encyclopedia text, but belong to different words and show no stable thematic condition.
patterns.domain: ArXiv scientific text and English Wikipedia

patterns.name: Within-word Italian fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within Italian words in commentary about work, death, and public ethics; the fragments themselves do not appear to share semantics.

patterns.name: Medical term outside English template boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs alone at the end of the drug name Octreotide, near discussion of clinical outcomes and preventive medication; there are no other medical fragments to validate a pattern.

2_1034.concept: 跨语言子词及结构标记
2_1034.description: 激活多落在多语种词内子词片段，尤其是拉脱维亚语形态片段；另对模板代码标记、缩进换行及若干专名或术语片段有反应。各例缺少稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 词内分段的 token 激活
patterns.context: 激活落在跨语言词汇的词内部，而非完整词或固定语义概念上；词边界和子词切分似乎是重要条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本，包括意大利语、拉脱维亚语、爱沙尼亚语及英语

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语形态与拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活位于拉脱维亚语词的子词片段，常见于带变格或派生后缀的词；部分例子涉及欧盟、动物福利、农业等议题。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 拉脱维亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 跨语言人名与专名片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名或术语内部的子词片段，涉及作者名、地名、人物名及药物名；未见稳定的共同语义类别。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、议会记录及医学摘要

patterns.name: 模板语法与代码分隔符
patterns.context: 在模板代码中，激活集中于 Jinja 风格控制语法、括号标记及换行缩进，而非普通代码标识符。

patterns.name: 英语词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 英文科学与百科文本中的词内片段有激活，但这些片段分属不同词，未显示稳定的主题条件。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学文本与英文 Wikipedia

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于意大利语词内部，语境是关于工作、死亡及公共伦理的评论；无法确认这些词片段本身共享语义。

patterns.name: 英语模板边界外的医学术语
patterns.context: 单独出现在 Octreotide 药名的词尾，邻近临床结局与预防用药叙述；没有其他医学片段可验证规律。

en.description: Activations occur in multilingual parliamentary text, encyclopedia place-name lists, legal cases, and scientific text, mainly on intra-word fragments in different languages or fragments of proper names and terms; no stable shared lexical meaning or domain pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Romanian name and award word fragments
patterns.context: Romanian sentences mention awards, recipients, and nationality-related words; several activations fall inside segmented words.

patterns.name: English road-name and place-name word fragments
patterns.context: An encyclopedia description of Texas interstate highways involving road names, routes, and place names.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in physics papers
patterns.context: Discussion of superconductors, oxide interfaces, and related research; activations occur in an author's surname.

patterns.name: Wine-region and place-name word fragments
patterns.context: California wine regions are listed by county; activations mostly occur inside place names.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia; geography and wine encyclopedia list

patterns.name: Slovak historical expressions
patterns.context: Expressions about European history, “century,” expulsion, and related topics; activations concentrate on different fragments of Slovak words.

patterns.name: Estonian tax and insurance questions
patterns.context: Questions about unemployment insurance, taxes, and measures to take when working across borders.
patterns.domain: EuroParl; Estonian policy questions and answers

patterns.name: Expressions of concern in Polish parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: A speaker expresses partial dissatisfaction and raises concerns before parliament; activations are distributed inside Polish words.

patterns.name: Italian discussion of work ethics
patterns.context: Discusses workplace deaths and public ethics; activations fall on fragments of Italian words.
patterns.domain: PhilPapers; Italian philosophical or social commentary

patterns.name: Word fragments in names from legal cases
patterns.context: Insurance contract litigation text citing the names of parties and prior claims.

patterns.name: Molecular biology term fragments
patterns.context: Describes a rat enzyme cloning research project and mentions oligonucleotide probes and monoclonal antibodies.

2_1034.description: 激活出现在多语种议会文本、百科地名、法律判例和科研文本中，主要落在不同语言的词内片段或专名、术语片段；没有稳定共享的词义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语人名与奖项词片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子中出现奖项、获奖者及国籍相关词；多个激活落在被切分的词内部。

patterns.name: 英语道路名称与地名词片段
patterns.context: 德州州际公路的百科描述，涉及道路名称、路线和地名。

patterns.name: 物理学文献中的词内片段
patterns.context: 讨论超导体、氧化物界面及相关研究，激活出现在作者姓氏中。

patterns.name: 葡萄酒产区与地名词片段
patterns.context: 按县列举加州葡萄酒产区，激活多出现在地名内部。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia；地理与葡萄酒百科列表

patterns.name: 斯洛伐克语历史表述
patterns.context: 关于欧洲历史及“世纪”、驱逐等表述；激活集中于斯洛伐克语词的不同片段。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语税务与保险问句
patterns.context: 询问失业保险、税务以及越境工作时应采取的措施。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会发言中的担忧表达
patterns.context: 发言者表示不完全满意，并向议会表达担忧；激活分布在波兰语词内部。

patterns.name: 意大利语劳动伦理论述
patterns.context: 谈论工伤死亡及公共伦理；激活落在意大利语词的片段中。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers；意大利语哲学或社会评论

patterns.name: 法律判例姓名中的词片段
patterns.context: 保险合同诉讼文本，引用案件当事人姓名及先前索赔。

patterns.name: 分子生物学术语片段
patterns.context: 描述大鼠酶的克隆研究计划，提到寡核苷酸探针和单克隆抗体。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter；生物医学研究摘要

en.description: Activations are distributed across template syntax, Markdown fences, and within-word fragments in multilingual text; examples occur in English, German, Estonian, and Italian. The specific word fragments vary widely, making it difficult to identify a stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Special syntax in code templates
patterns.context: Template code on GitHub contains template control syntax or expression boundaries; activations cluster near these syntax markers.

patterns.name: English affixes within words
patterns.context: Markers often fall within English words or near affixes, especially in inflected forms, compounds, or technical terms; they sometimes occur mid-sentence rather than sentence-initially.
patterns.domain: Biomedical text, technology headlines, software documentation

patterns.name: Within-word German fragments
patterns.context: Markers occur within German words or inflected forms, including parliamentary speeches and philosophical bibliographies.

patterns.name: Estonian morphemes/endings
patterns.context: Markers split within words, amid many inflected or derived forms; the specific boundaries cannot be reduced to a single affix.

patterns.name: English within-word fragments such as -en/-ine
patterns.context: In ordinary English sentences, markers fall within words, such as “sweetened” and “someone”; the latter also occurs in other passages.

patterns.name: Within-word Italian fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall within Italian words or parts of words in prose about public ethics and work.

patterns.name: Code fences
patterns.context: Fenced code blocks in GitHub Markdown documents; activations occur near code-block boundaries, with a few activations on nearby words as well.

patterns.name: Fragmented or unstable subword tokenization
patterns.context: Markers around template code and various within-word fragments across multilingual text; these passages alone cannot establish a shared semantic function.

patterns.name: Activations not grouped into stable patterns
patterns.context: These activations may reflect within-word subword boundaries or incidental local context, but the examples are insufficient to establish a consistent trigger condition.

2_1034.concept: 跨语言子词与代码边界
2_1034.description: 激活分布于模板语法、Markdown 围栏及多语种词内部片段；英语、德语、爱沙尼亚语、意大利语均有例子。具体词片段差异很大，难以归结为稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码模板中的特殊语法
patterns.context: GitHub 上的模板代码中，出现模板控制语法或表达式边界；激活集中在这些语法标记附近。

patterns.name: 单词内部的英语词缀
patterns.context: 标记常落在英语词内部或词缀附近，尤其是词形变化、复合词或技术词；有时出现在句中而非句首。
patterns.domain: 生物医学文本、科技标题、软件文档

patterns.name: 德语词内部片段
patterns.context: 标记出现在德语词或词形变化内部；包括议会发言与哲学书目。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词素／词尾
patterns.context: 标记切分在词内，伴随有大量变格或派生形式；具体边界难以还原成单一词缀。

patterns.name: 英语词内部的 -en／-ine 一类片段
patterns.context: 在普通英语句子中，标记落在词内部，如 “sweetened” 和 “someone”；后者在其他段落也出现。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语词内部或词的一部分，句子是关于公共伦理与工作的散文。

patterns.name: 代码围栏
patterns.context: GitHub Markdown 文档中的围栏代码块，激活出现在代码块边界附近；同时邻近词有少量激活。

patterns.name: 残缺或不稳定的子词切分
patterns.context: 模板代码周边的标记，以及跨语言文本中多种词内片段；不能仅凭这些段确认它们共享某一语义功能。

patterns.name: 未归入稳定模式的激活
patterns.context: 这些激活可能反映词内子词边界或偶然的局部上下文，但样例不足以判定一致触发条件。

en.description: Activations mostly fall on short subword fragments within words, especially in Baltic-language forms, but also in Italian and English words; the triggering fragments show no clear stable correspondence with meaning, syntax, or topic, and some markers may be affected by subword tokenization.

patterns.name: Within-word “ig/ig” character strings
patterns.context: Activations fall on ig character fragments within Italian words; both examples occur in the spelling of longer words, with no evidence that meaning or syntax is necessary.
patterns.domain: Italian commentary and proper names in English technology papers

patterns.name: Within-word Baltic-language fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall within Estonian and Latvian words; examples include place names, institution names, inflected forms, and long words, with no single fixed word or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Word boundaries and anomalous within-word splits
patterns.context: Markers fall within English or English-like words; in the first two examples, “x” immediately precedes the marked fragment, possibly due to tokenization or subword segmentation.

patterns.name: Other within-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across multiple internal fragments in Latvian or Estonian words, are relatively weak, and cannot be explained by one stable morphological form, meaning, or positional rule.

patterns.name: Broad phenomenon of within-word segmentation
patterns.context: Markers occur on fragments or short words within words across languages, word classes, and text positions; these low-strength examples suggest that within-word subword responses may be widespread, but are insufficient to identify a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Multilingual corpora and English web text

2_1034.description: 激活多落在词内的短子词片段，尤其见于波罗的海语言词形，也出现于意大利语和英语词中；触发片段与词义、句法或主题无明显稳定对应，部分标记可能受子词切分影响。

patterns.name: 词内的「ig/ig」字母串
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语单词内部的 ig 字母片段；两例都处于较长词的拼写中，没有证据表明词义或句法是必要条件。
patterns.domain: 意大利语评论文字与英文科技论文中的专名

patterns.name: 波罗的海语言词内片段
patterns.trigger: «»10出现在“Rume«en»10ias”“Sav«ien»10ībā”“kav«ats»4«en»10”等；强激活片段包括“en”“ien”“pi”“ia”等
patterns.context: 激活落在爱沙尼亚语、拉脱维亚语词的内部；相关例子涵盖地名、机构名、屈折词形及长词，未见单一固定词或语义条件。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 中的爱沙尼亚语和拉脱维亚语

patterns.name: 单词边界与词内切分异常
patterns.context: 标记落在英语词或类似英语词的内部；前两例中的“x”紧接着标记片段，可能与分词或子词切分有关。
patterns.domain: 电商/医疗片段与英文百科

patterns.name: 其他词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于拉脱维亚语或爱沙尼亚语词的多个内部片段，强度较弱，无法由一个稳定的词形、词义或位置规则解释。

patterns.name: 词内分段的广泛现象
patterns.context: 标记出现在多种语言、词类及文本位置的词片段或短词上；这些低强度例子提示词内子词响应可能较普遍，但不足以确定共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种语料及英语网页文本

en.description: All fragments fall within tokenized words across multiple languages and styles, with no stable word meaning. Clearer local contexts include European Parliament institutional references, parliamentary questions, and Italian and German academic text; there are also within-word fragments in a physics paper and a road encyclopedia article.

patterns.name: Within-word Roman-letter fragments and retokenization
patterns.context: Activation points fall on within-word subword fragments in different languages; there is no fixed word-initial or word-final position, or shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text and general tokenized sequences

patterns.name: European political institutions
patterns.context: Parliamentary statements about EU institutions, member states, or political representatives; some highlights fall within institution or nationality names.

patterns.name: Verbs or modal expressions in questions
patterns.context: Consecutive questions in Estonian or Romanian ask about circumstances, actions, or necessary resources.

patterns.name: Italian abstract nouns and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Highlights occur within words in Italian philosophical bibliographies or discussions of ethics and labor; the word meanings vary.
patterns.domain: PhilPapers, Italian academic bibliographies or discussions

patterns.name: German philosophical terms and within-word fragments
patterns.context: German titles in philosophical paper bibliographies; activation fragments are embedded within words.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in a superconducting materials paper
patterns.context: An academic sentence citing research on superconductivity at thin-film insulating-oxide interfaces; the highlight falls within an author's surname.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in place names or road descriptions
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry about a US interstate highway describes the road encircling a city; the activation point falls within a verb.

2_1034.description: 所有片段都落在被分词的词内部，跨多种语言与文体，未见稳定词义。较清楚的局部语境包括欧洲议会机构称谓、议会问句，以及意大利语、德语学术文本；另有物理论文和道路百科中的词内片段。

patterns.name: 词内罗马字母片段与重分词
patterns.trigger: 如«a»、«ir»、«iku»、«ena»、«ig»、«ente»；激活片段常处于被切分的词内部
patterns.context: 激活点落在不同语言的词内子词片段上；没有固定的词首、词尾或相同词义
patterns.domain: 多语种文本与一般分词序列

patterns.name: 欧洲政治机构称谓
patterns.context: 欧盟机构、成员国或政治代表的议会陈述语境；部分高亮落在机构或国籍名称中

patterns.name: 问句中的动词或情态表达
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语或罗马尼亚语的连续疑问句，询问处境、行动或所需资源

patterns.name: 意大利语抽象名词及词内片段
patterns.context: 高亮出现在意大利语哲学书目或伦理、劳动论述中的词内部，所涉词义各异
patterns.domain: PhilPapers，意大利语学术书目或论述

patterns.name: 德语哲学术语及词内片段
patterns.context: 哲学论文书目中的德语标题；激活片段嵌在词内部

patterns.name: 超导材料论文中的词内片段
patterns.context: 引用薄膜绝缘氧化物界面超导研究的学术句子；高亮位于作者姓氏中

patterns.name: 地名或道路描述中的词内片段
patterns.context: 美国州际公路的百科条目，叙述道路环绕城市；激活点在动词内部

en.description: Most activation markers fall on intra-word fragments across several European languages, especially in parliamentary text; sporadic English material, proper names, and attended also occur. No uniform semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Estonian word-final form fragments
patterns.context: Occurs inside Estonian words or at their endings, such as “Rume«enia»”, “ri«ik»liku”, “A«uh»in«na»”, and “« sa»«aja»”; no clear cross-passage semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Lithuanian
patterns.context: Activation markers are scattered inside Lithuanian words; the sentence discusses opportunities to participate in decision-making and is followed by a personal name.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Slovak
patterns.context: Markers are scattered across Slovak word forms; the passage discusses European historical events, migration, and expulsion.

patterns.name: Estonian word forms and questions
patterns.context: Occurs inside Estonian words, especially in questions and first-person expressions, such as “Mill«ine»”, “ma« pe»«an»”, and “kav«ats»«en»”.

patterns.name: Professional information after a personal name
patterns.context: An education or credentials description follows a personal name; the marker is a complete English word, not an obvious linguistic fragment shared with the other passages.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Italian
patterns.context: Scattered across Italian word forms; this passage is a parliamentary speech containing discussion of responses, denials of concealment, and language ability.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in English material
patterns.context: Occurs inside the surname in “Cav«ig»lia-2008”; only one activation occurs here, with no clear semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: Word fragments in SomineX product copy
patterns.context: Occurs in pharmaceutical and promotional text, especially inside the repeated name “SomineX”; other activated words are more scattered.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Romanian parliamentary text
patterns.context: Markers are scattered across Romanian word forms; the passage discusses how small businesses can obtain financing and whether a solidarity fund or collective solutions are needed.

2_1034.description: 激活标记大多落在多种欧洲语言的词内片段中，集中见于议会文本；另有零散英语材料、专名及 attended。未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语末尾词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在爱沙尼亚语词汇内部或词尾，如“Rume«enia»”“ri«ik»liku”“A«uh»in«na»”“« sa»«aja»”；没有明显的跨段语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活标记分散在立陶宛语词内部，句子讨论参与决策的机会，后接人名。

patterns.name: 斯洛伐克语词内片段
patterns.context: 标记散布于斯洛伐克语词形中；段落谈欧洲历史事件、迁徙与驱逐。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词形与问句
patterns.context: 出现在爱沙尼亚语词内部，尤其是疑问句和第一人称表达中，如“Mill«ine»”“ma« pe»«an»”“kav«ats»«en»”。

patterns.name: 人名后的职业信息
patterns.context: 人名之后接教育或资历介绍；该标记是完整英语词，而非显然与其他段共享的语言片段。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 分散在意大利语词形中；此段是议会发言，包含回应、否认隐瞒及语言能力等内容。

patterns.name: 英文材料中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Cav«ig»lia-2008”的姓氏内部；仅这一处激活，未见明确语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: SomineX 商品文案中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在药品及促销文本中，尤其是反复出现的“SomineX”名称内部；其他激活词较分散。
patterns.domain: 网页商品／药品促销文案

patterns.name: 议会文本中的罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 标记散布于罗马尼亚语词形中；段落讨论小企业如何融资、是否需要团结基金或集体解决方案。

en.description: Highlights mainly fall on short character fragments within words across languages, often at word endings or morphological inflections; no stable semantics are apparent. A few English collocations and a Romanian policy question provide local context but are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word character sequences
patterns.context: Activation fragments are embedded within whole words across languages; local triggers are often specific letter sequences rather than whole words or fixed semantics.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text (Estonian, Lithuanian, Slovak, Romanian, Italian, Spanish, English, etc.)

patterns.name: Word-final or morphological fragments
patterns.context: Marked fragments often occur at word endings or near within-word affixes in morphologically rich words; different words and languages show no clear shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European Parliament speeches and other multilingual text

patterns.name: place in an English phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the collocation “to take place on...” in English medical prose.

patterns.name: honor in an English historical reference
patterns.context: Occurs in the fixed phrase “in honor of” in an English proper-name description.

patterns.name: Romanian questions about funding and collective schemes
patterns.context: Consecutive questions discuss how small businesses can cope and whether a solidarity fund or collective solutions are needed; these words may coincide incidentally with the character-fragment pattern.

patterns.name: The Italian word for knowledge
patterns.context: A speaker mentions having language knowledge; the highlight falls within the word and is not an obvious semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual within-word fragments that are difficult to explain individually
patterns.context: Activation positions appear as within-word character fragments across passages, but the available examples cannot establish a stable shared character sequence, lexical function, or semantics; passages and topics vary widely.

2_1034.description: 高亮主要落在多语言词语内部的短字符片段，常处于词尾或形态变化处；暂看不出稳定语义。少数英文搭配和罗马尼亚语政策问句有局部语境，但难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 词内字符序列
patterns.context: 激活片段嵌在完整词语内部，跨多种语言出现；局部触发常是特定字母序列，而非整个词或固定语义。
patterns.domain: 多语言文本（爱沙尼亚语、立陶宛语、斯洛伐克语、罗马尼亚语、意大利语、西班牙语、英语等）

patterns.name: 词尾或词形片段
patterns.context: 被标注片段常位于词尾或词内词缀附近，出现在形态变化丰富的词中；不同词、语言之间没有明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语言发言及其他多语种文本

patterns.name: 英文短语中的 place
patterns.context: 英文医疗叙述中，出现在“to take place on...”这一搭配里。

patterns.name: 英文历史事件中的 honor
patterns.context: 英语专名说明中，出现在“in honor of”这一固定搭配里。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式历史与地理说明

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语中关于资金与集体方案的提问
patterns.context: 连续的问句谈小企业如何应对、是否需要团结基金或集体解决方案；这些词可能是偶然与字母片段模式并存。

patterns.name: 意大利语知识一词
patterns.context: 发言者谈到自己具备语言知识；高亮落在词内部，并非显然的语义触发。

patterns.name: 难以单独解释的跨语言词内片段
patterns.context: 各段的激活位置呈词内字符片段形式，但无法据现有样本确定一个稳定的共享字符序列、词法功能或语义；不同段落和主题差异很大。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on subword fragments inside words, often near word endings or morpheme boundaries, across languages and styles; they also occur in repeated spellings in drug advertisements and in proper names in physics papers, with no stable topic or semantic trigger apparent.

patterns.name: Word-final subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments inside words in multiple languages, often near word endings or at morpheme boundaries; no fixed word or meaning is required.

patterns.name: Spelling and morphological continuation
patterns.context: Activations involve continuous spelling fragments within words or derivational morphemes; in passage [4], the same word recurs with increasing intensity.
patterns.domain: English spam advertising / pharmaceutical shopping text

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Activations occur inside proper names or technical terms; here they appear in a citation in a superconductivity research paper.

2_1034.description: 激活主要落在单词内部的子词片段，常见于词尾或词素边界，跨多种语言与文体；也出现在药品广告的重复拼写片段及物理论文专名中，未见稳定的主题或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词尾子词元片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多种语言单词内部的子词片段，常接近词尾或处于词素边界；并不要求某个固定词或语义

patterns.name: 拼写与词素延续
patterns.context: 激活涉及词中连续拼写片段或派生词素；段[4]中同一词反复出现且强度递增
patterns.domain: 英文垃圾广告/药品购物文本

patterns.name: 专业术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于专名或专业词内部；此处出现在超导研究的论文引文中

en.description: Activation most clearly falls on matter (a legal issue or substance) and Archive strings; web markup, legal monetary wording, and sporadic URL/term highlights also appear, but it is unclear whether they share a trigger pattern. In paragraph 6, activation appears only in the matter filename.

patterns.name: matter terms and legal compounds
patterns.context: Appears in phrases such as “subject-matter jurisdiction,” “subject-matter,” or “resolving this matter”; in legal texts it often occurs near subject or jurisdiction, and can also mean an issue to be resolved.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments, legal and business email

patterns.name: Scientific use of matter
patterns.context: matter means substance or an object of study, adjacent to scientific or technical words such as light, interactions, and transplant.

patterns.name: Archive strings and related names
patterns.context: Appears as a website link path, organization name, URL anchor, or code identifier; surrounding context concerns web archiving, Internet Archive, database functions, or Archive links.

patterns.name: Pill at a boundary position
patterns.context: Appears in the title “A Bitter Pill”; it is relatively close to matter triggered in a URL in the same paragraph, but evidence on its own is weak.

patterns.name: Structured HTML and link markup
patterns.context: Formatted web text around HTML anchors, closing tags, and double square brackets.

patterns.name: Judgment amounts and interest wording
patterns.context: Legal-document terms for amounts, interest, and judgments occur nearby; they appear in the same paragraph as matter activation, but are not obviously the same triggering substring.

patterns.name: Year and link-path fragments
patterns.context: Dates, numbers, and path fragments in URLs; a single example cannot establish whether they trigger independently.

patterns.name: Other sporadic terms
patterns.context: Highlighted words are distributed across sentence fragments, some missing the left-side word form; it is unclear whether ous, the, or Archive share a contextual condition.

2_1092.concept: matter 与 Archive 字符串
2_1092.description: 激活最明确地落在 matter（法律事项或物质）与 Archive 字符串；另有网页标记、法律金额措辞及零散 URL/词项高亮，无法确定都属于同一触发规律。第6段仅见 matter 文件名中的激活。

patterns.name: matter 词项与法律复合词
patterns.context: 出现在“subject-matter jurisdiction”“subject-matter”或“resolving this matter”等短语中；法律文本中常与 subject、jurisdiction 相邻，也可指待解决事项。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法律与商务邮件

patterns.name: matter 的科学用法
patterns.context: matter 作物质或研究对象，与 light、interactions、transplant 等科学或技术词相邻。

patterns.name: Archive 字符串及相关命名
patterns.context: 作为网站链接路径、机构名称、URL 锚点或代码中的标识符出现；周围语境涉及网页归档、Internet Archive、数据库函数或 Archive 链接。

patterns.name: 边界位置的 Pill
patterns.context: 出现在标题“A Bitter Pill”中；与同段 URL 中触发的 matter 相距较近，单独证据较弱。

patterns.name: 结构化 HTML 与链接标记
patterns.context: HTML 锚点、闭合标签及双中括号等标记周围的格式化网页文本。
patterns.domain: 网页目录或 HTML 片段

patterns.name: 判决金额与利息措辞
patterns.context: 金额、利息及判决等法律文书词汇相邻；它们与 matter 激活同段，但并非显然同一触发子串。

patterns.name: 年份与链接路径碎片
patterns.context: 网址中的日期、数字及路径片段；是否独立触发无法从单一例子确定。

patterns.name: 其他零散词项
patterns.context: 高亮词分布在句子片段中，部分缺少左侧词形；不能确定 ous、the 或 Archive 是否有共同上下文条件。

en.description: Strong responses cluster around Archive and matter: Archive appears in web links, the proper name Internet Archive, and code object names; matter appears in legal compounds, general usage, and physics terminology. Triggers depend on local word form and formatting.

patterns.name: Archive links in HTML directories
patterns.context: In HTML directories or hyperlinks, Archive appears as part of a path or as link text.

patterns.name: Internet Archive proper name
patterns.context: Discusses blogs disappearing soon, the Internet Archive team, and buying time to preserve content.

patterns.name: Legal term subject-matter
patterns.context: matter is hyphenated after subject- to form subject-matter; concerns court jurisdiction or the subject of litigation.

patterns.name: Standalone word matter
patterns.context: matter appears alone in a sentence; one instance refers to an issue to be resolved, and another appears in a PDF filename.

patterns.name: matter in materials science
patterns.context: matter appears in the compound term light-matter interactions, discussing interactions between molecular systems and lasers.

patterns.name: Archive as part of a database object name
patterns.context: Archive appears in a qualified name for a Java test database object, followed by quotation marks and a semicolon.

patterns.name: Archive as a URL anchor fragment
patterns.context: Archive appears at the end of a web URL path, immediately followed by the anchor symbol #.

2_1092.description: 强响应集中在 Archive 和 matter：Archive见于网页链接、互联网档案专名及代码对象名；matter见于法律复合词、普通用法及物理术语。触发受局部词形和格式影响。

patterns.name: HTML目录中的Archive链接
patterns.context: HTML目录或超链接中，Archive作为路径组成部分或链接文本出现。

patterns.name: Internet Archive专名
patterns.context: 谈论博客即将消失、Internet Archive团队及其争取时间保存内容。

patterns.name: 法律术语subject-matter
patterns.context: matter与subject-连字符相接，组成subject-matter；涉及法院管辖权或诉讼标的。

patterns.name: 独立单词matter
patterns.context: matter单独出现在句中；一例指待解决事项，一例出现在PDF文件名中。

patterns.name: 材料科学中的matter
patterns.context: matter处于light-matter interactions复合术语中，讨论分子系统与激光的相互作用。

patterns.name: Archive作为数据库对象名的一部分
patterns.context: Archive出现在Java测试数据库对象的限定名中，后接引号和分号。

patterns.name: Archive作为URL锚点片段
patterns.context: Archive出现在网页URL的路径末端，并紧接锚点符号#。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on the Archive and matter word forms: the former occurs in archives, links, and code; the latter in legal compounds, matters, and scientific terminology. A few sporadic triggers in titles or URLs are difficult to group.

patterns.name: Archive word form
patterns.context: Archive appears alone or in compound names/links; examples include archival institutions, web paths, code identifiers, and forum links.
patterns.domain: Web pages, Internet Archive, code, forums

patterns.name: matter compounds
patterns.context: matter appears in compounds or phrases involving legal jurisdiction, scientific interactions, or general matters; its prefixes and meanings are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Local triggers in unusual titles or names
patterns.context: Sporadic occurrences in titles, URLs, or truncated words, without consistent shared context.

patterns.name: matter in a title
patterns.context: matter in a linked filename; the context is an article title about whether thinking or grades matter.

2_1092.description: 激活主要集中在 Archive 词形及 matter 词形：前者见于档案、链接和代码，后者见于法律复合词、事务及科学术语。另有少数标题或 URL 中的零散触发，难以归并。

patterns.name: Archive 词形
patterns.trigger: «Archive»、«Archive» Team、Single Nation Surveys 附近的 «Archive»；代码中的 create«Archive»；«_»Y«C»_«Archive»
patterns.context: 出现 Archive 或复合名称/链接中的 Archive；包括档案机构、网页路径、代码标识符和论坛链接。
patterns.domain: 网页、互联网档案、代码、论坛

patterns.name: matter 复合词
patterns.context: matter 出现在复合词或短语中，涉及法律管辖、科学相互作用或一般事务；其前缀和语义并不一致。

patterns.name: 特殊标题或名称中的局部触发
patterns.context: 零散出现在标题、URL 或被截断的词中，缺乏一致的共同上下文。

patterns.name: 标题中的 matter
patterns.context: 链接文件名中的 matter；上下文是关于思考或成绩是否重要的文章标题。

en.concept: matter-related forms and a few proper names/paths
en.description: Responds mainly to matter and its compounds (especially subject-matter and light-matter), as well as Archive-related names or paths and the proper name Bay Area; in [6], activation falls on the matter link, but the word is not marked, so the trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: matter compounds or legal terms
patterns.context: Appears in compounds such as subject-matter, light-matter, and fecal-matter, or alone to mean an issue to be resolved; also occurs in the legal term subject-matter jurisdiction.
patterns.domain: Legal, scientific, news, and email text

patterns.name: Archive-related names and paths
patterns.context: Appears in website link paths, Internet Archive-related names, or web directories.

patterns.name: Area in a place name
patterns.context: Appears in the proper name Bay Area, referring to the San Francisco Bay Area.

2_1092.concept: matter相关词形及少数专名/路径
2_1092.description: 主要响应 matter 及其复合表达（尤其 subject-matter、light-matter），也响应 Archive 相关名称或路径，以及专名 Bay Area；[6] 中激活落在 matter 链接上，但该词未标出，触发原因不明。

patterns.name: matter 复合词或法律术语
patterns.context: 出现在 subject-matter、light-matter、fecal-matter 等复合表达中，或单独表示待解决事项；也出现在 subject-matter jurisdiction 法律术语中。

patterns.name: Archive 相关名称与路径
patterns.context: 出现在网站链接路径、互联网档案馆相关名称或网页目录中。

patterns.name: 地名中的 Area
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Bay Area 中，指旧金山湾区。

en.description: Most paragraphs activate on word-initial capital U and subsequent digits/subword fragments, across domains and without shared semantic context; one other example activates on Area in “Bay Area”.

patterns.name: Capital U followed by a number or number-like subword
patterns.context: This fragment appears at the start of a word, abbreviation, or proper name; local contexts vary, with no unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: legislative text, web pages, medical literature, patents, encyclopedias, etc.

patterns.name: Area following a space, within or at the start of a word
patterns.context: Appears in “Bay Area”; the activation includes the preceding space and Area.

2_1092.description: 多数段落激活于词首大写 U 及其后续数字/子词片段，跨领域且缺少共同语义上下文；另有一例激活于“Bay Area”的 Area。

patterns.name: 大写 U 后接数字或数字样式的子词
patterns.trigger: 段 2–10 均以 «U» 开头，后接如 «10»；段 4、9 还标出 U 后续子词片段。
patterns.context: 该片段出现在词首、缩写或专名开头；局部上下文各异，不见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：议会文本、网页、医学文献、专利、百科等

patterns.name: 词内或词首的空格后 Area
patterns.context: 出现在“Bay Area”中，激活范围包含前导空格及 Area。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on Archive, the exacerbate stem, and sporadic internal word fragments; the latter two categories may reflect word-form substrings, but examples vary in meaning and domain, so no single clear condition explains all paragraphs.

patterns.name: Archive strings and related markers
patterns.context: Triggers occur in web links or titles, discussions of Internet archives, filenames/code identifiers, and C++ template type names; the specific meaning varies by context.

patterns.name: exacerbate stem
patterns.context: Embedded in English forms meaning to intensify or worsen; surrounding discussion concerns depression, economic problems, airway inflammation, or muscle weakness.

patterns.name: Irregular internal word fragments
patterns.context: Fragments occur inside longer words or identifiers without a shared obvious semantic condition; they may reflect multiple word-form/substring features.
patterns.domain: Medical, web, code, and general text

2_1092.description: 激活集中在 Archive 字样、exacerbate 词干，也散见于多种词内片段；后两类可能反映词形子串，但各例语义与领域不一，无法用单一明确条件解释全部段落。

patterns.name: Archive 字样及相关标记
patterns.trigger: «Archive»，包括路径中的 «Archive»10、代码标识符中的 «Archive»9
patterns.context: 触发出现在网页链接或标题、互联网存档讨论、文件名/代码标识符，以及 C++ 模板类型名中；具体含义随语境变化。

patterns.name: exacerbate 词干
patterns.context: 嵌在表示加剧、恶化的英语词形中；周围谈论抑郁、经济问题、气道炎症或肌无力。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 不规则词内片段
patterns.context: 片段落在较长词或标识符内部，没有共同的明显语义条件；可能反映多种词形/子串特征。
patterns.domain: 医学、网页、代码及一般文本

en.description: Activation falls mainly on the acerbate/worsen root and also appears in Archive strings; sporadic fragments occur in Wasserstein, cross-sectional, and group notation, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Forms meaning intensify or worsen
patterns.context: The root appears in contexts where a disease, symptom, or problem becomes more severe; the activated portion is segmented differently across paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, NIH project descriptions, informal economic discussion

patterns.name: Archive-related strings
patterns.context: Appears in web link paths or Archive identifiers in code; paragraph 8 also contains lowercase, unmarked archive.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of the proper name Wasserstein
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical notation or discussion of the Wasserstein distance.

patterns.name: Long-bone cross-section term
patterns.context: Appears in a compound term describing the cross-sectional area of a long bone.

patterns.name: Suzuki group notation
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical notation for finite groups.

2_1092.description: 激活主要落在 acerbate/加重词根，也出现在 Archive 字符串；另有 Wasserstein、cross-sectional 和群记号中的零散片段，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 加重与恶化形式
patterns.context: 该词根出现在疾病、症状或问题变得更严重的语境中；触发部分在各段有不同切分
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目描述、非正式经济讨论

patterns.name: Archive 相关字符串
patterns.context: 出现在网页链接路径或代码中的 Archive 标识符；段 8 另有小写的未标记 archive
patterns.domain: 网页目录、HackerNews 链接、代码

patterns.name: Wasserstein 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学论文对 Wasserstein 距离的记号或讨论中

patterns.name: 长骨截面术语
patterns.context: 出现在描述长骨横截面积的复合术语中

patterns.name: Suzuki 群记号
patterns.trigger: «_»（$^2B_2(q)$ 等群记号中的下标分隔符）
patterns.context: 出现在有限群的数学记号中

en.description: The strongest activations are concentrated on parallel (5 paragraphs) and placing (3 paragraphs), occurring respectively in contexts involving parallel relations and placing or positioning; there are also internal word fragments, line breaks, and scattered local activations across multiple domains, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: The word parallel
patterns.context: The word occurs in contexts describing parallel relations, parallel arrangements, or simultaneous activity; objects and domains vary.
patterns.domain: Chemistry, biomedicine, computer patents, materials and physics, mathematics, and legal texts

patterns.name: The word placing
patterns.context: Describes placing or positioning an object, or putting someone somewhere; objects include plant material, experimental animals, and witnesses.

patterns.name: Internal fragments and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Activation falls on split word fragments, mathematical symbols, or line-break markers rather than clearly meaningful whole words.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries and formatted mathematical papers

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in local phrases
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across common words or local phrases in specialized prose; no shared trigger as clear as parallel or placing is evident.

patterns.name: Other local function-word activations
patterns.context: Activation falls on sporadic words or fragments across paragraphs; their shared conditions cannot be determined from the available context.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions and encyclopedia entries

2_1092.description: 最强激活集中在 parallel（5段）和 placing（3段），分别出现在并行/平行关系及放置、安置语境；另有词内片段、换行和分散的局部激活，跨越多个领域，未显示统一语义。

patterns.name: parallel 一词
patterns.context: 该词出现在描述并行关系、平行排列或并列进行的语境中；对象和领域各异。
patterns.domain: 化学、生物医学、计算机专利、材料与物理、数学及法律文本

patterns.name: placing 一词
patterns.context: 描述把对象放置、安置或将某人置于某处；所涉对象包括植物材料、实验动物和证人。
patterns.domain: 专利、生物医学及法律文本

patterns.name: 词内片段与换行格式
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词片段、数学符号或换行标记上，而非明显的完整语义词。
patterns.domain: 百科条目及数学论文格式文本

patterns.name: 局部短语中的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活分布于专业叙述中的常见词或局部短语；未见与 parallel 或 placing 同样明确的共同触发项。

patterns.name: 其他局部功能词激活
patterns.context: 激活落在各段中零散的词或片段，无法从现有上下文确认其共同条件。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述及百科条目

en.concept: penetr- stem and related spelling patterns
