en.description: High activation is concentrated in the penetr- word family (penetrance or penetration/entry/depth), with additional responses to the inaccuracy family; the spelling fragment is shared, but the meanings span genetic expression, physical penetration, and measurement error.

patterns.name: penetrance word family
patterns.context: The trigger is the genetics term “penetrance,” describing genetic interactions in disease and reduced penetrance, tumorigenesis penetrance, and incomplete penetrance in autosomal dominant dystonia.

patterns.name: Penetration/entry
patterns.context: Triggers the “penetr-” stem and its variants, meaning molecules or particles entering tissue, a medium, or an internal space, or referring to penetration depth; objects and mechanisms vary.
patterns.domain: Mitochondrial biology, particle physics, neuroscience, optics, obstetrics and gynecology

patterns.name: inaccuracy word family
patterns.context: Triggers “inaccuracy” and word-form fragments referring to insufficient accuracy of measurements or methods; one example discusses disagreement between standards, while another lists errors and imprecision across different sample matrices.

2_1092.description: 高激活集中在 penetr- 词族（外显率或穿透、进入、深度），另对 inaccuracy 词族有响应；共享拼写片段，但语义分属遗传表达、物理穿透和测量误差。

patterns.name: penetrance 词族
patterns.context: 触发词是遗传学术语“penetrance”，分别描述疾病的遗传相互作用与降低的外显率、肿瘤生成的外显率，以及常染色体显性肌张力障碍的不完全外显率。
patterns.domain: 遗传学、肿瘤生物学、临床医学

patterns.name: 穿透/进入
patterns.context: 触发“penetr-”词干及其变化形式，表示分子或粒子进入组织、介质或体内空间，或穿透深度；对象和机制各异。
patterns.domain: 线粒体生物学、粒子物理、神经科学、光学、妇产科

patterns.name: inaccuracy 词族
patterns.context: 触发测量结果或方法准确性不足的“inaccuracy”及词形片段；前者讨论标准间结果不一致，后者列出不同样本基质中的误差与不精密性。

en.description: Most fragments activate on wet, covering wet weight, wet deposition, wet season, wet etching/chemistry, wet processes, and wet sludge; other non-wet activation terms occur in tent and dental contexts and cannot be explained by this word sense.

patterns.name: wetting / grain-boundary interfacial phenomena
patterns.context: Appears in “grain-boundary wetting,” describing wetting or pinning phenomena at grain boundaries or interfaces; wetting is split into a marked token.

patterns.name: wet weight measurement unit
patterns.context: Follows metabolite content and values in tissue, indicating measurement by wet weight.

patterns.name: wet deposition
patterns.context: Contrasted with dry deposition; refers to wet deposition of nitrogen- and phosphorus-containing aerosols and gases.

patterns.name: wet season
patterns.context: Contrasted with dry seasons as a seasonal comparison condition for fluoride concentrations.

patterns.name: wet etching
patterns.context: Describes a manufacturing process for etching metal layers with liquid chemical reagents.
patterns.domain: Patents, thin films, and metal processing

patterns.name: wet chemical methods
patterns.context: Appears as a technique category for synthesizing ZnO nanowires.

patterns.name: wet process
patterns.context: Describes wet processes that materials must withstand during circuit board manufacturing.

patterns.name: wet sludge
patterns.context: In the context of treating alcohol-distillation wastewater, describes sludge samples associated with suspended-solids concentrations.

patterns.name: Other highly activated content with no clear wet trigger
patterns.context: These fragments' high-activation markers do not fall on wet-related words; they concern folding tents and dental data analysis, with no obvious contextual connection to the other fragments' use of wet.

2_1092.description: 多数片段激活于 wet，涵盖湿重、湿沉降、湿季、湿法蚀刻/化学、湿制程及湿污泥；另有帐篷与牙科语境中的非 wet 激活词，无法由该词义统一解释。

patterns.name: wetting / grain-boundary界面现象
patterns.context: 出现在“grain-boundary wetting”中，描述晶界或界面的润湿、钉扎现象；wetting 被拆分为标记 token。

patterns.name: wet weight 测量单位
patterns.context: 紧接组织中代谢物含量及数值之后，表示按湿重计量。

patterns.name: wet deposition（湿沉降）
patterns.context: 与 dry deposition 对举，指含氮、磷气溶胶和气体的湿沉降。

patterns.name: wet season（湿季）
patterns.context: 与 dry seasons 对举，作为氟化物浓度的季节性比较条件。

patterns.name: wet etching（湿法蚀刻）
patterns.context: 描述用液体化学试剂蚀刻金属层的制造工艺。

patterns.name: wet chemical methods（湿化学法）
patterns.context: 作为合成 ZnO 纳米线的技术类别出现。
patterns.domain: 材料化学、纳米材料研究

patterns.name: wet process（湿制程）
patterns.context: 描述电路板制造过程中材料需要承受的湿制程。

patterns.name: wet sludge（湿污泥）
patterns.context: 在酒精蒸馏废水处理语境中，描述悬浮固体浓度所对应的污泥样品。

patterns.name: 其他无明显 wet 触发的高激活内容

patterns.name: 专名周边的零散短片段
patterns.context: 单次或少数出现，分别位于法院人员名单、人物介绍或技术问答中，缺少共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、百科、论坛问答

patterns.name: 图与网络术语片段
patterns.context: 图形界面标题或网络流量建模语境中出现，但标记并未覆盖这些完整词，且不构成稳定触发条件。

en.concept: Substrings within proper names and occasional word fragments
en.description: Strong triggers do not correspond to a single semantic theme: they are notably concentrated on substrings such as emb (Pembroke, pembrolizumab) and erm (Kermack, Kermanshah) within proper names; the remaining activations are scattered across local word fragments, place names, personal names, technical words, and formatting markers.

patterns.name: Pembroke / pembrolizumab string
patterns.context: The substring emb appears inside a proper name or drug name; it may cross capitalization and word-boundary positions and does not require a fixed meaning.
patterns.domain: Person and place entries, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Kermack string
patterns.context: The substring erm appears inside proper names; words with different origins and meanings can trigger it.

patterns.name: Isolated English word fragments
patterns.context: In technical sentences, the examples concern groom-ing ratio and uniform traffic; the marked portions are parts of words or phrases, with no consistent semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Isolated personal-name fragments
patterns.context: Appears in the personal name Agnes Mortimer; it occurs alongside the Pembroke string, but these markers themselves are not emb.

patterns.name: Isolated place-name fragments
patterns.context: Triggered in lists of Florida city and community names, often within a place name or part of one; there is no single shared meaning.

patterns.name: Isolated formatting markers and place-name fragments
patterns.context: Triggered in fragmentary table/template text in a wiki article; em also occurs in the spelling Pembro(keshire).

patterns.name: Isolated technical word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in a paper sentence about random lines and stationary processes of convex particles, scattered within or before several technical words.

patterns.name: Isolated epidemiology word fragments
patterns.context: Triggered in sentences describing worm transmission, infected hosts, and epidemiological models; apart from Kermack, these markers have no shared spelling pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated place-name fragments
patterns.context: Appears in a proper name for a tributary of Thunder River.

patterns.name: Isolated pharmaceutical word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in the anticancer drug names encorafenib and pembrolizumab; the latter also contains an emb trigger.

patterns.name: Isolated Persian place-name fragments
patterns.context: Appears in place-name entries for Shian and its province; Kermanshah is also triggered in the same paragraph.

2_1092.concept: 专名内部子串及偶发词片段
2_1092.description: 强触发并不对应单一语义主题：显著集中于 emb（Pembroke、pembrolizumab）和 erm（Kermack、Kermanshah）等专名内部子串；其余激活分散于各段中的局部词片段、地名、人名、技术词和排版标记。

patterns.name: Pembroke / pembrolizumab 字串
patterns.context: 子串 emb 出现在专名或药名内部；可跨越大小写及词界位置，不要求固定语义。
patterns.domain: 人物与地名条目、医学摘要

patterns.name: Kermack 字串
patterns.context: 子串 erm 出现在专名内部；不同词源和语义均可触发。
patterns.domain: 流行病学代码说明、地名条目

patterns.name: 孤立英语词片段
patterns.context: 在技术句中，分别涉及 groom-ing ratio、uniform traffic；被标记部分是词或词组的一部分，未显示一致语义条件。

patterns.name: 孤立人名词片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Agnes Mortimer 这一人名中；与 Pembroke 字串同时出现，但这些标记本身并非 emb。

patterns.name: 孤立地名词片段
patterns.context: 佛罗里达城市和社区名称列表中触发，常为地名词或其局部；没有单一共同词义。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的地名清单

patterns.name: 孤立排版标记与地名片段
patterns.context: 维基条目的残缺表格/模板文本中触发；em 同时位于 Pembro(keshire) 拼写中。
patterns.domain: 维基百科条目及标记文本

patterns.name: 孤立技术词片段
patterns.context: 出现在随机直线与凸粒子平稳过程的论文句子中，分散于多个技术词内或词前。

patterns.name: 孤立流行病学词片段
patterns.context: 描述蠕虫传播、感染主机及流行病模型的句子中触发；除 Kermack 外这些标记没有共同拼写模式。

patterns.name: 孤立地名词片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Thunder River 支流的专名中。

patterns.name: 孤立医药词片段
patterns.context: 出现在抗癌药名 encorafenib 与 pembrolizumab 中；后者还含 emb 触发。

patterns.name: 孤立波斯地名词片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Shian 及其所在省份的地名条目中；同段另有 Kermanshah 触发。

en.concept: No stable unified concept; biased toward local word fragments and proper nouns
en.description: Activations are scattered across terminology, proper nouns, and Wikipedia structural markers. Several occur in split name/citation fragments such as K-es, but examples from networking, physics, and place names have no consistent semantics.

patterns.name: K-es strings and continuations
patterns.context: Markers occur in the K-es character sequence in personal names, paper authors/references, or newspaper names; sometimes activations fall on name fragments split by tokenization.
patterns.domain: ArXiv references and author names, medical citations, historical newspapers

patterns.name: Surface tensors and random convex particles
patterns.context: Describes random lines, convex particles, and surface tensor estimation.

patterns.name: Network traffic modeling terminology
patterns.context: Technical description of nodes in a SONET ring network and fully connected traffic.

patterns.name: Proximity-induced Josephson junctions
patterns.context: Discusses π junctions in nanowires and topological insulators.

patterns.name: Vortex flow and shear stiffness
patterns.context: Studies material properties through vortex flow experiments in confined geometries.

patterns.name: West Welsh place names and Wikipedia markup
patterns.context: Templates, line breaks, and Welsh place-name fields split by tokenization in place-name articles.

patterns.name: Thunder River article title
patterns.context: Uses Thunder River as a disambiguation title and lists tributary names.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic terms
patterns.context: Markers occur separately in violence-related text, an Indian personal name, a common adjective, and a fragment of a television host's name; no shared local semantics or stable syntactic condition is evident.

2_1092.concept: 无稳定统一概念；偏向局部词片段与专名
2_1092.description: 激活分散于术语、专名及维基结构标记中；多处落在 K-es 等拆分的姓名/引文片段，但网络、物理、地名等例子并无一致语义。

patterns.name: K-es 字符串及其续写
patterns.context: 标记出现在人名、论文作者/参考文献或报刊名称中的 K-es 字符序列；有时激活落在被分词拆开的名字内部片段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 参考文献与作者名、医学引文、历史报刊

patterns.name: 表面张量与随机凸粒子
patterns.context: 描述随机直线、凸粒子及其表面张量估计。

patterns.name: 网络流量建模术语
patterns.context: SONET 环形网络节点与全互连流量的技术描述。
patterns.domain: 计算机网络／运筹学论文

patterns.name: 邻近诱导的约瑟夫森结
patterns.context: 讨论纳米线和拓扑绝缘体中的 π 结。

patterns.name: 涡旋流动与剪切刚度
patterns.trigger: « forcing» the vortices to flow；« confined» geometries；shear « rigidity»
patterns.context: 通过受限几何中的涡旋流动实验研究物性。

patterns.name: 西威尔士地名及维基标记
patterns.context: 地名条目中的模板、换行符和被分词拆开的威尔士地名字段。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科／结构化条目

patterns.name: Thunder River 条目标题
patterns.context: 以 Thunder River 为消歧标题并列出河流支流名称。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科／地名消歧条目

patterns.name: 待解释的零散词项
patterns.context: 标记分别落在暴力、印度人物姓名、普通形容词和电视节目主持人姓名片段中；未见共同的局部语义或稳定句法条件。
patterns.domain: 历史百科与人物／电视百科

en.concept: Short letter strings in proper names
en.description: Primarily activates on short letter strings such as em, ous, and es within proper names, including place names, personal names, company names, and newspaper names. Several one-off triggers occur in ordinary words, terminology, and proper-name fragments, without a stable pattern.

patterns.name: em inside proper names
patterns.context: The activated fragment is the letter substring em within a proper name, often in a place name, county name, company name, or personal name; local spelling environments vary.

patterns.name: ous in proper names
patterns.context: Appears inside a personal name or a proper system name.

patterns.name: es in proper names
patterns.context: Appears in a personal name, surname, or newspaper name.

patterns.name: Other short fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Sporadic activations fall in ordinary words, proper-name fragments, or terminology; no stable shared spelling or semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, historical and geographic encyclopedias, business emails

2_1092.description: 主要对专名内部的短字母串 em、ous、es 等激活，涉及地名、人名、公司名及报刊名；另有若干只出现一次的普通词、术语和专名片段，无法归入稳定模式。

patterns.name: 专名中间的 em
patterns.context: 激活片段是专名内部的字母子串 em，常出现在地名、县名、公司名或人名中；局部拼写环境各不相同

patterns.name: 专名中的 ous
patterns.context: 出现在人名或专有系统名称内部
patterns.domain: 论文作者信息、天文学论文

patterns.name: 专名中的 es
patterns.context: 出现在人名、姓氏或报纸名称中

patterns.name: 专名中的其他短片段
patterns.context: 零散激活，分别落在普通词、专名片段或术语中；未见稳定的共同拼写或语义条件
patterns.domain: 学术论文、历史与地理百科、商务邮件

en.concept: Internal letter fragments in proper nouns
en.description: Activations occur mainly on short letter fragments inside personal names, place names, or other proper nouns, especially em and kes; they also cover iem and ous. Domains and syntax vary widely, with no clear semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: kes/ker syllable fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activations fall on the kes letter fragment inside a personal name or proper noun; capitalization and following letters vary.
patterns.domain: Proper nouns in academic history, news history, and legal documents

patterns.name: em syllable and adjacent letter fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on the em letter fragment inside proper nouns, commonly personal names, place names, or company names; the surrounding letters vary.
patterns.domain: Proper nouns in encyclopedias, emails, legal and historical texts

patterns.name: iem letter fragment
patterns.context: Activations occur on the iem sequence inside a surname.
patterns.domain: Personal names in legal case citations

patterns.name: ous letter fragment
patterns.context: Activations occur on the ous sequence inside an author's surname.

2_1092.description: 激活主要落在人名、地名或其他专名内部的短字母片段，尤其是 em、kes；也覆盖 iem、ous。领域和句法差异很大，没有明显语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 人名中的 kes/ker 音节片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名或专名内部的 kes 字母片段；大小写和后续字母不固定。
patterns.domain: 学术史、新闻史、法律文书中的专名

patterns.name: em 音节及相邻字母片段
patterns.context: 激活在专名内部 em 字母片段，常见于人名、地名或公司名；片段前后字母各异。
patterns.domain: 百科、邮件、法律与历史文本中的专名

patterns.name: iem 字母片段
patterns.context: 激活在姓氏内部的 iem 字母序列。
patterns.domain: 法律判例引注中的人名

patterns.name: ous 字母片段
patterns.context: 激活在作者姓氏内部的 ous 字母序列。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on the strings es and em within proper names or words, and also responds to line breaks and markup in Wikipedia source; other word fragments are scattered and lack shared semantics.

patterns.name: Within-word Kes/Les syllables
patterns.context: Appears within proper names or words, often as part of a given name, surname, or place name; activation concentrates on the es string rather than a unified meaning.

patterns.name: Pem string
patterns.context: Embedded in place names or institution/company names beginning with P.

patterns.name: HTML line breaks and markup fragments
patterns.context: Appears near templates or table markup in Wikipedia articles; activated tokens include both line breaks and markup text.

patterns.name: Sporadic English word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in different words or proper names, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition; some fragments are adjacent and form a name or phrase.
patterns.domain: Historical narratives, emails, legal texts, encyclopedias, medical papers

2_1092.description: 激活主要落在专名或词语内部的 es 与 em 字符串，也会响应维基百科源码中的换行和标记；另有多种分散的词片段，缺乏共同语义。

patterns.name: 词内 Kes/Les 音节
patterns.context: 出现在专名或词语内部，常为名字、姓氏或地名的一部分；激活集中于 es 字符串，而非统一词义。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术论文、法律文本

patterns.name: Pem 字符串
patterns.context: 嵌在以 P 开头的地名或机构/公司名称中。

patterns.name: HTML 换行及标记片段
patterns.context: 出现在维基百科条目的模板或表格标记附近；激活 token 既包括换行符，也包括标记文本。

patterns.name: 零散英文词片段
patterns.context: 出现在不同词语或专名中，未见稳定的共同语义或句法条件；有的片段相邻组成名字或短语。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、邮件、法律文本、百科、医学论文

en.concept: Proper nouns and word-internal letter fragments
en.description: Activations occur mainly on short letter fragments inside proper nouns, such as em/Kem and Kes/Key, and also hit sporadic substrings in other proper nouns or common words. They span multiple domains and have no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: em/kem fragments inside words
patterns.context: Activations fall on substrings inside words such as em or Kem/Kem; adjacent characters or capitalization sometimes vary.
patterns.domain: Place names, proper nouns, software code, web configuration, and general text

patterns.name: Kes/Key fragments in surnames
patterns.context: Activations occur in personal names or surnames beginning with K, including letter sequences around kes.

patterns.name: Rare letter fragments inside other proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations hit short letter sequences inside proper nouns; their positions and specific letter combinations do not fully match the main pattern.
patterns.domain: Orthopedic device names and place-name lists in encyclopedia articles

patterns.name: Fragments in common words or stems
patterns.context: Markers occur on short substrings in configuration text or common words; surrounding semantics are not clearly related to the main proper-noun pattern.
patterns.domain: HTML email, server configuration, and encyclopedia device lists

2_1092.description: 激活主要落在 em/Kem 及 Kes/Key 等专名内部的短字母片段，也命中其他专名或普通词中的零散子串；跨多领域、无稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 单词内部的 em/kem 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 em 或 Kem/Kem 这类词内部的子串上；有时邻近字符或大小写有所不同。
patterns.domain: 地名、专名、软件代码、网页配置及一般文本

patterns.name: 姓氏中的 Kes/Key 片段
patterns.context: 激活位于以 K 开头的人名或姓氏中，包含 kes 一带的字母序列。

patterns.name: 其他专名内部的稀有字母片段
patterns.context: 激活命中专名内部的短字母序列；位置和具体字母组合与主要模式不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 百科条目中的骨科器械名称及地名列表

patterns.name: 一般词汇或词干中的片段
patterns.context: 标记落在配置文本或一般词汇中的短子串；周围语义与主要专名模式关联不明显。
patterns.domain: HTML 邮件、服务器配置与百科器械列表

en.description: Activations often fall on short substrings within words or proper names, commonly em or es/em after K, across many writing styles. Other scattered triggers include word fragments, numbers, markup, and line breaks, with no clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “em” substring and nearby lowercase letter combinations
patterns.context: Activation falls on em embedded in words or markup; common in place names, proper names, paths, or code, with numbers or symbols also preceding or following em in some examples.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments with a K prefix
patterns.context: Appears within proper names, especially personal names, place names, or device names; K followed by es or em is attested.

patterns.name: Other within-word substrings
patterns.context: A few activations fall on unrelated words, numbers, markup, or line breaks, with no stable shared semantic or formatting condition.
patterns.domain: Emails, encyclopedias, papers, legal texts, configuration, code

2_1092.description: 激活多落在单词或专名内部的短子串，常见 em、K 后的 es/em；跨多种文体，另有零散词片段、数字、标记与换行激活，语义规律不明显。

patterns.name: “em”子串及邻近小写字母组合
patterns.context: 激活落在嵌于单词或标记中的 em；常见于地名、专名、路径或代码，部分例子中 em 前后还有数字或符号。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本、维基条目、代码

patterns.name: 含 K 前缀的专名片段
patterns.context: 出现在专有名称内部，尤其是人名、地名或器械名称中；可见 K 后接 es 或 em。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、名单、维基百科

patterns.name: 其他词内子串
patterns.context: 少量激活落在不相同的词、数字、标记或换行符上，未显示稳定的共同语义或格式条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科、论文、法律文本、配置、代码

en.description: Most fragments suggest word-internal substring triggers: “em” in Wembley occurs in accounts of stadiums, matches, and performances. Other scattered word-internal fragments, code symbols, and markup activations lack a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Wembley place name
patterns.context: Activations occur inside the proper noun Wembley; contexts discuss football matches, national teams, stadiums, performances, or commemorations

patterns.name: Other word-internal fragments containing em
patterns.context: Activations occur inside words rather than as standalone words. The first two examples occur in title/link text and a Wikipedia infobox place name, respectively, with no apparent semantic link to Wembley

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Piscataway/Pemiscot place names
patterns.context: Activations occur on a word-initial fragment in the county name Pemiscot; describes patrol locations during the American Civil War

patterns.name: Bonus in track annotations
patterns.context: Activations occur at the beginning of Bonus in a track listing, followed by “audio stereo tracks”

patterns.name: Configuration directives and markup
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across fragments of port numbers, line-break markers, and certificate paths; the context is Nginx SSL configuration

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in proper nouns or place names
patterns.context: Activations occur in several adjacent place-name segments; the provided text is insufficient to identify a shared trigger condition
patterns.domain: Local election and administrative-area Wikipedia narratives

patterns.name: Table-of-contents marker
patterns.context: A letter fragment in a Wikipedia article's table-of-contents marker; nearby content includes a place-name infobox

2_1092.description: 多数片段显示词内子串触发：Wembley 中的「em」见于球场、比赛和演出叙述；另有若干分散的词内片段、代码符号及标记激活，缺乏统一语义条件。

patterns.name: Wembley 地名
patterns.trigger: «em»9 + 后续的「bley」或「bley Stadium」；片段中呈现为 W«em»9bley、W«em»9bley Arena
patterns.context: 激活落在专名 Wembley 的词内；上下文谈及足球比赛、国家队、球场、演出或纪念活动
patterns.domain: 体育与场馆相关百科叙述

patterns.name: 其他含 em 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于词中，而非独立词；前两例分别出现在标题/链接文字及维基信息框地名中，未显出与 Wembley 的语义联系
patterns.domain: 邮件网页片段、维基百科信息框

patterns.name: Piscataway/Pemiscot 地名词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于县名 Pemiscot 的开头词内片段；描述南北战争时期驻军巡逻地点

patterns.name: 音轨标注中的 Bonus
patterns.context: 激活落在音轨列表的 Bonus 一词开头，后接“audio stereo tracks”
patterns.domain: 音乐专辑/视频音轨说明

patterns.name: 配置指令与标记
patterns.context: 激活分散在端口号、换行标记及证书路径的若干片段；上下文为 Nginx SSL 配置
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答/代码配置

patterns.name: 专名或地名中的零散片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多个相邻地名词段中，所给文本不足以判断共同触发条件
patterns.domain: 地方选举与行政区维基叙述

patterns.name: 目录标记
patterns.context: 维基条目目录标记中的字母片段；附近另有地名信息框内容

en.description: Primarily activates on the em substring, especially in Wembley; also appears in Pembrokeshire, Wemyss, email strings, and code markers. A few activations occur on scattered words, paths, and newline markers, with no stable shared semantics.

patterns.name: em fragment within the place name Wembley
patterns.context: Activation falls on the em substring inside words; most instances are Wembley, with some in Pembrokeshire and Wemyss.
patterns.domain: Place names, geography, and sports reporting

patterns.name: em substring in Ruby/Rails code
patterns.context: Inside strings in code or email subjects; not observed as a standalone word.

patterns.name: em substring in structural markers
patterns.context: Adjacent to HTML/Wiki markup, such as the organization field in a vcard fragment; context may be markup or formatted text.

patterns.name: Other locally unrelated fragments
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across natural language or academic text, with no stable shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Historical narratives, politics, and academic papers

patterns.name: Paths and newline markers in code
patterns.context: Appears in Ruby source paths and code structures, differing from the dominant em substring pattern.

2_1092.concept: 含 em 的字符串片段
2_1092.description: 主要激活在 em 子串上，尤其是 Wembley，也出现在 Pembrokeshire、Wemyss、邮件字符串及代码标记中；少数另激活于分散词语、路径和换行标记，未见稳定共同语义。

patterns.name: Wembley 地名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的 em 子串；多数是 Wembley，也有 Pembrokeshire、Wemyss。

patterns.name: Ruby/Rails 代码中的 em 子串
patterns.context: 代码或邮件标题中的字符串内部；未见它作为独立词。

patterns.name: 结构标记中的 em 子串
patterns.trigger: «em»，位于 “<em>” 字样的分词片段中
patterns.context: 与 HTML/维基标记相邻，如 vcard 片段中的组织字段；上下文可能是标记或格式化文本。

patterns.name: 局部无明显关联的其他片段
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在自然语言或论文文本中，未显示稳定的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、政治及学术论文

patterns.name: 代码中的路径与换行标记
patterns.context: 出现在 Ruby 源码路径和代码结构中，与主导的 em 子串模式不同。

en.description: Activations are scattered across em/Gem strings, HTML markup, proper-name fragments, and words from multiple domains. Capitalization, word boundaries, and token boundaries vary, so these examples do not establish a single semantic or syntactic trigger condition.

patterns.name: HTML tags and markup boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur inside HTML tags, at tag-text boundaries, or on line-break markers; [1] also includes the URL fragment before the filename spacer.gif.

patterns.name: em or adjacent string fragments
patterns.context: The substring em occurs inside different words or in HTML markup; the feature may be sensitive to the em character sequence, but trigger positions and word meanings are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Web, code, place names, and general text

patterns.name: GEM/Gem strings
patterns.context: Gem strings with differing capitalization or word boundaries occur in Ruby namespaces, author names, drug names/abbreviations, and comments; some examples distribute activations across adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: Code, academic papers, medical texts, comments

patterns.name: Fragments inside proper nouns or words
patterns.context: Activations occur on word-internal fragments in domains, place names, personal names, or paths; the examples lack a unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Web, encyclopedias, paper citations, configuration files

patterns.name: Specific common or technical words
patterns.context: Activations occur respectively in energy headlines, TLS configuration, physics, oncology, comments, and Bayesian inverse problems; no shared word meaning or syntactic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: News headlines, configuration, physics, medicine, comments, statistics

2_1092.concept: 字符串片段与标记特征
2_1092.description: 激活分散于 em/Gem 字符串、HTML 标记、专名片段及多领域词语；有大小写、词界和 token 边界差异，无法从这些例子确认单一语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: HTML标签与标记边界
patterns.context: 激活落在 HTML 标签内部、标签文本边界或换行标记上；[1] 中还包括文件名 spacer.gif 前的 URL 片段。
patterns.domain: 网页片段、百科标记、代码

patterns.name: em 或相邻字符串片段
patterns.context: 子串 em 出现在不同词内或 HTML 标记中；可能对 em 字符序列敏感，但触发位置与词义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 网页、代码、地名与普通文本

patterns.name: GEM/Gem 字符串
patterns.context: 大小写或词界不同的 gem 字符串，见于 Ruby 命名空间、作者姓名、药名/缩写和评论文本；有些例子激活分布在相邻 token 上。
patterns.domain: 代码、学术论文、医学文本、评论

patterns.name: 专名或词语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在域名、地名、人名或路径中的词内片段；现有例子缺少统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页、百科、论文引用、配置文件

patterns.name: 特定普通词或技术词
patterns.context: 激活分别出现在能源标题、TLS 配置、物理、肿瘤学、评论和贝叶斯反问题等语境；未见共同的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻标题、配置、物理、医学、评论、统计学

en.description: Activations are distributed across diverse within-word fragments (especially em), plus a few fragments in code, mathematics, and physics texts. They span domains and contexts, with no unified semantics or stable contextual condition.

patterns.name: em substring within words or at word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter sequence em, which may occur within a word or correspond to part of a standalone word; there is no clear semantic or syntactic requirement.
patterns.domain: Multidomain text: place names, personal names, medical terminology, common vocabulary

patterns.name: Markers and path fragments in code
patterns.context: Paths, newline characters, and Ruby constants appear in code or markup languages; activation is distributed across different code substrings, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Stem fragment opt
patterns.context: A within-word fragment of minimization in a mathematics paper discussing optimization problems and Bayesian inverse problems.

patterns.name: Stem fragment rot
patterns.context: A within-word fragment of rotating in a physics paper describing a spatial rotation system.

2_1092.description: 激活分布在多种词内片段（尤以 em 为突出）及少量代码、数学和物理文本片段上；跨领域、跨语境，未见统一语义或稳定上下文条件。

patterns.name: 词内或词边界处的 em 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在 em 字母序列上；它可处于词中，也可对应独立词的一部分，没有明显一致的语义或句法要求。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本：地名、人名、医学术语、普通词汇

patterns.name: 代码中的标记与路径片段
patterns.context: 代码或标记语言中出现路径、换行符和 Ruby 常量；激活分布在不同代码子串上，未见明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 词干片段 opt
patterns.context: 数学论文中 minimization 一词的词内片段，周围讨论优化问题及贝叶斯逆问题。

patterns.name: 词干片段 rot
patterns.context: 物理学论文中 rotating 一词的词内片段，描述空间旋转系统。

en.concept: Detection of the character fragment em
en.description: The most stable commonality is the character fragment em: it appears across semantics and domains, often embedded in words or identifiers. Bes and various sporadic within-word and formatting fragments also activate, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Gem substring
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter sequence em, regardless of capitalization; it may occur within a word or as part of a Ruby namespace, with no unified semantic context.
patterns.domain: Programming, forums, encyclopedias, email, and patent texts

patterns.name: Bes substring
patterns.context: Activation falls on within-word substrings in the name Besov and the common English word beside; their meanings differ.

patterns.name: Rare within-word fragments
patterns.context: Markers are scattered across words, identifiers, formatting symbols, and typographic fragments; there is no consistent word meaning or contextually verifiable shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: ArXiv, email HTML, encyclopedia tables, etc.

2_1092.concept: 字符片段 em 检测
2_1092.description: 最稳定的共同点是字符片段 em：它跨语义和领域出现，常嵌在词中或标识符中。另有 Bes 及多种零散词内、格式片段激活，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: Gem 子串
patterns.trigger: «em»（[1]中的 «G«em»10::Specification、[2]中的 «deep»3G«em»10、[4]中的 P«em»10iscot、[5]中的 P«em»10ex、[8]中的 P«em»10brokeshire、[10]中的 G«em»9tuzumab）
patterns.context: 激活落在大小写不定的 em 字母序列上；可位于词内，也可作为 Ruby 命名空间中的一部分，未见统一语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 跨编程、论坛、百科、邮件及专利文本

patterns.name: Bes 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在 Besov 名称和普通英语单词 beside 的词内子串上，二者语义不同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文；生物医学论文

patterns.name: 稀有词内片段
patterns.context: 标记散布于词语、标识符、格式符及排版片段；没有一致的词义或可由上下文确认的共同触发条件。

en.description: Many activations occur on letter fragments such as em/gem, commonly in Gem names, drug names, or word-internal substrings. Other sporadic activations occur in academic terms, names, template markup, and URLs, making it difficult to group them into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: gem/related spelling fragments
patterns.context: Triggers are embedded in different words or identifiers: Ruby's `Gem::Specification`, the personal name `Gemelke`, the drug name `Gemtuzumab`, `deepGem`, the cancer drugs `gemcitabine`/`GemCis`, and truncated or cross-word fragments such as `Pem`.
patterns.domain: Code, academic papers, medical literature, forum text, web

patterns.name: em-related word-internal infix
patterns.context: Activations occur on letter fragments inside words; word meanings and syntactic conditions vary.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in paper terminology
patterns.context: In academic discussions of inverse problems and Bayesian inference, activations are distributed across multiple terms and word fragments, with no single clear trigger word.

patterns.name: Patent medical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of antibody-conjugated antitumor antibiotics; these words share a medical/drug context, but it is unclear whether they have a stable shared form feature.

patterns.name: Short words and markup symbols
patterns.context: Short fragments occur near encyclopedia templates, line breaks, and table fields; their connection to other activation patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Citation and author-name fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in academic citations or author names, resembling sporadic name/citation fragments rather than a consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Fragments in a PI3K pathway paragraph
patterns.context: Occurs in a medical paper paragraph about prostate cancer and the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway; a single paragraph is insufficient to determine the trigger condition.

patterns.name: Web address fragment
patterns.context: Embedded in the URL `rigzone.com`, surrounded by webpage image links and a news headline.

2_1092.description: 多段激活落在 em/gem 一类字母片段中，常见于 Gem 名称、药名或词内子串；另有学术词、姓名、模板标记和网址等零散激活，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: gem/相关拼写片段
patterns.context: 触发部分嵌在不同词或标识符中：Ruby 的 `Gem::Specification`、人名 `Gemelke`、药名 `Gemtuzumab`、`deepGem`、癌症药物 `gemcitabine`/`GemCis`，以及 `Pem` 等截断或跨词片段。
patterns.domain: 代码、学术论文、医学文献、论坛文本、网页

patterns.name: em 相关词中缀
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的字母片段；词义和句法条件不一致。

patterns.name: 零散论文词片段
patterns.context: 在逆问题与贝叶斯推断的学术表述中，激活分布于多个术语和词片段，未显示单一明确触发词。

patterns.name: 专利医学表达
patterns.context: 出现在抗体偶联抗肿瘤抗生素的描述中；这些词语共同属于医学/药物语境，但是否存在稳定的共同词形特征不明确。

patterns.name: 短词与标记符
patterns.context: 百科模板、换行及表格字段附近出现的短片段；与其他激活模式的联系不清楚。

patterns.name: 引用与作者名片段
patterns.context: 出现在学术文献引用或作者姓名中，像是零散的姓名/引用片段，而非一致的语义触发。

patterns.name: PI3K 通路段落中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在前列腺癌与 PI3K/Akt 信号通路的医学论文段落中；单段证据不足以确定触发条件。

patterns.name: 网页地址片段
patterns.context: 嵌在网址 `rigzone.com` 中，周围为网页图片链接和新闻标题。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的网页内容

en.description: Primarily sensitive to em/Gem letter fragments and their case variants, often within words, proper names, drug names, or code identifiers. There are also sporadic activations on newline markers and several scattered word fragments, without consistent context.

patterns.name: Gem/letter fragments
patterns.context: Appears in varied capitalization within words; sometimes embedded in proper names, chemical drugs, or code identifiers.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, cancer medicine, Ruby/Gem code, place names, or table text

patterns.name: Newline markers
patterns.context: The newline character itself is marked, often at Wiki markup or code paragraph boundaries.

patterns.name: Fragments in specific words
patterns.context: These words or word fragments activate in isolated contexts, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including papers, forums, encyclopedias, and email

2_1092.description: 主要对 em/Gem 字母片段及其大小写变体敏感，常位于词内或专名、药物名、代码标识中；另有换行标记与若干分散词片段的零散激活，缺少一致上下文。

patterns.name: Gem/字母片段
patterns.context: 大小写不一，出现在词内部；有时嵌在专名、化学药物或代码标识中。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、癌症医学、Ruby/Gem代码、地名或表格文本

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 换行符自身被标记，常出现在维基标记或代码段落边界。

patterns.name: 特定词语片段
patterns.context: 这些词或词片段在孤立语境中激活，未见稳定共同的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 论文、论坛、百科、邮件等多种文体

en.description: The most stable signal is activation on the em letter sequence, regardless of capitalization, often embedded in names, terminology, or identifiers. Several other sporadic fragments that do not share this spelling or semantics are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: em substring embedded in strings
patterns.context: Activation often falls on the em letter sequence inside longer words or identifiers; instances span code, personal names, place names, terminology, and drug names, with no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains: Ruby code, academic papers, Wikipedia, medical literature, etc.

patterns.name: Within-word variants of em with different capitalization
patterns.context: Activation also occurs on differently capitalized word fragments that are not spelled em, in proper names, titles, or common words; these do not match the dominant em substring pattern.
patterns.domain: Academic citations, place names and historical narratives, web page titles, forum text

patterns.name: Other sporadic within-word fragments
patterns.context: A few activations fall on common words or URL substrings, with no obvious commonality in meaning or context.
patterns.domain: Papers, email web content, forum discussions

2_1092.description: 最稳定的迹象是激活落在大小写不定的 em 字母串中，常嵌于名称、术语或标识符；另有若干不共享该拼写或语义的零散片段，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 嵌入字符串中的 em 子串
patterns.context: 激活常落在较长单词或标识符内部的 em 字母串中；这些实例横跨代码、姓名、地名、术语和药物名，未见一致的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 多领域：Ruby 代码、学术论文、维基百科、医学文献等

patterns.name: 大小写 em 的词内变体
patterns.context: 激活也出现在大小写不同、并非 em 拼写的词片段中，分别位于专名、标题或普通词语里；与主要的 em 子串模式不一致。
patterns.domain: 学术引用、地名与历史叙述、网页标题、论坛文本

patterns.name: 其他零散词内片段
patterns.context: 少数激活落在普通词或 URL 子串中，语义和上下文彼此缺乏明显共同点。
patterns.domain: 论文、邮件网页内容、论坛讨论

en.description: Activations are scattered across within-word fragments, with em/gem and several fragments containing similar letters being most prominent. They span code, proper names, and scientific text, with no stable semantic or contextual condition.

patterns.name: Gem / gem word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on contiguous letter fragments in gem, appearing in project names, place names, drug names, or drug abbreviations; sometimes it covers only part of gem.
patterns.domain: Code, encyclopedias, patent background, medical papers

patterns.name: Other word fragments containing Em
patterns.context: Activation falls on scattered subword fragments within longer words or proper names, with no consistent meaning or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Historical narratives, email, academic papers, institutional profiles

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Beyond the fragments above, activations occur in code symbols, common words, scientific terminology, and proper names, with no stable shared context.

2_1092.description: 激活分散于词内片段，较显眼的是 em/gem 及若干含相似字母的片段；覆盖代码、专名和科学文本，未见稳定语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: Gem / gem 词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 gem 的连续字母片段上，出现在项目名、地名、药名或药物缩写中；有时只覆盖 gem 的一部分。
patterns.domain: 代码、百科、专利背景、医学论文

patterns.name: 带 Em 的其他词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在更长词或专名内部的零散子词片段，未见一致的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、邮件、学术论文、机构介绍

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 除上述片段外，激活分布在代码符号、普通词、科学术语及专名中；未见稳定的共同上下文。

en.concept: Detection of the word-internal substring «em» (partial match)
en.description: The most prominent common clue is the word-internal fragment «em», often in gem/GEM. However, activations also mark many fragments and boundary markers that do not share this substring or meaning. They span domains and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: gem substring
patterns.context: Trigger markers occur across word boundaries or on word-internal fragments; the word need not be the sentence topic.
patterns.domain: Code, physics, place names, energy emails, biomedicine, forum comments, machine learning papers, and other styles

patterns.name: Confounding word-internal fragments
patterns.context: The shown fragments have no stable shared meaning; markers sometimes occur inside words and may be unrelated to the gem pattern.
patterns.domain: Papers, encyclopedias, email, comments, and code

patterns.name: Boundaries and special markers
patterns.context: Activation markers occur near line breaks or fragment boundaries; context does not establish whether they correspond to meaningful textual triggers.

2_1092.concept: 词内子串«em»检测（部分吻合）
2_1092.description: 最显著的共同线索是词内片段«em»，常见于 gem/GEM；但激活也标在多种不共享该子串或词义的片段及边界标记上，跨领域分布，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: gem 子串
patterns.context: 触发标记落在跨词边界或词内片段上；并不要求该词是句子主题。
patterns.domain: 代码、物理学、地名、能源邮件、生物医学、论坛评论、机器学习论文等多种文体

patterns.name: 易混淆的词内片段
patterns.context: 在所示片段里没有稳定的共同词义；标记有时位于词内部，可能与 gem 模式无关。
patterns.domain: 论文、百科、邮件、评论及代码

patterns.name: 边界及特殊标记
patterns.context: 激活标记落在换行或片段边界附近，无法从上下文确定它们是否对应有意义的文本触发。

en.concept: Within-word em substrings and miscellaneous features
en.description: The most stable signal is the em letter sequence within words, appearing across multiple corpora. There are also sporadic activations on code newlines, medical terminology, physics vocabulary, place names, and several domain-specific phrases; they cannot be grouped into a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments containing em
patterns.context: Activation falls on the em letter sequence inside words, often preceded by a consonant or uppercase letter; word meanings and contexts vary widely.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains: academic papers, patents, encyclopedias, email, etc.

patterns.name: Newlines and indentation in code
patterns.context: In Ruby configuration or source code, a newline is followed by indented code; occurs after require lines or before configuration statements.

patterns.name: Medical and cancer-related words
patterns.context: Cancer research, antitumor drugs, or cholangiocarcinoma treatment; activation markers are distributed across medical words and drug-name fragments.

patterns.name: Chemical/physics terminology and rotation systems
patterns.context: Discussion of the Lorentz force in a spatial rotation system, near citations to physics literature.

patterns.name: Social ecology and school safety
patterns.context: Discusses school safety and multilevel, multicomponent prevention interventions.

patterns.name: Place-name or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Appears in place names, administrative regions, or proper names in encyclopedia entries; there are also scattered activations beyond the em fragment.

patterns.name: Mnemonic context for crypto wallets in code
patterns.context: A JavaScript configuration declares a mnemonic string, followed by mnemonic content.

patterns.name: Energy-sector phrases in web email
patterns.context: A web page title or link text in an email mentions a dry gas discovery.

patterns.name: Song tracks and audio information
patterns.context: Album or concert track listings and bonus audio descriptions.

2_1092.concept: 词内 em 子串及杂项特征
2_1092.description: 最稳定的信号是词内 em 字母串，跨多种语料出现；此外还对代码换行、医学术语、物理词汇、地名及若干领域专属短语有零散激活，不能归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 含有 em 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的 em 字母串，左侧常为辅音或大写字母；词义和上下文差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：学术论文、专利、百科、邮件等

patterns.name: 代码中的换行及缩进
patterns.context: Ruby 配置或源码中，换行后接缩进代码；出现于 require 行后或配置语句前。

patterns.name: 医学与肿瘤相关词语

patterns.context: 触发词出现在询问整数是否为质数、列出质因数或讨论质数的数学题中；常邻近 factors、number、变量或数字。

patterns.name: 中草药用途与民间食品
patterns.context: 描述某种物质或植物用于缓解症状、治疗疾病，以及作为民间药物或食物摄入。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，医疗或传统用途描述

patterns.name: 月经相关表达
patterns.context: 月经综合征作为运动效果研究中的对象出现。

patterns.name: X 射线与指导水平
patterns.context: 讨论基于调查的 X 射线技术条件及相关指导水平。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，医学暴露或辐射技术

patterns.name: 中枢神经系统病毒
patterns.context: 以中枢神经系统为语境，提及麻疹病毒。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter，生物医学研究描述

patterns.name: 植物微 RNA 与甲基化处理
patterns.context: 研究无植原体病原体的泡桐植物中微 RNA 及其靶标，并提到甲基甲磺酸酯处理。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，植物分子生物学

en.description: Activations are scattered across substrings within words, ordinary words, numbers, commas, and mathematical symbols. They span mathematics, addresses, encyclopedias, and biomedicine; aside from local characters or punctuation, no consistent semantic or contextual pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Substrings within words and word-boundary fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on complete words or fragments within different words, with no consistent positional, morphological, or semantic condition; some fragments arise from subword tokenization.
patterns.domain: Math problems, medical abstracts and patents, encyclopedia entries, research texts, etc.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric sequences
patterns.context: Answers or values in math problems, as well as numbers in street addresses; the contexts vary.

patterns.name: Punctuation: commas
patterns.context: Commas in lists or addresses; some are marked, but the surrounding text and uses vary.
patterns.domain: Patent text, addresses, and general text

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols between words
patterns.context: In math problems, occurring between variables and equations.

patterns.name: Surname or place-name fragments
patterns.context: Street-name and city-name fragments in the address “12 17 W Fayette St Baltimore”.

patterns.name: Immunology and lung research terminology
patterns.context: Research sentences describing immune lung diseases and the role of alveolar macrophages.

patterns.name: Biomedical vocabulary unexplained by a shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: Sentences about bile acid, cholesterol, and phospholipid metabolism; their only connection to other passages is a broad biomedical domain, which does not explain why the neuron activates at these specific positions.

2_1199.concept: none
2_1199.description: 激活分散在词内子串、普通词、数字、逗号和数学符号上。涵盖数学、地址、百科及生物医学等场景；除局部字符或标点外，看不出一致语义或上下文规律。

patterns.name: 词内子串与词边界碎片
patterns.trigger: «ist»、« the»、« prime»；«uan»、«jin»、« pre»、«stru»、« syndrome»；« removal»、« allev»、«iation»、« parasites»、« treatment»；«T»、«ir»、«ahi»、« language»；«Running»；«In»、« such»、« as»；«B»、«ile»、«acids»、«coord»、«in»、«ately»、«hepat»、«bios»
patterns.context: 激活落在不同词的完整形式或词内片段上；没有一致的词位、词形或语义条件，部分词片段因子词切分而出现。
patterns.domain: 数学题、医学摘要与专利、百科条目、科研文本等

patterns.name: 数字及数值序列
patterns.context: 数学题中的答案或数值，以及街道地址中的数字；这些数字所在场景不同。

patterns.name: 标点逗号
patterns.context: 出现在并列项目或地址中的逗号，部分逗号被标记，但周围文本与用途不一致。
patterns.domain: 专利文本、地址及一般文本

patterns.name: 词语之间的数学符号
patterns.context: 数学题中，出现在变量与等式表达式之间。

patterns.name: 姓氏或地名片段
patterns.context: 地址“12 17 W Fayette St Baltimore”中的街道名和城市名片段。

patterns.name: 免疫与肺部科研术语
patterns.context: 描述免疫性肺部疾病及肺泡巨噬细胞作用的科研句子。

patterns.name: 无法由共享触发模式解释的生物医学词汇
patterns.context: 胆汁酸、胆固醇及磷脂代谢相关句子；与其他段落仅有宽泛的生物医学领域联系，无法说明神经元为何在这些特定位置激活。

en.description: All fragments are labeled with the letter k; it can appear in mathematical expressions, across word fragments, or in ordinary words, with varied domains and meanings. The main shared feature is the character k.

patterns.name: The letter k or a following subword
patterns.context: Strong response to words or subword fragments beginning with the letter k; sometimes k is marked alone, and sometimes together with a following word fragment.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including mathematics, medical abstracts, patents, parliamentary texts, and academic titles

2_1199.concept: 字母 k
2_1199.description: 所有片段均标记字母 k；它可出现在数学表达式、跨词片段或普通词中，领域与词义各异，主要共同点是字符 k。

patterns.name: 字母 k 或其延续子词
patterns.context: 对字母 k 起始的词或子词片段有明显响应；有时 k 单独标记，有时与其后续词片段共同出现。
patterns.domain: 数学、医学摘要、专利、议会文本、学术标题等多种文体

en.description: Primarily responds to prime and its derived collocations in mathematics, including prime factors, primality testing, and prime factorization; there are also a few activations on the initial letter of kappa and on the immunological use of prime/boost.

patterns.name: Prime factors and primality testing
patterns.context: Math questions and discussions about whether an integer is prime, finding prime factors, or discussing prime factors; also includes the use of “prime divisor” in group theory.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics math Q&A; ArXiv number theory and group theory

patterns.name: Kappa/lambda light chains
patterns.context: Quantification of immunoglobulin light chains in medical abstracts; activation falls on the initial letter of “kappa,” rather than on a prime-related use.

patterns.name: Prime/boost immunization regimen
patterns.context: A vaccination regimen involving priming and booster immunization; “prime” does not mean a prime number.

2_1199.concept: prime相关词形及搭配
2_1199.description: 主要响应数学中“prime”及其派生搭配，涵盖素因子、素数判定和素数因子化；另对kappa首字母及免疫学prime/boost用法有少量激活。

patterns.name: 素数因子与素数判断
patterns.context: 出现关于整数是否为素数、求素因子或讨论素数因子的数学问题与论述；也包括群论中“prime divisor”的用法。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 数学问答；ArXiv 数论与群论

patterns.name: kappa/lambda 轻链
patterns.context: 医学摘要中免疫球蛋白轻链定量语境；激活落在“kappa”首字母，而非素数相关用法。

patterns.name: prime/boost 免疫方案
patterns.context: 疫苗接种方案中先导免疫与加强免疫的语境；“prime”不是素数。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究计划

en.concept: Multiple uses of prime and related collocations
en.description: Strongly responds primarily to prime in number theory and its collocations with factors, factorization, and coprimality; it also responds to prime in biomedicine (primary target, vaccine priming) and a few unrelated word fragments, indicating that the trigger is not a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Prime as a number-theoretic term
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical or number-theoretic contexts to mean a prime number, prime factorization, or coprimality; sometimes triggered by a phrase ending in prime.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, number theory papers and problems

patterns.name: Prime in immunology
patterns.context: Appears in biomedical texts to mean a primary target or a vaccine priming/boosting regimen; not the number-theoretic meaning.

patterns.name: Other triggers in immunological contexts
patterns.context: Descriptions of lung disease and activated alveolar macrophages in immunology passages; the activation location has no clear relation to prime.

patterns.name: Trigger in kappa light-chain quantification context
patterns.context: Appears in medical descriptions of total kappa/lambda light chain quantification; may be triggered by a segmented kappa subword fragment.

2_1199.concept: prime 的多义用法及相关搭配
2_1199.description: 主要对数论中的 prime 及其因子、分解和互素搭配强烈响应；也响应生物医学里的 prime（主要靶点、疫苗初免）及少数无关词片段，说明触发并非单一语义模式。

patterns.name: prime 作为素数术语
patterns.context: 出现在数学或数论语境中，指素数、素因子分解，或互素关系；有时以 prime 结尾的短语触发。

patterns.name: 免疫学中的 prime
patterns.context: 出现在生物医学文本中，分别表示主要靶点，或疫苗接种的初免/加强方案；并非数论含义。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、生物医学研究计划

patterns.name: 免疫学语境中的其他触发
patterns.context: 免疫学段落中关于肺部疾病及活化肺泡巨噬细胞的描述；激活位置与 prime 无明显关系。

patterns.name: kappa 轻链量化语境中的触发
patterns.context: 出现在 total kappa/lambda light chain quantification 的医学描述中；可能由被拆分的 kappa 词片段触发。

en.concept: Specific character sequences and symbol fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across texts from multiple domains. More evident local patterns include k followed by 9, C followed by 10, and fragments in biochemical, medical, and mathematical symbols; no stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: The letter k adjacent to the number 9
patterns.context: The number 9 directly follows the letter k; occurs in both ordinary text and mathematical notation. Activation does not require a particular domain or syntax.

patterns.name: C adjacent to the number 10
patterns.context: The number 10 directly follows uppercase C, commonly in chemical names, formulas, or abbreviations.

patterns.name: The string Le before Leu
patterns.context: The Le portion of the amino acid abbreviation Leu is activated, appearing in peptide compound names.

patterns.name: Specific EEG letter fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the abbreviation EEG, but only the G is marked; the surrounding text is a title-like phrase about brain function and the post-hypoxic state.

patterns.name: Analyzed in a mass analysis term
patterns.context: Appears in the mass spectrometry term phrase “Mass-analyzed ion kinetic energy spectra”.
patterns.domain: Mass spectrometry and chemical physics texts

patterns.name: Phox cell names
patterns.context: Appears in the names of Phox2b-positive or -negative cells, in discussions of synaptic transmission blockade and rhythmogenesis.

patterns.name: Ion and fluorescent indicator symbols
patterns.context: Appears in Ca2+ and the fluorescent calcium indicators Fluo-3 and Indo-1; activation falls on chemical symbols or name fragments.

patterns.name: NF-kappa-B-related fragments
patterns.context: Appears in names of immune signaling pathways such as I-kappa-B-kinase and NF-kappa-B.

patterns.name: Mathematical graph theory notation
patterns.context: Symbol and variable fragments are activated in expressions involving the maximum genus of a graph, algorithms, and inequalities.

patterns.name: Other sporadic chemical and biomedical fragments
patterns.context: Appears in terms such as copper-zinc superoxide dismutase, bone marrow, and lymphoblasts; there is insufficient evidence to establish a more stable shared trigger pattern.

2_1199.concept: 特定字符序列及符号片段
2_1199.description: 激活分散在多领域文本中，较明显的局部模式是 k 后接 9、C 后接 10，以及生化、医学和数学符号中的片段；看不出稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 字母 k 与数字 9 的邻接
patterns.context: 字母 k 后紧接数字 9；在普通文本和数学记号中均出现。激活不要求特定领域或句法。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、ArXiv 数学文本

patterns.name: C 与数字 10 的邻接
patterns.context: 大写字母 C 后紧接数字 10，常见于化学名称、化学式或缩写。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、化学相关文本

patterns.name: Leu 前的 Le 字符串
patterns.context: 氨基酸缩写 Leu 中的 Le 部分被激活，出现在肽类化合物名称中。

patterns.name: 特定 EEG 字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在缩写 EEG 中，但只标记其中的 G；周围是脑功能与缺氧后状态的标题式表述。

patterns.name: 质量分析术语中的 analyzed
patterns.context: 出现在“Mass-analyzed ion kinetic energy spectra”这一质谱术语短语中。

patterns.name: Phox 细胞名称
patterns.context: 出现在 Phox2b 阳性或阴性细胞的名称中，讨论突触传递阻断和节律发生。

patterns.name: 离子与荧光指示剂符号
patterns.context: 出现在 Ca2+ 及荧光钙指示剂 Fluo-3、Indo-1 的名称中；激活落在化学符号或名称片段上。
patterns.domain: 细胞成像与神经科学摘要

patterns.name: NF-kappa-B 相关片段
patterns.context: 出现在 I-kappa-B-kinase 与 NF-kappa-B 等免疫信号通路名称中。
patterns.domain: 免疫学与肝脏生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 数学图论记号
patterns.context: 在图的最大 genus、算法及不等式表达式中，符号和变量片段被激活。

patterns.name: 其他零散化学与生物医学片段
patterns.context: 在铜锌超氧化物歧化酶、骨髓及淋巴母细胞等术语中出现；各自没有足够证据构成更稳定的共同触发模式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与生物化学摘要

en.description: The most consistent trigger is the As/as substring in varying capitalization, embedded in abbreviations such as GaAs and Asn as well as appearing as the standalone English word as; fragments of romanized names also activate.

patterns.name: AS10 subword boundary
patterns.context: High activation falls on the As/as string in varying capitalization or its initial subword; it appears in GaAs, the amino acid abbreviation Asn, and ordinary English as.

patterns.name: Romanized fragment in a personal name
patterns.context: Appears in the romanized personal name “Romanized as Khaẕar Gūr…”, rather than in ordinary syntax as as.

patterns.name: Unexplained proper-name fragment
patterns.context: Fragment 8 also activates on other character fragments in romanized names; its relationship to the main repeated As/as trigger is unclear.

2_1199.concept: As/as 字符串检测
2_1199.description: 最稳定触发是大小写不一的 As/as 子串，既嵌在 GaAs、Asn 等缩写中，也独立作为英语 as；另有罗马化人名片段激活。

patterns.name: AS10子词边界
patterns.context: 高激活落在大小写不同的 As/as 字符串或其开头子词上；分别出现在 GaAs、Asn 氨基酸缩写和普通英语 as 中。
patterns.domain: 科学摘要、专利、议会文本

patterns.name: 人名中的罗马化片段
patterns.context: 出现在罗马化人名“Romanized as Khaẕar Gūr…”中，而非普通句法中的 as。

patterns.name: 未解释的专名片段
patterns.context: 片段8还激活于罗马化人名的其他字符片段；与主要重复的 As/as 触发关系不明。

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on uppercase O and the string But. The former occurs across many languages and domains; the latter appears both as a conjunction and embedded in chemical and bacterial genus names. There is also As in GaAs, with no apparent unified semantics.

patterns.name: Fragments related to uppercase O
patterns.context: Uppercase O appears alone or as the initial of a following word; it may be preceded by a space or span token fragments.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: mathematics, medicine, Finnish/Hungarian/Italian, and EU texts

patterns.name: But as a word-initial string or standalone conjunction
patterns.context: The English conjunction But at the beginning or within a sentence; one activation also appears in the chemical name « But»10HN, possibly as an internal substring.

patterns.name: Butyricoccus initial substring
patterns.context: The substring But appears in the gut microbial genus name Butyricicoccus; this differs from the standalone conjunction But.

patterns.name: As fragment
patterns.context: Appears as the element symbol As in the chemical formula GaAs.

2_1199.concept: 特定大写字母串
2_1199.description: 强激活主要落在大写 O 及 But 字符串上，前者跨多种语言和领域，后者既作转折词也嵌于化学名及菌属名；另有 GaAs 中的 As，难见统一语义。

patterns.name: 大写 O 相关片段
patterns.context: 大写 O 独立出现，或作为后续词的词首；周围可有空格，也可能跨越分词片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：数学、医学、芬兰语/匈牙利语/意大利语及欧盟文本

patterns.name: But 词首或独立转折词
patterns.context: 英语句首或句中转折词 But；另有一次触发出现在化学名称 « But»10HN 中，可能是词内子串。

patterns.name: Butyricoccus 词首子串
patterns.context: 肠道微生物属名 Butyricicoccus 中出现 But 子串；与独立转折词 But 不同。

patterns.name: As 片段
patterns.context: 作为化学式 GaAs 中元素符号 As 出现。

en.description: Activations occur across parliamentary texts in several European languages, on scattered substrings within proper names, procedural terms, and ordinary words. The most conspicuous repetition is word-initial O, but the following word forms and meanings vary widely, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Oslo- or Norway-related proper names
patterns.context: Word-initial O is marked with the highest activation, but subsequent word forms and meanings vary; some are proper names and others ordinary words.

patterns.name: Parliamentary procedure and agenda terminology
patterns.context: Word forms concerning questions, resolutions, agendas, or meeting matters in parliamentary speeches; activation occurs at different subword positions within words.

patterns.name: Fragments of personal or institutional names
patterns.context: Several strong markers occur around personal names, titles, or proper names; not all characters in the names are marked.
patterns.domain: References to people and institutions in parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Subword fragments across languages
patterns.context: Across Finnish, Estonian, Dutch, and other texts, markers fall on short fragments within words, with no stable shared meaning or syntactic function.

patterns.name: Unexplained scattered triggers
patterns.context: Isolated letters, fragments within words, or abbreviations activate, with insufficient surrounding context to establish a connection to other patterns.

2_1199.concept: none
2_1199.description: 激活遍布多种欧洲语言的议会文本，落在专名、程序词及普通词的零散词内片段上；重复最明显的是词首 O，但其后词形和含义差异很大，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: Oslo／挪威相关专名
patterns.context: 词首 O 被标为最高激活，但后续词形和语义各异；有些是专名，有些是普通词。
patterns.domain: 多语种欧洲议会辩论文本

patterns.name: 议会程序与议程术语
patterns.context: 议会发言中关于问题、决议、议程或会议事项的词形；激活分布于词内不同子词位置。

patterns.name: 人名或机构名称片段
patterns.context: 人名、称谓或专名周边出现多个较强标记；并非所有姓名字符都被标记。
patterns.domain: 议会发言中的人物与机构指称

patterns.name: 多语种词内碎片
patterns.context: 跨芬兰语、爱沙尼亚语、荷兰语等文本，标记落在词内短片段，缺乏稳定的共同词义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 解释不明的离散触发
patterns.context: 孤立的字母、词内片段或缩写激活，周边语境不足以确立与其他模式的联系。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in multilingual European Parliament records, on proper names, institution or agenda names, and ordinary words beginning with O/o; there are also activations on numbers and many sporadic subwords. The pattern may be influenced by word-initial position and tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: O-initial names related to member states or places
patterns.context: European Parliament speeches contain personal names, place names, institution names, or agenda/document titles beginning with O; the O occurs mid-sentence or sentence-initially, often with unusual capitalization or following subword fragments.

patterns.name: O-initial words in parliamentary proceedings and formal speeches
patterns.context: Ordinary words beginning with o/O appear within sentences, especially in formal speeches, agendas, or statements; the same passage may also contain O-initial proper names.

patterns.name: Number immediately following O
patterns.context: Numbers appear in agenda items, dates, or sequence numbers after a period; an O-initial word may be nearby, but activation falls on the number.

patterns.name: Sporadic subword activation at tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Short subword fragments occur within or at the beginning of words in multiple languages, with no stable meaning; they often co-occur in the same passage as the O-initial words above.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary records; may reflect tokenization or spelling features

2_1199.concept: O/o 起始词片段
2_1199.description: 激活集中于欧洲议会多语种记录中 O/o 起始的专名、机构议题名及普通词，另有数字和大量零碎子词激活；模式可能受词首及分词边界影响。

patterns.name: 成员国/地名相关的 O 起始名称
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言中出现以 O 起始的人名、地名、机构名或议题/文件名；目标 O 位于句中或句首，常有特殊大小写或后续子词片段。

patterns.name: 议事与正式发言中的 O 起始词
patterns.context: 句中出现以 o/O 开始的普通词，尤其在正式议事发言、议程或陈述中；同一段也可能含 O 起始专名。

patterns.name: O 后紧接数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在句点后的议题、日期或序号中，附近可能有 O 起始词，但激活标在数字上。

patterns.name: 分词边界处的零碎子词激活
patterns.trigger: 如 « k»3、« te»2、« v»2 等散布于芬兰语、爱沙尼亚语、匈牙利语、荷兰语和波兰语文本
patterns.context: 多语种词内部或词首出现短子词片段，未显示稳定词义；往往与上述 O 起始词同段共现。
patterns.domain: 多语种议事记录；可能反映分词或拼写特征

en.description: All passages mark word-initial O/o subwords, including in ordinary words, proper names, and compounds; several other subword fragments activate sporadically across languages without an evident shared feature.

patterns.name: O-initial fragments in places or proper names
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated around word-initial O/o; the following forms are words or proper names in different languages, including both sentence-initial words and word-initial elements within proper names.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European parliamentary debates and reports; Lithuanian, Finnish, Hungarian, Dutch, Estonian, Romanian, etc.

patterns.name: Occasional high activation on O within words
patterns.context: The marked unit is primarily the word-initial O/o subword, not a stable complete-word meaning; the same subword occurs in ordinary words (e.g., «O»9«lem«me») as well as proper names and compounds, with highly variable strength.
patterns.domain: Cross-lingual parliamentary corpus; specific word meaning varies by language and context

patterns.name: Scattered activations on non-O subwords
patterns.context: Besides the recurring word-initial O/o, word-initial or within-word fragments in several different words also activate; these fragments lack stable shared morphological, semantic, or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Scattered vocabulary and inflected forms in the same multilingual European parliamentary corpus

2_1199.concept: 词首 O/o 子词检测
2_1199.description: 所有段落都标记了词首 O/o 子词，涵盖普通词、专名和复合词；另有若干跨语言、无明显共同点的词内片段零散激活。

patterns.name: 地点或专名中的 O 起始片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在词首 O/o 附近；后续拼接为不同语言的词或专名，既包括句首词，也包括专名内部的词首。
patterns.domain: 多语言欧洲议会辩论及报告；立陶宛语、芬兰语、匈牙利语、荷兰语、爱沙尼亚语、罗马尼亚语等

patterns.name: 词内子词 O 的偶发高激活
patterns.context: 被标记的主要是词首 O/o 子词，而不是稳定的完整词义；同一子词出现在普通词（如«O»9«lem«me»）和专名、复合词中，且强度差异较大。
patterns.domain: 跨语言议会语料；具体词义随语言和上下文变化

patterns.name: 非 O 子词的零散激活
patterns.context: 除反复出现的词首 O/o 外，若干不同词的词首或词内片段也有激活；这些片段彼此缺乏稳定的共同词形、语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 同一多语言欧洲议会语料中的零散词汇与屈折形式

en.description: Primarily activates on the uppercase letter O: in multilingual European Parliament texts, it often occurs at the beginning of a proper name or sentence-initial word; it also activates on O in the patent chemical formula AgCuO.

patterns.name: O-initial uppercase proper names or word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on an uppercase O at the beginning of a word, followed by a proper name or an uppercase word at the beginning or within a sentence; O need not stand alone as a word.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European Parliament speeches; also chemical formulas in patent technical texts

patterns.name: O in a chemical formula
patterns.context: O occurs in the chemical formula for silver copper oxide, followed by a stoichiometric number; it is not an ordinary uppercase word initial.

2_1199.concept: 大写字母 O
2_1199.description: 主要对大写字母 O 激活：欧洲议会多语种文本中常位于专名或句首词开头；另在专利化学式 AgCuO 中对 O 激活。

patterns.name: O 开头的大写专名或词形
patterns.trigger: “O” 后接大写字母或专名片段，如 «O»10slon、«O»10mbudsmani、«O»9uld、«O»9lemme、«O»9tsustame、«O»9laszország、«O»9ma、«O»9ost、«O»9ssétia
patterns.context: 激活落在词首大写 O 上，后续接专名或句首/句中大写词；并不要求 O 独立成词。
patterns.domain: 多语种欧洲议会发言；另有专利技术文本中的化学式

patterns.name: 化学式中的 O
patterns.context: O 出现在银铜氧化物化学式中，后接化学计量数字；不是普通词首大写词。

en.concept: The character O and its word-initial position
en.description: All activations fall on words or symbols beginning with O/O: place names, personal names, institutional terms, ordinary words, and the chemical symbol for oxygen. Languages and topics vary, with no narrower shared context apparent.

patterns.name: Oslo proper name in Finnish parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Finnish parliamentary text; activation occurs in a context discussing the need for a process and mentioning the proper name Oslo.

patterns.name: Estonian EU institutions and Ombudsman
patterns.context: Estonian text describing experience with European Parliament administration and mentioning the European Ombudsman.

patterns.name: Lithuanian personal name Ould Sidi Ali
patterns.context: Lithuanian parliamentary speech congratulating or welcoming a delegation; activation occurs on the name prefix Ould.

patterns.name: Oxygen symbol in a chemical formula
patterns.context: Patent background describing silver-copper oxide battery materials; activation falls on O in the chemical formula.

patterns.name: O-initial words in a Finnish passage
patterns.context: Finnish parliamentary text containing O-initial words such as olemme (“we are/have”); the passage also discusses industry, consumer confidence, and measures.

patterns.name: O-initial part of the Italian country name
patterns.context: Hungarian parliamentary text mentioning Italy; activation falls on the beginning of the word for Italy.

patterns.name: Dutch place name Ostsee
patterns.context: Dutch parliamentary vote of thanks discussing an exhibition about the Baltic Sea (Oostzee).

patterns.name: Otsustame in the Estonian parliamentary agenda
patterns.context: Estonian text discussing the meeting agenda and decisions; activation is at the beginning of Otsustame (“we decide”).

patterns.name: Oxygen in Italian environment and transport text
patterns.context: Italian encyclopedia passage discussing environmentally friendly travel and using Oxygen as a proper name; activation occurs at the start of the name.

patterns.name: Ochrony in a Polish parliamentary committee name
patterns.context: A Polish parliamentary report title includes the name of an environmental protection committee; activation occurs at the beginning of Ochrony (“protection”).
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Polish agenda and committee report

2_1199.concept: O 字符及其词首
2_1199.description: 各段激活都落在以 O/O 开头的词或符号上：地名、人名、机构词、普通词、化学式氧符号均有；语言与主题多样，未见更窄的共同语境。

patterns.name: 芬兰语议会发言中的 Oslo 专名
patterns.context: 芬兰语议会文本；在谈及需要某项进程、并出现 Oslo 专名的语境中激活。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语欧盟机构与 Ombudsman
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语中介绍欧洲议会行政事务经验，并提到欧洲 Ombudsman。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语人名 Ould Sidi Ali
patterns.context: 立陶宛语祝贺或欢迎代表团的议会发言；人名前缀 Ould 处激活。

patterns.name: 化学式中的氧符号
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述银铜氧化物电池材料；激活落在化学式 O 上。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利，电化学与材料

patterns.name: 芬兰语段落中的 O 开头词
patterns.context: 芬兰语议会文本，出现 olemme（“我们是/已经”）一类 O 开头词；同段还谈工业、消费者信任与措施。

patterns.name: 意大利语国名 O 开头部分
patterns.context: 匈牙利语议会文本中提到意大利；激活落在意大利国名意为“意大利”的词的开头。

patterns.name: 荷兰语 Ostsee 地名
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会致谢发言，谈到有关波罗的海（Oostzee）的展览。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语议会日程中的 Otsustame
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语文本讨论会议日程与决定；激活在 Otsustame（“我们决定”）词首。

patterns.name: 意大利语环境与交通文本中的 Oxygen
patterns.context: 意大利语百科段落讨论环保出行，以 Oxygen 作为专名；激活在该名称开头。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会委员会名称中的 Ochrony
patterns.context: 波兰语议会报告标题中出现环境保护委员会名称，激活在 Ochrony（“保护”）词首。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，波兰语议程与委员会报告

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and terminology patterns
en.description: Some activations cluster around the fixed mathematical-paper expression “in the sense of”; the rest are distributed across intraword fragments in multilingual European Parliament texts and chemical formulas, with no unified semantic interpretation so far.

patterns.name: Cu/O fragments in chemical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in silver copper oxide formulas; activation covers the element symbols and the digits following them.

patterns.name: “sense of” expression in mathematical literature
patterns.context: Appears after a mathematical term or definition in “in the sense of …,” specifying the meaning of a definition, concept, or name; most often occurs mid-sentence.

patterns.name: Intraword subword fragments in Finnish
patterns.context: Triggers are scattered within or at the beginnings of words in continuous Finnish text, across several different word forms; the local context is insufficient to infer a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Dutch intraword fragments and Oostzee environmental issues
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within or at the beginnings of Dutch words; this passage specifically discusses projects, environmental protection, and the Baltic region.

patterns.name: Hungarian intraword fragments and Olaszország
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within or at the beginnings of Hungarian word forms; this passage mentions crisis response measures and Italy.

patterns.name: Ombudsman in a Dutch title
patterns.context: Appears in the Dutch title of a special report by the European Ombudsman, with multiple words and intraword fragments marked.

2_1199.concept: 混合的词片段与术语模式
2_1199.description: 激活一部分集中在数学论文固定用语“in the sense of”；其余分布于多语种欧洲议会文本的词内片段及化学式，暂无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 化学式中的 Cu/O 片段
patterns.context: 出现在银铜氧化物化学式中；激活覆盖元素符号及其后的数字。

patterns.name: 数学文献中的 sense of 用语
patterns.context: 数学术语或定义后出现 “in the sense of …”，用于指明某定义、概念或命名的意义；多出现在句中。

patterns.name: 芬兰语中的词内子词片段
patterns.context: 触发分散在芬兰语连续文本的词内或词首，涉及多个不同词形；局部上下文不足以归纳为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段及 Oostzee 环境议题
patterns.context: 激活分布于荷兰语词语内部或词首；该段具体谈及项目、环境保护及波罗的海地区。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段及 Olaszország
patterns.context: 激活分布于匈牙利语词形内部或词首；该段提到危机应对措施及意大利。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会匈牙利语文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语标题中的 Ombudsman
patterns.context: 出现在欧洲监察专员特别报告的荷兰语标题中，多个词及词内片段均被标记。

en.description: Activations are scattered across O in chemical formulas, but in organic compound names, mathematical asymptotic notation and formula fragments, as well as O/o and Finnish word-form fragments in multilingual texts; no single semantic pattern explains all instances.

patterns.name: O/o letters in Latin-script languages
patterns.context: Activation falls on uppercase or lowercase O/o, often within or at the beginning of words, across several languages; no stable semantic or morphological condition surrounds the letter.
patterns.domain: Code comments, Finnish, Estonian, Portuguese, Romanian, and other natural-language texts

patterns.name: O in chemical formulas
patterns.context: The oxygen symbol O appears in inorganic chemical formulas, adjacent to other element symbols or stoichiometric subscripts.
patterns.domain: Patent battery backgrounds, condensed-matter physics/superconductivity research

patterns.name: but in chemical names
patterns.context: The but stem occurs in organic compound names, surrounded by substituents, hyphens, or suffixes.

patterns.name: as in mathematical text
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the asymptotic notation asymp; the same passage also contains mathematical symbols and formulas.

patterns.name: Finnish word-form fragments
patterns.context: Several activation fragments are distributed across Finnish inflected words, affixes, and stems rather than concentrated in a single complete word.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous formula markers
patterns.context: Activations occur near summation formulas, subscripts/superscripts, and asymptotic symbols; some markers are common mathematical typesetting elements, which alone do not establish a unified trigger condition.

2_1199.concept: 字母与短片段
2_1199.description: 激活散布于化学式的 O、有机物名称中的 but、数学渐近记号和公式片段，以及多语言文本中的 O/o 与芬兰语词形片段；尚无单一语义模式能解释全部实例。

patterns.name: 拉丁语种中的 O/o 字母
patterns.trigger: «O»（如段 3 的“FUNÇÃ«O»”、段 6 的“vahvaa« O»slon”、段 8 的“« O»mbudsmani”、段 9 的“ÇÃ«O»”、段 10 的“« O»magh”）
patterns.context: 激活落在大小写 O/o 上，常见于词中或词首，涉及多个不同语言；该字母周围没有稳定的特定语义或词法条件。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、芬兰语、爱沙尼亚语、葡萄牙语、罗马尼亚语等自然语言文本

patterns.name: 化学式中的 O
patterns.context: 氧元素符号 O 出现在无机化学式中，邻接其他元素符号或化学计量下标。
patterns.domain: 专利电池背景、凝聚态物理/超导研究

patterns.name: 化学名称中的 but
patterns.context: 作为有机化合物名称中的 but 词干，周围有取代基、连字符或后缀。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、天然产物/化学命名

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 as
patterns.context: 出现在渐近记号 asymp 的开头；同段也有数学符号与公式。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 多个激活片段分布在芬兰语屈折词、词缀及词干中，而非集中于单个完整词。

patterns.name: 杂项公式标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在求和公式、下标/上标及渐近符号附近；其中部分标记是常见数学排版成分，无法由其单独确定统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 数学论文与 LaTeX 公式

en.description: Activations mainly occur on character-level fragments, especially O in chemical formulas; they also cover code punctuation, Finnish word fragments, biomedical abbreviations, random strings, and mathematical notation, making a single semantic theme difficult to infer.

patterns.name: Oxygen symbol O in chemical formulas
patterns.context: O occurs in inorganic chemical formulas, material compositions, or similar chemical notation; it also activates in a few garbled texts, though it is unclear whether the trigger is the same.
patterns.domain: Electrochemistry, superconductivity, photocatalysis, and garbled text

patterns.name: Symbols and code punctuation
patterns.context: In C function declarations, annotated function names, or comments, commas and fragments of function names activate.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Finnish
patterns.context: Occurs in subword fragments of continuous Finnish words, alongside spaces and commas; activations fall on multiple suffixes or intraword fragments.

patterns.name: SFCAs and butyric fragments
patterns.context: Appears in a biomedical abstract on fecal sample testing methods, involving SFCAs and 2-ethylbutyric acid.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric fragments in random strings
patterns.context: In high-entropy, nearly random identifiers or encoded strings, activations are scattered across single letters and short substrings, with no clear semantic context.

patterns.name: Symbols in garbled legal text
patterns.context: In damaged, barely legible legal document fragments, markers fall on slashes and letters.

patterns.name: log and k in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in asymptotic estimate formulas, where log, the variable k, O notation, and punctuation are marked.

patterns.name: Unmarked ordinary prose
patterns.context: Activation markers mainly fall on adjacent chemical formulas or keywords, rather than ordinary semantic content in the current passage.

2_1199.concept: 字符级符号与子串
2_1199.description: 激活主要落在字符级片段，尤其是化学式中的 O；但也覆盖代码标点、芬兰语词片段、生物医学缩写、随机字符串及数学记号，难以由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 化学式中的氧符号 O
patterns.trigger: «O»，尤其是 AgCu«O»、Cu«O»、Ti«O»2；另有异常噪声串中的 «O»
patterns.context: O 位于无机化学式、材料组成或类似化学记号中；少数乱码文本中也激活，无法确认是否同一触发条件
patterns.domain: 电化学、超导、光催化及乱码文本

patterns.name: 符号与代码标点
patterns.context: 在 C 语言函数声明或被标注的函数名、注释中，逗号及函数名片段被激活

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 在芬兰语连续词语的子词片段中出现，伴随词间空格和逗号；激活落在多个词缀或词内片段上

patterns.name: SFCAs 与 butyric 的片段
patterns.context: 出现在粪便样本检测方法的生物医学摘要中，涉及 SFCAs 及 2-ethylbutyric acid

patterns.name: 随机字符串中的字母数字片段
patterns.context: 高熵、近似随机的标识符或编码字符串中，激活散布于单字母及短子串，缺少明显语义上下文

patterns.name: 乱码法律文本中的符号
patterns.context: 字符损坏、难以辨读的法律文档片段中，标记落在斜线及字母字符上

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 log 与 k
patterns.context: 出现在渐近估计公式中，log、变量 k、O 记号及标点被标记

patterns.name: 未标记的普通叙述
patterns.trigger: 未见可辨识的共同触发子串
patterns.context: 激活标记主要落在相邻的化学式或关键词上，而非当前片段中的普通语义内容

en.description: Activations are distributed across specific within-word fragments in multiple domains: O in chemical formulas, but in organic names, ro in oligodendroglia terms, and scattered fragments in Portuguese comments and mathematical symbols. No single semantic or stable domain theme is apparent.

patterns.name: O in oxygen-containing/elemental chemical formulas
patterns.context: Activation falls on O in chemical formulas, especially representations of oxides or compounds containing copper and titanium.
patterns.domain: Patent batteries, superconducting materials papers, photocatalysis abstracts

patterns.name: but in organic chemical nomenclature
patterns.context: Activation falls on the but fragment in organic compound names or descriptions of molecular structures.

patterns.name: ro in microorganism/cell names
patterns.context: Activation falls within oligodendroglia/oligodendroglial, referring to oligodendrocytes or their origin.
patterns.domain: Neuroscience, biomedical abstracts or funding texts

patterns.name: Word-final letters in Portuguese function names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in Portuguese code comments concerning labels such as “function start/main function”; it is distributed across multiple letter fragments within words.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, C code and Portuguese comments

patterns.name: F in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Activation falls on different occurrences of the set-/matching-related symbol F in a Pfaffian formula.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers, graph theory and algebraic notation

patterns.name: as in asymptotic notation
patterns.context: Activation falls on the as letter fragment in the asymptotic comparison symbol \asymp.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers, number theory or asymptotic analysis

2_1199.concept: none
2_1199.description: 激活分布在多种领域中特定词内片段：化学式的 O、有机名称的 but、少突胶质细胞词中的 ro，以及葡萄牙语注释和数学符号的零散片段。未见单一语义或稳定领域主题。

patterns.name: 含氧/元素化学式中的 O
patterns.context: 激活落在化学式里的 O，尤其是氧化物或含铜、钛的化合物表示中。
patterns.domain: 专利电池、超导材料论文、光催化摘要

patterns.name: 有机化学命名中的 but
patterns.context: 激活落在 but 片段，出现在有机化合物名称或分子结构描述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、天然产物化学

patterns.name: 微生物/细胞名称中的 ro
patterns.context: 激活落在 oligodendroglia/oligodendroglial 一词内部，描述少突胶质细胞或其来源。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、生物医学摘要或资助文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语函数名中的词尾字母
patterns.context: 激活出现在葡萄牙语代码注释中，涉及“函数开始/主函数”一类标记；激活分布在词内多个字母片段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，C 代码与葡萄牙语注释

patterns.name: 数学记号中的 F
patterns.context: 激活落在 Pfaffian 公式中集合/匹配相关记号 F 的不同出现处。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文，图论与代数记号

patterns.name: 渐近记号中的 as
patterns.context: 激活落在渐近比较符号 \asymp 的 as 字母片段中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文，数论或渐近分析

en.concept: Subword fragments and local features of academic text
en.description: Activations occur across several types of segmented fragments: ro/bro in glial and medical terms, the suffix -ian in mathematical terms, English function words, formula symbols, Portuguese code comments, Finnish word fragments, and several domain-specific expressions. No single trigger condition explains all instances.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments related to “ro”
patterns.context: Occurs within words related to glial cells, neural myelin, or medical terminology; some instances are morpheme-level segmentation fragments, not complete words.

patterns.name: “-ian” suffix fragment
patterns.context: Occurs at the ends of nouns related to mathematicians or mathematical structures.

patterns.name: Common English function words and word fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in English academic sentences; some are common function words, while others are content words or intraword fragments, with no single stable collocation apparent.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and local formula fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in local expressions in formulas related to perfect matchings, Pfaffians, and matrices.

patterns.name: Uppercase Portuguese fragments in C code comments
patterns.context: Appears in the main-function comment in C code, “INÍCIO DA FUNÇÃO PRINCIPAL”; the trigger positions are segmented fragments of uppercase Portuguese words.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Finnish
patterns.context: Triggered by subword segments of continuous Finnish words; the context discusses insufficient progress and the Oslo process.
patterns.domain: European Parliament debates, Finnish political text

patterns.name: Gene pathway enrichment and overlap descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses pathway analysis, overlap among gene members, and names that are similar but not identical.

patterns.name: butyrate fragment in short-chain fatty acid testing
patterns.context: Appears in a description of HPLC measurement methods for short-chain fatty acids in mouse feces.

patterns.name: O in silver copper oxide formulas
patterns.context: O appears in a silver copper oxide formula in patent text, with digits rendered as formula subscripts.

patterns.name: ECG and imaging orientation descriptions
patterns.context: Concerns right-axis deviation, dextrocardia, and posteroanterior chest radiographs, among other imaging or anatomical orientation details.
patterns.domain: Medical case reports or clinical studies

patterns.name: Citations and probability-space notation in mathematical text
patterns.context: Occurs in parenthetical reference markers, descriptions of the monotone case, and Hilbert-space and probability-space notation; activation fragments are scattered.

2_1199.concept: 词片段与学术文本局部特征
