2_1199.description: 激活分布在多类切分片段上：神经胶质及医学术语中的 ro/bro、数学术语词尾 -ian、英语功能词、公式符号，以及葡萄牙语代码注释、芬兰语词片段和若干学科专用表达。未见能统一解释所有实例的单一触发条件。

patterns.name: “ro”相关词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在神经胶质细胞、神经髓鞘相关词或医学术语的词内；部分实例是词素切分片段，并非完整词。

patterns.name: “-ian”词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学家或数学结构相关名词的词尾。

patterns.name: 英语常见功能词与词片段
patterns.context: 嵌在英语学术句子中；有些是常见虚词，有些是实词或词内片段，未见单一稳定搭配。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式局部
patterns.context: 出现在完美匹配、Pfaffian及矩阵相关公式的局部表达中。

patterns.name: C 代码注释中的葡萄牙语大写片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C 代码的主函数注释“INÍCIO DA FUNÇÃO PRINCIPAL”中，触发位置是大写葡萄牙语词的切分片段。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发于芬兰语连续词的子词切分；上下文谈及进展不足及奥斯陆进程。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论、芬兰语政治文本

patterns.name: 基因通路富集与重叠表述
patterns.context: 讨论通路分析、基因成员重叠及名称相似但不完全相同。

patterns.name: 短链脂肪酸检测中的 butyrate 片段
patterns.context: 出现在小鼠粪便中短链脂肪酸的 HPLC 测定方法描述中。

patterns.name: 银铜氧化物化学式中的 O
patterns.context: O 出现在专利文本的银铜氧化物化学式中，数字为化学式下标的文本呈现。

patterns.name: 心电图与影像方位描述
patterns.context: 围绕右轴偏移、右位心及胸片后前位等影像或解剖方位信息。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的引用及概率空间符号
patterns.context: 分别出现在括号内的文献标记、单调情形说明，以及 Hilbert 空间和概率空间记号中；激活片段分散。

en.description: Activations span multiple domains and writing forms: myelin/oligodendroglia terminology, mathematical formula fragments, chemical-formula O, Slavic names, and Portuguese code comments are prominent; several English function words and fragments of an obstetric phrase also occur, with no unified semantic cue.

patterns.name: Oligodendroglia and myelin-related terminology
patterns.context: Terms occur in sentences about central nervous system development, myelination, cellular processes, or antibody recognition; activation falls within tokenized terms
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Specific fragments in mathematical symbols and formulas
patterns.context: Activations occur in LaTeX formulas, probability expressions, combinatorics proofs, or optimization inequalities, often near variables, operators, or formula boundaries
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and theoretical computer science texts

patterns.name: Oxygen and adjacent structures in chemical formulas
patterns.context: O occurs in silver-copper oxide chemical formulas for patent battery materials, near numbers and the alternative-material connector “or”

patterns.name: Diacritical characters and syllables in Slavic names
patterns.context: Occurs in Slavic male names and biographical introductions, with activations distributed across fragments within the names

patterns.name: Uppercase word fragments in Portuguese code comments
patterns.context: In Portuguese comments following C code, where a conspicuous all-caps word with an accented letter marks the main-function section

patterns.name: Common English words and prepositional links
patterns.context: Short English words occur in prose sentences or mathematical exposition; activations are weak and scattered, with no stable specialized semantic condition
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, including biomedical, patent, mathematical, and ultrasound imaging abstracts

patterns.name: Utero ending in a pregnancy context
patterns.context: In the obstetric expression “in utero”, activation falls on the final fragment of utero

2_1199.concept: 跨领域的局部子串/符号特征
2_1199.description: 激活跨多种领域与书写形式：突出显示髓鞘/少突胶质术语、数学公式片段、化学式O、斯拉夫姓名与葡语代码注释；另有若干英语短词及产科短语片段，缺少统一语义线索。

patterns.name: oligodendroglia 与髓鞘相关术语
patterns.context: 术语位于有关中枢神经系统发育、髓鞘形成、细胞过程或抗体识别的句子中；激活落在被切分的术语内部
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与 NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式中的特定片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 LaTeX 数学公式、概率表达式、组合数学证明或优化不等式中，常落在变量、算子或公式边界附近
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与理论计算机科学文本

patterns.name: 化学式中的氧及其邻接结构
patterns.context: O 位于专利电池材料的银铜氧化物化学式中，附近有数字与“or”等备选材料连接

patterns.name: 斯拉夫姓名中的变音字母及音节
patterns.context: 出现在斯拉夫男性名字及人物姓名介绍中，激活分布于姓名内部的片段
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科人物介绍

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语代码注释中的大写词片段
patterns.context: 位于 C 代码之后的葡萄牙语注释，注释以醒目的全大写、带重音字母的词标示主函数部分

patterns.name: 英语常用短语与介词连接
patterns.trigger: « to»1、« and»3、« or»1、« from»1、« to»2、« same»2
patterns.context: 短英语词在句子或数学论述的行文部分出现；激活弱且分散，未见稳定的专门语义条件
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文，包括生物医学、专利、数学与超声影像摘要

patterns.name: 妊娠语境中的 uterus 词尾
patterns.context: “in utero”这一产科表达中，激活落在 utero 的末尾片段

en.concept: Heterogeneous subword fragments and contrast markers
en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual intraword fragments, mathematical symbols, and a few contrastive expressions; Portuguese word fragments and “Mas” are most recurrent, alongside isolated biomedical terms, early-life, and Slavic names.

patterns.name: Portuguese conjunctions or verb endings
patterns.context: In Portuguese sentences, activations fall on intraword fragments or common grammatical words; many different word forms occur and cannot be grouped by a single meaning.
patterns.domain: European Parliament, forums, and philosophical discourse

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and probability notation
patterns.context: Mathematical font symbols in probability expressions, especially probability operators and indicator-function notation.

patterns.name: Contrastive word “Mas”
patterns.context: Sentence-initial conjunction in Portuguese, introducing a contrast or response.
patterns.domain: Forums, philosophical discourse, and parliamentary dialogue

patterns.name: English contrastive word “contrary”
patterns.context: The contrastive word in the fixed expression “On the contrary.”

patterns.name: English contrastive word “but”
patterns.context: Introduces a limitation or counterexample after a preceding claim.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in English biomedical terms
patterns.context: Activation occurs within the biomedical term “oligodendroglial”; no other comparable evidence is apparent.

patterns.name: life in an English phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the compound expression “early-life environment,” referring to the environment in early life.

patterns.name: Č in a Slavic name
patterns.context: The accented initial letter in the proper name “Željko Čajkovski.”

2_1199.concept: 异质的词片段与转折标记
2_1199.description: 激活分布于多语种词内片段、数学符号及少数转折表达；最重复的是葡萄牙语材料中的词片段和“Mas”，另有生物医学术语、early-life与斯拉夫人名等孤例。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语接续词或动词词尾
patterns.context: 在葡萄牙语句子中，激活落在词内片段或常见语法词上；多种不同词形，无法归并到单一词义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、论坛及哲学论述

patterns.name: 数学符号与概率记号
patterns.context: 概率表达式中的数学字体符号，尤其是概率算子及指示函数记号。

patterns.name: 转折词“Mas”
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中转折或回应前的句首连接词。
patterns.domain: 论坛、哲学论述及议会对话

patterns.name: 英语转折词“contrary”
patterns.context: 固定表达“On the contrary”中，激活落在转折词上。

patterns.name: 英语转折词“but”
patterns.context: 给出前述论断之后引出限制或反例。

patterns.name: 英语生物医学词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在“oligodendroglial”这一生物医学术语内部；未见其他同类证据。

patterns.name: 英语短语中的 life
patterns.context: 出现在复合表达“early-life environment”中，指生命早期环境。
patterns.domain: 表观遗传与肥胖研究综述

patterns.name: 斯拉夫人名中的 Č
patterns.context: 专名“Željko Čajkovski”中带变音符号的首字母。

en.description: The activation pattern is scattered: the English utero fragment, the contrastive word contrary, mathematical formula symbols, chemical-formula O, and Portuguese function words and within-word fragments. It is primarily tied to local spelling or formatting, with no unified semantic theme apparent.

patterns.name: English word or root ut-ero
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ero part of a split English word; commonly occurs in the phrases “in utero” or “in utero exposure”, in contexts concerning the womb, pregnancy, or fetal exposure.
patterns.domain: Reproductive medicine, epidemiology, veterinary medicine, and NIH project abstracts

patterns.name: Contrastive expression contrary
patterns.context: Occurs in argumentation or comparisons of results, especially after “on the contrary”; activation is concentrated on contrary rather than the entire contrastive phrase.

patterns.name: Formal symbols and local mathematical notation
patterns.context: Activations occur on punctuation, symbols, or variable tokens in mathematical expressions; the first passage contains LaTeX formulas, and the third contains variables in proof text.

patterns.name: Oxygen symbol in chemical formulas
patterns.context: Activation falls on O in the battery-material formulas AgCuO and Ag2Cu2O in patent technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Portuguese function words and accented fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Portuguese text, activations are distributed across articles, prepositions, conjunctions, and subword fragments of accented words; no clear semantic theme is apparent.

2_1199.concept: 局部 token 形态与符号
2_1199.description: 激活模式分散：英语 utero 词片段、转折词 contrary、数学公式符号、化学式 O，以及葡萄牙语功能词和词内片段；主要集中于局部拼写或格式，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语单词或词根 ut-ero
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的英语单词 ero 部分；常见于短语 “in utero” 或 “in utero exposure”，上下文涉及胎内、妊娠期或胎儿暴露。
patterns.domain: 生殖医学、流行病学、兽医学及 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 对比转折表达 contrary
patterns.context: 出现在论证或结果对照中，尤其是 “on the contrary” 后；激活集中在 contrary，而非整个转折短语。
patterns.domain: 数学证明、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 形式符号与局部数学记号
patterns.context: 激活出现在数学表达式中的标点、符号或变量 token；第1段包含 LaTeX 数学公式，第3段为证明文本中的变量。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学

patterns.name: 化学式中的氧符号
patterns.context: 激活落在电池材料化学式 AgCuO、Ag2Cu2O 中的 O，处于专利技术描述。
patterns.domain: 专利、电化学与材料化学

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语功能词及重音片段
patterns.context: 在葡萄牙语连续文本中，激活分布于冠词、介词、连词以及带重音词的子词片段；未见明确语义主题条件。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语哲学或评论性散文

en.description: The most stable recurring cue is expressions indicating contrast or relative relations within sentences, especially English “on the contrary” and Italian “rispetto a”; there are also legal and policy comparison contexts. The remaining activations are scattered across formulas, Lithuanian/Czech fragments, and medical phrases, and are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: In-sentence concessive/contrastive connectors
patterns.context: Introduces contrast, an exception, a reason, or a relative relation in an argument; the clearest examples are Italian “rispetto a” and English “on the contrary,” but French «car» also activates, so the pattern cannot be reduced entirely to a single connector.

patterns.name: Relational words in legal and policy language
patterns.context: Compares rules or interventions, or introduces a concessive clause in legal or policy statements; Italian parliamentary text.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Italian legal and policy discussions

patterns.name: Indicator function in a sparse formula
patterns.context: A conditional indicator-function notation appears in a mathematical formula, with the condition written as “[ y_k=x_k”; this is the highest activation in the batch, with a more specific local trigger unlike the other examples.

patterns.name: Lithuanian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in a Lithuanian parliamentary speech; the strongest marker falls on the word form “žinias” (knowledge), alongside several participial fragments, with no clear semantic or syntactic commonality.

patterns.name: Forms of address and emphasis words in Czech speeches
patterns.context: In a Czech parliamentary speech, forms of address to the audience and word-form fragments meaning “this” are marked; no clear connection between the two triggers is apparent.

patterns.name: Ukrainian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Several word-form/subword fragments at the beginning of a Lithuanian text activate, especially “žinias”; there is insufficient evidence to establish a unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Cancer and cell-experiment terminology in medicine
patterns.context: A breast cancer tissue and cell experiment abstract; activation is scattered across terms and contrastive expressions, so it is unclear whether the terms themselves are a common trigger.

patterns.name: Medical imaging and anatomical expressions
patterns.context: Describes 3D ultrasound, anatomical planes, and fetal nuchal edema; the marked words do not show a clear shared domain-specific terminology pattern.

patterns.name: Contrastive expressions in biomedical results
patterns.context: After stating liver copper levels or changes in angiogenesis, the text introduces an opposite or contrasting result; the contrast phrase is the same English expression as in paragraph 4.

patterns.name: Contrastive expressions in cold-atom physics
patterns.context: After describing timescales and dipole coupling, the text shifts to another behavior at longer times; the contrast phrase is used as in other genres.

2_1199.concept: 对照与关系表达（不完全）
2_1199.description: 最稳定的重复线索是句中表示对照或相对关系的表达，尤其英语“on the contrary”和意大利语“rispetto a”；此外有法律政策比较语境。其余激活分散于公式、立陶宛语/捷克语片段及医学词句，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 句内让步/对照连接词
patterns.trigger: «ris»2pet«to»9« a»3« qu»1elle；«ris»2pet«to»9« ag»1«li»3；«On the« contrary»9；«al»1 contrario（本批未标出）；«car»9
patterns.context: 在论述中引出对照、例外、原因或相对关系；最明显的是意大利语“rispetto a”和英语“on the contrary”，但法语«car»也被激活，不能完全归入单一连接词。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会发言、科研论文

patterns.name: 法律政策措辞中的关系词
patterns.context: 法律或政策陈述中比较规则、干预措施，或引入让步从句；意大利语议会文本。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，意大利语法律政策讨论

patterns.name: 稀疏公式中的指示函数
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现带条件的指示函数记号，条件写作“[ y_k=x_k”；此处为全批最高激活，局部触发更具体、与其他例子不相似。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词形片段
patterns.context: 嵌在立陶宛语议会发言中；最强标记落在“žinias”（知识）词形上，周围同时有多个分词片段，缺乏明确的语义或句法共性。

patterns.name: 捷克语演讲称呼与强调词
patterns.context: 捷克语议会演讲中，对听众的称呼以及“这个/此”一类词形片段被标记；两处触发彼此未见明确联系。

patterns.name: 乌克兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 立陶宛语文本开头的若干词形/子词片段激活，尤其是“žinias”；没有足够证据确定统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 医学中的癌症与细胞实验术语
patterns.context: 乳腺癌组织与细胞实验的摘要语境；激活分散在术语及转折表达上，无法确认术语本身是共同触发因素。

patterns.name: 医学图像与解剖学表达
patterns.context: 描述三维超声、解剖平面及胎儿颈部水肿；所标记词并未显现清晰共同的领域术语模式。

patterns.name: 生物医学结果中的转折表达
patterns.context: 先陈述肝脏铜含量或新生血管变化，再转入相反或对照结果；与段4的同一英语短语一致。

patterns.name: 冷原子物理中的转折表达
patterns.context: 描述时间尺度与偶极耦合后，转入较长时间下的另一行为；转折短语与其他文体中的用法相同。

en.concept: contrary contrast marker and miscellaneous subword fragments
en.description: The clearest pattern is contrary in the phrase “On the contrary” across multiple domains; other activations are scattered across Lithuanian and French subword fragments, French coordinating or contrastive words, and a mathematical formula.

patterns.name: Contrast marker contrary
patterns.context: An expectation, hypothesis, or contrast is introduced earlier, then contrary introduces the opposite case; contrary is the most prominent trigger and appears across multiple corpus domains.
patterns.domain: ArXiv proofs or papers; PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Lithuanian function words and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Consecutive words in Lithuanian parliamentary speech; activation is distributed across word-initial and intra-word fragments and short function words.

patterns.name: French et and parliamentary wording
patterns.context: Coordination and intra-word fragments activate in French parliamentary text; the same passage also contains “caractère commun de nos efforts”.

patterns.name: French intra-word fragments and mercury-related text
patterns.context: Words are split into marked fragments in French text; the content concerns the hazards of mercury and its compounds, with activation also involving negation and contrast words.

patterns.name: Mathematical formula symbols and variables
patterns.context: Braces, variables, product indices, and symbols in a mathematical expression; markers are interspersed with formula structure.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics or theoretical physics paper

patterns.name: French medical word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented fragments within long words in a French medical passage; it discusses pheochromocytoma and the prognostic significance of hereditary forms.

2_1199.concept: contrary转折标记及杂项词片段
2_1199.description: 最鲜明的模式是多个领域中句式“On the contrary”里的 contrary；其余激活分散于立陶宛语及法语词片段、法语并列或转折词，以及一段数学公式。

patterns.name: 转折标记 contrary
patterns.context: 前文提出某种预期、假设或对照，随后用 contrary 引出相反情况；其中 contrary 是最突出的触发词，多个语料领域均出现。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 证明或论文、PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 立陶宛语功能词及词内片段
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会发言中的连续词语；激活分布在词首、词内片段及短功能词上。

patterns.name: 法语 et 及议会用语
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中，并列连接及词内片段激活；同段还有“caractère commun de nos efforts”。

patterns.name: 法语词内片段与 mercury 相关文本
patterns.context: 法语文本中词语被拆分标记；内容谈汞及其化合物的危险性，激活也涉及否定和转折词。

patterns.name: 数学公式符号与变量
patterns.context: 数学表达式中的花括号、变量、求积指标及符号；标记与公式结构交错。

patterns.name: 法语医学词语片段
patterns.context: 法语医学段落中，激活落在长词内部的分词片段；讨论嗜铬细胞瘤及遗传形式的预后意义。

en.description: Primarily responds to the “ro” fragment in the fib- stem; it also responds to comparative structures with similar and the contrastive expression contrary. Several Lithuanian subword fragments and mathematical typesetting symbols occur only in single passages, with unclear patterns.

patterns.name: fibro/fibroid stem
patterns.context: “ro” occurs within a word, followed by different endings; examples include fibroids, fibroin, and fibroproliferative. Activation clusters near segmentation boundaries and does not require a particular meaning.

patterns.name: similar collocations
patterns.context: similar occurs in comparative or analogical structures; activation falls on the word fragment and nearby collocates.

patterns.name: Counter-expectation contrast phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the contrastive expression “On the contrary” or “on the contrary.”

patterns.name: Lithuanian intraword fragments and function words
patterns.context: The marked fragments are distributed within or at word boundaries in continuous Lithuanian text; a single example is insufficient to determine a more specific morphological or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Symbol fragments in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical font or symbol notation in formulas; markers fall on fragments of typesetting commands or symbols.

2_1199.concept: 词内片段与论述连接词
2_1199.description: 主要响应 fib- 词干中的“ro”片段；另对 similar 的比较结构及 contrary 转折语有反应。立陶宛语若干子词片段和数学排版符号仅见于单段，规律不明。

patterns.name: fibro/fibroid 词干
patterns.context: “ro”位于单词中，后接不同词尾；包括 fibroids、fibroin、fibroproliferative。激活集中在分词边界附近，并不要求某个固定语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: similar 搭配
patterns.context: 比较或类比结构中出现 similar；激活落在词内片段及其附近的搭配词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、数学论文

patterns.name: 反预期转折短语
patterns.context: 出现在 “On the contrary” 或 “on the contrary” 这一转折表达中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、数学证明

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词内片段及功能词
patterns.context: 这些被标记的片段分布在立陶宛语连续文本的词内或词边界；无法从单例确定更具体的词法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 立陶宛语议会发言

patterns.name: 数学排版中的符号片段
patterns.context: 出现在公式的数学字体或符号记号中；标记落在排版命令或符号的子词片段上。

en.description: Activation is scattered across intra-word fragments or common expressions in multiple languages, formulas, and technical texts: these include Lithuanian conjunctions, formula symbols, chemical names, contrastive and comparative phrases, and medical and French word fragments, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: The fragment “ir” in Lithuanian words
patterns.context: Appears in Lithuanian sentences, connecting coordinated items; the fragment itself is the common conjunction “ir” (and).

patterns.name: I in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: Appears in a probability or information-theory formula as a mathematical symbol, followed by a condition in square brackets.

patterns.name: isopropyl in a chemical name
patterns.context: Appears as a character fragment within a compound name; the same name is repeated in the passage.

patterns.name: contrary contrast expression
patterns.context: Appears in “on the contrary,” introducing a case opposite to the preceding argument or statement.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical proof; PubMed biomedical abstract

patterns.name: similar to comparative expression
patterns.context: similar describes a relation of similarity or comparison between objects; it can occur with to or in “a similar level”.

patterns.name: “it” within an English word
patterns.context: Appears as a character fragment in a Russian context, not as a standalone English word; the trigger semantics are unclear.

patterns.name: Fibroids in a biomedical term
patterns.context: An intra-word fragment in the English term “fibroids” activates, describing uterine imaging findings.

patterns.name: ers in the brand name Superspher
patterns.context: Appears within the column name “Superspher,” not as a standalone word.

patterns.name: The French word-final fragment “end”
patterns.context: Activation falls within French words such as “étendre” and “secteur”; the passage also has strong « bout»8 and « contra»3«ire»6, but the shared trigger pattern is unclear.

2_1199.concept: 跨语料片段与词形激活
2_1199.description: 激活分散在多种语言、公式与专业文本的词内片段或常见表达上：包括立陶宛语连词、公式符号、化学名、转折和比较短语，以及医学和法语词片段，缺乏统一语义规律。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词内的「ir」片段
patterns.context: 出现在立陶宛语句子中，连接并列项；该片段本身是常见连词「ir」（和）。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 I
patterns.context: 出现在概率或信息论公式中，作为数学符号，后接方括号条件。

patterns.name: 化学名中的 isopropyl
patterns.context: 作为化合物名称内部的字符片段出现；同一段重复出现该名称。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学摘要，药理学

patterns.name: contrary 转折表达
patterns.context: 出现在「on the contrary」中，引出与前述论证或陈述相反的情况。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学证明；PubMed 生物医学摘要

patterns.name: similar to 比较表达
patterns.context: 以 similar 描述对象之间的相似或比较关系；可带 to，也可用于「a similar level」。

patterns.name: 英文词中含有「it」
patterns.context: 出现在俄语上下文中的字符片段，未显示为独立英文词；触发语义不明确。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的纤维瘤
patterns.context: 英文术语「fibroids」中词内片段被激活，描述子宫影像所见。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学摘要，妇科影像

patterns.name: Superspher 品牌词中的 ers
patterns.context: 出现在色谱柱名称「Superspher」的词内，而非独立词。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学摘要，分析化学

patterns.name: 法语词尾「end」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在法语词内部，如「étendre」和「secteur」；本段另有较强的 « bout»8 与« contra»3«ire»6，但共同触发规律不明。

en.concept: Multiple word forms and symbol fragments
en.description: Activation centers on “On the contrary,” in utero, and supers-related word fragments; P/I notation in a probability formula and multiple Lithuanian word fragments also appear. Each pattern is triggered by a different context.

patterns.name: “contrary” contrastive transition
patterns.context: Appears in “On the contrary,” introducing a case opposite to or different from what came before.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, including mathematical proofs and physics and biomedical studies.

patterns.name: Fragments in “in utero”
patterns.context: “in utero” means in the uterus; the context concerns prenatal exposure, fetal nutrition, or fetal imaging.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, public health, and medical research.

patterns.name: “supers-” related fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in “Superspher” (a chromatography column name) and “superspace” (a theoretical-physics term); activation also occurs with “«pace»”.

patterns.name: Letters in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Appears in a formula consisting of probability or indicator-function notation; P appears twice in the same formula.
patterns.domain: Mathematical formulas, probability or information-theory-related text.

patterns.name: Lithuanian word-form fragments
patterns.context: These fragments appear in Lithuanian sentences concerning “the European Union’s capacity, knowledge, and innovation”; activation is distributed across multiple words and intra-word fragments.

2_1199.concept: 多种词形与符号片段
2_1199.description: 激活集中于“On the contrary”、in utero、supers-相关词片段；另见概率公式中的P/I记号及一段立陶宛语多词片段。各模式由不同语境触发。

patterns.name: “contrary”对比转折
patterns.context: 出现在“On the contrary”中，引出与前文相反或不同的情况。
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文，涉及数学证明、物理研究和生物医学研究。

patterns.name: “in utero”中的片段
patterns.context: “in utero”指在子宫内；上下文涉及产前暴露、胎儿营养或胎儿影像。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、公共卫生与医学研究。

patterns.name: “supers-”相关片段
patterns.context: 嵌在“Superspher”（色谱柱名称）和“superspace”（理论物理术语）中；也伴随“«pace»”激活。

patterns.name: 数学符号中的字母
patterns.context: 出现在概率或指示函数记号构成的公式中；P在同一公式中出现两次。
patterns.domain: 数学公式、概率或信息论相关文本。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词形片段
patterns.context: 这些片段出现在立陶宛语句子中，涉及“欧洲联盟的能力、知识与创新”等内容；激活分布在多个词及词内片段上。
patterns.domain: 立陶宛语政治或政策文本。

en.concept: Local word-form and symbol triggers in multilingual text
en.description: The most stable pattern is contrary in “On the contrary,” found in mathematical research and medical abstracts; other scattered triggers include Lithuanian policy words, the French parliamentary time word demain, formula symbols P/I, and chromatography-column terminology.

patterns.name: English contrastive phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “On the contrary,” usually introducing a statement that opposes or contrasts with the preceding text; this word is the strongest and most recurrent trigger.
patterns.domain: ArXiv proofs or research prose, PubMed scientific abstracts

patterns.name: Lithuanian knowledge vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in Lithuanian parliamentary text alongside EU policy words such as “kompetenciją” and “naujoves.”

patterns.name: French political time word
patterns.context: Refers to tomorrow or the following day in French parliamentary text, in the context of meeting arrangements, voting, or an agenda.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, French parliamentary speeches and agendas

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols P and I
patterns.context: Appear in formulas as a probability symbol and an indicator-function symbol, respectively; activation falls on local symbol tokens.
patterns.domain: ArXiv, mathematical or information theory formulas

patterns.name: Chromatography column terminology fragments
patterns.context: An analytical chromatography methods description mentions a precolumn, analytical column, and specific column names.

2_1199.concept: 多语文本中的局部词形与符号触发
2_1199.description: 最稳定的模式是“On the contrary”中的 contrary，见于数理研究与医学摘要；另有立陶宛语政策词、法语议会时间词 demain、公式符号 P/I 及色谱柱术语等零散触发。

patterns.name: 英文转折短语
patterns.context: 出现在短语 “On the contrary” 中，通常引出与前文相反或补充对照的陈述；该词是最强、重复出现的触发点。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 证明或研究叙述、PubMed 科学摘要

patterns.name: 立陶宛语知识词汇
patterns.context: 位于立陶宛语议会文本中，与“kompetenciją”“naujoves”等欧盟政策词汇并列。

patterns.name: 法语政治时间词
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中指向明天或次日，处于会议安排、投票或议程语境。

patterns.name: 数学符号 P 与 I
patterns.context: 出现在公式中，分别作为概率符号与指示函数符号；激活落在符号的局部 token 上。

patterns.name: 色谱柱术语片段
patterns.context: 分析色谱方法描述中，提及预柱、分析柱及具体色谱柱名称。

en.description: Primarily responds to English contrastive expressions: on the contrary and as opposed to, especially contrary and opposed. There are also sporadic activations in mathematical proof formatting, a chromatography column name, and Lithuanian word fragments.

patterns.name: “on the contrary” transition
patterns.context: Appears after a prior statement to introduce an opposite or different result; activation is concentrated on contrary
patterns.domain: Academic discourse, including mathematical, medical, and physics texts

patterns.name: “as opposed to” contrast
patterns.context: Compares or distinguishes two cases, objects, or organization types
patterns.domain: Physics papers, medical research abstracts, and NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Mathematical proof formatting marker
patterns.context: Appears in a LaTeX math-formatting command in a theorem-proof heading

patterns.name: Chromatography column name fragment
patterns.context: Embedded in a commercial or model name for an analytical chromatography column

patterns.name: Lithuanian word fragments
patterns.context: Lithuanian parliamentary or EU-related text; activation falls on intra-word subwords, with no clear shared syntactic function

2_1199.concept: 对照转折表达
2_1199.description: 主要响应英语对照转折表达：on the contrary 与 as opposed to，尤其是其中的 contrary、opposed。另有数学证明排版、色谱柱名称及立陶宛语词片段的零散激活。

patterns.name: “on the contrary” 转折语
patterns.trigger: «contrary»，前文附近有“On the contrary”或“on the contrary”
patterns.context: 出现在前述陈述之后，用来引出相反或不同的结果；激活集中在 contrary 一词
patterns.domain: 学术论述，含数学、医学和物理文本

patterns.name: “as opposed to” 对照语
patterns.context: 比较或区分两种情况、对象或组织类型
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、医学研究摘要及 NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 数学证明格式标记
patterns.context: 出现在定理证明标题的 LaTeX 数学排版命令中

patterns.name: 色谱柱名称片段
patterns.context: 嵌在分析色谱柱的商品或型号名称里

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词片段
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会或欧盟相关文本；激活落在词内子词，未见明确共同句法功能

en.description: Activation is scattered across Lithuanian word fragments, English contrastive discourse, mathematical symbols, and intra-word fragments in various biomedical and chromatography terms; apart from “on the contrary,” no unified semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Lithuanian morphemes and conjunctions
patterns.context: Intra-word fragments and conjunctions in continuous Lithuanian text; multiple markers fall on adjacent words.

patterns.name: Contrastive argument phrase
patterns.context: Appears in English academic argumentation as “on the contrary,” introducing a situation or argument opposite to what came before.
patterns.domain: Mathematical proofs, medical research abstracts, physics papers

patterns.name: Theorem and mathematical symbols in proof discourse
patterns.context: A theorem proof begins with “by similar argument” and includes LaTeX theorem-heading and proof formatting.

patterns.name: Probability notation and indicator function
patterns.context: A probability distribution notation and conditional indicator function appear in a mathematical formula; markers are embedded in a LaTeX symbol sequence.

patterns.name: Uterine imaging and polyp-related terms
patterns.context: Discusses clinical imaging topics such as coronal uterine imaging, IUD positioning, fibroids, and polyps.

patterns.name: Uterine fibroids and their epidemiology
patterns.context: fibroids is segmented into intra-word markers; the context concerns uterine fibroids, hysterectomy, and disease burden.

patterns.name: Fibrin-related molecular terms
patterns.context: Markers fall within the names of fibrin messenger RNA and fibroin, among other biomolecules; these share only partial character strings with fibroids in other passages.

patterns.name: Dupuytren’s contracture and fibrous proliferation
patterns.context: Intra-word fragments occur in the disease name and descriptive medical terms; the passage discusses a fibrous proliferative disease of the palmar aponeurosis.

patterns.name: Chromatography column terminology
patterns.context: Describes backflushing, analytical columns, gradient elution, and chromatographic stationary phases; trigger fragments occur in instrument and material names.

2_1199.concept: none
2_1199.description: 激活分散于立陶宛语词片段、英语对比语篇、数学符号，以及多种生物医学和色谱术语内部片段；除“on the contrary”外，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词素与连接词
patterns.context: 立陶宛语连续文本中的词内片段及连接词；多个标记落在相邻词语中。

patterns.name: 对比论证短语
patterns.context: 出现在英语学术论证中，短语为“on the contrary”，用于引出与前文相反的情况或论点。
patterns.domain: 数学证明、医学研究摘要、物理学论文

patterns.name: 证明语篇中的定理与数学符号
patterns.context: 定理证明开头使用“by similar argument”，并伴随 LaTeX 定理标题与证明格式。

patterns.name: 概率记号与指示函数
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现概率分布记号及条件指示函数；标记嵌于 LaTeX 符号序列。

patterns.name: 子宫影像与息肉相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论子宫冠状面成像、IUD 定位、肌瘤及息肉等临床影像内容。

patterns.name: 子宫肌瘤及其流行病学
patterns.context: fibroids 在词内被分段标记；语境涉及子宫肌瘤、子宫切除术及疾病负担。

patterns.name: 纤维蛋白相关分子术语
patterns.context: 标记落在纤维蛋白信使 RNA 与 fibroin 等生物分子名称内部；与其他段中的 fibroids 仅共享部分字母串。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、生物医学

patterns.name: 杜普伊特朗挛缩与纤维增生
patterns.context: 疾病名称和描述性医学术语中出现词内片段，讨论掌腱膜纤维增生性疾病。

patterns.name: 色谱柱术语
patterns.context: 描述反冲、分析柱、梯度洗脱及色谱固定相；触发片段位于仪器与材料名称中。

en.concept: Local word forms and phrases across languages
en.description: Activation mainly falls on “On the contrary” in English academic or medical text, just in Swedish parliamentary contexts, and fragments in the medical word fibroids; there are also single instances in the Lithuanian word-final fragment in žinias and the French word-final fragment in demain.

patterns.name: English contrastive phrase
patterns.context: Appears in English academic argumentation or medical abstracts, usually introduced by “On the”, to present an opposite case; [2] contains “on the contrary”, and [7][8] contain “On the contrary”.
patterns.domain: ArXiv proofs and physics research; PubMed medical abstracts

patterns.name: Swedish just
patterns.context: Appears in Swedish parliamentary speeches, embedded in expressions such as “har just avslutats”, “ni just nämnde”, and “har just diskuterat”, meaning just now or precisely.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in English fibroids
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal fragment of the medical word fibroids; [5] occurs in a discussion of uterine fibroid epidemiology, while [9] occurs in a list of indications for uterine imaging.
patterns.domain: NIH medical text; PubMed medical abstracts

patterns.name: Token in Lithuanian zninias
patterns.context: Appears in a Lithuanian coordinated expression about EU capacity, knowledge, and innovation; this pattern occurs in only one passage, so it cannot be confirmed as a stable language pattern.

patterns.name: Ending of French demain
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of French demain, in parliamentary text about advances in employees’ wages in the event of employer insolvency and voting arrangements; a single instance.

2_1199.concept: 多语种局部词形与短语
2_1199.description: 激活主要落在英语学术或医学文本的“On the contrary”、瑞典语议会语境的 just，以及医学词 fibroids 的片段；另有立陶宛语 žinias 词尾和法语 demain 词尾的单例。

patterns.name: 英语对比转折短语
patterns.context: 出现在英语学术论证或医学摘要中，通常由“On the”引出，用于提出相反情况；[2] 中是“on the contrary”，[7][8] 中是“On the contrary”。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 证明与物理研究；PubMed 医学摘要

patterns.name: 瑞典语 just
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语议会发言中，嵌在“har just avslutats”“ni just nämnde”“har just diskuterat”等表达里，表示刚刚或恰恰。

patterns.name: 英语 fibroids 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学词 fibroids 的内部片段上；[5] 出现于子宫肌瘤流行病学讨论，[9] 出现于子宫影像检查的适应症列表。
patterns.domain: NIH 医学文本；PubMed 医学摘要

patterns.name: 立陶宛语 zninias 中的 token
patterns.context: 出现在立陶宛语关于欧盟能力、知识与创新的并列表达中；此模式只见于一段，无法确认是否为稳定语言模式。

patterns.name: 法语 demain 末尾
patterns.context: 激活落在法语 demain 的词尾，处于有关雇主破产时雇员工资垫付及投票安排的议会文本中；单例。

en.description: Primarily responds to the contrastive phrase “on the contrary” in English academic text, and also to “just” in Swedish parliamentary text; there is one additional instance of Lithuanian “žinias.” These triggers are not consistent in language or context.

patterns.name: Contrastive phrase
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning or middle of a sentence, introducing an opposite, contrasting, or contrary result after a prior statement; especially evident in paragraphs 3, 5, 9, and 10.
patterns.domain: Academic argumentation, physics and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Swedish just
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary speeches, means “just/recently” or “exactly,” often followed by a verb or occurring near references to meetings, discussions, or votes.

patterns.name: Lithuanian žinias
patterns.context: Occurs in a coordinated Lithuanian noun phrase listing “knowledge” and innovation in relation to EU objectives.

2_1199.concept: 转折标记与 just
2_1199.description: 主要响应英语学术文本中的转折短语“on the contrary”，也响应瑞典语议会文本中的“just”；另有一次立陶宛语“žinias”。这些触发词在语言、语境上并不统一。

patterns.name: 对比转折短语
patterns.context: 位于句首或句中，在此前陈述后引出相反、对照或反向结果；第3、5、9、10段尤为明显。
patterns.domain: 学术论证、物理学与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 瑞典语 just
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语议会发言中，表示“刚刚/正好”，常接动词或与会议、讨论、投票等表述相邻。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语 žinias
patterns.context: 出现在立陶宛语并列名词短语中，列举欧盟目标相关的“知识”和创新。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 立陶宛语议会记录

en.concept: Word forms and contrast markers across languages
en.description: The main patterns are Swedish just in parliamentary text and English on the contrary introducing contrast in academic discourse. There are also proof headings, speaker titles, and scattered multilingual intra-word subword activations; these sporadic patterns are difficult to group under one semantic function.

patterns.name: Directional or concessive contrast word contrary
patterns.context: In English academic discourse, this phrase introduces content that contradicts or contrasts with what was said earlier.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and physics; PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Swedish just
patterns.context: Appears near verbs or other elements in Swedish parliamentary speeches; means “just now” or “precisely,” among other things, depending on context.

patterns.name: Lithuanian žinias
patterns.context: In a Lithuanian parliamentary context, appears in an expression listing “capacity, knowledge, and innovation”; activation falls on an intra-word subword.

patterns.name: Proof in English proof headings
patterns.context: The trigger is the Proof subword in LaTeX mathematical formatting for a mathematical proof heading.

patterns.name: Swedish speaker marker talmannen
patterns.context: Activation falls within talmannen in a speaker label or form of address to the chair in parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Specific Swedish intra-word subwords
patterns.context: Appear respectively in names, common verbs, and adjectives; the fragments do not show a shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Multilingual intra-word subwords
patterns.context: Triggers are scattered within Lithuanian and Swedish word forms, making it difficult to establish a unified contextual condition from these examples.

patterns.name: Sporadic common function words and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Each appears in a different syntactic position; the fragments do not support a shared trigger condition more specific than the lexical item itself.
patterns.domain: Swedish parliamentary records, English academic text and abstracts

patterns.name: Sporadic intra-word morphological fragments
patterns.context: Belong to names, common words, and inflectional or derivational fragments; there is no clear consistent semantic or contextual pattern.

2_1199.concept: 多语种词形与转折标记
2_1199.description: 主模式是瑞典语议会文本中的 just，以及英语学术论述中引出对比的 on the contrary。另有证明标题、讲话人称谓和分散的多语种词内子词激活；这些零散模式难以归为同一语义功能。

patterns.name: 方向性或让步转折词 contrary
patterns.context: 英语学术论述中用该短语引出与前述说法相反或形成对比的内容。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理；PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 瑞典语 just
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中，出现在动词或其他成分附近；表示“刚刚、正是”等，具体义随上下文变化。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语 žinias
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会语境中，出现在列举“能力、知识和创新”的表达里；激活落在词内子词上。

patterns.name: 英语证明标题中的 Proof
patterns.context: 数学证明的排版标题中，触发点是 LaTeX 数学格式里的 Proof 子词。

patterns.name: 瑞典语讲话人标记 talmannen
patterns.context: 议会发言的讲话人标签或对主席的称呼中，激活落在 talmannen 的词内。

patterns.name: 瑞典语特定词内子词
patterns.context: 分别出现在姓名、普通动词及形容词中；现有片段未显示它们具有共同的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 多语种词内子词
patterns.context: 触发分散在立陶宛语和瑞典语词形内部，难以从这些例子确认统一上下文条件。

patterns.name: 零散常见虚词与词内片段
patterns.context: 各自在不同句法位置出现；片段不足以支持比词项本身更具体的共享触发条件。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语议会记录、英语学术文本和摘要

patterns.name: 零散词内形态片段
patterns.context: 分属姓名、常见词及屈折或构词片段；没有清晰的一致语义或上下文模式。

en.description: Strong activation centers on Swedish just and English On the contrary; the remaining activation is scattered across Lithuanian, Swedish, and French word fragments, as well as comparative words and sporadic subwords in research texts. These patterns are weak and heterogeneous.

patterns.name: just token
patterns.context: Appears in Swedish parliamentary speech in structures such as “har just diskuterat”, “ni just nämnde”, and “just nu”, meaning “just now,” “precisely,” or “at this moment.”
patterns.domain: Swedish parliamentary speech or formal addresses

patterns.name: On the contrary transition
patterns.context: In the fixed phrase “On the contrary,” appearing after contrastive or transitional discourse; the preceding text often describes scientific results or comparisons.

patterns.name: Lithuanian intra-word fragments and function words
patterns.context: In Lithuanian parliamentary text, activation falls on intra-word subword fragments, word endings, or conjunctions; examples include “kadangi”, “mūsų”, “bendras”, “žinias”, “ir”, “lapkričio”, “prašymas”, and “Parlamentas”.

patterns.name: Swedish intra-word fragments and common words
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary text, activation is scattered across intra-word subwords, pronouns, conjunctions, and word endings; examples include “välkommen”, “Jag”, “även”, “Barrot”, “tyvärr”, “talman”, “meddelade”, and “att”, with no single stable semantic or syntactic position.

patterns.name: English comparative structures and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Appears when comparing results or describing experimental effects in research abstracts; in passage 7, local fragments such as “that”, “dip”, and “many” also activate in physics discourse, but cannot be grouped into one clear collocation.
patterns.domain: English biomedical abstracts and physics papers

patterns.name: French intra-word fragments and time words
patterns.context: In parliamentary budget text, activation is distributed across subword fragments in words such as “supplémentaire”, “demain”, and “suivant”.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary administrative and budget text

2_1199.concept: 异质词元与子词触发
2_1199.description: 强激活集中在瑞典语 just 和英语 On the contrary；其余激活分散于立陶宛语、瑞典语、法语词片段，以及科研文本中的比较词和零散子词，模式较弱且异质。

patterns.name: just 词元
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语议会发言中，位于“har just diskuterat”“ni just nämnde”“just nu”等结构，表示“刚刚/正是/此刻”。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语议会口语或正式发言

patterns.name: On the contrary 转折语
patterns.context: 固定短语“On the contrary”中，出现在对比或转折论述之后；前文常有科学结果或比较描述。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词内片段与功能词
patterns.trigger: « kad»、«s»、« bend»、«ras»、«os»、«as»、« ir»；另有«us»、«ij»、« į»、« lap»、«ų»、« pra»、«šym»、« pat»
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会文本中，激活落在词内子词片段、词尾或连接词上；包括“kadangi”“mūsų”“bendras”“žinias”“ir”“lapkričio”“prašymas”“Parlamentas”等。
patterns.domain: 立陶宛语议会正式文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段及常用词
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，激活分散在词内子词、代词、连词及词尾；包括“välkommen”“Jag”“även”“Barrot”“tyvärr”“talman”“meddelade”“att”等，未见单一稳定的语义或句法位置。

patterns.name: 英语比较结构及词内片段
patterns.trigger: « similar»、« as»、« that»、« of»；另有« than»、« those»、« Knock»、« down»、« and»、« p»
patterns.context: 科研摘要中比较结果或描述实验效应时出现；第7段另在物理学论述中激活于“that”“dip”“many”等局部片段，不能归并为同一明确搭配。
patterns.domain: 英语生物医学摘要及物理学论文

patterns.name: 法语词内片段与时间词
patterns.context: 议会预算文本中，激活分布于“supplémentaire”“demain”“suivant”等词的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 法语议会行政与预算文本

en.description: Activation centers on Swedish «just» in parliamentary contexts and the English contrastive phrase «on the contrary»; there is also one instance within Lithuanian «žinias» (knowledge). The patterns vary across languages and word meanings.

patterns.name: Swedish “just”
patterns.context: Appears in Swedish sentences meaning “just now / precisely”; it is sometimes repeated within the same passage.

patterns.name: English “on the contrary” contrast marker
patterns.context: In the phrase “On the contrary,” appearing at a point of contrast or transition.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, mathematics and physics papers

patterns.name: Lithuanian terms related to knowledge and innovation
patterns.context: Located in the coordinated expression “competence, knowledge and innovation”; activation falls within Lithuanian “žinias” (knowledge).

2_1199.concept: 近期性或对比强调标记
2_1199.description: 激活集中在瑞典语议会语境中的«just»和英语转折短语«on the contrary»；另有一次落在立陶宛语«žinias»（知识）中。跨语言与词义分散。

patterns.name: 瑞典语“just”
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语句中，表示“刚刚／正是”；有时在同一段重复出现。

patterns.name: 英语“on the contrary”转折标记
patterns.context: 短语“On the contrary”中，出现在转折或对比论述处。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、数学与物理学论文

patterns.name: 立陶宛语知识与创新相关词语
patterns.context: 位于“competence, knowledge and innovation”并列表达中；激活落在立陶宛语“žinias”（知识）内部。

en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual word fragments: Swedish just (just now, precisely, exactly), Lithuanian ir, the final но in Russian равно, and English On the contrary. Swedish patterns are the majority, but the other fragments have no obvious semantic connection to them.

patterns.name: Word-level suffix “just”
patterns.context: In Swedish contexts, usually the standalone adverb just; occurs in structures such as “har just röstat,” “det var just därför,” and “just nu,” meaning just now, precisely, or exactly.

patterns.name: Lithuanian intraword fragment “ir”
patterns.context: Embedded in Lithuanian word forms, especially in “žinias ir naujoves,” where it is the conjunction “ir” (and); this passage also activates intraword fragments such as “Euro” and “pos.”

patterns.name: Russian word-final/intraword “но”
patterns.context: Appears at the end of “равно,” in a Russian Q&A about an object becoming a null object; short fragments such as “По” and “и” also activate in the same passage.

patterns.name: English contrastive connector “contrary”
patterns.context: Occurs in the contrastive phrase “On the contrary” in an academic abstract; nearby are comparative expressions such as “similar” and “as that of.”

2_1199.concept: none
2_1199.description: 激活分布于多语种词片段：瑞典语 just（刚刚、正是、恰好），立陶宛语 ir，俄语 равно 的词尾 но，以及英语 On the contrary。瑞典语模式占多数，但其余片段与之缺乏明显语义共同点。

patterns.name: 词内后缀“just”
patterns.context: 瑞典语语境中，通常是独立副词 just；出现在“har just röstat”“det var just därför”“just nu”等结构，意为刚刚、正是或恰好。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词内片段“ir”
patterns.context: 嵌在立陶宛语词形中，尤其“žinias ir naujoves”中作为连接词“ir”（和）；本段还激活“Euro”“pos”等词内片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 立陶宛语议会文本

patterns.name: 俄语词尾/词内“но”
patterns.context: 出现在“равно”一词末尾，周围是俄语关于对象变为空对象的问答；同段还激活“По”“и”等短片段。

patterns.name: 英语对比连接词“contrary”
patterns.context: 出现在学术摘要的转折短语“On the contrary”中；附近还有“similar”“as that of”等比较表达。
patterns.domain: PubMed 英语生物医学摘要

en.concept: Local word-form fragments in multilingual text
en.description: Primarily responds to the Swedish word just (“just now,” also in just nu and just därför); it also responds to local character fragments of the same “as/но” type in Lithuanian žinias, Russian равно, Estonian just, and English Measles, showing a clear cross-lingual subword pattern.

patterns.name: Swedish just meaning “just now”
patterns.context: «just» is followed by a perfect auxiliary or present-perfect participle, as in “har just avslutats”, “har just diskuterat”, “ni just nämnde”, and “vi just har röstat”; also “just nu” and “just därför”

patterns.name: Character sequence in Lithuanian žinias
patterns.context: In the Lithuanian phrase “kompetenciją, žinias ir naujoves”, activation falls at the end of žinias

patterns.name: Character sequence in Russian равного
patterns.context: In a Russian technical Q&A, describing something becoming equivalent to an empty object; activation falls within “равно”

patterns.name: Character sequence in Estonian just
patterns.context: In the Estonian sentence “oleme näinud just viimastel aastatel”, it appears as just, spelled the same as in Swedish, but the context is Estonian

patterns.name: Internal character sequence in English Measles
patterns.context: A medical text lists antibody testing targets; activation falls on an internal character sequence in Measles

2_1199.concept: 多语文本中的局部词形片段
2_1199.description: 主要响应瑞典语单词 just（“刚刚”，也见 just nu、just därför）；另在立陶宛语 žinias、俄语 равно、爱沙尼亚语 just 和英语 Measles 中响应相同的“as/но”类局部字母片段，呈现明显的跨语言子词模式。

patterns.name: 瑞典语 just 表示刚刚
patterns.context: «just» 后接完成时助动词或现在完成式分词，如“har just avslutats”“har just diskuterat”“ni just nämnde”“vi just har röstat”；也有“just nu”“just därför”

patterns.name: 立陶宛语 žinias 中的字母序列
patterns.context: 立陶宛语短语“kompetenciją, žinias ir naujoves”中，激活落在 žinias 的末尾
patterns.domain: 立陶宛语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 俄语 равного 中的字母序列
patterns.context: 俄语技术问答中，描述某物变成等同于空对象；激活落在“равно”的内部

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语 just 的字母序列
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语句子“oleme näinud just viimastel aastatel”中，出现与瑞典语拼写相同的 just，但上下文是爱沙尼亚语
patterns.domain: 爱沙尼亚语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 英语 Measles 的内部字母序列
patterns.context: 医学文本列举抗体检测对象；激活落在 Measles 一词内部的字母序列

en.description: Activations cluster around two types of local expressions: the contrastive phrase “on the contrary” in academic discourse, and Swedish “just,” meaning just now or currently, in parliamentary records; Lithuanian “ir” appears once as well.

patterns.name: Contrastive phrase “on the contrary”
patterns.context: The phrase occurs at the beginning or middle of a sentence to introduce a statement that opposes, contrasts with, or corrects the preceding text; the main marked word is contrary.

patterns.name: Swedish just
patterns.context: Means “just now/exactly” in Swedish parliamentary speeches, as in “har just avslutats,” “Vi har just diskuterat,” and “just nu”; appears in descriptions of proceedings or the current point in time.

patterns.name: Lithuanian conjunction ir
patterns.context: Occurs in lists or coordinate structures, such as “žinias ir naujoves,” meaning “and”; the passage also contains markers on inflectional endings.

2_1199.concept: 局部词汇/短语识别
2_1199.description: 激活集中在两类局部表达：学术论述中的转折短语“on the contrary”，以及议会记录中表示刚刚、当前的瑞典语“just”；另见一次立陶宛语“ir”。

patterns.name: 转折短语“on the contrary”
patterns.context: 该短语出现在句首或句中，用来引出与前文相反、对照或修正的陈述；被标记的主要是 contrary。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（数学、生物医学、物理）

patterns.name: 瑞典语 just
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中表示“刚刚／正好”，如“har just avslutats”“Vi har just diskuterat”“just nu”；出现于议事过程或当前时点的叙述。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会瑞典语口语记录

patterns.name: 立陶宛语连接词 ir
patterns.context: 出现在列举或连接成分中，如“žinias ir naujoves”，意为“和”；该段同时出现格变化词尾的标记。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会立陶宛语文本

en.description: All passages show strong activation on the Ros- prefix in proper names, while subsequent spelling and contextual domains vary. Names include given names, surnames, team or organization names, and place names.

patterns.name: Ros prefix in proper names
patterns.context: The token occurs at the beginning of a proper name, such as a given name or surname, or a team, organization, or place name. No specific syntactic position is required; examples occur in lists, signatures, narratives, and legal documents.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain proper names; includes Wikipedia, legal documents, emails, paper abstracts, and literary texts

2_1544.concept: 专名中的 Ros- 前缀
2_1544.description: 全部段落都在专名的 Ros- 前缀处强激活，后续拼写和上下文领域各异；专名包括人名、姓氏、球队或机构名及地名。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Ros 前缀
patterns.context: 该 token 出现在专名开头；专名可为人名或姓氏，也可为球队、机构或地名。上下文不要求特定句法位置，名单、署名、叙述和法律文书中均出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域专名；涵盖维基百科、法律文书、邮件、论文摘要和文学文本

en.description: All segments show high activation on the string Ros- in personal or family names; each also has a few sporadic activated tokens, with no consistent pattern.

patterns.name: Personal-name segments beginning with Ros-
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in personal or family names beginning with Ros; the fragment may cross token boundaries, and subsequent spellings vary.
patterns.domain: Biographical articles, sports entries, legal documents, email directories, academic author lists, and literary texts

patterns.name: Sporadic activations unrelated to Ros in personal names
patterns.context: In the same contexts, several different tokens besides Ros-initial names show weaker activation, with no stable shared context or compositional pattern.
patterns.domain: Sporadic occurrences across Wikipedia, email, legal, academic, and literary corpora

2_1544.description: 所有片段都出现高激活的 Ros- 字符串，且均处于人名或姓氏中；各段另有少量分散激活 token，未见一致规律。

patterns.name: Ros- 开头的人名片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Ros 开头的人名或姓氏中；该片段可能跨 token 边界，后续拼写各不相同。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、体育条目、法律文书、邮件通讯录、学术作者列表及文学文本

patterns.name: 与人名中的 Ros 无关的零散激活
patterns.context: 同一上下文里除 Ros 开头姓名外，若干不同 token 也有较弱激活，未显示稳定的共同上下文或组合规律。
patterns.domain: 跨 Wikipedia、邮件、法律、学术和文学语料的零散现象

en.description: All segments contain a strongly marked Ros substring in different surnames, given names, or place names; entity types and genres vary. Other names also have occasional marks, but there is no evidence that they are independent primary triggers.

patterns.name: Name segments beginning with Ros-
patterns.context: Occurs within personal or organization names; subsequent spellings vary, such as Ros«enthal», Ros«eng»ård, Ros«man», Ros«elyn», Ros«al»ie. The highlighted span is the Ros substring in a name; it need not be a complete word or occur at the start of a word.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, sports entries, legal documents, email lists, paper author information, and historical texts

patterns.name: In-word segmentation of Rosen surnames
patterns.context: Ros is followed by different letter sequences to form names such as Rosenthal, Rosengård, Rosman, and Rosalee; stronger activation is concentrated on the Ros substring, while the specific suffix varies.

patterns.name: Names or place names beginning with Ros
patterns.context: Ros is followed by different spellings to form given names, surnames, or place names; some forms are not common Ros- surnames (e.g., Rosyth), so they cannot all be classified as the same surname.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic people and places, legal cases, and historical narratives

patterns.name: Name segments not beginning with Ros
patterns.context: Other parts of names are also marked as in-word fragments, but the prominent shared substring is still Ros in the same paragraph (Ros Hasni). This suggests a possible association with entity/name formatting, but the examples do not establish an independent trigger mechanism.
patterns.domain: Names and birth information in encyclopedic biographies

patterns.name: Non-name Ros forms or uncertain boundaries
patterns.context: Roser in a paper author field may be a surname or a given name; the name role cannot be determined from the fragment alone. The example still contains the Ros substring.
patterns.domain: Academic paper abstracts and author lists

2_1544.description: 所有段均含被强标记的 Ros 子串，位于不同姓名、名字或地名中；实体类型和文体多样。其他姓名内部也有零星标记，但没有证据表明它们是独立主触发。

patterns.name: Ros-开头的姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名或组织名内部；后续拼写各异，如 Ros«enthal»、Ros«eng»ård、Ros«man»、Ros«elyn»、Ros«al»ie。高亮的是名称中的 Ros 子串，不要求它是完整词或位于词首。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、体育条目、法律文书、邮件名单、论文作者信息及历史文本

patterns.name: 罗森姓氏的词内切分
patterns.context: Ros 后接不同字母片段，组成 Rosenthal、Rosengård、Rosman、Rosalee 等姓名；较强激活集中在 Ros 子串，具体后缀不固定。
patterns.domain: 人名实体及实体密集型文本

patterns.name: Ros 开头的名字或地名
patterns.context: Ros 后接不同拼写，形成名字、姓氏或地名；有些形式不是常见 Ros- 姓氏（如 Rosyth），不能仅归为同一姓氏。
patterns.domain: 百科人物与地点、法律案件及历史叙述

patterns.name: 不以 Ros 开头的姓名切分
patterns.context: 姓名其他部分也以词内片段标记，但激活显著的共同子串仍是同段落中的 Ros（Ros Hasni）。这提示可能存在实体/姓名格式关联，但无法由例子确定独立触发机制。
patterns.domain: 百科传记中的姓名与出生信息

patterns.name: 非姓名 Ros 形式或边界不确定
patterns.context: 论文作者字段中的 Roser 可能是姓氏，也可能是名字；仅凭片段不能确定姓名角色。该例仍含 Ros 子串。
patterns.domain: 学术论文摘要及作者列表

en.description: The most stable trigger is the “Ros” fragment in names or other proper nouns, followed by varied endings and appearing across multiple corpora. Other name fragments and a few non-name internal substrings also activate, with no single semantic category accounting for them.

patterns.name: Ros- in surnames
patterns.context: Occurs in names of people, clubs, or organizations; activation is concentrated on the tokenized Ros fragment, while suffixes and surrounding contexts vary widely
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies and sports entries, legal documents, email contacts, academic papers

patterns.name: Other fragments in names
patterns.context: Other parts of names show sporadic positive activation in name lists or body text, but less consistently than the Ros- fragment; this may be related to proper names and their tokenization
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal texts, emails, paper metadata

patterns.name: Similar strings in non-name words
patterns.context: Does not fully match the primary Ros- surname pattern; some instances are internal word substrings or proper names, and activation positions do not align with a consistent semantic category
patterns.domain: Sports entries, legal documents, mathematics papers, encyclopedia narratives

2_1544.concept: 姓名中的 Ros- 字串
2_1544.description: 最稳定的触发是姓名或专名中的“Ros”片段，后接多种词尾并出现在多类语料中。另有其他姓名片段及少量非姓名词内子串激活，无法归结为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 姓氏 Ros-
patterns.context: 出现在人名、俱乐部名或机构名中；激活集中在被切分标记的 Ros 片段，后缀及其余上下文变化很大
patterns.domain: 百科人物与体育条目、法律文书、邮件联系人、学术论文

patterns.name: 姓名中的其他片段
patterns.context: 人名列表或正文人名中，姓名其他部分也有零星正激活，但不如 Ros- 片段稳定；可能与专名及其分词形式有关
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、邮件、论文元数据

patterns.name: 非姓名词中的相似字串
patterns.context: 与主要 Ros- 姓氏模式不完全吻合；部分是词内子串或专名，激活位置与语义类别不一致
patterns.domain: 体育条目、法律文书、数学论文、百科叙述

en.concept: Proper names and other salient subword fragments
en.description: Activation is most consistently found in name segments beginning with Ros; there are also localized strong responses to vens in Damallsvenskan, Taylor, electrical, approving in approval contexts, and Fleming in a list. The fragments occur across encyclopedic, email, and medical texts.

patterns.name: Name segments beginning with Ros-
patterns.context: Activation falls on consecutive subword fragments beginning with Ros in names; these may be personal or place names, with varying spellings and suffixes.
patterns.domain: People, organizations, or place names in encyclopedia entries and corporate email

patterns.name: Word-final or cross-word-boundary -vens
patterns.context: Occurs in the name of the Swedish women's football league Damallsvenskan, with activation concentrated on the segmented subword vens.

patterns.name: Taylor name segment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the name Taylor in an email address and an email recipient list.
patterns.domain: Names and addresses in corporate email

patterns.name: Electrical term electrical
patterns.context: In biomedical descriptions of neuromuscular junctions and drug effects, activation falls on the word electrical.

patterns.name: Plan-approval wording approving
patterns.context: Occurs in a formal description of a plan submitted for approval and then approved by a legislative body through a resolution.
patterns.domain: Policy or regulatory affairs descriptions in corporate email

patterns.name: Name segment Fleming in a list
patterns.context: Appears in a list of names sorted by surname, near many other comma-separated names.
patterns.domain: Directories or lists in corporate email

2_1544.concept: 专名及其他显著子词片段
2_1544.description: 激活最稳定地出现在 Ros 开头的姓名片段；另对 Damallsvenskan 中的 vens、Taylor、electrical、审批语境中的 approving 及名单中的 Fleming 有局部强响应。不同片段分布于百科、邮件和医学文本。

patterns.name: Ros-开头的姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名中以 Ros 开头的连续子词片段；这些姓名可能是人名或地名，周围可有不同拼写和后缀。
patterns.domain: 百科条目与企业邮件中的人名、组织或地名

patterns.name: 词尾或跨词边界的 -vens
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典女子足球联赛名称 Damallsvenskan 内，激活集中于被切分出的 vens 子词。

patterns.name: Taylor 姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Taylor 这一姓名词上，分别出现在邮箱地址和邮件收件人列表中。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的姓名与地址

patterns.name: 电学术语 electrical
patterns.context: 激活在神经肌肉接头和药物效应的生物医学描述中，落在 electrical 一词。

patterns.name: 计划审批措辞 approving
patterns.context: 出现在关于计划提交审批、再由立法机构通过决议的正式说明中。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的政策或监管事务说明

patterns.name: 名单中的人名片段 Fleming
patterns.context: 在按姓氏排列的姓名清单中出现，附近也有大量逗号分隔的姓名。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的目录或名单

en.description: Activation is concentrated on several lexical fragments: Ros in proper names, approving in approval contexts, and isolated words such as Connie, dial, and electrical. The latter examples span different domains and contexts, with no unified syntactic or topical pattern.

patterns.name: Ros string and its continuations
patterns.context: The Ros string in a name or other proper noun, usually an internal word fragment after tokenization; full spellings vary, suggesting a specific subword fragment trigger.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal texts, emails, and lists

patterns.name: Approving in approval resolutions
patterns.context: Occurs in formal approval or regulatory resolution language, followed by objects such as rules or orders.

patterns.name: Connie as a name
patterns.context: Used as a form of address in dialogue or as a name in an email recipient list.

patterns.name: Dial in phone instructions
patterns.context: Occurs in conference-call arrangements, followed by “in instructions” after a hyphen.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in electrical
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “membrane electrical noise” in a medical research abstract.

2_1544.description: 激活集中于若干词汇片段：专名中的 Ros、审批语境的 approving，以及 Connie、dial、electrical 等孤立词。后几项跨领域且上下文各异，未见统一句法或主题模式。

patterns.name: Ros 字符串及其续接
patterns.context: 姓名或专名中的 Ros 字符串，且通常是分词后的词内片段；完整拼写不一致，可能是特定子词片段触发。

patterns.name: 批准决议中的 approving
patterns.context: 出现在正式审批或法规决议表述中，后接规则、命令等宾语。

patterns.name: Connie 人名
patterns.context: 作为对话称呼或邮件收件人名单中的姓名。

patterns.name: 数字拨号词 dial
patterns.context: 出现在电话会议安排中，连字符后接“in instructions”。

patterns.name: electrical 的词内片段
patterns.context: 医学研究摘要中，位于“membrane electrical noise”短语内。

en.description: Primarily activates on the letter string “Ros” in proper names, including people, teams, places, and dramatic characters; a separate “cano” fragment appears in canoe, volcano, and metaphorical usage. No clear corresponding pattern is evident for the approval plan in the email or sermon in the novel.

patterns.name: “Ros” fragment in proper names
patterns.context: Embedded in different proper nouns; it is not tied to a fixed word boundary or meaning, and following characters vary, as in “Ros Hasni,” “Rosengård,” “Roselyn,” and “Rosyth.”
patterns.domain: Proper names such as people, clubs, and places, across Wikipedia, legal texts, novels, and other texts

patterns.name: “cano” string
patterns.context: Occurs within complete words such as canoes, volcano, and volcanic; topics include boats and volcanoes, as well as metaphorical usage.
patterns.domain: Novel narratives, volcano-related descriptions; word-form string matching

patterns.name: Subword fragment in names at the start of paragraphs or entries
patterns.context: A name is repeated at the beginning of an entry and contains the “Ros” fragment; the strongest specific activation falls on “Ros.”

patterns.name: Team names containing “Ros” in sports entries
patterns.context: The Ros substring occurs in club or team names; also seen in the team name “«Ros»9engård” containing Ros.
patterns.domain: Football season overviews and sports club histories

patterns.name: Proper names containing “Ros” in dramatic dialogue or literary texts
patterns.context: The spelling of Shakespeare’s character Rosencrantz contains Ros; the same passage also discusses drama and prose dialogue.

patterns.name: “Ros” in general names
patterns.context: Ros occurs within a name; the fragment may cross into a following morpheme and does not form a stable semantic category.

2_1544.concept: 字母串片段 Ros（兼有 cano）
2_1544.description: 主要激活于专名中的字母串“Ros”，覆盖人名、队名、地名和戏剧人物名；另有独立的“cano”片段，见 canoe、volcano 及比喻用法。邮件中的批准方案和小说中的 sermon 暂无明确对应模式。

patterns.name: 专名片段“Ros”
patterns.context: 嵌在不同专有名词中；不是固定单词边界或特定词义，后续字符各不相同，如“Ros Hasni”“Rosengård”“Roselyn”“Rosyth”。
patterns.domain: 人名、俱乐部名、地名等专名，跨 Wikipedia、法律、小说及其他文本

patterns.name: “cano”字符串
patterns.context: 出现在完整词内部：canoes、volcano、volcanic 等；所处主题包括船只及火山，也有比喻用法。
patterns.domain: 小说叙述、火山相关说明；词形字符串匹配

patterns.name: 段落或条目起始姓名的子词片段
patterns.context: 姓名在条目开头重复出现，且含有“Ros”片段；其中较强的具体激活落在“Ros”。

patterns.name: 体育条目中的队名包含“Ros”
patterns.context: 俱乐部或队伍专名中出现 Ros 子串；另见带 Ros 的队名“«Ros»9engård”。
patterns.domain: 足球赛季介绍及体育俱乐部历史

patterns.name: 戏剧对白或文学文本中的专名含“Ros”
patterns.context: 莎士比亚人物 Rosencrantz 的词形中出现 Ros；同段还有戏剧与 prose dialogue 讨论。

patterns.name: 一般姓名中的“Ros”
patterns.context: 人名内部出现 Ros；片段可能跨越后续词素，未形成稳定语义类别。
patterns.domain: 人物传记及法律裁判文本

en.concept: Appearance or judgment introduced by seemed
en.description: The main pattern is the English word “seemed” and nearby expressions, especially “seemed to” and “seemed as if,” used to convey observation, speculation, or judgment in novels, legal texts, and news. Passages 5 and 8 show no clear corresponding trigger.

patterns.name: Seemed followed by a description or judgment
patterns.context: “Seemed” shows the strongest activation, often followed by “to” or “as if” to describe how a person or thing appears; sometimes followed by like or somewhat of a.
patterns.domain: Novel narratives, legal documents, news reports

patterns.name: Seemed unable to act or concentrate
patterns.context: Seemed is followed by a judgment about insufficient ability, inability, or unwillingness to do something.

patterns.name: Narrative use of seemed to challenge
patterns.context: “Seemed to” introduces an action or posture with a challenging quality.

patterns.name: Seemed like a good idea
patterns.context: “Seemed like” is followed by an evaluation of a decision or action.

patterns.name: Seemed somewhat of a foregone conclusion
patterns.context: “Seemed” is followed by a judgment that the outcome was already settled.

2_1544.concept: seemed 引出的表象或判断
2_1544.description: 主模式是英语词“seemed”及其相邻表达，尤其“seemed to”“seemed as if”，用于呈现观察、推测或判断，涵盖小说、法律和新闻。第5、8段没有明显对应触发词。

patterns.name: seemed 后接描述或判断
patterns.context: “seemed”受到最强激活，常见后续为“to”或“as if”，引出人物、事物看起来如何；有时后接 like 或 somewhat of a。
patterns.domain: 小说叙事、法律文书、新闻报道

patterns.name: 似乎无法行动或无法专注
patterns.context: 似乎后接能力不足、无法或不愿做某事的判断。

patterns.name: seemed to challenge 的叙事用法
patterns.context: “seemed to”引出带有挑战意味的动作或姿态。

patterns.name: 似乎是个好主意
patterns.context: “seemed like”后接对某项决定或行为的评价。

patterns.name: seemed somewhat of a foregone conclusion
patterns.context: “seemed”后接对结果已成定局的判断。

en.description: Strong activation falls on the paragraph transition word “Finally,” the phrases “simplest prototype/hub,” and the mathematical symbol “tau.” The first occurs across several genres, while the latter two are limited to specific contexts. Activation locations in passages 1 and 9 show no clear shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Finally as a paragraph transition marker
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of a paragraph or at the beginning of a sentence after a line break, followed by a comma and introducing a final item, conclusion, or new topic.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain expository, discussion, and email texts

patterns.name: Simplest prototype or configuration
patterns.context: Occurs in “I will start with the simplest prototype” or “the simplest hub possible,” describing a simplified approach to be built or tested.

patterns.name: Mathematical group element tau
patterns.context: Occurs in a definition of robotic-arm symmetry and a group G, as an element of the set {1, tau}.

2_1544.concept: 不明显的词汇/符号触发
2_1544.description: 强激活分别落在段落推进词“Finally”、短语“simplest prototype/hub”和数学符号“tau”上；前者跨多类文体，后两者各限特定语境。第1、9段激活处没有明显共同触发模式。

patterns.name: Finally 段落转折标记
patterns.context: 出现在段落末尾或换行后的句首，后接逗号并引出最后一项、结论或新话题。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文、讨论和邮件文本

patterns.name: simplest 原型或配置
patterns.context: 出现在“I will start with the simplest prototype”或“the simplest hub possible”中，修饰开始构建或测试的简化方案。

patterns.name: 数学群元素 tau
patterns.context: 出现在对机械臂对称性及群 G 的定义中，作为集合 {1, tau} 的元素。

en.description: Primarily activates on the here substring across words such as there, where, nowhere, and here, and across code, academic, and narrative contexts; also activates on the part substring in tripartite and partisanship.

patterns.name: here suffix in here
patterns.context: The target string is split at token boundaries, with activation on here; it appears in different spellings or word boundaries such as there, where, nowhere, and in here, usually inside a sentence.
patterns.domain: Multidomain texts, code, and ordinary narratives

patterns.name: part suffix in part
patterns.context: Activation falls on the part substring, appearing in the tokenization of the anthrax toxin term tripartite and the political word partisanship.

2_1544.description: 主要激活于 here 子串，跨越 there、where、nowhere、here 等词及代码、学术、叙事语境；另在 tripartite、partisanship 中激活于 part 子串。

patterns.name: here 中的后缀 here
patterns.context: 目标字符串被拆分到 token 边界，激活落在 here；可见于 there、where、nowhere、in here 等不同拼写或词界中，通常处于句子内部。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本、代码与普通叙述

patterns.name: part 中的后缀 part
patterns.context: 激活落在 part 子串，分别出现在 anthrax toxin 术语 tripartite 和政治词 partisanship 的分词中。

en.concept: Internal fragments and sporadic formatting features
en.description: The clearest repeated cross-domain pattern is the -omes/-ome fragment inside longer words. Other sporadic triggers include code help text, patent boilerplate, part in legal definitions, and Portuguese pronouns, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: -omes/-ome word-form fragment
patterns.context: The trigger is usually inside a longer word, often at the word ending or the boundary between a stem and suffix; surrounding semantics and syntax vary widely. In passage 1, «thym» occurs in thymus and thymocytes; in passage 6, «onucle» occurs in isonucleosides. These may be responses to the same kind of internal word fragment, but the evidence is weak.
patterns.domain: Across genres including biomedical, mathematical, dictionary, news, patent, and code texts; this fragment pattern does not depend on a specific domain.

patterns.name: Python command help output
patterns.context: In Python function definitions and command-line help text, responses fall on code keywords, output statements, and help menu items; activation does not correspond to just one word fragment.
patterns.domain: Python code and CLI documentation on Github.

patterns.name: Emphasis word in patent legal boilerplate
patterns.context: Occurs in the fixed phrase “either alone or in any combination thereof” in a patent background section, describing prior art alone or in combination.

patterns.name: part in a legal definition
patterns.context: Occurs in “as part of an electronic address,” meaning a component; although the homograph is the same as in passage 2, the local syntax and meaning differ.

patterns.name: Portuguese interrogative expression
patterns.context: Occurs in the Portuguese sentence “Eu fiz a conversão aí mas”; activation falls on the first-person pronoun, with insufficient evidence to determine whether the trigger is the language itself or a specific collocation.

2_1544.concept: 词内片段与零散格式特征
2_1544.description: 最明显的跨领域重复模式是长词内部的 -omes/-ome 片段；另有代码帮助文本、专利套语、法律定义中的 part，以及葡萄牙语代词等零散触发，未形成统一语义规律。

patterns.name: -omes/-ome 词形片段
patterns.trigger: «omes»（如 transcript«omes»、micros«omes»、bi«omes»、hom«omes»、h«omes»）；以及第 1 段中的 «thym»、第 6 段中的 «onucle»
patterns.context: 触发位置多在较长单词内部，常见于词尾或词干与后缀交界；周围语义和句法差异很大。第 1 段的 «thym» 位于 thymus、thymocytes 中，第 6 段的 «onucle» 位于 isonucleosides 中，可能是同类词内片段响应，但证据较弱。
patterns.domain: 跨生物医学、数学、词典、新闻、专利和代码等文体；该片段模式不依赖特定领域。

patterns.name: Python 命令帮助输出
patterns.context: Python 函数定义及命令行帮助文本中，响应落在代码关键字、输出语句和帮助菜单项上；激活并非只对应某个单词片段。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Python 代码与 CLI 文档。

patterns.name: 专利法律套语中的强调词
patterns.context: 出现在专利背景技术的固定表述“either alone or in any combination thereof”中，描述现有技术单独或组合的情形。

patterns.name: 法律定义中的 part
patterns.context: 出现在“as part of an electronic address”中，表示某个组成部分；与第 2 段的同形词虽相同，局部句法和语义不同。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语疑问表达
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语句子“Eu fiz a conversão aí mas”中；激活落在第一人称代词，未见足够证据判断是否由语言本身或具体搭配触发。

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on local fragments such as out (code output or labels) and easy (simple, effortless); the rest is distributed across punctuation, line breaks, technical terms, command help, and legal citations, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: out label or output marker
patterns.context: Code or terminal text contains an out label, output path, or connected output object; sometimes adjacent to a colon, line break, or variable assignment

patterns.name: In-word fragment of easy
patterns.context: easy occurs in English phrases describing an operation or property, such as “easy to form”, “easy accessibility”, “easy replacement”; activation marks only part of the word

patterns.name: Separating punctuation and structural markers in technical text
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur near punctuation, parentheses, periods, and line breaks in technical prose, legal decisions, or code, with no stable lexical trigger
patterns.domain: Scientific, patent, legal, and code texts

patterns.name: Sporadic local activation on technical vocabulary
patterns.context: Individual technical words or in-word fragments in biomedical, network programming, or engineering contexts; no shared trigger word recurs across segments

patterns.name: Formatting in terminal usage instructions
patterns.context: Local activations occur near output prompts and command lists in command-line help text

patterns.name: Legal provision citations and judicial wording
patterns.context: Near citations to Federal Rules of Criminal Procedure provisions and terms such as affirm/vacate/remand in decisions

2_1544.description: 激活最一致地落在 out（代码输出或标签）以及 easy（易于、容易）等局部片段；其余分布于标点、换行、技术词、命令帮助和法律编号等多种位置，未呈现统一语义条件。

patterns.name: out标签或输出标记
patterns.context: 代码或终端文本中出现 out 标签、输出路径或连接输出对象；有时紧邻冒号、换行或变量赋值

patterns.name: easy 的词内片段
patterns.context: easy 出现在描述操作或性质的英语短语中，如“easy to form”“easy accessibility”“easy replacement”；激活只标在词的一部分

patterns.name: 专业文本中的分隔标点及结构标记
patterns.context: 专业叙述、法律判决或代码中，标点、括号、句号及换行附近有零散激活，未见稳定词汇触发

patterns.name: 技术词汇的零散局部激活
patterns.context: 生物医学、网络编程或工程技术语境中的个别技术词或词内片段；缺少跨段复现的共同触发词

patterns.name: 终端用法说明的排版
patterns.context: 命令行帮助文本中，输出提示及命令列表附近有局部激活

patterns.name: 法律条文编号和裁判措辞
patterns.context: 联邦刑事程序条款引用及判决中 affirm/vacate/remand 等措辞附近

en.description: Activation is distributed across where/thereunder in legal texts, Gib in Gibby/Gibraltar, out in technical texts, the subword fragment in Committees, and line breaks, indentation, and paper citations; no single meaning accounts for all of them.

patterns.name: Locative/relational preposition where
patterns.context: Introduces conditions, locations, or relative clauses in legal texts; passage 3 has thereunder in a clause.

patterns.name: Gib fragment in place names
patterns.context: In passage 2, it is part of the place name Gibby Beam; in passage 10, it is embedded in Gibraltar.

patterns.name: out output marker
patterns.context: The string out occurs in code or technical texts: passage 4 has program output, passage 5 has it in a paper-title author name, and passage 9 has it as a C code label.
patterns.domain: StackExchange code Q&A, computer science paper citations, Github source code

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Committees
patterns.context: Occurs in the name Armed Services Committees; activation falls on the internal tees substring.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or internal segmentation marker
patterns.context: Activation occurs near line breaks or indentation; it may be related to formatted text or code block boundaries, but not all line breaks trigger it.

patterns.name: Internal token fragment out
patterns.context: Occurs in English technical citations such as paper titles and author names, with activation involving subword tokenization; partially overlaps with the out string in passages 4 and 9.

2_1544.description: 激活分散于法律文本中的 where/thereunder、Gibby/Gibraltar 内的 Gib、技术文本中的 out，以及 Committees、换行缩进和论文引文的子词片段；尚无单一语义能解释全部。

patterns.name: 地点/方位介词 where
patterns.context: 法律文本中引出条件、地点或关系从句；段3为条款中的 thereunder。

patterns.name: Gibby 地名片段
patterns.context: 段2中是地名 Gibby Beam 的组成部分；段10中嵌在 Gibraltar 一词内。

patterns.name: out 输出标记
patterns.context: 位于代码或技术文本中的 out 字符串：段4是程序输出，段5出现在论文标题作者名中，段9是 C 代码标签。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码问答、计算机论文引用、Github 源码

patterns.name: Committees 词内片段
patterns.context: 国会委员会名称 Armed Services Committees 中；激活落在词内的 tees 子串。

patterns.name: 句首或句内切分标记
patterns.context: 换行或缩进附近出现激活；可能与格式化文本、代码块边界有关，但并非所有换行都触发。

patterns.name: 切分词内片段 out
patterns.context: 出现在论文标题、作者名等英文技术引文中，激活涉及子词切分；与段4、9的 out 字符串部分重合。

en.concept: Multiple local word-form and phrase triggers
en.description: Strong patterns include the range expression “up to”, where in legal conditional clauses, and the out substring; there are also scattered triggers involving gullies/Gibby, Hoc, patent risk statements, and various isolated words that cannot be grouped.

patterns.name: “up to” upper-bound or range expression
patterns.context: «up» immediately precedes to, introducing an upper bound for a quantity, degree, or equivalent transformation; to is unmarked
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patents, and mathematics papers

patterns.name: where in legal conditional clauses
patterns.context: In legal argument, where introduces a judicial condition or factual circumstance, with a court, discretion, or legal consequence nearby

patterns.name: out substring
patterns.context: Activation falls on words containing out or on a standalone command-line output marker; semantic and syntactic environments vary
patterns.domain: Functional programming papers; Python code and terminal output

patterns.name: gullies and the place name beam
patterns.context: Describes mining landforms and their naming features; activation is distributed across subword fragments in gullies and Gibby

patterns.name: Hoc protein and its name fragment
patterns.context: In technical descriptions of phage capsids and targeting ligands, activation falls within the protein name Hoc

patterns.name: Risk of unreacted substances in bottled materials
patterns.context: Discusses migration of monomers or oligomers from beverage bottles, water, and containers, and related health risks; multiple activated words are scattered across the same sentence

patterns.name: Proper names or citation-format fragments in medical literature
patterns.context: A reference author's surname appears in a parenthetical citation in a medical paper

patterns.name: Corpus-specific words near unmarked introductory words
patterns.context: These activations occur respectively in reference markers, mathematical terms, and ordinary function words or adjectives, with no shared local syntactic or semantic condition

patterns.name: Other sporadic lexical activations
patterns.context: Seen only in single segments, across particle, physics, medical, and legal contexts; no stable shared trigger pattern

2_1544.concept: 多种局部词形与短语触发
2_1544.description: 强模式包括“up to”范围表达、法律条件从句 where，以及 out 子串；另有 gullies/Gibby、Hoc、专利风险语句中的分散触发和多种无法归并的孤立词。

patterns.name: “up to”上限或范围表达
patterns.trigger: «up»8 to 870 copies per particle；«up»9 to 155 copies per capsid；«up»9 to moderate densities；«up»9 to variable relabeling
patterns.context: «up»紧邻 to，用于引出数量、程度或等价变换的范围上限；to 未标记
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利及数学论文

patterns.name: 法律条件从句中的 where
patterns.trigger: « where»10 the appellate court；« where»9 it appears
patterns.context: 法律论述中 where 引出裁判条件或事实情形，前后涉及法院、裁量或法律后果

patterns.name: out 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在包含 out 的词或独立的命令行输出标记上，语义和句法环境不一致
patterns.domain: 函数式编程论文；Python 代码及终端输出

patterns.name: gullies 与 beam 地名
patterns.context: 描述采矿地貌及其命名特征；激活分布在 gullies 和 Gibby 的子词片段上

patterns.name: Hoc 蛋白及其命名片段
patterns.context: 在噬菌体衣壳及靶向配体的技术描述中，激活落在蛋白名称 Hoc 内部

patterns.name: 瓶装材料中未反应物质的风险
patterns.context: 讨论饮料瓶、水及容器中的单体或低聚物迁移和健康风险；多个激活词分散在同一句

patterns.name: 医学文献中的专名或引用格式片段
patterns.context: 参考文献作者姓氏出现在医学论文的括号引用中

patterns.name: 未标记引导词附近的语料偶发词
patterns.context: 这些激活分别位于参考文献标识、数学术语及普通功能词或形容词中，缺乏共同的局部句法或语义条件

patterns.name: 其余零散词汇激活
patterns.trigger: « particle»1；« agreement»1；« polarized»3；« premature»3；« public»1« officials»2；« gross»2
patterns.context: 仅见于单段，分属粒子、物理、医学和法律语境；没有稳定的共同触发模式

en.description: Activation positions are distributed across different word forms and contexts: Gib- proper names, Cout- names, the place name beam, the Portuguese word ending ciente, and here in legal contexts. Apart from proper-name fragments, no unified semantic or syntactic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Gibco brand or name fragment
patterns.context: Proper names beginning with the string Gib- occur; commonly the Gibco BRL reagent brand, but also names of people, places, or organizations, with activation concentrated on Gib and subsequent subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Biomedical methods and reagents, transportation research, parliamentary texts, etc.

patterns.name: Cout- initial surnames or names
patterns.context: Occurs in author names or bibliographic names in references, or in proper names; nearby text often includes citation formatting, publication titles, or author lists.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, computer science papers, bibliographies

patterns.name: Place name containing beam
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper name Gibby Beam, preceded by a list of gullies on a moor; the broader sentence mentions landforms and their names.

patterns.name: Portuguese word ending -iente
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-ending fragment «ciente» in Portuguese, meaning that someone is informed; the same passage also mentions the name of an MEP, Banotti.

patterns.name: here in a legal sentence
patterns.context: Activation falls on here; occurs after a case citation, contrasting the facts of an earlier case and recounting the evidence in the present case.

2_1544.description: 激活位置分散在不同词形和语境：Gib- 专名、Cout- 姓名、beam 地名、葡语 ciente 词尾及法律语境 here；除专名片段外，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: Gibco 商标或名称片段
patterns.context: 出现字符串 Gib- 起始的专名；常见于 Gibco BRL 试剂商标，也见人名/地名或机构名，激活集中在 Gib 及其后续子词片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法与试剂、交通研究、议会文本等

patterns.name: Cout- 开头的姓氏或名称
