patterns.context: 出现在参考文献中的作者姓名或书目姓名，或专名；周围常有引用格式、出版物标题或作者列表。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、计算机科学论文、书目

patterns.name: 带 beam 的地名
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Gibby Beam 中，前文列举 moor 上的沟谷名称；更广泛的句子提及地貌特征及其命名。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾 -iente
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语 «ciente» 的词尾片段，句中表示某人知情；同段还出现议员姓名 Banotti。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

patterns.name: 法律句中的 here
patterns.context: 激活落在 here；出现在判例引证后，对比先前案件事实并转述本案证据。

en.description: Activation has no unified semantic theme: the most salient and recurring pattern is the out/Cout letter sequence; other activations span Portuguese word fragments, gullies, mathematical formula symbols, paper citations, and legal abbreviations, with varied sources and functions.

patterns.name: Cout and its in-word fragments
patterns.context: Strong response to in-word or word-boundary segmentation of the letter sequence out / Cout; especially prominent in 1, 2, 4, 8, 9 are surnames or code identifiers Cout*, while in 7 it occurs in out-coming.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains: functional programming, name indexes, biomedicine, code Q&A, physics

patterns.name: Portuguese word-final fragments
patterns.context: In-word fragments, common words, and punctuation in continuous Portuguese text; 3 and 6 are both parliamentary speeches, with activation distributed across multiple word fragments.

patterns.name: gullies and place-name fragments
patterns.context: English narrative about landform ravines and their names; gullies recurs in the same segment.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula markers
patterns.context: A paper passage on the Wigner surmise and matrix formulas; mathematical delimiters and nearby formula text are prominent.

patterns.name: Scientific citations and reference formatting
patterns.context: Literature citations and discussion of Kerr spacetime geodesics; triggers are scattered and may include common word fragments or citation formatting.

patterns.name: Legal abbreviation CPL
patterns.context: Statutory abbreviation CPL article 730 in legal decisions and criminal proceedings; activations beyond the abbreviation are weaker.

2_1544.description: 激活没有统一语义主题：最显著且反复出现的是 out/Cout 字母片段；另覆盖葡萄牙语词片段、gullies、数学公式符号、论文引文及法律缩写，来源和功能各异。

patterns.name: Cout 与其词内片段
patterns.context: 对字母序列 out / Cout 的词内或词边界切分强烈响应；1、2、4、8、9中尤其突出的是姓氏或代码标识符 Cout*，7中则出现在 out-coming。
patterns.domain: 多领域：函数式编程、姓名索引、生物医学、代码问答、物理学

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语连续文本中的词内片段、常见词及标点；3、6均为议会发言，激活分布在多个词片段上。

patterns.name: gullies 与地名词片段
patterns.context: 英文关于地貌沟谷及其名称的叙述；gullies 在同段重复出现。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式标记
patterns.context: Wigner surmise 及矩阵公式的论文段落；突出数学定界符和公式邻近文本。

patterns.name: 科研引文与参考文献格式
patterns.context: Kerr 时空测地线研究的文献引述与叙述；触发分散，可能混有常见词片段或引用格式。

patterns.name: 法律缩写 CPL
patterns.context: 法律判决和刑事诉讼语境中的法条缩写 CPL article 730；除缩写外的激活较弱。

en.description: Activations often fall on letter fragments such as Gib, Coy, and out, scattered across proper names, common words, and texts from different fields. There are also activations on word fragments in a poem and within Argentine, with no unified semantic explanation yet.

patterns.name: gib/related strings within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on the string Gib in proper names or words; capitalization, word boundaries, and following characters vary, suggesting subword fragments rather than complete-word triggers.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, academic papers, literary texts

patterns.name: C + oy fragments within words
patterns.context: Occurs in the Coy module name and the personal name Wil-E-Coyote; strong activations concentrate within the string Coy.

patterns.name: Other within-word fragment out
patterns.context: Activations fall on letter fragments in the surname Coutinho and the word Courts, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Other within-word fragments without shared semantics
patterns.context: Activations occur on common word fragments in a poem and in the classification label Argentine; apart from occurring within words, the trigger conditions are unclear.

2_1544.description: 激活多落在 Gib、Coy、out 等字母片段上，分散于专名、普通词及不同领域文本；另有诗句词片段与 Argentine 内的激活，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 单词内部的 gib/关联词段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或词语中的 Gib 字符串；大小写、词界及其后续字符不同，可能是子词片段而非完整词触发。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、学术论文、文学文本

patterns.name: C + oy 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Coy 模块名及人名 Wil-E-Coyote 中；强激活集中于字符串 Coy 的内部。

patterns.name: 其他词内片段 out
patterns.context: 激活落在 Coutinho 姓氏和 Courts 一词的字母片段中，未见明确共同语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、书目列表

patterns.name: 其他无共同语义的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在诗句中的普通词片段，以及分类标签 Argentine 中；除位于词内外，触发条件不明。

en.concept: Argentina word-form fragments and sporadic word fragments
en.description: Primary activations occur on the Ar and gent fragments within Argentina/Argentine word forms, across news, country classifications, and sports entries; other sporadic triggers include a programming module name, the place name Gibby, and up to in a physics paper.

patterns.name: Fragments in Argentina word forms
patterns.context: In-word fragments in country names or adjectives such as Argentina and Argentine; common in category labels, sports events, and news headlines, and also found within sentences.

patterns.name: C in a code example
patterns.context: A module is mentioned after a Perl compilation error; only in this example does activation fall on the C/oy fragment rather than an Argentina word form.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in the place name beam
patterns.context: When describing mining gullies and their place names, activation is concentrated on the initial fragment of Gibby; it is not clearly related to the other examples.

patterns.name: up in a physics description
patterns.context: A paper describes the strength of a magnetic dipole interaction as reaching a certain multiple; activation occurs in the phrase up to.

2_1544.concept: 阿根廷词形片段及零散词片段
2_1544.description: 主要激活于 Argentina/Argentine 词形内部的 Ar、gent 片段，涵盖新闻、国家分类与体育条目；另有编程模块名、Gibby 地名及物理论文 up to 等零散触发。

patterns.name: Argentina 词形中的片段
patterns.context: Argentina、Argentine、Argentine 等国名或形容词的词内片段；常见于分类标签、体育赛事和新闻标题，也出现在句中。

patterns.name: 代码示例中的 C
patterns.context: Perl 编译错误之后提及添加某模块；仅此例中激活落在 C/oy 片段，而非阿根廷词形。

patterns.name: beam 地名中的词尾
patterns.context: 描述矿区沟壑及其地名时，激活集中在 Gibby 的开头片段；与其他例子无明显关联。

patterns.name: 物理描述中的 up
patterns.context: 论文中描述磁偶极相互作用强度可达到某一倍数；激活在短语 up to 中。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the spelling fragment Cun, found in names or proper nouns such as Cunard, Cunha, and Cunliffe. There are also sporadic activations on fragments within English words and on title and proper-name tokens, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Cun-related names and terms
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the spelling fragment Cun, occurring in different words such as Cuna, Cunha, and Cunard; the triggering form may involve within-word subwords or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Within-word English fragments and common suffixes
patterns.context: Activations occur on fragments within longer English words, with no unified semantics; some fragments have no clear connection to the Cun pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in titles and proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on local tokens in proper names, title words, or cited references, with no shared contextual conditions.

2_1544.concept: Cun 字符串及零散子词
2_1544.description: 主要对 Cun 拼写片段敏感，涉及 Cunard、Cunha、Cunliffe 等姓名或专名；另有若干英文词内片段及标题、专名 token 的零散激活，缺少统一语义解释。

patterns.name: Cun 相关姓名与词项
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Cun 拼写片段，出现在 Cuna、Cunha、Cunard 等不同词中；触发形式可能包含词内子词或分词边界。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段与常见后缀
patterns.context: 在较长英文词的词内片段上激活，未见统一语义；其中部分片段与 Cun 模式无明显关联。

patterns.name: 标题与专名中的零散片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、标题词或引用文献中的局部 token，缺少共同上下文条件。

en.description: The main pattern is an existential clause introduced by there is/are/were after a comma, often used for contrast or an additional statement; there are also scattered activations on encompasses, fragments within proper names, and several isolated words and punctuation marks, with some paragraphs not fitting the main pattern.

patterns.name: Existential clause following there
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on there in a mid-sentence existential construction followed by is, are, or were; often in a contrastive or supplementary clause after a comma.

patterns.name: Expression of inclusion
patterns.context: Describes the objects covered by a formula or disclosure in legal argument; the same word recurs within a segment.

patterns.name: Word fragments within proper names
patterns.context: The activated fragment is embedded in a proper name or personal-name spelling rather than being a stable semantic trigger; similar fragments occur in different words.

patterns.name: Punctuation and sentence boundaries
patterns.context: Weak activations occur near commas or periods, often adjacent to existential there constructions or at sentence ends; it is uncertain whether this is an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic word activations
patterns.context: Occur sporadically in their respective contexts, with no shared clear lexical or syntactic condition.

2_1544.description: 主模式是逗号后以 there is/are/were 引出的存在句，常用于转折或补充陈述；另有 encompasses、专名内片段及若干零散词和标点激活，部分段落无法归入主模式。

patterns.name: there 后接存在句
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在句中 there 后，接 is、are 或 were 的存在句；常位于逗号后的转折或补充分句中。
patterns.domain: 学术、专利及说明性散文

patterns.name: 包含关系表达
patterns.context: 在法律论证中描述一项公式或披露所涵盖的对象；同一词在一段中重复出现。

patterns.name: 专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活片段嵌在专名或人名拼写中，并非稳定的词义触发；不同词中出现相似片段。
patterns.domain: 百科、参考文献及体育新闻

patterns.name: 标点与句界
patterns.context: 逗号或句号附近有弱激活，常紧邻 there 存在句或句末；是否为独立模式不确定。

patterns.name: 零散词语激活
patterns.trigger: « Mediterranean»、« European»、« White»、« Star»、« companies»、« vessels»、« server»、« proteins»
patterns.context: 在各自语境中零散出现，未见共同的明确词义或句法条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to there introducing an existential statement (there are/is); other activations fall on fragments within proper names or abbreviations such as Cunard and Cunha. The latter pattern is weaker, and some instances are unexplained.

patterns.name: Cun/Cun- strings in proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized fragments within proper names, especially the shipping company Cunard and the Portuguese name Cunha.

patterns.name: Existential sentences with there
patterns.context: there is immediately followed by are/is, often introducing a question, drawback, or state; activations concentrate on there and are relatively strong.

patterns.name: Internal subword fragments in various proper names
patterns.context: Activations occur on fragments within names, abbreviations, or words, with no shared semantics or consistent syntactic environment.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, forums, patents, emails, and medical style texts

2_1544.description: 主要响应句中引出存在陈述的 there（there are/is）；另有激活落在 Cunard、Cunha 等专名或缩写的内部片段，后者规律较弱，部分实例无法解释。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Cun/Cun- 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部的分词片段上，尤其是 Cunard 航运公司及葡萄牙人名 Cunha。

patterns.name: 句中 there 后的存在句
patterns.trigger: « there»10 are；« there»10 is；« there»9 are；« there»8 is
patterns.context: there 后紧接 are/is，常引出问题、缺点或状态；激活集中在 there，强度较高。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、法律论证

patterns.name: 多种专名中的内部子词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在名称、缩写或词语内部的片段，未见共同语义或一致句法环境。
patterns.domain: 百科、论坛、专利、邮件及医学出版规范文本

en.description: Primarily activates on substrings within proper names such as Cun-; it also hits other in-word fragments in place and personal names, along with scattered activations on paragraph-initial line breaks, common words, and punctuation in patent texts.

patterns.name: Cunha surname fragment
patterns.context: Names or proper nouns contain Cun-, including Cunha and Cunard; the fragment occurs across different capitalization and word forms.
patterns.domain: Email recipients, legal texts, historical and encyclopedic articles

patterns.name: Letter fragments within place or proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls inside longer proper names or place names rather than standalone words; examples include Coryell, Lauderdale, Coral Gables, and Alberta.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in foreign names
patterns.context: Portuguese names João de Barros, António, and other proper names with diacritics contain activated in-word substrings.

patterns.name: Paragraph-initial line-break marker
patterns.context: A line break at the start of a new paragraph heading or body is marked; in this example it directly follows the heading “Early operation”.

patterns.name: Common words and punctuation in long text
patterns.context: Patent technical prose contains there, commas, and line breaks after periods, with no direct word-form condition shared with the proper-name pattern.

2_1544.description: 主要对 Cun- 等专名内部的子串激活，也命中地名、人名中的其他词内片段；另有段首换行及专利文本常见词、标点的零散激活。

patterns.name: Cunha 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 姓名或专名中包含 Cun-，包括 Cunha、Cunard；片段可跨越不同大小写和词形。
patterns.domain: 邮件收件人、法律文本、历史与百科文章

patterns.name: 地名或专名内部的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长专名或地名的内部，而非独立词；包括 Coryell、Lauderdale、Coral Gables、Alberta。

patterns.name: 外语姓名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语姓名 João de Barros、António 等带变音符号的专名中，激活落在词内子串。

patterns.name: 句首换行标记
patterns.context: 新段落标题或正文开始处的换行符被标记；该例中紧接标题 “Early operation”。

patterns.name: 长文本中的常见词与标点
patterns.context: 专利技术叙述中出现 there、逗号及句点后的换行，未见与专名模式相同的直接词形条件。

en.description: Activations often fall on subword fragments within different languages, proper names, and common words; there is also the English “there are” construction. Across medical, legal, maritime, email, sports, crypto, Russian Q&A, Italian, and encyclopedia texts, no stable shared semantic or domain pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Cunard word-form fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper name Cunard, while C and the suffix ard are not marked in context; appears with varying strength in Enron emails.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal subwords in proper names or personal names, while surrounding letters and common words are not marked.

patterns.name: Fragments of medical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in medical descriptions and terminology related to antibody patterns.

patterns.name: Financial/crypto vocabulary fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur within cryptocurrency project names or words such as “decentralization”.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Russian answers
patterns.context: Occurs in Russian Q&A text, including explanations following code examples.

patterns.name: Italian safety vocabulary fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within words related to workplace safety, health, and history.

patterns.name: Determiner construction before an English noun
patterns.context: “there” is followed by “are”, introducing a statement that the number of options of a given kind is limited.

2_1544.description: 激活多落在不同语言、专名及普通词内部的子词片段；另有英语“there are”结构。跨医学、法律、航运、邮件、体育、加密、俄语问答、意大利语和百科文本，未见稳定共享的语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: Cunard词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Cunard 中，且 C 和后缀 ard 在上下文中未标记；在 Enron 邮件里以不同强度出现。

patterns.name: 人名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或人名的内部子词上，周围字母及普通词未标记。

patterns.name: 医学术语的片段
patterns.context: 出现在医学描述及抗体模式相关术语中。

patterns.name: 金融/加密词汇片段
patterns.context: 激活位于加密货币项目名或“decentralization”等词的内部。

patterns.name: 俄语回答中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在俄语问答正文中，包含代码示例后的解释。

patterns.name: 意大利语安全词汇片段
patterns.context: 出现在工作安全、健康及历史相关词语内部。
patterns.domain: 意大利语学术/会议文本

patterns.name: 英语名词前的限定结构
patterns.context: “there”后接“are”，引出某类选择数量有限的陈述。

en.description: Primarily responds to there in existential constructions, especially where there is/are introduces a problem, need, difficulty, risk, or choice; one other example activates on a subword segmentation in the medical term anticentromere.

patterns.name: there introducing a statement
patterns.context: The sentence contains an existential construction there is/are/would be, usually followed by a copula and introducing a circumstance, problem, need, difficulty, risk, or choice; word forms and surrounding contexts vary.
patterns.domain: Explanatory styles including patent background sections, Q&A, medical abstracts, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: there and segmentation within an antibody term
patterns.context: Activation falls on a segmented subword fragment within a medical term describing an ANA antibody pattern; it does not fit the common existential-there construction.

2_1544.description: 主要响应存在句中的 there，尤其在 there is/are 后引出问题、需求、困难、风险或选择；另有一例激活落在医学术语 anticentromere 的子词切分上。

patterns.name: there 后引出陈述
patterns.context: 句中出现存在句结构 there is/are/would be，通常紧接系动词并引出某种情况、问题、需求、困难、风险或选择；不同词形和前后文均有变化。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、问答、医学摘要、百科等多种说明性文体

patterns.name: there 与抗体术语内部的切分
patterns.context: 激活落在分词后的子词片段，处于描述 ANA 抗体模式的医学术语中；不符合常见的 there 存在句。

en.description: All examples show strong activation on there, especially in existential or evaluative constructions such as there is/are/was/would be; subsequent content covers drawbacks, needs, risks, limitations, scarcity, and hypothetical outcomes.

patterns.name: Existential/evaluative constructions with there
patterns.context: there functions as a dummy subject in existential clauses or introduces an evaluation, need, risk, limitation, knowledge gap, or outcome; activation concentrates on there rather than field-specific vocabulary.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections, encyclopedias, genomics and medical literature

patterns.name: Problems or improvement needs in background sections
patterns.context: After describing the advantages, current state, or limitations of an existing approach or technology, there is/are introduces drawbacks, needs, or room for improvement.

patterns.name: Risks or possibilities in background sections
patterns.context: there is/are is followed by nouns such as possibility or risk, indicating that an event is impossible or that a risk remains.

patterns.name: Statements about limitations or growing demand
patterns.context: After describing material or manufacturing constraints, states that options are limited or that industry demand consequently increases.

patterns.name: Knowledge gaps and scarcity
patterns.context: Notes insufficient relevant knowledge, then uses there are to indicate that very few items are currently available.

patterns.name: Outcome introduced by a hypothetical condition
patterns.context: After an economic or policy hypothetical introduced by if, there would be introduces an inferred outcome.

2_1544.description: 全部样例都在 there 上强激活，尤其是 there is/are/was/would be 存在或判断句式；后续内容涵盖缺点、需求、风险、限制、稀缺及假设结果。

patterns.name: there 后的存在/判断句式
patterns.context: there 用作存在句或引出判断、需求、风险、限制、知识缺口、结果的主语占位成分；激活集中在 there，而不是某个特定领域词汇。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、百科、基因组学与医学文献

patterns.name: 背景中的问题或改进需求
patterns.trigger: «there»10 are also «drawbacks»；«there»10 is a need；«there»10 is always room for improvement；«there»10 are two «major» «shortcomings»
patterns.context: 先描述已有方案或技术的优点、现状或局限，再以 there is/are 引出缺点、需求或改进空间。

patterns.name: 背景中的风险或可能性
patterns.trigger: «there»10 is no possibility；«there»10 is always some risk
patterns.context: there is/are 后接 possibility、risk 等名词，说明某种事件不可能发生或仍有风险。

patterns.name: 有限性或需求增长的陈述
patterns.trigger: «there»10 are a limited number；«there»10 grew a demand
patterns.context: 在材料或制造限制之后，陈述可选项有限或行业需求随之增长。

patterns.name: 知识缺口及稀缺性
patterns.context: 说明相关知识不足，并由 there are 引出目前可用对象数量很少。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究文本

patterns.name: 假设条件引出的结果
patterns.context: 在 if 引导的经济或政策假设之后，以 there would be 引出推演结果。

en.description: Primarily responds to local spellings Chel, hel, and sea in words such as Chelsea/Cheltenham/chelating, as well as the string OT across technical texts; other markers are sporadic, with unstable semantic connections.

patterns.name: Chelsea / Chelsea string
patterns.context: Activation falls on the segmented spelling of the proper noun Chelsea, including Chelsea abbreviations/names in chat, as well as personal and football club names.
patterns.domain: IRC chat, Wikipedia biographies and sports entries

patterns.name: Chel- root and derivatives
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial Chel- in the school name Cheltenham and in chelating/chelating activity; the latter occurs in contexts involving metal chelation, drugs, or experimental assays.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia school entries, medical and biochemical papers

patterns.name: OT substring
patterns.context: Activation falls on the uppercase string OT, appearing respectively in COTS (commercial off-the-shelf products), DOThelp, the DOTALL regular expression, and the abbreviation GOTS; surrounding contexts differ.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, customer support text, code, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Local character fragments such as hel/sea
patterns.context: Falls on the same or similar letter sequences within several words: Chelsea, Cheltenham, chelating. This is more consistent with a response to local spelling fragments and does not establish a single word meaning.

patterns.name: Formatting markers and other sporadic tokens
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across different passages and show no stable shared context; they may be secondary responses beyond the main pattern or incidental co-occurrences.
patterns.domain: Scientific text, forums, chat, code, etc.

2_1544.description: 主要响应 Chelsea/Cheltenham/chelating 等词中的 Chel、hel、sea 局部拼写，以及跨技术文本出现的 OT 字符串；其余标记零散，语义联系不稳定。

patterns.name: Chelsea / Chelsea 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在英文专名 Chelsea 的分段拼写上，包含聊天中的 Chelsea 缩写/名称，以及人名、足球俱乐部名。
patterns.domain: IRC 聊天、维基百科人物与体育条目

patterns.name: Chel- 词根及其派生词
patterns.context: 激活落在 Cheltenham 校名以及 chelating/chelating activity 中的词首 Chel-；后者处于金属络合、药物或实验测定语境。
patterns.domain: 维基百科学校条目、医学与生化论文

patterns.name: OT 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在大写 OT 字符串中，分别出现在 COTS（商业现货产品）、DOThelp、正则表达式 DOTALL 和 GOTS 缩写；周围语境各不相同。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、客服文本、代码、医学摘要

patterns.name: hel/sea 等局部字符片段
patterns.context: 在多个词中落于相同或相近的字母片段：Chelsea、Cheltenham、chelating；更像对局部拼写片段的响应，不能据此确定单一词义。

patterns.name: 格式标记及其他零散 token
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在不同段落中，未显示稳定的共同语境；可能是主模式之外的次级响应或偶然共现。
patterns.domain: 科学文本、论坛、聊天、代码等

en.description: The most consistent trigger is there, especially after a comma or period and followed by is, would, or similar forms to make an existential or concluding statement. Other activations are scattered across local vocabulary and subwords, with no consistent theme.

patterns.name: there within a sentence and following evaluation
patterns.context: After a period or comma, continues with an explanation of a situation, conclusion, need, or controversy, often in the form “there is/was/would …”; there is a dummy subject.
patterns.domain: Expository texts, academic abstracts, news narratives, patent backgrounds, and technical discussions

patterns.name: there in less common contexts
patterns.context: there also occurs, but the following structure or function does not fully match a typical existential/evaluative sentence; other activations involve various words or subwords.
patterns.domain: Science-fiction discussions, medical titles and ethnic names, literary criticism, business emails

patterns.name: there in a time-design context
patterns.context: Capitalized There at the start of a sentence, followed by “just are too many”, indicating that there are too many items of a kind; activations also involve a subword of idiosyncrasies.

2_1544.description: 最稳定的触发是 there，尤其句中逗号或句号后接 is、would 等构成存在句或结论句；其他激活分散于局部词汇与子词，未见一致主题。

patterns.name: 句中 there 及后续判断
patterns.context: 句号或逗号之后，接续说明某种情况、结论、需求或争议，常见形式为“there is/was/would …”；主语为形式主语 there。
patterns.domain: 说明文、学术摘要、新闻叙述、专利背景及技术讨论

patterns.name: 少见语境中的 there
patterns.context: 同样出现 there，但后续结构或功能不完全符合典型的存在句/判断句；其余激活也涉及多种词汇或子词。
patterns.domain: 科幻讨论、医学标题与民族名称、文学评论、商业邮件

patterns.name: 时间设计语境中的 there
patterns.context: 句首大写 There，后接“just are too many”，表示某类事物过多；激活还涉及 idiosyncrasies 的子词。

en.description: Primarily activates on in-word fragments containing cor/on in terms such as coronary artery and coronavirus; also seen in Cree, coroners, and a few biomedical and punctuation fragments, some of which may stem from subword or boundary features.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of coronary
patterns.context: Occurs in the medical compounds “coronary artery/heart disease,” where the fragment may be split into multiple subwords; also appears in related disease names or medical outcomes.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of coronavirus
patterns.context: A subword fragment within “coronavirus,” appearing in reports and links related to the pandemic, infection, or viruses.

patterns.name: Shared fragments in coronary-related word forms
patterns.context: Appears adjacent to complete coronary-related word forms; the fragment may also simply be a subword within a word rather than an independent semantic unit.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in coroners
patterns.context: Embedded in the code identifier “coroners,” in a code context involving the location of death and coroner associations.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Cree
patterns.context: Part of the ethnonym or language name “Cree”; surrounding text mentions Ojibway, Indigenous peoples in Canada, or Cree storytellers.

patterns.name: Anomalous in-word activations
patterns.context: Sporadic activations in biomedical lists concerning immunity, cell function, and similar topics, without a clear trigger shared with the other passages.

patterns.name: Sporadic punctuation or short-token activations
patterns.context: Appears near sentence beginnings, headings, numbering, or word boundaries; these fragments alone do not support a stable semantic condition.
patterns.domain: News headlines, medical abstracts, and other texts

2_1544.concept: 含 cor/on 的词内片段
2_1544.description: 主要激活于冠状动脉、冠状病毒等含 cor/on 的词内片段；另见 Cree、coroners 及少量生物医学和标点碎片激活，部分可能源于子词或边界特征。

patterns.name: coronary 的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在医学复合词“coronary artery/heart disease”中，片段可被拆成多个子词；也出现在相关疾病名称或医学结局中。

patterns.name: coronavirus 的分词片段
patterns.context: 作为“coronavirus”一词内部的子词片段，出现在疫情、感染或病毒相关报道与链接中。
patterns.domain: 新冠疫情新闻、网页链接

patterns.name: 冠状动脉相关词形的共享片段
patterns.context: 与冠状动脉相关的完整词形相邻出现；该片段也可能仅是词内部的子词，而非独立语义单位。

patterns.name: coroners 的词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在代码标识符“coroners”中，代码上下文涉及死亡地点与验尸官关联。

patterns.name: Cree 的词内片段
patterns.context: 作为族名或语言名称“Cree”的组成部分，周围提及 Ojibway、加拿大原住民或 Cree 讲述者。
patterns.domain: 医学人文文章、人物传记

patterns.name: 异常词内激活
patterns.context: 在免疫、细胞功能等生物医学枚举中零散激活，未见与其他段共同的明确触发词。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目摘要、生物医学文本

patterns.name: 零散标点或短 token 激活
patterns.context: 出现在句首、标题、编号或词边界附近，单凭这些片段无法归纳出稳定语义条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻标题、医学摘要及其他文本

en.description: Activations mostly fall on in-word fragments: split parts of coronary, ree in the name Cree, and several unrelated word-final or in-word fragments. Trigger contexts span medicine, history, code, email, and web text, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Coronary-related spelling fragments
patterns.context: The word coronary is split into multiple tokens; appears in medical terminology or code identifiers
patterns.domain: Cardiovascular medicine, medical papers, and code

patterns.name: Cree name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the name of the Cree people; the prefix C is unmarked
patterns.domain: Introductions to Indigenous people and groups

patterns.name: German personal-name ending
patterns.context: Attached to nunc- to form nuncios; the passage concerns historical church affairs

patterns.name: Word ending in a fungal name
patterns.context: Appears in the medical term Polyendocrinopathy

patterns.name: In-word English fragment
patterns.context: Combines with the adjacent token to form “Concur,” appearing in an expense heading

patterns.name: Colloquial in-word fragment
patterns.context: Embedded in the username duncan_bayne, in a non-prose colloquial passage

2_1544.description: 激活多落在词内片段：coronary 的拆分部分、Cree 名称中的 ree，以及若干各异的词尾或词内片段；触发环境跨医学、历史、代码、邮件与网络文本，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 冠状动脉相关拼写片段
patterns.context: 词语 coronary 被拆分成多个 token；出现在医学术语或代码标识符中
patterns.domain: 心血管医学、医学论文及代码

patterns.name: Cree 名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Cree 族群名称中，前缀 C 未标记
patterns.domain: 原住民人物与群体介绍

patterns.name: 德语人名词尾
patterns.context: 附着于 nunc-，构成 nuncios；段落谈及历史教会事务

patterns.name: 真菌学名中的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在医学术语 Polyendocrinopathy 内

patterns.name: 英文词内部片段
patterns.context: 与相邻 token 拼成“Concur”，出现在费用标题中

patterns.name: 口语词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在用户名 duncan_bayne 中，非正文口语段落

en.concept: True/false question templates and medical word fragments
en.description: Items 1–9 focus on mathematical Q&A asking whether a number or variable is prime or composite, and on true/false answers, with sporadic arithmetic fragments. Item 10 activates on a fragment within a biomedical term and differs from the mathematical question pattern.

patterns.name: Prime/composite judgment template
patterns.context: Math questions ask whether a variable or number is prime/composite, often using the template “Is [object] a prime/composite number?” The object may be introduced by an earlier equation or definition.

patterns.name: Sporadic numerical values and symbols in equations
patterns.context: Occurs in equations, variable definitions, or negative-number expressions; appearances are sparse, with no consistent association with a specific value or operation.

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in medical descriptions related to lung infections and autoimmune syndromes; activation falls on a subword fragment within a term.

2_1544.concept: 判断题模板与医学词片段
2_1544.description: 1–9集中于数学问答中判断数或变量是否为素数、合数及其真假回答，另有零散算式片段；10激活生物医学术语内部片段，与数学题型不同。

patterns.name: 素数/合数判断模板
patterns.context: 数学题中询问某变量或数是否为素数/合数，常见模板为“Is [对象] a prime/composite number?”；对象可由前文算式或定义引入。

patterns.name: 算式中的零散数值与符号
patterns.context: 出现在算式、变量定义或负数表达式中；仅零星出现，未见它们与某一特定数值或运算稳定相关。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在肺部感染及自身免疫综合征相关的医学叙述中，激活落在术语内部的子词片段。

en.description: Peak activations are distributed across subword fragments within different words (on, OT, DOT, ion, end, ANC, ET), with no clear shared semantics; there are also activations for the construction there are and for integer in a math problem.

patterns.name: Highly activating subword fragments in specific words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within longer words or identifiers; the spellings differ, and the available examples do not establish a unified word-form or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Biomedical text, software code, error identifiers, and email addresses; varied styles.

patterns.name: there
patterns.context: In explanatory English sentences, uses there to introduce options or approaches (“there are various ways”“there are several other options”).

patterns.name: integer
patterns.context: A math problem states that a value is rounded to the nearest integer.

2_1544.description: 最高激活分散在多种词内子词片段（on、OT、DOT、ion、end、ANC、ET），未见明确共同语义；另有 there are 句式及数学题中的 integer 激活。

patterns.name: 特殊词内的高激活子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词或标识符内部的子词片段；各片段拼写并不相同，现有例子无法确定统一的词形或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学文本、软件代码、错误标识符及邮件地址；风格各异。

patterns.name: there
patterns.context: 解释性英文句子中，以 there 引出选项或做法（“there are various ways”“there are several other options”）。

patterns.name: integer
patterns.context: 数学题中说明将数值四舍五入到最近的整数。

en.description: Strongly responds primarily to composite in questions asking whether a number is composite, and also responds to prime in prime-number questions; the numbers are often constructed from preceding arithmetic or equations. Another passage activates on comment markers related to cancellation and on CANCELED in a C enum comment.

patterns.name: Asking whether an integer is composite
patterns.context: Primarily takes the form Is [variable or expression] a composite [number]? The target number is usually derived from preceding integer arithmetic, an equation, or a function definition, followed by True/False.

patterns.name: Asking whether an integer is prime
patterns.context: Primarily takes the form Is [variable or expression] a prime number? Often alternates with composite-number questions, with the answer immediately following.

patterns.name: Code comment about cancellation
patterns.context: Appears in a C-style enum definition; the comment explains the CANCELED state and that the operation is usually canceled by the caller. Unrelated to the number-theory questions.

2_1544.concept: 数论判断词及局部标记
2_1544.description: 主要对合数判断问句中的 composite 强烈响应，也会对素数判断中的 prime 响应；数值多由前文算术或方程构造。另有一段对 C 枚举注释中取消操作相关的注释标记与 CANCELED 产生激活。

patterns.name: 询问整数是否为合数
patterns.context: 以 Is [变量或算式] a composite [number]? 询问为主；目标数通常由前文的整数算术、方程或函数定义得到，后接 True/False。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 合成式数论问答

patterns.name: 询问整数是否为素数
patterns.trigger: « prime»8 或 «prime»7，附近可见 « number»1、问号及 True/False
patterns.context: 以 Is [变量或算式] a prime number? 为主；常与合数判断交替出现，答案紧随其后。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 合成式数论问答

patterns.name: 取消操作的代码注释

en.concept: Word fragments and math-problem vocabulary detection
en.description: Activations are distributed across different in-word fragments and words: Concur, Gonadotropin, there, CANCELED, nuncios, integer, and composite; the latter recurs in three synthetic composite-number questions.

patterns.name: Concur string segmentation
patterns.context: Appears in the forms Concur or Concurrence, with activation concentrated on the substring cur; contexts are an email subject and a quantum information paper, respectively.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Gonadotropin
patterns.context: Located in the initial part of the medical term Gonadotropin, followed by adotropin-releasing hormone.

patterns.name: there
patterns.context: An existential adverb in a sentence explaining how to merge patient cases and find the earliest admission time.

patterns.name: CANCELED identifier fragment
patterns.context: Located in the enum constant CANCELED; the code comment explains that an operation was canceled.

patterns.name: Word ending in nuncios
patterns.context: Located at the end of nuncios in a historical narrative about German envoys and the Imperial Diet.

patterns.name: integer
patterns.context: A math problem asks to round a value to the nearest integer.

patterns.name: composite number judgment
patterns.context: A synthetic arithmetic problem asks whether variable a is composite, followed by True or False.

patterns.name: Unmarked context also belonging to an arithmetic problem
patterns.context: Functions and variables are defined and integers computed in sequence, but the marked activations remain concentrated on words such as composite rather than on the expressions themselves.

2_1544.concept: 词片段与数学题词汇检测
2_1544.description: 激活分散在不同词内片段与词汇上：Concur、Gonadotropin、there、CANCELED、nuncios、integer及composite；后者在三段生成式合数判断题中重复出现。

patterns.name: Concur 字符串切分
patterns.context: 出现在词形 Concur 或 Concurrence 内，激活集中于 cur 子串；上下文分别是邮件主题和量子信息论文。

patterns.name: Gonadotropin 词内片段
patterns.context: 位于医学术语 Gonadotropin 的开头部分，后接 adotropin-releasing hormone。

patterns.name: there
patterns.context: 在解释如何按患者合并病例并查找最早入院时间的句子中，作为存在句副词。

patterns.name: CANCELED 标识符片段
patterns.context: 位于枚举常量 CANCELED 中；代码注释说明操作被取消。

patterns.name: nuncios 词尾
patterns.context: 位于 nuncios 的词尾，出现在历史叙述中，谈及德国使节与帝国议会。

patterns.name: integer
patterns.context: 数学题中询问将数值取到最近的整数。

patterns.name: composite 数学判定
patterns.context: 生成式算术题询问变量 a 是否为合数，后接 True 或 False。

patterns.name: 未标记但同属算术题的上下文
patterns.trigger: 未见额外高亮 token；可见触发点主要是普通算术表达式与变量定义
patterns.context: 连续定义函数、变量并计算整数，但标出的激活仍集中在 composite 等词，而非这些表达式本身。

en.description: Primarily responds to composite in number-theory questions, especially “Is … a composite?”; responds more weakly to prime questions and related question structures. Also activates within the identifier CANCELED and in a data-modeling recommendation passage, where triggers are scattered and difficult to unify with the mathematical pattern.

patterns.name: Substring in a cancellation identifier
patterns.context: Occurs in the enum constant CANCELED, with surrounding code comments explaining that an operation was canceled; appears only within that identifier.

patterns.name: composite in composite questions
patterns.context: Occurs in template questions asking whether an integer is composite, such as “Is ... a composite?” or “Is ... a composite number?”; preceded by the variable to be assessed and followed by a question mark or number.

patterns.name: prime in prime questions
patterns.context: Occurs in the template “Is ... a prime number?” asking whether an arithmetic expression is prime.

patterns.name: Question structure beginning with Is
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical template questions, introducing an assessment of an expression or variable; the relevant passages often contain prime/composite vocabulary.

patterns.name: Question punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs at the expression or sentence-final punctuation in mathematical judgment questions; only a few instances are marked, with no evidence of a stable independent trigger.

patterns.name: Data-modeling recommendation passage
patterns.context: Occurs in a StackExchange answer discussing data models/query design, clarifying comments, and grouping records by patient; activations are scattered across multiple common discourse words.

2_1544.description: 主要响应数论问句中的 composite，尤其“Is … a composite?”；较弱地响应 prime 问句和相关问句结构。另在 CANCELED 标识符内部及一段数据建模建议语篇中激活，后者触发分散，难与数学模式统一。

patterns.name: 取消标识符中的子串
patterns.context: 出现在枚举常量 CANCELED 中，周围代码注释说明操作被取消；只见于该标识符内部。

patterns.name: composite 问句中的 composite
patterns.context: 出现在判断整数是否为合数的模板问句“Is ... a composite?”或“Is ... a composite number?”中；前接待判断的变量，后接问号或 number。

patterns.name: prime 问句中的 prime
patterns.context: 出现在询问算术表达式是否为素数的模板“Is ... a prime number?”中。

patterns.name: 句首 Is 的问句结构
patterns.context: 位于数学模板问句中，开启对表达式或变量性质的判断；相关段中常与 prime/composite 词汇同现。

patterns.name: 问句中的疑问标点
patterns.context: 出现在数学判断问句的表达式或句末标点处；仅少数实例被标记，未显示为稳定独立触发条件。

patterns.name: 数据建模建议语篇
patterns.context: 出现在 StackExchange 回答中，讨论数据模型/查询设计、评论澄清及按患者归并记录；触发分散在多个常见语篇词上。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to there in existential sentences, often used to introduce a situation, issue, or object; other sporadic patterns include mathematical classification labels, cancellation terms in code, the ending of nuncios, and the phrase First part.

patterns.name: there as the focus in an existential construction
patterns.context: Appears in existential sentences such as “there are various ways”“there is no recovery mechanism”“there is no difference”“there is still the question”“there is a nontrivial cocycle”; preceding conditions or discussion introduce a situation, issue, or object.

patterns.name: Classification or judgment labels
patterns.context: Data lists questions and true/false answers about whether numbers are prime or composite, or code enums defining operation outcomes and cancellation states; the label words themselves or their components are marked.

patterns.name: Ending in nuncios
patterns.context: Appears in a historical narrative about ecclesiastical diplomatic representatives exercising their authority; marks the end of a word rather than an existential sentence.

patterns.name: Phrase beginning with part
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase “First part goes into…” introducing material about neural networks.

2_1544.description: 主要对存在句中的 there 强烈响应，常用于引出情况、问题或对象；另有数学分类标签、代码中的取消状态词，以及 nuncios 的词尾和短语 First part 等零散模式。

patterns.name: there 是存在式中的焦点
patterns.context: 出现在 “there are various ways”“there is no recovery mechanism”“there is no difference”“there is still the question”“there is a nontrivial cocycle”等存在句中；前面的条件或论述引出某种情况、问题或对象。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、技术文档、宗教论述、数学讨论；段落叙述

patterns.name: 分类或判断标签
patterns.context: 数据以逐条问题和真假答案列出数字的素合数属性，或代码枚举定义操作结果与取消状态；标签词本身或其组成部分被标记。
patterns.domain: 数学问答数据、程序代码

patterns.name: nuncios 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在关于教会外交代表行使职权的历史叙述中，标记单词末尾，而非存在句。

patterns.name: part 开头短语
patterns.context: 出现在介绍神经网络内容的短语 “First part goes into…” 中。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论或书籍/内容介绍

en.description: All passages highlight there, especially in existential constructions such as there is/are/’s/can be; often appears in conclusions following If conditions, and also in explanations, mathematical arguments, and prose. Other activating words are sporadic, with no shared pattern.

patterns.name: there in existential constructions
patterns.context: Often follows a condition or background explanation, with there introducing existence, possibility, or a state; common forms include “If …, there is/are/’s …”, though segments [8] and [9] have no immediately preceding If
patterns.domain: Cross-domain Q&A, technical explanations, comments, and prose from StackExchange, Github, HackerNews, and the Pile-CC

patterns.name: If conditional clauses
patterns.context: A main clause often follows a conditional clause; however, the activation focus appears to be on the subsequent there rather than on If itself. Segments [2], [8], and [9] also lack this trigger word
patterns.domain: Conditional statements in technical Q&A, business commentary, academic discussion, and prose

patterns.name: Sporadic non-there lexical activations
patterns.context: Trigger words differ across passages and are mostly in-word fragments or local vocabulary; there is no stable shared contextual condition, and these may be secondary or incidental activations
patterns.domain: Local lexical fragments in cross-domain text

patterns.name: there is adjacent to a formula
patterns.context: After a mathematical formula, there is introduces an existence claim; there is no If conditional clause

2_1544.description: 所有段都突出 there，尤其是 there is/are/’s/can be 这类存在句；多见于 If 条件后的结论，也出现于说明、数学论证和散文。其他激活词零散，缺少共同模式。

patterns.name: 存在句式中的 there
patterns.trigger: «there»10（段[1]–[5]），«there»9（段[6]–[10]）；尤其是紧随 If 条件句之后的 “there is/are/’s/can be”
patterns.context: 多出现在条件或背景说明之后，there 引出存在、可能性或状态；常见形式包括 “If …, there is/are/’s …”，但段[8]和[9]没有紧邻的 If
patterns.domain: 跨 StackExchange、Github、HackerNews、Pile-CC 的问答、技术说明、评论和散文

patterns.name: If 条件从句
patterns.trigger: «If»4（段[1]）、«If»3（段[3]–[7]、[10]）以及 “when”“However, if”等条件或让步语境
patterns.context: 常在条件从句之后接主句；但激活重点似乎落在后续 there，而非 If 本身，段[2]、[8]、[9]也没有该触发词
patterns.domain: 技术问答、商业评论、学术讨论及散文中的条件陈述

patterns.name: 零散的非 there 词汇激活
patterns.context: 各段触发词不一致，且多为词内片段或局部词汇；没有稳定共享的上下文条件，可能是次级或偶然激活
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本中的局部词汇片段

patterns.name: 公式邻接的 there is
patterns.trigger: “So there is a nontrivial cocycle”中的 «there»9
patterns.context: 数学公式之后，以 there is 引出存在性结论；没有 If 条件句

en.description: All passages highlight there in existential constructions, followed by forms of be such as is, are, was/would/could/can, introducing the existence of a thing, situation, or possibility; domains and topics vary.

patterns.name: there in existential sentences
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on existential constructions of the form there + be (or there + be + noun phrase), often introduced by an if condition or preceding description, asserting the existence of an object, situation, or possibility.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: forum Q&A, technical discussions, legal texts, parliamentary texts

2_1544.description: 所有片段都在存在句式中突出 there，后接 is、are、was/would/could/can 等 be 形式，用于引出存在的事物、情况或可能性；领域和话题各异。

patterns.name: 存在句中的 there
patterns.trigger: «there»10 are various ways；«there»10 is a price；«there»10's probably；«there»10 is no recovery mechanism；«there»10 would no longer be；«there»9's no timestamp；«there»9 are other sorts；«there»9 could be no doubt；«there»9 are more things；«there»9 can be dozens
patterns.context: 激活集中在存在句式 there + be（或 there + be + 名词短语），常由 if 条件或前文描述引出，陈述某物、情况或可能性的存在。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：论坛问答、技术讨论、法律文本、议会文本

en.description: The main pattern is there as the subject of an existential clause, often followed by is/are or a modal verb and frequently introduced by a condition such as If. There is also the negative construction there is no. The activation on part in the fourth passage does not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: there as the subject of an existential clause
patterns.context: there is followed by a copula, expressing existence, occurrence, or an outcome; the preceding text often states a condition or hypothesis (e.g., If…), though it can also occur in a statement or inference.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, forum discussions, technical texts, academic papers, and legal documents

patterns.name: there linked to a preceding conditional
patterns.context: A conditional clause or limiting condition comes first, followed by there introducing existence, an outcome, or a possibility under that condition; a comma may separate the conditional clause from the main clause.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English argumentation and expository texts

patterns.name: Fixed negative existential construction there is no
patterns.context: there is followed by is no, denying the existence of something, the need for something, or the existence of a conclusion; activation in passage 8 is weak (9).
patterns.domain: Forums, technical descriptions, and academic argumentation

patterns.name: there with would/could modals
patterns.context: there is followed by a modal verb, expressing an outcome or judgment under a hypothetical condition.
patterns.domain: EU policy argumentation and legal documents

patterns.name: Local activation on the conditional marker If
patterns.context: If occurs at the start of a conditional clause; many passages that follow contain existential there, but in passage 10 the if-clause and there are not in the same main clause.

patterns.name: Anomalous local pattern in passage 4
patterns.context: part occurs in “the central part of interest”, not in a there construction; other marked tokens may be nearby common words.

2_1544.description: 主模式是 there 作存在句主语，常接 is/are 或情态动词，且常由 If 等条件引出；另有 there is no 否定结构。第4段的 part 激活与此不符。

patterns.name: there 作存在句主语
patterns.trigger: «there»10 is / are / would be / could be
patterns.context: there 后接系动词，表示存在、发生或某种结果；前文常先提出条件或假设（如 If…），但也可出现在陈述或推论中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、论坛讨论、技术文本、学术论文与法律文书

patterns.name: there 与前置条件句衔接
patterns.context: 条件从句或限定条件先行，随后以 there 引出条件下的存在、结果或可能性；条件从句与主句之间可有逗号。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语论述与说明文

patterns.name: there is no 固定否定存在结构
patterns.context: there 后接 is no，否定某物存在、某事有必要或某结论存在；段 8 的激活较弱（9）。
patterns.domain: 论坛、技术说明与学术论述

patterns.name: there 与 would/could 情态搭配
patterns.context: there 后接情态动词，表达假设条件下的结果或判断。
patterns.domain: 欧盟政策论述与法律文书

patterns.name: 条件标记 If 的局部激活
patterns.context: If 位于条件从句开头；多段后续有 there 存在句，但段 10 的 if 从句与 there 不在同一主句中。

patterns.name: 段 4 的异常局部模式
patterns.context: part 出现在 “the central part of interest” 中，并非 there 句式；其余标记可能是邻近的普通词语。

en.concept: there as the subject of an existential sentence
en.description: All passages show the strongest activation on there, followed by an existential predicate; these sentences affirm, negate, or qualify things, objects, situations, and their quantity across varied domains and styles.

patterns.name: there + predicate structure
patterns.context: “there” occupies the subject position in an existential or modal existential sentence, with what follows introducing an object, situation, or requirement; this is the direct trigger shared by all passages
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, technical texts, legal texts, and dialogue

patterns.name: Existence/quantity assertions
patterns.context: Uses forms such as there are／would be／must be to assert the existence or quantity of objects, categories, or conditions
patterns.domain: Q&A, academic, parliamentary, patent, and legal texts

patterns.name: Negative or absent existence
patterns.context: there is followed by a negation, indicating that something does not exist, something is unnecessary, or relevant information is absent from a disclosure
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, academic papers, legal texts

patterns.name: Existential sentences introducing mathematical objects
patterns.context: there is/are introduces a mathematical object or structure

patterns.name: Colloquial contracted existential sentence
patterns.context: there's introduces a colloquial conjecture containing probably

2_1544.description: 所有片段都在 there 上出现最强激活，且后接存在句谓语；这些句子肯定、否定或限定事物、对象、情况及其数量，领域与文体多样。

patterns.name: there + 谓语结构
patterns.context: “there”处于存在句或情态存在句的主语位置，后续引出某物、某种情况或要求；是所有片段共有的直接触发形式
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、技术文本、法律文本及对话

patterns.name: 存在／数量断言
patterns.trigger: « there»10 are various« ways»；« there»10 are no such« contributions»；« there»10 are other sorts；« there»10 would no longer be a« European» fish；« there»10 must be at« least» two« phases»
patterns.context: 以 there are／would be／must be 等形式断言对象、类别、数量或条件是否存在
patterns.domain: 问答、学术、议会、专利和法律文本

patterns.name: 否定或缺失存在
patterns.trigger: « there»10 is no recovery mechanism；« there»10 is no point；« there»10 is nothing
patterns.context: there 后接否定表达，说明某物不存在、某事无必要或披露中没有相关内容

patterns.name: 存在句引出数学对象
patterns.trigger: « there»10 is a« nontrivial»1 cocycle；« there»10 are other sorts of metric spaces
patterns.context: there 后以 is/are 引出数学对象或结构

patterns.name: 口语缩写存在句
patterns.context: there's 引出带有 probably 的口语推测

en.concept: Unclear; clause-initial there and sporadic word fragments
en.description: Strong activation positions vary: five passages contain there/there is at the start of an independent clause in existential constructions; five others fall respectively on nuncios, carbendazim, polyendocrinopathy, Gonfloni, and part, spanning historical, medical, and physics contexts.

patterns.name: Sentence- or clause-initial there
patterns.context: Often occurs at the beginning of a new clause after a comma or period, introducing an existential statement, outcome, or evaluation; followed by a be verb or similar construction
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, including Q&A, forums, parliamentary speeches, and religious argumentation

patterns.name: Within-word fragment end

patterns.name: Within-word fragment on

patterns.name: Within-word fragment part

2_1544.concept: 不明显；分句起始 there 与零散词片段
2_1544.description: 强激活位置多样：五段位于分句起始的 there/there is 存在句；另五段分别落在 nuncios、carbendazim、polyendocrinopathy、Gonfloni、part 中，涵盖历史、医学、物理等语境。

patterns.name: 句首或分句起始的 there
patterns.trigger: «there»10；第2、6段为小写 there，第8、9、10段为 there’s / There is

patterns.name: 词内片段 end

patterns.name: 词内片段 ios

patterns.name: 词内片段 on

patterns.name: 词内片段 part

en.description: Strongly activates mainly on commas following quoted strings or phrases, across papers, code, queries, and abstracts. Also includes isolated code identifier fragments, comment words, the pornographic title word Bi, and a passage about character sets that does not fit these patterns.

patterns.name: Phrase boundary with a comma after a preposition or introductory word
patterns.context: A comma immediately follows a single-quoted string or phrase; many high activations fall on the comma, often at the end of a longer parameter or phrase.
patterns.domain: Paper prose, code, configuration/queries, and medical abstracts; cross-domain punctuation pattern

patterns.name: b in a Vue component name
patterns.context: In Vue template/script code, the component name double-bounce activates on the b inside the identifier.

patterns.name: dings in a variable/identifier
patterns.context: In code comments describing dings, activation falls on the initial d and following ings; adjacent to callback and request code in the same passage.

patterns.name: Bi in an adult pornographic title
patterns.context: In the title phrase “Bisexual Dink's Bi Sex 2 Rectal Stretch”, the title word Bi receives the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Split lastHost identifier
patterns.context: In the configuration object property _globals.lasthost, activation falls on fragments of the property name split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Narrative quoted phrase following a single quote
patterns.context: In abstract titles or quotations, single quotes enclose the contrasting phrase “something old, something new”; something also activates more weakly, besides the comma.

2_1622.concept: 引号/字符串边界及代码片段
2_1622.description: 主要在带引号字符串或短语结束后的逗号处强激活，跨论文、代码、查询和摘要。另有孤立的代码标识符片段、注释词、色情标题词 Bi，以及字符集讨论段无法归入这些模式。

patterns.name: 介词/引导词后接逗号的短语边界
