patterns.name: Supplementary explanation or continuation in a paragraph
patterns.context: A line-break marker occurs at a paragraph boundary or in text layout; the paragraph also contains names, abbreviations, and dedication formatting, so it is unclear whether the line-break marker is an independent trigger.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book front matter, dedications, and formatted text

2_1746.concept: 引出关注重点的分词表达
2_1746.description: 主要对 focusing 这一现在分词引出的主题、对象或范围说明起强反应，跨学术、百科、评论和新闻文本；另对政治语境中的 emphasizing 有反应，并有一例书籍献词排版中的换行标记。

patterns.name: 现在分词 focusing 引出讨论重点
patterns.trigger: «focusing»10；前文常有 discuss、proposal、review、research 或 examines 等表示讨论/研究的词
patterns.context: 在句中或分句中以 focusing 引出接下来说明的重点、对象、主题或范围；其后常接 on，但不要求固定领域
patterns.domain: 说明文、评论、学术摘要、百科与新闻报道

patterns.name: 强调政策立场或能力
patterns.context: 以 emphasizing 引出被强调的政策取向、能力或优先事项；此处均与政治人物或公共政策相关

patterns.name: 段落中的附带说明或续接
patterns.context: 换行标记出现在段落边界或文本排版位置；该段另有名字、缩写和献词格式，无法确定换行标记是否是独立触发因素
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍前置页、献词与排版文本

en.description: The strongest responses center on forms of focus, especially focusing as a supplementary phrase after a comma, usually introducing the object of attention; it also responds more weakly to focus and focused.

patterns.name: Present participle focusing
patterns.context: Used after a comma or within a sentence as a present participle specifying what a study, article, project, organization, or action focuses on, commonly in the structure “focusing on …”; the object may follow immediately or be separated by a line break.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain explanatory prose, academic abstracts and papers, news discussion, encyclopedia and popular science texts

patterns.name: Other inflected forms of focus
patterns.context: The base form or past tense describes attention turning to problem solutions or the topic of an activity or meeting; these share a root with the dominant present-participle use but differ in morphology and syntax.

2_1746.concept: 聚焦、关注某对象
2_1746.description: 最强响应集中于 focus 的词形，尤其是逗号后作补充说明的 focusing，通常引出关注对象；也较弱地响应 focus、focused。

patterns.name: 现在分词 focusing
patterns.context: 在逗号后或句中作现在分词，补充说明研究、文章、项目、组织或行动所关注的对象，常见结构为“focusing on …”；对象可紧随其后，也可被换行隔开。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文、学术摘要与论文、新闻讨论、百科及科普文本

patterns.name: 动词 focus 的其他屈折形式
patterns.context: 以 focus 的原形或过去式描述注意力转向问题解决方案，或活动/会议的主题；与主要的现在分词用法同词根，但形态和句法不同。

en.concept: focusing word form and name fragments
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to “focusing” when it introduces the object of attention in a sentence, across reviews, academic writing, and institutional profiles; three other instances activate on the fragments “ude,” “ole,” and “adding” within names, with no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: focusing and its continuation
patterns.context: A sentence uses focusing to introduce the object of discussion, research, attention, or activity; the subject before it is often a review, researcher, organization, or author.
patterns.domain: Reviews, academic papers, researcher profiles, organization descriptions, and other styles

patterns.name: Specific letter sequences in names
patterns.context: Some triggers are embedded in proper names rather than standalone syntactic words; the surrounding text is respectively a dedication list and a lawyer’s name.
patterns.domain: Book title page/dedication; lawyer listing in a legal judgment

patterns.name: Name fragment in a table
patterns.context: The trigger fragment is embedded in a person’s name in a table entry, near the location “WA” and a description of local youth.

2_1746.concept: focusing 词形及姓名片段
2_1746.description: 主要对句中引出关注对象的“focusing”强烈响应，跨评论、学术与机构介绍；另有三例对姓名内部的“ude”“ole”“adding”片段激活，缺乏明显共同语义。

patterns.name: focusing 及其续接内容
patterns.trigger: «focusing»（含大小写变体时亦见“Focusing”）；后接宾语、介词短语或副词，如“focusing the blame”“focusing further on”“focusing on”“focusing initially on”“focusing in particular on”
patterns.context: 句中以 focusing 引出讨论、研究、注意力或活动所针对的对象；前面常有 review、研究者、组织、作者等主语。
patterns.domain: 评论、学术论文、研究者简介、组织介绍等多种文体

patterns.name: 姓名中的特定字母序列
patterns.context: 触发部分嵌在专名中，并非句法上的独立词；周围分别是献词名单和律师姓名。
patterns.domain: 书籍扉页/献词；法律判决中的律师署名

patterns.name: 表格中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在表格条目的人名中，附近是地点“WA”及对当地青年的说明。

en.concept: Partially sensitive to the string ude
en.description: Activation is scattered across focusing, discourse-linking structures, and sentence-initial As well as, and repeatedly falls on the string ude (Gertrude, Nude, Judean); several other common words appear in isolation, with no clear unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Bare or punctuated focusing
patterns.context: Used as a participle or gerund to introduce the object or aspect under discussion; may also appear after a contrast within a sentence.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research papers, and online commentary

patterns.name: Nude string
patterns.context: The string ude appears in the name Gertrude or the proper noun Nude; activation mainly falls on ude, despite substantial differences in neighboring forms and meaning.
patterns.domain: Book dedications, music reviews, music album entries

patterns.name: Discourse connectives and following words
patterns.context: Appears in sentences expressing concession, contrast, addition, or introducing considerations; strong trigger words vary, and some are prominent only in particular collocations.
patterns.domain: Discursive prose, online discussions, academic writing

patterns.name: Sentence-initial As well as
patterns.context: A sentence-initial connective structure used to add to or list simple requests.

patterns.name: Scattered phrases and common words
patterns.context: The passages share no clear syntactic or semantic conditions; these words occur separately in dedications, discussions of pilgrimage, music reviews, resource discussions, music catalogs, and social issues.

patterns.name: Spelling fragment ude
patterns.context: Embedded in Judean in an encyclopedia category entry; it matches similar strings in names and music proper nouns but occurs in a different context.

2_1746.concept: 部分对字符串 ude 敏感
2_1746.description: 激活散布于 focusing 及论述连接结构、句首 As well as，也反复落在 ude 字符串（Gertrude、Nude、Judean）；另有多种孤立常见词，难以归为统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 裸词或带标点的 focusing
patterns.context: 作为分词或动名词，引出讨论所集中考察的对象或方面；也可能出现在句中转折后。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、研究论文及网络评论

patterns.name: Nude 字符串
patterns.context: 字符串 ude 出现在人名 Gertrude 或专名 Nude 中；触发部分主要落在 ude，邻近词形和语义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 书籍题献、音乐评论、音乐专辑条目

patterns.name: 话语连接词及后续词
patterns.context: 在让步、转折、补充或引入考量的句子中；其中强触发词并不一致，且有的只在特定搭配中显著。
patterns.domain: 论述性散文、网络讨论、学术写作

patterns.name: 句首 As well as
patterns.context: 句首用作补充或列举简单请求的连接结构。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、URL 重写说明

patterns.name: 分散的短语与常见词
patterns.context: 各段中没有共同的明显句法或语义条件；这些词分别出现在题献、朝圣论述、音乐评论、资源讨论、音乐目录和社会议题中。

patterns.name: 拼写片段 ude
patterns.context: 嵌在 Judean 一词内部，位于百科分类条目中；与人名及音乐专名中的相似字符串同形，但此处语境不同。

en.concept: Partial dependencies and morphological subword fragments
en.description: Activations concentrate on relying in legal arguments and focusing in descriptions of research or activities; there are also local responses to Claude/ude fragments within names and the suffix ism in patriotism, along with several sporadic short words and punctuation activations.

patterns.name: focusing followed by a research object or topic
patterns.context: Appears in clauses describing research, reviews, or organizational activities, followed by a research topic, factor, or activity area
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, medical research, institutional descriptions, and encyclopedic prose

patterns.name: relying followed by a legal basis
patterns.context: In legal arguments, a court or party relies on precedents, rulings, or other legal authority

patterns.name: Subword fragment of the Claude syllable in a proper name
patterns.context: Appears in a given name or surname; the highlighted characters are a fragment within the name, not an independent word
patterns.domain: Book credits, names, and email recipient lists

patterns.name: Word ending in patriotism
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the word patriotism in a sentence discussing patriotic motives

patterns.name: Miscellaneous short words and punctuation
patterns.context: Distributed across narratives, the body of judicial opinions, and paragraph or sentence boundaries, with no shared local semantic condition

2_1746.concept: 部分依赖关系与词形片段
2_1746.description: 激活集中于法律论证中的 relying、研究或活动说明中的 focusing；另对姓名内部 Claude/ude 片段及 patriotism 的词尾 ism 有局部反应，也出现若干分散短词与标点激活。

patterns.name: focusing 后接研究对象或主题
patterns.context: 出现在说明研究、综述或组织活动内容的分句中，后接研究主题、因素或活动方向
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、医学研究、机构介绍及百科叙述

patterns.name: relying 后接法律依据
patterns.context: 法律论证中，法院或当事人依据判例、裁决或其他法律权威

patterns.name: 专名中 Claude 音节的子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名或姓氏中；高亮的是名称内部的字符片段，不是独立词
patterns.domain: 书籍署名、人名及邮件收件人列表

patterns.name: patriotism 的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 patriotism 一词末尾，句子讨论爱国主义动机
patterns.domain: 旅行叙述与宗教/社会议题

patterns.name: miscellaneous 短词与标点
patterns.context: 分布于叙述、判决正文、段落或句子边界，缺少共同的局部语义条件

en.concept: Textual cohesion and local word-form features
en.description: Activation is scattered across discourse connectives, “relying” in legal contexts, fragments within proper names, and line-break formatting; several word endings and name fragments occur in isolation and cannot be assigned to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Connectives and discourse cohesion
patterns.context: Introduces contrast, progression, addition, or continuation of preceding material at the beginning or within a sentence; many activations fall on words or punctuation following the connective.
patterns.domain: General narrative, popular science, forum Q&A

patterns.name: Participle relying
patterns.context: In legal argument, “relying upon/on” introduces the precedent or decision on which the argument is based.

patterns.name: Token fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Names or category labels are split into multiple tokens; activation centers on name fragments, especially fragments containing “ude.”
patterns.domain: Book dedications, biographies, and encyclopedia categories

patterns.name: Line-break markers
patterns.context: Appears at line breaks in book dedications and in code/list-based Q&A.

patterns.name: Specific word endings and spelling fragments
patterns.context: Occurs separately in words or proper names such as patriotism, temples, the case name Kamin, and the name Scott, without a shared context.

2_1746.concept: 文本衔接与局部词形特征
2_1746.description: 激活分散于话语连接词、法律语境的“relying”、专名内部碎片及排版换行；若干词尾/姓名片段孤立出现，难归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 连接词与话语衔接
patterns.context: 句首或句中转折、递进、补充、承接前文；不少激活落在连接词后的词或标点上。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、科普、论坛问答

patterns.name: relying 的分词形式
patterns.context: 法律论述中以“relying upon/on”引入所依据的判例或决定。

patterns.name: 专名中的片段 token
patterns.context: 人名或类别名称中，词被拆分成多个 token；激活集中于专名片段，尤其含“ude”的片段。
patterns.domain: 书籍题献、传记及百科分类

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 出现在书籍题献的排版换行及代码/列表问答中的换行处。
patterns.domain: 电子书及 StackExchange 帖文

patterns.name: 特定词尾与拼写碎片
patterns.context: 分别出现在 patriotism、temples、判例人名 Kamin、姓名 Scott 等词或专名中，缺乏共同语境。

en.description: Activations are distributed across local fragments such as considering, and so, and Mad-ole, as well as quotations, punctuation, and numbering in legal documents; sporadic subword fragments also occur in code, biomedicine, paper abbreviations, and prose, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Participial supplement after considering
patterns.context: “considering” introduces an additional consideration about one’s own experience or an object, followed by a noun phrase
patterns.domain: Travel/personal narratives; computer vision research papers

patterns.name: Mad(e)ole surname fragment
patterns.context: An internal subword fragment of the name Mad-ole, appearing in litigation attorney lists or email contact lists

patterns.name: Fixed expression so on
patterns.context: “and so” indicates continuation of a list or an inferred result; the two examples have different grammatical functions

patterns.name: Sporadic markers in legal citations and litigation language
patterns.context: Near citations, arguments, or circuit court abbreviations in legal opinions; activations fall on ordinary legal words and citation characters

patterns.name: Numbers/symbols in numbering or annotations
patterns.context: Near court docket numbers, dates, citations, or line-break markers, without a unified semantic condition

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments and technical abbreviations
patterns.context: Activations cover local fragments in code variables, type declarations, biomedical sequence abbreviations, and algorithm abbreviations, with no shared lexical or syntactic condition
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A; biomedical papers; machine learning papers

patterns.name: Sporadic common words and fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Distributed across religious/travel narratives, entomological prose, and contact names, without a consistent trigger condition

2_1746.concept: none
2_1746.description: 激活分散于 considering、and so、Mad-ole 等局部片段，以及法律文书中的引文、标点和编号；另见代码、生物医学、论文缩写与散文中的零散词片段，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: considering 后的分词补充语
patterns.trigger: «considering»10 my own life history；«considering»8 a pair of images
patterns.context: “considering”引出对自身经历或某对象的补充考量，后接名词短语
patterns.domain: 游记/个人叙述；计算机视觉研究论文

patterns.name: Mad(e)ole 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 人名 Mad-ole 的内部子词片段，出现在诉讼律师名单或邮件联系人名单中

patterns.name: so on 固定表达
patterns.context: “and so”表示列举延续或推导结果；两例语法作用不同

patterns.name: 法律引文与诉讼语句中的零散标记
patterns.context: 法律判决引文、论证或巡回法院缩写附近；激活落在普通法律词及引文字符上

patterns.name: 编号或标注中的数字/符号
patterns.context: 法院案号、日期、引文或换行标记附近，未显示统一语义条件

patterns.name: 特定子词片段与技术缩写
patterns.context: 激活覆盖代码变量、类型声明、生物医学序列缩写和算法缩写中的局部片段，缺少共同的词义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 编程问答；生物医学论文；机器学习论文

patterns.name: 零散普通词与专名内部片段
patterns.context: 分散出现在宗教/旅行叙述、昆虫学叙述及联系人姓名中，未形成一致触发条件

en.description: Activation is scattered across discourse cohesion (especially “And so…” in continuation or enumeration), “relying on/upon” in legal argument, and legal formatting, titles, and sporadic word fragments; no single semantic feature covers all passages.

patterns.name: Discourse marker “so”
patterns.context: Functions as a discourse marker to continue from preceding material, extend a list, or transition to what follows; appears in body text or sentence-initially.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, legal documents, forum articles

patterns.name: Participle/preposition relying
patterns.context: In legal argument, explains that a court or argument relies on a precedent, ruling, or authority, followed by “on/upon.”

patterns.name: Continuative connectives and phrases
patterns.context: Used sentence-initially or between sentences to contrast, add information, introduce a conclusion, or continue an argument; the specific triggers vary.

patterns.name: Numbers and formatting fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: In legal-report formatting containing court names, case numbers, dates, and names, activation falls on split punctuation or word fragments.
patterns.domain: Headers and docket information in historical court opinions

patterns.name: Word fragment in a game title
patterns.context: In a press-release title, activation falls on tokenized fragments of “Videogame Debut.”

patterns.name: Abstract noun fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a fixed expression that explains or restates preceding text; its trigger has no clear connection to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Verbs of consideration or cognition
patterns.context: The present participle is used when a narrator introduces a personal experience or viewpoint.

patterns.name: Other isolated word fragments
patterns.context: Occur separately in company press releases and legal citations/arguments, with insufficient repeated evidence to establish a shared trigger condition.

2_1746.concept: 篇章衔接与法律文本碎片
2_1746.description: 激活分散于篇章衔接（尤以“And so…”列举或承接为显著）、法律论证中的“relying on/upon”，以及法律排版、标题和零散词片；尚无单一语义特征覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 篇章衔接词“so”
patterns.trigger: «so»8，常见于“And so on”“And so forth”“And so now”
patterns.context: 作为承接前文、列举延续或转入下文的篇章标记；出现于正文或句首
patterns.domain: 技术问答、法律文书、论坛文章

patterns.name: 分词/介词 relying
patterns.context: 法律论证中说明法院或论述依赖某项判例、裁决或依据，后接“on/upon”

patterns.name: 承接性连接词及短语
patterns.context: 句首或句间用于转折、补充、引出结论或承接论述；本模式中的具体触发形式各异

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与格式碎片
patterns.context: 法院名称、案号、日期、姓名等法律报告排版文本中，激活落在被切分的标点或词片上
patterns.domain: 历史法律判决的页眉及案卷信息

patterns.name: 游戏标题中的词片
patterns.context: 新闻稿标题中，激活落在被分词器切开的“Videogame Debut”词片上

patterns.name: 抽象名词词片
patterns.context: 解释或改述前文的固定表达中出现；触发本身未能与其余模式建立明确联系

patterns.name: 考虑/认知动词
patterns.context: 叙述者引出个人经历或观点时使用现在分词

patterns.name: 其他孤立词片
patterns.context: 分别出现在公司新闻稿及法律引文/论述中，缺少足够重复证据说明共同触发条件

en.concept: Heterogeneous subword fragments and connective expressions
en.description: Activations are distributed across connectives, legal phrasing, narrative expressions, and subword fragments within various words; there is no single stable semantic theme. And, relying, and as each recur locally, while most others are isolated examples.

patterns.name: Additive connective “And”
patterns.context: And introduces an addition, subsequent event, or consideration mid-sentence or at the beginning of a new sentence; common in narrative text.
patterns.domain: Travel writing, narratives, and general descriptions

patterns.name: Participial relying
patterns.context: In legal arguments, indicates reliance on prior case law, often followed by upon.

patterns.name: Split fragments in compound words
patterns.context: When a word is split into multiple subwords, activation falls on an internal fragment; examples occur in terms, names, or scale names.

patterns.name: as in narratives
patterns.context: Occurs in fixed/narrative constructions such as “as luck would have it” or “as the day … comes up”.

patterns.name: Basis language in legal citations
patterns.context: States that an administrative decision must be based on an appropriate legal standard; co-occurs with the connectives Thus and even.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper names or classifications
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal subword fragments of proper or institutional names in classification lists.

patterns.name: Name fragment Keith
patterns.context: A particular person is introduced with most notably in a cast list.

patterns.name: Film/TV character name fragment
patterns.context: A character’s name appears in a paragraph introducing the character and performer.

patterns.name: Place-name fragment Bahia/Baja
patterns.context: A Mexican coastal place name appears in travel descriptions.

patterns.name: Number and ordinal fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within numbers, years, or court citation numbers; no consistent semantic context.
patterns.domain: Legal citations, academic references, category lists

patterns.name: Other sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different syntactic environment, and current examples are insufficient to group them under a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Travel writing, law, encyclopedias, medicine, and other fields

2_1746.concept: 异质词片段与连接表达
2_1746.description: 激活分散在连接词、法律措辞、叙事表达及多种词内子词片段；没有单一稳定语义主题。And、relying、as各有局部重复，其余多为孤例。

patterns.name: 转折补充连接词“And”
patterns.context: 句中或新句开头用 And 引入补充、后续事件或考虑；常见于叙述性文本。

patterns.name: 分词 relying
patterns.context: 法律论证中说明裁判依据先前判例，常接 upon。

patterns.name: 复合词中的切分片段
patterns.context: 词被分成多个子词时，激活落在词内片段；分别出现在术语、姓名或量表名称中。
patterns.domain: 学术参考文献、医学摘要

patterns.name: 叙事中的 as
patterns.context: “as luck would have it”或“as the day … comes up”等固定/叙事结构中。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的依据措辞
patterns.context: 说明行政决定需基于适当法律标准；与连接词 Thus、even 同现。

patterns.name: 专名或分类中的词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或机构名的内部子词片段，所在文本为分类列表。

patterns.name: 人名片段 Keith
patterns.context: 演员名单中以 most notably 引出特定人物。

patterns.name: 电影/电视人物名片段
patterns.context: 介绍角色及扮演者的段落中出现人物名字。

patterns.name: 地名片段 Bahia/Baja
patterns.context: 旅行描写中出现墨西哥海岸地名。

patterns.name: 数字及序数片段
patterns.context: 数字、年份或法庭引文编号内部的子词片段；没有一致语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、学术参考文献、分类列表

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 各自在不同句法环境中出现，现有样本不足以归为同一触发条件。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to paraphrase markers such as “In other words” and nearby cohesive structures; other scattered activations include connectives, numbers and punctuation, and fragments of citations or names, which cannot be unified.

patterns.name: “In other words” paraphrase marker
patterns.context: The phrase introduces a restatement, explanation, or summary of preceding material; it is directly marked in [2], [3], [4], [8], and [9]. Passage [1] has a similar contrastive-continuation context, but the activation marker falls on “And considering”.

patterns.name: Discourse connectives and following structures
patterns.context: At the start of a passage or sentence, a connective continues from preceding material and introduces considerations or an inference; activation is distributed across the connective and following words.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and phrase fragments
patterns.context: Appears in local text involving numbering, citations, abbreviations, hyphenated compounds, title markers, or names; apart from “or” in the title in [5], there is no shared clear semantic context.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, legal citations, patents, and structured text

patterns.name: Non-standardized activations on common words
patterns.context: These words occur in ordinary syntax or specialized narration in their respective passages, with no shared, stable trigger condition; “words” in [2] and [3] is adjacent to paraphrasing expressions.
patterns.domain: Patent background, astronomy, medicine, research funding descriptions, and terms of service

2_1746.concept: 释义转述标记与话语衔接
2_1746.description: 主要对“In other words”这类释义转述标记及邻近衔接结构敏感；另有连接词、数字标点、引文或姓名碎片等零散激活，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: “In other words”释义引导
patterns.context: 该短语引出对前文的转述、解释或归纳；在[2]、[3]、[4]、[8]、[9]中被直接标记。第[1]段有相似的转折续接语境，但激活标记落在“And considering”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明性、论证性文本

patterns.name: 话语连接词及后续结构
patterns.context: 段首或句首用连接词承接前文，再引出考虑因素或推论；激活分散在连接词及其后续词上。

patterns.name: 数字、标点与短语碎片
patterns.context: 在编号、引文、缩写、连字符复合词、标题标记或人名的局部文本中出现；除[5]标题中的“or”外，缺少共同的明确语义语境。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律引文、专利及结构化文本

patterns.name: 非标准化的普通词激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在各自段落的普通句法或专业叙述中，未见共同而稳定的触发条件；其中“words”在[2]、[3]与释义表达相邻。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、天文学、医学、研究资助说明及服务条款

en.description: All examples show strong activation at “In other words,” followed by a rephrasing or inference from the preceding text, across multiple domains and genres; a few markers elsewhere lack a consistent pattern.

patterns.name: Rephrasing marker “In other words”
patterns.context: The preceding text provides an explanation, data, or argument, followed by this phrase introducing a summary, clarification, or inference; this is the most stable and broadly represented trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain explanatory prose, patent backgrounds, popular science, and web text

patterns.name: Summary or clarification across domains
patterns.context: A condensation, explanation, or inference from the preceding text follows the rephrasing marker; the activation token itself is “words” in the phrase, not the subsequent content.
patterns.domain: Explanatory texts on medicine, social media terms, trademarks, engineering, business, and research funding

patterns.name: Lexical triggers outside rephrasing positions
patterns.context: These tokens occur elsewhere in context and may reflect weak co-activation, incidental triggers, or contextual effects; examples are insufficient to support a unified independent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains, including academic citations, legal/patent text, and general explanatory prose

2_1746.concept: 改述引导短语“In other words”
2_1746.description: 所有样本均在“In other words”处强激活，后接对前文的改述或推论，跨越多种领域与文体；少量其他位置的标记词缺乏一致模式。

patterns.name: “In other words”改述标记
patterns.context: 前文先给出说明、数据或论述，随后用该短语引出总结、释义或推论；这是最稳定、覆盖面最广的触发模式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明性 prose、专利背景、科普及网络文本

patterns.name: 跨领域的总结或释义内容
patterns.trigger: 短语之后的“over the five-year span”“a gynaecologist in Gur”“trademarks serve to identify”“the related-art cooling method cannot”等
patterns.context: 改述标记后紧接对前文的压缩、解释或推论；激活 token 本身是短语中的“words”，而非这些后续内容。
patterns.domain: 医学、社交媒体条款、商标、工程、商业和科研资助等说明文本

patterns.name: 文中非改述位置的词汇触发
patterns.context: 这些 token 位于上下文其他位置，可能属于弱共激活、偶然触发或上下文效应；现有例子不足以支持统一的独立语义条件。
patterns.domain: 多领域；含学术引文、法律/专利及一般说明文本

en.concept: English letter fragments and word endings
en.description: Strong activation often falls on letter sequences or endings such as is, words, and on, and also appears on consideration terms, connectives, and fragments within proper names; positions and genres vary, with scattered accompanying activations that resist a single semantic explanation.

patterns.name: The string is in “is”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the consecutive letters is within words; meaning and syntactic position vary. Common examples include spelling fragments in proper names, technical terms, or ordinary words.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including law, research, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Ending in “words”
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed expression In other words, marking a paraphrase or summary.
patterns.domain: Patent background and online service terms

patterns.name: Ending in “on”
patterns.context: Occurs in the list-ending expression so on, preceded by And so and followed by an ellipsis.

patterns.name: Strong local activation on “to”
patterns.context: Appears in the structure And so to determine..., linking the preceding transition to an infinitive of purpose.

patterns.name: Strong local activation on “considering”
patterns.context: Follows the sentence-initial connective And and introduces the author’s consideration of personal experience.

patterns.name: Fragment within “gill”
patterns.context: Embedded in the scientific name Misgurnus anguillicaudatus; the example also includes other scattered within-word activations.

patterns.name: “erox” brand-name fragment
patterns.context: Falls within the brand name Xerox, followed by a list of other brand names.

patterns.name: Other low-intensity scattered fragments
patterns.context: Distributed across line breaks, sentence-initial connectives, common words, and word-internal positions, with no stable shared trigger condition across passages; these may be accompanying activations.

2_1746.concept: 英语字母片段与词尾
2_1746.description: 强激活多落在 is、words、on 等字母片段或词尾，也见考虑、连接词及专名内部片段；位置和文体不统一，另有零散伴随激活，难以由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: “is”中的 is 字符串
patterns.trigger: «is»9（[3] 中为 «is»9ra，[4] 中为 «is»9placement，[6] 中为 M«is»9g...，[7] 中为 M«is»9ra）
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的连续字母 is 上，词义和句法位置不固定；常见于专名、术语或普通单词的拼写片段。
patterns.domain: 法律、科研、百科等多种文体

patterns.name: “words”中的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在固定表达 In other words 中，标记释义或换言之式的总结。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与网络服务条款

patterns.name: “on”中的词尾
patterns.context: 处于列举收束表达 so on 中，前接 And so，后接省略号。

patterns.name: “to”的局部强激活
patterns.context: 出现在 And so to determine... 结构中，连接前面的承接语与不定式目的表达。

patterns.name: “considering”的局部强激活
patterns.context: 位于句首承接词 And 后，引出作者对自身经历的考量。

patterns.name: “gill”词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在鱼类学名 Misgurnus anguillicaudatus 的单词内部；该例还伴随其他零碎词内激活。

patterns.name: “erox”品牌词片段
patterns.context: 落在品牌名 Xerox 的内部，后文列举其他品牌名称。

patterns.name: 其他低强度零碎片段
patterns.context: 分散在换行、句首连接词、常见词及单词内部，未见跨段稳定的共同触发条件，可能是伴随激活。

en.description: All fragments show their strongest activation at “In other words,” involving explanation, rephrasing, or inference from preceding text; a few fragments also activate on words signaling contrast, exceptions, emphasis, or a new argument, as well as a line-break formatting signal in legal text.

patterns.name: Summary introduced by “In other words”
patterns.context: The phrase appears at the end of the context, followed by an explanation, rephrasing, or inference from the preceding text; it is the strongest trigger shared by all fragments.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including legal, social media terms, medical, research, patent, and commentary

patterns.name: Inferential connective in legal arguments
patterns.context: In a legal opinion, introduces the question the court will consider next after citing precedent.

patterns.name: Explanatory connective meaning
patterns.context: Introduces an explanation of the previously mentioned policy consequences in commentary.

patterns.name: Emphatic adverbs especially / particularly
patterns.context: Emphasize a particular circumstance or reason when describing falling costs and cautious corporate attitudes.

patterns.name: Contrast and concession word but
patterns.context: First acknowledges a limitation, then explains that it is controlled or mitigated.

patterns.name: Additional qualification except that
patterns.context: States an exception to a general rule in terms of service and explains what users can control.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Now introducing a new claim
patterns.context: Introduces a new policy claim in an opinion piece.

patterns.name: Formatting line break
patterns.context: Activation appears near a line-break marker in paragraph or footnote formatting in legal text; it may co-occur with the paragraph format containing “and so”.

2_1746.concept: 改述与解释引导语
2_1746.description: 所有片段都在“In other words”处出现最强激活，涉及前文的解释、改述或推论；少数片段还激活转折、例外、强调或引入新论点的词，另有法律文本换行格式信号。

patterns.name: “In other words”引述总结
patterns.context: 该短语出现在上下文末尾，后接对前文的解释、改述或推论；是所有片段共有的最强触发。
patterns.domain: 法律、社交媒体条款、医学、科研、专利及评论等多种文体

patterns.name: 法律论证中的推论连接
patterns.context: 法律判决文本中，在援引先例后引出法院接下来要判断的问题。

patterns.name: 解释性连接词 meaning
patterns.context: 评论性论述中引出对前述政策后果的说明。

patterns.name: 强调性副词 especially / particularly
patterns.context: 描述成本下降及企业谨慎态度时，用于强调特定情形或原因。

patterns.name: 转折与让步词 but
patterns.context: 先承认存在限制，再转述限制受到控制或缓解。

patterns.name: 补充限定 except that
patterns.context: 服务条款中说明一般规则的例外，并交代用户可控制的事项。

patterns.name: 句首 Now 引出新主张
patterns.context: 评论文章中引入一项新的政策主张。

patterns.name: 格式性换行符
patterns.context: 法律文本的段落或脚注排版中，换行标记附近出现激活；可能与“and so”所在段落格式共同出现。

en.description: The strongest and recurring pattern is “In other words” introducing a restatement or explanation of preceding text, with words especially prominent. In two passages, er/ox in Xerox also activate; the rest are sporadic signals from brand names, conjunctions, pronouns, and technical characters.

patterns.name: “In other words” paraphrase lead-in
patterns.context: The phrase appears after a preceding explanation, inference, or restatement, often at the beginning of a sentence; activation is concentrated on words
patterns.domain: Patent background, online privacy, law, encyclopedias, and general expository prose

patterns.name: Morphemes in the brand name Xerox
patterns.context: Appears in a brand or photocopying context, with Xerox written as a common word or used as a noun
patterns.domain: Branding, business explanations, and legal texts

patterns.name: -name in names
patterns.context: name is individually emphasized when describing a brand or product identifier

patterns.name: Conventional contrastive or additive conjunctions
patterns.context: Sentence-initial contrast, or conjunctions adding clauses and temporal conditions within sentences; all are sporadic activations
patterns.domain: Patent, legal, and general expository texts

patterns.name: Other sporadic function words and characters
patterns.context: Appears in their respective syntactic or technical-notation positions; apart from the paraphrase lead-in, no stable shared condition is apparent
patterns.domain: Mixed; includes narrative, patent technical text, and character annotations

2_1746.concept: 释义重述引导语（兼有零散词形信号）
2_1746.description: 最强且反复的模式是“In other words”引出对前文的重述或解释，words 尤其突出。另在两段中激活 Xerox 的 er/ox；其余为品牌 name、连接词、代词及技术字符等零散信号。

patterns.name: “In other words”释义引导语
patterns.context: 该短语出现在前文解释、推论或重述之后，常位于句首；主要激活落在 words
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、网络隐私、法律、百科及一般说明性散文

patterns.name: Xerox 品牌名中的词素
patterns.context: 出现在品牌或复印件语境中，Xerox 被写作普通词或作为名词使用
patterns.domain: 品牌、商业说明及法律文本

patterns.name: 名称中的 -name
patterns.context: 说明品牌或产品标识时，name 被单独强调

patterns.name: 惯用转折或补充连接词
patterns.context: 句首转折，或句中连接、补充从句与时间条件；均为零散激活
patterns.domain: 专利、法律及一般说明性文本

patterns.name: 其他零散功能词与字符
patterns.context: 在各自句法或技术记号位置出现，除释义引导语之外看不出稳定共同条件
patterns.domain: 混合；包含叙述、专利技术文本与字符标注

en.concept: Mixture of local subword fragments and common structures
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of local cues: M-initial word fragments, an internal fragment of the Xerox brand, pronouns and connectives, code indentation/return, numeric commas, and fragments within names; there is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Continuation fragment after token “M”
patterns.context: An uppercase M occurs at the beginning or within a word, with the following word fragment marked; sometimes embedded in a code variable.

patterns.name: “Xer” within a brand name
patterns.context: The brand name Xerox appears in explanatory, historical, or legal narratives, with activation concentrated on the internal fragment “er”.

patterns.name: “you” and following collocations
patterns.context: The pronoun you recurs in an informal comic review addressed to readers.

patterns.name: Capitalized “And” and coordination
patterns.context: Connects adjacent clauses in narratives or legal documents.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Appears in name lists, with activation on internal character fragments of proper names.

patterns.name: Code indentation and return statements
patterns.context: Indented code and function return statements in JavaScript object configurations.

patterns.name: Comma after a number
patterns.context: Punctuation in numbers, dates, or chemical formulas; fragment [2] also contains an unmarked comma.

patterns.name: Determiners/demonstratives and general connectives
patterns.context: Occur sporadically in ordinary prose, without a consistent local structure.

2_1746.concept: 局部词片段与常见结构混合
2_1746.description: 激活分散在多类局部线索：M开头词片段、Xerox品牌内部片段、代词与连接词、代码缩进/return、数字逗号及人名内部片段；没有单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: token“M”的续词片段
patterns.context: 词首或词内出现大写 M，后续词片段被标记；有时夹在代码变量中。

patterns.name: 品牌名中的“Xer”
patterns.context: 品牌名 Xerox 出现在说明、历史或法律叙述中，激活集中在词内片段“er”。
patterns.domain: 百科、科技评论、法律文书

patterns.name: “you”及后续搭配
patterns.trigger: “you”与“pick”“care”等邻近词；另有普通连接词“and”
patterns.context: 面向读者的口语化漫画评论，代词 you 重复出现。

patterns.name: 大写“And”与并列衔接
patterns.context: 在叙述或法律文书中连接前后分句。

patterns.name: 专名内部子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名列表中，激活落在专名的内部字符片段。

patterns.name: 代码缩进与返回语句
patterns.context: JavaScript 对象配置中的缩进代码与函数返回语句。

patterns.name: 数字后的逗号
patterns.context: 数字、日期或化学式中的标点；片段[2]另有逗号但未标记。

patterns.name: 限定词/指示词与通用连接词
patterns.context: 在普通叙述中零散出现，缺少一致的局部结构。

en.description: The most stable cues are intraword fragments in proper names such as McGraw (including McGraw in email addresses) and Xerox; there are also sporadic word fragments such as parasitology and glutton, as well as function words, numbers, and newline activations across styles and positions.

patterns.name: Segmentation fragment in the proper name McGraw-Hill
patterns.context: Appears as part of the surname or publisher name McGraw, sometimes with a preceding or following hyphen or in an email address; activation is concentrated on an intraword fragment.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in a brand name
patterns.context: Appears in the brand name Xerox, possibly associated with photocopying or a product-brand context.

patterns.name: Other proper-name or intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on short subword fragments inside common words or proper names; there is no shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Varied high-frequency function words and punctuation
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across sentence transitions, legal citations, and code indentation, with no stable shared context.

2_1746.concept: 专名及词内片段
2_1746.description: 最稳定的线索是 McGraw（含邮箱中的 McGraw）及 Xerox 等专名的词内片段；另有 parasitology、glutton 等零散词片段，以及跨文体、位置不一的功能词、数字和换行激活。

patterns.name: McGraw-Hill 专名中的切分片段
patterns.context: 作为姓氏或出版社名 McGraw 的一部分出现，前后可带连字符或邮箱地址；激活集中在词内片段。
patterns.domain: 书目、工程参考、电子邮件

patterns.name: 品牌名词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在品牌名称 Xerox 中，可能与复印或产品品牌语境有关。

patterns.name: 其他专名或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词或专名内部的短子词片段；缺少共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 多样的高频功能词及标点
patterns.context: 这些标记分散于句子衔接、法律引文及代码缩进等不同位置，未见稳定共同上下文。

en.description: The most salient identifiable pattern is subwords within the proper names McGraw-Hill and Xerox; there are also &, the x in the register ecx, and the common word and. The passages additionally contain sporadic activations on various function words, punctuation, and code symbols, without consistent conditions.

patterns.name: Word segmentation in the name McGraw-Hill
patterns.context: In the publisher proper name McGraw-Hill, activation falls on the internal Graw/raw portion; some examples include the hyphen and its suffix

patterns.name: Word segmentation in the name Xerox
patterns.context: The brand Xerox appears in examples of brands, photocopied documents, company/research-institute histories, computer equipment, or link labels; activation falls near the intraword er/erox, with varying strength
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal texts, technology discussions, medical equipment descriptions, technical labels

patterns.name: Ampersand in a technical abbreviation
patterns.context: The symbol & occurs in the company name AT&T

patterns.name: The character x in code
patterns.context: Activation falls on x in the assembly-code register name ecx

patterns.name: and in a common word
patterns.context: The common word and connects coordinated actions or relations within a sentence

patterns.name: Various grammatical function words
patterns.context: These activations occur sporadically in bibliography formatting, ordinary narrative, legal texts, code, and quotations, with no unified local-context condition

2_1746.concept: 词内片段及符号
2_1746.description: 最显著的可辨模式是 McGraw-Hill 与 Xerox 专名内部的子词；另有 AT&T 的 &、寄存器 ecx 的 x，以及普通 and。各段还零散激活多种功能词、标点和代码符号，缺乏一致条件。

patterns.name: McGraw-Hill 名称中的分词
patterns.context: 出版商专名 McGraw-Hill 中，激活落在名称内部的 Graw/raw 部分；有的例子带连字符及其后缀
patterns.domain: 参考书目、工程文档、邮件

patterns.name: Xerox 名称中的分词
patterns.context: 品牌 Xerox 出现在品牌举例、复印文件、公司/研究机构历史、计算机设备或链接标识中；激活落在词内 er/erox 附近，强度有变化
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、科技讨论、医疗设备介绍、技术标识

patterns.name: 技术缩写中的 & 符号
patterns.context: 符号 & 位于公司名 AT&T 内

patterns.name: 代码中的 x 字符
patterns.context: 汇编代码寄存器名 ecx 中，激活落在 x

patterns.name: 普通词中的 and
patterns.context: 句中连接并列动作或关系的普通词 and

patterns.name: 多种语法功能词
patterns.context: 这些激活零散出现于书目格式、普通叙述、法律文本、代码和引语中，未见统一的局部上下文条件

en.concept: Fragments within specific words and code fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to the “er” fragment in the name Xerox, including the company, products, and PARC; also responds to “raw” in McGraw-Hill and activates on indentation, return, and bitwise-operation-related fragments in two code passages.

patterns.name: Xerox name and brand contexts
patterns.context: When the text mentions Xerox Corporation, products, copiers, or its research institute; includes the brand name and part of a proper name.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news discussions, legal documents, medical project descriptions

patterns.name: Internal fragment of McGraw-Hill
patterns.context: Appears in references, publisher names, or email sender names.

patterns.name: Specific syntax fragments in code
patterns.context: Indentation and keywords in a JavaScript configuration object, or bitwise operations/variable comments in assembly code; no clear connection to Xerox or McGraw-Hill names.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, Github assembly code

2_1746.concept: 特定词内部片段及代码片段
2_1746.description: 主要响应 Xerox 名称中的“er”片段，涵盖公司、产品及 PARC；也响应 McGraw-Hill 中的“raw”，并在两段代码里激活于缩进、return 和位运算相关片段。

patterns.name: Xerox 名称及品牌语境
patterns.context: 在文中提及 Xerox 公司、产品、复印机或其研究机构时；包括品牌名与专名的一部分。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻讨论、法律文书、医学项目描述

patterns.name: McGraw-Hill 名称内部
patterns.context: 出现在参考文献、出版社名称或邮件发件人姓名中。
patterns.domain: 百科参考文献、专利背景、邮件

patterns.name: 代码中的特定语法片段
patterns.context: JavaScript 配置对象中的缩进、关键字，或汇编代码中的位运算/变量注释；与 Xerox、McGraw-Hill 名称无明显关联。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、Github 汇编代码

en.concept: Xerox spelling fragments and miscellaneous tokens
en.description: The strongest and recurring pattern is the Xerox name and related technology-history contexts; other activations are scattered across common English word fragments, sentence-initial/newline/indentation formatting, computer terminology, and assembly operators, and are difficult to group under a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Xerox name and word-form fragments
patterns.context: When discussing the brand, company, products, photocopier business, or Xerox PARC and the Sigma-3 computer, activation is concentrated on spelling fragments in Xerox/Xerox; the brand name may relate to its work or technology history.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal texts, HackerNews, medical technology

patterns.name: Letter fragments within specific words
patterns.context: In ordinary English prose, activation falls on complete words or fragments within words; fragment positions and meanings vary, with no shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or formatting tokens
patterns.context: Appears in sentence-initial transitions, newlines, list/configuration-file formatting, or code indentation; activations are scattered across different structural tokens.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, forums, technical documents, configuration code

patterns.name: Substrings in computer terminology
patterns.context: Embedded separately in technical words such as Xeons, Xephyr, and mnemonic, with no shared context; may reflect incidental responses at the character-fragment level.
patterns.domain: Hardware discussions, Linux technical documents, blockchain code

patterns.name: Bitwise operators
patterns.context: When an assembly comment explains a mask, activation covers the spellings of the AND/XOR operators.

2_1746.concept: Xerox 拼写片段及杂项 token
2_1746.description: 最强且反复的模式是 Xerox 名称及其技术史相关语境；其余激活散落在英文常见词片段、句首/换行/缩进格式、计算机术语和汇编运算符中，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: Xerox 名称及词形片段
patterns.context: 在谈品牌、公司、产品、复印机业务或 Xerox PARC、Sigma-3 计算机时，激活集中于 Xerox/Xerox 的拼写片段；品牌名可与其任务或技术史相连。

patterns.name: 特定词内的字母片段
patterns.context: 在普通英文叙述中激活落在完整词或词中片段上；片段出现位置和词义各异，缺少共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 句首或格式性 token
patterns.context: 出现在句首衔接、换行、列表/配置文件格式或代码缩进位置；激活分散于不同结构 token。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、论坛、技术文档、配置代码

patterns.name: 计算机术语中的子串
patterns.context: 分别嵌在 Xeons、Xephyr、mnemonic 等技术词中，未见共同上下文；可能是字符片段层面的偶发响应。
patterns.domain: 硬件讨论、Linux 技术文档、区块链代码

patterns.name: 位运算运算符
patterns.context: 汇编注释说明 mask 时，激活覆盖 AND/XOR 运算符拼写片段。

en.description: The clearest recurring pattern is Xerox spelling fragments (segments 1, 2, 3, 5, and 6); other activations are scattered across English words, Russian words, code whitespace and keywords, operation-related comments, and legal ordinal citations, with no unified, verifiable trigger condition.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of the string Xerox
patterns.context: Activation falls on “er” or the adjacent “ox” fragment within the spelling of Xerox; occurs in the brand name, possessive forms, and spellings such as Xerox PARC.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal texts, technology discussions, research abstracts

patterns.name: Letter fragments in specific English words
patterns.context: Markers within these English function words or common words activate, but their positions and contexts vary; the material does not establish a shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Local fragments in code
patterns.context: Appears in code indentation, within identifiers, and in keywords; code comments also include « and» and «x«or».

patterns.name: Russian word-final or intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed within or at the ends of multiple Russian words, with no single lexical category apparent.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix in a numbered citation
patterns.context: Ordinal abbreviation indicating a circuit court number in a legal citation; activation covers both the number and th.

patterns.name: Symbols and operation-related words
patterns.context: Assembly comments describing bitmasks involve AND and XOR, respectively; this may reflect responses to operator names or related spelling fragments.

patterns.name: Embedded “em” fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs within the word mnemonic, in the context of a code variable-name explanation; this is a singleton, so it is unclear whether it relates to the code pattern or the English-fragment pattern.

2_1746.concept: Xerox 拼写片段偏好
2_1746.description: 最明显的重复模式是 Xerox 拼写片段（段1、2、3、5、6）；其余激活零散落在英文词、俄语词、代码空白与关键字、运算相关注释及法律序数引文中，缺少统一的可证实触发条件。

patterns.name: Xerox 字样的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Xerox 拼写中的「er」或邻近的「ox」片段；出现于品牌名、所有格及 Xerox PARC 等写法。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、科技讨论、科研摘要

patterns.name: 特定英文词中的字母片段
patterns.trigger: 「« The»」「« and»」「« upon»」「« as»」「« they»」「« indeed»」「« where»」「« there»」
patterns.context: 这些英文功能词或普通词内部的标记片段均有激活，但位置和上下文不一致；未见可由材料确认的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码中的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在代码缩进、标识符内部及关键字中；另有代码注释中的「« and»」「x«or»」。

patterns.name: 俄语词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在多个俄语词的内部或词尾，未显示单一词法类别。

patterns.name: 带编号引文中的序数后缀
patterns.context: 法律引文中表示巡回法院编号的序数缩写；激活同时覆盖数字和 th。

patterns.name: 符号与运算相关词
patterns.context: 汇编注释中描述位掩码，分别涉及 AND 与 XOR；可能是对运算符名称或相关拼写片段的响应。

patterns.name: 嵌入的「em」片段
patterns.context: 激活位于 mnemonic 一词内部，处于代码中的变量名说明语境；孤例，无法判断是否与代码模式或英文片段模式相关。

en.description: Activations are scattered across intraword fragments in multiple languages and across numbers and parenthetical punctuation; they include both Russian substrings and English word fragments, code identifiers, and document numbering, and cannot be explained by a single word meaning, grammatical function, or domain.

patterns.name: Intraword subword fragment «ли»
patterns.context: All triggers occur inside longer words, not as standalone words: for example, «пис»ь«м»о, л«и», у«б»ирает л«и»шние, and mn«em»onic.
patterns.domain: Russian Q&A and English code/technical texts

patterns.name: English word-final or intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on local fragments of English words, including whole words, suffixes, and consecutive characters within words; there is no shared syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Fiction, encyclopedias, legal documents, and package manifests

patterns.name: Heading numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Numbers or parenthetical punctuation occur in heading numbers, indexes, or parenthetical structures in legal documents.
patterns.domain: Patent specifications, package manifests, legal documents

2_1746.concept: 词片段与文档标记
2_1746.description: 激活分散在多语种词内片段及数字、括号标点上；既包括俄语子串，也包括英文词片段、代码标识符和文档编号，无法由单一词义、语法功能或领域解释。

patterns.name: 词中子词素「ли」
patterns.context: 触发点都处于更长词内部，而非独立单词：如 «пис»ь«м»о、л«и»、у«б»ирает л«и»шние、mn«em»onic。
patterns.domain: 俄语问答文本及英文代码/技术文本

patterns.name: 英文词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词的局部片段上，涵盖完整词、后缀及词内部连续字符；未见统一的句法位置。
patterns.domain: 小说、百科、法律文书及软件包清单

patterns.name: 标题编号与标点
patterns.context: 数字或括号标点位于标题编号、索引或法律文书的括注结构中。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、软件包清单、法律文书

en.description: Activations fall on varied local strings: er in Xerox, fragments within Russian words, several common English words, code indentation and internal word fragments, as well as parentheses and numbers. No unified semantics or stable contextual condition is evident across corpora.

patterns.name: Token fragment in the Xerox string
patterns.context: Appears in the brand name Xerox/Xerox’s, with unmarked “ox” following the fragment; [1] also contains “X«er»10ox” and discussion of the brand name.
patterns.domain: Brands, legal text, and technology commentary

patterns.name: Fragments within Russian words
patterns.context: Activation is embedded in Russian words: “имярек” and “ли” in [3], and “ли” in [9]; these are not the same word or clearly semantically related.

patterns.name: Fragments in specific English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on common English words or short words, distributed across narrative, book review, and research prose, with no shared meaning or stable syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative, book reviews, academic prose

patterns.name: Code indentation and whitespace
patterns.context: In JavaScript object code, activation is on leading spaces at different indentation levels; the same passage also activates on the code word “return” and “em” in “mnemonic”.

patterns.name: Parentheses and numeric characters
patterns.context: In a legal sentence, parentheses enclose the number 2, and three adjacent characters are each marked as activated.

2_1746.concept: none
2_1746.description: 激活落在多种局部字符串上：Xerox 中的 er、俄语词内片段、若干普通英语词、代码缩进与词内片段，以及括号和数字。跨语料未见统一语义或稳定上下文条件。

patterns.name: Xerox 字符串中的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在品牌名 Xerox/Xerox’s 中，片段后接未标记的“ox”；[1] 还出现“X«er»10ox”及品牌名讨论。
patterns.domain: 品牌、法律文本及科技评论

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活嵌在俄语单词中：[3] 的“имярек”及“ли”，[9] 的“ли”；不是同一词或明确相同语义。

patterns.name: 特定英语词语中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英语词或短词上，分布于叙事、书评和科研散文，未显示共同词义或稳定句法条件。
patterns.domain: 文学叙事、书评、学术散文

patterns.name: 代码缩进与空白
patterns.context: JavaScript 对象代码中，激活的是行首不同层级的空格缩进；同段也激活了代码词“return”及“mnemonic”中的“em”。

patterns.name: 括号及数字字符
patterns.context: 法律句子中，括号包住数字 2，三个相邻字符分别标记激活。

en.concept: Mixed activation on words and subword fragments
en.description: The clearest recurring patterns are er in Xerox and indeed in narrative or legal sentences; there are also webpage second-person you and numerous sporadic activations on function words, letters, and punctuation. The triggers are not consistent in meaning or style.

patterns.name: Xerox spelling fragment
patterns.context: Occurs within the brand name Xerox, at er in the letter sequence X-er-ox; whether other specific contextual cues are present seems unimportant.
patterns.domain: Branding, business, legal, and technology texts

patterns.name: indeed
patterns.context: Used mid-sentence to add, emphasize, or introduce further explanation, with varying punctuation and sentence structures.

patterns.name: you
patterns.context: Addresses the reader directly in statements, recommendations, or instructions; often occurs with can, but also appears in other sentence structures.
patterns.domain: Webpage instructions, product reviews, and event promotions

patterns.name: can in second-person imperatives
patterns.context: Tells the reader what actions they can perform or what features are available; overlaps with the preceding pattern.

patterns.name: English article The
patterns.context: The definite article at the beginning of a sentence or after a quotation, preceding a noun phrase; appears in only two passages, with inconsistent contexts.

patterns.name: Weak conjunctions and common function words
patterns.context: Common conjunctions, pronouns, adverbs, or verbs appear in their respective syntactic positions; there is no unified local context.

patterns.name: Letters within Russian words
patterns.context: Markers fall on individual Cyrillic letters in Russian sentences, especially inside words or in questions about quoted signature formats; there is insufficient evidence of a stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Appears near numbering, line breaks, or parentheses and square brackets in legal texts; markers are sporadic, with no confirmed common pattern.

patterns.name: Special letter fragment in the proper name Xerox
patterns.context: Also the brand Xerox; the marker in [3] is in the same position as in [1][2], but is slightly weaker.

2_1746.concept: 词汇与子词片段的混合激活
2_1746.description: 最清楚的反复模式是 Xerox 中的 er，以及叙事或法律语句里的 indeed；另有网页第二人称 you 和大量零散功能词、字母及标点激活。各触发在语义和文体上并不统一。

patterns.name: Xerox 拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在品牌名 Xerox 的内部，标注位置是字母序列 X-er-ox 中的 er；周围是否有其他特定语境似乎不重要。
patterns.domain: 品牌、商业、法律及科技文本

patterns.name: indeed
patterns.context: 句中用于补充、强调或引出进一步说明，标点与句式各异。
patterns.domain: 叙事 prose 与法律文本

patterns.name: you
patterns.context: 直接以第二人称向读者陈述、建议或说明操作；常与 can 连用，但也见于其他句式。
patterns.domain: 网页说明、产品评论与活动宣传

patterns.name: 第二人称祈使句中的 can
patterns.context: 向读者说明可进行的操作或可获得的功能；与上一个模式重叠。

patterns.name: 英文冠词 The
patterns.context: 句首或引述后作为名词短语的定冠词；只在两段出现，语境不一致。

patterns.name: 弱连接词与常见功能词
patterns.context: 在各自句法位置作为常见连接词、代词、副词或动词；未见统一的局部语境。

patterns.name: 俄语词内字母
patterns.context: 标记落在俄语句子中的单个西里尔字母，尤其出现在词内或引号中的签名格式问题；没有足够证据表明有稳定词义触发。

patterns.name: 数字与标点
patterns.context: 出现在法律文本中的编号、换行或括号、方括号等标点附近；标记零散，未形成可确认的共同模式。

patterns.name: Xerox 专有名词中的特殊字母片段
patterns.context: 同为品牌 Xerox；[3] 的标记位置与 [1][2] 一致，但强度略低。

en.concept: Specific string fragments and result conjunctions
en.description: Activation mainly occurs on the causal/resultative conjunction thereby, er in the brand name Xerox, and here in where clauses introducing legal conditions; code indentation spaces and man in Newman also appear, all as local string triggers.

patterns.name: Suffix in the Xerox brand name
patterns.context: The brand name Xerox appears in a sentence or legal document, with activation concentrated on er

patterns.name: Causal or resultative conjunction thereby
patterns.context: The preceding text describes a process, condition, or method, and thereby introduces its consequence; activation falls on thereby
patterns.domain: Historical discussion, patent technology, machine-learning papers

patterns.name: Conditional or legal clause introduced by where
patterns.context: The beginning of where is unmarked or not fully shown; it introduces a condition, circumstance, or legal rule

patterns.name: JavaScript indentation spaces
patterns.context: Spaces at the start of object-property lines in a code block, increasing with indentation depth

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the name Newman
patterns.context: The personal name Newman in a citation, with activation concentrated on the substring man

patterns.name: Internal fragment in another brand name
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the brand name Kleenex; activation is weaker and occurs in the same segment as Xerox

2_1746.concept: 特定字符串片段与结果连接词
2_1746.description: 主要激活于因果结果连接词 thereby、品牌名 Xerox 中的 er，以及法律条件从句 where 中的 here；另见代码缩进空格和 Newman 中的 man，均为局部字符串触发。

patterns.name: Xerox 品牌名中的后缀
patterns.context: 品牌名 Xerox 被写在句中或法律文书中，激活集中在 er

patterns.name: 因果或结果连接词 thereby
patterns.context: 前文描述某过程、条件或方法，thereby 引出其导致的结果；激活落在 thereby
patterns.domain: 历史论述、专利技术、机器学习论文

patterns.name: where 引导的条件或法律从句
patterns.context: where 的前部未标记或未完整呈现；用于引出条件、情形或法律规则

patterns.name: JavaScript 缩进空格
patterns.context: 代码块中位于对象属性行首的空格，随缩进层级增加

patterns.name: Newman 名字内部片段
patterns.context: 引文中的人名 Newman，激活集中在 man 这一子串

patterns.name: 其他品牌名内部片段
patterns.context: 品牌名 Kleenex 的内部片段；激活较弱，且与 Xerox 同段出现

en.description: Activation is distributed across letters within Russian words, Where in legal texts, conjunctions, and parenthetical numbers; indeed also appears in literary and legal arguments. These local patterns differ substantially and are difficult to group as a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Specific letters within Russian words
patterns.context: These letters occur inside words in Russian sentences; the surrounding topics are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Legal conditional clause introduced by where
patterns.context: Where introduces a condition, rule, or statement of fact in legal case citations or legal arguments.

patterns.name: indeed as an additive emphasis
patterns.context: After a preceding statement, indeed adds, emphasizes, or introduces further support.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or medial conjunctions
patterns.context: Common English function words appearing in clauses, coordination, sentence-initial structures, or contrast; no narrow shared semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Parentheses and punctuation
patterns.context: Parentheses and adjacent numbers are marked in legal citations, possibly reflecting a local punctuation or number pattern.

patterns.name: Character fragments within English words
patterns.context: Character fragments occur within English words such as “8th”, “Xerox”, “Kleenex”, and “seawall”, with no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: Question-title line break
patterns.context: A newline marker occurs near a StackExchange post title or the beginning of a question.

patterns.name: Context without salient markers
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on letters in Russian words, where, indeed, and other disparate local features; the remaining unmarked content does not explain these highlights.

2_1746.concept: none
2_1746.description: 激活分布于俄语词内字母、法律文本中的 Where、连接词及括号数字，也见文学与法律论证中的 indeed；这些局部模式彼此差异明显，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 俄语词内特定字母
patterns.context: 俄语句子中，这些字母出现在词内部；上下文主题并不一致。
patterns.domain: 俄语 StackExchange 及俄语文本

patterns.name: where 引导的法律条件从句
patterns.trigger: «here»（与前面的 W/w 合成 “Where”）；有时后接 « there»
patterns.context: 法律判例引文或法律论证中，以 Where 引出条件、规则或事实陈述。

patterns.name: indeed 转折补充
patterns.context: 前句陈述之后，以 indeed 补充、强调或引出进一步论据。

patterns.name: 句首或句中连接词
patterns.context: 英语句子中的常见功能词，分别出现在从句、并列、句首或转折结构中；未见统一的窄语义条件。

patterns.name: 括号与标点
patterns.context: 法律引文中括号及相邻数字被标记，可能是局部标点或数字模式。

patterns.name: 英文词内字符片段
patterns.context: 字符片段位于英文词内部，如 “8th”“Xerox”“Kleenex”“seawall”，没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 问题标题换行
patterns.context: StackExchange 帖子标题或问题开头附近出现换行标记。

patterns.name: 未显著标记的上下文
patterns.trigger: 无可归纳的稳定触发子串
patterns.context: 激活集中在俄语词中字母、where、indeed 等彼此差异较大的局部；其余未标记内容无法解释这些高亮。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several local characters or words: Russian и, er in Xerox, English and there (also and upon), and indeed in narrative. Contexts and meanings vary substantially, with no unified syntactic or thematic pattern.

patterns.name: Russian «и» character and occurrences within words
patterns.context: In Russian contexts, it appears both as an independent conjunction or interrogative particle and within words; examples occur near punctuation, string searches, and general programming Q&A.

patterns.name: «er» in the Xerox brand name
patterns.context: In English text referring to Xerox copiers or copies, activation falls on the internal character substring «er» in the brand name.

patterns.name: Adjacent collocation and there
patterns.context: In several English prose passages, activation falls on there, often following and; in one legal passage, activation is on upon instead of there.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research abstracts, financial reporting, sports commentary, and legal documents

patterns.name: Causal or emphatic connective indeed
patterns.context: In narrative prose, used as an additional emphasis in a sentence explaining that a child fears their father.

2_1746.concept: none
2_1746.description: 激活分布在几类局部字符或词汇上：俄语 и、Xerox 中的 er、英语 and there（另见 and upon）及叙事中的 indeed。各处上下文和语义差异明显，未见统一句法或主题。

patterns.name: 俄语 «и» 字符及其词内出现
patterns.context: 俄语语境中，既出现在独立的连词或疑问小词里，也出现在词内部；可见于标点、字符串搜索及一般编程问答。

patterns.name: Xerox 品牌名中的 «er»
patterns.context: 在提到 Xerox 复印机或副本的英语文本中，激活落在品牌名内部的字符子串 «er»。

patterns.name: and there 相邻搭配
patterns.context: 多段英语散文中激活落在 there，常接在 and 后；法律文书一段则激活 upon，而非 there。
patterns.domain: 百科、科研摘要、财经报道、体育评论及法律文书

patterns.name: 原因或强调性连接词 indeed
patterns.context: 叙事散文中，在说明孩子害怕父亲的句子里，用作补充强调。

en.concept: There be and ли function-word fragments
en.description: Activation mainly occurs on English there (especially existential there be constructions), as well as the Russian interrogative particle ли; it also sporadically covers sentence-initial determiners, English function words, newlines, and intraword characters, with no consistent semantic pattern among the latter categories.

patterns.name: Russian interrogative/conditional particle «ли»
patterns.context: In Russian sentences, “ли” forms a question or indirect question, with activation concentrated on characters in the middle of the word; [1] asks whether a comma is needed after a form of address, and [2] asks whether a string contains a particular word.

patterns.name: Characters within English there
patterns.context: In English, there is followed by a form of be to express existence or introduce a clause; most instances are preceded by and, with another in the legal citation “where there is”. Activation falls on characters within there.
patterns.domain: English legal texts, encyclopedias, and narrative prose

patterns.name: English function words and local syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across English prose: as introduces a reason or clause; care appears in the negative expression “did not seem to care”; indeed provides parenthetical emphasis; with introduces an accompanying or supplementary detail. These do not fully overlap with the dominant there pattern.

patterns.name: English sentence-initial article The
patterns.context: The definite article or possessive determiner appears at the start of a new sentence, paragraph, or clause, followed by a noun phrase; the triggering forms are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments and proper-name spellings
patterns.context: Only character fragments inside words or proper names are marked, spanning names, common words, numbers, and hyphenation; these examples lack a unified semantic or syntactic trigger.
patterns.domain: Multilingual legal, encyclopedic, and literary texts

patterns.name: Sentence-initial newline marker
patterns.context: The marker falls on a newline, near the beginning of a paragraph or question in Russian Q&A text; it may co-occur with the Russian fragments above, but its role is uncertain.

2_1746.concept: there be 与 ли 等功能词片段
2_1746.description: 主要激活于英语 there（尤其 there be 存在句），另有俄语疑问词 ли；还零散覆盖句首限定词、英语功能词、换行符及词内字符，后几类缺少一致语义规律。

patterns.name: 俄语疑问/条件词「ли」
patterns.trigger: [1] «и»（落在“ли”中）；[2] «и»（落在“ли”中），对应“нужна ли”“есть ли”
patterns.context: 俄语句中以“ли”构成疑问或间接疑问，激活集中在该词中间的字符；[1]询问称呼语后是否要逗号，[2]询问字符串中是否存在某词。
patterns.domain: 俄语语言讨论、编程问答

patterns.name: 英语句中 there 的词内字符
patterns.trigger: « there»9：[4]“where there is no”；[5]“and there were”；[6]“and there can be”；[8]“and there were”；[9]“and there is”；[10]“and there were”
patterns.context: 英语中 there 后接 be 动词，表达存在或引出从句；多数前接 and，另有法律引文中的“where there is”。激活位置在 there 的词内字符。
patterns.domain: 英语法律文本、百科与叙事散文

patterns.name: 英语功能词及局部句法片段
patterns.context: 分散出现在英语散文中：as 引导原因或从句，care 出现在否定表达“did not seem to care”，indeed 作插入强调；with 引出伴随或补充说明。它们与高频 there 模式并不完全重合。

patterns.name: 英语句首冠词 The
patterns.trigger: «The»2：[5]“The cyclone”；[6]两处“The grown-ups”“The story”；« His»2：[8]“His maternal grandfather”
patterns.context: 定冠词或物主限定词位于新句、段落或新分句开头，后接名词短语；触发形式并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 词内片段和专名拼写
patterns.context: 仅标出词或专名内部的字符片段，跨越姓名、普通词、数字和连字符；这些例子缺少统一的语义或句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种混合的法律、百科及文学文本

patterns.name: 句首换行标记
patterns.context: 标记落在换行符上，出现在俄语问答文本的段落或问题开头附近；可能与前述俄语片段共现，但本身的作用不确定。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答及格式化文本

en.description: The most prominent recurring pattern is er in Xerox-related spellings; Russian и, English as and where, and several other sporadic fragments are also activated. The variation across languages, parts of speech, and contexts is substantial, so no single semantic feature explains them.

patterns.name: er substring in “Xerox”
patterns.context: Appears in proper names such as Xerox/Xerox’s/Xerox copies/Xerox PARC; in segment 10, it appears in the common English word newer.
patterns.domain: Russian Q&A, encyclopedias, law, technology history discussions, code comments

patterns.name: Highlighted и in Russian words
patterns.context: In Russian sentences, the marker falls on the Cyrillic letter “и”; the meaning is unrelated to Xerox.

patterns.name: Specific word fragments in English adverbs or connectives
patterns.context: In English narrative, as occurs in a subordinate-clause linking position; the highlighted token may also simply be a subword segmentation fragment.

patterns.name: Fragment of sentence-initial Just
patterns.context: The phrase Just as introduces a description of opportunities to participate; activation falls on as rather than on an obvious semantic concept of the phrase as a whole.

patterns.name: where in a legal citation
patterns.context: Appears in the conditional clause “where there is no…” in a legal case citation; may reflect activation at the word-fragment level.

patterns.name: Other sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: These fragments occur in different syntactic positions, with no stable shared meaning or contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, law, research, technology discussions, and other fields

2_1746.concept: 词片段 er / 偶发片段
2_1746.description: 最醒目的重复模式是 Xerox 相关拼写中的 er；另有俄语 и、英语 as、where 及多个零散片段被激活。跨语言、词类与语境差异较大，无法用单一语义特征解释。

patterns.name: “Xerox”中的 er 子串
patterns.trigger: «er»10（1、2、3、7、8）；另有 «er»5（10，作为 newer 的一部分）
patterns.context: 出现在 Xerox/Xerox’s/Xerox copies/Xerox PARC 等专名中；第10段则出现在普通英语单词 newer 中。
patterns.domain: 俄语问答、百科、法律、科技史讨论、代码注释

patterns.name: 俄语词中被突出标记的 и
patterns.context: 俄语句子中，标记落在西里尔字母“и”；词义与 Xerox 无关。

patterns.name: 英语副词或连接词中的特定词片段
patterns.trigger: «as»10（6）；«as»10 的对应片段并非稳定的词义类别
patterns.context: 在英语叙述中，as 出现在从句连接位置；高亮 token 也可能只是子词切分片段。

patterns.name: 句首 Just 的片段
patterns.context: 短语 Just as 引出关于参与机会的说明；激活落在 as，而非短语整体的明显语义概念。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 where
patterns.context: 出现在法律判例引文的条件从句 “where there is no…” 中；可能是词片段层面的激活。

patterns.name: 其他零散的词片段
patterns.context: 这些片段分布在不同句法位置，未显示稳定的共同语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、科研、科技讨论等

en.description: Activations cover diverse subword fragments: aroma/captivating in food-sensory contexts, Calibrating, Sec and long in code, Favorite, and postoperative medical terminology. These triggers lack a shared meaning or stable context.

patterns.name: In-word fragments adjacent to aroma
patterns.context: In food or beverage descriptions, especially when a modifier or verb immediately precedes aroma, or in sentences describing fragrance; paragraph 2 contains Captivating and aroma, and paragraphs 3, 4, and 5 also contain aroma

patterns.name: In-word substring in Calibrating
patterns.context: Mac OS X system titles followed by repeated occurrences of Calibrating; activation is distributed across multiple subword fragments of the same word

patterns.name: Code identifier fragment Sec
patterns.context: At the start of a code field name or identifier: Secure in CookieOptions and Sec in Timespec

patterns.name: Favorite in interface/title text
patterns.context: Favorite appears in short editing-interface phrases or album review titles

patterns.name: Code type name containing long
patterns.context: As part of a type name in C type mappings or struct field declarations

patterns.name: Postoperative infection section context
patterns.context: In medical paper titles or section headings, modifying infectious complications

2_1818.description: 激活覆盖多种彼此差异较大的词片段：食品感官语境中的 aroma/captivating、Calibrating、代码中的 Sec 与 long、Favorite，以及术后医学术语；这些触发项缺乏统一语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: 词内片段与 aroma 邻接
patterns.context: 在食品或饮品描述中，尤其 aroma 前紧邻限定词或动词，或处于描述香气的句子里；第2段同现 Captivating 与 aroma，第3、4、5段也有 aroma

patterns.name: Calibrating 的词内子串
patterns.context: Mac OS X 系统标题及其后重复出现 Calibrating；激活分布在同一词的多个子词片段

patterns.name: 代码标识符片段 Sec
patterns.context: 作为代码字段名或标识符的开头：CookieOptions 中的 Secure，以及 Timespec 中的 Sec

patterns.name: Favorite 界面/标题用语
patterns.context: Favorite 出现在编辑界面短语或专辑评论标题中

patterns.name: long 的代码类型名
patterns.context: C 类型映射或结构体字段声明中，作为类型名的一部分

patterns.name: 术后感染章节语境
patterns.context: 医学论文标题或章节标题中，修饰 infectious complications

en.description: Primarily responds to “aroma” in food and beverage contexts; also activates on Favorite, the Sec substring, Mac, the C type name long, and recurring newline formatting. The latter cases belong to different contexts.

patterns.name: Aroma description
patterns.context: Directly describes odors, aromas, or the olfactory characteristics of food or drink
patterns.domain: Food and beverage reviews, cooking articles

patterns.name: Favorite substring
patterns.context: “Favorite” used as a page-action label or in an album title

patterns.name: Sec substring
patterns.context: Appears in code field names, struct fields, or paper section identifiers

patterns.name: Mac operating system
patterns.context: Refers to Mac systems, alongside “OS X Systems”

patterns.name: long type name
patterns.context: Adjacent to C type names and integer-width declarations

patterns.name: Newline marker
patterns.context: Line-break boundaries in paragraphs or code blocks; recurs across multiple samples
patterns.domain: Formatting and code syntax across genres

2_1818.description: 主要响应食品与饮品语境中的“aroma”；另对 Favorite、Sec 子串、Mac、C 类型名 long 及反复出现的换行格式有激活，后几类分属不同语境。

patterns.name: 香气描述
patterns.context: 直接描述气味、香味或食物/饮品的嗅觉特征
patterns.domain: 食品与饮品评论、烹饪文章

patterns.name: Favorite 子串
patterns.context: 作为页面操作标签或专辑标题中的“Favorite”

patterns.name: Sec 子串
patterns.context: 出现在代码字段名、结构体字段或论文章节标识中

patterns.name: Mac 操作系统
patterns.context: 与“OS X Systems”并列，指 Mac 系统

patterns.name: long 类型名
patterns.context: 与 C 类型名及整数宽度声明相邻

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 段落或代码块的换行边界；多个样本中反复出现
patterns.domain: 多种文体的排版与代码格式

en.concept: Multiple types of intra-word fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple intra-word fragments and formatting markers: aroma in food-odor contexts, ating in Calibrating/captivating, Sec in code fields, Favorite in titles, and newline and medical-term fragments. The triggers may be independent of one another and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Intra-word substring “ating”
patterns.context: Part of longer words; appears in body text, titles, or product descriptions, regardless of word meaning

patterns.name: Aroma-related words
patterns.context: Descriptions of food, drink, or odors involving aroma, smell, or flavor evaluation
patterns.domain: Food reviews, cooking, and sensory descriptions

patterns.name: “Sec” within security-related terms
patterns.context: Field names in code denoting security-related fields or time structures; the substring may also be a purely orthographic trigger

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation of Favorite
patterns.context: A title word in webpage headings or music-review metadata

patterns.name: Newline markers in document structure
patterns.context: Line or paragraph boundaries in text or code; appears in excerpts from multiple domains
patterns.domain: Web text, code, and medical papers

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in a medical term
patterns.context: A term describing serum albumin levels in a medical paper

patterns.name: Numeric or list-structure fragments
patterns.context: In numbering, lists, code type widths, or numeric thresholds; the triggering role is uncertain
patterns.domain: Web metadata, code, and medical papers

2_1818.concept: 多类词内片段与格式标记
2_1818.description: 激活分散于多种词内片段和格式标记：食品气味语境中的 aroma、Calibrating/captivating 中的 ating、代码字段中的 Sec、标题中的 Favorite，以及换行和医学术语片段。各触发可能彼此独立，不能由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 单词内部子串「ating」
patterns.context: 作为较长单词的一部分；出现在正文、标题或产品描述中，不限词义

patterns.name: 香气相关词
patterns.context: 食品、饮品或气味描述中，涉及香气、气味或风味评价
patterns.domain: 食品评论、烹饪与感官描述

patterns.name: 安全属性词内的「Sec」
patterns.context: 代码中表示安全相关字段或时间结构的字段名；该子串也可能只是词形触发
patterns.domain: Github 代码与结构体定义

patterns.name: Favorite 的词内切分
patterns.context: 网页标题或音乐评论元数据中的标题词

patterns.name: 文档结构中的换行标记
patterns.context: 文本或代码的行间、段间边界；在多个不同领域片段中出现
patterns.domain: 网页文本、代码及医学论文

patterns.name: 医学术语的词内片段
patterns.context: 医学论文中描述血清白蛋白水平的术语

patterns.name: 数字或列表结构片段
patterns.context: 编号、列表、代码类型宽度或数值阈值中；触发作用不确定
patterns.domain: 网页元数据、代码与医学论文

en.description: Activations occur on in-word subword fragments across different texts, as well as near webpage line breaks and code-structure whitespace. Trigger meanings, languages, and styles are diverse, with no evidence that these phenomena are driven by the same semantic feature.

patterns.name: In-word tokenization or subword segmentation
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments inside words; some examples are English affixes or internal word fragments, while others are Chinese lexical fragments. Their specific meanings and contexts vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Web text, code, chat, and mixed Chinese-English text

patterns.name: Line breaks and item layout in web templates
patterns.context: Line-break markers occur densely in webpage-like titles, metadata, and body text; these examples alone do not establish that line breaks themselves cause the activation.

patterns.name: Code indentation and structural whitespace
patterns.context: In code or form-like content, activation falls near tabs, line breaks, and structured fields.

patterns.name: Isolated fragments with no clear semantic relation
patterns.context: Occurs across different words, languages, and contexts; apart from the surface feature of being subword fragments, consistent trigger conditions are difficult to infer.
patterns.domain: Web, code, IRC chat, and Chinese text

2_1818.description: 激活分布在多种文本中的词内子词片段，也出现在网页换行和代码结构空白附近；触发词义、语言与文体分散，尚无证据证明这些现象由同一语义特征驱动。

patterns.name: 词内分词或子词切分
patterns.trigger: «ibr»、«ating»、« Mon»、«itors»、« Mac»、« OS»、« F»、«avorite»、« DP»、« Sec»、«ure»、« Capt»、«iv»、« aroma»、«撸»
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的子词片段；部分例子是英语词缀或词中片段，另有中文词汇片段。具体词义和上下文差异较大。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、代码、聊天及中英文混合文本

patterns.name: 网页模板中的换行与条目布局
patterns.trigger: «↵»；如«↵»«↵»以及相邻标题、日期或评论数
patterns.context: 网页式标题、元数据和正文片段中，换行标记密集出现；单凭这些例子无法确认换行本身就是激活原因。

patterns.name: 代码缩进与结构性空白
patterns.context: 代码或类表单内容中，激活落在制表符、换行及结构化字段附近。

patterns.name: 无明显语义关联的孤立片段
patterns.context: 出现在不同词、语言和语境中；除词内片段这一表面特征外，难以归纳一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 网页、代码、IRC聊天及中文文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across the Favorite stem, English intra-word fragments, formatting boundaries, common short words, and a few numeric, identifier, and Khmer-script fragments. They span multiple genres, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Favorite stem and its segmentation
patterns.context: Favorite appears in a title or phrase describing favored content; some contexts show only the start of the word and what follows.

patterns.name: English suffixes segmented within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on morphemes or substrings inside English words, rather than at word beginnings; the words and meanings vary.
patterns.domain: Technical titles, code comments, and identifiers

patterns.name: Structural tokens such as markers and newlines
patterns.context: Activations occur at IRC message boundaries, between code/data lines, and in formatting structures such as indentation.

patterns.name: English function words or common short words
patterns.context: Occur sporadically in ordinary English titles or dialogue, with no stable semantic or syntactic environment.

patterns.name: Fragments adjacent to non-Latin text
patterns.context: Activations occur in field values or interface strings containing Khmer script, often embedded among unmarked Khmer text.

patterns.name: Numbers and number-adjacent fragments
patterns.context: A few numbers or numeric strings are marked in music reviews, titles, and code type declarations, with no shared semantic context.

patterns.name: Specific identifiers/word fragments
patterns.context: Occur in isolation within abbreviations, proper names, usernames, or code identifier fragments; insufficient evidence to determine a shared trigger condition.

2_1818.description: 激活分散在 Favorite 词干、英语词内片段、格式边界、常见短词及少量数字、标识符和高棉文字片段上；跨多种文体，未见单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: Favorite 词干及其分词
patterns.context: Favorite 位于标题或短语中，描述喜爱内容；部分上下文只呈现单词开头及后文。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、音乐/电影列表、问答

patterns.name: 词内切分的英语后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词内部的后续词素或子串，而非词首；所处单词和语义各异。
patterns.domain: 技术标题、代码注释与标识符

patterns.name: 标记与换行等结构 token
patterns.context: 激活出现在 IRC 发言边界、代码/数据行间及缩进等格式结构中。

patterns.name: 英语功能词或常见短词
patterns.context: 零散出现在普通英文标题或对话中，未显示稳定的语义或句法环境。

patterns.name: 紧邻非拉丁文字的片段
patterns.trigger: 高亮的“«ី»”“«ម»”“«ៅ»”等高棉文字片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在包含高棉文字的字段值或界面字符串中，常夹在未标记的高棉文字之间。
patterns.domain: Github 代码或本地化数据

patterns.name: 数字及数字邻接片段
patterns.context: 少量数字或数字串被标记，分别处于音乐评论、标题和代码类型声明中，没有共同语义场景。

patterns.name: 特定标识符/词片段
patterns.context: 孤立地落在缩写、专名、用户名或代码标识符片段中；不足以确定共同触发条件。

en.concept: Code file headers and structural markers
en.description: Activations occur mainly in code file headers: C/C++ preprocessor directives and quoted dependency paths are most prominent. Other examples include Ruby test headers, assembly comments, escaped-string tests, English webpage titles, and transaction/identifier text; the latter examples have no common trigger feature.

patterns.name: C/C++ preprocessor directives
patterns.context: At the top of a code file or module; commonly include guards, header references, and nearby line breaks

patterns.name: Quoted strings or paths in source code
patterns.context: When including dependencies, paths or module names are enclosed in double quotes; often adjacent to preprocessor directives or test file headers
patterns.domain: GitHub C/C++ and Ruby test code

patterns.name: Software documentation titles and webpage interface text
patterns.context: Ordinary English titles or webpage editing prompts, with triggers concentrated on words in the title and subsequent text

patterns.name: Author and project acknowledgments in code comments
patterns.context: Semicolon comments and copyright/acknowledgment text at the beginning of assembly source

patterns.name: Test and localization string fragments
patterns.context: Message strings testing escaped backslashes and their translation entries
patterns.domain: GitHub test code and localization files

patterns.name: Database transactions and identifiers
patterns.context: Configuration or data identifiers following a transaction start marker

patterns.name: Ruby test file header setup
patterns.context: Frozen-string comments, dependency loading, and test description blocks at the beginning of Ruby test files

2_1818.concept: 代码文件头部与结构标记
2_1818.description: 激活多见于代码文件头部：C/C++预处理指令与引号括起的依赖路径最突出；另见Ruby测试头、汇编注释、转义字符串测试、英文网页标题及事务/标识符文本，后几类缺少共同触发特征。

patterns.name: C/C++预处理指令
patterns.trigger: “#”“ifndef”“define”“include”，以及 include 后的引号路径
patterns.context: 代码文件头部或模块开头；常见为 include guard、头文件引用，附近可能有换行

patterns.name: 源码中的字符串或路径引号
patterns.trigger: include 后的 “"video_settings.h"”“"ace/Pair_T.h"”“"depthmarket.h"”“"nasm.h"”，以及 require 后的 “"rails_helper"”
patterns.context: 引入依赖时，路径或模块名被双引号括起；常与预处理指令或测试文件头部相邻
patterns.domain: GitHub C/C++ 与 Ruby 测试代码

patterns.name: 软件文档标题及网页界面文本
patterns.trigger: “Calibrating and Profiling Dual Monitors on Mac OS X Systems”及“Edit This Favorite”
patterns.context: 普通英文标题或网页编辑提示，触发集中在标题中的词及其后续文本
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 文档标题、网页文本

patterns.name: 代码注释中的作者与项目致意
patterns.context: 汇编源码开头的分号注释和版权/致意信息

patterns.name: 测试与本地化字符串片段
patterns.context: 测试转义反斜线的消息字符串及其翻译条目
patterns.domain: GitHub 测试代码与本地化文件

patterns.name: 数据库事务及标识符
patterns.context: 事务开始标记后接配置或数据标识符
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的技术/业务文本

patterns.name: Ruby 测试文件头部设置
patterns.context: Ruby 测试文件开头的冻结字符串注释、依赖加载和测试描述块

en.description: Activations occur in email bodies and headers, code directives and strings/identifiers, template markers, copyright comments, and legal titles. The main commonality is local fragments in structured text; no single stable semantic trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Page markers in HTML/templates
patterns.context: Occurs in indented template fragments containing tags, template control markers, or page links; activation falls on page text/tag fragments.

patterns.name: C/C++ preprocessor directives and headers
patterns.context: Include directives and header names in code lines; activation is concentrated near paths or filenames.

patterns.name: String, identifier, and comment fragments in code
