patterns.context: In code contexts, activation falls on string literals, comments, or underscore-separated identifiers/names; these examples have no apparent shared semantics.

patterns.name: Requests and forms of address in emails
patterns.context: Direct requests or statements addressed to the recipient in email bodies; paragraph 1 also contains email-format markers.

patterns.name: Email headers and date/time/address fields
patterns.context: Email metadata or email-header-like structured lines, including dates, times, names, addresses, and field labels.

patterns.name: Court heading in legal opinions
patterns.context: Centered heading and court name at the beginning of an opinion.

patterns.name: Copyright and project acknowledgment comments
patterns.context: Comment sections at the beginning of code files, containing copyright years and project acknowledgments.

2_1818.description: 激活分布于邮件正文与邮件头、代码指令和字符串/标识符、模板标记、版权注释及法律标题；共同点主要是结构化文本中的局部片段，未见单一稳定语义触发模式。

patterns.name: HTML/模板中的页面标记
patterns.context: 出现在缩进的模板片段中，包含标签、模板控制符或页面链接；激活落在页面文字/标签片段上。

patterns.name: C/C++ 预处理指令与头文件
patterns.context: 代码行中的 include 指令及其头文件名；激活集中在路径或文件名附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串、标识符及注释片段
patterns.trigger: `"intersect s1 and s2 took"`、`"s3.length = "`、`// sleep to let check memory consumption`、`KALI_SERVICE_NAME`、`kali`、`"dockersecplayground/hackbrowser`
patterns.context: 代码上下文中，激活落在字符串常量、注释或由下划线连接的标识符/名称上；这些例子间没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 邮件中的请求措辞与称谓
patterns.trigger: `Would you please look over`、`you`、`if you think`
patterns.context: 邮件正文中直接对收件人提出请求或表达判断；第1段还含邮件格式标记。

patterns.name: 邮件头与时间/地址字段
patterns.context: 邮件元数据或类似邮件头的结构化行，包括日期、时间、姓名、地址及字段标签。

patterns.name: 法律意见书的法院标题
patterns.context: 意见书开头的居中标题及法院名称。

patterns.name: 版权与项目致谢注释
patterns.trigger: `(C) Frank Klemm 1995, 2000`、`Dedicated to the LAME project`
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的注释区，包含版权年份和项目致谢。

en.description: Activations occur in emails, webpage titles and reviews, code, and copyright text. Visible cues include you, JetBrains, newcomers, and let check, but the other highlighted words and formats are distributed across domains, making it difficult to explain them with one stable pattern.

patterns.name: Second-person you
patterns.context: Appears in sentences, email requests, or URL text; sometimes immediately adjacent to modal verbs, verbs, or hyphenated phrases.

patterns.name: JetBrains name
patterns.context: The company name JetBrains follows a copyright notice; it appears repeatedly in the same excerpt.

patterns.name: Newcomers word ending
patterns.context: Occurs in a review about cross-disciplinary communication and helping newcomers read materials.

patterns.name: Verb after let
patterns.context: In a code comment, meaning to run a checker to observe memory consumption.

patterns.name: Lexical and formatting activations not summarized
patterns.context: These activations are distributed across emails, link titles, reviews, legal/archive descriptions, and code fragments, with no consistent local trigger condition.

2_1818.description: 激活分布于邮件、网页标题与评论、代码及版权文本；可见线索包括 you、JetBrains、newcomers 和 let check，但其余高亮词及格式跨域分散，难以由单一稳定模式解释。

patterns.name: 第二人称 you
patterns.context: 在句子、邮件请求或 URL 文字中出现 you；有时紧邻情态词、动词或连字符短语。

patterns.name: JetBrains 名称
patterns.context: 版权声明后跟公司名 JetBrains；同一片段重复出现。

patterns.name: 新手词尾
patterns.context: 出现在关于跨领域交流、帮助新人阅读资料的评论中。

patterns.name: let 后接动词
patterns.context: 代码注释中表示让检查程序运行，以观察内存消耗。

patterns.name: 未能归纳的词汇与格式激活
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在邮件、链接标题、评论、法律/档案说明及代码片段中，缺少一致的局部触发条件。

en.concept: Jet string and several common words
en.description: The most stable feature is strong activation on Jet, regardless of capitalization, and its proper-name and compound-word uses. Weaker activations also occur on lets, Buy in promotional contexts, and How in a few questions.

patterns.name: Jet substring
patterns.context: Capitalized as Jet, often appearing in brand names, product names, aviation/energy terms, or legal and astronomical proper names; the token immediately following Jet is the strongest activation position.
patterns.domain: Software, technology, aviation, astronomy, law, music, and other styles

patterns.name: lets
patterns.context: Used as a verb meaning to allow someone to do something; appears in product descriptions or email suggestions.

patterns.name: Buy
patterns.context: Appears in purchase promotions or descriptions of POS discount rules.
patterns.domain: Payment product descriptions, retail software Q&A

patterns.name: Question words and question phrasing
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of questions or in question phrasing; activation is weak and does not occur in every question.

2_1818.concept: Jet 字符串及若干常见词
2_1818.description: 最稳定的特征是对大小写 Jet 及其专名、复合词用法的强激活；另对 lets、促销语境中的 Buy，以及少数问句中的 How 有较弱激活。

patterns.name: Jet 子串
patterns.trigger: “Jet”后紧接或构成专名的一部分
patterns.context: 大小写为 Jet，常出现在品牌、产品名、航空/能源术语或法律与天文学专名中；紧随 Jet 的 token 是最强激活位置。
patterns.domain: 软件、科技、航空、天文、法律、音乐等多种文体

patterns.name: lets
patterns.context: 作为动词，表示允许、让某人做某事；出现在产品介绍或邮件建议中。

patterns.name: Buy
patterns.context: 出现在购买促销或 POS 折扣规则的表述中。
patterns.domain: 支付产品介绍、零售软件问答

patterns.name: 疑问词与问句措辞
patterns.context: 出现在问题开头或提问措辞中；激活较弱，且并非所有问句都有此表现。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the Swedish time-word stem tid and the cross-linguistic letter string or. There is also strong activation on Danish let in one instance. The latter two are cross-context and semantically diverse, suggesting subword matching rather than a unified concept.

patterns.name: Swedish time-word stem
patterns.context: Swedish words contain the substring tid, appearing in tidigare (earlier) and tidpunkt (point in time); activation falls on this stem fragment.

patterns.name: Letter string or
patterns.context: This substring appears in different contexts: the standalone English conjunction or in a mathematical statement, an internal letter string in Swedish territorium, and a final fragment in Swedish tror; no unified semantic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: StackExchange mathematics text, R code answers, and Swedish European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Danish let
patterns.context: Occurs in the Danish phrase “let forståelige oplysninger” (easily understandable information); this is the only example, making it difficult to determine a more general condition.

2_1818.description: 激活主要落在瑞典语“tid”时间词词干和跨语言字母串“or”上；另在一处丹麦语“let”上强激活。后两者跨语境且语义不一，像词片段匹配而非统一概念。

patterns.name: 瑞典语时间词词干
patterns.context: 瑞典语词中含有子串“tid”，分别出现在“tidigare”（更早）和“tidpunkt”（时间点）里；激活落在该词干片段上。

patterns.name: 字母串 or
patterns.context: 该子串出现在不同语境：英语数学表述中的独立连词“or”、瑞典语“territorium”中的内部字母串，以及瑞典语“tror”中的结尾片段；未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: StackExchange数学文本、R代码回答及欧洲议会瑞典语发言

patterns.name: 丹麦语 let
patterns.context: 出现在丹麦语短语“let forståelige oplysninger”（容易理解的信息）中；仅此一例，难以确定更一般的条件。

en.description: Activations often occur in get/get10 value expressions or “I get” derivation sentences in technical Q&A. Other examples involve code, errors, types, deployment, and authentication; no single specialized domain is evident.

patterns.name: get a variable or object value
patterns.context: get is followed by an object such as a variable, coordinate, field, or result; in code or technical explanations it means to retrieve a value, often adjacent to identifiers such as getXval, getYval, and getNext.

patterns.name: Numeric formatting and decimal places
patterns.context: Formatting a Double value as a string with two decimal places.

patterns.name: Pandas mixed types and object
patterns.context: Explains that a column or row containing values of different types results in the object type.

patterns.name: DataFrame schema error
patterns.context: Reports a TypeError after constructing a Spark DataFrame.

patterns.name: Maya API and command modules
patterns.context: Compares classes or commands available after importing or using the Maya command interface versus the API.

patterns.name: Azure VM deployment failure
patterns.context: A deployment failure response appears after creating or configuring a cloud instance via the command line.

patterns.name: get in algebraic derivations
patterns.context: Introduces an equation derived from preceding relations in a mathematical proof.

patterns.name: Unexpected index value
patterns.context: After a Java method updates an index, the questioner reports that the value read is always 0.

patterns.name: Login and authentication flow
patterns.context: Describes a flow involving a login page, username and password, and authentication results.

patterns.name: MATLAB image callback and coordinates
patterns.context: Reads the parent object and current point on the axes in an image-click callback.

2_1818.description: 激活多出现在技术问答中的 get/get10 取值表达式或“I get”推导句；其余涉及代码、错误、类型、部署和认证等多种编程语境，未见统一专门领域。

patterns.name: get 变量或对象值
patterns.context: get 后接变量、坐标、字段或结果等对象；在代码或技术说明中表示获取值，常与 getXval、getYval、getNext 等标识符相邻。

patterns.name: 数值格式与小数位
patterns.context: 格式化 Double 数值为保留两位小数的字符串。

patterns.name: Pandas 混合类型与 object
patterns.context: 解释列或行包含不同类型值时产生 object 类型。

patterns.name: DataFrame schema 错误
patterns.context: 构造 Spark DataFrame 后报告 TypeError。

patterns.name: Maya API 与命令模块
patterns.context: 比较导入或使用 Maya 命令接口与 API 后可见的类或命令。

patterns.name: Azure VM 部署失败
patterns.context: 命令行创建或配置云实例后出现部署失败响应。

patterns.name: 代数推导中的 get
patterns.context: 数学证明中引出由前述关系推出的等式。

patterns.name: 索引值异常
patterns.context: Java 方法更新索引后，提问者报告读到的值始终为 0。

patterns.name: 登录与认证流程
patterns.context: 描述登录页面、用户名密码和认证结果的流程。

patterns.name: MATLAB 图像回调与坐标
patterns.context: 图像点击回调中读取父对象和坐标轴当前点。

en.description: Primarily activates on the phrase “I get” in StackExchange posts reporting results or errors from running code; also occurs in code method calls to get and VBA’s “On Error Resume Next.” These uses are superficially related through get/error handling, but their trigger forms are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: “get” followed by a diagnostic result
patterns.context: First-person descriptions of a value, error, or exception obtained after running code, performing a query, or constructing something; “get” is often marked, and the surrounding I/get may also be marked.

patterns.name: get call in code
patterns.context: A call to a function or method named get in code, followed by arguments such as an object or property; distinct from the English phrase “I get.”

patterns.name: On Error Resume Next
patterns.context: An error-handling statement in VBA macro code; activation is concentrated on the latter part of this fixed statement.

2_1818.description: 主要激活于 StackExchange 中第一人称报告运行结果或错误的短语“I get”，也见于代码方法调用 get，以及 VBA 的“On Error Resume Next”；这些用法表面上都有 get/错误处理，但触发形式并不完全一致。

patterns.name: “get”后接诊断结果
patterns.context: 第一人称描述代码运行、查询或构造操作后得到的值、错误或异常；“get”常被标记，周围的 I/get 也可能被标记。

patterns.name: 代码中的 get 调用
patterns.context: 代码中调用名为 get 的函数或方法，后接对象、属性等参数；不同于英语短语“I get”。

patterns.name: On Error Resume Next
patterns.context: VBA 宏代码中的错误处理语句，激活集中在该固定语句的末尾部分。

en.description: Most fragments activate on pay, across collocations such as pay attention, paying fees, and pay off; there are also two isolated patterns, and in a code identifier and get in a programming question.

patterns.name: Phrase contexts preceding pay
patterns.context: Activation falls on pay; often followed by off, attention, whatever, a little more, monthly, or bitcoin. The preceding text expresses spending, payment, attention, or expectation of a result.
patterns.domain: Web text, Q&A, sports commentary, scam descriptions, and product discussions

patterns.name: Pay forming the phrasal verb pay off
patterns.context: pay is followed by off, meaning that effort, an advantage, or preparation eventually yields a reward; in paragraph 9, the phrase also conveys uncertainty.
patterns.domain: Sports commentary and narrative web text

patterns.name: Collocation pay attention
patterns.context: pay is directly followed by attention, meaning to notice something or pay heed to information.

patterns.name: Payment-related pay
patterns.context: pay means to pay money or cover a cost; its complements specify the amount, method, or recipient of payment.
patterns.domain: Sports commentary, consumer advice, business service discussions, online scam descriptions

patterns.name: and in a variable name
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in the code identifier utm_zone_and_hemisphere_from; and is part of a compound variable name, not a natural-language conjunction.

patterns.name: Parameter name get
patterns.context: In a question about the function parameter na.rm=TRUE, get means to obtain or encounter that parameter; no pay collocation is present.

2_1818.description: 多数片段在 pay 一词上激活，涵盖 pay attention、支付费用及 pay off 等搭配；另有代码标识符中的 and 和编程问答里的 get 两个孤立模式。

patterns.name: pay 前的短语语境
patterns.context: 激活落在 pay；多见于 pay 后接 off、attention、whatever、a little more、monthly 或 bitcoin 等不同补语，前文表示付出、支付、注意或期待结果。
patterns.domain: 网页正文、问答、体育评论、诈骗描述及产品讨论

patterns.name: pay 与 off 构成短语动词
patterns.context: pay 后接 off，表示努力、优势或准备最终得到回报；第9段该短语还带有不确定语气。
patterns.domain: 体育评论及叙述性网页文本

patterns.name: pay attention 搭配
patterns.context: pay 后直接接 attention，表示留意某项内容或信息。
patterns.domain: 网页设计建议、问答叙述

patterns.name: 支付类 pay
patterns.trigger: «pay»10 whatever it takes；«pay»10 a little more；«pay»10 monthly；«pay»10 bitcoin
patterns.context: pay 表示付钱或承担费用，补语分别说明金额、方式或支付对象。
patterns.domain: 体育评论、消费建议、商业服务讨论、网络诈骗描述

patterns.name: 变量名中的 and
patterns.context: 触发位置在代码标识符 utm_zone_and_hemisphere_from 中，and 是复合变量名的一部分，并非自然语言连接词。

patterns.name: 参数名 get
patterns.context: 在询问函数参数 na.rm=TRUE 的情况下，get 表示取得或遇到该参数；未见 pay 搭配。

en.description: Primarily responds to pay (including pay attention, pay monthly, pay for), and also activates on tarnish/tarnished and and in the code identifier find_one_and_update; no visible corresponding pattern is present in segment 9.

patterns.name: Payment-related expressions
patterns.context: pay followed by complements such as attention, monthly, or for the service; appears in several different sentence constructions.

patterns.name: Contaminated/tarnished reputation
patterns.context: Discusses damaging a person’s reputation or tarnishing the United Nations flag; an inflection marker occurs within the word.

patterns.name: and in Python/MongoDB update code

en.description: Activations are scattered across substrings within multiple words: split fragments of tarnish, treat, pay, ly in terms such as glycoprotein, and and in code identifiers. Contexts involve reputational harm, treatment/analysis, payment, biomedicine, and programming, respectively.

patterns.name: Segmentation/stem fragments of tarnish

2_1818.description: 激活分散于多个词内的子串：tarnish 的拆分片段、treat、pay、glycoprotein 类术语中的 ly，以及代码标识符中的 and；上下文分别涉及声誉损害、处理/分析、付费、生物医学和编程。

patterns.name: tarnish 的分词/词干片段

patterns.name: treat 及其屈折形式

patterns.name: glycoprotein 的内部片段

patterns.name: and 的代码标识符片段
patterns.context: 作为函数名 find_one_and_update 中的 and 子串，处于 MongoDB/Python 代码标识符内部。

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on the segmented word-form fragment t…arnish; there are also isolated or sparse responses to find, recommend, knew, and and within code identifiers, as well as sentence-initial Tackling. These span multiple genres, with no unified semantic condition observed.

patterns.name: Rare word fragment t…arnish
patterns.context: Activation falls within segmented words: segments 4 and 9 contain tarnish(ed) (damage someone’s reputation), segment 1 contains tarnish, and segment 6 occurs in “tarn o'shanter,” possibly reflecting a different word form or erroneous tokenization.
patterns.domain: Social media comments, political discourse, fiction, and news reporting

patterns.name: find
patterns.context: Occurs in “I find myself …,” expressing the speaker’s discovery that they are in a certain emotional state.

patterns.name: re-commend
patterns.context: Occurs in the imperative “I recommend …,” recommending books to readers.

patterns.name: knew
patterns.context: The past-tense verb knew; segment 5 is “I knew it” in dialogue, and segment 10 is a commenter emphasizing that they had recognized a name long before.

patterns.name: and
patterns.context: Occurs inside the code identifier find_one_and_update, rather than as a conjunction in ordinary syntax.

patterns.name: tackling
patterns.context: Sentence-initial present participle referring to the research task of addressing differences between training and test distributions.

2_1818.description: 激活最稳定地落在被切分的 t…arnish 词形片段上；另对 find、recommend、knew、代码标识符中的 and、句首 Tackling 有孤立或少量响应，跨越多种文体，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 罕见词片段 t…arnish
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的单词中；段 4、9 是 tarnish(ed)（损害名誉），段 1 是 tarnish，段 6 出现于 “tarn o'shanter” 中，可能是不同的词形或分词误切。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体评论、政治论述、小说叙述及新闻报道

patterns.name: find
patterns.context: 出现在 “I find myself …” 中，表达说话者发现自己处于某种情绪状态。

patterns.name: re-commend
patterns.context: 出现在给读者推荐书籍的祈使句 “I recommend …” 中。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论及影评/电影讨论

patterns.name: knew
patterns.context: 作为过去式动词 knew；段 5 是对话中 “I knew it”，段 10 是评论者强调自己早已认出某个名字。

patterns.name: and
patterns.context: 出现在代码标识符 find_one_and_update 内部，而非普通句法中的连词。

patterns.name: tackling
patterns.context: 句首现在分词，指应对训练与测试分布差异这一研究任务。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on subword fragments within words across languages: English tarnish, Srsly, recommend, Tackling, track, and Supply, as well as re/tre in Romanian words. The meanings and contexts of the triggered words vary, with no unified semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Intra-word subword fragment in English tarnish
patterns.context: The fragment spans subwords within tarnish; the sentence discusses a social media post damaging someone’s reputation.

patterns.name: Intra-word subword fragment in English Srsly
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the colloquial abbreviation Srsly; the same word also appears in a code identifier.

patterns.name: re subword fragment in the English word recommend
patterns.context: Appears as the initial subword in recommend; the sentence recommends reading about film grammar.
patterns.domain: English film reviews or film discussions

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in English Tackling
patterns.context: Forms the initial word Tackling, referring to addressing distributional differences and extrapolation.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in English track
patterns.context: Appears in track developing patterns, meaning to monitor patterns that develop over time.

patterns.name: Final subword in English supply
patterns.context: Appears in Supply in Supply Chain Improvement.

patterns.name: Romanian word fragments with diacritics
patterns.context: Activations fall on intra-word subword fragments in Romanian words such as oprire, întrevederi, and întreaga; they recur across multiple parliamentary texts.

2_1818.description: 强激活多落在跨语言词内的子词片段：英语 tarnish、Srsly、recommend、Tackling、track、Supply，以及罗马尼亚语多词中的 re/tre；触发词义和语境各异，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 英语词内的 tarnish 子词片段
patterns.context: 片段横跨词内子词，组成 tarnish；所在句谈社交媒体发帖损害个人声誉。

patterns.name: 英语词内的 Srsly 子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在口语缩写 Srsly 的词尾；同一词也出现在代码标识符中。

patterns.name: 英语推荐词内的 re 子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在 recommend 的词首子词；句子是在推荐电影语法相关读物。

patterns.name: 英语 Tackling 词内片段
patterns.context: 组成句首的 Tackling，指着手处理分布差异与外推问题。

patterns.name: 英语 track 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 track developing patterns 中，表示追踪随时间发展的模式。

patterns.name: 英语 supply 词尾子词
patterns.context: 出现在 Supply Chain Improvement 的 Supply 中。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语重音词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在罗马尼亚语词内子词片段，如 oprire、întrevederi、întreaga；在多个议会文本中反复出现。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语欧洲议会发言

en.description: Strong activation positions are scattered across different contexts and word forms. Most involve ly or nearby character fragments, but raw_text and Tackling also occur; there is no stable semantic, topical, or stylistic condition, and the pattern may relate to tokenization fragments.

patterns.name: Intra-word ly string
patterns.context: Activation often falls on word-final or internally segmented fragments, across widely varying forms and meanings. It is unclear whether the neuron consistently responds to the letter sequence or is merely sensitive to specific token boundaries or contexts.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, code, and proper nouns

patterns.name: raw_text variable in code
patterns.context: In a Python-style conditional, the variable raw_text is followed by is not None; nearby ly activation occurs in the preceding code fragment srsly.read_jsonl.

patterns.name: Word-final ly in English contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in the colloquial adverb Srsly, a phrase about wordplay in a book review, and forum slang; these examples show no clear unified semantics.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: The fragment is embedded in a server name, music group name, personal name, or place name; these are not the same type of proper noun or a shared topic.
patterns.domain: Java documentation, music descriptions, sports reporting, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: ly string in ordinary words
patterns.context: Activation falls on unrelated ordinary words or spelling fragments, including Ayiti, srsly, and Tackling, and cannot be explained by a unified meaning or context.
patterns.domain: Agriculture headlines, code, academic papers, music descriptions

2_1818.concept: 词内字符片段（疑似 ly）
2_1818.description: 强激活位置分散在不同语境与词形中，多数涉及 ly 或其邻近字符片段，但也见于 raw_text、Tackling 等；没有稳定的语义、主题或文体条件，可能与分词片段有关。

patterns.name: 词内 ly 字符串
patterns.trigger: 分散的词段 «ly»10、«ly»9、«ly»8，及 «s»1«ly»9、«s»1«ly»8；另有 «'»1Ayiti 中的字符片段
patterns.context: 激活位置多落在词尾或被分词切开的内部片段，词形与语义差别很大；不能确定神经元是否稳定响应字母序列，或只是对特定分词边界/上下文敏感
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言、代码与专名

patterns.name: 代码中的 raw_text 变量

patterns.name: 英语语境中的词尾 ly

patterns.name: 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 片段嵌在服务器名称、音乐组合名、人名或地名中；并非同一种专名或共同主题

patterns.name: 普通词中的 ly 字母串
patterns.context: 激活落在不相关的普通词或拼写片段中，包括 Ayiti、srsly、Tackling 等，无法由统一词义或语境解释

en.description: In most segments, activations fall on the ly/-sly character sequence, often at word endings or within proper names, across body text, code, and academic writing; the independent character activation in segment 9 cannot be clearly linked to this pattern.

patterns.name: English word-final -sly
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the ly substring forming or spelling -sly, common in adverbial endings but possibly just part of a longer word or proper name; the beginning of the same word is often unmarked.
patterns.domain: English body text, titles, and code in mixed corpora

patterns.name: Character fragments in non-English or corrupted text
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur in Italian-like text or text that appears corrupted or irregularly segmented, with no clear word-final -sly pattern.

2_1818.concept: 英语 ly/-sly 词尾片段
2_1818.description: 多数段落激活落在 ly/-sly 字符片段上，常处于词尾或专名内部，跨正文、代码和学术文本；第9段的独立字符激活无法与此模式明确对应。

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -sly
patterns.context: 激活集中在构成或拼出 -sly 的 ly 子串，常见于副词尾缀，也可能只是更长词或专名的一部分；同一词的前部多未标记。

patterns.name: 非英语或损坏文本中的字符片段
patterns.context: 零散激活于意大利语样式文本或疑似损坏、分词异常的文本，未见清楚的 -sly 词尾模式。

en.description: All segments highlight character fragments containing `ly`, often in the form `sly` preceded by `s`, though they also occur across word boundaries or within words. Meanings, capitalization, domains, and contexts vary widely, with no stable semantic condition observed.

patterns.name: Letter sequence s-ly / sly
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the letter sequence `ly`, often adjacent to a preceding `s` or forming a cross-word fragment; capitalization, word boundaries, and following characters vary. The words and syntactic positions differ, with no specific semantic requirement.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, marketing copy, fantasy Q&A, papers, forums, code, supply-chain headlines, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Possible secondary word-form associations
patterns.context: Some activations fall within complete English words or internal word fragments, possibly corresponding to `imply`, `supply`, or the abbreviation/name `Sly` in a paper; however, all contain the letter sequence `ly`, and evidence is insufficient to confirm independent semantic or syntactic triggers.

2_1818.concept: 字符片段 ly（常见于 sly）
2_1818.description: 所有段都突出含 `ly` 的字符片段，常见形式为前接 s 的 `sly`，也有跨词或词内出现。词义、大小写、领域和上下文差异很大，未见稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 含字母序列 s-ly / sly
patterns.context: 激活集中在字母序列 `ly`，常与前面的 `s` 相邻或构成跨词片段；大小写、词边界和后续字符不固定。所处词语和句法位置各异，并不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: 跨百科、营销文案、奇幻问答、论文、论坛、代码、供应链标题、体育报道等多种文体

patterns.name: 可能的次要词形关联
patterns.trigger: `What« Do»2`、`Ambulatory ... Imp«ly»10`（[2]）；`« Supp»1«ly»9 Chain`（[7]）；`« the»1 S«ly»9 and HSF2`（[4]）
patterns.context: 部分激活落在完整英语词或词内片段中，分别可能对应 `imply`、`supply` 或论文中的缩写/名称 `Sly`；但都同时包含 `ly` 字母序列，证据不足以确认独立的语义或句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 营销文案、标题、学术摘要

en.description: The most stable signal is the letter sequence ly within or at the end of words, occurring in adverbs, proper names, gene names, and technical names. There are also scattered activations on words and code-comment markers, with no unified condition.

patterns.name: Intra-word ly sequence
patterns.context: Activations mainly fall on the letter sequence ly within words, rather than on a stable complete word; surrounding word forms vary and often include proper names, common nouns, or adverbs.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including fiction discussions, music listings, biomedicine, code, forums, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Standalone word-final ly
patterns.context: Appears at the end of or within words such as likely, singly, and Sly; singly occurs in contrastive contexts such as in combination and in interaction, but the other examples do not require that context.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, market analysis, popular culture, and online slang

patterns.name: Entities or names containing ly
patterns.context: The activated ly is internal to a person’s name, institution name, gene name, or technical name, with no shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Fiction, music, biomedicine, and software documentation

patterns.name: Scattered activations beyond ly
patterns.context: These markers occur in different syntactic positions and have no obvious shared trigger condition; they cannot be fully explained by the ly pattern.
patterns.domain: Marketing copy, research abstracts, technical text, forums, and news reports

patterns.name: Code comment formatting
patterns.context: In Java-style class documentation comments, low-intensity activations occur near newlines, comment boundaries, and version numbers; these coexist with ly activations in the same segment.

2_1818.description: 最稳定的信号是词内或词尾的 ly 字母序列，出现在副词、专名、基因名及技术名中；另有分散的词语与代码注释标记激活，缺乏统一条件。

patterns.name: 词内 ly 序列
patterns.context: 激活主要落在单词内部的字母序列 ly，而非一个稳定的完整词；周围词形各异，常见于专名、普通名词或副词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；包括小说讨论、音乐条目、生物医学、代码、论坛和体育报道

patterns.name: 单独的 ly 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 likely、singly、Sly 等词的末尾或词内；其中 singly 前后有 in combination、in interaction 等对照语境，但其它例子并不要求该语境。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、市场分析、流行文化及网络口语

patterns.name: 包含 ly 的实体或名称
patterns.context: 激活的 ly 位于人名、学院名、基因名称或技术名称的内部，不依赖共同语义。
patterns.domain: 小说、音乐、生物医学和软件文档

patterns.name: ly 之外的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些标记分布在不同句法位置，彼此没有明显共享的触发条件；不能由 ly 模式充分解释。
patterns.domain: 市场文案、研究摘要、技术文本、论坛及新闻报道

patterns.name: 代码注释格式
patterns.context: 在 Java 风格类文档注释中，换行、注释边界和版本号附近出现低强度激活；与同段的 ly 激活并存。
patterns.domain: 软件源码与 API 文档

en.concept: No single concept: multiple patterns including address and singly
en.description: Activation concentrates in two types of academic expression: address when introducing a problem or goal, and singly when indicating that something is examined separately. There are also the word-internal fragment Slytherin, gather, and Do in a headline, in unrelated contexts that cannot be grouped with the first two patterns.

patterns.name: Problem/goal-introducing use of address
patterns.context: Research or discourse first presents a question, goal, or hypothesis, then uses address to introduce how it will be handled; in [2], address is followed by the hypothesis, and in [4][5][9] it appears in To address.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, research proposals, and project descriptions

patterns.name: Separately (singly)
patterns.context: Occurs when explaining that variables, factors, or genes can be examined separately or combined/interacted with other factors; [6][8][10] explicitly contrast it with interaction, combination, or in combination.
patterns.domain: Academic research on social contexts, gene regulation, or genetics

patterns.name: Tokenization fragment in Slytherin
patterns.context: The proper noun Slytherin is segmented in a fantasy-novel-related Q&A; activation falls on the “ly” fragment within it.

patterns.name: Tokenization fragment in gather
patterns.context: In a context about the EPA collecting information on economic damage, activation falls on an internal fragment of gather.
patterns.domain: Economic and regulatory policy news or explanatory text

patterns.name: Other fragments containing question words
patterns.context: In the headline-style question “What Do … Imply?”, activation falls on Do; it has no clear connection to the address-problem or singly contexts in the other segments.

2_1818.concept: 无单一概念：address 与 singly 等多类模式
2_1818.description: 激活集中在两类学术表达：提出问题或目标时用 address，以及用 singly 表示分别考察。另有词内片段 Slytherin、gather 和标题中的 Do，语境各异，无法归并到前两类。

patterns.name: address 的问题/目标引出用法
patterns.context: 研究或论述先提出问题、目标或假设，随后用 address 引出处理方式；[2] 中 address 后接 the hypothesis，[4][5][9] 中为 To address。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、研究计划及项目说明

patterns.name: 单独或分别地（singly）
patterns.context: 出现在说明变量、因素或基因可分别考察、也可与其他因素组合或交互的语境中；[6][8][10] 明确对照 interaction、combination 或 in combination。
patterns.domain: 学术研究，涉及社会情境、基因调控或遗传学

patterns.name: Slytherin 的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名 Slytherin 在奇幻小说相关问答中被拆分；激活落在其中的 “ly” 片段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、哈利·波特话题

patterns.name: gather 的分词片段
patterns.context: EPA 收集经济损害信息的语境；激活落在 gather 的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 经济与监管政策新闻或说明

patterns.name: 含疑问词的其他片段
patterns.context: 标题式问题 “What Do … Imply?” 中，激活落在 Do；与其他段的地址问题或 singly 语境没有明确联系。

en.concept: Sensitive to the ly character sequence
en.description: Most strong activations fall on the letter sequence ly, often within words but sometimes across word boundaries; text domains and semantics vary widely. The strong activation in segment 9 falls on ather in gather and cannot be explained by the ly pattern.

patterns.name: ly substring and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the letter sequence ly; sometimes part of a word (e.g., Slytherin, Sly, imply, sly), sometimes at a word boundary or in nonstandard segmentation. Segment 9’s «ather»9 does not fit this pattern.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, including fiction Q&A, music, forums, code, medical papers, market analysis, and filenames

patterns.name: Other local tokens
patterns.context: Most strong activations can still be explained by the ly character sequence in the segment; the strong activation in segment 9 falls on ather in gather, and the available samples do not establish its separate trigger condition. Other marked tokens are weaker and scattered across different syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Agricultural policy texts and other cross-domain texts

2_1818.concept: 对 ly 字符序列敏感
2_1818.description: 多数强激活落在 ly 字母序列上，常处于词内，也可跨词边界；文本领域和语义差异很大。段9的强激活在 gather 的 ather，无法由 ly 模式解释。

patterns.name: ly 子串及词内片段
patterns.trigger: «ly»10（段 1–7）和 «ly»9（段 8、10）；另有 «ly»10 跨词边界，如 «ly»10broadcast、S«ly»10 and
patterns.context: 激活集中在字母序列 ly；有时是词内的一部分（如 Slytherin、Sly、imply、sly），有时落在词边界处或非标准切分中。段 9 的 «ather»9 不符合此模式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；涉及小说问答、音乐、论坛、代码、医学论文、市场分析和文件名等

patterns.name: 其他局部 token
patterns.trigger: «ather»9（g«ather» information，段 9）；以及较弱激活的«曾标记词»，如 «created»、«try»、«played»、«handle»、«refer»、«fine»
patterns.context: 强激活大多仍可由片段中的 ly 字符序列解释；段 9 的强激活落在 gather 的 ather，现有样本难以确定其单独触发条件。其余标记 token 强度较弱、分散于不同句法位置。
patterns.domain: 农业政策文本及其他多领域文本

en.description: Primarily responds to research goals or problems introduced by “To address” in scientific text. There are also isolated activations: “Imply” in a business headline, Swedish “vis,” and Hungarian “ó,” with no common semantic explanation yet.

patterns.name: “To address” introducing a research goal or question
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning or within a sentence, followed by research goals, an issue, a hypothesis, aims, issues, or gaps; it typically continues by explaining how the research will be conducted.

patterns.name: “imply” in English business copy
patterns.context: The word-final “ly” in the headline question “What Do … Services Imply?” is strongly activated; the same segment also includes content on market size and growth rates.

patterns.name: “vis” in Swedish
patterns.context: Embedded in the conditional structure “om … ska …,” expressing that coordination and integration are necessary for effectiveness; activation falls on a Swedish word fragment.

patterns.name: “ó” in Hungarian
patterns.context: A word-final fragment in “folyó vitába” (ongoing debate), surrounded by a polite interjection in parliamentary debate.

2_1818.description: 主要响应科研文本中“To address”引出的研究目的或待解决问题；另有孤立激活：商业标题中的“Imply”、瑞典语“vis”和匈牙利语“ó”，尚无共同语义解释。

patterns.name: “To address”引出研究目标或问题
patterns.context: 出现在句首或句中，后接研究的 goals、issue、hypothesis、aims、issues 或 gaps；通常继续说明研究将如何开展。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划、科研论文

patterns.name: 英语商务文案中的“imply”
patterns.context: 标题问题“What Do … Services Imply?”中的动词词尾“ly”被强激活；同段还有市场规模和增长率等内容。

patterns.name: 瑞典语中的“vis”
patterns.context: 嵌在“om … ska …”条件结构中，表达若要有效就必须协调整合；激活落在瑞典语词片段上。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语中的“ó”
patterns.context: 出现在“folyó vitába”（正在进行的辩论）中的词尾片段，周围是对议会辩论的礼貌插话。

en.description: The most prominent reproducible patterns are sentence-initial “address” in scientific texts, the Danish conditional word “hvis,” and several isolated word forms and function-word fragments. These activations are dispersed across languages and genres, with no shared semantic or grammatical feature.

patterns.name: address substring
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a sentence or clause, followed by an infinitive or a statement of purpose, such as “the aims” or “the goals”; not dependent on a specific corpus topic.

patterns.name: English -ack word forms
patterns.context: An English word contains ack/acking in a context involving punishment, blame, or descriptions of behavior; the two word forms are not identical.

patterns.name: Danish conditional construction
patterns.context: “hvis” functions as a conditional conjunction within a sentence, introducing a conditional clause.

patterns.name: French y a construction
patterns.context: The French existential construction “il y a” occurs within a clause such as “c'est qu'il y a...”.

patterns.name: English forms of be
patterns.context: A modal verb or other construction is followed by be, as in “could be” and “should be”; the strong activation is on be.

patterns.name: English preference verbs
patterns.context: Describes preferences and opinions about electricity procurement arrangements; activation markers are dispersed across related sentences, with no single shared trigger word.

patterns.name: Philosophical semantic terminology
patterns.context: Discusses how to treat objects of belief in “treat objects of 'believe'”; the context includes terms such as possible worlds and infinitives.

patterns.name: Spanish function name
patterns.context: Provides code-naming advice, using “en vez de Leer()” to mean “instead of”; surrounded by Spanish code explanations.

patterns.name: English name fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial fragment of the name Sowdhamini, with no clear semantic or syntactic trigger.

2_1818.description: 最显著的可复现模式是科研文本中句首的“address”，丹麦语条件词“hvis”及若干孤立词形、功能词片段；这些激活跨语言、文体分散，缺少统一语义或语法特征。

patterns.name: address 子串
patterns.context: 出现在句首或分句开头，后接不定式或目的说明，如“the aims”“the goals”；不依赖特定语料主题。

patterns.name: 英语 -ack 词形
patterns.context: 英语词中包含 ack/acking，语境涉及惩罚、指责或行为描述；两例词形并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 丹麦语条件结构
patterns.context: “hvis”作为条件连词，置于句中引出条件从句。

patterns.name: 法语 y a 结构
patterns.context: 法语“il y a”存在句，嵌在“c'est qu'il y a...”一类从句中。

patterns.name: 英语 be 动词形式
patterns.context: 情态动词或其他结构后接 be，分别见“could be”和“should be”；强激活落在 be。

patterns.name: 英语偏好动词
patterns.context: 描述对电力采购安排的偏好与看法；激活标记分散在相关句中，未见共同的单一触发词。

patterns.name: 哲学语义术语
patterns.context: “treat objects of 'believe'”中讨论如何处理信念对象；上下文含 possible worlds、infinitives 等术语。

patterns.name: 西班牙语函数名
patterns.context: 给出代码命名建议，在“en vez de Leer()”中表示“而不是”；周围有西班牙语代码说明。

patterns.name: 英语人名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名 Sowdhamini 的词首片段，未见明确的语义或句法触发条件。

en.description: Activation is scattered across multilingual subword fragments: Swedish Tack, Danish fragments, Portuguese têm, and the English Supposedly, game-title numbers, and whack word family. No single stable semantic or syntactic function is observed.

patterns.name: Portuguese verb ending têm
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on a stem/ending fragment in the Portuguese word form têm; the surrounding text is parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Tack in Swedish parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Tack occurs after a speaker addresses someone or expresses thanks in Swedish parliamentary speech; the trigger falls within the word.

patterns.name: Danish intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within several ordinary words are activated in Danish parliamentary speech, with no unified meaning or syntactic role observed.

patterns.name: English Supposedly
patterns.context: English wording equivalent to allegedly/supposedly; one example concerns a family-history account and another a hardware problem description.

patterns.name: Swedish reflexive/morphological fragments
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary speech, word-internal segments occur within adjective or adverb forms, with local contexts involving evaluation or opposition.

patterns.name: English game titles and numbers
patterns.context: Game names include titles and numbers such as Doom 3 and Unreal Tournament 3; activation falls on both title fragments and nearby numbers.

patterns.name: English whack word family
patterns.context: In discussions of power in energy markets, whack/whacks/jacking and other similarly spelled words recur; activation concentrates on internal word fragments.

2_1818.description: 激活分散于多语种词内子词片段：瑞典语 Tack、丹麦语片段、葡语 têm，以及英语 Supposedly、游戏标题数字和 whack 词族；未见单一稳定语义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语动词词尾 têm
patterns.context: 激活集中在葡语词形 têm 中的词干/词尾片段；周围是议会发言正文。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会发言中的 Tack
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中，发言人称呼或致谢之后出现 Tack；触发落在词内部。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内片段
patterns.context: 丹麦语议会发言中，若干普通词的词内子词片段激活，未见统一词义或句法角色。

patterns.name: 英语 Supposedly
patterns.context: 英语句中 allegedly/supposedly 类表述；一个为家族史转述，一个为硬件问题说明。

patterns.name: 瑞典语反身/形态片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中，词内分段落在形容词或副词形态中，且局部语境涉及评价或对抗。

patterns.name: 英语游戏标题与数字
patterns.context: 游戏名称中出现 Doom 3、Unreal Tournament 3 等标题及数字；激活同时落在标题片段和数字附近。

patterns.name: 英语 whack 词族
patterns.context: 讨论能源市场权力时，反复出现 whack/whacks/jacking 等拼写相近词；触发集中在词内片段。

en.description: Activations are triggered by varied local word forms: Swedish parliamentary thanks, English Supposedly, a place name containing Ustyug, philosophical semantic terminology, Spanish programming explanations, and biomedical gene names. These contexts have no shared theme.

patterns.name: Swedish parliamentary expressions of thanks
patterns.context: In Swedish European Parliament speeches, the speaker thanks the president, a member, or the Council; often appears in forms of address or at a handover between speaking turns.

patterns.name: English Supposedly
patterns.context: Introduces a rumor, speculation, or unverified claim in an English sentence, followed by a comma or noun phrase.

patterns.name: Discussion of English infinitival complements
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of English expressions of volition, complement forms, and possible-world semantics.

patterns.name: English population and geography entries
patterns.context: A substring in the place names Velikoustyugsky / Veliky Ustyug, within descriptions of Russian settlements, administrative divisions, or geographic information.

patterns.name: Spanish code explanation
patterns.context: Explains a programming error in Spanish, stating that a code statement outside a loop results in including only the final value.

patterns.name: PubMed molecular and reproductive medicine narrative
patterns.context: Reports sperm counts, abnormality rates, and changes in gene mRNA expression in a NaF dose experiment; activation falls on a gene-name fragment.

2_1818.description: 激活由多种局部词形触发：瑞典语议会致谢、英语 Supposedly、含 Ustyug 的地名、哲学语义术语、西班牙语编程解释及生物医学基因名；这些上下文缺乏统一主题。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会致谢用语
patterns.trigger: «T»1«ack»10；«ack»10,« her»1«r»2；T«ack»10 för dina« väl»3kom«n»1ande ord；T«ack»10« till»2
patterns.context: 瑞典语欧洲议会发言中，发言者向主席、委员或理事会致谢；常出现在称谓或发言轮次交接处。

patterns.name: 英语 Supposedly
patterns.context: 英语句中以“Supposedly”引入传闻、推测或未经证实的说法，后接逗号或名词短语。

patterns.name: 英语不定式补语讨论
patterns.trigger: « comp»1lements；infinitives« pick»3 out sets« of»3 possible worlds
patterns.context: 讨论英语意愿描述、补语形式及可能世界语义时出现。

patterns.name: 英语人口与地理条目
patterns.context: 地名 Velikoustyugsky / Veliky Ustyug 中的子串，置于俄罗斯聚居地、区划或地理信息描述中。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地理条目

patterns.name: 西班牙语代码解释
patterns.context: 用西班牙语解释程序错误，说明代码语句位于循环之外导致只包含最后一个值。

patterns.name: PubMed分子与生殖医学叙述
patterns.context: NaF剂量实验中报告精子数量、畸形率及基因mRNA表达变化；激活落在基因名片段。

en.description: Activations are dispersed across languages and parts of speech: English supposedly and finally, Spanish verb endings and internal fragments, Swedish tittar, the name Sowcar, and the number 17. There is no stable, unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: supposedly collocations
patterns.context: Used at the beginning or within a sentence to introduce an unverified claim, rumor, or guess about a cause; followed by a statement.

patterns.name: Inflected spelling of finally
patterns.context: Means “at last/eventually” within a sentence, often appearing before a verb or subject; activation is concentrated in the latter part of finally.
patterns.domain: English forums, online articles, code text

patterns.name: Spanish verb endings
patterns.context: Inflectional or derivational endings of Spanish verbs, appearing within verb forms; both examples contain endings of the -uye/-ye type.

patterns.name: Swedish verb ending -ar
patterns.context: In the Swedish verb tittar (look), activation is mainly on the latter part of the verb stem and the -ar ending; occurs in a relative clause.

patterns.name: Fragment in a name
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial part of the actor’s name Sowcar, within a cast-list entry.

patterns.name: Spanish word fragment containing -can
patterns.context: Activation falls on the middle of the Spanish word alcanza, in a negative statement about the goal of opening markets.

patterns.name: Number or numeric-string fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs within a year or numeric expression, immediately following a birth-year context.

2_1818.description: 激活分散于不同语言与词类：英语 supposedly、finally，西班牙语动词词尾及词内片段，瑞典语 tittar、人名 Sowcar 和数字 17；没有稳定统一的语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: supposedly 搭配
patterns.context: 句首或句中用来引入未经证实的说法、传闻或对原因的猜测；后接陈述内容。

patterns.name: finally 的分词式拼写
patterns.context: 句中表示“终于/最终”，常位于动词或主语之前；激活集中在单词 finally 的后半部分。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛、网络文章、代码文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语动词词尾
patterns.context: 西班牙语动词的屈折或派生词尾，出现在句中动词形式中；两例均含 -uye/-ye 一类结尾。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语学术文本、问答

patterns.name: 瑞典语动词词尾 -ar
patterns.context: 在瑞典语动词 tittar（看）中，激活主要落在动词词干后段及 -ar 词尾；处于关系从句中。

patterns.name: 人名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在演员姓名 Sowcar 的开头部分，处于演员表条目中。

patterns.name: 含 -can 的西班牙语词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语 alcanza 的中段，出现在市场开放目标的否定陈述中。

patterns.name: 数字或数字串片段
patterns.context: 激活位于年份/数字表达内部，紧接在出生年份语境中。

en.concept: ly character fragment and scattered subwords
en.description: Primarily activates English spelling fragments containing ly, especially supposedly; it also appears sporadically in French y, Estonian word forms, and various unrelated subword fragments.

patterns.name: English supposed/morphological fragment
patterns.context: The ly in the English adverb supposedly; it is preceded by supposed, with no consistent semantic requirement in the surrounding contexts.
patterns.domain: English forums, genealogy Q&A, and historical discourse

patterns.name: Internal ly in English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the internal ly character fragment; [4] is the spelling of Olympians, and [10] is the ending of sly.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia text and forum colloquial language

patterns.name: Other English ly endings
patterns.context: Occurs inside the proper noun Konoply[a], with no clear semantic connection to supposedly.

patterns.name: French y character fragment
patterns.context: The y in the French phrase y compris; activation also covers the subword fragment comp.

patterns.name: Estonian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Word-final or internal subword fragments in Estonian, including ma ei saa and sest; no clear corresponding English meaning is apparent.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Short character or common-word fragments in their respective sentences that are difficult to group into the language or word-form patterns above.
patterns.domain: English forums, encyclopedia text, and Estonian parliamentary text

2_1818.concept: ly 字符片段及杂散子词
2_1818.description: 主要激活英语含 ly 的拼写片段，尤其 supposedly；也散见于法语 y、爱沙尼亚语词形及多种无关子词片段。

patterns.name: 英语 supposed/形态片段
patterns.context: 英语副词 supposedly 中的 ly；前面是 supposed，周围语境并无一致的语义要求。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛、家谱问答及历史论述

patterns.name: 英语单词内部 ly
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的 ly 字符片段；[4] 为 Olympians 的拼写，[10] 为 sly 的词尾。
patterns.domain: 英语百科文本及论坛口语

patterns.name: 英语其他 ly 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Konoply[a] 的单词内部，未见与 supposedly 的明确语义联系。

patterns.name: 法语 y 字母片段
patterns.context: 法语 y compris 短语中的 y；激活也覆盖 comp 的子词片段。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语中词尾或词内子词片段，包括 ma ei saa、sest 等；没有明显对应的英语词义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会爱沙尼亚语发言

patterns.name: 未解释的零散片段
patterns.context: 在各自句子中的短字符或常见词片段，难以归入上述语言或词形模式。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛、百科文本及爱沙尼亚语议会文本

en.description: Activations often fall on intra-word substrings or near tokenization boundaries: English allegedly, several proper nouns and word fragments, and French and Swedish fragments. There are also sporadic number and letter activations. No clear, unified semantic or topical trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Hedging marker allegedly
patterns.context: Means reportedly or supposedly in English sentences; occurs both sentence-initially and medially.
patterns.domain: Genealogy Q&A, forum discussions, historical writing

patterns.name: Intra-word ly substring
patterns.context: Appears within the tokenized word “O«ly»9mpians”; unlike the complete word form allegedly.

patterns.name: Intra-word sty substring
patterns.context: An intra-word fragment in the place names Velikoustyugsky and Veliky Ustyug.

patterns.name: Intra-word ner substring
patterns.context: Appears in an English verb meaning to obtain or collect.

patterns.name: Intra-word unload fragment
patterns.context: In a financial context, discusses selling securities; high activation is on load, with weaker activation on un.

patterns.name: ingle in a legal name
patterns.context: Appears in the tokenization of the lawyer’s name Ronald A. Skingle.

patterns.name: French word fragments y and comp
patterns.context: Embedded respectively in the pronoun y and the tokenized fragment of compris in a French sentence; nearby content concerns stability, the euro, and other topics.

patterns.name: Swedish intra-word fragment it
patterns.context: Appears in the Swedish form s itt (sitt), near formal discussion of climate change and the committee.

patterns.name: Common cross-lingual word fragments
patterns.context: Markers occur in patent, Swedish, and legal texts, with no identifiable shared meaning or stable contextual trigger.
patterns.domain: Patent background, Swedish parliamentary text, legal documents

2_1818.description: 激活多落在词内子串或分词边界附近：英语 allegedly、若干专名和词形片段，以及法语、瑞典语片段；另有零散数字、字母激活。没有清晰统一的语义或主题触发模式。

patterns.name: 假设性标记 allegedly
patterns.context: 英语句中表示据称、假定；不论句首还是句中都出现。
patterns.domain: 家谱问答、论坛讨论、历史论述

patterns.name: 词内 ly 子串
patterns.context: 出现在“O«ly»9mpians”这一被切分的单词内部；与 allegedly 的完整词形不同。

patterns.name: 词内 sty 子串
patterns.context: 地名 Velikoustyugsky、Veliky Ustyug 中的词内片段。

patterns.name: 词内 ner 子串
patterns.context: 出现在表示获得、收集的英语动词中。

patterns.name: 词内 unload 片段
patterns.context: 金融语境中谈到卖出证券；高激活标在 load，un 也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 法律姓名中的 ingle
patterns.context: 出现在律师姓名 Ronald A. Skingle 的词内切分中。

patterns.name: 法语词片段 y、comp
patterns.context: 法语句中分别嵌在代词 y 和 compris 的分词片段内；附近有稳定性、欧元等内容。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段 it
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语 s itt（sitt）形式中，附近是气候变化与委员会的正式论述。

patterns.name: 跨语种常见词片段
patterns.context: 标记散见于专利、瑞典语及法律文本，缺少可确认的共同词义或稳定上下文触发条件。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、瑞典语议会文本、法律文书

en.description: Primarily responds to subword fragments of Swedish “Dessutom” and English “supposedly” and “finally”; there are also sporadic activations on names, numbers, punctuation, and internal Swedish fragments that do not fit a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Swedish “Dessutom”
patterns.context: The Swedish connective adverb Dessutom (in addition) appears at the beginning or within a sentence, with an internal subword fragment activated; followed by supplementary information.

patterns.name: English adverb supposed(ly)
patterns.context: The ly part of the English word supposedly is activated; often used to report an unverified claim, with or without a comma and sometimes followed by a clause.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, genealogy Q&A, and historical explanations

patterns.name: Code keyword finally
patterns.context: Appears in a list of JavaScript-style keywords, with activation on the latter part of finally.

patterns.name: English finally
patterns.context: Means “at last” in an English sentence, preceded by Will and followed by see.

patterns.name: Possible word-fragment/subword activations
patterns.context: Activation falls on date punctuation, within names, on numbers, or inside Swedish words; the context shows no clearly consistent semantic or syntactic condition shared with other high-activation patterns.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, Swedish parliamentary text, and mixed code/text content

2_1818.description: 主要响应瑞典语“Dessutom”、英语“supposedly”及“finally”的子词片段；另有零散姓名、数字、标点和瑞典语内部片段激活，无法归入统一模式。

patterns.name: 瑞典语“Dessutom”
patterns.context: 句首或句中出现瑞典语连接副词 Dessutom（此外），其内部子词片段被激活；后接补充说明。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语欧洲议会发言文本

patterns.name: 英语副词 supposed(ly)
patterns.context: 英语单词 supposedly 中 ly 部分被激活，常用于转述未经证实的说法；可带逗号，也可接从句。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、家谱问答及历史说明

patterns.name: 代码关键字 finally
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript 风格的关键字列表中，finally 的后半部分激活。

patterns.name: 英语 finally
patterns.context: 英语句子中表示“终于”，前有 Will，后接 see。

patterns.name: 可能的词片段/子词激活
patterns.context: 激活落在日期标点、姓名内部、数字或瑞典语词内部；上下文中未见与其他高激活模式明确一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文件、瑞典语议会文本及代码/文本混合内容

en.description: High activations are dispersed across word-form fragments in multiple languages. Clearer subpatterns include the English ly ending in supposedly and the Italian sta progressive construction. The remaining highlighted fragments span languages, meanings, and genres, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: English adverbs reportedly/supposedly
patterns.context: The English adverb supposedly appears, with activation concentrated on the ly ending; in [8], a line break splits the word, and ly is semantically similar to allegedly.
patterns.domain: Forum technical discussions, genealogy Q&A, historical explanations（[2][3][8]）

patterns.name: Italian verb sta
patterns.context: In Italian present progressive constructions, sta is followed by a participle or gerundio, as in “si sta diffondendo” and “sta maturando”.

patterns.name: Multilingual intra-word fragments or word-form boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on local word fragments in different languages or proper nouns; word forms and syntactic environments vary, with no shared meaning or positional pattern.
patterns.domain: Danish parliamentary speeches, Estonian parliamentary text, Spanish academic and parliamentary text, U.S. legal documents（[5][6][7][9][10]）

2_1818.description: 高激活分散于多语种词形片段；较清楚的子模式是英语 supposedly 的 ly 词尾，以及意大利语 sta 进行结构。其余高亮片段跨语言、语义和体裁，缺少统一解释。

patterns.name: 英文副词 reportedly/supposedly
patterns.context: 出现英文副词 supposedly，激活集中在词尾 ly；[8]中词被换行拆分，ly 与 allegedly 的语义功能相近。
patterns.domain: 论坛技术讨论、家谱问答、历史说明（[2][3][8]）

patterns.name: 意大利语动词 sta
patterns.context: 意大利语现在进行结构中，sta 后接动词分词或 gerundio，如“si sta diffondendo”“sta maturando”。

patterns.name: 多语种词内片段或词形边界
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语言或专名中的局部字词片段，所处词形及句法环境各异，未见统一语义或位置规律。
patterns.domain: 丹麦语议会发言、爱沙尼亚语议会文本、西班牙语学术及议会文本、美国法律文书（[5][6][7][9][10]）

en.description: Activation is distributed across complete words or intra-word fragments in several European languages: Italian sta, Spanish verb endings, Danish tager, English Supposedly, and Swedish and Estonian word forms. There is no stable cross-segment semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Italian sta + participle
patterns.context: Part of an Italian verb phrase, followed by a participle or other predicate component; expresses an ongoing or continuing event, or a tendency toward change.

patterns.name: Spanish conclusion verb
patterns.context: In a Spanish academic abstract, Se introduces the research conclusion; the highest activation falls on the verb ending ye.

patterns.name: Danish past-tense tager
patterns.context: In the Danish parliamentary formula “Det tager vi til efterretning,” activation concentrates on the stem and ending of tager.

patterns.name: English Supposedly
patterns.context: The adverb Supposedly introduces a rumor or reported claim at the beginning or within an English sentence; activation falls on the adverb’s ly ending.

patterns.name: Swedish dess- compound connective
patterns.context: Swedish dess­utom (furthermore), which connects preceding and following statements; activation concentrates on an internal fragment.

patterns.name: Estonian otsused
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the noun otsused (decisions) in parliamentary text; voting is mentioned nearby, and the decision will be made later.

patterns.name: Spanish desaparecen
patterns.context: In philosophical discourse, something disappears as copies are destroyed; activation falls on the verb ending.

2_1818.description: 激活分布于多种欧洲语言的完整词或词内片段：意大利语 sta、西班牙语动词词尾、丹麦语 tager、英语 Supposedly，以及瑞典语和爱沙尼亚语词形。没有跨段稳定的语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 意大利语 sta + 分词
patterns.context: 意大利语中作为动词短语的一部分，后接分词或其他谓语成分；表示正在发生、持续或趋于变化。
patterns.domain: 学术哲学文本、议会发言

patterns.name: 西班牙语结论动词
patterns.context: 西班牙语学术摘要中，主语 Se 引出研究结论；最高激活落在动词词尾 ye。

patterns.name: 丹麦语过去式 tager
patterns.context: 丹麦语议会套语“Det tager vi til efterretning”中，激活集中在 tager 的词干与词尾。

patterns.name: 英语 Supposedly
patterns.context: 句首或句中以副词 Supposedly 引入传闻、据称的说法；激活落在副词词尾 ly。

patterns.name: 瑞典语 dess-复合连接词
patterns.context: 瑞典语中连接前后陈述的 dess­utom（此外）；激活集中于词内片段。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语 otsused
patterns.context: 议会文本中名词 otsused（决定）的词内片段；附近提及投票及决定将在之后作出。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 desaparecen
patterns.context: 哲学论述中描述副本销毁时某物消失，激活落在动词词尾。

en.description: Activations are scattered across intra-word fragments, suffixes, and verb forms in multilingual text, spanning parliamentary speeches, philosophical writing, policy texts, online Q&A, and family narratives. There is no apparent unified semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Word-final morphemes or suffixes within words
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur within words or at their ends, often in the final part of a word; examples include Supposedly, diffondendo, diminuire, lyckas, hääletused, and otsused.

patterns.name: Italian intra-word fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Italian prose, activation falls on fragments within complete words, such as metà, maturando, orizzonte, ampio, and complesso.

patterns.name: Spanish verb forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on Spanish verbs or intra-word fragments in academic statements and general explanations.

patterns.name: Discourse continuation after English Supposedly
patterns.context: Supposedly occurs mid-sentence, followed by an assessment or explanation; one example introduces a claim about a switch, another a family rumor.

patterns.name: Spanish inter-word combination fragment
patterns.context: Activation covers an initial fragment; its meaning relates to achieving a goal and fully opening a market.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Spanish programming Q&A
patterns.context: The answer explains that appending data outside a Python loop includes only the final value; activation is distributed across Spanish explanations and code-related word fragments.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Danish parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: After a handover in a parliamentary speech, forms of address and remarks appear; activation falls on fragments such as Hr. formand.

patterns.name: Swedish intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Involves discussion of poverty alleviation and the economy, with activation dispersed across intra-word fragments such as lyckas, fattigdom, and hoppats.

patterns.name: Weak Italian intra-word fragments
patterns.context: An academic paragraph lists philosophical movements and discusses their influence; activation falls on several intra-word fragments.

2_1818.description: 激活散布在多语种文本的词内片段、词尾和动词形式中，涉及议会发言、哲学论述、政策文本、网络问答及家族叙述；没有明显统一的语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 单词内部的末尾词素或后缀
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在词内部或词尾，常是单词的结尾部分；分别见 Supposedly、diffondendo、diminuire、lyckas、hääletused、otsused。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 意大利语连续正文中，激活落在完整词的内部片段，如 metà、maturando、orizzonte、ampio、complesso。

patterns.name: 西班牙语动词形式
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语动词或其词内片段中，出现在学术陈述及一般说明中。

patterns.name: 英语 Supposedly 后的句间衔接
patterns.context: Supposedly 位于句中，后接判断或解释；一处引出对开关的说法，一处引出家族传闻。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词间组合片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖词首片段，词义与达到目标、完整开放市场的陈述有关。

patterns.name: 西班牙语程序问答中的词内片段
patterns.context: 回答解释 Python 循环外追加数据导致只纳入最后一个值；激活分布在西语说明和代码相关词片段中。

patterns.name: 丹麦语议会发言中的词内片段
patterns.context: 议会发言交接后出现称呼与致辞，激活落在 Hr. formand 等片段。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 涉及扶贫及经济讨论，激活分散在词内片段中，如 lyckas、fattigdom、hoppats。

patterns.name: 意大利语弱词内片段
patterns.context: 学术段落列举哲学流派并讨论其影响，激活落在若干词内部片段。

en.description: The strongest responses are distributed across intra-word fragments in multilingual text: ly in supposedly, the Estonian verb fragment used, Italian sta, German was, the H in Danish Hr., and fort in Swedish fortfarande. Beyond local word form and syntactic position, there is no clear shared meaning.

patterns.name: Hedging adverb Supposedly
patterns.context: Strongest activation is concentrated on the word-final ly in supposedly; the word introduces an unverified or qualified claim. Ordinary neighboring words such as his and the sometimes show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Estonian intra-word fragment
patterns.context: In Estonian, the fragment used occurs within a verb form; surrounding sentences concern voting and making a decision.

patterns.name: Italian verb ending
patterns.context: sta occurs in an Italian progressive construction, followed by a verb; no strong response to the following verb is observed.

patterns.name: German interrogative or explanatory-clause marker was
patterns.context: Appears in a German sentence introducing explanatory content; examples concern explaining what Verfassung is and the benefits brought by Flugpreise.

patterns.name: Danish sentence-initial H-initial fragment
patterns.context: Appears as the initial letter of the abbreviation Hr. in a formal parliamentary speech addressing Vitorino; neighboring ordinary words also show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Middle fragment of Swedish fortfarande
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the adverb fortfarande, meaning “still”; the context discusses whether treatment of developing countries remains effective.

2_1818.description: 最强响应分布在多语文本中的词内片段：supposedly 的 ly、爱沙尼亚语动词片段 used、意大利语 sta、德语 was、丹麦语 Hr. 的 H、瑞典语 fortfarande 的 fort。除局部词形与句法位置外，没有明确共享语义。

patterns.name: 据说／推测语气词 Supposedly
patterns.trigger: «ly»10（[1]、[2]）和 «ly»9（[4]）；前接未标记的 Supposed«，而 [4] 还出现分词断开的 «supp»1osed«ly»9
patterns.context: 最强激活集中在 supposedly 的词尾 ly；该词用于引入未经证实或带保留的说法。有时邻近 his、the 等普通词也有弱激活
patterns.domain: 论坛、家谱问答、历史说明

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 在爱沙尼亚语中，片段 used 出现在动词词形内部；周围句子涉及投票和作出决定

patterns.name: 意大利语动词词尾
patterns.context: 位于意大利语进行结构中的 sta，后接动词；未显示对其后续动词的强响应

patterns.name: 德语疑问或解释从句标记 was
patterns.context: 出现在德语句中，引出说明性内容；分别涉及解释 Verfassung 是什么、以及 Flugpreise 带来的好处

patterns.name: 丹麦语句首 H开头词片段
patterns.context: 在称呼 Vitorino 的正式议会发言中，出现在缩写 Hr. 的首字母；邻近普通词也有较弱激活

patterns.name: 瑞典语 fortfarande 的中间片段
patterns.context: 位于表示“仍然”的副词 fortfarande 开头；上下文讨论对发展中国家的待遇是否继续有效

en.concept: multilingual word forms and subword fragments
en.description: Activations are dispersed across Italian progressive and conditional forms, Estonian and Swedish word forms, German function-word fragments, Danish questions, and English adverb endings. There are also cross-lingual intra-word fragments, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Italian progressive auxiliary construction
patterns.context: «sta» is followed by a present participle to form “is …ing”; in another passage, the sequence is «si»«sta»«diffondendo».

patterns.name: Italian conditional-ending fragment
patterns.context: An internal fragment of an Italian verb form occurs in a parliamentary speech; similar morpheme-like word fragments include «pot»3«er»2.

patterns.name: Estonian voting-related word forms
patterns.context: When giving the voting date, activation falls on the intra-word fragment «used»; the same passage also contains «otsused»9.

patterns.name: Swedish endings and verbal morphology fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on morphological fragments within words or near word boundaries; the context concerns provisions related to third countries and developing countries.

patterns.name: Swedish interrogative fragment
patterns.context: A standalone sentence-initial interrogative word, followed by «Därför» in the response.

patterns.name: English adverb ending
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the latter part of the adverb innately, in a scientific description of mice with innate susceptibility or resistance.

patterns.name: German demonstrative pronoun and conjunction fragments
patterns.context: An explanatory parliamentary speech about a “security and defense alliance”; activation falls on common German function words or intra-word fragments.

patterns.name: Danish questions and word-form fragments
patterns.context: A conditional clause appears in the sentence, followed by a handover to a member; activation is dispersed across short function words and fragments within forms of address.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual intra-word/word-boundary fragments
patterns.context: These weaker activations are distributed within words or at word boundaries in different languages; no unified lexical meaning or grammatical function explains them within a passage, and the high-activation words also differ.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary corpora and philosophical texts

2_1818.concept: 多语种词形与子词片段
2_1818.description: 激活分散在意大利语进行时与条件式词形、爱沙尼亚语和瑞典语词形、德语功能词片段、丹麦语疑问句及英语副词词尾；同时存在跨语种词内片段，缺乏统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 意大利语进行时助动结构
patterns.context: «sta» 后接现在分词，构成“正在……”；在另一段中为 «si»«sta»«diffondendo»。

patterns.name: 意大利语条件式词尾片段
patterns.context: 意大利语动词词形内部的片段，出现在议会发言中；类似的语素化词片段还有 «pot»3«er»2。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会口语／程序讨论

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语投票相关词形
patterns.context: 在说明投票日期时，激活落在词内的 «used» 片段；同段另有 «otsused»9。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾及动词形态片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内或词边界附近的形态片段，语境谈及第三国、发展中国家相关规定。

patterns.name: 瑞典语疑问词片段
patterns.context: 句首独立疑问词，随后以 «Därför» 回答。

patterns.name: 英语副词词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中在副词 innately 的后半部分，处于先天易感或抗性小鼠的科研描述中。

patterns.name: 德语指示代词及连接词片段
patterns.context: 围绕“安全与防务联盟”的解释性议会发言，激活落在常见德语功能词或词内片段。

patterns.name: 丹麦语疑问句与词形片段
patterns.context: 句中出现条件句，随后把发言权交给委员；激活分散在短功能词和称谓内部。

patterns.name: 跨语种词内／词边界片段
patterns.trigger: « Me»、« pe»、« A»、« on»（段3）；« Pot»、«reb»、« intend»、« present»（段4）；«på»、« syn»、« fort»（段5）；«z»、«war»、«Ver»（段8）
patterns.context: 这些较弱激活分布于不同语种的词内或词边界，段内没有统一的词义或语法功能可解释；强激活词也各不相同。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会语料及哲学文本

en.description: Activation often falls within or at the end of words across languages: English supposedly and innately, Italian progressive constructions, and Danish, Estonian, and Spanish word-form fragments. The commonality is more of a local morphological/subword pattern, while languages and lexical functions vary.

patterns.name: Ending activation in Supposedly
patterns.context: The complete or nearly complete word “Supposedly,” especially sentence-initial or parenthetical; activation falls on the ending ly.

patterns.name: Italian progressive endings
patterns.context: Italian constructions expressing an ongoing or developing event, such as “sta maturando” and “si sta diffondendo”.

patterns.name: Danish honorific Hr.
patterns.context: In Danish parliamentary speech, the abbreviation “Hr.” addressing a member of parliament is followed by a title or name.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in innately
patterns.context: In the English word “innately,” activation is distributed across the initial inn and final ately; occurs in descriptions of attributes such as susceptibility or freedom.

patterns.name: Estonian word endings
patterns.context: Estonian plural or case-inflected forms, with activation concentrated near the ending; the specific morphological functions are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Spanish verb endings
patterns.context: The ending portions of Spanish third-person singular verb forms, in descriptions of agreements and their measures.

2_1818.concept: 跨语言词尾与子词片段
2_1818.description: 激活多落在跨语言词语的内部或词尾：英语 supposedly、innately，意大利语进行式结构，以及丹麦语、爱沙尼亚语和西班牙语词形片段。共同点偏向局部形态/子词模式，语言与词法功能多样。

patterns.name: Supposedly 的词尾激活
patterns.context: 完整或近完整的 “Supposedly” 一词，尤其位于句首或插入语位置；激活落在词尾 ly。
patterns.domain: 论坛、历史问答、宗教史网页

patterns.name: 意大利语进行式词尾
patterns.context: 意大利语中表示正在发生或逐渐发展的结构，如 “sta maturando”“si sta diffondendo”。

patterns.name: 丹麦语敬称 Hr.
patterns.context: 丹麦语议会发言中，称呼议员的缩写 “Hr.” 后接称谓或姓名。

patterns.name: innately 的词内片段
