patterns.name: 方法词“method”
patterns.context: 用于介绍或指称一种技术、实验或检测流程；常与“by means of”所在的方法描述语境相邻，但也可在专利中指称待说明的操作方法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利说明文

patterns.name: 专利中的“ink”打印操作
patterns.context: 讲述喷墨打印头将墨滴喷到纸上并检测落点的具体流程；未见明显“by means of”式研究方法表述。

patterns.name: 量子态与光子数表述
patterns.context: 讨论纠缠光子对、GHZ态以及按需合成多光子态；与主要的方法句式不同。

en.description: Activations occur across multiple types of technical, patent, and legal texts: commonly around the relative word which and its prepositional collocations, and also in gravity-driven/separation and paper-inkjet topics. Lexical and semantic cues are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: “by which” relative clauses in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: In the “by which” construction, introduces an action or relation on which a method, device, or result depends; patent-style explanatory prose often appears before and after the phrase.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds and invention descriptions

patterns.name: Gravity-driven processes or gravity separation
patterns.context: Explicitly mentions gravity as a transport, driving, or separation mechanism.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions; also StackExchange vehicle explanations

patterns.name: Paper and inkjet printing
patterns.context: Discusses inkjet printing, recording media, paper coatings, or ink properties; specific trigger words vary across passages.

patterns.name: Causal or functional relations in patent texts
patterns.context: Technical or legal explanations use relational structures to describe device functions, rights transfers, sources, or invention purposes; partly overlaps with the “by which” pattern, but has no uniform function.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent texts and FreeLaw legal texts

2_1913.description: 激活分布在多类技术、专利及法律文本中：常见于关系词which及其介词搭配，也出现于重力驱动/分离和纸张喷墨主题。词法与语义线索并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的“by which”关系从句
patterns.context: 在“by which”结构中引出方法、装置或结果所依赖的动作或关系；词组前后常见专利式说明文。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与发明描述

patterns.name: 重力驱动或重力分离
patterns.context: 明确提及重力作为输送、驱动或分离机制。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明；另有 StackExchange 车辆说明

patterns.name: 纸张与喷墨打印
patterns.context: 讨论喷墨打印、记录介质、纸张涂层或油墨性能；不同段的具体触发词不完全相同。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的因果或功能关系表达
patterns.context: 技术或法律说明中用关系结构说明设备用途、权利转让、来源或发明目的；与“by which”模式有部分重叠，但功能并不统一。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利文本及 FreeLaw 法律文本

en.concept: Primarily email headers and quotation formatting, with scattered lexical responses
en.description: Primarily responds to original-message separator lines and email-header fields; also activates strongly on the beginning of “pondered” and in the experimental-method phrase “by means of.” Some punctuation activates sporadically; news segment [4] has no clear corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: Email quotation separator
patterns.context: An original-message separator line appears after an email body or at the start of forwarded content; activation concentrates on the dashes and “Original Message,” sometimes extending to the following sender field.

patterns.name: Email header fields
patterns.context: Structured fields such as sender, date, and email address appear in a header or address; a quotation separator is not required.

patterns.name: pondered
patterns.context: The word “pondered” is split into tokens, with activation on the initial subword “pon”; used once in a personal narrative and once in a news summary.

patterns.name: Experimental-method connective phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the “by means of” structure describing an experimental procedure, followed by a specific experimental technique.

patterns.name: Separator punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation and line breaks near email headers or original-message separators also show weaker activation, but the distribution is insufficient to establish an independent pattern.

2_1913.concept: 邮件头与引用格式为主，兼有零散词项响应
2_1913.description: 主要响应邮件的原始邮件分隔行及邮件头字段；另在“pondered”的词首、实验方法短语“by means of”中强烈激活。部分标点激活零散；新闻段落[4]无明确对应模式。

patterns.name: 邮件引用分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件正文后或转发内容开头出现原始邮件分隔行；激活集中在破折号和“Original Message”，有时也延伸到其后的发件人字段。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段
patterns.context: 邮件头或地址中出现发件人、日期、邮箱地址等结构化字段；不一定伴随引用分隔符。

patterns.name: pondered
patterns.context: 词语“pondered”被拆分标记，激活落在词首子词“pon”；一次用于个人叙述，一次用于新闻摘要。

patterns.name: 实验方法术语连接词
patterns.context: 出现在描述实验流程的“by means of”结构中，后接具体实验技术。

patterns.name: 分隔符标点
patterns.context: 邮件头或原始邮件分隔附近的标点、换行也有较弱激活，但分布不足以确定独立规律。

en.description: Primarily responds to the fixed phrase “by means of” in scientific and patent method descriptions, especially means; also strongly activates on From in email headers and SQL. Other word activations are sporadic, and the Polish examples are difficult to interpret.

patterns.name: Fixed prepositional phrase “by means of”
patterns.context: Describes using a method, tool, or measurement technique; may occur in method descriptions, experimental measurements, research results, or patent technical narratives.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers and patent technical texts

patterns.name: From in an email header field
patterns.context: Follows the From: field name in an email header and denotes the sender; date and encoding fields appear nearby.

patterns.name: From in SQL statements
patterns.context: Appears in an SQL subquery or query, introducing the source table.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Polish
patterns.context: An intra-word fragment in a Polish prayer, in a religious context involving humility and vanity; only one example, so the exact lexical trigger pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Other weak or local word activations
patterns.context: Passage 1 has the and Chl; passage 2 has an internal fragment of salicylamide and a concentration expression; passage 3 has measurement; passage 5 has which, of, worker; passage 6 has median, In accordance with; passage 7 has words related to students and geographic origins. Apart from “by means of” in passage 6, no consistent and reliable trigger condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Scientific, patent, and general texts across domains

2_1913.concept: 方法表达及 From 标记
2_1913.description: 主要响应科学与专利方法描述中的固定短语“by means of”，尤其是 means；另对邮件头和 SQL 中的 From 有强激活。其余词语激活分散，波兰语例句难以解释。

patterns.name: 固定介词短语“by means of”
patterns.context: 说明采用某种方法、工具或测量手段；可出现在方法描述、实验测量、研究结果或专利技术叙述中。
patterns.domain: 科学论文与专利技术文本

patterns.name: 邮件头字段中的 From
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头的字段名 From: 后，表示发件人；附近有日期和编码字段。

patterns.name: SQL 语句中的 From
patterns.context: 出现在 SQL 子查询或查询语句中，引出数据表来源。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语祷文中的词内片段，处于谦逊、虚荣等宗教语境；仅此一例，无法判断确切词汇触发规律。

patterns.name: 其他弱或局部词语激活
patterns.context: 段1有 the、Chl；段2有 salicylamide 内部片段及浓度表达；段3有 measurement；段5有 which、of、worker；段6有 median、In accordance with；段7有学生、地理来源相关词。除段6的“by means of”外，未见统一且可靠的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域科学、专利及一般文本

en.concept: Phrases introducing a method or route
en.description: Primarily responds to “by way of” in patents and “by means of” in scientific and medical texts, fixed phrases introducing a method, route, or means; there are also local activations for fluorescence measurement, the security checkpoint “puesto,” and “jaded.”

patterns.name: “by means of” tool/method phrase
patterns.context: Uses means of to introduce a method or tool for performing an operation or measurement; also appears in “means of sucrose density gradient centrifugation”.

patterns.name: “by way of” manner or route phrase
patterns.context: A fixed prepositional phrase introducing an example, procedure, or data-transmission route.

patterns.name: Chlorophyll fluorescence measurement
patterns.context: Measures chlorophyll fluorescence in purified LHCII, involving an aqueous buffer and experimental conditions.

patterns.name: Planar temperature measurement and laser-induced fluorescence
patterns.context: Describes measuring the temperature of a compressible flow field using two-line laser-induced iodine fluorescence.

patterns.name: Spanish security checkpoint
patterns.context: Air passengers entering the United States pass through a single checkpoint; activation falls on puesto.

patterns.name: “jaded” expressing weariness or cynicism
patterns.context: A commenter says a view is overly weary or cynical; it has no clear connection to the technical expressions in the other segments.

2_1913.concept: 引出方式或途径的短语
2_1913.description: 主要响应专利中的“by way of”和科学、医学文本中的“by means of”，即引出方式、途径或手段的固定短语；另有荧光测量、安检点“puesto”和“jaded”等局部激活。

patterns.name: “by means of”工具/方法短语
patterns.context: 用 means of 引出实施操作或测量的方法、工具；也见于 “means of sucrose density gradient centrifugation”。

patterns.name: “by way of”方式或途径短语
patterns.context: 以固定介词短语引出示例、操作方式或数据传输途径。

patterns.name: 叶绿素荧光测量
patterns.context: 测量纯化 LHCII 的叶绿素荧光，涉及水性缓冲液和实验条件。

patterns.name: 平面温度测量与激光诱导荧光
patterns.trigger: «measurement» «in»；“planar measurement of temperature in compressible flow”及“fluorescence”
patterns.context: 描述用双线激光诱导碘荧光测量可压缩流场温度的方法。
patterns.domain: 流体力学/光学测量摘要

patterns.name: 西班牙语安检点
patterns.context: 航空旅客入境美国时通过单一检查点；激活落在 puesto。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会西班牙语文本

patterns.name: “jaded”表达厌倦或愤世
patterns.context: 评论者称某种看法过于厌倦、愤世；与其他段落的技术表达无明显联系。

en.description: Primarily activates on From/from: email sender headers, SQL or code syntax, and the English preposition; also responds to colons and slashes in email dates and times, and sporadically activates on common English words and the endings of pondered and jaded.

patterns.name: From field
patterns.context: Appears in an email header or forwarded-email sender field; capitalization may vary.

patterns.name: From in SQL queries
patterns.context: Located in an SQL subquery, indicating the query’s data source; table names and query syntax are nearby.

patterns.name: from in code
patterns.context: Part of code syntax or a variable expression; may appear in an array field name or a LINQ query.

patterns.name: Ordinary English from
patterns.context: Appears in natural-language prepositional phrases indicating a source or starting time; only local markers are present.

patterns.name: Email date and time separators
patterns.context: Appears in date and time strings in email headers or forwarded headers, marking hours and minutes and month, day, and year.

patterns.name: Fragments of common English words
patterns.context: Sporadically falls within English narratives or code explanations; no consistent syntactic or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Email, technical Q&A, and forum comments

patterns.name: Ending of pondered
patterns.context: Appears within the word “pondered” in an English narrative sentence.

patterns.name: Ending of jaded
patterns.context: Appears within the word “jaded,” describing opinions or audiences; both passages involve this word.

patterns.name: From in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: An identifier in a symbolic computation language expression, rather than an email field or SQL keyword.

2_1913.description: 主要激活于 From/from：邮件寄件人头、SQL或代码语法及英文介词；也响应邮件日期时间中的冒号和斜线，并零散激活常见英文词及 pondered、jaded 的词尾。

patterns.name: From 字段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头或转发邮件的寄件人字段中；大小写可能不同。

patterns.name: SQL 查询中的 From
patterns.context: 位于 SQL 子查询中，表示查询数据来源；邻近表名及查询语法。

patterns.name: 代码中的 from
patterns.context: 作为代码语法或变量表达式的一部分；可见于数组字段名或 LINQ 查询。

patterns.name: 普通英文 from
patterns.context: 出现在自然语言的介词短语中，表示来源或时间起点；仅有局部标记。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术说明、HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: 邮件日期和时间分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头或转发头的日期、时间字符串中，标记时分及月日年。

patterns.name: 英语常见词片段
patterns.trigger: « sure»、« of»、« them»、« or»、« With»、« will»、« wonder»
patterns.context: 零散地落在英文叙述或代码说明中；没有一致的句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术问答与论坛评论

patterns.name: pondered 的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在“pondered”一词内部，处于英文叙述句中。

patterns.name: jaded 的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在“jaded”一词内部，描述观点或观众；两段均涉及该词。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 From
patterns.context: 作为符号计算语言表达式中的标识符，而非邮件字段或 SQL 关键字。

en.description: Activations are scattered across the email header From, English from, the patent fixed phrase by way of, decimal points in amounts, and code symbols; the shared signal is weak, and some peaks may come from formatting or local tokens.

patterns.name: From email header field
patterns.context: Appears in an email or forwarded-email header, followed by sender information; segment 1 is truncated at the beginning of the field value.

patterns.name: English from and its collocations
patterns.context: Indicates origin in ordinary English or patent narrative; segment 2 concerns a fuel source, and segment 5 a cited patent source. Distinguish from the capitalized email-header From.

patterns.name: Manner phrase by way of
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “by way of” indicates a manner or example; both instances occur in patent descriptions.

patterns.name: Numeric amounts with decimal points
patterns.context: A decimal point followed by three digits in an amount appears in a list of payment dates and amounts.

patterns.name: Symbols, variables, and code syntax
patterns.context: Appears in a Mathematica-style expression, where the variable x_ and a character-code condition contain a slash; activation falls on syntax symbols.

2_1913.description: 激活分散在 From 邮件头、英文 from、专利固定短语 by way of、金额小数点及代码符号上；共同线索较弱，部分峰值可能来自格式或局部 token。

patterns.name: From 邮件头字段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头或转发邮件头中，后接发件人信息；第1段截断在字段值开头。

patterns.name: 英文 from 及其搭配
patterns.context: 普通英文或专利叙述中表示来源；第2段为燃料来源，第5段为引用专利来源。与大写邮件头 From 区分。

patterns.name: 方式短语 by way of
patterns.context: 固定短语“by way of”中，表示方式或举例；两处都位于专利说明文字。

patterns.name: 带句点的数字金额
patterns.context: 金额的小数点后接三位数字，出现在付款日期与金额的列表中。

patterns.name: 符号、变量与代码语法
patterns.context: 出现在 Mathematica 风格表达式中，变量 x_ 与字符码条件含斜线；激活标记落在语法符号上。

en.description: High activations occur on the Hungarian jelen word family, which in patent clauses, From in email headers, and jaded in discussions of audience fatigue; these belong to different languages, formats, and semantic contexts.

patterns.name: Hungarian jelen word family
patterns.context: Appears in Hungarian sentences, including jelen (“current, present”) and its derived or compound forms; surrounding context concerns attendance, political significance, or current circumstances.

patterns.name: which in patent citations
patterns.context: In English patent backgrounds or technical descriptions, which introduces a clause related to a patent number, device, component, or preceding item.

patterns.name: From in email headers
patterns.context: In a formatted email or forwarded-email header, From marks the sender field, usually followed by a name or address.

patterns.name: Audience fatigue with videos
patterns.context: Informal English comments describe viewers becoming tired of television or video content, or harder to please.

2_1913.description: 高激活分别落在匈牙利语 jelen 词族、专利从句中的 which、邮件头 From，以及讨论受众厌倦的 jaded 上；这些词分属不同语言、格式与语义情境。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语 jelen 词族
patterns.context: 出现在匈牙利语句子中，包含 jelen（“当前、在场”）及其派生或复合形式；周围语境谈及出席、政治意义或当前状况。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 专利引文中的 which
patterns.context: 英文专利背景或技术描述中，which 引出与专利号、设备、部件或前述事物有关的从句。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的 From
patterns.context: 邮件或转发邮件的格式化头部中，From 标记发件人字段，通常后接姓名或地址。

patterns.name: 视频受众的厌倦
patterns.context: 英语非正式评论中描述观众对电视或视频内容感到厌倦、变得难以取悦。

en.description: Primarily responds to the Hungarian stem jelen and English from/From; it also responds to email headers, forwarded-message separators, date/time formats, and encoding markers. from in code also triggers, indicating variation in capitalization and context.

patterns.name: Hungarian “jelen” stem
patterns.context: Part of a word in Hungarian text, appearing in different inflected or derived forms such as jelen vannak, jelenlegi, jelenleg.
patterns.domain: European Parliament Hungarian-language political, financial, and international affairs texts

patterns.name: From field in email headers
patterns.context: In an email or forwarded-email header, followed by a sender name, address, or institutional path; no specific email-body content is required.
patterns.domain: Enron email headers and forwarding format

patterns.name: from in code
patterns.context: Part of an import source or query syntax in code, followed by a module name or data-source expression.
patterns.domain: JavaScript/Ember import code, C# LINQ examples

patterns.name: Formatting markers near email forwarding separators
patterns.context: Date, time, and separator-line formatting in forwarded emails; occurs with the From field but also shows notable activation on its own.

patterns.name: Content-Transfer-Encoding in email headers
patterns.context: The quoted-printable encoding declaration in an email header, with date and From fields nearby.

2_1913.description: 主要响应匈牙利语 jelen 词干及英语 from/From；另对邮件头、转发分隔线、日期时间和编码标记有响应。代码中的 from 也触发，表明大小写和语境均有差异。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语「jelen」词干
patterns.context: 匈牙利语正文中，作为词语的一部分；出现于不同屈折或派生形式，如 jelen vannak、jelenlegi、jelenleg。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会匈牙利语政治、财政及国际事务文本

patterns.name: 邮件头部的 From 字段
patterns.context: 邮件或转发邮件头部，后接发件人姓名、地址或机构路径；不要求特定邮件正文内容。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件头及转发格式

patterns.name: 代码中的 from
patterns.context: 代码中作为导入来源或查询语法的一部分，后接模块名或数据源表达式。
patterns.domain: JavaScript/Ember 导入代码、C# LINQ 示例

patterns.name: 邮件转发分隔线附近的格式标记
patterns.context: 转发邮件的日期、时间及分隔线格式；与 From 字段共同出现，但本身也呈现明显激活。

patterns.name: 邮件头部的 Content-Transfer-Encoding
patterns.context: 邮件头部中编码声明的 quoted-printable 字样，且附近有日期和 From 字段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and styles, including Hungarian jelen forms, email-header From, code variables, and several fixed legal or patent phrases; no single semantic pattern fully explains them.

patterns.name: jelen stem within Hungarian words
patterns.context: Activations cluster on intra-word fragments of Hungarian words such as jelen/jelenlegi; the specific forms and contexts in [1], [4], and [8] differ. Political or parliamentary contexts are common, but [1] is a speech of thanks

patterns.name: Source relations in patent citations
patterns.context: Appears in patent background citations of prior patents or documents, forming from which followed by a number or source information; note that [9] also has from which, but its highest activation is not on that phrase

patterns.name: Sender field in email headers
patterns.context: In email metadata headers, From is followed by a colon and the sender’s name or address; unrelated to the email body

patterns.name: demand in a conditional legal statement
patterns.context: In a French parliamentary speech, appears in the structure «on demande à la Commission de donner», meaning that the Commission is asked to take action
patterns.domain: Colloquial French parliamentary speech in EuroParl

patterns.name: suggestion after a rule heading
patterns.context: In a U.S. court rule text, appears in the procedural condition “on suggestion of a party”

patterns.name: from iteration structure in code
patterns.context: In a C# LINQ query, from is followed by a variable, then by in and a data source; activation is actually concentrated on the variable schools, and the preceding code discusses displaying a data grid

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase in a technical description
patterns.context: In a patent technical description, from which introduces the source from which a fuel component is extracted; shares patent style and the phrase with [2], but this passage also has activation near “by way of”

patterns.name: permission in an appeal heading
patterns.context: In a case heading or procedural summary, appears in the fixed legal phrase “Appeal, by permission of a Justice”

2_1913.description: 激活分散于不同语种与文体，包含匈牙利语 jelen 词形、邮件头 From、代码变量及若干法律或专利固定短语；不能由单一语义模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内的 jelen 词干
patterns.trigger: «elen»10（[1] 中紧接着 «j»；[4] 中为 «j«el»3«ent»2ősé«ge»1 a j«elen»10legi）；以及 [8] 的「j«elen»9leg」
patterns.context: 激活集中在匈牙利语 jelen/jelenlegi 一类词的词内片段；[1]、[4]、[8] 的具体形态和上下文不同，常见政治或议会语境，但 [1] 是致谢发言
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 专利引述中的来源关系
patterns.context: 出现在专利背景技术对先前专利或文献的引述中，组成 from which，后接编号或来源信息；注意 [9] 也出现 from which，但激活最高处不在该短语

patterns.name: 邮件头中的发件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件元数据头部中，From 后接冒号和发件人姓名、地址；与邮件正文无关

patterns.name: 法条条件句中的 demand
