patterns.domain: EuroParl 法语口语化议会发言

patterns.name: 规则标题后的 suggestion
patterns.context: 美国法院规则文本中，出现在「on suggestion of a party」这一程序条件表述中

patterns.name: 代码中的 from 迭代结构
patterns.context: C# LINQ 查询中，from 后接变量，再接 in 和数据源；激活实际集中在变量 schools 上，且代码前文讨论数据网格显示

patterns.name: 技术说明中的介词短语
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中，from which 引出燃油组分被提取的来源；与 [2] 同有专利文体及短语，但本段另有“by way of”附近的激活

patterns.name: 上诉标题中的 permission
patterns.context: 案件标题或程序摘要中，出现在「Appeal, by permission of a Justice」的固定法律表述

en.description: Activations are scattered across Hungarian subword fragments, common French and English words, `from` in code, `From` in email headers, chemical procedure verbs, and formatting punctuation; no stable, unified semantic pattern is apparent across languages and styles.

patterns.name: Hungarian intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on stems or affixes within Hungarian words, often where BPE splits word boundaries; corresponding fragments appear in segments 1, 3, and 5.
patterns.domain: Hungarian political text from the European Parliament

patterns.name: Common French word fragments
patterns.context: In French parliamentary speeches, activation falls on substrings of common words or inflected forms, but the word meanings and syntactic positions differ across instances.
patterns.domain: French text from the European Parliament

patterns.name: English connectives and discourse words
patterns.context: English function words, prepositions, and discourse connectors in academic discussion or technical explanations; high activation falls on ordinary words rather than clearly specialized terms.

patterns.name: From field in email headers
patterns.context: A header field name followed by sender information; the same capitalization also appears in other code contexts, so activation may not be specific to email headers.

patterns.name: `from` string in code
patterns.context: The identifier or string `from` appears in code or code snippets; the two programming Q&A examples have different syntax.

patterns.name: Experimental procedure verbs
patterns.context: In chemical experiment procedures, activation marks verbs or verb fragments describing experimental operations; several neighboring words in the text are unmarked.

patterns.name: Formatting whitespace and parentheses
patterns.context: Formatting or punctuation tokens such as indentation whitespace and right parentheses appear in code Q&A, without a clear semantic trigger.

2_1913.description: 激活分散在匈牙利语词片段、法语及英语常见词、代码中的 from、邮件头 From、化学操作动词和格式标点上；不同语种与文体间未见稳定统一的语义模式。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在匈牙利语词的词干或词缀内部，常见于词语边界被 BPE 切分的情形；段1、3、5均有相应片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会匈牙利语政治文本

patterns.name: 法语常见词片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中，激活落在常见词或词形的子串上，但各处词义和句法位置不同。

patterns.name: 英文连接与篇章词
patterns.context: 学术论述或技术说明中的英文功能词、介词及篇章衔接词；高激活落在普通词而非明确的专门术语上。

patterns.name: 邮件头 From 字段
patterns.context: 邮件头字段名后跟发件人信息；同一大写拼写也出现在其他代码语境，激活未必只识别邮件头。

patterns.name: 代码中的 from 字符串
patterns.context: 代码或代码片段中出现 from 标识符或字符串；两处编程问答语法并不相同。

patterns.name: 实验操作动词
patterns.context: 化学实验步骤中，激活标记实验操作叙述里的动词或其词形片段；相邻叙述中也有多个未标记词。

patterns.name: 版式空白与括号
patterns.context: 代码问答中出现缩进空白和右括号等格式或标点 token，缺乏清晰的语义触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to the From sender field, forwarded-message separators, and adjacent date/time metadata in email formats; also responds to From/from strings in code Q&A, along with several inconsistent code punctuation and syntax patterns.

patterns.name: Forwarded-email separator
patterns.context: A forwarded email header appears after the email body, often accompanied by “Forwarded by … on …” and a subsequent “From:”; it may also appear between the body and forwarded header.

patterns.name: From in email headers
patterns.context: Appears in or near an email header or forwarded-email header; passage 1 is also in a quoted-printable encoded email header.

patterns.name: from identifier in code
patterns.context: Appears as code syntax or string content, rather than an email sender field.

patterns.name: Email timestamp format
patterns.context: Dates and times are adjacent to email headers or forwarded metadata, with dense punctuation and numeric fields.

patterns.name: Special code punctuation and parameters
patterns.context: Operators, punctuation, color strings, or SQL syntax in code snippets; no common, clear semantic trigger word.

2_1913.concept: 格式边界与 From 字符串
2_1913.description: 主要响应邮件格式中的 From 发件人字段、转发分隔线及邻近的日期时间元数据；另在代码问答中响应 From/from 字符串，以及若干彼此不一致的代码标点和语法。

patterns.name: 转发邮件分隔线
patterns.context: 邮件正文后出现转发邮件头，常伴随“Forwarded by … on …”和后续“From:”；也可在正文与转发头之间出现。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的 From
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头或转发邮件头附近；段1还处于 quoted-printable 编码的邮件头中。

patterns.name: 代码中的 from 标识符
patterns.context: 作为代码语法或字符串内容出现，而非邮件发件人字段。

patterns.name: 邮件时间戳格式
patterns.context: 日期、时间与邮件头或转发元数据相邻，标点和数字字段密集。

patterns.name: 特殊代码标点与参数
patterns.context: 代码片段中的运算符、标点、颜色字符串或 SQL 语法；没有共同的明显语义触发词。

en.concept: From/from strings and local formatting fragments
en.description: The clearest pattern is `From/from` with varying capitalization: it appears in email sender headers, code keys or strings, and SQL clauses. Other activations include `give` in a math problem, Italian intra-word fragments, and scattered punctuation and newline activations; these cannot all be attributed to one trigger mechanism.

patterns.name: From field in email headers
patterns.context: `From` appears as a sender field in an email header or body, often followed by a colon and sender name; capitalization is not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: `from` string in code
patterns.context: Appears as a JSON key, code string, or query parameter; it is not an email header field.
patterns.domain: Github, StackExchange code or technical Q&A

patterns.name: From in SQL queries
patterns.context: Appears as an SQL clause followed by a table name.

patterns.name: `from` in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In algebra problem text, it indicates transforming one expression into another; the shown activation falls on the English preposition `to`, not `from`.

patterns.name: `give` in math instructions
patterns.context: After an algebraic expression, the text asks for the value of a variable; `and` is also activated.

patterns.name: Italian `set`/series word forms
patterns.context: In “set­te date diverse” and “set­te diverse,” the activated fragments fall within Italian words or on adjacent words.

patterns.name: Periods and other sporadic activations
patterns.context: Appear in plotting code, math problems, or JSON snippets, without consistent local semantic conditions.
patterns.domain: Code, mathematical text, and structured text

2_1913.concept: From/from 字符串及局部格式片段
2_1913.description: 最明显的模式是大小写不同的 From/from：邮件发件人头字段、代码键或字符串、SQL 子句均出现；另有数学题中的 give、意大利语词内片段，以及分散的标点和换行激活，不能完全归为同一触发机制。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的 From 字段
patterns.context: 邮件头或正文中作为发件人字段的 From，常接冒号及发件人姓名；大小写不完全一致。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及邮件格式文本

patterns.name: 代码中的 from 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON 键、代码字符串或查询参数中；不是邮件头字段。
patterns.domain: Github、StackExchange 的代码或技术问答

patterns.name: SQL 查询中的 From
patterns.context: 作为 SQL 查询子句，后接表名。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 from
patterns.context: 代数题文字中表示从某表达式变换为另一表达式；所示激活落在英文介词 to，而非 from。

patterns.name: 数学指令中的 give
patterns.context: 代数表达式后要求给出某变量的值；«and»也有激活。

patterns.name: 意大利语中的 set/系列词形
patterns.context: 在“set­te date diverse”“set­te diverse”中，激活片段落在意大利语词内或相邻词上。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语政治文本

patterns.name: 句点及其他零散激活
patterns.context: 出现于绘图代码、数学题或 JSON 片段，缺乏一致的局部语义条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、数学文本及结构化文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across diverse texts: a colon in an email time field, `and` in syntax or citation markers, legal documents, idioms, JSON boundaries, and chemical experiment vocabulary. No stable common trigger pattern explains all examples; some activations may fall on common words, punctuation, or formatting fragments.

patterns.name: English colon
patterns.context: Appears in an email header time field, with digits immediately after the colon; parts of the time string on both sides of the colon are marked in this segment.

patterns.name: Word fragments around `and`
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the ordinary English conjunction `and` or on `and` embedded in a longer string; contexts include academic citations, coordinated chemical species, mathematical prose, and other English text. The exact activation position varies.

patterns.name: OF in court documents
patterns.context: Uppercase `OF` follows an attorney’s name and precedes `COUNSEL`, followed by a newline; the same passage also has lower-intensity activations on `Appeal`, `permission`, and `the`.

patterns.name: `feet` in an idiom
patterns.context: Appears in the expression “on its feet,” describing a newspaper becoming operational after its founding; the same passage also contains `partnership` and `this`.

patterns.name: JSON keys and string boundaries
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a JSON-style object, involving the left brace, newline, key name, and the boundary of a string value.

patterns.name: Common words in experimental procedures
patterns.context: Chemical experiment procedure text involving charging reagents, stirring, adding water, forming a solid, and filtering; markings are scattered across multiple sentence positions.

patterns.name: Scattered academic vocabulary
patterns.context: Different words in academic prose refer to theoretical speculation, mathematical method descriptions, and astrophysical processes; these words do not appear to form a unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Intra-word substring `and`
patterns.context: `and` occurs inside an author name or citation identifier in academic literature, rather than as an ordinary syntactic conjunction; this should be distinguished from activation on ordinary `and`.

2_1913.description: 激活分散于多种文本：邮件时间中的冒号、句法或引用标识中的 and、法律文书、习语、JSON 边界及化学实验词汇。未见能解释全部样本的稳定共同触发模式；部分激活可能落在常见词、标点或格式片段上。

patterns.name: 英文冒号
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头的时间字段中，冒号后紧接数字；该段中冒号两侧的时间字符串部分被标记。

patterns.name: and 周边词片段
patterns.context: 触发出现在普通英文连接词 and，或更长字符串中包含的 and；上下文包括学术引用、并列化学物种、数学叙述及其他英文文本。具体触发位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 法庭文书中的 OF
patterns.context: 大写 OF 位于律师姓名之后、COUNSEL 前，随后是换行；此外同段还有 Appeal、permission、the 等低强度激活词。

patterns.name: 习语中的 feet
patterns.context: 出现在“on its feet”这一表达中，描述报纸创办后开始运作；同段另有 partnership、this。

patterns.name: JSON 键与字符串边界
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON 样式对象的开头，涉及左花括号、换行、键名及键值字符串的边界。

patterns.name: 实验步骤中的常用词
patterns.context: 化学实验操作叙述中，涉及投料、搅拌、加水、生成固体和过滤；标记分散在句子多个位置。

patterns.name: 零散学术词汇
patterns.context: 学术论文叙述中的不同词汇，分别涉及理论推测、数学方法说明及天体物理过程；目前看不出这些词本身构成统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内子串 and
patterns.context: and 位于学术文献中的作者名或文献标识符内部，而非普通句法连接词；与普通 and 的激活需区分。

en.description: Activations are scattered across ordinary function words, punctuation, code/format separators, and various intra-word fragments; they span scientific, parliamentary, legal, coding, and email texts. The two legal passages are nearly duplicates; no stable semantic or morphological commonality is apparent in the rest.

patterns.name: Grammatical words, separators, and punctuation
patterns.context: Appears in ordinary sentences, French/Dutch parliamentary texts, legal texts, email headers, or code; activations are scattered, with no stable semantic collocation
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, code, and formatted text

patterns.name: Fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Annotations cluster on fragments inside different words, without showing a consistent morphological or semantic category
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, encyclopedias, legal texts, patents, code, email

patterns.name: JSON key-value fragments
patterns.context: In JSON-style objects, adjacent to quotation marks, colons, and strings

patterns.name: Dutch parliamentary proper names and word fragments
patterns.context: Dutch titles and parliamentary records; fragments span complete words and parts of words

patterns.name: Fragments within French words
patterns.context: In French parliamentary speech, activations fall within fragments of multiple words

patterns.name: Fixed legal phrases
patterns.context: Adjacent to legal expressions such as “findings of fact,” “of law,” and “held in abeyance”; the two passages are almost identical

patterns.name: Code identifiers and query syntax
patterns.context: C#-style object member assignments and LINQ query fragments

patterns.name: Email header fields
patterns.context: A quoted-printable email header containing a date and sender name

2_1913.description: 激活位置分散于普通功能词、标点、代码/格式分隔符及多种词内片段；涵盖科研、议会、法律、代码和邮件。法律两段近乎重复，其余看不出稳定语义或词形共性。

patterns.name: 语法词、分隔符及标点
patterns.context: 出现在普通句子、法语/荷兰语议会文本、法律文本、邮件头或代码中；激活位置分散，未见稳定的语义搭配
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、代码及格式化文本

patterns.name: 特定词内的片段
patterns.context: 标注集中在不同单词的内部片段，未显示一致的词形或语义类别
patterns.domain: 科研论文、百科、法律、专利、代码、邮件

patterns.name: JSON键值片段
patterns.context: JSON样式对象中，紧邻引号、冒号及字符串

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会专名与词片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语标题及议会记录，片段横跨完整词和词内部分

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中，激活落在多个词的内部片段

patterns.name: 法律固定短语
patterns.context: 与“findings of fact”“of law”“held in abeyance”等法律语句相邻；两段内容几乎重复

patterns.name: 代码标识符与查询语法
patterns.context: C#样式对象成员赋值及 LINQ 查询片段

patterns.name: 邮件头字段
patterns.context: quoted-printable 邮件头，包含日期、发件人姓名

en.description: Activations are scattered across several types of word fragments: English function words, Dutch parliamentary word forms, the suffix of `abeyance`, and academic proper names and transliterated text. There is no unified semantic theme; some patterns are more consistent with local word forms or substrings.

patterns.name: Intra-word substring “vande”
patterns.context: `and` occurs inside a split word, possibly in Sanskrit transliteration or a proper name; there is no stable semantic condition nearby.

patterns.name: Intra-word substring “and”
patterns.context: `and` appears inside proper names, citation identifiers, or word forms; it is also marked as a standalone word in ordinary sentences, but strong activation often falls on intra-word fragments.

patterns.name: Intra-word substring “eyance”
patterns.context: The complete word `abeyance` is split across multiple tokens, with the strongest activation on the suffix fragment “ance”; in legal contexts it refers to an application being held in abeyance, and it also appears in a context where a bank branch suspends operations.

patterns.name: Dutch word-form fragments
patterns.context: These fragments are embedded in continuous Dutch word forms such as “orde,” “verslag,” and “debat”; activation is concentrated in headings and descriptions of parliamentary procedure.

patterns.name: English function words and local collocations
patterns.context: A few common English words are marked, but their meanings and syntactic positions differ, with no single stable collocation apparent.

patterns.name: Letters/word chunks in proper names
patterns.context: Appears in author affiliations and French addresses in astronomy research papers; the triggered fragments are mostly proper names, place names, or address terms.

2_1913.description: 激活分散在多类词片段：英文功能词、荷兰语议会词形、abeyance词尾，以及学术专名和转写文本；没有统一语义主题，部分规律更像局部词形或子串。

patterns.name: 词内子串“vande”
patterns.context: and 位于被切分的词内部，可能是梵语转写或专名；周围没有稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 词内子串“and”
patterns.context: and 出现在专名、引文标识或词形内部；在一般句子中也标记独立词 and，但强激活常落在词内片段。

patterns.name: 词内子串“eyance”
patterns.context: 完整词 abeyance 被分成多个 token，最强激活落在词尾片段“ance”；法律语境中指申请暂缓处理，另有银行分行暂停营业语境。
patterns.domain: 法律文书与历史/银行史

patterns.name: 荷兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 这些片段嵌在荷兰语连续词形中，如 “orde”“verslag”“debat”；激活集中在标题及议会程序表述。

patterns.name: 英文功能词及局部搭配
patterns.context: 少量英文常见词被标记，词义和句法位置并不一致，未见单一稳定搭配。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母/词块
patterns.context: 出现在天文研究论文的作者单位和法国地址中，触发片段多属专名、地名或地址词。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 作者地址/机构信息

en.description: Activations are scattered across `mandate` and `deeds` in legal documents, `from` indicating origin or source, the statistical ratio `out of`, and scientific measurement and historical partnership contexts; no single word sense runs through all examples.

patterns.name: `mandato` in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in a legal context where a court is petitioned to issue a writ of mandate requiring the defendant to perform a duty.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal proceedings

patterns.name: `from` in English phrases
patterns.context: The preposition indicates source, starting point, or the start of a range; examples include numerical ranges, code key names in Russian explanations, and JSON snippets.

patterns.name: Ratio expression `out of`
patterns.context: Used to express the number or proportion of cases, tissues, or samples as “some number out of a total.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, tissue surveys, medical abstracts

patterns.name: `deeds` in court decisions
patterns.context: Used in the phrase `recorder of deeds`, referring to the real-estate deed recording office.

patterns.name: Measurements and technical terms in scientific text
patterns.context: Descriptions of material preparation and instrument measurements involve spectra, resolution, and units; activation also falls on connectives, so there is no clear single-term trigger pattern.

patterns.name: `partnership` in historical narrative
patterns.context: Describes a newspaper proprietor leaving and their child establishing a partnership with someone else.

2_1913.description: 激活分散于法律文书中的 mandate、deeds，表示起点或来源的 from，统计比例 out of，以及科学测量和历史合作语境；没有贯穿全部例子的单一词义。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 mandato
patterns.context: 出现在申请法院签发 writ of mandate、要求被告履行职责的法律语境中。
patterns.domain: 美国法院意见、法律诉讼

patterns.name: 英语词组中的 from
patterns.context: 作为表示来源、起点或范围起点的介词；包括数值范围、俄文说明里的代码键名，以及 JSON 片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、俄语 StackExchange、代码/JSON

patterns.name: 比例表达 out of
patterns.context: 用于以“若干 out of 总数”表达病例、组织或样本数量/比例。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、组织调查、医学摘要

patterns.name: 法律判决中的 deeds
patterns.context: 与 recorder of deeds 连用，指不动产契据登记机关。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的测量与技术术语
patterns.context: 材料制备及仪器测量描述中，涉及光谱、分辨率和单位；激活也落在连接词上，未显示为清晰的单一术语触发模式。
patterns.domain: 材料科学/分析化学论文

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的 partnership
patterns.context: 描述报纸经营者离开后，其子与他人建立合作关系。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科历史叙述

en.description: Primarily responds to quantitative information, especially ranges, percentages, weight ratios, measurement parameters, and sample statistics; it also activates on local phrases involving legal discretion, partnerships, patent numbers, JSON fields, and chemical procedures.

patterns.name: Measurement and composition percentages
patterns.context: Quantifies ratios, ranges, concentrations, measurement parameters, or sample statistics in experimental methods, patent formulations, or research results; often accompanied by units such as `percent`, `%`, `by weight`, and `cm`.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent texts, medical research

patterns.name: Discretionary action in legal proceedings
patterns.context: A legal procedural context where a court may act on its own initiative, with nearby words relating to petitions, motions, parties, or court orders.

patterns.name: Interpersonal cooperation and partnership
patterns.context: Describes people or organizations operating or cooperating together, or forming a partnership.

patterns.name: Patent numbers and ownership
patterns.context: Lists issued patents and states their ownership; numerical identifiers are adjacent to words such as `patent(s)` and `inventor`.

patterns.name: JSON field names
patterns.context: Appears as a key in JSON or code snippets, followed by a colon and string value.

patterns.name: Experimental operations and product separation
patterns.context: Describes consecutive steps in a synthesis experiment: adding and stirring, pouring in a solvent, forming a product, and separating it by filtration.

2_1913.concept: 定量信息及结构化文本细节
2_1913.description: 主要响应数字化的定量信息，尤其是范围、百分比、重量比例、测量参数与样本统计；另对法律裁量、伙伴关系、专利编号、JSON字段及化学操作等局部短语有激活。

patterns.name: 计量与组成百分比
patterns.trigger: 数字、范围及单位，如“100:21”“4,000 and 6 400 cm^−1^”“from about 35 percent to about 98 percent”“0.01 to 5% by weight”“35.7% (15 out of 42 cases)”
patterns.context: 在实验方法、专利配方或研究结果中，以数字量化比例、范围、浓度、测量参数或样本统计；常伴随 percent、%、by weight、cm 等单位。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利文本、医学研究

patterns.name: 法律程序中的裁量行动
patterns.context: 法院可自行采取行动的法律程序语境，周围出现申请、动议、当事方或法院命令等词。

patterns.name: 人际合作与伙伴关系
patterns.context: 描述人物或组织共同经营、合作或建立伙伴关系。

patterns.name: 专利编号与权利归属
patterns.trigger: “6,1183,101”“6,123,616”“5,926,440”等专利号及“owned by the current inventor”
patterns.context: 列举已授权专利，并说明其归属；数字编号与 patent(s)、inventor 等词相邻。

patterns.name: JSON 字段名
patterns.context: JSON 或代码片段中作为键名出现，后接冒号及字符串值。

patterns.name: 实验操作与产物分离
patterns.trigger: “was added”“was stirred”“was poured into water”“yielded and isolated by filtration”
patterns.context: 描述合成实验中加入、搅拌、倒入溶剂、生成并过滤分离产物的连续步骤。

en.description: Activations occur in experimental methods and measurements, patent technical parameters and formulations, analytical calibration, medical case counts, and a few historical texts and code fragments; there is no single clear semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Experimental procedures and instrument measurements in papers
patterns.context: Describes sample preparation, reaction treatment, instrument measurements, or experimental steps, often using past tense, passive voice, and specific parameters.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, especially chemistry and materials experiments; passages 1, 2, 6

patterns.name: Technical parameters and compositional constraints in patents
patterns.context: In patent background or claims contexts, describes technical phenomena, formulation proportions, or patent ownership.

patterns.name: Study design and standard samples
patterns.context: Describes experimental design, calibration matrices, and standards and blank samples.
patterns.domain: Analytical methods research in PubMed abstracts; passage 8

patterns.name: Counting expressions in case proportions
patterns.context: Reports case counts in numerator/denominator form, in clinical treatment or outcome descriptions.

patterns.name: The phrase partnership
patterns.context: Describes entering a partnership with someone after a transfer of newspaper management rights; no obvious experimental or patent context.

patterns.name: JSON key from
patterns.context: Used as a JSON object key in a code snippet, with quotation marks, a colon, and json-schema-traverse nearby.

2_1913.description: 激活分布于实验方法与测量、专利技术参数和配方、分析校准、医学病例计数，以及少数历史文本和代码片段；没有单一明确的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 论文中的实验流程与仪器测量
patterns.trigger: « mixture»、« pellets»、« spectra»、« resolution»、« heated»、« reaction»、« monitored»、« filtration»
patterns.context: 描述样品制备、反应处理、仪器测量或实验步骤，常见过去时、被动语态与具体参数。
patterns.domain: 科学论文，尤其化学与材料实验；段1、2、6

patterns.name: 专利中的技术参数与成分限定
patterns.trigger: « number» of « prints»、« particle size»、« resolution»、« developing»；«%» by « weight»；« issued» « patents»
patterns.context: 专利背景或权利要求语境中，说明技术现象、配方比例或专利权属。

patterns.name: 统计设计与标准样品
patterns.context: 描述实验设计、校准矩阵及标准品和空白样品。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的分析方法研究；段8

patterns.name: 病例比例中的计数表达
patterns.context: 以分子/分母形式报告病例数，并处于临床治疗或结局描述中。

patterns.name: 短语 partnership
patterns.context: 描述报纸经营权交接后与某人合伙；未见明显实验或专利语境。

patterns.name: JSON 键名 from
patterns.context: 代码片段中作为 JSON 对象的键名，附近有引号、冒号及 json-schema-traverse。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across legal terminology, applications held in abeyance, patent formulations, chemical experiments and spectroscopy, medical statistics, and historical narratives. `abeyance` recurs, alongside several common function words and local collocations, but no unified semantic rule is apparent.

patterns.name: Legal term `mandate`
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving court orders, pleadings, or judicial review; it is often adjacent to `application`, and `to compel` also conveys its compulsory nature.

patterns.name: `abeyance` and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Means that an application or matter is temporarily suspended; the trigger falls near the suffix/intra-word fragments `ance` or `ey`, in contexts explicitly involving procedural suspension.
patterns.domain: Legal documents; the same word also appears in a historical narrative

patterns.name: Weight percentages in patent formulations
patterns.context: Describes composition ingredients and their weight ratios, often with numerical ranges, chemical substances, and claim-style lists.

patterns.name: Experimental procedures and sample processing
patterns.context: Sequentially describes adding materials, stirring, pouring into water, precipitating a solid, filtering, and drying.

patterns.name: Instrument analysis parameters
patterns.context: Describes spectral measurements and instrument parameters, including wavenumbers, units, and equipment models.

patterns.name: Numerical comparisons and clinical statistics
patterns.context: Reports numerical changes or case denominators, with nearby medical outcomes, proportions, and case counts.

patterns.name: `application` in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Refers to an application submitted to a court; the passage involves habeas corpus, findings of fact at trial, or an application for a stay.

patterns.name: Organization members and representative titles
patterns.context: Lists members of a legislature and describes them as plaintiffs seeking relief from a court.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of litigants in judicial opinions

patterns.name: Common collocations in historical texts
patterns.context: Historical figures and newspaper business narratives; activations are scattered across common words and fixed collocations, without a clear semantic link to the other passages.

patterns.name: Common prepositions and conjunctions
patterns.context: Appears in general narrative or technical text, with no stable, independent trigger condition; may be a local accompanying activation.

2_1913.description: 强激活分散于法律术语、申请暂缓、专利配方、化学实验与光谱、医学统计及历史叙述；其中“abeyance”重复出现，另有若干普通功能词和局部搭配，未见统一语义规则。

patterns.name: “mandate”法律术语
patterns.context: 出现在法院命令、诉状或司法审查语境中；多次与“application”相邻，也有“to compel”说明其强制性。
patterns.domain: 判决、法律意见及诉讼文书

patterns.name: “abeyance”及词内片段
patterns.context: 表示申请或事项暂缓处理；触发点落在词尾/词内的“ance”或“ey”附近，语境明确为程序暂缓。
patterns.domain: 法律文书；另有历史叙述中的同词

patterns.name: 专利配方中的重量百分比
patterns.context: 描述组合物成分及其重量比例，常见数字范围、化学物质和权利要求式列举。

patterns.name: 实验步骤与样品处理
patterns.context: 按顺序叙述加料、搅拌、倒入水中、析出固体、过滤和干燥等操作。

patterns.name: 仪器分析参数
patterns.context: 描述光谱测量及仪器参数，含波数、单位和设备型号。
patterns.domain: 材料/化学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 数值比较及临床统计
patterns.context: 报告数值变化或病例分母，周围有医学结局、比例和病例数。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的“application”
patterns.context: 指向法院提出的申请；段落涉及人身保护令、审理事实认定或申请暂缓。

patterns.name: 组织成员与代表称谓
patterns.context: 列举立法机关成员，并说明其作为原告向法院申请救济。
patterns.domain: 司法意见中的诉讼当事人描述

patterns.name: 历史文本中的普通搭配
patterns.context: 历史人物与报纸经营叙述；激活分散在普通词语及固定搭配上，缺乏与其他段明确的语义联系。

patterns.name: 普通介词及连词
patterns.context: 出现在一般叙述或技术文本中，未见稳定且独立的触发条件，可能是局部伴随激活。

en.concept: Local patterns in heterogeneous technical text
en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: they include numerical ranges, percentages, and case counts; `abeyance` in legal/historical contexts; and local strings in patents, code, mathematics, and experimental methods. No single pattern explains all the snippets.

patterns.name: Number, unit, and percentage formatting
patterns.context: Activation falls near numbers, ranges, percent signs, or adjacent measurement expressions; no specific domain is required.

patterns.name: Word form `abeyance`
patterns.context: The word appears in the legal or historical expression “in abeyance,” with activation concentrated on the suffix “ance.”

patterns.name: BSD makefile markers
patterns.context: Appears in an `include` directive in a Makefile rule or build script.
patterns.domain: GitHub code, BSD ports build configurations

patterns.name: `in` in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A math problem asks for a polynomial to be written in a specified form; activation falls on the preposition connecting the expression to “the form.”

patterns.name: `from` in patent numbers
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph introduces related patent numbers using published patent application numbers.

patterns.name: Ingredient lists in patent formulations
patterns.context: Lists ingredients and weight-percentage ranges in patents for formulations or compositions.

patterns.name: API template placeholders
patterns.context: Code markers appear in discussions of route templates, queries, or request-header parameter binding.

patterns.name: FTIR spectroscopy descriptions
patterns.context: A methods sentence describes the instrument, spectral range, and resolution.

patterns.name: Medical case-count expressions
patterns.context: Reports a proportion or the occurrence of a treatment/variant using case counts and a total number of people.

2_1913.concept: 异质技术文本局部模式
2_1913.description: 激活模式较分散：包括数值范围、百分比与病例计数，法律/历史语境中的 abeyance，及专利、代码、数学和实验方法中的局部词串；没有一个模式能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 数值与单位、百分比的格式
patterns.context: 激活落在数值、范围、百分号或相邻计量表达附近；不要求特定领域。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利、医学摘要

patterns.name: abeyance 词形
patterns.context: 该词出现在“in abeyance”这一法律或历史叙述语境中，激活集中在词尾“ance”。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科历史文本

patterns.name: BSD make 文件标记
patterns.context: 出现在 Makefile 规则或构建脚本的 include 指令中。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码、BSD ports 构建配置

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 in
patterns.context: 数学题目要求将多项式写成指定形式；激活落在连接表达式与“the form”的介词上。

patterns.name: 专利号中的 from
patterns.context: 专利背景段落通过专利申请公开编号引出相关专利号。

patterns.name: 专利配方的成分列举
patterns.trigger: “a base oil and, based on a total amount of the composition”及“by weight of”
patterns.context: 配方或组合物专利中列举成分及其重量百分比范围。

patterns.name: API 模板占位符
patterns.context: 讨论路由模板、查询或请求头参数绑定时出现的代码标记。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、软件开发

patterns.name: FTIR 光谱实验描述
patterns.context: 描述仪器、光谱范围与分辨率的实验方法句。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、材料表征方法

patterns.name: 医学病例计数表达
patterns.trigger: “15 out of 42 cases”“three out of 15”“12 out of 29”
patterns.context: 以病例数和总人数给出比例或治疗/变异发生情况。

en.description: Activations are scattered across different styles: `abeyance` and writs of mandate in legal text, patent citations, experimental parameters and case ratios, historical partnership narratives, and build files and query code. Apart from local fixed phrases, no unified semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: `abeyance` and fixed legal expressions
patterns.context: “held in abeyance” appears near the end of a sentence and refers to an application being held in abeyance; “in abeyance” also describes a branch suspending operations during a war.

patterns.name: Numbers and hyphens in patent citations
patterns.context: In patent or technical-literature citations, a number is followed by “from which” and an abbreviation for a U.S. patent number; high activation falls on “which”.

patterns.name: Scientific measurements and instrument parameters
patterns.context: Methods list measurement ranges, units, instruments, and resolution; activation is concentrated near numbers/symbols and `resolution`.

patterns.name: `out of` expressions for case proportions
patterns.context: Medication proportions are reported using a numerator/denominator and total case count; activation is concentrated on `out of` and the quantity expression.

patterns.name: Journalism figures and partnerships
patterns.context: Narrates a newspaper being taken over and operated by someone, and describes their partnership with another person; high activation falls on `partnership`.

patterns.name: Request for a writ of mandate in a judicial decision
patterns.context: The decision describes the plaintiff's identity and application, and asks the court to compel the defendant to perform a duty; high activation falls on `Representatives` and `mandate`.

patterns.name: BSD build-file directive
patterns.context: A BSD ports Makefile snippet uses an `include` directive to load build rules.

patterns.name: Joined queries and field mapping in code
patterns.context: A query expression maps fields and joins query results with another data source; activation falls on indentation, property names, `from`, and `in`.

2_1913.description: 激活分散在多种文体：法律中的 abeyance 与强制令、专利引用、实验参数和病例比例、历史合伙叙述，以及构建文件和查询代码；除局部固定词句外，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: “abeyance”及固定法律表达
patterns.context: “held in abeyance”出现在句末附近，指申请暂缓处理；另有“in abeyance”描述分支在战争期间暂停营业。

patterns.name: 专利引用中的编号与连字符
patterns.trigger: “Japanese Patent Application laid-open No. 5-557904, from which U.S. Pat. No.”，尤其“557904, from« which»10 U.S.”
patterns.context: 专利或技术文献引用中，编号后接“from which”和美国专利号缩写；高激活落在“which”。

patterns.name: 科学计量与仪器参数
patterns.trigger: “4,000 and 400 cm^−1 by using a Bruker Vector 33 spectrometer at a resolution of 4.0 cm^−1”
patterns.context: 实验方法中列举测量范围、单位、仪器及分辨率；激活集中在数值/符号与“resolution”附近。

patterns.name: 病例比例的‘out of’表达
patterns.context: 用分子/分母和病例总数报告用药比例；激活集中在“out of”及数量表达。

patterns.name: 新闻业人物与合伙关系
patterns.context: 叙述报纸由某人接手经营，并说明其与他人合伙；高激活在“partnership”。

patterns.name: 司法判决中的强制令请求
patterns.trigger: “application to this Court for a writ of mandate to compel”
patterns.context: 判决书交代原告身份、申请及请求法院强制被告履行职责；高激活在“Representatives”和“mandate”。

patterns.name: BSD 构建文件指令
patterns.context: BSD ports 的 Makefile 片段，以 include 指令加载构建规则。

patterns.name: 代码中的联合查询与字段映射
patterns.context: 查询表达式中映射字段并将查询结果与另一数据源联合；激活落在缩进、属性名及“from”“in”。

en.concept: English function words and local syntactic structures
en.description: Activations are widely scattered: common English function words occur across domains; specific lexical items also appear in chemical experimental procedures, legal proceedings, patent references, and medical counts, while a few triggers come from subword fragments or formatting whitespace.

patterns.name: Grammatical function words and common connective structures
patterns.context: Appears in various syntactic positions, including coordination, prepositional phrases, passive constructions, and quantity expressions; specific words vary by passage.

patterns.name: Experimental steps and reaction-process vocabulary
patterns.context: Chemical experimental methods describe procedures such as heating, stirring, cooling, separating, or treating mixtures.

patterns.name: Motions and applications in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Contexts in which a court may take procedural action at a party’s request, on motion, or on its own initiative.

patterns.name: Introducing or referential relations in technical literature
patterns.context: Patent specifications cite prior patents and use relational words to connect technical sources or device descriptions.

patterns.name: Counting and proportion expressions
patterns.context: Describes statistical results using total case counts, subsets, or proportions.

patterns.name: Participle or word-form fragment
patterns.context: Appears once in a historical narrative describing a newspaper as bribed or corrupted.

patterns.name: Build-system template placeholder
patterns.context: Indented whitespace in a Makefile command line; surrounded by variable expansion and BSD Ports build rules.

patterns.name: Stem fragment within a word boundary
patterns.context: Found only near scientific notation or citation identifiers; the triggering fragment itself has no clear shared semantic meaning.

2_1913.concept: 英语功能词与局部语法结构
2_1913.description: 激活分布很散：常见英语功能词在多领域出现；另在化学实验流程、法律程序、专利指引和医学计数中出现特定词项，少数触发来自词片段或格式空白。

patterns.name: 语法功能词与常见连接结构
patterns.context: 在多种句法位置出现，包括并列、介词短语、被动结构和数量表达；具体词项因段而异。

patterns.name: 实验步骤与反应过程词汇
patterns.context: 化学实验方法中描述加热、搅拌、冷却、分离或处理混合物的流程。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的动议与申请
patterns.context: 法院可依当事人申请、动议或自行决定采取程序措施的语境。

patterns.name: 技术文献中的引出或指向关系
patterns.context: 专利说明书引述既有专利，并用关系词连接技术来源或装置说明。

patterns.name: 计数与比例表达
patterns.context: 以病例总数、子集或比例说明统计结果。

patterns.name: 分词或词形片段
patterns.context: 单次出现在描述报纸遭贿赂或腐化的历史叙述里。

patterns.name: 构建系统模板占位符
patterns.context: Makefile 命令行中的缩进空白；周围是变量展开与 BSD 端口构建规则。

patterns.name: 分词边界内的词干片段
patterns.trigger: «g»、«ib»、«and»（分别嵌在 g/mol、gib、v&?and? 文本片段中）
patterns.context: 仅见于科学记号或引用标识符附近，触发片段本身不构成清晰共同语义。

en.concept: Local word forms and experimental/counting terms
en.description: The clearest pattern is the suffix of `abeyance`; activations also occur in case-counting with `out of`, spectral resolution, chemical operations, and `and` fragments in academic citations or names.

patterns.name: Suffix of `abeyance`
patterns.context: In fixed expressions such as “held in abeyance” or “had been in abeyance,” activation falls on the word suffix;

patterns.name: Counting structure with `of`
patterns.context: The “out of N” structure expresses the proportion of samples or cases, with activation concentrated on `out` and `of`;

patterns.name: Spectral resolution
patterns.context: A parameter in FTIR spectral measurements specifies the spectrometer's resolution;

patterns.name: Filtration step
patterns.context: An experimental step separates the crude product after chemical synthesis;

patterns.name: `trapped` and local collocations
patterns.context: Discusses molecules potentially trapped in an ice matrix;

patterns.name: Citation or name fragments containing `and`
patterns.context: Activation appears in token fragments of reference identifiers or author names;

patterns.name: Mixture and reaction operations
patterns.context: Preparation, stirring, and workup of a reaction mixture;

2_1913.concept: 局部词形与实验/计数术语
2_1913.description: 最清晰的模式是 abeyance 的词尾；此外还激活于病例“out of”计数、光谱分辨率、化学操作，以及学术引文或姓名中的 and 片段。

patterns.name: abeyance 的词尾
patterns.context: “held in abeyance”或“had been in abeyance”这类固定搭配中，激活落在单词词尾；

patterns.name: of 的计数结构
patterns.context: 表示样本或病例数量占比的“out of N”结构，激活集中在 out、of；

patterns.name: 光谱分辨率
patterns.context: FTIR 光谱测量参数中，说明光谱仪的分辨率；

patterns.name: 过滤步骤
patterns.context: 化学合成后分离粗产物的实验步骤；

patterns.name: trapped 及其局部搭配
patterns.context: 讨论分子可能被冰基质捕获；

patterns.name: and 的引用或姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在参考文献标识或作者姓名的 token 片段中；

patterns.name: 混合物与反应操作
patterns.context: 反应混合物的制备、搅拌和后处理；

en.description: Activations are scattered across several types of phrases: abeyance, writ of mandate, and several function words in legal documents; out of in medical proportions; and in academic coordination; and organizations in an organizational survey.

patterns.name: abeyance in legal contexts
patterns.context: In legal documents, indicates that an application or proceeding is suspended, commonly in the collocation “held in abeyance”; the same text fragment is repeated.

patterns.name: Legal collocation of mandate
patterns.context: Appears in “writ of mandate,” referring to a writ; nearby context involves a court, parties, or a legal claim.

patterns.name: out of in quantity expressions
patterns.context: Introduces sample or case counts with out of, commonly used to report proportions; activation strength falls on different tokens in the phrase.

patterns.name: and in technical academic text
patterns.context: A coordinating conjunction in academic explanations, appearing in lists of experimental methods, research results, or scientific objects.

patterns.name: Other function-word activations in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears separately in legal sentences at “Relators,” “This application,” “In this petition,” and “the action”; no uniform local collocation is evident.

patterns.name: organizations in an organizational survey
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of surveyed organizations that consider mentoring important; the trigger falls near the noun phrase.

2_1913.description: 激活分散在多类短语：法律文书中的 abeyance、writ of mandate及若干功能词；医学比例中的 out of；学术并列中的 and；另见组织调查中的 organizations。

patterns.name: 法律语境中的 abeyance
patterns.context: 法律文书中，表示申请或程序暂缓，常见搭配为“held in abeyance”；相同文本片段重复出现。

patterns.name: mandate 的法律搭配
patterns.context: 出现在“writ of mandate”中，指令状；相邻语境涉及法院、当事人或诉讼请求。

patterns.name: 数量表达中的 out of
patterns.context: 以 out of 引出样本或病例数，常用于报告比例；触发强度落在短语不同 token 上。

patterns.name: 技术性学术文本中的 and
patterns.context: 学术说明中的并列连接词，出现在实验方法、研究结果或科学对象并列中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与天体物理学术文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的其他功能词激活
patterns.context: 法律句子中分别出现在“Relators”“This application”“In this petition”“the action”等位置；未见统一的局部搭配。

patterns.name: 组织调查中的 organizations
patterns.context: 报告受访组织中认为导师制重要的比例，触发落在名词短语附近。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across Finnish word-internal fragments, fragments of place and personal names, and words such as schematic, conference, evidence, proteasome, and rectification. Some word-internal triggers may involve local subword morphology, but no semantic or formatting pattern unifies all examples.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual word-internal fragment uh
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs inside words, in Finnish forms such as «uhreiksi» and «uhke»; the context is ordinary words in complete sentences.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment Ts in a proper noun
patterns.context: The fragment occurs inside the proper noun Tsukuba, preceded by Mount and followed by Ropeway; the standalone proper-noun heading is followed by a line break.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Japanese names
patterns.context: Multiple marked fragments occur within romanized personal names; the names are then repeated on the following line, where the repetitions also activate strongly.

patterns.name: schematic in figure descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in patent figure descriptions and scientific paper captions, describing a schematic or schematic view.

patterns.name: conference at sentence end
patterns.context: Appears in promotional product copy describing where a portable interactive whiteboard can be used, as the final item in a list of locations, immediately before a period.

patterns.name: Disease-treatment wording
patterns.context: The phrase “evidence-based treatments” discusses treatment options; activation falls on evidence.

patterns.name: Biomedical proteasome
patterns.context: A word-internal substring forms proteasome, in scientific descriptions of the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway and mitotic protein proteolysis.

patterns.name: Cryogenic air distillation
patterns.context: A word-internal substring forms rectification, referring to cryogenic air rectification to produce oxygen and nitrogen.

2_2055.description: 强激活分散在芬兰语词内片段、地名和人名片段，以及 schematic、conference、evidence、proteasome、rectification 等不同词中；部分词内触发可能涉及局部子词形态，但没有覆盖全部例子的统一语义或格式规律。

patterns.name: 跨语言词内片段 uh
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在词内部，分别位于芬兰语 «uhreiksi» 和 «uhke» 一类词形中；上下文为完整句子中的普通词语。

patterns.name: 专名内部片段 Ts
patterns.context: 片段位于专名 Tsukuba 内部，前有 Mount，后接 Ropeway；独立专名标题后有换行。

patterns.name: 日文人名内部片段
patterns.context: 多个被标记的片段分布在罗马字人名内部；姓名随后以换行重复，重复处也有较强激活。

patterns.name: 图示中的 schematic
patterns.context: 出现在专利附图说明及科研论文图注中，描述示意图或示意视图。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、科研论文图注

patterns.name: 句末 conference
patterns.context: 出现在介绍便携式交互白板使用场所的产品宣传句中，作为地点列举的末项并紧接句号。

patterns.name: 疾病治疗措辞
patterns.context: 短语 “evidence-based treatments”，讨论治疗方案；激活落在 evidence。

patterns.name: 生物医学 proteasome
patterns.context: 词内子串组成 proteasome，处于泛素-蛋白酶体通路及有丝分裂蛋白水解的科研描述中。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学项目摘要

patterns.name: 空气低温精馏
patterns.context: 词内子串组成 rectification，指空气低温精馏以生产氧和氮。

en.description: The activation distribution is highly mixed: internal fragments of proper names, Finnish words related to harm, diagram terminology, fragments within scientific and technical words, and several singleton collocations and unit characters; there is no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Proper names capitalized at the beginning of English words
patterns.context: Proper names such as people’s and place names appear capitalized in sentence-initial or title-style form; activation concentrates at the beginning of the word or on internal subword fragments of the name. No specific semantic category is required.

patterns.name: Words involving harm or adverse circumstances
patterns.context: In Finnish passages, activation falls on word fragments related to being threatened or being in difficult circumstances; Finnish morphological segmentation is also present.

patterns.name: Diagram or schematic descriptions
patterns.context: schematic receives strong activation when describing a diagram, schematic, or illustration of experimental apparatus.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in scientific or technical terms
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on internal substrings of longer compound terms or technical words, rather than on complete word boundaries; the specific terms have different meanings.
patterns.domain: Biomedical project abstracts, patent technical backgrounds

patterns.name: conference in frequent product promotional copy
patterns.context: In product descriptions listing places where a device can be used, conference appears as a place noun.

patterns.name: evidence in a strong-evidence collocation
patterns.context: The phrase begins with Many and describes evidence supporting a type of treatment.

patterns.name: Unit letters in particle-velocity units
patterns.context: In physics experiment captions, the velocity unit is written as μm/s; activation is distributed across the backslash and unit characters, rather than concentrated on a single word sense.

2_2055.description: 激活分布很杂：专名内部片段、芬兰语危害相关词、图示术语、科学技术词内片段，以及若干单例搭配和单位字符；没有统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 英语词首字母大写的专名
patterns.context: 人名或地名等专名以句首/标题式大写形式出现，激活集中在词首或专名内部子词片段；不要求特定语义类别。

patterns.name: 涉及危害或不利处境的词
patterns.context: 芬兰语段落中，激活落在与受威胁、处境艰难相关的词语片段；也伴随芬兰语形态切分。

patterns.name: 图示/示意图表述
patterns.context: 描述图、示意图或实验装置的图示时，schematic 获得强激活。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书与科学论文

patterns.name: 科学或技术术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 强激活落在较长复合术语或技术词的内部子串，而非完整词边界；具体术语含义不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学项目摘要、专利技术背景

patterns.name: 高频产品宣传文案中的 conference
patterns.context: 产品介绍列举设备可使用的场所时，conference 作为场所名词出现。

patterns.name: 强证据搭配中的 evidence
patterns.context: 短语以 Many 开头，描述证据支持某类治疗。

patterns.name: 粒子速度单位中的单位字母
patterns.context: 物理实验图注中，速度单位写作 μm/s；激活分散于反斜线及单位字符，强度并不集中在单一词义上。

en.description: High activation is distributed across Finnish word fragments and English instances of conference, schematic, regulation, then, inset, medical terms, and evidence. The styles span parliamentary text, product copy, patents, forums, and papers, with no unified triggering semantics.

patterns.name: Finnish stems/internal word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized fragments within Finnish words, appearing in “uhreiksi joutuvat” (become victims) and “uhke”; no specific syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: conference in English meeting-related words
patterns.context: Appears in English product promotional copy describing uses for a portable interactive whiteboard, listing classrooms, meeting rooms, or conference venues.

patterns.name: schematic in patent diagrams
patterns.context: Used in descriptions of patent illustrations, followed by view to describe the device or experiment shown in an accompanying figure.

patterns.name: Regulation in medical research
patterns.context: Appears in an NIH project abstract describing the role of the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway in a biological process.

patterns.name: English internal fragment en
patterns.context: Embedded within “enabling,” in product copy introducing the use of interactive whiteboards by teachers and presenters; its relation to other high-activation patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: then in mathematical text
patterns.context: Connects a list of mathematical research topics in English, followed by a transition to topics such as Hopf algebras.

patterns.name: inset in paper captions
patterns.context: Introduces the content of an illustration in an experimental figure caption describing a particle experiment.

patterns.name: Medical morphemes in paper abstracts
patterns.context: Appear in medical abstracts on placental pregnancy complications and fecal samples containing drug-resistant bacteria; highlights are distributed across medical terms rather than one fixed word.

patterns.name: General English noun evidence
patterns.context: Used in an evidence-based treatment abbreviation and in a statement about evidence in placental research; the meanings are medically related but the contexts differ.

patterns.name: English article/function-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ordinary English function word a in an experimental description; this is a singleton with no clear specialized semantic condition.

2_2055.description: 高激活分散在芬兰语词内片段及英语中的会议、示意图、调控、then、inset、医学术语和 evidence；文体跨议会、产品文案、专利、论坛与论文，未见统一触发语义。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词干/词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在芬兰语单词内部的分词片段，分别出现在“uhreiksi joutuvat”（成为受害者）和“uhke”等词中；不要求特定句法位置。

patterns.name: 英语会议相关词中的 conference
patterns.context: 出现在介绍便携式互动白板用途的英语产品宣传句中，列举教室、会议室或会议场所。

patterns.name: 专利图示中的 schematic
patterns.context: 用于专利说明书的图示描述，后接 view，说明附图展示的设备或实验。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的调控
patterns.context: 出现在描述泛素-蛋白酶体途径对生物过程发挥作用的 NIH 项目摘要中。

patterns.name: 英语词内片段 en
patterns.context: 嵌在 “enabling” 的词内片段中，位于介绍教师与演示者使用互动白板的产品文案里；与其他高激活模式关系不明。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 then
patterns.context: 连接一串数学研究主题的英语列表，随后转入 Hopf 代数等内容。

patterns.name: 论文图注中的 inset
patterns.context: 实验图注中引出示意图内容，描述粒子实验的插图。

patterns.name: 论文摘要中的医学词素
patterns.context: 分别出现在胎盘相关妊娠并发症研究，以及耐药细菌粪便样本研究的医学摘要中；高亮分布于医学术语，而非单一固定词。

patterns.name: 通用英语名词 evidence
patterns.context: 分别用于循证治疗缩写和胎盘研究中的证据表述，语义与医学研究相关但上下文不同。

patterns.name: 英语冠词/小词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英语功能词 a 上，处于实验描述句中；单例，缺少明确的专门语义条件。

en.concept: Word fragments and local vocabulary mix
en.description: Activations often fall on English st-initial subwords (staphylococcal, stencil, sturgeon, stopper) and Finnish fragments. Other sporadic items come from medicine, promotional copy, software instructions, and patents, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation of medial st morphemes
patterns.context: English words are split into st-initial subwords or contain similar st subword sequences; activation concentrates on word-initial st, while the complete word varies with context.

patterns.name: Finnish uh- forms
patterns.context: Occurs in Finnish sentences, continued as «ke» (uhke) and «rei» (uhreiksi); the trigger position is word-internal.

patterns.name: Local modifiers or phrases in research abstracts
patterns.context: In biomedical research abstracts, activation falls on fragments of English compounds or terms; these fragments do not represent the same medical concept.

patterns.name: conference in promotional copy
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence describing portable interactive whiteboard use, in a list of locations.

patterns.name: schematic in document figure descriptions
patterns.context: A patent figure-description sentence describing a schematic of an automatic document feeder.

patterns.name: Marked en in a Finnish sentence
patterns.context: Occurs in a long Finnish sentence, near other Finnish forms; no clear trigger condition shared with other passages is apparent.

patterns.name: Stem or affix fragments in Finnish passages
patterns.context: A Finnish sentence about a country being affected and suffering; activation is distributed across multiple word-internal fragments and cannot be summarized by a single fragment.

patterns.name: Interactive-learning phrases in promotional copy
patterns.context: Describes a portable interactive whiteboard and uses such as classrooms and meetings; activation positions are scattered.

patterns.name: Interface terms in instructions
patterns.context: Instructions for copying graphics and creating a new template; besides the repeated st subword pattern, these weaker local activations also occur.

patterns.name: Zoological terms and morphology
patterns.context: A study of sex identification in great blue herons; activation falls both on subword fragments in the species name and on methodological terms.

patterns.name: Patent figure numbers and descriptive terms
patterns.context: Figure numbers and figure descriptions in a patent for an automatic document feeder; activations on figure numbers are not clearly related to English word fragments.

patterns.name: Local words in other biomedical abstracts
patterns.context: Two different medical abstracts describe staphylococcal toxin research and pregnancy complications related to the placenta; the highly activated words differ.

2_2055.concept: 词片段与局部词汇混合
2_2055.description: 激活多落在英文 st 起始子词（staphylococcal、stencil、sturgeon、stopper）及芬兰语片段；另有分散的医学、宣传、软件说明和专利词项，缺少统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 中间词素 st 的子词切分
patterns.trigger: « st»10；同时出现 «aphyl»、«encil»、«ur»、«opper» 等后续片段
patterns.context: 英文词被拆成以 st 开头的子词，或含有类似 st 子词序列；激活集中在词首 st，具体完整词随语境变化。

patterns.name: 芬兰语 uh- 词形
patterns.context: 出现在芬兰语句子中，分别接续为 «ke»（uhke）和 «rei»（uhreiksi）；触发位置在词内。

patterns.name: 研究摘要中的限定词或词组局部
patterns.context: 生物医学研究摘要中，激活落在英文复合词或术语片段；这些片段并非同一医学概念。

patterns.name: 宣传文案中的 conference
patterns.context: 介绍互动白板便携使用场景的句子，在列举地点时出现。

patterns.name: 文档示意图说明中的 schematic
patterns.context: 专利图示说明句，描述自动送纸器的示意图。

patterns.name: 芬兰语句中标记的 en
patterns.context: 出现在芬兰语长句中，附近为其他芬兰语词形；未见与其他段落共享的清楚触发条件。

patterns.name: 芬兰语段落中的词干或词缀片段
patterns.trigger: « kö»7；另有 « maiden»4、« kä»2、« kärs»3、« jout»7
patterns.context: 芬兰语关于国家受影响与受苦的句子；激活分布在多个词内片段，无法由单一片段概括。

patterns.name: 宣传文案中的交互式学习词组
patterns.context: 描述便携式互动白板及其课堂、会议等用途；这些激活位置彼此分散。

patterns.name: 操作说明中的界面词
patterns.context: 指导用户复制图形并创建新模板；除重复的 st 子词模式外，还有这些较弱局部激活。

patterns.name: 动物学术语及形态学
patterns.context: 研究大蓝鹭性别鉴定，激活既落在物种名称的子词片段，也落在方法术语。

patterns.name: 专利图示数字与描述词
patterns.context: 自动文档送纸器专利的图号和图示描述；图号激活与英文词片段不明显相关。

patterns.name: 其他生物医学摘要局部词
patterns.context: 两个不同医学摘要分别描述葡萄球菌毒素研究与胎盘相关妊娠并发症；高激活词各异。

en.description: Most passages show strong activation on words beginning with st, spanning multilingual word forms and medical, technical, parliamentary, philosophical, and patent texts; the peak words in passages 5 and 7 show no clear st and are unexplained exceptions.

patterns.name: st in the name staphylococcal
patterns.context: In medical or experimental-protocol text, st begins the word staphylococcal.

patterns.name: st in stencil
patterns.context: In drawing-software instructions, st begins stencil; it appears repeatedly in the same passage.

patterns.name: st in sturgeon
patterns.context: In the species name great sturgeon, st begins sturgeon.

patterns.name: st in stomal
patterns.context: In a medical title, st begins stomal; stenosis also appears in the passage.

patterns.name: Anomalous activation without a clear st substring
patterns.context: The peak activation is on evidence, with no st nearby; this may be sporadic activation unrelated to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Swedish word forms related to stor/arbete
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary text, words such as stor/störda begin with st; they recur in the same passage.

patterns.name: Anomalous activation without a clear st substring
patterns.context: The strongest activation falls on complications, with additional high activation on evidence; no clear st trigger string is visible in the text.
patterns.domain: PubMed pregnancy and placental research abstracts

patterns.name: st in Dutch stedelijke
patterns.context: In Dutch parliamentary text, st begins stedelijke (urban).

patterns.name: st in Dutch sturen
patterns.context: In Dutch philosophical text, st begins sturen (guide/send).

patterns.name: st in stowed
patterns.context: A patent describes equipment that can be stowed in briefcases, purses, and other places; st begins stowed.

2_2055.description: 多数段在 st 开头的词上强激活，涵盖多语言词形及医学、技术、议会、哲学和专利文本；第5、7段峰值词无明显 st，属未解释例外。

patterns.name: staphylococcal 名称中的 st
patterns.context: 医学或实验方案文本中，st 是 staphylococcal 一词的开头。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: stencil 中的 st
patterns.context: 绘图软件操作说明中，st 是 stencil 一词的开头；同段多次出现。

patterns.name: sturgeon 中的 st
patterns.context: 物种名称 great sturgeon 中，st 是 sturgeon 的开头。

patterns.name: stomal 中的 st
patterns.context: 医学标题中，st 是 stomal 的开头；该段另有 stenosis。
patterns.domain: PubMed 泌尿外科研究标题

patterns.name: 无明显 st 子串的异常激活
patterns.context: 激活最高处为 evidence，附近未见 st；可能是与主模式无关的偶发激活。

patterns.name: 瑞典语 stor/arbete 相关字形
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，stor/störda 等词以 st 开头；同段重复出现。

patterns.name: 无明显 st 子串的异常激活
patterns.context: 最强激活落在 complications，另有 evidence 高激活；可见文本中没有明显 st 触发串。
patterns.domain: PubMed 妊娠与胎盘研究摘要

patterns.name: 荷兰语 stedelijke 中的 st
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会文本中，st 是 stedelijke（城市的）的开头。

patterns.name: 荷兰语 sturen 中的 st
patterns.context: 荷兰语哲学文本中，st 是 sturen（引导/发送）的开头。

patterns.name: stowed 中的 st
patterns.context: 专利描述设备可收纳于 briefcases、purses 等处，st 是 stowed 的开头。

en.description: In most passages, highlights concentrate on word-initial st fragments across words with no apparent semantic relation. There is also a draw fragment in code and an internal fragment of complications in a medical text; neither is explained by the st pattern.

patterns.name: Segmented fragment of the string st
patterns.context: The letter sequence st occurs, with activation on the subword or word-initial fragment st; subsequent letters and word meanings are not fixed. Complete words across passages include stencil, sturgeon, staphylococcal, stapes, staphylococci, stedelijke, sturen.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; includes technical instructions, medical abstracts, Dutch parliamentary/philosophical text, and code

patterns.name: draw stem across word boundaries
patterns.context: The draw stem occurs in code identifiers; both instances appear in identifiers such as draw_likelihood_closure / draws.

patterns.name: Other highlighted word fragments
patterns.context: In passage 5, strong activation falls on an internal subword fragment of complications, not st or draw; the surrounding text discusses placenta-mediated pregnancy complications.
patterns.domain: Medical abstract on racial disparities and pregnancy complications

2_2055.description: 多数段落的高亮集中在词首 st 片段，涵盖多种无明显语义关联的词；另有代码中的 draw 片段，以及一段医学文本中 complications 的内部片段，后两者无法由 st 模式解释。

patterns.name: 字符串 st 的切分片段
patterns.context: 出现字母序列 st，激活落在子词或词首片段 st 上；后续字母和词义并不固定。各段中的完整词包括 stencil、sturgeon、staphylococcal、stapes、staphylococci、stedelijke、sturen。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；包括技术说明、医学摘要、荷兰语议会/哲学文本和代码

patterns.name: 跨词边界的 draw 词干
patterns.context: 代码标识符中的 draw 词干；两处均出现在 draw_likelihood_closure / draws 一类标识符中。

patterns.name: 其他高亮词片段
patterns.context: 第 5 段的强激活落在 complications 一词的中间子词片段，而非 st 或 draw；周围讨论胎盘介导的妊娠并发症。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要，种族差异与妊娠并发症

en.description: Activations mainly concentrate on internal subword fragments of specific words: Silicon, proteasome, Grenoble, sturgeon, Kitahara, Synchronous, and schematic. The trigger words span chemistry, biomedicine, place names, personal names, patent terminology, and paper figure descriptions, with no unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in Silicon
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a chemical name or entry, followed by Valley Manufacturing Group Members, or repeated after a line break and followed by « hydr»«ide»; activation falls on a token fragment of Silicon.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in proteasome
patterns.context: Occurs in ubiquitin-proteasome pathway, with activation concentrated on an internal token of proteasome.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in Grenoble
patterns.context: An initial fragment of Grenoble, the French city, appearing in a location or institutional address list.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia geography entries, institutional addresses, academic paper affiliations

patterns.name: stur in a term or proper noun
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “Gender identification in great sturgeon,” with activation spanning an internal fragment of sturgeon.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstract titles or topic phrases

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in the name Kitahara
patterns.context: The name Sota Kitahara is repeated on adjacent lines, with activation concentrated on an internal fragment of the surname Kitahara.

patterns.name: Syn in a patent title
patterns.context: Occurs in the technical title “Automotive Synchronous Rectifiers,” with activation concentrated on a word-initial fragment of Synchronous.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in schematic
patterns.context: Occurs in the figure description “Inset shows a schematic illustration,” with activation on schematic.

2_2055.description: 激活主要集中在特定词的内部子词片段：Silicon、proteasome、Grenoble、sturgeon、Kitahara、Synchronous、schematic。触发词分属化学、生物医学、地名、人名、专利术语及论文图示说明，未见统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: Silicon 的子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在化学名称或条目开头，后接 Valley Manufacturing Group Members，或在换行后重复并接 « hydr»«ide»；激活落在 Silicon 的 token 片段上。

patterns.name: proteasome 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 ubiquitin-proteasome pathway 中，激活集中于 proteasome 的词内 token。

patterns.name: Grenoble 的词内片段
patterns.context: 作为法国城市 Grenoble 的开头片段，出现在地点地址或机构地址列表中。
patterns.domain: 百科地理条目、机构地址、学术论文作者单位

patterns.name: 术语或专名中的 stur
patterns.context: 出现在短语 “Gender identification in great sturgeon” 中，激活覆盖 sturgeon 的内部片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要标题或主题短语

patterns.name: 人名 Kitahara 的词内片段
patterns.context: 人名 Sota Kitahara 在相邻行重复出现，激活集中于姓氏 Kitahara 的内部片段。

patterns.name: 专利标题中的 Syn
patterns.context: 出现在技术标题 “Automotive Synchronous Rectifiers” 中，激活集中于 Synchronous 的词首片段。

patterns.name: schematic 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在实验图示说明“Inset shows a schematic illustration”中，激活于 schematic。

en.description: Activations are scattered across segmented subwords in technical text: prominent fragments include prote, Silicon, and Syn. It also responds to patent boilerplate, rare proper nouns, and code identifiers, making it difficult to reduce to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: prote fragment in technical or scientific terms
patterns.context: Terms are segmented into prote-initial subwords; these occur in the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway and biotechnology.

patterns.name: Segmentation fragments in Silicon
patterns.context: Silicon is split into the two subwords Sil and icon; it may refer to Silicon Valley, silicon hydride, or Silicon Photonics.

patterns.name: Syn-initial segmented fragment
patterns.context: Syn occurs in segmented technical proper names: Automotive Synchronous Rectifiers, Respiratory Syncytial Virus.

patterns.name: Field-introducing phrase in patent text
patterns.context: The conventional patent expression “related to the field of,” followed by the name of a technical field.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in proper names or rare words
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented subwords in names or rare words such as Grenoble and strophanthin, with no clear shared context.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and spreadsheet operations
patterns.context: Code contains segmented variable/class identifiers and a call to retrieve the last row number of a spreadsheet.

2_2055.concept: 技术文本中的子词片段
2_2055.description: 激活分散于技术文本中的拆分子词：突出 prote、Silicon、Syn 等片段，也响应专利套语、罕见专名及代码标识符；难以归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 技术或科学术语中的 prote 片段
patterns.context: 术语被切分为以 prote 开头的子词；分别出现在泛素-蛋白酶体通路和生物技术领域。

patterns.name: Silicon 的分词片段
patterns.context: Silicon 被拆分为 Sil 与 icon 两个子词；可指 Silicon Valley、silicon hydride 或 Silicon Photonics。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科、专利；科技语境

patterns.name: Syn 开头的分词片段
patterns.context: Syn 出现在被切分的专有技术名称中：Automotive Synchronous Rectifiers、Respiratory Syncytial Virus。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的字段引入语
patterns.context: 专利惯用表达“related to the field of”，后接技术领域名称。

patterns.name: 专有名称或罕见词的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Grenoble 和 strophanthin 等专名或罕见词的拆分子词上，没有明显共同语境。
patterns.domain: 科研设施描述、医学摘要

patterns.name: 代码标识符与表格操作
patterns.context: 代码中出现拆分的变量/类标识符以及获取电子表格末行号的调用。

en.description: The strongest and recurring pattern is the phrase “the advent of,” used to introduce a newly emerging drug, technology, method, or other thing. Two other examples activate on word-initial advent in adventurous and adventitious, respectively in historical narrative and biosafety text.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “the advent of”
patterns.context: Appears after the definite article the and before of, introducing something newly emerging or gradually gaining prominence; appears at varying strengths
patterns.domain: Primarily academic papers, research grant texts, and patent backgrounds; also general narrative

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in adventurous
patterns.context: The word adventurous is segmented, with activation on word-initial advent; the context describes maritime privateers

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in adventitious
patterns.context: The word adventitious is segmented and followed by agents, referring to microorganisms that enter accidentally or from outside

2_2055.description: 最强且反复出现的模式是短语“the advent of”，用于引出新出现的药物、技术、方法或事物。另有两例激活落在 adventurous、adventitious 的词首 advent，分别见于历史叙事和生物安全文本。

patterns.name: 固定短语“the advent of”
patterns.context: 出现在定冠词 the 后，后接 of，引入新出现或逐渐兴起的事物；不同强度均出现
patterns.domain: 主要为学术论文、科研资助文本及专利背景，也见一般叙述

patterns.name: adventurous 的词内片段
patterns.context: 词语 adventurous 被拆分标记，激活落在词首 advent；语境描述海上私掠者

patterns.name: adventitious 的词内片段
patterns.context: 词语 adventitious 被拆分标记，后接 agents，指偶然进入或外来的微生物
patterns.domain: 动物设施与生物安全科研文本

en.concept: Multilingual word forms and text fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual text and code: prominent features include Hungarian ő (especially in Erdős), Chinese “常/异常” and anomaly messages, code identifiers, and the medical title word Validation. Other activations involve legal headings, web terminology, and sporadic English forms, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Chinese character “常”
patterns.context: “常” appears as part of a word or phrase: in “常亮” in passage 1, and in “异常” in passages 5 and 7.

patterns.name: Hungarian ő
patterns.context: Occurs in Hungarian forms, including “következő” and the name “Erdős”.

patterns.name: Chinese requests and anomaly messages
patterns.context: The Chinese prompt “请求转换异常，请重试” occurs, as do references to an anomaly and its resolution in a Japanese sentence.
patterns.domain: Chinese user prompts in code, Japanese web text

patterns.name: Code identifiers and punctuation
patterns.context: A Java-style always-on window flag expression and the end of a PHP code block; triggers are scattered across identifiers and symbols.

patterns.name: ő in a mathematical name
patterns.context: Occurs where mathematics texts mention Erdős, whether in a theorem, proof, or reference to the name.

patterns.name: Validation in titles
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a PubMed abstract or title, followed by the study subject or measurement instrument name.

patterns.name: Sporadic English forms and grammatical fragments
patterns.context: Occur in mathematical discussion, citations, hyphenated expressions, and scale names; no stable shared context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, legal texts, biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: EuroParl agenda transitions
patterns.context: The chair’s title and a transition phrase meaning “the next item” in Hungarian parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Legal document section headings
patterns.context: An uppercase section heading in a court opinion, followed by party names and argumentation.

patterns.name: Network and probability terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of coupled networks, oscillator interactions, and probability approximations.

2_2055.concept: 多语种词形与文本片段
2_2055.description: 激活分散于多语种文本与代码：突出匈牙利语 ő（尤见 Erdős）、中文“常/异常”及异常提示、代码标识符、医学标题 Validation；另有法律标题、网络术语和零散英文词形，未呈现单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 中文“常”字
patterns.context: “常”作为词或短语的一部分出现；第1段在“常亮”中，第5、7段在“异常”中。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语 ő
patterns.context: 出现在匈牙利语词形中，包括“következő”以及人名“Erdős”。
patterns.domain: 匈牙利语议会文本、数学论文

patterns.name: 中文请求与异常提示
patterns.context: 中文提示语中出现“请求转换异常，请重试”，以及日文句子中出现异常及其解决相关表述。
patterns.domain: 代码中的中文用户提示、日文网页文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与标点
patterns.context: Java 风格窗口常亮标志表达式，以及 PHP 代码块结束处；触发分散在标识符和符号上。

patterns.name: 数学人名中的 ő
patterns.context: 出现在数学文本提及 Erdős 的位置，不论是定理、证明还是人名引述。

patterns.name: Validation 标题词
patterns.context: 出现在 PubMed 摘要或标题开头，后接研究对象或测量工具名称。

patterns.name: 零散英文词形与语法片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在数学论述、引用、连字符表达以及量表名称中；未见稳定共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、法律文本、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: EuroParl 议程过渡语
patterns.context: 匈牙利语议事文本中的主席称谓和“下一项”过渡句。

patterns.name: 法律文书段落标题
patterns.context: 法院意见书中大写章节标题后接当事人姓名及论证叙述。

patterns.name: 网络与概率术语
patterns.context: 描述耦合网络、振子相互作用及概率近似时出现。

en.description: The most stable trigger is `func` in Swift/Go code declarations, especially Swift method definitions. There are also segmented occurrences of function and activations on surrounding types and member identifiers, across mathematical and programming-instruction contexts.

patterns.name: Swift method declarations
patterns.context: Function declarations or method definitions in Swift code; common forms include `private func`, `override open func`, `static func`, `class func`, extension methods, and protocol/type-related code.

patterns.name: Go function declarations
patterns.context: A method in Go code declared with `func`, followed by parameters and a return type; here it is a method on a proxy interface.

patterns.name: Swift type- or member-related words
patterns.context: Local fragments of Swift types, API names, members, or technical terms; activations occur sporadically, with no stable independent trigger condition.

patterns.name: Mathematical discussion of the function concept
patterns.context: In an English question, `function` is split into `func` and `ions` while discussing the mean-value property of harmonic functions; the trigger fragment matches the code keyword.

patterns.name: JavaScript explanation of the function concept
patterns.context: English text explaining the scope and binding of inner JavaScript functions; the natural-language word function occurs, but the strongest activation still falls on the code form `func`.

2_2055.description: 最稳定的触发是 Swift/Go 代码声明中的 `func`，尤其 Swift 方法定义；另有被拆分的 function 词及周边类型、成员标识符激活，覆盖数学与编程说明语境。

patterns.name: Swift 方法声明
patterns.context: Swift 代码中的函数声明或方法定义；常见于 `private func`、`override open func`、`static func`、`class func`、扩展方法及协议/类型相关代码。

patterns.name: Go 函数声明
patterns.context: Go 代码中以 `func` 声明带接收者的方法，后接参数与返回类型；此处是代理接口的方法。

patterns.name: Swift 类型或成员相关词
patterns.context: Swift 类型、API 名称、成员或技术术语的局部片段；激活分散出现，未见稳定的独立触发条件。

patterns.name: 函数概念的数学讨论
patterns.context: 英文问题中 `function` 被拆分为 `func` 与 `ions`，讨论非调和函数的均值性质；触发片段与代码关键字同形。

patterns.name: 函数概念的 JavaScript 说明
patterns.context: 英文解释 JavaScript 内层函数的作用域及绑定；出现自然语言单词 function，但最高激活仍落在代码形态 `func`。

en.description: Primarily responds to function- and method-related forms in code, especially declarations or calls; it also activates strongly on “homotopy” in an algebraic topology paper, Elixir Mix configuration, and “combine” in a patent, spanning different domains.

patterns.name: Function calls or definitions in programs
patterns.context: Near function/method declarations, calls, or related code descriptions in PHP, Go, Swift, JavaScript, and other code; syntax varies across languages

patterns.name: Homotopy topology terminology
patterns.context: In mathematics papers discussing homotopy structures, homotopy invariance, or related spaces and operations

patterns.name: Elixir Mix configuration
patterns.context: Describes application configuration and dependencies, followed by the Mix.Config module and use Mix
patterns.domain: Elixir project configuration code and comments

patterns.name: Combine harvester in agricultural machinery
patterns.context: After discussing differences in input and output speeds of a transmission, the text turns to the combine harvester rotor

2_2055.concept: 多义词与代码函数特征
2_2055.description: 主要响应代码中函数、方法相关写法，尤其是声明或调用；另在代数拓扑论文的“homotopy”、Elixir Mix 配置和专利中的“combine”处强烈激活，语义跨域。

patterns.name: 程序中的函数调用或定义
patterns.context: PHP、Go、Swift、JavaScript 等代码中，函数/方法声明、调用或相关代码说明附近；不同语言的写法并不相同

patterns.name: 同伦拓扑术语
patterns.context: 数学论文中讨论同伦结构、同伦不变性或相关空间与运算时

patterns.name: Elixir Mix 配置
patterns.context: 描述应用配置及依赖，随后出现 Mix.Config 模块和 use Mix
patterns.domain: Elixir 项目配置代码及注释

patterns.name: 农业机械中的联合收割机
patterns.context: 讨论传动装置的输入输出速度差异后，转向联合收割机转子
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，农业机械

en.concept: Functions and test markers in code
en.description: Strong responses mainly concentrate on the function declaration marker func in code, especially Swift, and also respond significantly to the Jasmine testing framework name. Other activations involve scattered code syntax tokens, injector identifiers, and network terminology.

patterns.name: Swift function declarations
patterns.context: Function declarations in Swift code, especially the function name after func; includes ordinary methods and operator overloading.

patterns.name: Jasmine testing identifier
patterns.context: Jasmine occurs in test code or testing instructions, near testing terms such as spy, mock, controller, and fixtures.

patterns.name: Other programming syntax tokens
patterns.context: Closing braces, empty function bodies, or Angular injector identifiers in code; trigger positions and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Network-device terminology
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the phrase “network kit” in discussions of router configuration and network devices.

patterns.name: JavaScript function binding
patterns.context: Text and example code explaining how to bind an inner function to the parent this context.

2_2055.concept: 代码中的函数与测试标记
2_2055.description: 强响应主要集中在代码中的函数声明标记 func（尤见 Swift），也对 Jasmine 测试框架名称有显著响应；另有若干分散的代码语法 token、注入器标识符及网络术语激活。

patterns.name: Swift 函数声明
patterns.context: Swift 代码中的函数声明，尤其是 func 后的函数名；包括普通方法及运算符重载。

patterns.name: Jasmine 测试标识符
patterns.context: 测试代码或测试说明中出现 Jasmine，邻近 spy、mock、controller、fixtures 等测试术语。

patterns.name: 其他编程语法 token
patterns.context: 代码中的闭合花括号、空函数体或 Angular 注入器标识符；触发位置和上下文各异。

patterns.name: 网络设备术语
patterns.context: 讨论路由器配置及网络设备时，出现在“network kit”短语末尾。

patterns.name: JavaScript 函数绑定
patterns.context: 说明将内层函数绑定到父级 this 上下文的文字及示例代码。

en.concept: Partially sensitive to the string kit
en.description: Primarily responds to the string kit, covering different uses such as kits, reagent kits, and network devices; it also includes kitty internally. It additionally responds to the structural term honeycomb and func in code declarations. The cosmetics packaging passage has no clear corresponding trigger.

patterns.name: Honeycomb structure
patterns.context: Appears when describing rotational or translational symmetry, or material/imaging structures; activation concentrates on the honeycomb substring

patterns.name: kit and kit in compounds
patterns.context: Activates on the noun kit or words containing kit; kit may refer to a toolkit, equipment set, or reagent kit, and may also occur in a word without the meaning of kit
patterns.domain: Patents, online Q&A, technical forums, sports commentary, medical research

patterns.name: Identifier prefix in deleteUserProfile
patterns.context: In a Swift-style function declaration, func is marked while the following delete and the rest of the function name are not

2_2055.concept: 部分对 kit 字符串敏感
2_2055.description: 主要响应 kit 字符串，覆盖工具包、试剂盒、网络设备等不同用法，也包括词内 kitty；另响应 honeycomb 结构词，以及代码声明中的 func。化妆品包装段无明显对应触发。

patterns.name: honeycomb 结构
patterns.context: 描述旋转、平移对称性或材料/成像结构时出现；触发集中在 honeycomb 子串
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、医学影像摘要

patterns.name: kit 及复合词中的 kit
patterns.trigger: «kit»；包括«development» kit、«reagent» kit、«network» kit，以及词内«kit»ty
patterns.context: 在名词 kit 或包含 kit 的词中激活；kit 可指工具包、设备套装、试剂盒，也可出现在非 kit 义的词形中
patterns.domain: 专利、网络问答、技术论坛、体育评论、医学研究

patterns.name: deleteUserProfile 标识符前缀
patterns.context: Swift 风格的函数声明中，func 被标记，而后续 delete 及函数名其余部分未标记

en.description: Activations occur most consistently on kit and contexts involving kits or equipment sets. There are also notable responses to an algolia search URL on HN, patent descriptions of skincare product packaging and dispensing, and mixture in semi-supervised learning.

patterns.name: “kit” and kit-related expressions
patterns.context: kit refers to a set of equipment, parts, or materials ready for use; modifiers and uses vary by context.
patterns.domain: Network configuration, electronics, development tools, biomedicine, automotive modification

patterns.name: algolia in Hacker News search URLs
patterns.context: Occurs in an hn.algolia.com search URL; query is followed by a search term or parameters.
patterns.domain: Hacker News forum posts and links

patterns.name: Skincare packaging and cream dispensing
patterns.context: Describes a device for packaging and applying or dispensing cosmetics and care products.

patterns.name: mixture in semi-supervised learning
patterns.context: mixture refers to a mixture of class-conditional distributions, used in theoretical discussion of semi-supervised classification.

2_2055.description: 激活最一致地出现在 kit（套件、成套设备）及其用途语境；另对 HN 的 algolia 搜索网址、专利中的护肤品包装分配描述，以及半监督学习里的 mixture 有明显反应。

patterns.name: “kit”及套件类表达
patterns.context: kit 指可供使用的一组设备、部件或材料；修饰语和用途因语境而异。

en.description: The most stable signal is the SY subword fragment, especially in names such as Sim in legal cases, judges’ surnames, and other proper nouns; it also appears in Synod, Sylvan, and SYNOW. There are also AM fragments, legal punctuation, and sporadic low-intensity word fragments, which are difficult to group into a unified pattern.

patterns.context: Appears in case citations, case names, or legal discussion; activation falls specifically on name fragments beginning with Sim, with weaker activations on punctuation.
