en.description: Strong activations are scattered across medical subword fragments (e.g., C, the y in palsy), the name Hart, formula-boundary punctuation, and sporadic word fragments. The segments lack consistent semantic or grammatical triggers, and the weak activations cannot be reliably categorized.

patterns.name: Word-initial C and following fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the capital letter C and following subword fragments in different medical terms; there is no clear shared meaning or fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Final or internal y
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter y in medical terms, appearing in cerebral palsy and dysembryoplastic; other fragments containing y are unmarked, so this does not support a general y pattern.

patterns.name: Syntactic or formula-boundary punctuation
patterns.context: Activation occurs on semicolons at the ends of formulas in mathematical Q&A and in formulas or symbolic expressions in papers; it may be sensitive to specific formula-boundary punctuation.

patterns.name: Hart in names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in Hartlib and Hartigan, both parts of the names of a historical figure or tennis player; it is unclear whether this detects a specific string or a name component.

patterns.name: Boundary fragment up
patterns.context: Appears in “came up with” and “set up,” both with up in phrasal verbs; activation is weaker than the primary markers.

patterns.name: Biomedical morpheme fragments
patterns.context: Several consecutive morphemes or subword fragments in tumor names activate; this fits the medical topic, but the same pattern does not appear in other medical passages.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Appears on the closing parenthesis after the abbreviation “(CP)” for cerebral palsy; it is isolated and lacks a confirmed shared pattern.

patterns.name: Result or relation words
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of treatment effects, method steps, and mathematical arguments; the grammatical functions differ, so these cannot yet be grouped into a reliable trigger category.

patterns.name: Technical term fragments and quantifiers
patterns.context: Sporadically falls on materials-physics terms, historical time expressions, and tennis score symbols; the topics and contexts differ.

2_2191.description: 强激活分散在医学词片段（如 C、palsy 中的 y）、人名 Hart、公式边界标点及零散词片段上。各段缺少一致的词义或语法触发条件，多个弱激活也无法可靠归类。

patterns.name: 词首 C 与后续词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在大写字母 C 及其后的词片段上，组成不同医学词汇；没有明显统一的词义或固定搭配。

patterns.name: 词尾或内部的 y
patterns.context: 激活位于医学术语的 y 字母上，分别出现在 cerebral palsy 和 dysembryoplastic 中；另有其他片段中的 y 未标记，不能据此概括为普遍的 y 模式。

patterns.name: 句法或公式边界标点
patterns.context: 在数学问答公式末尾的分号，以及论文公式或符号表达中的分号处激活；可能对特定公式边界标点敏感。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数学问答、ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 人名中的 Hart
patterns.context: 在人名 Hartlib 和 Hartigan 中激活，均为历史人物或网球选手姓名的一部分；是否识别特定字符串或人名成分不明。

patterns.name: 边界词片段 up
patterns.context: 分别出现在“came up with”和“set up”中，都是短语动词里的 up；激活强度低于主要标记。

patterns.name: 生物医学词素片段
patterns.context: 在肿瘤名称中激活若干连续词素或词片段；与医学主题相符，但其他医学段落未呈现同样模式。

patterns.name: 数学符号的右括号
patterns.context: 出现在 cerebral palsy 缩写“(CP)”之后的右括号，孤立出现，缺乏可确认的共同模式。

patterns.name: 结果或关系词
patterns.context: 分别出现在治疗效果描述、方法步骤描述和数学论述中，语法功能不同，暂不能归为一个可靠的触发类别。

patterns.name: 技术名词片段与数量词
patterns.context: 零散地落在材料物理名词、历史时间表述以及网球比分符号上，主题和语境不同。

en.description: Activation is scattered: medical subword fragments and word-internal y are relatively concentrated; other sporadic patterns include boundary punctuation, mathematical symbols, English phrases, and proper names, which cannot be explained by a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Word-internal letter y
patterns.context: The letter y occurs inside words, including disease names and medical terms; nearby subword fragments are often split and annotated.

patterns.name: Medical subword fragments beginning with C
patterns.context: Capital C begins a medical term; subsequent subword fragments are unannotated or weakly activated.

patterns.name: Sentence-final or clause-boundary punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs at the boundaries of formulas, explanations, or sentences; the marked punctuation types and positions vary.
patterns.domain: Q&A, encyclopedias, academic papers, medical abstracts

patterns.name: English phrases up / at
patterns.context: Phrase components in ordinary English prose, appearing respectively in code explanations and historical narratives.

patterns.name: Proper name Hart
patterns.context: Appears as a surname in personal names; both instances are the initial fragment Hart of Hartigan.

patterns.name: Dollar sign after a formula variable
patterns.context: In mathematical formulas, the dollar sign closing LaTeX math mode is marked after a variable or expression.

patterns.name: Semicolon after a mathematical symbol
patterns.context: A semicolon immediately follows the end of a LaTeX formula, introducing a subsequent explanation.

patterns.name: Punctuation separating genetic-model steps
patterns.context: When listing two transition steps in a paper, a semicolon separates the first item.

patterns.name: Temperature notation in a magnetism paper
patterns.context: In a description of magnetoresistance results, a semicolon near a temperature symbol introduces a subsequent explanation.

patterns.name: Hyphen and preposition in a sports list
patterns.context: In tennis tournament entries, activation occurs near scores, championship descriptions, prepositions, and tournament names.

2_2191.concept: 词片段与标点的混合特征
2_2191.description: 激活分布杂乱：医学词片段和词内 y 较集中；另有边界标点、数学公式符号、英语短语及专名等零散模式，无法由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 词内字母 y
patterns.context: 字母 y 位于单词内部；涵盖疾病名称及医学术语，周围常有被拆分标注的词片段。

patterns.name: C 开头医学词片段
patterns.context: 大写 C 是医学词语的开头，后续词片段未标注或激活较弱。

patterns.name: 句末或分句边界标点
patterns.context: 标点出现在公式、说明或句子的边界；被标记的标点种类和位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 问答、百科、学术论文、医学摘要

patterns.name: 英语短语 up / at
patterns.context: 普通英语叙述中的短语成分，分别出现在代码说明和历史叙述中。

patterns.name: 专名 Hart
patterns.context: 作为姓氏出现在人名中；两处均为 Hartigan 的开头片段 Hart。

patterns.name: 公式变量后的美元符号
patterns.context: 数学公式中变量或表达式后，闭合 LaTeX 数学模式的美元符号被标记。

patterns.name: 数学符号后的分号
patterns.context: LaTeX 公式结束后紧接分号，标点用于引出后续解释。

patterns.name: 遗传模型步骤分隔标点
patterns.context: 论文中列举两个转变步骤时，第一项后用分号分隔。

patterns.name: 磁学论文中的温度记号
patterns.context: 磁阻结果描述中，分号位于温度符号附近并引出后续说明。

patterns.name: 体育列表中的短横线与介词
patterns.context: 网球赛事条目中，比分、夺冠描述、介词及赛事名称附近出现激活。

en.concept: Mixed local subword and punctuation patterns
en.description: Activation does not reflect a single semantic pattern: the most prominent feature is the tokenized fragments of cerebral palsy in medical text; others are scattered across subword fragments, formula punctuation, and image filenames in tumor terminology, names, code, mathematics, and physics.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments of Cerebral palsy
patterns.context: Triggers cluster at positions beginning with capital C, where token fragments combine to form “Cerebral palsy”; they also occur near the parenthetical abbreviation “(«CP»).”

patterns.name: Other fragments within medical terms
patterns.context: Several internal subword fragments in medical tumor names are marked simultaneously; no semantic context related to cerebral palsy is evident.

patterns.name: Punctuation and subword fragments in code discussions
patterns.context: In the prose and mathematical expressions of a coding question, phrases and formula punctuation are marked; multiple triggers are scattered throughout the same paragraph.

patterns.name: Historical name Hartlib
patterns.context: The fragment Hart is marked in the name Samuel Hartlib and in repeated occurrences of the surname.

patterns.name: Punctuation after mathematical symbols
patterns.context: In mathematical formulas or discussion, formula-ending symbols and the semicolons and connective phrases that follow are marked.

patterns.name: Punctuation in discussion of genetic algorithms
patterns.context: When describing selection and mutation steps, punctuation near associated and variable symbols is marked.

patterns.name: Physics terms and formula punctuation
patterns.context: In discussion of magnetoresistance and resistivity measurements, term fragments and formula-boundary punctuation are marked.

patterns.name: Image markers and filename fragments
patterns.context: Multiple character fragments are marked in filenames or numeric strings following Markdown image syntax.
patterns.domain: Image markers in PubMed Central text

2_2191.concept: 混合的局部子词与标点模式
2_2191.description: 激活并非单一语义模式：最显著的是医学文本中 cerebral palsy 的分词片段；其余分散于肿瘤术语、人名、代码、数学与物理论述的词片段、公式标点及图像文件名。

patterns.name: Cerebral palsy 拼写片段
patterns.context: 触发集中在以大写 C 开头、分词片段拼成“Cerebral palsy”的位置；也出现在括号缩写“(«CP»)”附近。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 项目记录

patterns.name: 其他医学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 医学肿瘤名称中的若干词内子词片段同时标记；未见与 cerebral palsy 相关的语义上下文。

patterns.name: 代码讨论中的标点与词片段
patterns.context: 代码问题的叙述和数学表达中，短语及公式标点被标记；多个触发分散在同一段落。

patterns.name: 历史人名 Hartlib
patterns.context: 人名 Samuel Hartlib 及其重复出现的姓氏中，Hart 片段被标记。

patterns.name: 数学符号后的标点
patterns.context: 数学论文的公式或论述中，公式结束符号及其后的分号、连接短语被标记。

patterns.name: 遗传算法论述标点
patterns.context: 描述 selection 与 mutation 步骤时，associated 及变量符号附近的标点被标记。

patterns.name: 物理术语与公式标点
patterns.context: 磁阻与电阻率测量的论述中，术语片段及公式边界标点被标记。

patterns.name: 图像标记与文件名片段
patterns.context: Markdown 图片语法后的文件名或编号字符串中，多个字符片段被标记。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文本中的图像标记

en.description: Activations are scattered across varied subword fragments. The most prominent is word-final y, especially in medical terms; other activations occur in medical compounds, ordinary word subwords, formula punctuation, and image markers. They vary across domains, position, and meaning.

patterns.name: Word-final y
patterns.context: Activation falls on y at the end of a word, especially when the stem or earlier part is split into multiple subword fragments; it also occurs at the ends of ordinary words.

patterns.name: Number and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: In formulas, markup, or symbol-containing text, activation falls on dollar signs, semicolons, and within image markers; segment 4 also involves an alphanumeric filename fragment.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, mathematics papers, web/image markup

patterns.name: English internal or final fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across fragments of medical terms or compounds split by the tokenizer, with no fixed position; segment 5 includes an internal y.

patterns.name: Subword boundaries in ordinary words
patterns.context: A small number of activations occur on subword fragments of common words or proper names, without stable semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, patent background, historical encyclopedia, mathematics papers

2_2191.description: 激活分散于多种分词片段：突出的是词尾 y（尤见医学术语），另见医学复合词、普通词子词、公式标点及图像标记。跨领域且位置和语义不稳定。

patterns.name: 词尾 y
patterns.trigger: «y»10（第2、3段）；«y»10 出现在 «C»3ere«bral»2« pals»1«y»10；第8段为 «y»9
patterns.context: 激活落在单词末尾的 y，尤其在词干或前部已分成多个子词片段时；也出现在普通单词末尾。

patterns.name: 数字与标点边界
patterns.context: 公式、标记语言或含符号的文本中，激活落在美元符号、分号及图像标记内部；第4段还涉及字母数字文件名片段。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、数学论文、网页/图像标记

patterns.name: 英文词内或词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在被分词器拆开的医学术语或复合词片段上，位置不固定；第5段包含词内 y。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、肿瘤学标题

patterns.name: 普通词的子词边界
patterns.context: 少量激活出现在常见词或专名的子词片段上，未显示稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、专利背景、历史百科、数学论文

en.concept: Word forms and internal fragments containing y
en.description: Activation is scattered across medical terms, proper names, and other word fragments; many instances involve the letter y or words containing y, but other internal fragments also occur, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Cerebral palsy word forms
patterns.context: The full name cerebral palsy or its abbreviation appears in medical text; highlighting spans fragments across words

patterns.name: y in disease or medical terms
patterns.context: Disease names, tumor terminology, or number-like strings following image markers in medical materials; the trigger may fall inside a word or immediately next to a marker

patterns.name: Word-final y in English
patterns.context: The letter y occurs at the end of ordinary English proper names or nouns; the surrounding context has no clear, consistent medical meaning
patterns.domain: Patent background, online encyclopedias, web text

patterns.name: Other term fragments in medical papers
patterns.context: Internal word fragments are marked in cancer titles or drug names; the triggers combine with neighboring words to form domain-specific terms

2_2191.concept: 含 y 的词形及词内片段
2_2191.description: 激活分散在医学术语、专名及其他词语片段中；多处涉及字母 y 或含 y 的词，但也有分散的词内片段，缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Cerebral palsy 词形
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现 cerebral palsy 的完整名称或缩写；高亮覆盖跨词片段
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目记录

patterns.name: 疾病或医学术语中的 y
patterns.context: 医学资料中的疾病名称、肿瘤术语，或图像标记后接类似编号的字符串；触发可能落在词内或紧邻标记
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、医学论文内容

patterns.name: 英文词尾 y
patterns.context: 普通英文专名或名词中，y 位于词尾；周围上下文并无明显一致的医学含义
patterns.domain: 专利背景、网络百科、网页文本

patterns.name: 医学论文中的其他术语片段
patterns.context: 癌症标题或药物名称中被标记的内部词片段；触发与相邻词共同构成领域术语

en.description: Activations are scattered across several contexts: separately marked y in medical words, y in filenames and proper names, diagnosis-related words, mathematical code symbols, and forgiven in religious narrative. No single stable meaning explains them.

patterns.name: Continuation y in disease names
patterns.context: Preceded by separately marked word-initial fragments, forming complete medical terms such as «C»ere«bral» pals«y», «D»y«semb»ry«oplastic», and «C»aries.

patterns.name: Internal y subword in English words
patterns.context: Occurs within a word rather than as a standalone word; neighboring subwords form a filename or proper name, as in «y»j«bm»...

patterns.name: y in a specific name or word form
patterns.context: The letter y occurs in the proper name John Dury, amid a historical account of a 17th-century correspondence network.

patterns.name: PD diagnostic context and crossroads
patterns.context: Discussion of personality disorder diagnosis; activation concentrates on related words and their split subwords.

patterns.name: Symbols and parentheses in mathematical code
patterns.context: Near symbols such as variable substitutions, trigonometric conditions, and parentheses in mathematical expressions or code snippets.

patterns.name: Forgiveness in religious narrative
patterns.context: First-person narrative mentions the forgiveness of sins; other religious-context words include burdens of the heart and miracles.

2_2191.description: 激活分散在多种场景：医学词语中拆分标注的 y、文件名及专名中的 y，另有诊断相关词、数学代码符号，以及宗教叙述里的 forgiven。无法由单一稳定语义解释。

patterns.name: 疾病名称中 y 的续写
patterns.context: 前面为拆分标注的词首，组成完整医学术语，如 «C»ere«bral» pals«y»、«D»y«semb»ry«oplastic»、«C»aries。

patterns.name: 英文词内部的 y 子词
patterns.context: 出现在词中而非独立词，前后子词共同构成文件名或专名；如 «y»j«bm»...

patterns.name: 特定专名或词形中的 y
patterns.context: 字母 y 位于专名 John Dury 中，周围是 17 世纪通信网络的历史叙述。

patterns.name: PD 的诊断语境与 crossroads
patterns.context: 人格障碍诊断的讨论；激活集中在相关词及其拆分子词上。
patterns.domain: 医学/心理学资助项目文本

patterns.name: 数学代码中的符号与括号
patterns.context: 数学表达式或代码片段中，变量替换、三角函数条件及括号等符号附近。

patterns.name: 宗教叙述中的 forgiveness
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中提到罪获得赦免；同时出现心中负担、奇迹等宗教语境词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across subwords in disease or sports names, copy in emails, image filenames, forgiven in religious text, and semicolons and equals signs after formulas in mathematical/scientific text; local triggers differ, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments of the term “Cerebral palsy”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the disease name split into multiple tokens; one example is followed by “improvement achieved by…”, another by the abbreviation “(CP)” and epidemiological description.

patterns.name: Name of a sport
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword tokens in the sport name “Archery”; the sentence introduces the sport.

patterns.name: copy in an email phrase
patterns.context: “copy” appears in parentheses, referring to a copy of a memo attached to an email; strong activation is concentrated on the word.

patterns.name: Image filename/path tokens
patterns.context: A sequence resembling an image filename follows a Markdown image marker; activation falls on several path/filename fragments.
patterns.domain: Markup or image references in PubMed Central documents

patterns.name: Equals sign in a formula
patterns.context: In a discussion of trigonometric values, the equals-sign token «=» is adjacent to a formula representing ±1; the newline token is also marked.

patterns.name: Forgiven in religious narrative
patterns.context: A first-person account of faith describes sins being forgiven; activation falls on “forgiven”.

patterns.name: Semicolon after a genetic transfer step
patterns.context: A technical sentence first describes a selection step and its associated potential function; a semicolon ends that clause and connects it to the subsequent mutation step. Activation falls on the semicolon.

patterns.name: Equals sign in a formula
patterns.context: In a geometry formula, an equals sign connects an expression to zero, followed by a semicolon and a condition; strong activation is on the equals sign and semicolon.

patterns.name: Equals sign in a formula
patterns.context: In a particle-physics sentence, a semicolon follows a formula and connects parallel explanations; activation falls on the semicolon.

2_2191.description: 激活分散在疾病或运动名称的子词、邮件中的 copy、图像文件名、宗教词 forgiven，以及数学／科学文本中公式后的分号和等号；各处局部触发不同，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: “Cerebral palsy”术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分成多个 token 的疾病名称上；一例后接 “improvement achieved by…”，另一例接缩写 “(CP)” 及流行病学描述。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 项目记录

patterns.name: 运动项目名称
patterns.context: 激活落在运动名称 “Archery” 的子词 token 上，句子介绍该运动。

patterns.name: 邮件短语中的 copy
patterns.context: “copy”出现在括号内，指随邮件附上的备忘录副本；强激活集中在该词。

patterns.name: 图像文件名／路径 token
patterns.context: Markdown 图片标记后紧跟类似图像文件名的字符序列，激活落在路径／文件名的若干片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文档中的标记或图像引用

patterns.name: 公式中的等号
patterns.context: 三角函数取值讨论中，等号 token «=» 与表示 ±1 的公式相邻；同时换行 token 也被标记。

patterns.name: 宗教叙述中的 forgiven
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述信仰经历，描述罪得到宽恕；激活落在 “forgiven”。

patterns.name: 遗传转移步骤后的分号
patterns.context: 技术句子先描述 selection step 及其 associated potential function，分号结束该分句并连接后续 mutation step；激活落在分号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学／遗传算法研究

patterns.name: 公式中的等号
patterns.context: 几何学公式中等号连接表达式与零，后接分号和条件说明；强激活在等号及分号。

patterns.name: 公式中的等号
patterns.context: 粒子物理句中公式后以分号连接并列说明，激活落在分号。

en.concept: copy subword and sporadic string features
en.description: Activations mainly fall on copy and words containing copy or appearing in file-copy contexts. They also occur in the tokenization of Cerebral palsy, final y, image-file strings, the fixed expression ROC, and the Observer identifier; these secondary patterns are difficult to unify.

patterns.name: copy subword and file copying
patterns.context: copy occurs in ordinary words, compounds, or file-copy/file-copy contexts, including “colposcopy”, “gonioscopy”, “unit-copy bacterial plasmids”, and “version/copy of the file”; activation falls on the copy token.
patterns.domain: Emails, medical abstracts, research texts, technical documentation; segments 1, 2, 6, 8, 9, 10

patterns.name: Tokenized spelling of cerebral palsy
patterns.context: “Cerebral palsy” is split into multiple tokens, with activation distributed across the parts of the words, especially the final y.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and NIH project text; segments 3, 4

patterns.name: Word-final y
patterns.context: Activation occurs on word-final y; “Archer«y»” in segment 5 and “y” in the image filename in segment 7 lack shared semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Patent background text, PubMed Central image markup; segments 5, 7

patterns.name: Letter sequence jbm
patterns.context: Occurs in image markup and non-natural-language strings resembling filenames such as “![](yjb m00...)”; appears in the same segment as word-final y.
patterns.domain: Image/file markup in PubMed Central documents; segment 7

patterns.name: under in ROC
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed statistical expression “areas under the ROC curves”.
patterns.domain: Statistical results in medical abstracts; segment 10

patterns.name: Observer identifier
patterns.context: Appears twice as a system/component name in file-copy and failure-recovery instructions.

2_2191.concept: copy 子词及零散字符串特征
2_2191.description: 激活主要落在 copy 及含 copy 的词或文件副本语境，也出现在 Cerebral palsy 的分词、词尾 y、图像文件串、ROC 固定表达和 Observer 标识上；这些旁支难以统一解释。

patterns.name: copy 子词及文件复制
patterns.context: copy 出现在普通词、复合词或文件复制/副本语境中，包括“colposcopy”“gonioscopy”“unit-copy bacterial plasmids”“version/copy of the file”；激活落在 copy 的 token 上。
patterns.domain: 邮件、医学摘要、科研文本、技术文档；段1、2、6、8、9、10

patterns.name: 脑性瘫痪的分词拼写
patterns.context: “Cerebral palsy”被拆成多个 token，激活分布在词的各部分，尤其是结尾 y。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与 NIH 项目文本；段3、4

patterns.name: 词尾 y
patterns.context: 激活出现在词尾 y；段5 的“Archer«y»”及段7 图像文件名中的“y”，缺少共同的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 专利背景文本、PubMed Central 图像标记；段5、7

patterns.name: 字母序列 jbm
patterns.context: 出现在图像标记及文件名“![](yjb m00...)”一类的非自然语言串中；与词尾 y 同段出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文档中的图像/文件标记；段7

patterns.name: ROC 下的 under
patterns.context: 出现在“areas under the ROC curves”这一固定统计表达中。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要中的统计结果；段10

patterns.name: Observer 标识
patterns.context: 在文件复制和故障恢复说明中作为系统/组件名称出现两次。

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and code patterns
en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments such as spinal and sph in medical text, code identifiers and formatted calls, Portuguese word forms, and email and parliamentary expressions; no single semantic pattern covers all the fragments.

patterns.name: spinal vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in the medical phrases “cerebrospinal fluid” and “spinal cord”; nearby words often include fluid, cord, and injury.

patterns.name: Greek-letter sequence sph
patterns.context: Occurs within medical terms, continuing as “sphygmomanometer” and “sphincter”; it is not a standalone word.

patterns.name: Copy of a document: copy
patterns.context: Appears in “copy attached” or “colposcopy centre”, with meanings related to copying or the name of an examination.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-final ar
patterns.context: Embedded in Portuguese word forms such as “gostaríamos” and “libertar”; occurs in parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Code formatting function
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++-style code calls, near format strings or buffers.

patterns.name: Numbers and code identifiers
patterns.context: Part of array sizes, structs, or function names, near underscore identifiers and code.

patterns.name: Exception or unknown-type identifier
patterns.context: Appears in switch/case branches and error-message strings.

patterns.name: Wording in a statistical analysis title
patterns.context: Located at the end of a medical paper title, describing the study design or analysis method.

patterns.name: English formal correspondence
patterns.context: An email quotes a previous memo and proposes arrangements.

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations and term fragments
patterns.context: Appears in research on urinary incontinence treatment, including a parenthetical abbreviation, expanded terminology, and patient descriptions.

patterns.name: Health programs and affected populations
patterns.context: Introduces rehabilitation goals and populations with stroke, spinal cord injury, or amputation.

patterns.name: Ingestion incident in a medical case
patterns.context: A case report describes mercury ingestion and the patient’s work repairing blood-pressure gauges.

patterns.name: Biochemical experiment and brain-tissue measures
patterns.context: Describes a rat experiment, infusion of artificial cerebrospinal fluid, and changes in biochemical measures in brain tissue.

patterns.name: Quotation about releasing captured persons
patterns.context: Quotes a political statement demanding the release of still-imprisoned missing persons, with a Portuguese equivalent.

2_2191.concept: 异质文本词段与代码模式
2_2191.description: 激活分散于医学文本中的 spinal、sph 等词段、代码标识符与格式化调用、葡语词形及邮件和议会表达；未见能覆盖全部片段的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: spinal 词汇
patterns.context: 出现在医学短语“cerebrospinal fluid”和“spinal cord”中；周围常有 fluid、cord、injury 等词。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、退伍军人康复研究

patterns.name: 希腊字母 sph
patterns.context: 位于医学术语内部，分别接续为“sphygmomanometer”和“sphincter”；不是独立词。

patterns.name: 复制件 copy
patterns.context: 出现在“copy attached”或“colposcopy centre”中，语义与复制或检查名称有关。

patterns.name: 葡语词尾 ar
patterns.context: 嵌在葡语词形中，如“gostaríamos”“libertar”；处于议会发言语境。

patterns.name: 代码格式化函数
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 风格代码调用中，邻近格式串或缓冲区。

patterns.name: 数字与代码标识符
patterns.context: 作为数组大小、结构体或函数名的一部分，邻近下划线标识符与代码。

patterns.name: 异常或未知类型标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 switch/case 分支和错误消息字符串中。

patterns.name: 统计分析标题用语
patterns.context: 位于医学论文标题末尾，描述研究设计或分析方式。

patterns.name: 英文公文表达
patterns.context: 邮件引用此前备忘录并提出安排事项。

patterns.name: 医学缩写与术语碎片
patterns.context: 出现在尿失禁治疗研究中，含括号缩写、术语展开及患者描述。

patterns.name: 健康项目与受影响人群
patterns.context: 介绍康复目标及中风、脊髓损伤或截肢人群。

patterns.name: 医学病例中的摄入事件
patterns.context: 病例报告描述汞摄入及患者维修血压计的情境。

patterns.name: 生化实验与脑组织指标
patterns.context: 描述大鼠实验、人工脑脊液输注及脑组织中的生化指标变化。

patterns.name: 引述释放被俘人员
patterns.context: 引述一项要求释放仍被囚禁失踪人员的政治表述，并附葡语对应内容。

en.concept: Lexical fragments and compound suffixes (especially like)
en.description: Activations are scattered across word-internal fragments, like compounds, and several proper names and domain terms. The like suffix recurs across multiple topics, but the other triggers lack a shared semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: “erry” in strings
patterns.context: English names or proper nouns contain spellings such as Jerry, Morley, and Ferry; activation may fall on an internal word fragment rather than a whole word.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographical entries, place or transportation entries

patterns.name: Suffix in the term for banner blindness
patterns.context: Discusses banner blindness and forms a hyphenated like compound after banner.

patterns.name: “like” compound suffix
patterns.context: like attaches to a noun or adjective to form an analogical, similarity, or modifying compound; it appears across different fields.

patterns.name: “cord” in a medical term
patterns.context: Medical context such as spinal cord injury; the visible fragment joins spinal and cord.

patterns.name: Proper name Warburg
patterns.context: Medical text mentions the Warburg effect; activation falls on the latter part of the surname.

patterns.name: Liquid-liquid extraction terminology
patterns.context: Introduces liquid-liquid extraction by a synonymous name; activation falls on a short word and term fragments.

2_2191.concept: 词汇片段与复合词后缀（尤其 like）
2_2191.description: 激活分散于词内片段、like复合词及若干专名和领域术语；like后缀跨多个主题重复出现，但其余触发缺少共同语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 字符串中包含或切分出“erry”
patterns.context: 英文人名或专名中出现 Jerry、Morley、Ferry 等拼写；激活可能落在词内片段，而非完整单词。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目、地名或交通条目

patterns.name: 广告盲视术语中的后缀
patterns.context: 讨论广告盲视，并在 banner 后以连字符构成 like 复合词。

patterns.name: “like”复合词后缀
patterns.context: like 附着在名词或形容词后构成类比、相似或修饰性复合词；不同领域均出现。

patterns.name: 医学研究术语中的“cord”
patterns.context: 脊髓损伤等医学语境；可见片段把 spinal 与 cord 连写。

patterns.name: Warburg 专名
patterns.context: 医学文本提及 Warburg effect，激活落在姓氏后半部分。

patterns.name: 液液萃取术语
patterns.context: 以同义名称介绍 liquid-liquid extraction；激活落在短词及术语片段。

en.concept: Heterogeneous structural and word-internal fragment triggers
en.description: Activations span email-list address punctuation and fields, code quotes, newlines, and import paths, as well as word-internal fragments in multilingual parliamentary text; these patterns have no apparent shared meaning or genre condition.

patterns.name: Email addresses and mailing lists
patterns.context: Multiple email addresses are listed consecutively, often with commas, newlines, names, or organization names; activation is distributed across address components and separators

patterns.name: Quotes, newlines, and import statements in code
patterns.context: Program code repeatedly contains line delimiters, string quotes, import statements, and package paths; path fragments also activate
patterns.domain: Github code, including C header files, Java imports, and Go package declarations

patterns.name: Sentence-final words in French political text
patterns.context: In an EU narrative, «stable» at the end of a sentence or phrase receives the strongest activation; nearby content concerns a single currency

patterns.name: Internal fragments of German compounds or long words
patterns.context: In German parliamentary sentences, activation falls on internal subword fragments of compounds and long words, without a shared meaning or fixed part of speech

patterns.name: Danish word fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on word-final fragments in Danish parliamentary text; the examples are insufficient to establish stable lexical conditions

2_2191.concept: 异质的结构与词内片段触发
2_2191.description: 激活覆盖邮箱列表的地址标点与字段、代码的引号换行及导入路径，以及多语种议会文本中的词内片段；这些模式表面上并无统一词义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 电子邮件地址与邮箱名单
patterns.trigger: «@»、«.»、«com»、«edu»，以及人名与尖括号邮箱格式
patterns.context: 连续列举多个邮箱地址，常伴随逗号、换行、姓名或组织名；激活分布在地址组成部分及分隔符上
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的收件人/联系人列表

patterns.name: 代码中的引号、换行与导入语句
patterns.context: 程序代码中重复出现行界定符、字符串引号、导入语句和包路径；路径片段也有激活
patterns.domain: Github 代码，包含 C 头文件、Java 导入和 Go 包声明

patterns.name: 法语政治文本中的句末词语
patterns.context: 欧盟叙述中，句末或短语收尾处的 «stable» 获得最强激活；邻近内容谈论单一货币

patterns.name: 德语复合词或长词内部片段
patterns.context: 德语议会句子中，激活落在复合词、长词的内部子词片段，并非统一的词义或固定词类

patterns.name: 丹麦语词语片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在丹麦语议会文本的词尾片段；样例不足以确认稳定的词法条件

en.description: Activation is distributed across split morphemes and character fragments, often in technical identifiers, paths, email addresses, and names; it also appears in multilingual parliamentary compounds, paper terminology, and forum punctuation/signatures, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Morpheme/character fragments inside words
patterns.context: Activation often falls inside split words, especially technical identifiers, file paths, email addresses, and names; it does not always correspond to a complete word meaning.

patterns.name: Specific identifiers and filenames in code
patterns.context: In C/C++ header-file paths or Scala test dependency declarations, activation concentrates on components of class names, library names, and filenames.

patterns.name: Word endings and security-related words in European issues
patterns.context: In German parliamentary statements, activation falls on compounds and their split morphemes, especially words related to security, defense, and objectives; in another French passage, it falls on morphemes in words for “world war” and “stability.”

patterns.name: Polish names and institutional addresses
patterns.context: In academic author and address lines, activation occurs in spelling fragments of Polish names and institution names.

patterns.name: Forensic entomology terminology
patterns.context: In an introduction explaining the term forensic entomology, strong activation falls on the closing quotation mark around the term.

patterns.name: Tk/Tcl technical names
patterns.context: When discussing the Tk GUI toolkit and its theme functionality, activation falls on internal character fragments of the names; sparse activation also occurs in ordinary prose in the same passage.

patterns.name: Email recipient names and addresses
patterns.context: In email header recipient lists, activation occurs in split fragments of names and email addresses.

patterns.name: Quotation marks/punctuation and signatures in discussion
patterns.context: A question mark appears at the end of a comment, followed by a username signature after a separator line; weakly activated word fragments also occur in the body.

2_2191.concept: 词内片段与专名/标识符
2_2191.description: 激活分布于拆分的词素和字符片段，常见于技术标识符、路径、邮箱及姓名；也出现在多语种议会复合词、论文术语和论坛标点/签名，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 单词内部的词素/字符片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在被拆分的词内部，尤其是技术标识符、文件路径、邮箱地址和姓名；并非总对应完整词义。
patterns.domain: 代码、标识符、联系人信息

patterns.name: 代码中的特定标识符与文件名
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件路径或 Scala 测试依赖声明中，激活集中在类名、库名和文件名的组成片段。

patterns.name: 欧洲议题中的词尾与安全相关词
patterns.context: 德语议会语句中，激活落在复合词及其拆分词素，尤其是安全、防务和目标相关词；另一段法语中则落在“世界大战”与“稳定”等词的词素。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、多语种政治论述

patterns.name: 波兰姓名与机构地址
patterns.context: 学术论文作者及地址行中，激活出现在波兰姓名、机构名的拼写片段。

patterns.name: 昆虫法医学术语
patterns.context: 引言中解释 forensic entomology 一词时，强激活落在引号内术语的结束引号。

patterns.name: Tk/Tcl 技术名称
patterns.context: 讨论 Tk 图形工具包及其主题功能时，激活落在名称内部字符片段；同段普通叙述也有零星激活。

patterns.name: 邮件收件人姓名与地址
patterns.context: 邮件头中的收件人列表，姓名及邮箱被拆分的片段出现激活。

patterns.name: 讨论中的引号/标点及签名
patterns.context: 评论文本末尾出现问号、分隔线后的用户名签名；正文也有弱激活词片段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several word-internal fragments and whole words: case/briefcase, brokers, German compounds, hard(er), probands/probiotics, Newcastle, and conservative. They span domains and contexts, with no stable unified meaning.

patterns.name: Word-internal suffixes or boundary fragments
patterns.context: Triggers fall on parts of longer words or paths rather than stable whole words; examples include “briefcase”, “case”, “probands”, “probiotics”, “brokers”, and “Verteidigungsunion”.
patterns.domain: Legal, code, email, news, and academic texts

patterns.name: “briefcase” and related contexts
patterns.context: One is a briefcase in an evidence list; another is a commentary containing a nuclear strike threat. Their only commonality is “briefcase”; the other contexts differ.

patterns.name: Final segment of a German compound
patterns.context: In German political text, activation lies near an internal boundary in the compound “Verteidigungsunion”.

patterns.name: Email address and encoded string
patterns.context: An address appears in an email header, containing a split-marked domain and escape characters.

patterns.name: case in a code path
patterns.context: A comment for a generated file lists a source-file path containing “case”; activation also covers slashes and fragments in the path.

patterns.name: hard(er) in an astronomy term
patterns.context: Describes a predicted slope as bluer and harder than the observed slope; activation falls mainly on the comparative expression.

patterns.name: Schizophrenia sample terminology
patterns.context: Appears in “schizophrenic probands”, referring to probands in the study sample.

patterns.name: Probiotic word form
patterns.context: Appears in “probiotics”, discussing fungi, the host immune system, and the gastrointestinal tract.

patterns.name: Newcastle in a disease name
patterns.context: A place-name or disease-name fragment remains at the start of an abstract, which then shifts to a trial of surgery for cerebral hemorrhage.

patterns.name: Conservative-related wording
patterns.context: Describes a political figure in one instance and conservative treatment for cerebral hemorrhage in another; the meanings and fields differ, as do the activation locations.

2_2191.description: 激活分散在若干词内片段与完整词上：case/briefcase、brokers、德语复合词、hard(er)、probands/probiotics、Newcastle及conservative。跨领域且上下文差异明显，未见稳定统一语义。

patterns.name: 词内后缀或词边界片段
patterns.context: 触发落在较长词或路径的一部分，并非稳定的完整词；例如“briefcase”“case”“probands”“probiotics”“brokers”“Verteidigungsunion”。
patterns.domain: 法律、代码、邮件、新闻、学术文本

patterns.name: “briefcase”及相关语境
patterns.trigger: “briefcase”[1,6]；另有“briefcase”相邻的“stolen credit cards”[1]、“nuclear”与“infinite damage”[6]
patterns.context: 一个是证物清单中的公文包，另一个是带有核打击威胁的评论；共同点只是出现“briefcase”，其余语境不同。

patterns.name: 德语复合词末段
patterns.context: 德语政治文本中，激活位于复合词“Verteidigungsunion”的内部边界附近。

patterns.name: 电子邮件地址与编码字符串
patterns.context: 地址出现在邮件头，包含被拆分标记的域名和转义字符。

patterns.name: 代码路径中的 case
patterns.context: 生成文件的注释列出一个包含“case”的源文件路径；激活还覆盖路径中的斜杠及片段。

patterns.name: 天文学术语中的 hard(er)
patterns.context: 形容预测斜率比观测斜率更蓝、更硬；激活主要落在比较级表达上。

patterns.name: 精神分裂症样本术语
patterns.context: 出现在“schizophrenic probands”中，指研究样本的先证者。

patterns.name: 益生菌词形
patterns.context: 出现在“probiotics”中，讨论真菌与宿主免疫系统及胃肠道。

patterns.name: 疾病名称中的 Newcastle
patterns.context: 作为摘要开头残留的地名或疾病名称片段，随后转入脑出血手术试验。

patterns.name: 保守派相关措辞
patterns.context: 一次描述政治人物，一次描述脑出血的保守治疗；词义和领域不同，且激活位置也不同。

en.description: Activation often falls on internal/final word fragments, quotation marks, and newline boundaries; examples occur in code paths, legal narratives, typography discussions, and multilingual text. There are also local triggers such as team and pt, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: String, identifier, and quotation-mark boundaries
patterns.context: Activation often falls on quotation marks, newlines, or final fragments of code/paths/identifiers; adjacent punctuation and word fragments sometimes co-occur.
patterns.domain: Code, configuration files, file paths, and serialized text

patterns.name: Internal and final word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across internal or final fragments of split words, with no stable shared meaning; fragments sometimes occur in compounds, proper names, or multilingual text.
patterns.domain: German, English, Spanish, and directory text

patterns.name: Sentence-final newlines and whitespace
patterns.context: Occurs at text or code-block boundaries, often alongside quotation marks, indentation, or word fragments; this trigger is strongest in segment 2.
patterns.domain: Literary text, legal narratives, code, and documentation

patterns.name: briefcase in a legal evidence list
patterns.context: Appears in a legal narrative describing items found in a search; the same passage also lists credit cards, driver's licenses, and other items.

patterns.name: case in a filename
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a source filename listed in an automatically generated code comment, unrelated to a legal context.

patterns.name: Word fragments related to research teams
patterns.context: Appears in an institutional profile, next to text describing members such as scientists and engineers.

patterns.name: Typography terms and font sizes
patterns.context: Discusses how Minion Pro looks at smaller font sizes, followed by typography examples.

patterns.name: Spanish statistical text fragments
patterns.context: Appears in humanities and social-science text about graduates and statistical data.

patterns.name: Word fragments in a political meeting title
patterns.context: Embedded in the German meeting title “Gemeinsam für psychische Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden”.

2_2191.description: 激活多落在词内/词尾片段、引号与换行边界；代码路径、法律叙述、排版讨论和多语正文均有例子。另有team、pt等局部触发，未呈现统一语义。

patterns.name: 字符串、标识符与引号边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在引号、换行或代码/路径/标识符的末尾片段；有时伴随相邻标点和词片。
patterns.domain: 代码、配置文件、文件路径及序列化文本

patterns.name: 词内片段与词尾
patterns.context: 激活分布在被拆分的词内部或末尾片段，未见稳定的共同词义；片段有时处于复合词、专名或多语文本中。
patterns.domain: 德语、英语、西班牙语及目录文字

patterns.name: 句末换行与空白
patterns.trigger: «↵»（尤其连续换行或换行后缩进）
patterns.context: 在文本或代码段落边界处出现，常与引号、缩进或词片段同现；第2段此触发最强。
patterns.domain: 文学文本、法律叙述、代码与文档

patterns.name: 法律证物清单中的briefcase
patterns.context: 出现在描述搜查所得物品的法律叙述中；同段还列出信用卡、驾照等。

patterns.name: 文件名中的case
patterns.context: 出现在自动生成的代码注释所列源文件名末尾，与法律语境无关。

patterns.name: 科研团队相关词片
patterns.context: 出现在机构简介中，紧邻描述科学家、工程师等成员的文字。

patterns.name: 排版术语及字号
patterns.context: 谈论 Minion Pro 在较小字号下的显示效果，后接排版示例。

patterns.name: 西班牙语统计文字片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于毕业生及统计数据的人文社科文字中。

patterns.name: 政治会议标题中的词片段
patterns.context: 嵌在德语会议标题“Gemeinsam für psychische Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden”中。

en.description: The clearest recurring cue is English times/timescales, especially in discussions of time required, duration, or scale. Activations also occur across Hungarian fragments, Spanish por, German and citation fragments, as well as financial, WASM, and philosophical contexts; overall, the pattern is mixed.

patterns.name: times in English compounds
patterns.context: In English, times follows phrases describing duration, cost, or scale; examples include standalone times and tokenized forms of timescales.

patterns.name: Internal/cross-word tokenization of times
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized word fragments, with no stable shared semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-final and internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation concentrates within or at the ends of Hungarian words; it occurs in continuous inflected text, but the specific morphological functions vary.

patterns.name: Spanish preposition por
patterns.context: por appears in academic narration introducing a philosophy lecturer or the subject under discussion.

patterns.name: Accurate/reliable financial information
patterns.context: Requests accurate information about financial conditions.

patterns.name: WASM runtime
patterns.context: Discusses server-side runtimes for running WASM outside a browser; the strongest marker falls on the end of runtimes.

patterns.name: Drilling time in a patent
patterns.context: Geothermal steam wells require substantial drilling time and are expensive.

patterns.name: The term “semantic problem”
patterns.context: A Spanish philosophy paper discusses a problem in semantics and its prior treatment.

patterns.name: Fragments of paper citation identifiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of ArXiv citation identifiers; there is no clear semantic cue.

patterns.name: Possible character-level or tokenization noise
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across fragments within multilingual words, from which no consistent meaning or grammatical function can be determined.

2_2191.concept: 英文 times 及多语词片
2_2191.description: 最清楚的重复线索是英语 times/timescales，尤其谈论耗时、持续时间或尺度；此外激活散布于匈牙利语词片、西班牙语 por、德语及引文碎片，并有财务、WASM和哲学语境，整体模式混杂。

patterns.name: 英语复合词中的 times
patterns.context: 英语中 times 接在描述持续时间、成本或尺度的词组后；既包括独立的 times，也包括 timescales 的切分形式。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、天体物理学论文

patterns.name: times 的词内/跨词切分
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的词片段上，未见稳定的共同语义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 德语议会报告、天体物理学参考文献

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词尾及词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在匈牙利语单词内部或词尾；出现于词形变化丰富的连续文本中，但具体词法功能并不一致。

patterns.name: 西班牙语介词 por
patterns.context: por 出现在介绍哲学讲授者或讨论对象的学术叙述中。

patterns.name: 精确/可靠财务信息
patterns.context: 要求取得关于财务状况的准确信息。

patterns.name: WASM 运行时
patterns.context: 讨论浏览器之外运行 WASM 的服务器端运行时；最强标记落在 runtimes 的词尾。

patterns.name: 专利钻井耗时
patterns.context: 地热蒸汽井需要大量钻井时间，且成本较高。

patterns.name: 术语“semantic problem”
patterns.context: 西班牙语哲学论文中谈及语义学问题及其既有讨论。

patterns.name: 论文引文标识片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 ArXiv 文献引用标识的内部片段；无明确语义线索。

patterns.name: 疑似字符级或分词噪声
patterns.context: 激活分布在多语言词内部的碎片上，无法从片段独立确定一致词义或语法功能。

en.description: Strong activation falls on local fragments of multilingual word forms: English days, Czech word-final ky, Estonian tulevik, Hungarian temporal endings, Spanish endings or por, Italian due, and the technical proper name Dalvik. The semantics and registers vary considerably.

patterns.name: English days and comparative collocations
patterns.context: In English, days refers to days or units of time; one instance contrasts good/bad, and another occurs in a comparison of eras.

patterns.name: Czech word endings or fragments
patterns.context: In a Czech parliamentary speech, the fragment poplatky (fees) occurs at the end of a question; strong activation falls on the ending ky.

patterns.name: Estonian tulevik word forms
patterns.context: In Estonian parliamentary text, tulevik (future) appears in different inflected forms.

patterns.name: Hungarian időnk ending
patterns.context: In Hungarian parliamentary text, an internal fragment of the time-related word időnként is activated.

patterns.name: Spanish esfuerzos ending
patterns.context: In Spanish academic text, a final fragment of esfuerzos (efforts) occurs in the phrase en los marcos de estos esfuerzos.

patterns.name: Italian due
patterns.context: In an Italian academic paragraph, due (two) occurs before condiz.ioni.

patterns.name: Spanish por
patterns.context: In a Spanish philosophy paper, por introduces David Kaplan as the person addressing the relevant question.

patterns.name: Dalvik substring
patterns.context: In the name Dalvik in an Android JIT compiler link, activation falls on the substring vik.

2_2191.description: 强激活落在多语种词形的局部片段：英语 days、捷克语词尾 ky、爱沙尼亚语 tulevik、匈牙利语时间词尾、西班牙语词尾或 por、意大利语 due，以及技术专名 Dalvik。语义与语域差异明显。

patterns.name: 英语 days 及其比较搭配
patterns.context: 英文语境中，days 指日子或时间单位；一处与 good/bad 对比，一处在比较年代时出现。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 叙述；PhilPapers 学术文本

patterns.name: 捷克语词尾或词片段
patterns.context: 捷克语议会发言中，词片段 poplatky（费用）位于问句末尾；较强激活落在词尾 ky。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语 tulevik 词形
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语议会文本中，tulevik（未来）以不同词尾形式出现。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语 időnk 词尾
patterns.context: 匈牙利语议会文本中，时间相关词 időnként 的词内片段被激活。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 esfuerzos 词尾
patterns.context: 西班牙语学术文本中，esfuerzos（努力）的词尾片段处于短语 en los marcos de estos esfuerzos 中。

patterns.name: 意大利语 due
patterns.context: 意大利语学术段落中，due（两个）出现在 condiz.ioni 之前。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 por
patterns.context: 西班牙语哲学论文中，por 引出 David Kaplan 作为相关问题的处理者。

patterns.name: Dalvik 子串
patterns.context: Android JIT 编译器链接中的 Dalvik 名称内，激活落在 vik 子串。

en.concept: Word forms/subword fragments and due to
en.description: High activations often fall on within-word fragments split into subwords, especially in Italian, Finnish, Hungarian, Dutch, and French. In English, the due in due to stands out, along with a few instances of times. Patterns vary substantially across corpora, parts of speech, and semantics.

patterns.name: Italian word-form boundary components
patterns.context: In continuous Italian text, activation falls within words split across subwords, especially on affixes or stem fragments; no stable sentence-level semantic condition is apparent

patterns.name: Finnish compound-word/word-form fragments
patterns.context: Finnish inflected forms and long compounds are split into multiple tokens; activation concentrates on within-word fragments

patterns.name: Hungarian within-word fragments
patterns.context: Stems, affixes, or within-word fragments spanning tokens in agglutinative Hungarian forms; no clear semantic constraint

patterns.name: Dutch word-form fragments and public hearing terms
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across internal fragments of Dutch compounds and inflected/derived words, especially words meaning “public hearing” and “organization”

patterns.name: English due to collocation
patterns.context: In English, due to introduces a reason, followed by explanations involving performance, contracts, or costs. There are also activations in adjacent passages that may be affected by word-form segmentation

patterns.name: times in expressions of time/frequency
patterns.context: In the English phrase “numerous times before,” times denotes the number of repeated occurrences; due to does not appear in this passage

patterns.name: Category term in a French statistical definition
patterns.context: When explaining categorical variables and their groupings of values, activation falls on a subword fragment within “catégorielle”; other nearby activations are weaker

patterns.name: Final fragment of a Finnish regulatory term
patterns.context: In parliamentary text discussing continued supervision of member-state markets, activation falls on a long within-word fragment of the compound “valvontakyvyn”; may overlap with other Finnish within-word fragment patterns

patterns.name: Final fragment of a Dutch organization term
patterns.context: In a sentence stating that a public hearing has been organized, activation falls on an internal word-form fragment of the verb “georganiseerd”

patterns.name: English segmented fragment after due to
patterns.context: Describes software being unavailable due to poor performance; strong activation corresponds to due, immediately followed by to

patterns.name: English segmented fragment after due to
patterns.context: In a comment on football transfer prices and contract years, due to introduces the reason for an offer

patterns.name: English segmented fragment after due to
patterns.context: When discussing the cost-effectiveness of rooftop solar, due to introduces labor costs as the reason

patterns.name: English WASM plural ending
patterns.context: Discusses server-side WASM runtimes; high activation falls on times in a technical plural noun phrase

2_2191.concept: 词形/词片段与 due to
2_2191.description: 高激活多落在被子词切分的词内片段，特别是意大利语、芬兰语、匈牙利语、荷兰语和法语；英语中突出 due to 的 due，以及少数 times。跨语料、词类和语义差异较大。

patterns.name: 意大利语词形边界成分
patterns.context: 意大利语连续文本中，激活落在跨子词切分的词内部，尤其是词缀或词干片段；未见稳定的句义条件
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语政治文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语复合词/词形片段
patterns.context: 芬兰语词形变化和长复合词被切分成多个 token；激活集中于词内片段

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语黏着词形中的词干、词缀或跨 token 词内片段；无明显语义限制
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语政治文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语词形片段及公开听证会词语
patterns.context: 激活分布于荷兰语复合词与屈折/派生词的内部片段，尤其是“公开听证会”“组织”等词

patterns.name: 英语 due to 搭配
patterns.context: 英语中 due to 引出原因；后接性能、合同或成本等原因说明。另有相邻段内可能受词形切分影响的激活

patterns.name: 时间/次数表达中的 times
patterns.context: 英语短语“numerous times before”中，times 表示反复发生的次数；本段未出现 due to

patterns.name: 法语统计学定义中的类别词
patterns.context: 解释分类变量及其取值分组时，激活落在“catégorielle”的词内片段；其他邻近激活较弱

patterns.name: 芬兰语监管词的尾部片段
patterns.context: 议会文本讨论继续监督成员国市场时，激活落在复合词“valvontakyvyn”的长词内片段；可能与其他芬兰语词内片段模式重叠

patterns.name: 荷兰语组织词尾部片段
patterns.context: 公共听证会已被组织的句子中，激活落在动词“georganiseerd”的内部词形片段

patterns.name: 英语 due to 之后的切分片段
patterns.context: 描述软件因性能差而不可用；强激活对应 due，且其后紧接 to

patterns.name: 英语 due to 之后的切分片段
patterns.context: 足球转会价格及合同年份的评论中，due to 引出报价理由

patterns.name: 英语 due to 之后的切分片段
patterns.context: 讨论太阳能屋顶的成本效益时，due to 引出人工成本这一原因

patterns.name: 英语 WASM 复数词尾
patterns.context: 讨论服务器端 WASM 运行时；高激活落在 times，语境为技术复数名词短语

en.description: Activation shows several local patterns: English text repeatedly responds strongly to the causal phrase “due to”; Dutch responds to “geconfronteerd” and also includes crisis-related fragments; Italian activation is scattered across several policy words, expressions, and internal word fragments. The languages and contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Italian fragments related to «presente»
patterns.context: In an Italian sentence, activation concentrates on internal fragments of the capitalized word «PRESENTAZIONE» and the ending of «piacere»; the surrounding sentence concerns time, climate, architecture, and other topics.

patterns.name: Dutch «geconfronteerd»
patterns.context: In Dutch, this word occurs in a syntactic context where a committee is “confronted” with a situation; nearby words include «commissies» and «met».
patterns.domain: EuroParl; parliamentary procedure and trade policy text

patterns.name: Crisis concepts and their internal fragments
patterns.context: When discussing crises and the concept of «crisis» in Dutch, activation falls on the word and its internal substrings; the context includes «oplossingen», «leven», «wiskundigen», and «fysici».

patterns.name: Italian financial services directive
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of words related to financial services and community policy, within parliamentary statements about a directive taking effect and the development of new policies.
patterns.domain: EuroParl; EU financial regulation and policy text

patterns.name: English due to
patterns.context: In the English causal phrase «due to», «due» is strongly activated; it is followed by an explanation of a cause or grounds for a recommendation. The phrase occurs in varied contexts, including performance problems, evaluations, profit motives, and transport advice.
patterns.domain: HackerNews conversations, Pile-CC web pages, and transport information

patterns.name: Causal construction with due to in an English comment
patterns.context: In a HackerNews comment, «due to» introduces the reason a book fell out of favor; the surrounding text evaluates the book and describes its era.

patterns.name: Italian account of relations with Serbia
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final internal portion of «avviare» (to initiate, start); the sentence describes an attempt to cooperate with neighboring Serbia emerging from grief.
patterns.domain: EuroParl; international relations and parliamentary speeches

2_2191.description: 激活呈多种局部模式：英文本中反复强烈响应因果短语“due to”；荷兰语响应“geconfronteerd”，并出现危机词片段；意大利语则分散在若干政策词、表述及词内片段。语言和语境差异较大。

patterns.name: 意大利语「presente」相关片段
patterns.context: 意大利语句子中，激活集中在大写词「PRESENTAZIONE」的词内片段及其后「piacere」的末尾；句子周围涉及时间、气候、建筑等内容。

patterns.name: 荷兰语「geconfronteerd」
patterns.context: 荷兰语中该词出现在委员会「面对」某种情形的句法环境；附近出现「commissies」「met」等词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl；议会程序与贸易政策文本

patterns.name: 危机概念及其词内片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语讨论危机及「crisis」这一概念时，激活落在该词及词内子串；伴随「oplossingen」「leven」「wiskundigen」「fysici」等语境。

patterns.name: 意大利语金融服务指令
patterns.context: 激活落在金融服务及共同体政策相关词语的词内片段，置于指令生效、制定新政策等议会表述中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl；欧盟金融监管与政策文本

patterns.name: 英文 due to
patterns.context: 英文因果短语「due to」中「due」强激活；后接原因解释或建议依据。该短语出现在性能问题、评价、利润动因和交通建议等不同语境。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 对话、Pile-CC 网页与交通信息

patterns.name: 英文评论中的 due to 因果结构
patterns.context: 在 HackerNews 评论中，「due to」引出某本书失宠的原因；周边是书籍评价及年代描述。

patterns.name: 塞尔维亚关系的意大利语叙述
patterns.context: 激活在「avviare」（开启、启动）的词内末段；句子描述从悲痛中出现与邻国塞尔维亚展开合作的尝试。

en.description: Activation often falls on suffixes or final fragments of words across languages, especially Italian infinitives and Estonian inflected words. It also appears on French medical word endings, Java class-name endings, and sporadic English word fragments, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Italian inflected word endings
patterns.context: In Italian, endings or parts of word forms are split into multiple tokens; common in infinitive verbs, and also seen in nouns and adjectives. Activation does not always fall on the complete ending.
patterns.domain: Italian European Parliament and philosophical texts

patterns.name: Estonian word endings
patterns.context: In inflected Estonian words, activation falls on endings or nearby fragments after segmentation; in segment 4 it appears in expressions such as “tuleviku nimel,” while in segment 3 it falls on a later part of the same word.

patterns.name: Fragments within program identifiers
patterns.context: In Java package and class names, activation falls on the end of camel-case class names rather than on ordinary word endings in sentences.

patterns.name: French medical word endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on a final fragment of “opératoires,” in a medical account of an uncomplicated postoperative recovery.

patterns.name: Final parts of English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal final part of a comparative adjective and on a separate adverb; the two instances have no clear shared syntactic or semantic condition.

2_2191.description: 激活常落在多语种词的后缀或末尾片段，尤其意大利语不定式、爱沙尼亚语屈折词；也出现在法语医学词尾、Java 类名末尾及英语零散词片段，未见稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 意大利语屈折词尾
patterns.trigger: »ere«、»e«、»i«、»a» 等，尤其长词中的词尾片段，如« red»2«ige»2«re»10、« av»1«via«re»10、« pot»1«ote«re»10
patterns.context: 意大利语中词尾或词形的一部分被切成多个 token；常见于不定式动词，也见于名词或形容词。激活不总落在完整词尾上。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会意大利语、哲学文本

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词尾
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语屈折词中，激活落在分词后的词尾或词尾附近；第4段出现在“tuleviku nimel”一类表达中，第3段则落在同一词的后续部分。

patterns.name: 程序标识符内部片段
patterns.context: Java 包名和类名中，激活落在驼峰式类名的末尾，而非句子中的普通词尾。

patterns.name: 法语医学词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在“opératoires”的词尾片段，处于手术后恢复顺利的医学叙述中。

patterns.name: 英语词的末尾部分
patterns.context: 激活分别落在比较级形容词的词内末尾和独立副词上；两处没有明显共同的句法或语义条件。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on fragments of multilingual word forms: Italian infinitive -re, feminine plural forms, and -mente, as well as English times; Portuguese perspect-, Spanish posit-, and isolated si also occur, along with a highly activated fragment that appears garbled. These do not form a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Italian infinitive ending -re
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the Italian infinitive ending -re; strong instances occur in «redigere», «esprimere», and «avviare». The «re» in segments 6 and 8 is weaker and does not necessarily form a clear infinitive.
patterns.domain: EU parliamentary Italian, English web forums

patterns.name: Italian feminine plural past participle ending
patterns.context: Occurs in Italian feminine plural forms (such as «operate», «presentate») or in the adjacent string «present»; word boundaries and token segmentation are not always consistent.

patterns.name: Italian adverb/adjective ending -mente
patterns.context: The ending -mente occurs in Italian adverbs; in segment 4, «mente» occurs in incomplete or noisy text.

patterns.name: English times and related forms
patterns.context: In two English passages, activation falls on times; segment 2 discusses movie clichés, while segment 6 is a forum quote.

patterns.name: Portuguese perspectiv- stem
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of the Portuguese noun «perspectivas», in a sentence about partnerships and growth prospects.

patterns.name: Spanish posit- stem
patterns.context: Strong activation occurs in «positivas», contrasted with «negativas» in the same sentence; it mainly falls on the string posit-.

patterns.name: Italian stare/si-related forms
patterns.context: «si» occurs in an Italian sentence; it may be a reflexive or impersonal pronoun, but the context alone cannot confirm that this is a distinct trigger feature.

patterns.name: English interested / interesting endings
patterns.context: Activation occurs in interesting in a quotation, but is weak; there is insufficient evidence that it is related to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Unclassifiable highly activated fragment
patterns.context: Possibly a username, garbled text, or truncated string; there is insufficient surrounding context to determine the word form or trigger condition.

2_2191.description: 激活主要落在多语种词形片段：意大利语不定式 -re、阴性复数形式及 -mente，也有英语 times；另见葡萄牙语 perspect-、西班牙语 posit-，并有孤立的 si 与疑似乱码高激活，不能归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 意大利语动词不定式词尾 -re
patterns.context: 激活集中在意大利语动词不定式词尾 -re；较强实例分别出现在 «redigere»、«esprimere»、«avviare»。第6、8段的 «re» 较弱，且不一定构成清晰的不定式。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会意大利语、网络论坛英语

patterns.name: 意大利语完成分词阴性复数词尾
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语阴性复数形式（如 «operate»、«presentate»）或相邻的 «present» 字符串中；词界与分词切分并不总一致。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会意大利语、哲学文本

patterns.name: 意大利语副词/形容词词尾 -mente
patterns.context: 词尾 -mente 出现在意大利语副词中；第4段的 «mente» 位于残缺或噪声较多的文本中。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会意大利语、哲学文本

patterns.name: 英语 times 及相关词形
patterns.context: 在两段英语文本中，激活落在 times；第2段谈电影套路，第6段为论坛引语。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 perspectiv- 词干
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语名词 «perspectivas» 的词尾，处于关于伙伴关系与增长前景的句子中。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 posit- 词干
patterns.context: 较强激活出现在 «positivas» 中，和同句的 «negativas» 对照；主要落在 posit- 字符串。

patterns.name: 意大利语 stare/si 相关形式
patterns.context: 在意大利语句子中出现 «si»；可能是反身/无人称代词，但单凭上下文难以确认这是独立触发特征。

patterns.name: 英语 interested / interesting 词尾
patterns.context: 激活出现在引语中的 interesting，但强度较低，未见足够证据表明其与主要模式相关。

patterns.name: 无从归类的高激活片段
patterns.context: 疑似用户名、乱码或截断字符串，周围语境不足以确定词形或触发条件。

en.description: Activation primarily targets within-word or word-final subword fragments across languages, with Italian infinitive -re most prominent; French word endings also recur. Other instances include sporadic English, Dutch, and technical-term fragments, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Italian infinitive ending
patterns.context: Italian infinitive ending -re; strongest in “esprimere” and “potere,” and also occurs in final fragments of words such as “iniziare” and “ricordare”

patterns.name: French word-final fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments occurring at the ends of French words; involve nouns and adjectives, not the same complete word or a fixed meaning
patterns.domain: Academic texts, European Parliament texts, and medical texts

patterns.name: Other Italian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across subword fragments of verbs, nouns, and adjectives in Italian parliamentary sentences; apart from the word-final pattern, no clear consistent semantic condition

patterns.name: English -ing fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in “veiling,” meaning to obscure; no other similar trigger appears in the current examples

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a long Dutch word
patterns.context: Occurs in the plural ending of a word meaning “responsible person”; only one example

patterns.name: French nominal ending
patterns.context: French feminine adjective ending; a single instance, with insufficient evidence to confirm the same condition as other high-activation fragments

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Local fragments of several terms or common words in medical pathology accounts; there is insufficient evidence that these fragments form a stable pattern

2_2191.concept: 多语种词尾与子词片段
2_2191.description: 激活以多语种词内或词尾子词片段为主，意大利语不定式 -re 最突出；法语词尾也反复出现。其余包括零散的英语、荷兰语及专业词片段，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 意大利语不定式词尾
patterns.context: 意大利语动词不定式词尾 -re；在“esprimere”“potere”中最强，也出现在“iniziare”“ricordare”等词的末尾片段
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 法语词尾片段
patterns.context: 法语词汇中出现在词末的子词片段；涉及名词和形容词，并非同一个完整词或固定语义
patterns.domain: 学术文本、欧洲议会文本及医学文本

patterns.name: 意大利语其他词形片段
patterns.context: 意大利语议会句子中，分散出现在动词、名词和形容词的子词片段；除词尾模式外没有明显一致的语义条件
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 英语 -ing 片段
patterns.context: 出现在“veiling”中，描述遮蔽；当前例子中没有其他相似触发

patterns.name: 荷兰语长词内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在表示“责任人”的复数形式词尾；仅有一个例子

patterns.name: 法语名词性词尾
patterns.context: 法语阴性形容词词尾；孤例，难与其他高激活片段确认同一条件

patterns.name: 专业词语中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 医学病理叙述中多个术语或常用词的局部片段；没有足够证据说明这些片段构成稳定模式

en.description: Activation often falls on internal or final subword fragments across Italian, French, Slovenian, and English, commonly in inflected, derived, or plural forms; some instances match Italian potere, but meanings and domains are not uniform.

patterns.name: Italian internal word boundaries
patterns.context: Italian words are split into multiple subword fragments; stronger activation falls on final fragments or fragments of completed word forms, especially the infinitive ending -re, but other endings also occur
patterns.domain: European Parliament Italian speeches and Italian academic commentary

patterns.name: French internal word fragments
patterns.context: Words in French text are split into subwords; activation concentrates on internal or final fragments and does not correspond to a clear shared meaning
patterns.domain: European Parliament French speeches and medical case reports

patterns.name: Fragments of power-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in statements that “the state has the power to act” or that “political power is separate from religious authorities”; the trigger fragment is the ending of Italian potere
patterns.domain: European Parliament political and institutional discussion

patterns.name: Word endings in English patent terminology
patterns.context: In English patent background text, the technical noun photomasks is split, with activation falling on the plural ending
patterns.domain: Semiconductor manufacturing and lithography patent text

patterns.name: Slovenian word-final fragments
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech calls on colleagues to participate in the work; activation falls on an internal final fragment

2_2191.description: 激活多落在跨意大利语、法语、斯洛文尼亚语及英语的词内或词尾子词片段，常见于屈折、派生或复数形式；部分命中意大利语 potere，但词义和领域并不统一。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内边界
patterns.context: 意大利语词被拆分成多个子词片段；较强激活落在词尾或完成词形的片段上，尤其是不定式动词词尾 -re，但也见于其他词尾
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语发言及意大利语学术评论

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 法语文本中单词被拆分为子词；激活集中在词中或词尾片段，不对应一个明确的共同词义
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会法语发言及医学病例文本

patterns.name: 权力相关词的片段
patterns.context: 出现在“国家有权采取行动”或“政治权力与宗教当局分离”等表述中；触发片段是意大利语 potere 的词尾
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会政治与制度论述

patterns.name: 英语专利术语中的词尾
patterns.context: 英语专利背景文本中，技术名词 photomasks 被拆分，激活落在复数词尾片段
patterns.domain: 半导体制造与光刻专利文本

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词尾片段
patterns.context: 议会发言中呼吁同事参与工作；激活落在词内末尾片段
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会斯洛文尼亚语发言

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the Italian infinitive verb ending “-re” across parliamentary, philosophical, and literary texts; there is also local activation in Portuguese “vez” and English “knower,” which cannot be grouped under the same word-ending pattern.

patterns.name: Italian infinitive ending -re
patterns.context: Activation markers fall on the infinitive verb ending “re”; the word form is often split into multiple tokens, with the verb stem preceding it.
patterns.domain: Italian parliamentary speeches, philosophical texts, and literary criticism

patterns.name: Ending re in a Portuguese verb
patterns.context: Segment 10 is Portuguese parliamentary text, and the strong activation position is “vez,” which does not match the distribution of the Italian infinitive ending.

patterns.name: French polit«ico»
patterns.context: An Italian sentence discusses political power and the separation of religious institutions; the high-activation “re” still falls on the infinitive ending of “potere.”
patterns.domain: French speech with embedded Italian in EuroParl

patterns.name: English noun suffix er
patterns.context: In an English sentence, activation falls on “er” in the noun “knower,” which does not match the Italian infinitive-ending pattern.

2_2191.description: 主要对意大利语不定式动词词尾「-re」强烈响应，跨越议会、哲学和文学文本；另有葡语「vez」及英语「knower」中的局部激活，不能归入同一词尾模式。

patterns.name: 意大利语不定式词尾 -re
patterns.context: 激活标记落在不定式动词词尾「re」；词形常被分成多个 token，前面是动词词干。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会发言、哲学文本及文学评论

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语动词中的词尾 re
patterns.trigger: 「rep«etir»2-se」「seg«unda»3 «vez»9」中，强激活实际落在「vez」而非动词词尾；段10未显示「re」激活
patterns.context: 段10是葡萄牙语议会文本，强激活位置为「vez」，与意大利语不定式词尾的分布不吻合。

patterns.name: 法语 polit«ico»
patterns.context: 意大利语句子中谈论政治权力及宗教机构分离；高激活的「re」仍位于「potere」的不定式词尾。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 中夹有意大利语的法语发言

patterns.name: 英语名词后缀 er
patterns.context: 英语句子中激活落在名词「knower」的「er」，不符合意大利语不定式词尾模式。

en.description: The strongest and most recurring pattern is the -inal fragment in English ophthalmic terms such as retinal; other activations are scattered across internal or final fragments in Italian, French, and Latvian parliamentary text, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Endings of retinal-related anatomical terms
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the endings of the English medical terms retinal, subretinal, and extraretinal; the surrounding context concerns ocular anatomy or retinal signals.

patterns.name: Italian verb endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on ending fragments of Italian infinitive verbs in formal parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: French verb or derived-noun endings
patterns.context: In the French words “dit”, “italien”, and “indipendenza”, activation falls on internal fragments, with no apparent shared semantics.

patterns.name: Latvian inflectional or derivational fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Latvian words or on their endings; fragments are scattered across different words, with no consistent semantics or grammatical function.

2_2191.description: 最强且跨多段的模式是英文眼科术语中 retinal 一类的 -inal 片段；其余激活散见意大利语、法语和拉脱维亚语议会文本的词内或词尾片段，未显示统一语义。

patterns.name: 视网膜相关解剖词的词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中落在英文医学术语 retinal、subretinal、extraretinal 的词尾；周围语境涉及眼科解剖或视网膜信号。
patterns.domain: 眼科医学论文、临床研究

patterns.name: 意大利语动词词尾
patterns.context: 激活的是意大利语不定式动词的词尾片段，处于正式议会发言中。

patterns.name: 法语动词或名词派生词尾
patterns.context: 在“dit”“italien”“indipendenza”等法语词中，激活落在词内片段，未见明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语屈折或派生片段
patterns.context: 激活落在拉脱维亚语词内部或词尾；片段分散在不同词中，语义与具体语法功能不统一。

en.description: In English ophthalmology materials, the «inal» fragment of retinal-related words activates repeatedly. In Latvian parliamentary text, various within-word fragments activate, often in words about rules, restrictions, and standards; one Lithuanian passage also has scattered word-fragment activations.

patterns.name: retinal in English ophthalmology contexts
patterns.context: In English ophthalmology or medical text, words appear in retinal-related forms; the trigger falls on a suffix fragment of the word rather than a fixed phrase
patterns.domain: Ophthalmology papers, abstracts, and research project titles

patterns.name: Latvian within-word segmented fragments
patterns.context: In Latvian EuroParl text, activation falls on within-word subword fragments shown as segmented; several passages involve rules, restrictions, standards, or use, but not all trigger words are the same

patterns.name: Lithuanian segmented fragments
patterns.context: Lithuanian parliamentary speech thanking the rapporteur and discussing the Bologna Process and student mobility; activation is distributed across several different word fragments, with no lexical triggers shared with the Latvian or ophthalmology texts

2_2191.description: 英语眼科材料中多次激活 retinal 相关词的«inal»片段；另在拉脱维亚语议事文本中激活多种词内片段，常见于规则、限制、标准等词；立陶宛语一段也有分散词片段激活。

patterns.name: 英语眼科语境中的 retinal
patterns.trigger: «inal»，出现于“subret«inal» hemorrhage”“extra«ret»inal signal”“panret«inal» laser”及“intraret«inal» Schisis”等
patterns.context: 英语眼科或医学文本中，词语以 retinal/retinal 相关形式出现；触发点落在该词后缀片段，而不是固定短语
patterns.domain: 眼科医学论文、摘要及研究项目标题

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内切分片段
patterns.trigger: «ik»，见“note«ik»umus”“note«ik»umu”“note«ik»«tu»”；也见同批语境中的其他词内分片，如«ot»、«c»、«ž»、«oj»
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语 EuroParl 文本中，激活落在被拆分呈现的词内子词片段；多段涉及规则、限制、标准或使用，但并非所有触发词都相同
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会拉脱维亚语议事文本

patterns.name: 立陶宛语分词片段
patterns.trigger: «ij»，见“Bolon«ij»os”；同段还标记了“«)»”“«Vis»”及多个词内片段
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会发言，感谢报告人并谈及博洛尼亚进程及学生流动；激活分布在多个不同词片段，未见与拉脱维亚语或眼科文本相同的词汇触发
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会立陶宛语议事文本

en.concept: Retinal subword fragments and occasional foreign-language word forms
en.description: Primarily responds to the subword fragment retinal in ophthalmology contexts, including retinal hemorrhage, blood vessels, imaging, disease, treatment, and retinal size; also includes an internal fragment of the Italian word proteggere, whose meaning has no clear connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: retinal subword fragment in ophthalmic terminology
patterns.context: Activations cluster on subword fragments of retinal in ophthalmology contexts, especially in compound terms involving hemorrhage, blood vessels, images, disease, or treatment; [9] also contains “Ret«inal» size”.
patterns.domain: Ophthalmic medicine, retinal physiology, and research

patterns.name: Italian word-form fragment meaning protect
patterns.context: Appears in Italian parliamentary text, meaning “protect”; the surrounding passage also discusses protecting economic activity and the single market, but the activation falls on an internal word fragment.

2_2191.concept: 视网膜词段及偶发异语词形
2_2191.description: 主要响应眼科语境中 retinal 的词段，涵盖视网膜出血、血管、成像、疾病、治疗及视网膜大小；另有一段意大利语 proteggere 的内部片段，语义与主模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 眼科术语中的 retinal 拆分词段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 ophthalmology 语境中 retinal 一词的词段上，尤其与出血、血管、图像、疾病或治疗构成复合术语时；[9]也出现「Ret«inal» size」。
patterns.domain: 眼科医学、视网膜生理与研究

patterns.name: 意大利语保护词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语议会文本中，意为“保护”；同段周围还谈到保护经济活动与单一市场，但激活落在词内部片段。
patterns.domain: 意大利语政治／经济议会文体

en.description: Primarily responds to retinal and its within-word fragments in ophthalmology and vision-science texts; also responds to subretinal hemorrhage and macular disease names. In one Italian parliamentary passage, it activates on several unrelated word fragments.

patterns.name: retinal in retinal-related terms
patterns.context: Occurs in ophthalmology, physiology, or vision research contexts, often adjacent to vessels, hemorrhage, image, size, laser, thrombosis, and other terms; the activation fragment often falls within retinal.
patterns.domain: Ophthalmology and vision-science papers, research abstracts, and grant descriptions

patterns.name: Subretinal hemorrhage
patterns.context: When discussing choroidal surgery or retinal disease, subretinal is followed by hemorrhage; activation falls on «inal» in subretinal.

patterns.name: Macular-related terms
patterns.context: Macular is followed by ophthalmic disease names such as degeneration or edema; only the «mac» fragment of macular is marked.

patterns.name: Italian within-word fragments unrelated to retinal
patterns.context: Activation falls on several segmented word fragments in Italian parliamentary text discussing markets, activities, and protection; no clear ophthalmology or retinal context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Italian political and economic parliamentary speeches

2_2191.description: 主要对眼科与视觉科学文本中的 retinal 及其词内片段反应，也响应 subretinal hemorrhage 和 macular 病名；另在一段意大利语议会文本中对多个无关词片段激活。

patterns.name: 视网膜相关词中的 retinal
patterns.context: 出现在眼科、生理学或视觉研究语境，常与 vessels、hemorrhage、image、size、laser、thrombosis 等词相邻；激活片段常落在 retinal 的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 眼科与视觉科学论文、研究摘要及资助项目描述

patterns.name: 视网膜下出血
patterns.context: 讨论脉络膜手术或眼底疾病时，subretinal 后接 hemorrhage；激活落在 subretinal 的 «inal»。

patterns.name: 黄斑相关词
patterns.context: macular 后接退变或水肿等眼科病名；仅 macular 的 «mac» 片段被标记。

patterns.name: 与 retinal 无关的意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语议会文本中多个被拆分的词片段，句子谈及市场、活动与保护；未见明确眼科或 retinal 语境。
patterns.domain: 意大利语政治与经济议会发言

en.description: Primarily responds to the ending inal in retinal and its compounds, especially in ophthalmology literature; also activates on ener in gardener and iro in the surname Cordeiro, with no clear connection between the latter examples and the main pattern.

patterns.name: Word-final suffix in retinal
patterns.context: In medical or ophthalmology contexts, the trigger is the ending inal in retinal; it can occur in words such as subretinal, intraretinal, and panretinal.
patterns.domain: Ophthalmology papers, abstracts, and clinical research titles

patterns.name: Word-final suffix in gardener
patterns.context: In contexts involving people's occupations or gardening, the trigger is the ending ener in gardener.
patterns.domain: Biographical entries, gardening, or patent background text

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in the surname Cordeiro
patterns.context: Appears in an author's name, with activation on the ending iro of the surname; there is no clear shared context with the other trigger words.
patterns.domain: Geochemistry or volcanic ash literature citations

2_2191.description: 主要响应 retinal 及其复合词中的词尾 inal，尤见眼科文献；另在 gardener 的 ener 和姓氏 Cordeiro 的 iro 上激活，后两者与主模式关系不明。

patterns.name: retinal 词内后缀
patterns.context: 在医学或眼科语境中，触发点是 retinal 的词尾 inal；可出现在 subretinal、intraretinal、panretinal 等词中。
patterns.domain: 眼科医学论文、摘要及临床研究标题

patterns.name: gardener 词内后缀
patterns.context: 在人物职业或园艺活动的语境中，触发 gardener 的词尾 ener。
patterns.domain: 传记条目、园艺或专利背景文本

patterns.name: Cordeiro 姓氏词尾
patterns.context: 出现在作者姓名中，激活落在姓氏词尾 iro；缺乏与其他触发词相同的明显上下文。
patterns.domain: 地球化学或火山灰文献引用

en.description: Activations are scattered across several kinds of internal word fragments: glistering, retinal-related words, local letter fragments in proper nouns or technical terms, and place names in URLs. Apart from two examples of glistering and two retinal-related examples, there is no unified semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: glistering/texture adjective
patterns.context: Present participle adjective describing the visual appearance of sunlight, water, or a monster; the word is split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Subword fragment al within a word
patterns.context: A character fragment at the end or within an English word, not clearly an independent word; one occurrence is in an occupational noun, another in an adjective.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia timeline, forum code, and mixed Russian text

patterns.name: Subword fragment ge within a word
patterns.context: A split letter fragment in the spelling of an Italian verb.

patterns.name: Syllabic fragment in a proper noun
patterns.context: The final letter fragment in the Welsh place name Llangefni.

patterns.name: Retinal fragment in a medical word
patterns.context: Appears in retinal terminology in ophthalmology text; activation centers on the fragment “inal”, not the complete word.

patterns.name: xl fragment within a word
patterns.context: The ending character fragment of the gene name Runxl, in the context of hematopoietic stem cell research.

patterns.name: Numeric fragment in a URL
patterns.context: The place name Rio in a video URL path; activation falls on the word-final fragment.

2_2191.description: 激活分散在多类词内片段：glistering、retinal相关词、专名或术语的局部字母片段及网址地名；除两处 glistering 和两处 retinal 相关例子外，未见统一语义或领域。

patterns.name: glistering/纹理形容词
patterns.context: 形容词现在分词，描述阳光、水面或怪物的视觉外观；词被分词标记拆开

patterns.name: 词内子词片段 al
patterns.context: 出现在英语词尾或词内部的字符片段，并非明显独立词；一处为职业名词，另一处为形容词

en.description: Activation spans texts in Russian, English, German, and Dutch, and is distributed across within-word fragments, word endings, numbers, and punctuation. Local recurrence is seen for -inger and machinery, among others, but there is no stable semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: -inger string
patterns.context: Activation falls in words containing the letter sequence inger; sometimes it crosses word boundaries or adjoins punctuation, and the matches are not entirely consistent.
patterns.domain: Legal, biographical, reference, and forum texts

patterns.name: machinery word segment
patterns.context: Located near the end of Machinery; the beginning of the word is unmarked.

patterns.name: Russian function words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: In Russian sentences, activation is distributed across several within-word fragments and function words, especially “одноразового”; no clear unified morphological condition.

patterns.name: English -ent/-ence and other word segments
patterns.context: Several local fragments of words are marked in English narrative or legal text; their meanings and morphological relationships are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Number and date fragments
patterns.context: Activation appears around numbers, years, dates, or report identifiers, often mixed with adjacent punctuation.

patterns.name: Fragments of reference authors' names and identifiers
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across author names, years, and BibTeX-style citation identifiers, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: German within-word fragments
patterns.context: Falls within German compounds or inflected words, including word endings; a scattered subword-fragment pattern.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in English narrative
patterns.context: Different local fragments of several ordinary words activate in literary narrative sentences, with no single semantic category.

patterns.name: Capitalized fragments in legal case names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the all-caps company name LOGISTICS PERSONNEL, distributed across within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments near forum code and usernames
patterns.context: Activation occurs in ordinary English words, the code node.js, and around usernames/citation formats in technical discussions.

patterns.name: Dutch within-word fragments
patterns.context: Falls within Dutch nouns, verb forms, and word endings, without a clearer shared semantic condition.

2_2191.description: 激活跨俄语、英语、德语和荷兰语等文本，分布于词内片段、词尾、数字与标点；可见 -inger、machinery 等局部重复，但没有稳定语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: -inger 字符串

patterns.name: 数字与日期片段

patterns.name: 参考文献作者名及标识符片段

patterns.name: 法律案名大写词片段

patterns.name: 论坛代码与用户名附近片段
