patterns.context: 邮件以能源行业上下游关系说明交易对手或日程，激活落在公司名 Mirant 的词尾。

patterns.name: 文学段落中的哀怜表达
patterns.trigger: my« brethren»2 are« more»1« numerous»2 and« miserable»1
patterns.context: 引号内人物哀叹同伴数量众多且悲惨，随后出现怜悯语境；没有证据表明此处是跨语料稳定模式。

en.concept: Legal text markers and proper-name fragments
en.description: Activations are most concentrated in legal case citations, litigation and arbitration phrasing, and paragraph markers; they also occur sporadically on subword fragments in names, company names, and place names, as well as religious-literary words, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: End-of-citation paragraph marker
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a legal citation or argument paragraph, usually immediately before a line break, followed by a page number or the next paragraph; strongly present in [1][2].

patterns.name: Case names and case-citation formatting
patterns.context: Formatted citations in legal texts, including case names, years, volume and page numbers, courts, and party names; activations fall on name and number fragments.

patterns.name: Litigation and arbitration terminology
patterns.context: Legal arguments and documents discussing parties, arbitration clauses, court jurisdiction, notice, or service.

patterns.name: Paragraph or footnote number markers in court documents
patterns.context: Bracketed numbers and following text appear after a line break in legal opinions; they may be page, paragraph, or editorial markers.

patterns.name: Specific letter fragments in author names
patterns.context: Appears in bylines and law firm addresses at the end of legal documents, where names are split into multiple subword fragments.

patterns.name: Word fragment in a company name
patterns.context: Appears in energy-trading emails, with activation on a final fragment of the company name Mirant.

patterns.name: Word fragment in a historical figure’s name
patterns.context: Appears in a historical account of nobility, mistresses, children, and annuities, with activation on the proper noun Stanley.

patterns.name: Split fragment in a place name
patterns.context: In a biblical geography account, activations concentrate on internal subword fragments of Jericho; Bethphage, Bethany, and Jerusalem are also mentioned nearby.

patterns.name: Name fragments of a philosopher and architectural theorist
patterns.context: In a philosophical/architectural-theory passage about centralized community, place, and the whole, activation falls on a subword fragment of the name Harries.

patterns.name: Word for mercy after a religious appeal
patterns.context: In literary dialogue with quotation marks and line breaks, a character pleads for the Lord’s mercy; strong activation falls on pity in an emotional and religious context.

2_2200.concept: 法律文本标记与专名片段
2_2200.description: 激活最集中于法律判例引注、诉讼仲裁措辞及段落标记；此外零散落在姓名、公司名、地名的子词片段，以及宗教文学词语上，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 引文段落结束标记
patterns.context: 出现在法律引文或论证段落末尾，通常紧邻换行，后接页码或下一段正文；在[1][2]中强烈出现。

patterns.name: 案名与判例引注格式
patterns.context: 法律文本中的案名、年份、卷页号、法院或当事人名称等格式化引注；激活落在名称片段和数字片段上。

patterns.name: 诉讼与仲裁术语
patterns.trigger: « plaintiffs»、« deny»、« Plaintiffs»、« cite»、« Federal»、« in»、« service»
patterns.context: 讨论当事人、仲裁条款、法院管辖权、通知或送达的法律论证及文书。

patterns.name: 法庭文书中的段落或脚注编号标记
patterns.context: 法律意见书中换行后出现方括号编号及后续正文，可能是页码、段落或编辑标记。

patterns.name: 作者姓名中的特定字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律文件末尾的署名与律师事务所地址中，姓名被拆成多个子词片段。

patterns.name: 公司名中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在能源交易邮件中，激活落在公司名称 Mirant 的词尾片段。

patterns.name: 历史人物姓名中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于贵族及其情妇、子女和年金的历史叙述中，激活落在专名 Stanley 上。

patterns.name: 地名中的切分片段
patterns.context: 在圣经地理叙述中，激活集中于 Jericho 的内部子词片段；周围还提及 Bethphage、Bethany 和 Jerusalem。

patterns.name: 哲学家与建筑理论家姓名片段
patterns.context: 在讨论中心化共同体、地方与整体的哲学／建筑理论段落中，激活落在姓名 Harries 的子词片段。

patterns.name: 宗教呼告后的怜悯词
patterns.context: 在带有引号和换行的文学对白中，人物祈求主怜悯；强激活落在情感与宗教语境中的 pity。

en.concept: Specific text fragments and formatting cues
en.description: Activations occur across letter fragments within proper names, legal citations and layout, as well as poem numbering and sporadic words in verse, school directories, and legal argumentation. No single semantic trigger condition spans all passages.

patterns.name: Specific letter sequences within proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on consecutive letter fragments within proper names or surnames; the fragments vary and commonly occur in personal names, place names, or institution names.
patterns.domain: Philosophical texts, biblical geography, legal documents, poetry, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Legal citations and case formatting
patterns.context: Occurs in sequences of case citations, volume and page numbers, years, punctuation, and line breaks in legal layout; activations do not all fall on the same citation component.

patterns.name: Biblical place names and distance descriptions
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of biblical figures or places and their relative locations or distances; some activations fall within tokenized place names.
patterns.domain: Biblical commentary or religious explanatory text

patterns.name: Poem stanza numbering and layout
patterns.context: Occurs in poetic formatting made up of Roman-numeral stanza labels, spaces, and line breaks; the same passage also contains sporadic activations in verse.

patterns.name: Poetic words and verse fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on common words or fragments in verse, without a stable semantic or syntactic condition; it appears alongside stanza labels.

patterns.name: School names and education lists
patterns.context: School entries and name lists include both common title words and tokenized fragments of Indian place and school names.

patterns.name: Procedural wording in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Jurisdiction, service, and procedural language in legal passages such as those concerning arbitration agreements; activations are distributed across common legal vocabulary.

patterns.name: Signposting phrases in legal argumentation
patterns.context: Occurs when the court moves from a case citation to its discussion or reasoning; the same passage also contains activations on citation page numbers and formatting.

2_2200.concept: 特定文本片段与格式线索
2_2200.description: 激活分布于专名内部的字母片段、法律引文和版式，以及诗歌编号与零散诗句词语、学校名录和法律论证措辞；没有贯穿各段的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名内部的特定词段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或姓氏内部的连续字母片段；片段本身并不固定，常见于人名、地名或机构名。
patterns.domain: 哲学文本、圣经地理、法律文书、诗歌和百科条目

patterns.name: 法律引文与判例格式
patterns.context: 出现在判例引注、卷页号、年份、标点与换行等法律排版序列中；激活位置不全落在同一种引文成分上。

patterns.name: 经文地名与距离叙述
patterns.trigger: « came»« unto»« Beth»«ph»age、« Mark»、« Jerusalem»、« Jer»«ich»«o»、«about»
patterns.context: 叙述圣经人物或地点及其相对位置、距离时出现，部分激活落在被拆分的地名内部。
patterns.domain: 圣经注释或宗教说明文字

patterns.name: 诗歌的诗节编号与版式
patterns.context: 罗马数字诗节标号、空格和换行构成的诗歌版式中出现；同段还包含诗句中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 诗歌词语及诗句片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在诗句中的普通词或词段，未显示稳定的语义或句法条件；与诗节标号同时出现。

patterns.name: 学校名与教育列表
patterns.context: 学校条目及名称列表中，既有普通标题词，也有被拆分的印度地名、校名词段。

patterns.name: 司法意见中的程序性措辞
patterns.context: 仲裁协议等法律段落中的管辖权、送达和程序性表述；激活分布在常见法律词汇上。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的提示语
patterns.context: 引述判例后转入法院论述或推理时出现；同段还有引文页码与排版激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns and internal word fragments, punctuation, and numeric/layout symbols, and also appear in legal, list, poetry, religious, and biographical texts; the varied trigger forms are difficult to attribute to a single stable semantic feature.

patterns.name: Internal word fragment “-ries”
patterns.context: Appears in proper nouns such as Norberg-Schulz and Harries; marks only a word-final fragment, with insufficient evidence that the whole word or its meaning is the trigger.

patterns.name: Interpersonal word fragment in an encouraging context
patterns.context: Encourages investing time in people who can help you improve, and includes the name Chalene Johnson; the two markers have no obvious shared meaning.

patterns.name: Word fragment within a place or organization name
patterns.context: Located within a school name or proper noun, with school names listed nearby; the activation point is a substring within a word rather than a whole word.

patterns.name: Case numbers and name fragments in legal texts
patterns.context: Activations occur in court case numbers, judge or attorney names, and legal-document formatting, on both punctuation and internal name fragments.

patterns.name: Biblical place names and spelling fragments
patterns.context: Discusses locations in the Gospel of Mark and the distance between Jerusalem and Jericho; place names are marked as multiple subword fragments.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments and layout symbols in poetry
patterns.context: The poetry text contains Roman-numeral-style numbering, spaces, and line breaks; activations are distributed across poetic wording and layout symbols.

patterns.name: Name fragments and year formatting in biographies
patterns.context: A chronological list of school heads, with activations on internal name fragments and years.

patterns.name: Title and internal word fragments in poetry
patterns.context: The poetry text includes a title or emphasized capitalized words, along with split internal word fragments; shares poetry corpus with segment 6, but trigger forms differ.

patterns.name: Names and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal bylines/citations consisting of a date, attorney name, law firm, and location; punctuation and name subfragments are both marked.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in a biographical account
patterns.context: Honors, birth, and family information about a woman scientist; activations occur on a place name, common function words, and name fragments.

2_2200.description: 激活散布于专名和词内片段、标点与数字/版式符号，也见于法律、名单、诗歌、宗教及传记文本；触发形式多样，难以归为单一稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: 词内片段「-ries」
patterns.context: 出现在专名中，如 Norberg-Schulz、Harries；只标记词尾片段，未见足够证据表明整词或语义触发。

patterns.name: 劝勉语境中的人际词片段
patterns.context: 鼓励投入时间与能推动自己进步的人交往，且出现人名 Chalene Johnson；两个标记没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 地名或机构名内的词片段
patterns.context: 位于学校名称或专名内部，附近还列举学校名称；激活点是词内子串而非完整词。

patterns.name: 法律案号及人名片段
patterns.context: 法院案号、法官或律师姓名及法律文书排版中，标点、姓名内部片段均有激活。

patterns.name: 圣经地名及拼写片段
patterns.context: 讨论《马可福音》中的地点及耶路撒冷、耶利哥之间的距离；地名被分成多个子词片段标记。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的词形片段与编排符号
patterns.context: 诗歌正文夹有罗马数字式编号、空格和换行；激活分布在诗词用语及版式符号上。

patterns.name: 人物姓名片段及年份格式
patterns.context: 按年代排列的学校负责人名单，姓名内部片段和年份均出现激活。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的标题和词内片段
patterns.context: 诗歌正文包含标题或强调性大写词，另有词内拆分片段；与段6同属诗歌语料，但触发形式不一致。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的姓名与标点
patterns.context: 日期、律师姓名、律所及地点组成的法律署名/引文，标点和姓名子串均被标记。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 女性科学家的荣誉、出生与家庭信息；地点、常见功能词和姓名片段均有激活。

en.description: Activations often occur on “Har…” and “…ene” fragments in personal names, and also within legal formatting, school names, and company names; they appear sporadically on common narrative words and punctuation as well, making it difficult to identify a unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Harms/Harm… in personal names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the latter part of this word form within a personal name or surname; [1] is an attorney's name, [3] a scholar's name, and [8] an author's/researcher's name.
patterns.domain: Legal directories, academic discussion, supplementary paper materials

patterns.name: -ene in personal names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the “ene” letter fragment within personal names; the fragment is not itself a complete word.

patterns.name: Fixed formatting and punctuation in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in court headers, judge names, court-decision formatting, or contract/arbitration clauses and numbering; activation points are scattered across format words, short words, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Fragments within place or institution names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on internal letter fragments in Indian school names or company names; no clear common semantics are apparent.

patterns.name: Common words and collocations in narrative text
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous prose, with activations distributed across prepositions, verbs, and common nouns; no stable single meaning or syntactic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Academic prose, legal clauses, biographies, and art history

2_2200.description: 激活多落在人名中的「Har…」「…ene」片段，也见于法律格式、学校及企业专名内部；另零散出现在普通叙述词和标点上，难以归为统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Harms/Harm…
patterns.context: 激活位于人名或姓氏中该词形的后半部分；[1]为律师姓名，[3]为学者姓名，[8]为作者/研究者姓名。
patterns.domain: 法律名录、学术论述、论文补充材料

patterns.name: 人名中的 -ene
patterns.context: 激活落在人名内部的「ene」字母片段，涉及不同姓名；该片段本身并非完整词。
patterns.domain: 励志引语、人物传记、艺术史

patterns.name: 法律文书中的固定格式与标点
patterns.context: 出现在法院抬头、法官姓名、裁判格式或合同/仲裁条款及编号中；激活点分散于格式词、短词和标点。

patterns.name: 地名或机构名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在印度学校名称或企业名称的内部字母片段；没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 叙述中的常见词及搭配
patterns.context: 在连续散文中出现，激活分布于介词、动词和普通名词，未见稳定的单一词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 学术散文、法律条款、传记与艺术史

en.description: Activations are distributed across internal subword fragments, legal formatting and names, alert headlines, and financial, contractual, and market terminology; some recurring trigger forms are visible, but no single stable semantic pattern covers all examples.

patterns.name: Subword fragments and internal word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often fall on internal fragments of complete words, especially capitalized abbreviations, proper nouns, or tokenized words; no stable shared meaning can be inferred from these fragments.

patterns.name: Legal-document formatting and punctuation
patterns.context: Appears near case numbers, page numbers, citations, line breaks, spaces, or document endings; some strong activations fall on formatting markers or numbers.
patterns.domain: Court opinions, legal contracts, and case-file texts

patterns.name: Names and titles in legal documents
patterns.context: Activations occur near names, judicial titles, or formulaic rulings, but the same segment also contains many internal name fragments and formatting markers.

patterns.name: “in/center” and its contexts
patterns.context: One example occurs in “believe in,” another in “church in the center”; two examples are insufficient to determine whether the trigger is a preposition, a spatial relation, or a word-fragment feature.

patterns.name: Headline-style alert wording
patterns.context: ALERT appears in capitalized headlines or labels; in one example it accompanies intelligence, and in another a volcanic alert level.

patterns.name: Financial and policy terminology
patterns.context: Appears near financial regulation, debt guarantees, and company names; the activated words are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Financial news, policy, and company reporting

patterns.name: Legal terminology in contracts
patterns.context: Appears in contract clauses on arbitration, service of notice, and copies of documents; local prepositions and legal terms both activate.

patterns.name: Medical and market-report vocabulary
patterns.context: The surrounding contexts range from medical improvement to market-research headlines and the “Adhesion” category, with no clear unified trigger condition.

2_2200.description: 激活分散在词内子片段、法律格式与姓名、警报标题，以及金融、合同和市场术语上；部分重复触发形式可见，但没有覆盖全部例子的单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 子词片段与词内边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在完整单词的内部片段上，尤其是大写缩写、专名或被分词的词；无法从这些片段归纳出稳定的共同词义。

patterns.name: 法律文书格式与标点
patterns.context: 出现在案号、页码、引文、换行、空格或文书结尾附近；部分强激活落在格式标记或数字上。
patterns.domain: 法院意见、法律合同及案卷文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的姓名与职衔
patterns.context: 姓名、法官职衔或裁判套语附近有激活，但同一片段也包含大量姓名内部片段及格式标记。

patterns.name: “in/中心”及其语境
patterns.context: 一个例子在“believe in”中，另一个在“church in the center”中；仅凭两例不能确定是介词、位置关系还是词片段特征。
patterns.domain: 阴谋论相关叙述；哲学/建筑社会理论

patterns.name: 标题式警报用语
patterns.context: 大写标题或标签中出现 ALERT；在一例中伴随 intelligence，在另一例中伴随火山警报等级。
patterns.domain: 新闻/宣传式标题；地质监测报告

patterns.name: 金融与政策术语
patterns.context: 分别出现在金融监管、债务担保与公司名称附近；激活词并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 金融新闻、政策及公司报道

patterns.name: 合同中的法律术语
patterns.context: 出现在仲裁、通知送达及文件副本等合同条款中；局部介词和法律词均有激活。

patterns.name: 医疗与市场报告词汇
patterns.context: 相邻语境从医疗改善转到市场研究标题及“Adhesion”分类，缺乏明确统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 商业宣传、市场研究摘要

en.description: Activations often occur within proper names, place names, and words, and are also common on line breaks, punctuation, headings, and citation formatting in legal documents. A few common words, financial terms, sports names, and mixed-text fragments also appear; the patterns are scattered.

patterns.name: Specific letter sequences within tokens
patterns.context: Activation occurs on internal subword fragments in English proper names or words, commonly names, place names, and tokenized words; trigger fragments span many word forms and are not always complete words.

patterns.name: Legal document formatting and punctuation
patterns.context: Formatting tokens around line breaks, paragraph markers, spaces, punctuation, and case numbers activate, particularly in headers, citations, and heading layout in legal opinions.

patterns.name: Personal names and signature lists
patterns.context: Activations occur around the names or initials of attorneys, judges, and other people, including signatures and names in the body of opinions.

patterns.name: Place-name fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur when place names are split into subword fragments, such as Abilene and Burkburnett; another example is fragments of the names Heidegger and Norberg-Schulz, which are not necessarily place names.

patterns.name: Chapter-heading layout
patterns.context: All-caps chapter headings in legal opinions, along with nearby paragraph and line-break markers.

patterns.name: Repeated word and transition
patterns.context: Repeated instances of Bet are followed by a blank line, then a news sentence about Wenger; this pattern is difficult to connect with other passages.

patterns.name: Word fragments in inspirational quotes
patterns.context: Several word fragments activate in quotes encouraging social interaction and success; «ene» occurs within the name Chalene.

patterns.name: Federal case citations and judicial language
patterns.context: Fragments occur in case citations, statute effective dates, and judicial statements; dense formatting symbols are also present.

patterns.name: Financial and policy vocabulary
patterns.context: Several complete words activate in discussion of Libra, privacy, national security, transactions, and monetary policy; Jerome Powell also appears nearby.

patterns.name: Tennis results and names
patterns.context: In a tennis final result sentence, activations occur on fragments within the players' names.

patterns.name: Philosophical architectural imagery
patterns.context: Discussion of images associated with Heidegger and others, as well as a sentence about a church at the center of a community; activated words and proper-name fragments co-occur.

patterns.name: Historical biographical narration
patterns.context: In a sentence about Duffy entering the oil industry after retirement, doing business in a Texas town, and settling there, common function words and verbs also activate.

2_2200.description: 激活多落在专名、地名和词语的内部子串，也常见于法律文书的换行、标点、标题及引文格式；另有少数普通词、金融词汇、体育姓名和混合文本片段，模式分散。

patterns.name: 分词内部的特定字母串
patterns.context: 激活落在英文专名或词语的内部子词片段上，常见于姓名、地名及拆分的词；触发片段本身跨越多种词形，并不总是完整词。
patterns.domain: 混合语料中的分词文本

patterns.name: 法律文书格式与标点
patterns.context: 换行、段落符、空格、标点及案件编号周围的格式 token 激活，尤其是法律意见书的页眉、引文和标题排版。

patterns.name: 人名及署名列表
patterns.context: 律师、法官或其他人物姓名及姓名首字母附近出现激活；包括署名和判决正文中的人名。

patterns.name: 地名片段
patterns.context: 地名被拆成子词片段时激活，如 Abilene、Burkburnett；另一例是 Heidegger 与 Norberg-Schulz 的姓名片段，未必为地名。

patterns.name: 章节标题排版
patterns.context: 法律意见书中全大写章节标题及其周围的段落和换行标记。

patterns.name: 重复词与转场
patterns.context: 多次重复的 Bet 后接空行，随后转入关于 Wenger 的新闻句；该模式与其他段落难以建立联系。

patterns.name: 激励性引语中的词片段
patterns.context: 鼓励人际交往与成功的引语中出现若干词片段激活；«ene»位于人名 Chalene 内。

patterns.name: 联邦判例引用与裁判语
patterns.context: 判例引文、法规生效日期和法院裁判语句中出现的片段；同时伴随密集排版符号。

patterns.name: 金融与政策词汇
patterns.context: 谈及 Libra、隐私、国家安全、交易及货币政策时，若干完整词激活；相邻处还出现 Jerome Powell。

patterns.name: 网球比赛结果与姓名
patterns.context: 网球决赛结果句中，激活分别落在球员姓名内部片段。

patterns.name: 哲学建筑意象
patterns.context: 讨论海德格尔等人的意象，以及教堂位于共同体中心的句子；激活词与专名片段并存。

patterns.name: 历史人物传记叙述
patterns.context: 叙述 Duffy 退役后进入石油业、在德州城镇经营并定居的句子中，普通功能词和动词也有激活。

en.concept: ENE character fragment and sporadic word forms
en.description: The most stable response is to ENE in the name GREENE, especially in legal documents; additional sporadic responses include name fragments, the literary word seized, email ALERT, company name NEUROHM, and the judgment disposition AFFIRMED, along with weak formatting and citation markers.

patterns.name: ENE in the surname GREENE
patterns.context: Appears in the personal name GREENE, commonly the name of a judge, defendant, or attorney in legal decisions; [9] also appears in an email contact name.

patterns.name: Other personal-name fragments
patterns.context: Appears in names or initials; apart from «yle» in [5] and «Y» in [10], activation is low.
patterns.domain: Legal attorney lists, email contact lists

patterns.name: Literary word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the literary criticism sentence “had rightly seized at first”.

patterns.name: Email alert word ending
patterns.context: Appears in the capitalized alert phrase “CRIME ALERT” in an email subject line.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a company name
patterns.context: Appears within the company name “NEUROHM”.

patterns.name: Legal disposition wording
patterns.context: Appears in the disposition at the end of a decision.

patterns.name: Litigation labels and formatting markers
patterns.context: Appears in decision headings, party labels, judge bylines, or line-break formatting; activations are weak and scattered.

patterns.name: Other fragments
patterns.context: Includes numbers in citations, general words, and formatting fragments, with no shared condition stably corresponding to the primary pattern.
patterns.domain: Legal citations, biographical profiles, email, and other texts

2_2200.concept: ENE 字符片段及偶发词形
2_2200.description: 最稳定的响应是人名 GREENE 中的 ENE，尤其在法律文书中；此外零散响应姓名片段、文学词语 seized、邮件 ALERT、公司名 NEUROHM 和判决结论 AFFIRMED，另有弱格式与引文标记。

patterns.name: GREENE 姓氏中的 ENE
patterns.context: 出现在人名 GREENE 中，常见于法律判决的法官、被告或律师姓名；[9] 也出现在邮件联系人姓名中。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件联系人列表

patterns.name: 其他人名片段
patterns.context: 出现在姓名或姓名缩写中；除 [5] 的 «yle» 和 [10] 的 «Y» 外，标注强度较低。
patterns.domain: 法律律师名单、邮件联系人列表

patterns.name: 文学词语片段
patterns.context: 出现在 “had rightly seized at first” 的文学评论句中。

patterns.name: 邮件警报词尾
patterns.context: 出现在邮件主题中的大写警报词 “CRIME ALERT”。

patterns.name: 公司名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在公司名 “NEUROHM” 内。

patterns.name: 法律结论用语
patterns.context: 出现在判决末尾的裁判结论中。

patterns.name: 诉讼称谓与格式标记
patterns.context: 出现在判决抬头、当事人称谓、法官署名或换行格式中，激活较弱且分散。
patterns.domain: 法律文书排版与诉讼用语

patterns.name: 其余片段
patterns.context: 包含引文中的数字、一般词语及格式片段，未见可与主模式稳定对应的共同条件。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、人物简介、邮件及其他文本

en.concept: Proper names and uppercase text fragments
en.description: Activations often occur on fragments within proper names or fixed labels: personal names, place names, titles, alert terms, and Roman numerals. They also appear in all-caps headings and dates. The commonality is loose and cannot be reduced to a single meaning.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in capitalized personal names or titles
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur in capitalized or title-case personal names and titles; they also appear in capitalized names and job titles within sentences. Fragments often cross token boundaries.
patterns.domain: Historical book titles, formal letter headers, legal opinions

patterns.name: Internal capitalized fragments
patterns.context: The trigger is a consecutive fragment within a capitalized word or all-caps text, not necessarily a personal name; it occurs in event titles and displayed text such as dates.
patterns.domain: Event promotions, headings, and date formatting

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Indian place names
patterns.context: Activation occurs within place names in a consecutive list of locations in Kerala, India; it may occur at the beginning, middle, or end of a word.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Occurs within names in academic discussion or historical text; not limited to capitalized heading formats.
patterns.domain: Philosophical discussion, historical or political text

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in place names
patterns.context: Located within university or city names, surrounded by descriptions of scholars' employment histories.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in an alert term
patterns.context: Occurs in the all-caps compound warning label “CRIME ALERT” as part of an email subject line.
patterns.domain: Crime alert notifications in mailing lists

patterns.name: Name fragments in case names
patterns.context: Occurs in party names in U.S. case citations, followed by citation information.

patterns.name: Fragments in Roman numerals
patterns.context: Located within the Roman-numeral year “MDCC.LXXXVI”; activation covers only an internal part of the number.
patterns.domain: Date formatting in bibliographies or historical documents

2_2200.description: 激活多落在专名或固定标签的词内片段：人名、地名、职位、警报词及罗马数字，也见于全大写标题与日期。共同点较松散，不能归结为单一词义。

patterns.name: 大写人名或称谓中的词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段位于大写或标题式人名、头衔中；也出现在句中大写姓名及职位称谓。片段常跨越词内分段。
patterns.domain: 历史书籍标题、正式信函抬头、法律判决

patterns.name: 词内大写片段
patterns.context: 触发的是大写词或全大写排版中的连续词内片段，不要求是人名；在活动标题和日期等展示文字中出现。
patterns.domain: 活动宣传、标题与日期排版

patterns.name: 印度地名的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在连续列举的印度喀拉拉邦地名内部，词首、词中或词尾均可。

patterns.name: 个人姓名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 在学术论述或历史文字中出现的人名内部；并非只限于大写标题格式。
patterns.domain: 哲学论述、历史或政治文字

patterns.name: 地名词尾片段
patterns.context: 位于大学或城市专名内部，周围是学者任职经历的介绍。

patterns.name: 警报词词尾
patterns.context: 出现在全大写的复合警示标签“CRIME ALERT”中，作为邮件标题的一部分。
patterns.domain: 邮件列表中的犯罪警报通知

patterns.name: 判例名称中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在美国判例引文的当事人姓名中，后接引证信息。

patterns.name: 罗马数字中的片段
patterns.context: 位于罗马数字年份“MDCC.LXXXVI”中；激活只覆盖数字内部片段。
patterns.domain: 书目或历史文献的日期排版

en.description: Activations often fall on within-word fragments after tokenization, especially in proper names, surnames, place names, and words such as Honourable and adhesion; there are also sporadic activations on archaic typography, legal-document punctuation, and a few common words. Trigger conditions span domains, with no unified semantic theme observed.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in Honourable titles
patterns.context: Honourable is segmented and emphasized in formal titles or forms of address; often accompanied by line breaks and all-caps formatting
patterns.domain: Historical documents, letters, or formal lists

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Adams
patterns.context: Strong activations fall on a within-word fragment; Adams appears in a name or quotation, while adhesion appears in a technical term
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, forums, patents, and business texts

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in place names
patterns.context: The fragment lies within a proper name, surrounded by lists of places or personal names

patterns.name: Letter fragments in proper names or abbreviations
patterns.context: Capital-letter fragments are embedded in organization, personal, or company names
patterns.domain: Event promotions, legal documents, company profiles

patterns.name: Numeric or punctuation formatting
patterns.context: In scans of old books or typeset texts, characters such as line breaks, Roman numerals, and dates activate individually

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in common words
patterns.context: No stable local semantic or syntactic condition; fragments occur sporadically in ordinary sentences

patterns.name: Punctuation and boilerplate in legal documents
patterns.context: Near initials in names, sentence-final punctuation, and lists of members of a court panel

patterns.name: Common word forms and subword fragments
patterns.context: Capitalized words or place names in historical quotations, with no consistent semantic condition

2_2200.description: 激活常落在分词后的词内片段，尤其是专名、姓氏、地名及 Honourable、adhesion 等；也对古籍排版字符、法律文书标点和少数普通词零散激活。触发条件跨领域，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: honour 标题中的词尾
patterns.trigger: H«ON»OUR«ABLE»；H«ON»OUR，且常见于人名前的称谓
patterns.context: 正式标题或称谓中，Honourable 被分段强调；多伴随换行、全大写排版
patterns.domain: 历史文献、书信或正式名单

patterns.name: Adams 的词内片段
patterns.context: 强激活落在词中片段；Adams 出现在姓名或引文中，adhesion 出现在技术术语中
patterns.domain: 百科、论坛、专利及商业文本

patterns.name: 地名词内片段
patterns.context: 片段位于专名内部，周围有地点列表或人名

patterns.name: 专名或缩写中的字母片段
patterns.context: 大写字母片段嵌在机构名、人名或公司名中
patterns.domain: 活动宣传、法律文书、公司介绍

patterns.name: 数字或标点排版
patterns.context: 古籍扫描或排版文本中，换行、罗马数字、日期等字符被单独激活

patterns.name: 普通词中的零散片段
patterns.context: 没有稳定的局部语义或句法条件，散见于普通句子

patterns.name: 法定文书中的标点与套语
patterns.context: 姓名缩写、句末标点及法庭合议庭名单附近

patterns.name: 普通词形与分词片段
patterns.context: 历史引文中的大写词或地名，未显示一致语义条件

en.description: Activations occur across legal opinions and case-file formatting, fragments within Bhola/Bhil and adhesion, personal names and common forum tokenization, as well as uppercase forms of address, military titles, Roman numerals, and blank-line markers in old books; the triggering mechanism is not uniform.

patterns.name: Court decisions and legal heading formats
patterns.context: Formatting in judicial conclusions, appellate case headings, or court documents; [1] also contains a judge's name and concur.

patterns.name: Token fragments in Bhola words
patterns.context: Activation occurs on token fragments within a proper name or word; [2] is a hurricane name, and [9] is an ethnic group name.

patterns.name: Tokenization within adhesion
patterns.context: Within adhesion/adhesives-related words in discussions of bonding, adhesion, or adhesive technology.
patterns.domain: Medical business news and patent background material

patterns.name: Local token fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Occurs within names listed in tennis match results.

patterns.name: Common tokenization in English phrases
patterns.context: Related words occur as standalone words or token fragments in an IPO transaction narrative; surrounding text describes stock prices, accounts, and pending orders.

patterns.name: Line breaks and blank-space markers
patterns.context: Near line breaks or large blank spaces; activation also covers subsequent heading content, so it is unclear whether layout itself is the trigger.
patterns.domain: Legal case files and old-book layout text

patterns.name: Token fragments in uppercase forms of address
patterns.context: Fragments are scattered within the words of the uppercase printed form of address “RIGHT HONOURABLE”; it occurs in an address or personal title.

patterns.name: Roman numerals and signature layout in old books
patterns.context: On old-book pages, Roman numerals, abbreviations, asterisks, blank lines, and signatures occur near one another.

patterns.name: Split words in military titles in old books
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple subword fragments in uppercase printed military titles and names.

2_2200.concept: 混合的分词与排版片段
2_2200.description: 激活分布在法律判决与案卷排版、Bhola/Bhil及adhesion等词内分片、人名和论坛常见分词，以及旧书的大写敬称、军事头衔、罗马数字和空白换行标记；触发机制并不统一。

patterns.name: 法庭判决及法律标题格式
patterns.context: 司法判决结语、上诉案件标题或法庭文书中的排版；[1] 还出现法官姓名与 concur。

patterns.name: Bhola 词语中的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名或词语内部的分词片段；[2] 是飓风名称，[9] 是族群名称。

patterns.name: adhesion 的词内分词
patterns.context: adhesion/adhesives 相关词内部，讨论胶粘、粘附或粘合剂技术。
patterns.domain: 医疗商业资讯与专利背景技术

patterns.name: 人名中的局部分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在网球赛事结果所列的人名内部。

patterns.name: 英文短语中的常见分词
patterns.context: IPO 交易叙述中，相关词以独立词或分词形式出现；周围描写股价、账户和等待订单。

patterns.name: 换行及版面空白标记
patterns.context: 换行或大段空白附近；激活也覆盖其后的标题内容，无法确定是否由排版本身触发。
patterns.domain: 法律案卷与旧书排版文本

patterns.name: 大写敬称中的分词片段
patterns.context: 大写排印的英文敬称“RIGHT HONOURABLE”中，片段分散在词内；出现在致辞或人物头衔。

patterns.name: 旧书罗马数字及署名排版
patterns.context: 古籍页面中，罗马数字、缩写、星号、空行和署名等排版元素相邻。

patterns.name: 旧书军事头衔中的拆分词
patterns.context: 大写印刷的军事头衔与姓名中，词被分成多个子词片段。

en.concept: Word fragments and proper names in heterogeneous texts
en.description: Activations occur in judicial language, signatures, and proper-name fragments in case law, as well as in words related to mystery themes, Bhola, tennis player names, microbiological terms, and intelligence headlines; several common-word triggers lack a unified context.

patterns.name: Formulaic language at the end of legal judgments
patterns.context: The disposition section states that a judgment is reversed and remanded, followed by the names of judges who concur; activations cluster on legal terms and specific substrings in judges' names.

patterns.name: Personal-name and place-name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Case-law layouts dense with proper names, such as attorney lists, party representation information, or judicial signatures; trigger points are scattered across names, place names, and introductory phrases.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in mystery-themed text
patterns.context: When words related to mystery/mysterious occur, activations fall on substrings within the words rather than on the complete words; contexts include novel descriptions, bibliographies, and discussion.
patterns.domain: Film and television descriptions, bibliographies, literary discussion

patterns.name: Proper-name fragment in Bhola
patterns.context: In the place or event name “Bhola cyclone,” activations fall at different positions within Bhola.

patterns.name: Tennis player name fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur within players' names in tennis match result sentences.

patterns.name: Microbiology term fragments
patterns.context: In a research abstract describing hydrolysates of corynebacterial cells and carbohydrate components, activations occur on a substring within arabinose.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in intelligence headlines
patterns.context: In the headline- or announcement-style all-caps phrase “INTELLIGENCE ALERT,” activations fall within ALERT; the same passage also discusses the Russian public, aliens, and a shadow government.

patterns.name: Common words related to appearance or identity
patterns.context: These trigger points occur in literary discussion, plot summaries, and online commentary, with no shared local semantic or syntactic condition.

2_2200.concept: 异质文本中的词片段与专名
2_2200.description: 激活分布于判例的裁判语、署名与专名片段，也见于神秘题材词、Bhola、网球选手名、微生物术语及情报标题；若干常见词触发缺乏统一语境。

patterns.name: 法律判决末尾固定语
patterns.context: 判决结果部分陈述撤销判决、发回重审，随后列出同意意见的法官姓名；激活集中在法律术语及法官姓名中的特定子串。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的人名与地名片段
patterns.context: 律师名单、当事人代理信息或法官署名等专名密集的判例版式；触发点散布于姓名、地名和引介语中。

patterns.name: 神秘主题的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现 mystery/mysterious 相关词时，激活落在词内子串，而非完整词；语境分别是小说简介、书目和论述。
patterns.domain: 影视简介、书目、文学论述

patterns.name: Bhola 专名片段
patterns.context: 地名或事件名“Bhola cyclone”中，激活落在 Bhola 的不同词内位置。

patterns.name: 网球选手姓名片段
patterns.context: 网球比赛结果句中，激活出现在选手姓名内部。

patterns.name: 微生物学术语片段
patterns.context: 描述棒状杆菌细胞水解产物和糖类成分的科研摘要中，激活出现在 arabinose 的词内子串。

patterns.name: 情报标题中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 标题或公告式大写短语“INTELLIGENCE ALERT”中，激活落在 ALERT 的词内部分；同段还出现关于俄罗斯民众、外星人与影子政府的内容。

patterns.name: 外观或身份相关常见词
patterns.trigger: “« exposing»”、“« On»”、“« In»”、“« people»”、“« about»”、“« Russians»”、“« shadow»”、“« moment»”
patterns.context: 这些触发点分属文学论述、剧情简介和网络评论，缺少共同的局部语义或句法条件。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on letter fragments within personal names, including signatures in legal documents and names from other domains; they often occur alongside abbreviations, punctuation, line breaks, or numbers. Legal judicial language also has sporadic activations, but does not appear to form a separate stable rule.

patterns.name: Letter combinations or name fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Trigger fragments are embedded in personal names, including parties, attorneys, judges, athletes, authors, and historical figures in legal cases; sometimes a fragment is split across several marked tokens while surrounding letters are unmarked
patterns.domain: Personal names in legal signatures and judgments, sports records, bibliographic formats, historical timelines, and forum text

patterns.name: Legal judgment signatures and judicial language
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of court judgments or in judicial explanations, often adjacent to lists of judges, opinions, and case dispositions

patterns.name: Name initials and document formatting
patterns.context: Occurs alongside name initials, case numbers, line breaks, and aligned formatting; marking is weak or sporadic
patterns.domain: Legal document headings, signatures, and formatting

patterns.name: Fragments near dates and numbers
patterns.context: Numbers themselves are mostly unmarked; activations occur on adjacent name or punctuation fragments in dates, case numbers, scores, and other numeric strings
patterns.domain: Legal dates and case numbers, match scores, historical timelines

2_2200.description: 激活主要落在人名内部的字母片段，涵盖法律文书署名及其他领域姓名；常伴随缩写、标点、换行或数字。法律裁判用语也有零散激活，但难以视为独立稳定规则。

patterns.name: 人名中的字母组合或姓名片段
patterns.trigger: 姓名内部的「«Ha«uck»」「«Cheryl»」「«Wiedmeier」「«Conlan」「«Eliel»」「«Pierson」「«Palmeri」「«Hoffman」「«Connors」「«Delort」「«CURWOOD」「«WADE」「«PR ADE」「«Vijay」「«Elter」「«Sheril」「«Emilie」等被标记片段；常落在姓名内部，而非词首或词尾
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在人名中，包含法律案件当事人、律师、法官、运动员、作者和历史人物；有时片段被拆成若干标记token，周围字母未标记
patterns.domain: 法律文书署名与判决、体育赛事记录、书目格式、历史年表及论坛文本中的人名

patterns.name: 法律判决署名与裁判用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决末尾或裁判说明中，常与法官列名、意见和案件处理结果相邻

patterns.name: 姓名缩写及文书排版
patterns.context: 与人名缩写、案号、换行和对齐排版共同出现；标记强度较弱或零散
patterns.domain: 法律文书标题、署名及排版

patterns.name: 日期与数字周边片段
patterns.context: 数字本身多数未标记，激活出现在日期、案号或比分等数字串的相邻姓名或标点片段中
patterns.domain: 法律日期与案号、赛事比分、历史年表

en.description: The main response is to the myster- stem (my ster ies/ious) and its “mysterious, unknown” meaning, also appearing in the title of Mystery works. Other activations occur on legal punctuation, line breaks, and internal fragments in several proper names, which cannot be fully explained by the same semantic pattern.

patterns.name: myster- stem
patterns.context: The stem ster is split by tokenization; the complete word refers to something mysterious, unknown, or difficult to understand. It appears in interpersonal relationships, natural phenomena, and discussions of knowledge.
patterns.domain: Novel summaries, nature writing, popular science, or philosophical discussion

patterns.name: Mysteries book or work entries
patterns.context: The word appears in work titles, series, or lists of entries rather than in general sentences meaning “mysterious things.”

patterns.name: Legal text fragments with punctuation
patterns.context: Activation occurs on formatting fragments such as periods, line breaks, or date digits; the context includes attorney names, locations, and citation formatting.

patterns.name: Webpage line-break markers
patterns.context: Activation is on line breaks, surrounded by webpage tags or article content; there is no clear semantic connection to other topic words in the same passage.

patterns.name: Tokenization of proper names in book titles
patterns.context: Activation occurs on token fragments within proper names; the context mentions a publisher reissuing someone's work.

patterns.name: Tokenization of an alien-related proper name
patterns.context: Activation occurs within a proper name mentioned in a UFO Q&A passage; its semantics and word form do not clearly match the main pattern in other passages.

patterns.name: Tokenization of tennis players' names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on surname fragments in tennis results, with no semantic relation to the myster- stem.

2_2200.description: 主要对 myster- 词干（my ster ies/ious）及其“神秘、未知”含义起反应，也见于 Mystery 作品名。另有法律标点、换行符和若干专名内部片段，无法由同一语义模式充分解释。

patterns.name: myster-词干
patterns.context: 词干 ster 被切分标记，所在完整词指神秘、未知或难以理解之物；出现于人物关系、自然现象和知识论述
patterns.domain: 小说简介、自然写作、科普或哲学论述

patterns.name: Mysteries 书名或作品条目
patterns.context: 该词出现在作品名称、系列或条目列表中，而非一般句子里的“神秘事物”

patterns.name: 带标点的法律文本碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在句点、换行或日期数字等排版碎片上；上下文是律师姓名、地点与引文格式

patterns.name: 网页换行标记
patterns.context: 激活标在换行符，周边为网页标签或文章内容；与同段其他主题词没有明显语义联系

patterns.name: 书名中的专名切分
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部的分词片段；上下文提及出版社再版某人的著作
patterns.domain: 宗教类博客或出版资讯

patterns.name: 外星人相关专名切分
patterns.context: 激活落在一段 UFO 问答中所述的专名内部，语义和词形都与其他段落的主要模式不明显相同
patterns.domain: UFO 电台问答、网络留言

patterns.name: 网球选手姓名切分
patterns.context: 激活落在网球比赛结果中的姓氏片段，不表现出与 myster- 词干相同的语义

en.description: Activations mainly occur on subword fragments within proper names, including personal names, character names, and place or language names; a few activations fall on formatting elements such as line breaks, page numbers, numbering, and legal conclusions, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in names
patterns.context: Trigger fragments lie within proper names, especially personal or character names; fragments are often marked as part of a subword rather than as complete words.
patterns.domain: Tennis events, people lists, science-fiction Q&A, paper authors, film and television descriptions, legal documents, etc.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in place names or ethnic and language names
patterns.context: Fragments are embedded in geographical names or ethnic and language names in discussions of language distribution and its geographical connections.

patterns.name: Formatting boundaries and directory-style layouts
patterns.context: Formatting elements such as line breaks, indentation, page numbers, or numbering and conclusions in legal documents are marked; no consistent semantic trigger condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Book contents and other formatted texts, including legal documents

2_2200.concept: 专名及其内部子词片段
2_2200.description: 主要激活于专名内部的子词片段，涵盖人名、角色名及地名或语言名；少数激活落在换行、页码、编号和法律结论等格式元素上，缺少统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 姓名中的内部片段
patterns.trigger: 人名中被切分标记的片段，如 «ore»、«lla»、«Hend»、«ainer»、«iel»、«ster»、«uck»、«yle»、«Y»
patterns.context: 触发片段处于专名内部，尤其是人名或角色名；片段常被标记为子词的一部分，而非完整单词。
patterns.domain: 网球赛事、人物名单、科幻问答、论文作者、影视简介、法律文书等

patterns.name: 地名或民族语言名内部片段
patterns.context: 片段嵌在地理名称或民族、语言名称中，讨论语言分布及其地理联系。
patterns.domain: 维基百科地理与语言学条目

patterns.name: 排版边界及目录式格式
patterns.context: 换行、缩进、页码或法律文书中的编号与结论等格式元素被标记；未见它们构成一致的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录、法律文书等格式化文本

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on fragments within words related to “myster-” and on “ory” in the proper name “Emory”; there are also various scattered within-word fragments and fragments in common words, with no unified semantics or context.

patterns.name: mystery stem
patterns.context: The stem occurs within complete words; content concerns mysterious figures, unexplained phenomena, mystery stories, or unsolved cases
patterns.domain: Novel descriptions, popular science essays, book titles, and media headlines

patterns.name: Proper-name fragment in Emory
patterns.context: The proper name Emory is followed by University, Gordy, or other text, as part of an institution or personal name

patterns.name: Local fragments in common words
patterns.context: Each fragment occurs only in a single local context, with no stable shared condition

patterns.name: English syntax and derivational fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous prose, including verbs, connective words, and common word-final fragments, with no obvious shared semantics
patterns.domain: Historical or scientific discussion, literary prose

patterns.name: Other local word fragments
patterns.context: Embedded respectively in book titles, surnames, or common words; beyond the individual terms, there is no clear shared context
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, biographies, drama reviews, academic news

2_2200.description: 强激活主要落在“myster-”相关词的内部片段，以及专名“Emory”的“ory”；另有多种分散的词内片段和常见词片段，缺少统一语义或语境。

patterns.name: mystery 词干
patterns.trigger: «ster»、«ster» 后接 «ious» 或复数词尾构成的 “mysterious”“mysteries”
patterns.context: 词干出现在完整单词内部；内容涉及神秘人物、未解现象、神秘故事或谜案
patterns.domain: 小说介绍、科普散文、书名及媒体标题

patterns.name: Emory 专名片段
patterns.context: 专名 Emory 后接 University、Gordy 等文字，作为机构或人名的一部分
patterns.domain: 人物传记、政治与学术新闻

patterns.name: 局部常见词片段
patterns.trigger: «On»（“Back On Her Feet”）、« Man»（“Man She’s Never…”）、« Down»（“direction. Down”）、« back»（“pouring back”）、« bos»（“bosom”）
patterns.context: 这些片段各自只在单个局部语境出现，未见稳定共同条件

patterns.name: 英文句法及派生词片段
patterns.trigger: « exposing»、« pret»（“pretensions”）、« gradually»、« towards»、« there»、« deemed»、« manner»
patterns.context: 出现在连续散文中，包含动词、连接性词语及常见词尾片段，彼此无明显一致语义
patterns.domain: 历史或科学论述、文学散文

patterns.name: 其他局部词片段
patterns.trigger: « Cauld»（“Cauldron”）、« Chin» 与 «at»（“Chinatown”）、« considered»、« assessed»、« leaving»、« during»、« aforementioned»、« phenomenal»、« Emily»、« as»、« in»、« presented»
patterns.context: 分别嵌在书名、姓氏或普通词语中；除各自词项外没有明确的共享语境
patterns.domain: 百科条目、人物介绍、戏剧评论、学术新闻

en.concept: The «ster» fragment in the mystery word family
en.description: The main pattern is within-word «ster», concentrated in mystery/mysterious/mysteries and related titles. Line-break markers and several scattered within-word and proper-name fragments also activate, without an apparent unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in the myster- family
patterns.context: The fragment «ster» is part of words such as mystery/mysterious/mysteries; it often follows unmarked my, while subsequent word endings may or may not activate.
patterns.domain: Novel descriptions, popular science or literary discussion, book titles and entries, reviews

patterns.name: List line-break marker
patterns.context: Occurs between Wikipedia lists or entries in a section, marking a line break or item boundary; sometimes appears alongside nearby book names or titles.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: These fragments occur within common words or personal names, with no shared local semantic or syntactic condition; they often co-occur incidentally with strongly activating contexts.
patterns.domain: Literary texts and encyclopedia biographies and sports entries

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Marked in their respective passages, but do not form a shared trigger condition supported by the data; examples include unrelated encyclopedia directory words, forum usernames, numbers, and ordinary narrative words.

2_2200.description: 主模式是词内 «ster»，集中出现在 mystery/mysterious/mysteries 及相关标题中。另有换行标记和若干分散的词内片段、专名片段被激活，未显出统一语义条件。

patterns.name: myster- 词内片段
patterns.context: 片段 «ster» 是 mystery/mysterious/mysteries 等词的词内组成部分，常紧接未标记的 my，后续词尾也可能被激活或不被激活。
patterns.domain: 小说简介、科普或文学论述、书名与条目、书评

patterns.name: 列表换行标记
patterns.context: 出现在维基百科列表或栏目条目之间，表示换行或条目分隔；有时与临近书名、标题同现。

patterns.name: 专名内部子词片段
patterns.context: 这些片段处于普通词或人名内部，未见共同的局部语义或句法条件；多为偶然与强激活上下文同现。
patterns.domain: 文学文本及百科人物、体育条目

patterns.name: 零散词语片段
patterns.context: 在各自段落中被标记，但不构成可由材料支持的共同触发条件；如无关百科目录词、论坛用户名、数字和普通叙述词。

en.description: Most passages activate on the internal fragment “ster” in mystery/mysterious word forms, covering unknown phenomena and various titles; other activations occur on internal proper-name fragments and line breaks, concentrated in lists, reports, emails, and web text.

patterns.name: mystery stem
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur in mystery/mysteries/mysterious word forms; they appear in descriptions of unknown phenomena and in book, series, or program titles.
patterns.domain: Narrative prose, fiction/film titles, bibliographies, and web text

patterns.name: Letter fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs within personal or proper names, not mystery word forms; examples include Francis Bret Harte, Kathleen Harter, and Mauro Arce in an email.

patterns.name: Line breaks
patterns.context: Line breaks are marked, especially as separators between entries in directory-style text; they also occur near HackerNews usernames.

2_2200.description: 多数段在 mystery/mysterious 词形的内部片段“ster”处激活，涵盖未知现象及各类标题；另有姓名专名内部片段和换行符激活，集中于列表、报道、邮件与网页文本。

patterns.name: mystery 词干
patterns.context: 触发片段包含 mystery/mysteries/mysterious 词形；分别出现在描述未知现象、书名/系列名或节目名中。
patterns.domain: 叙述性散文、小说/影视标题、书目及网页文字

patterns.name: 专名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名或专名的内部，而非 mystery 词形；包括 Francis Bret Harte、Kathleen Harter，以及邮件中的 Mauro Arce。
patterns.domain: 目录、体育报道、商务邮件

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 换行符被标记，尤其是目录式文本中的条目分隔；在 HackerNews 用户名附近也出现。
patterns.domain: 排版/列表文本、网页评论

en.description: Activations mainly occur on word fragments containing “ter” or “ster,” especially in personal-name spellings and the mystery/mysterious word family; some passages also mark other tokens with no obvious commonality, which this pattern cannot explain.

patterns.name: Fragments containing “ter”
patterns.context: Occurs in “-ter” spelling fragments in names and “ster” fragments in words such as “mystery/mysterious”; other scattered activated tokens also appear near these word fragments.
patterns.domain: Tennis and sports reports, and literary narrative

2_2200.description: 主要在含“ter”或“ster”的词片段上激活，尤其是人名拼写和 mystery/mysterious 词族；部分段落还标记了彼此无明显共性的其他 token，无法由此模式解释。

patterns.name: 含“ter”的词片
patterns.context: 出现在姓名中的“-ter”拼写片段，以及“mystery/mysterious”一类词中的“ster”片段；这些词片段附近另有零散激活 token。
patterns.domain: 网球赛事报道、体育报道及文学叙述

en.concept: Sensitivity to the ster string and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: Activations mainly occur on ster in mysteries/mysterious, sometimes extending to adjacent word fragments; there are also sporadic activations on the word-final ant and in names, proper names, legal boilerplate, and line breaks, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in mysteries
patterns.context: In the words mysteries / mysterious, activations concentrate on ster; observed forms include “my«ster»ies,” “my«ster»«ious»,” and “My«ster»«ious»« Man»” split by spaces or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Novel descriptions, literary prose, encyclopedia entries, HackerNews, and other genres

patterns.name: Word-final ant
patterns.context: Occurs in “extravag«ant» pretensions” and in the proper name “Manzi et Joy«ant» Gallery”; the contexts are a suffix in an adjective and part of a personal or institutional name, respectively.

patterns.name: Other sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur in Chinatown, Nemours, personal names and boilerplate in legal documents, line-break boundaries, and words such as Annex and Mauro Arce in Enron emails; there is no shared stable contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal documents, forum comments, business emails

2_2200.concept: 对 ster 字符串及零散子词片段敏感
2_2200.description: 主要激活 mysteries/mysterious 中的 ster，偶尔延伸到相邻词片段；另有 ant 词尾及若干姓名、专名、法律套语和换行处的零散激活，缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: mysteries 的词内片段
patterns.context: 在单词 mysteries / mysterious 中，激活集中于 ster；可见词形包括“my«ster»ies”“my«ster»«ious»”，以及被空格或标点切分的 “My«ster»«ious»« Man»”。
patterns.domain: 小说简介、文学散文、百科条目、HackerNews 等多种文体

patterns.name: 词尾 ant
patterns.context: 出现在“extravag«ant» pretensions”以及专名“Manzi et Joy«ant» Gallery”中；上下文分别是形容词词尾和人名/机构名的一部分。

patterns.name: 其他零散子词片段
patterns.context: 零散激活于 Chinatown、Nemours、法律文书中的人名与套语、换行边界，以及 Enron 邮件中 Annex、Mauro Arce 等词；没有共同的稳定上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律文书、论坛评论、商务邮件

en.concept: The mystery root and sporadic formatting/proper-name features
en.description: The main response is to the within-word fragment «ster» in mystery/mysterious, across prose, book titles, and web text; there are also sporadic activations on timeline numbers and proper names, place-name and ethnic-name fragments, and line-break formatting, with no clear unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: mystery root
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the subword unit «ster» in mystery/mysteries/mysterious; it can occur at different positions within words and in different capitalization forms.
patterns.domain: Prose, encyclopedias, book titles, and web text

patterns.name: Numbers and proper names in lists
patterns.context: Occurs in structures such as timelines, birth and death years of public figures, and email bodies; activations fall on numbers, proper-name fragments, line breaks, or adjacent word fragments, with no clear semantic trigger like that of the mystery root.

patterns.name: Place-name and ethnic-name fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in tokenized fragments of place or ethnic names such as Hindu Kush, Goa, and Bhil; no clear shared meaning is evident.

patterns.name: Paragraph openings and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Line-break markers sometimes activate, especially near paragraph openings, lists, or email formatting; they may indicate boundary or formatting cues, but are insufficient on their own to explain other triggers.

2_2200.concept: mystery 词根及零散格式/专名特征
2_2200.description: 主要响应 mystery/mysterious 的词内片段 «ster»，涵盖散文、书名和网页文本；另有年表数字与专名、地名族名片段及换行格式等零散激活，未形成明确统一语义模式。

patterns.name: mystery 词根
patterns.context: 激活集中在 mystery/mysteries/mysterious 中的子词元 «ster»；可出现在词内不同位置及大小写形式。
patterns.domain: 散文、百科、书名与网页文本

patterns.name: 列表中的数字与专名
patterns.context: 出现在年表、人物生卒年份及邮件正文等结构中；激活落在数字、专名片段、换行或相邻词片段，未见与 mystery 词根相同的清楚语义触发。
patterns.domain: 维基百科年表、商务邮件

patterns.name: 地名与族名片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Hindu Kush、Goa、Bhil 等地名或族名的分词片段中；未见明确共同词义。
patterns.domain: 维基百科语言与地理介绍

patterns.name: 段首及格式边界
patterns.context: 换行标记本身有时激活，尤见于段首、列表或邮件格式附近；可能是边界/格式线索，但单独不足以解释其他触发。
patterns.domain: 网页条目、论坛评论、邮件

en.description: The most stable pattern is strong activation on the “ster” fragment within mystery/mysterious word-family forms, involving natural mysteries, promotional copy, and book titles. Other fragments occur in the email name Mauro, in Bhili and Emilie, as well as on a few line breaks, for unclear reasons.

patterns.name: mystery word family
patterns.context: Triggers occur within mystery/mysterious and related plural forms; passages 1–3 are within sentences about the ocean, natural phenomena, or things in the universe not yet understood; passage 5 is title-style copy containing “mysterious Man”; passages 8–9 occur in work or book titles.
patterns.domain: Prose, fiction promotional copy, encyclopedia entries, and book titles

patterns.name: Name fragments in Enron emails
patterns.context: Company emails mention Mauro Arce and discuss news commentary, Annex V, and spot-price caps; multiple activations occur on proper-name or common-word fragments, with no clear shared trigger condition yet.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the language name Bhili
patterns.context: Occurs in an encyclopedic account of Dardic influence and the distribution of Indian languages; nearby are weak activations on place names such as Hindu Kush and Goa.

patterns.name: Name fragments in lists
patterns.context: Occurs in a chronological list of historical figures, with dates, numbers, and titles nearby; apart from internal name fragments, no clear common pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Line breaks
patterns.context: In passages 6, 8, and 9, activation occurs on line breaks; passage 8 is in an external-links section, and passage 9 is in HackerNews comments.
patterns.domain: Email, encyclopedia entries, and web comment formatting

2_2200.description: 最稳定的模式是对 mystery/mysterious 词族内部的“ster”片段强激活，涉及自然之谜、宣传文案及书名。另有邮件人名 Mauro、Bhili 与 Emilie 中的片段，以及少量换行符激活，成因不明。

patterns.name: mystery 词族
patterns.trigger: 段1–3中的 «ster»10（mysteries/mysterious 的词内片段），以及段5的 «ster»10«ious»2、段8–9的 «ster»9
patterns.context: 触发点位于 mystery/mysterious 及其复数等词的内部；段1–3处于句中，谈海洋、自然现象或宇宙中尚未理解的事物；段5为标题式文案中的“mysterious Man”；段8–9出现在作品名或书名中。
patterns.domain: 散文、小说宣传文案、百科条目与书名

patterns.name: Enron 邮件中的人名片段
patterns.trigger: «auro»10，位于“Mauro”；同段另有 «Annex»3、« setting»3、« »3 等激活
patterns.context: 公司邮件中提及 Mauro Arce，并讨论新闻评论、Annex V 和现货价格上限；多处激活落在专名或常见词片段上，尚无明确共同触发条件。

patterns.name: Bhili 语言名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于 Dardic 影响及印度语言分布的百科叙述中；邻近另有 Hindu Kush、Goa 等地名的弱激活。

patterns.name: 名单中的人名片段
patterns.context: 出现在按日期排列的历史人物名单中，附近还有日期、数字和头衔；除姓名内部片段外未见明显共同模式。

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 段6、8、9中激活落在换行符上；段8位于外部链接区，段9位于 HackerNews 评论文本。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科条目及网页评论格式

en.description: Mainly detects names and their tokenized fragments, and repeatedly detects within-word fragments in mystery/mysterious/mysteries; there are also a few sporadic activations on place names, common words, and formatting symbols.

patterns.name: Middle fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activations fall within personal names or name fragments, especially tokenized fragments in given names, surnames, or author citations; adjacent name fragments sometimes activate too.
patterns.domain: Emails, legal judgments, sports entries, forum signatures, academic citations

patterns.name: mystery stem within words
patterns.context: Activations occur on subword fragments within words such as mystery/mysterious/mysteries; following parts of the word sometimes activate as well.
patterns.domain: Film and television descriptions, bibliographies, novels, and explanatory prose

patterns.name: Other within-word fragments
patterns.context: Sporadically detects substrings in proper names, place names, common words, or formatting text, with no consistent local semantic condition.

patterns.name: Line-break markers
patterns.context: Activates at line breaks in emails or forum text, possibly related to text formatting.

2_2200.description: 主要命中姓名及其分词片段，也反复命中 mystery/mysterious/mysteries 的词内片段；另有少量地名、普通词、格式符号等零散激活。

patterns.name: 人名中间片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名或姓名片段中，尤其是名字、姓氏或作者引用中的分词片段；有时相邻姓名片段也激活。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律判决、体育条目、论坛署名、学术引用

patterns.name: 词内的 mystery 词干
patterns.context: 激活出现在 mystery/mysterious/mysteries 一类词的内部子词片段；词形后续部分有时也激活。
patterns.domain: 影视简介、书目列表、小说与说明性散文

patterns.name: 词内其他碎片
patterns.context: 零散地命中专名、地名、普通词或格式文本中的子串，未见一致的局部语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、邮件、法律文本、论坛

patterns.name: 换行标记
