patterns.trigger: «Copyright»3« 2019»2 The« Vit»2«ess»3« Authors»6；«Lic»2«ensed»5 under the Apache License
patterns.context: 源码文件开头的版权及开源许可证注释中，声明性文字附近。

patterns.name: 文档正文中的专业术语
patterns.context: 正文或摘要中出现专业概念、术语或标题时；强激活落点各异，未见共同语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 机器学习文档、医学文献、数学论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across long hyphen lines and heading boundaries in formatted documents, production configuration terminology, and various code identifiers; table tags and a refusal phrase also occur, making the overall pattern heterogeneous.

patterns.name: Hyphen separators
patterns.context: Long sequences of ASCII hyphens serve as document dividers; there are also heading underlines made of equals signs.
patterns.domain: Markdown, legal documents, scientific papers, and other formatted text

patterns.name: production configuration terminology
patterns.context: In software deployment or settings code, production denotes the production environment or configuration.
patterns.domain: Software engineering, Github documentation and code

patterns.name: Special names or strings in code
patterns.context: Local identifiers, attribute names, and string fragments activate in code, markup languages, or configuration files; there is no clear unified semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Github source code and configuration files

patterns.name: Headings and structured-document markers
patterns.context: Activations occur near document titles, section headings, or heading-format boundaries, often alongside dividers or Markdown/text structure.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, academic papers, and formatted documents

patterns.name: Statistical labels and values in tables
patterns.context: Statistical column names, category labels, and values in parentheses in tables.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in emphatic phrases
patterns.context: A colloquial headline contains a phrase expressing refusal of an invitation; activation falls on subword fragments of the phrase.

patterns.name: XML tags and test names
patterns.context: Fragments near tags and test/attribute names in XML project files.

patterns.name: Heterogeneous code tokens
patterns.context: Punctuation, function names, comments, and attributes appear in code or API examples; there is insufficient evidence to infer a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Github source code and API documentation

2_2329.concept: 文档结构与代码格式片段
2_2329.description: 激活分散于格式化文档的长横线与标题边界、production 配置术语，以及多种代码标识符；另见表格标签和拒绝短语，整体模式异质。

patterns.name: 横线分隔符
patterns.context: 连续、较长的 ASCII 连字符横线作为文档中的分隔线；也有等号组成的标题下划线。
patterns.domain: Markdown、法律文书、科学论文等格式化文本

patterns.name: production 配置术语
patterns.context: 在软件部署或设置代码中，production 表示生产环境或生产配置。
patterns.domain: 软件工程、Github 文档与代码

patterns.name: 代码中的特殊名称或字符串
patterns.context: 代码、标记语言或配置文件中，局部标识符、属性名及字符串片段出现激活；并无明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 标题与结构化文档标记
patterns.trigger: «OP»4«INION»1 OF THE COURT、«Dis»4persion equation、«Metallicity and» 等标题附近标记
patterns.context: 文档标题、章节标题或标题格式边界附近出现激活，常伴随分隔线或 Markdown/文本结构。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、学术论文及格式化文档

patterns.name: 表格统计标签与数值
patterns.context: 表格中的统计列名、类别标签及括号内数值。

patterns.name: 强调性短语中的词片段
patterns.context: 口语化标题中表达拒绝邀约的短语；激活落在短语的词片段上。

patterns.name: XML 标签与测试名称
patterns.context: XML 项目文件中标签及测试/属性名称附近的片段。

patterns.name: 异质代码 token
patterns.context: 代码或 API 示例中出现的标点、函数名、注释及属性；没有足够证据归纳出共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: Github 源码与 API 文档

en.description: The most stable trigger is the year “1947,” spanning historical narratives, legal dates, and vehicle model years; other activations involve numbers, structural markers, and local code fragments in software or documents, without unified semantics.

patterns.name: Year 1947
patterns.context: A four-digit year appears as the year of a historical event, land purchase, legal document date, product year, or endpoint of a time range; it occurs across multiple formats and domains.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic history, legal judgments, car descriptions, software translation, and histories of international organizations

patterns.name: Numbers and structural boundaries in terms
patterns.context: Numbers or short strings are embedded in software resource identifiers, document structure tags, or code assertions; activations are sporadic and cannot clearly be grouped under a single semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Github resource files, PubMed article structure markers, code

2_2329.description: 最稳定的触发是年份“1947”，横跨历史叙述、法律日期及车辆年份等语境；另有软件或文档中的数字、结构标记和代码局部激活，缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 年份 1947
patterns.context: 四位年份作为历史事件年份、地块购置年份、法律文件日期、商品年份或时间区间端点出现；在多个格式和领域中均出现。
patterns.domain: 百科历史、法律判决、汽车描述、软件翻译及国际组织历史

patterns.name: 词项中的数字与结构边界
patterns.context: 数字或短字符串嵌在软件资源标识、文档结构标签或代码断言中；激活较零散，不能明确归并为同一语义条件。
patterns.domain: Github 资源文件、PubMed 文章结构标记、代码

en.description: Activations occur on identifiers and structural punctuation in code, as well as variables, subscripts, superscripts, and separators in mathematical and physical formulas. Cross-domain commonality is weak, and no stable single semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Punctuation terminates expressions, separates parameters/fields, or closes code blocks; activation locations vary by corpus slice

patterns.name: Attributes and call structures in code
patterns.context: Identifiers occur in code structures such as object properties, method calls, or type/field declarations, often co-occurring with punctuation boundaries
patterns.domain: JavaScript, Dart, Go, and other code

patterns.name: Variables, subscripts, and superscripts in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Variables occur in formulas with subscripts, superscripts, summation/sequence notation, or function notation; local activations also fall on commas, parentheses, and formula boundaries
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science papers, mathematical Q&A

patterns.name: Parameter notation in physical formulas
patterns.context: Physical quantities or parameters occur in academic passages followed by explanations of formulas

2_2329.description: 激活分布于代码中的标识符及结构标点，也分布于数学、物理公式的变量、上下标和分隔符。跨领域共同点较弱，未见稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构边界
patterns.trigger: 多段中激活落在「;」「}」「,」「)」「{」等标点或紧邻它们的空白、换行上
patterns.context: 标点用于结束表达式、分隔参数/字段或闭合代码块；激活位置随语料切片而变化

patterns.name: 代码中的属性与调用结构
patterns.context: 标识符处在对象属性、方法调用或类型/字段声明等代码结构中，且多与标点边界共现

patterns.name: 数学公式中的变量与下标上标
patterns.context: 变量嵌在带下标、上标、求和/序列或函数记号的公式中；局部激活也落在逗号、括号和公式边界
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文、数学问答

patterns.name: 物理公式中的参数记号
patterns.context: 物理量或参数出现在公式后接说明文字的学术段落中

en.concept: Salient terms and markers in technical documents
en.description: Activations occur in fixed disclosure and citation wording in patents, patent numbers, chemical, biochemical, and lens-processing terminology, as well as LaTeX boundaries and mathematical/physical symbols in ArXiv formulas and sale in emails; no single meaning explains all instances.

patterns.name: Fixed wording for disclosed content in patent specifications
patterns.context: Patent backgrounds or specifications introduce prior art or cite references, often at the beginning of a sentence or in fixed legal wording, such as “The disclosures of …”; also includes adjacent contexts such as specifications and claims.

patterns.name: Patent document titles and number citations
patterns.context: Citations to Japanese or other patent documents, with nearby patent office, publication number, year, and identifier.

patterns.name: Closing alignment environments in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In LaTeX mathematics, a formula fragment or summation expression is followed by a line break, an aligned-environment closing marker, and a display-math closing marker.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and operator notation
patterns.context: Mathematical fonts, symbols with subscripts, Hamiltonians, or equality notation occur inside formulas; not necessarily at the end of a passage.

patterns.name: Compound modifiers in chemical substance names
patterns.context: Water-soluble compounds, reactants, and processing steps are listed in patent claims or technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Glycosidic bonds and enzyme activity terminology
patterns.context: Describes hydrolysis of alpha-1,4 bonds between maltose residues and alpha-glucosidase activity.

patterns.name: Lens-processing terminology
patterns.context: Discusses lens edge-finishing steps, contours, and finished-product quality.

patterns.name: Trade terminology in company email
patterns.context: A brief internal email mentions a system trade to Aquila on a certain date.

patterns.name: Trigonometric functions and matrix-index expressions
patterns.context: Formulas contain cosine, indexed variables, or matrix elements; no context clearly connects this pattern to the others.

patterns.name: Superconductivity/particle operator notation
patterns.context: Physical formulas containing spin up/down arrows, creation and annihilation operators, and Hamiltonian symbols.

2_2329.concept: 技术文档中的显著术语与标记
2_2329.description: 激活分布在专利固定披露与引文措辞、专利编号、化学及生化和镜片加工术语，另见ArXiv公式的LaTeX边界与数学/物理符号，以及邮件中的sale；没有单一词义能解释全部。

patterns.name: 专利说明书中披露内容的固定措辞
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书中介绍现有技术、引用文献，常出现在句首或固定法律措辞中，如“The disclosures of …”；也包括说明书、claims 等相邻语境。

patterns.name: 专利文献名称及编号引用
patterns.context: 引用日本专利或其他专利文献，附近出现专利局、公布号、年份及编号。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的对齐环境收尾
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式中，公式片段或求和表达式之后出现换行、aligned 环境结束符及显示公式结束符。

patterns.name: 数学符号与算符记号
patterns.context: 公式内部出现数学字体、带下标的符号、哈密顿量或等式等记号；未必处于段落收尾。

patterns.name: 化学物质名称中的复合修饰
patterns.context: 专利权利要求或技术描述中列举水溶性化合物、反应物及处理步骤。
patterns.domain: USPTO 化学/材料专利文本

patterns.name: 糖苷键与酶活性术语
patterns.context: 描述麦芽糖残基间 alpha-1,4 键的水解及 alpha-glucosidase 活性。

patterns.name: 镜片加工术语
patterns.context: 讨论镜片边缘精加工步骤、轮廓和成品质量。
patterns.domain: USPTO 光学/制造专利背景

patterns.name: 公司邮件中的交易用语
patterns.context: 简短内部邮件提及某日向 Aquila 的系统交易。

patterns.name: 三角函数与矩阵索引表达式
patterns.context: 公式中包含余弦、带索引的变量或矩阵元素；未见与其他模式明确相连的上下文。

patterns.name: 超导/粒子算符记号
patterns.context: 含自旋上下箭头、产生湮灭算符及哈密顿量符号的物理公式。

en.description: Activation spans multiple text types, with a notable commonality in specialized terminology or structured content: mathematical formulas and paper terminology, technical Q&A, medical and health content, and legal descriptions of payments. No clear semantic theme accounts for all paragraphs.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical expressions and formula structure
patterns.context: Formula fragments consisting of mathematical symbols, variables, subscripts, superscripts, or sets; commonly found in equations or theorem statements in papers

patterns.name: Specific terms in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Terms embedded in academic discussion of local stereological estimators, near citations and mathematical parameters
patterns.domain: ArXiv geometry or applied mathematics papers

patterns.name: Warm inflation and non-Gaussianity terminology
patterns.context: Discusses the generation of non-Gaussianity in canonical warm inflation and related papers

patterns.name: WebRTC and technical Q&A
patterns.context: A HackerNews question asks for learning resources and mentions that the technology changes quickly and resources become outdated

patterns.name: Reproductive health and medical advice
patterns.context: Discusses women's level of knowledge about the topic and recommends that healthcare professionals proactively provide educational and counseling materials

patterns.name: Obstetric delivery evidence Q&A
patterns.context: Asks which pushing position is evidence-based without an epidural and cites a Cochrane review
patterns.domain: Health information or evidence-based medicine text

patterns.name: Amounts and payment language in legal documents
patterns.context: States facts about payment for engineering work, a paid balance, and material suppliers

2_2329.concept: 专业术语与结构化文本
2_2329.description: 激活分布于多类文本，较突出的共性是专业术语或结构化内容：数学公式与论文术语、科技问答、医学健康内容及法律付款叙述；没有一个能覆盖全部段落的明确语义主题。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式与公式结构
patterns.trigger: 如 «cos», «\phi», «I_{...}», «\Hom», «\mathbb{Z}[Q]», «w_1 = \{...\}», «A_{3i} \bullet f»；并伴随大量上下标、集合符号、公式分隔符
patterns.context: 数学符号、变量、上下标或集合构成的公式片段；常见于论文中的公式或定理陈述

patterns.name: 数学论文中的特定术语
patterns.context: 术语嵌在关于局部立体学估计量的学术叙述中，临近引用和数学参数
patterns.domain: ArXiv 几何或应用数学论文

patterns.name: 暖暴胀与非高斯性术语
patterns.context: 讨论 canonical warm inflation 中非高斯性的生成及相关论文

patterns.name: WebRTC 及技术问答
patterns.context: HackerNews 提问，询问学习资源，并提及技术变化快、资料过时

patterns.name: 生殖健康与医学建议
patterns.context: 讨论女性对相关知识的了解程度，并建议医护人员主动提供教育和咨询材料

patterns.name: 产科分娩证据问答
patterns.context: 询问无硬膜外麻醉时何种用力姿势有证据支持，并引用 Cochrane 综述
patterns.domain: 健康科普或循证医学文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的款项与付款表述
patterns.context: 陈述工程工作款项、余额已支付及材料供应商等事实

en.concept: Sales-related words and a few form-based triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to sales, sell, selling, and other sales-related words and contexts involving marketing, sales training, closing deals, and delivery; two outlier triggers are the place name Jalore and the question mark in a URL query parameter.

patterns.name: sales/sales-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Activations concentrate in sentences discussing sales, pitching, sales skills, sales training, or sales volume; sometimes the word itself is central, and sometimes it occurs in a compound or collocation.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments, Enron business email, Pile-CC training materials

patterns.name: Business discussions of selling, marketing, and delivery
patterns.context: Focuses on how products or services are sold or marketed, whether sales succeed, or how the sales process works; activation words often occur near salespeople, customers, support, pricing, or delivery.

patterns.name: Place name Jalore
patterns.context: Appears in a historical narrative mentioning a person advancing toward Jalore and being recalled there; the context is unrelated to sales or marketing.

patterns.name: q in URL query parameters
patterns.context: Appears in code or link examples where a question mark introduces URL query parameters; activation centers on the question mark rather than the surrounding link text.
patterns.domain: HackerNews technical discussions and code examples

2_2329.concept: 销售相关词及少数词形触发
2_2329.description: 主要响应 sales、sell、selling 等销售词及营销、销售培训、成交和交付语境；另有 Jalore 地名与 URL 查询参数问号两类离群触发。

patterns.name: sales／销售相关词汇
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在讨论销售、推销、销售能力、销售培训或销售量的语句中；有时词本身是中心词，有时处于复合词或搭配中。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、Enron 商务邮件、Pile-CC 培训材料

patterns.name: 售卖、营销与交付的业务讨论
patterns.context: 围绕产品或服务如何销售、营销，销售是否成功或销售流程如何运作；激活词常与销售人员、客户支持、价格或交付相邻。

patterns.name: Jalore 地名
patterns.context: 出现在历史叙述中，提及人物向 Jalore 推进及被召回至该地；上下文并非销售或营销。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科历史条目

patterns.name: URL 查询参数中的 q
patterns.context: 出现在代码或链接示例里，问号引出 URL 查询参数；激活集中于问号，而非周围的链接文字。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术讨论及代码示例

en.description: Strongly responds to sales and its compounds, covering sales in business discussions, salespeople, and sales transactions and contracts in legal and regulatory texts; related contexts often include selling, marketing, purchase, or rep.

patterns.name: Sales in sale and marketing contexts
patterns.context: Discusses how to sell, marketing, sales channels, and sales performance; sales may appear alone or alongside marketing and selling
patterns.domain: HackerNews startup, software, and business discussions

patterns.name: Salespeople and sales representatives
patterns.context: Salespeople dealing with customers, making calls, quoting prices, or negotiating
patterns.domain: HackerNews business discussions, FreeLaw factual accounts

patterns.name: Sales in formal transactions or legal texts
patterns.context: Sales refers to transactions, contracts, or their legal/regulatory records, rather than specific salespeople
patterns.domain: Energy regulatory emails, real estate legal texts

2_2329.description: 强烈响应 sales 及其复合词，覆盖商业讨论中的销售、销售人员，以及法律和监管文本中的销售交易与合同；相关上下文常伴随 selling、marketing、purchase 或 rep。

patterns.name: sale 与市场营销语境中的 sales
patterns.context: 讨论如何销售、营销、销售渠道与销售业绩；sales 可单独出现，也可与 marketing、selling 并列
patterns.domain: HackerNews 创业、软件与商业讨论

patterns.name: 销售人员与销售代表
patterns.context: 出现与客户交涉、打电话、报价或洽谈的销售人员
patterns.domain: HackerNews 商业讨论、FreeLaw 事实叙述

patterns.name: 正式交易或法律文本中的 sales
patterns.context: sales 指交易、合同或其法律/监管记录，而非具体销售人员
patterns.domain: 能源监管邮件、房地产法律文本

en.description: All passages contain a form of sales or an adjacent word in a buying/selling context; the core response is to sales, selling, seller, salesman, and related product marketing, transactions, and sales-volume contexts, across forums, email, legal, and industry text.

patterns.name: sales forms and sales-related words
patterns.context: Highly sensitive to sales and its derived forms; no fixed syntactic position or particular type of sale is required.
patterns.domain: Forums, business email, legal text, news narratives, and other genres

patterns.name: Marketing and sales processes
patterns.context: Discusses how products or services are promoted, sold, or delivered, or focuses on sales models and sales volume; sales terms co-occur with commercial-context words such as market, product, affiliate, and delivery.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions of products, applications, and business models

patterns.name: Sales department contact details
patterns.context: Sales appears as part of an email address in sentences inviting contact for questions or inquiries; here it does not denote an ordinary sales action.

patterns.name: Energy trading and regulatory disclosures
patterns.context: Sales occur near purchase transactions, prices, exemptions, disclosures, and other regulatory or trading information.
patterns.domain: Enron email and energy regulatory materials

patterns.name: Buyers and sellers in contract disputes
patterns.context: Describes consumers purchasing goods, a salesperson’s understanding, or whether the parties reached an agreement.

patterns.name: Dealer sales and industry customers
patterns.context: Describes trucks as a best-selling product and the share of dealer sales attributable to oil and gas operators.

2_2329.description: 所有段落都含 sales 词形或紧邻的买卖语境词；核心响应是 sales、selling、seller、salesman 等及产品营销、交易、销售额相关上下文，覆盖论坛、邮件、法律和行业文本。

patterns.name: sales 词形及销售相关词
patterns.context: 对 sales 及其派生形式高度敏感；不要求固定句法位置，也不要求它表示特定类型的销售。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、商务邮件、法律文本、新闻叙述等多种文体

patterns.name: 市场营销与销售流程
patterns.context: 围绕产品或服务如何推广、售卖、交付，或销售模式及销售额展开讨论；销售词与 market、product、affiliate、delivery 等商业语境词共现。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 产品、应用和商业模式讨论

patterns.name: 销售部门联系方式
patterns.context: sales 作为邮箱地址的一部分，出现在邀请联系咨询或查询的句子中；此处并非普通语义上的销售动作。

patterns.name: 能源交易及监管披露
patterns.context: 销售与采购交易、价格、豁免披露等监管或交易信息相邻。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及能源监管材料

patterns.name: 买卖双方与合同争议
patterns.context: 描述消费者购买商品、销售人员的理解，或买卖双方是否达成合意。

patterns.name: 经销商销售额与行业客户
patterns.context: 描述卡车作为畅销商品，以及经销商销售中来自油气运营商的比例。

en.description: Every paragraph contains the sales root, mainly concerning sales, buying and selling, or salespeople; contexts include energy transactions, retail, real estate, securities, corporate marketing, and sales ethics. The root appears both independently and within words such as salesman, contract, and salesmanship.

patterns.name: Sales as a commercial root
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving commercial transactions, salespeople, sales channels, or selling, often near words such as purchase, sell, market, contract, dealership, and business; activation locations include both the full word and the sales root.
patterns.domain: Commerce, marketing, corporate discussions, and transaction descriptions in legal texts

patterns.name: Energy commodities and sales filings
patterns.context: Involves disclosures or regulatory information about natural gas sellers, LDCs, and purchase and sales transactions; activation is concentrated on sales.
patterns.domain: Energy regulation, government documents, and Enron emails

patterns.name: Sales pitches and salespeople
patterns.context: Discusses how to market or sell products, whether to contact a sales representative, or a customer's interaction with a salesperson and purchase of goods.
patterns.domain: Online forum discussions and legal testimony

patterns.name: Real estate purchase and sale contracts
patterns.context: Real estate transactions, signing purchase and sale contracts, or facts concerning property purchases; the sales root may appear in sales contract.

patterns.name: Dealer sales and customers
patterns.context: Describes local dealers acquiring customers, sales changing over time, or retail matters such as product repairs.

patterns.name: Corporate business models and affiliate sales
patterns.context: Discusses corporate models, website design, and earning revenue through affiliate sales rather than individual transactions.

patterns.name: Wholesale and retail salespeople
patterns.context: Describes a wholesale lumber company's inventory, sawmills, employees, and sales to retailers.
patterns.domain: Business descriptions, factual statements in legal materials

patterns.name: Buying and selling securities
patterns.context: Sales refers to securities transactions, with connections to interstate commerce, mail, or telegraph orders.

patterns.name: Advertising and sales ethics
patterns.context: Discusses advertising and sales techniques as an ethical issue rather than describing specific product transactions.

2_2329.description: 所有段落都出现 sales 词根，主要涉及销售、买卖或销售人员；语境涵盖能源交易、零售、房地产、证券、企业营销及销售伦理，词根既可独立出现，也可嵌在 salesman、contract、salesmanship 等词中。

patterns.name: sales 作为商业销售词根
patterns.context: 出现在商业交易、销售人员、销售渠道或销售行为的语境中，常与 purchase、sell、market、contract、dealership、business 等词相邻；触发位置包括完整单词，也包括 sales 词根。
patterns.domain: 商业、市场营销、企业讨论及法律文本中的交易描述

patterns.name: 能源商品与销售申报
patterns.context: 涉及天然气卖方、LDCs、采购与销售交易的披露或监管信息；激活集中在 sales。
patterns.domain: 能源监管、政府文件与 Enron 邮件

patterns.name: 销售话术与销售人员
patterns.context: 讨论如何营销或出售产品、是否要联系销售代表，或叙述顾客与销售员接触并购买商品。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛讨论与法律证词

patterns.name: 房地产买卖合同
patterns.context: 房地产交易、签署买卖合同或围绕房产的购置事实；sales 词根可出现在 sales contract 中。

patterns.name: 经销商销售与顾客
patterns.context: 描述地方经销商获得顾客、销售随时间变化或商品维修等零售业务情形。

patterns.name: 企业商业模式与关联销售
patterns.context: 讨论企业模式、网站设计及通过关联销售获利，而非单笔交易。

patterns.name: 批发与零售销售人员
patterns.context: 介绍批发木材企业的库存、锯木厂、员工及向零售商销售的业务。
patterns.domain: 企业经营描述，法律材料中的事实陈述

patterns.name: 证券交易中的买卖
patterns.context: sales 指证券买卖，且与跨州商业、邮寄或电报订单相关。

patterns.name: 广告与销售伦理
patterns.context: 将广告与销售技巧作为伦理议题讨论，而非描述具体商品交易。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛中的观点讨论

en.concept: Gestational-age expressions and incidental subword fragments
en.description: The most stable pattern is “weeks gestation” in obstetric texts. Other high activations are scattered across within-word fragments: ity, use, akes, ender, spanning different meanings and styles, with no consistent semantics or contextual conditions.

patterns.name: Gestational weeks and age
patterns.context: Describes pregnant women at a specific gestational week or stage, often near thresholds such as 20 or 17 weeks

patterns.name: Within-word string ity
patterns.context: Activation falls on a letter fragment within a word; occurs in comity, Garrity, and MIA, with different meanings and contexts

patterns.name: Within-word string use
patterns.context: Activation falls on the use substring within museums, in a tagged social-media topic
patterns.domain: Online comments, discussions of race relations

patterns.name: Within-word string handshake
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending fragment of handshakes, in discussions about handshakes and gender

patterns.name: Within-word string ender
patterns.context: Activation falls within the word slender, describing a person's appearance

2_2329.concept: 孕龄表达及偶然词片段
2_2329.description: 最稳定的模式是产科文本中的 weeks gestation。其余高激活分散在词内片段：ity、use、akes、ender，涉及不同词义与文体，未见一致语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 妊娠周数与孕龄
patterns.context: 描述孕妇在妊娠特定周数或孕龄阶段，常见于20周、17周等阈值附近
patterns.domain: 产科医学研究、专利背景

patterns.name: 词内字符串 ity
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的字母片段；对应 comity、Garrity、MIA，词义和上下文不相同
patterns.domain: 法律文本、人物传记、网页文本

patterns.name: 词内字符串 use
patterns.context: 激活落在 museums 一词内部的 use 子串，出现在带标签的社交媒体话题中
patterns.domain: 网络评论、种族关系讨论

patterns.name: 词内字符串 handshake
patterns.context: 激活落在 handshakes 的词尾片段，出现于关于握手与性别的讨论

patterns.name: 词内字符串 ender
patterns.context: 激活落在 slender 一词内部，描述人物体貌

en.description: Activation falls mainly on sh-containing fragments within words and also on fragments in labels, proper names, or abbreviations beginning with M; a few activations involve line breaks, separators, and structural symbols. The material spans domains, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: sh or similarly spelled fragments in word endings or stems
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within segmented words; these are mostly parts of inflected forms, proper names, or compounds, with no stable syntactic or semantic condition observed
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: music, everyday language, commercial copy, history, science, and web text

patterns.name: Fragments in specific proper names or labels
patterns.context: Appears in proper names, labels, or abbreviations; activation may be related to spelling fragments in these strings, especially fragments beginning with M
patterns.domain: Social media hashtags, geographic classifications, virology

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting markers
patterns.context: In forum, web, or paper text, occasional activations appear near line breaks, separators, or markers; this does not fully match the within-word fragment pattern
patterns.domain: Forum formatting, web structure, paper structure

2_2329.concept: 字符串片段与格式标记
2_2329.description: 激活主要落在含 sh 的词内片段，也出现在 M 开头的标签、专名或缩写片段；少数激活涉及换行、分隔线及结构符号。材料跨领域，缺少稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 词尾或词干中的 sh/类似拼写片段
patterns.trigger: 多处触发于含 sh 的词片段，如「Sh«akes»」「handsh«akes»」「sh«aming»」「Sh«amp»」「Sh«ams»」；另有「M«use»ums」「M«ining»」「sh«ining»」
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标注的词内部片段上；多为词形、专名或复合词的一部分，未见稳定的句法或语义条件
patterns.domain: 跨领域：音乐、日常表达、商业文案、历史、科学及网页文本

patterns.name: 特定专名或标签中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名、标签或缩写中；激活可能与这些字符串的拼写片段有关，尤其是 M 开头的片段
patterns.domain: 社交媒体标签、地名分类、病毒学

patterns.name: 断行及格式标记
patterns.context: 论坛、网页或论文文本中，换行、分隔线、标记符号附近偶有激活；与词内片段模式并不完全一致
patterns.domain: 论坛格式、网页结构、论文结构

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and tokenization boundaries
en.description: Activations mainly fall on segmented string fragments: Amity, Muse/museums, several proper names, and technical terms; there is also sporadic follow-up. Domains and semantics vary widely, making it difficult to group them into a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Tokenization boundary in the string Amity
patterns.context: Amity is split into multiple subword tokens; occurs in school or treatment-program names

patterns.name: Internal fragments of the string Museums
patterns.context: Museums is split within the word, with activations concentrated on the muse/use fragments; occurs in hashtags, category headings, or category entries

patterns.name: Split fragments in place names or proper names
patterns.context: Subword fragments in proper names are marked, including place names, personal names, and titles; no stable shared semantics are apparent

patterns.name: Fragments within specific word forms
patterns.context: Technical terms in texts about bacterial resistance are split into subwords; activations fall within gene or drug names

patterns.name: aff fragment in legal citations
patterns.context: The surname Schaffer is tokenized in case citations, with activation on the medial aff fragment

patterns.name: Split fragments in musician names
patterns.context: Names in music-competition lists are split into multiple subwords; activation fragments are scattered and vary in strength

patterns.name: Title fragments in bibliography entries
patterns.context: Activations occur near work titles and italic/underline markup in bibliography lists; there is also the name fragment Shay

patterns.name: Muse in jazz discographies
patterns.context: The record label Muse in parentheses in a discography is split; its spelling resembles muse/museums in paragraphs 4 and 5

patterns.name: The follow fragment in ordinary words
patterns.context: The word post-treatment follow-up is split in a research abstract; activation is weak

2_2329.concept: 特定子词片段与分词边界
2_2329.description: 激活主要落在被拆分的字符串片段上：Amity、Muse/museums、若干专名及专业术语；另有零星的 follow-up。领域和语义差异很大，难以归为同一语义类别。

patterns.name: Amity 字符串的分词边界
patterns.context: Amity 被拆成多个子词 token；位于学校名称或治疗项目名称中

patterns.name: Museums 字符串的内部片段
patterns.context: Museums 在单词内部被切分，激活集中于 muse/use 片段；出现在话题标签、分类标题或分类条目中

patterns.name: 地名或专名中的切分片段
patterns.context: 专名中的子词片段被标记，包括地名、人名及作品名；未见稳定的共同语义

patterns.name: 特定词形内部的片段
patterns.context: 细菌耐药相关文本中的专业术语被拆成子词；激活落在基因名或药物名内部

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 aff 片段
patterns.context: 判例引述中姓氏 Schaffer 被分词，激活落于中间的 aff 片段

patterns.name: 音乐人姓名中的切分片段
patterns.context: 音乐竞赛名单中的人名被切成多个子词；激活片段分散且强度不一

patterns.name: 书目条目中的作品名片段
patterns.context: 书目列表中作品标题及斜体/下划线标记附近出现激活，另有姓名片段 Shay

patterns.name: 爵士唱片目录中的 Muse
patterns.context: 唱片目录括号内的唱片厂牌 Muse 被拆分；与第4、5段的 muse/museums 字形相似

patterns.name: 普通词语中的 follow 片段
patterns.context: 研究摘要中 post-treatment follow-up 一词被拆分，激活很弱

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and word forms
en.description: Activation falls mainly within words containing the fragments ay, use, akes/shake, and aming. The words concern handshakes, museums, names or titles, and shaming; CF in MCF-7 also appears. No unified semantics or context is evident.

patterns.name: The word form handshake
patterns.context: Handshake refers to a physical handshake or the establishment of a communications connection; activation falls on different subword fragments of the word
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions; patent background text

patterns.name: The word form Museums
patterns.context: A subword fragment inside the word Museums
patterns.domain: Web pages on social issues; city Wikipedia entries

patterns.name: Name fragment in Shayne
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the name Shayne

patterns.name: Title fragment in Shaykh
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the religious title Shaykh

patterns.name: Name fragment in Shay
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the name Shay

patterns.name: The word form shaming
patterns.context: In a sentence criticizing someone for publicly shaming an employer

patterns.name: CF tumor cell-line marker
patterns.context: The tumor cell line name MCF-7 in parentheses

2_2329.description: 激活主要落在包含片段 ay、use、akes/shake、aming 的词内；词项分属握手、博物馆、人名或称谓、羞辱等，另见 MCF-7 中的 CF，未显示统一语义或语境。

patterns.name: handshake 词形
patterns.context: handshake 指握手或通信连接建立时出现；激活落在该词的不同子词片段上
patterns.domain: Hacker News 讨论；专利背景文本

patterns.name: Museums 词形
patterns.context: Museums 一词中间的子词片段
patterns.domain: 社会议题网页；城市维基百科条目

patterns.name: Shayne 姓名片段
patterns.context: 人名 Shayne 的内部片段

patterns.name: Shaykh 称谓片段
patterns.context: 宗教人物称谓 Shaykh 的内部片段

patterns.name: Shay 姓名片段
patterns.context: 人名 Shay 的内部片段

patterns.name: shaming 词形
patterns.context: 批评他人公开羞辱雇主的句子中

patterns.name: CF 肿瘤细胞系标记
patterns.context: 括号中的肿瘤细胞系名称 MCF-7

en.description: The most prominent pattern is the within-word fragment «align» in malignant/non-malignant in medical contexts; proper names such as Amity and Maysville, as well as marriage-related contexts, also trigger activation. Other activations are scattered across diverse terms and styles, without a unified context.

patterns.name: malignant/non-malignant contrast
patterns.context: Embedded in the stems of malignant/non-malignant; commonly occurs in contrasts between malignant and non-malignant lesions, cells, or tissues.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, patent background, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Amity project name
patterns.context: Triggered by the proper name “Amity,” in the context of NIH project descriptions analyzing data from prior projects.

patterns.name: May’sville place name
patterns.context: Triggered by the place name “Maysville” in parentheses as a product origin, alongside the U.S. state abbreviation KY.

patterns.name: May and marriage-related context
patterns.context: Occurs in a private email discussing a father's name and whether someone will get married; the same passage also contains ordinary thought and referential-word activations.

patterns.name: Various low-intensity term and component triggers
patterns.context: Scattered words, punctuation, spaces, or within-word fragments across passages; some occur in medical discussion, others in email, project descriptions, product copy, or patent text, with no shared specific contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; includes email, biomedicine, project descriptions, product descriptions, and patents

2_2329.description: 最突出的模式是医学语境中 malignant／non-malignant 的词内片段 «align»；另有 Amity、Maysville 等专名及婚姻语境触发。其余激活零散分布于多种词项和文体，缺少统一上下文。

patterns.name: malignant／non-malignant 对照
patterns.context: 嵌在 malignant／non-malignant 这组词的词干中；常见于描述恶性与非恶性病变、细胞或组织的对照。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景、科研项目说明

patterns.name: Amity 项目名称
patterns.context: 触发于项目专名 “Amity”，出现在 NIH 项目说明对既有项目数据进行分析的语境中。

patterns.name: May’sville 地名
patterns.context: 触发于产品产地括号中的地名 “Maysville”，并与美国州缩写 KY 同现。

patterns.name: May 与婚姻语境
patterns.context: 在谈及父亲姓名、某人是否会结婚的私人邮件中出现；同段还含普通思考与指代词激活。

patterns.name: 多种低强度词项与成分触发
patterns.context: 各段中零散出现的词、标点、空格或词内片段；有些位于医学论述，有些来自邮件、项目说明、商品文案或专利文本，未见共同的具体语境条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；包括邮件、生物医学、项目说明、商品描述和专利

en.concept: align substring in the malignancy word family
en.description: Primarily responds to malignant, malignancy, malignancies, and the within-word fragment align in non-malignant, commonly in oncology contexts; there is also one activation on the abbreviation MRT, with an uncertain connection.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in non-malignant
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the substring align in malignant, especially in non-malignant and its variants; the prefix non-m and suffix ant are unmarked or weaker.

patterns.name: The malignant / malignancy word family
patterns.context: Stem fragments in malignant, malignancies, and malignancy related to malignant tumors or states activate; some examples also include the non-malignant contrast.

patterns.name: An anomalous malignancy-related substring
patterns.context: The align substring is localized within the malignancy word family, possibly reflecting a response to a specific within-word character sequence rather than a complete semantic concept; word forms and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in the abbreviation RT
patterns.context: Appears in the abbreviation expansion “MRT: malignant rhabdoid tumor”; this is a single example, and its relation to the malignant word-family pattern is uncertain.

patterns.name: M-align substring in a bone scan heading
patterns.context: Appears in the title text malignant melanoma, involving the align substring as well as melanoma; consistent with other word-family examples.

2_2329.concept: 恶性词族中的 align 子串
2_2329.description: 主要响应 malignant、malignancy、malignancies 及 non-malignant 中的词内片段 align，常见于肿瘤医学语境；另有一次 MRT 缩写激活，关联不确定。

patterns.name: non-malignant 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 malignant 一词中 align 的子串，尤其出现在 non-malignant 及其变体中；前缀 non-m 与后缀 ant 未标记或较弱。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物医学及专利文本

patterns.name: malignant / malignancy 词族
patterns.context: 与恶性肿瘤或恶性状态相关的 malignant、malignancies、malignancy 中的词干片段被激活；部分样例同时含 non-malignant 对照。
patterns.domain: 医学文献及肿瘤学文本

patterns.name: 异常的 malignancy 相关子串
patterns.context: 在 malignancy 词族内部定位到 align 子串，可能是对特定词内字符序列而非完整语义概念的响应；词形与上下文变化较大。

patterns.name: RT 缩写中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“MRT: malignant rhabdoid tumor”的缩写说明中；仅此一例，是否与 malignant 词族模式相关不确定。

patterns.name: 骨显像标题中的 M-align 子串
patterns.context: 出现在 malignant melanoma 的标题文本中，除 align 子串外还涉及 melanoma；与其他词族样例相符。
patterns.domain: 医学病例或影像学摘要

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to the within-word fragment align in malignant/non-malignant in medical contexts, and also covers premalignant and definitions of tumor abbreviations; there are occasional activations on non-medical word forms such as Masons and Museums.

patterns.name: malignant/non-malignant contrast
patterns.context: In medical texts, occurs alongside or in contrast with malignant, often modifying effusions, lesions, cells, tissues, diagnoses, and similar terms; activation is concentrated on the align portion.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, patent background, and research abstracts

patterns.name: premalignant word form
patterns.context: Describes the precancerous nature of a lesion, in contexts involving symptoms, risk, or patient concerns.

patterns.name: malignant abbreviation entry
patterns.context: A tumor name is defined in an abbreviation list; activation falls within malignant in that name.

patterns.name: Masons in a proper name
patterns.context: An ordinary spelling fragment in the U.S. Navy ship name USS Masons; no malignancy or medical semantics.

patterns.name: museums in a social-media hashtag
patterns.context: Within-word fragment in the hashtag #Museumsrespond; unrelated to the medical context.

2_2329.concept: 医学恶性相关词形片段
2_2329.description: 主要对医学语境中 malignant/non-malignant 的词内片段 align 强烈响应，也覆盖 premalignant 和肿瘤缩写定义；另有 Masons、Museums 等非医学词形偶发激活。

patterns.name: malignant/non-malignant 对照
patterns.context: 在医学文本中与 malignant 并列或对照，常修饰 effusions、lesions、cells、tissues、diagnoses 等；激活集中在 align 部分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景和研究摘要

patterns.name: premalignant 词形
patterns.context: 描述病变的癌前性质，出现在有关症状、风险或患者担忧的语境中。

patterns.name: malignant 缩写表项
patterns.context: 缩写表中给出肿瘤名称定义；激活落在该名称的 malignant 内部。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Masons
patterns.context: 美国海军舰名 USS Masons 中的普通拼写片段；无恶性或医学语义。

patterns.name: 社交媒体话题中的 museums
patterns.context: 标签 #Museumsrespond 的词内片段；与医学语境无关。

en.description: Strong activation primarily falls on the substrings align, oser, isf, IA, and UC within different words or symbols. align commonly occurs in malignant; the others appear in a mathematical term, a name, aircraft-model text, and a gene symbol, respectively. Beyond substring localization, semantics and style are not unified.

patterns.name: Word ending in malignant
patterns.context: Appears in hyphenated or segmented malignant / non-malignant, marking the within-word align substring; malignant and non-malignant often occur in contrast.

patterns.name: Surname ending in Moser
patterns.context: Appears in the mathematical term Nash-Moser, activating the oser substring within the surname.

patterns.name: Literary name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the play character name Misfortune, marking the within-word isf substring.

patterns.name: IA in the Me 163 model designation
patterns.context: Appears in an account of the official records and observers of the Me 163B Komet aircraft, activating IA within the string FIA.

patterns.name: UC in the MUC gene symbol
patterns.context: Appears in mucin-related gene names MUC1 and MUC5AC, activating UC within the gene symbol.

2_2329.description: 强激活主要落在不同词或符号内部的 align、oser、isf、IA、UC 子串。align 多见于 malignant；其余分别见于数学术语、人名、飞机型号文字和基因符号。除子串定位外，语义与文体并不统一。

patterns.name: malignant 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在被连字符或分词切开的 malignant / non-malignant 中，标记词内的 align 子串；周围常出现 malignant 与 non-malignant 的对照。
patterns.domain: 医学、肿瘤学及专利文本

patterns.name: Moser 姓氏词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 Nash-Moser 这一数学术语中，激活其姓氏内部的 oser 子串。

patterns.name: 文学人名词尾
patterns.context: 出现在诗剧人名 Misfortune 中，标记词内的 isf 子串。

patterns.name: Me 163 型号中的 IA
patterns.context: 出现在有关 Me 163B Komet 飞机官方纪录及观察员的叙述中，激活 FIA 字符串中的 IA。

patterns.name: MUC 基因符号中的 UC
patterns.context: 出现在黏蛋白相关基因名称 MUC1、MUC5AC 中，激活基因符号内部的 UC。

en.description: All fragment activations are concentrated within words or abbreviations containing M, such as Moser, MCI, malignant, Movember, and MBA; no stable thematic or syntactic condition is apparent, and activation may primarily respond to specific within-word subword fragments.

patterns.name: Strings containing m-related letters
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword fragment or character sequence after M; includes full words, proper names, and abbreviations, without requiring a fixed syntactic or semantic context.
patterns.domain: Mixed: academic, medical, patent, literary, online texts, etc.

2_2329.concept: M 开头词的词内片段
2_2329.description: 所有片段的激活都集中在带 M 的词或缩写内部：如 Moser、MCI、malignant、Movember、MBA；未见稳定的主题或句法条件，可能主要响应特定词内子词片段。

patterns.name: 含 m 相关字母串
patterns.trigger: M«oser», M«CI», M«oser», «M»1…«oser», non-m«align», M«ovember», M«BA»
patterns.context: 激活落在 M 之后的子词片段或词内字符序列；包含完整词、专名、缩写，且不要求固定句法或语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 混合：学术、医学、专利、文学、网络文本等

en.description: Primarily activates on the cross-word-boundary letter fragments MISF, MALIGN, and MISS, as well as word-final S and ION; there are also sporadic local triggers such as TGF, numeric punctuation, clinical symptoms, MCI, and code-interface words, with varied semantics and styles.

patterns.name: Cross-word-boundary MISF / MALIGN / MISS fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on continuous letter fragments within words, often split by capitalization, word boundaries, or hyphens in the context; examples include Misfortune, Misfit, malignant/non-malignant, and MISSING.
patterns.domain: Literature, film synopses, medical papers/patents, code comments

patterns.name: Word-final S
patterns.context: S at the end of standalone words or proper nouns is highlighted; it appears in chapter headings, organization names, and abbreviations, including possessive and plural forms.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal ION
patterns.context: The -ion/-tion letter sequence in longer words is activated, appearing in words such as devotion, Salvation, and collection.

patterns.name: I in abbreviations
patterns.context: A single I inside uppercase abbreviations or brand names is activated, with no stable semantic condition observed.

patterns.name: TGF abbreviation fragment
patterns.context: Character fragments in abbreviations such as TGF-alpha and TGF-beta1 in medical texts; activation is weak and may be related to other letter-fragment patterns.

patterns.name: Numeric and punctuation fragments
patterns.context: Local activation on numbers and punctuation in statistics, decimals, or table numbering; no shared semantic trigger can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Wound and subsequent word fragments
patterns.context: Local fragments of words such as wound, toxicity, and stiffness are activated when tables list adverse events or symptoms; their relationship to the main letter-fragment patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: MCI letter fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside a team abbreviation in sports reporting; no other matching context was observed.

patterns.name: User-interface word fragments
patterns.context: Accessibility-reading instructions and editor field names in code comments; these words have no obvious connection to the main patterns.

2_2329.description: 主要对跨词边界的字母片段 MISF、MALIGN、MISS 及词尾 S、ION 激活；另有 TGF、数字标点、临床症状、MCI 和代码界面词等零散局部触发，语义与文体不一。

patterns.name: 跨词边界的 MISF / MALIGN / MISS 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的连续字母片段，常被上下文中的大小写、词边界或连字符切开；包括 Misfortune、Misfit、malignant/non-malignant 与 MISSING。
patterns.domain: 文学、电影简介、医学论文/专利、代码注释

patterns.name: 词尾 S
patterns.context: 独立词或专名末尾的 S 被突出；在章节标题、机构名称及缩写中出现，含所有格或复数等情形。
patterns.domain: 目录、法律/机构文本、叙事对白

patterns.name: 词尾或词内 ION
patterns.context: 较长词中的 -ion/-tion 字母序列被激活，出现在 devotion、Salvation、collection 等词里。

patterns.name: 缩写中的 I
patterns.context: 大写缩写或品牌名称内部的单个 I 被激活，未见稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: TGF 缩写片段
patterns.context: 医学文本中 TGF-alpha、TGF-beta1 等缩写里的字符片段；激活较弱，可能与其他字母片段模式有关。

patterns.name: 数字与标点片段
patterns.context: 统计值、小数或表格编号中的数字和标点局部激活，缺少可确认的共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Wound 及其后续词片段
patterns.context: 表格列举不良事件或症状时，伤口、毒性、僵硬等词的局部片段激活；与主要字母片段模式的关系不明确。

patterns.name: MCI 字母片段
patterns.context: 体育报道中的队名缩写内部激活，未见其他相同语境。

patterns.name: 用户界面词片段
patterns.context: 代码注释中的无障碍阅读说明和编辑器字段名；这些词与主模式缺少明显联系。

en.description: Activates mainly on stem fragments in medical words such as malignant and malignancies, especially align after m; there are also sporadic character fragments such as isf, standalone S, use, and A in Q&A, spanning domains without a unified semantics.

patterns.name: malign/malignant word forms
patterns.context: Activation often falls on stem fragments in medical terms such as malignant, malignancies, and non-malignant; contexts include contrasts between positive and non-positive lesions, as well as malignant tumors and diagnoses.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, clinical research, and medical patent background

patterns.name: isf string fragment
patterns.context: Occurs as a character fragment within English words or in software configuration keys; there is no consistent semantic or contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Literary texts, film descriptions, software configuration

patterns.name: Possessive/plural s
patterns.context: In uppercase contract-clause headings, activation falls on the final letter of plural or possessive forms.

patterns.name: Museums character fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in “Museums” in a hashtag about race relations related to Ferguson; semantically inconsistent with the medical word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Letter in a Q&A title
patterns.context: In music-album promotional copy mentioning that an event concluded with a Q&A session, activation falls on the A in Q&A.

2_2329.description: 主要激活于 malignant、malignancies 等医学词的词干片段，尤其是 m 后的 align；另有 isf、单独的 S、use、Q&A 中 A 等零散字符片段，跨领域且缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: malign/malignant 词形
patterns.trigger: «align»、«malign»，尤其是 «align» 前接未标记的“m”或在词内拆分出的“m”；见“m«align»9ant”“M«align»9ant”“m«isf»…（非此类）”等
patterns.context: 激活多落在 malignant、malignancies、non-malignant 等医学词汇的词干片段上；既有阳性与非阳性病变的对照，也有恶性肿瘤、诊断等上下文。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、临床研究与专利医学背景

patterns.name: isf 字符串片段
patterns.context: 出现在英文单词内部的字符片段或软件配置键中；没有一致的语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 文学文本、电影简介、软件配置

patterns.name: 所有格/复数 s
patterns.context: 合同条款标题的全大写文本中，激活落在复数或所有格形式的末尾字母。

patterns.name: Museums 字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Ferguson 相关种族关系话题标签中的“Museums”字样；语义上与医学词形模式不相符。
patterns.domain: 网络评论或社交媒体文本

patterns.name: 问答标题字母
patterns.context: 音乐专辑宣传文案提到活动以问答环节结束时，激活落在 Q&A 的 A。

en.concept: Responses to word-form and formatting fragments
en.description: Strong activation does not form a single semantic pattern: it occurs notably on spelling fragments such as malign/misf, Magento, and MIME-Version, as well as code syntax, email headers, and sporadic lexical items. Some may be triggered by subword spelling or formatting, and cannot be explained uniformly.

patterns.name: malignancy stem and its fragments
patterns.context: Strong activation concentrates on spelling fragments such as malign-/misf-; the complete words may refer to malignant tumors, but may also occur in unrelated words such as Misfortune, Misfit, and misfire. This is not simply a response to medical meaning.
patterns.domain: Across styles; medical texts and literary, game-description, and software texts

patterns.name: Magneto-related name fragments
patterns.context: Appears in Magento product-configuration class names, namespaces, or test paths; activation falls on a segmented fragment of the string Magneto.

patterns.name: MIME email header
patterns.context: Appears in the email header field MIME-Version, especially near version number 1.0.

patterns.name: Game-description text containing target
patterns.context: Located at the beginning of game promotional or descriptive text; this example also contains other activation patterns, but the word itself may be an independent trigger.

patterns.name: Type-declaration fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a PHP strict_types declaration; activation concentrates on types split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Email subject and forwarding markers
patterns.context: Subject lines at the start of emails and repeated forwarding prefixes; ordinary words in subject bodies are also marked, so it is unclear whether this constitutes a stable pattern.

patterns.name: XML parameter tags and names
patterns.context: Near argument tags, attribute names, and product-configuration helper class names in XML snippets.

2_2329.description: 强激活并不形成单一语义模式：显著落在 malign/misf、Magento、MIME-Version 等拼写片段，也有代码语法、邮件头和零散词项。部分可能由子词拼写或格式触发，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: malignancy词干及其片段
patterns.context: 强激活集中在 malign-/misf- 等拼写片段；完整词可指恶性肿瘤，也可出现在 Misfortune、Misfit、misfire 等无关词中。不是单纯对医学含义的反应。
patterns.domain: 跨文体；医学文本及文学、游戏简介、软件文本

patterns.name: Magneto相关名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Magento 的产品配置类名、命名空间或测试路径中；激活落在被切分的 Magneto 字符串片段上。
patterns.domain: 软件配置与 PHP 代码

patterns.name: MIME邮件头
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头字段 MIME-Version 中，尤其是版本号 1.0 附近。

patterns.name: 含 target 的游戏简介文本
patterns.context: 位于游戏宣传或简介语句开头；该例同时包含其他激活模式，但此词本身可能是独立触发。

patterns.name: 类型声明片段
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP strict_types 声明中；激活集中于被分词切开的 types。

patterns.name: 邮件主题与转发标记
patterns.context: 邮件开头的主题行和反复转发前缀，另有主题正文中的普通词被标记，是否构成稳定模式不确定。

patterns.name: XML参数标签与名称
patterns.context: XML片段中 argument 标签、属性名及产品配置帮助类名附近。

en.description: Activation is scattered across various texts, often on internal word fragments or proper-name fragments: misfortune/misfit, XLIFF, Magento, Schiff, and Metals; it also occurs on directory headings, dates, XML tags, and indentation, with no unified semantics or stable syntactic conditions observed.

patterns.name: isf inside tokenized words
patterns.context: Appears inside words such as misfortune and misfit; in both cases it follows the prefix mis and is not at a complete-word boundary.

patterns.name: iff in technical identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in identifiers or technical terms such as XLIFF / Xliff, involving translation, XML schemas, and web applications.

patterns.name: agent in technical identifiers
patterns.context: Appears inside Magento, involving product configuration, Catalog Helper, or category restrictions.

patterns.name: Schiff in a scientific staining term
patterns.context: Appears in the periodic acid-Schiff / PAS stain name, near descriptions of tissue processing, liver tissue, or microscopy.

patterns.name: metals in legal case names
patterns.context: Appears in Metals in company or case names, near discussion of courts, insurance, or rulings.

patterns.name: COUNTRY PARTY in directory headings
patterns.context: An uppercase chapter heading in a directory entry, surrounded by Roman numerals, chapter titles, and page numbers.

patterns.name: argument in XML tags
patterns.context: Appears in a closing tag in an XML configuration snippet, near argument names, attributes, and Magento configuration.

patterns.name: 26 in document dates
patterns.context: Appears in the date format of a court decision document.

patterns.name: Whitespace indentation
patterns.context: Consecutive spaces used for indentation in an XML snippet.

2_2329.description: 激活散落在多种文本中，常落在词内片段或专名片段：misfortune/misfit、XLIFF、Magento、Schiff、Metals；另有目录标题、日期、XML 标签和缩进，未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 分词内部的 isf
patterns.context: 出现在单词内部，形成 misfortune、misfit 等词；两次都位于词首前缀 mis 后，且不在完整词边界。

patterns.name: 技术标识符中的 iff
patterns.context: 出现在 XLIFF / Xliff 等标识符或技术术语中，涉及翻译、XML schema 与 Web 应用。

patterns.name: 技术标识符中的 agent
patterns.context: 出现在 Magento 名称内部，涉及产品配置、Catalog Helper 或分类限制。

patterns.name: 科学染色术语中的 Schiff
patterns.context: 出现在 periodic acid-Schiff / PAS 染色名称中，邻近组织处理、肝组织或显微镜检查描述。

patterns.name: 法律案件名称中的 metals
patterns.context: 出现在公司或案件名称中的 Metals，邻近法院、保险或判决论述。

patterns.name: 目录标题中的 COUNTRY PARTY
patterns.context: 目录项中的大写章节标题，周围有罗马数字、章节名与页码。

patterns.name: XML 标记中的 argument
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 配置片段的闭合标签中，邻近 argument name、属性与 Magento 配置。

patterns.name: 文档日期中的 26
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决文档的日期格式中。

patterns.name: 空白缩进
patterns.context: XML 片段中用于缩进的连续空格。

en.description: The most stable trigger is the Magento name and its PHP namespace; activation also occurs in misfortune/Misfit, image-orientation handling code, and code containing Boolean values and color arrays, with weaker associations in the latter cases.

patterns.name: Magento namespaces and identifiers
patterns.context: Magento brand name or Magento in PHP namespaces and class names; occurs in code, documentation, or link text.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in “Misfortune”
patterns.context: misfortune occurs in English poetry or prose; another instance is Misfit in a game plot summary.

patterns.name: Image and TIFF orientation information
patterns.context: A code comment describes converting image orientation based on Orientation metadata in TIFF.

patterns.name: Magento string value in a configuration fragment
patterns.context: In XML configuration, a Magento helper-class namespace occurs as a string value.

patterns.name: Color arrays and Boolean values
patterns.context: Code fragments with variable assignments and arrays of color names; not clearly related to the themes of the other high-activation fragments.

2_2329.concept: Magento 名称与代码标识符
2_2329.description: 最稳定的触发因素是 Magento 名称及其 PHP 命名空间；另在 misfortune/Misfit、图像方向处理代码和含布尔值、颜色数组的代码中激活，后几类关联较弱。

patterns.name: Magento 命名空间与标识符
patterns.context: Magento 品牌名或 PHP 命名空间、类名中的 Magento；出现在代码、文档或链接文本中。

patterns.name: “Misfortune”词内片段
patterns.context: 英文诗歌或散文中出现 misfortune；另一次为游戏剧情简介中的 Misfit。

patterns.name: 图像及 TIFF 方向信息
patterns.trigger: « to»1« transform»6 the« i»1«am»1«ge»2 at right« orientation»1；«t»«iff»«Orientation»
patterns.context: 代码注释描述按 TIFF 元数据中的 Orientation 转换图像方向。

patterns.name: 配置片段中的 Magento 字符串值
patterns.context: XML 配置中，Magento 帮助类命名空间作为字符串值出现。

patterns.name: 颜色数组与布尔值
patterns.context: 变量赋值及颜色名称数组的代码片段；与其他高激活片段主题不明显相同。

en.concept: Fragmented technical terms and formatting markers
en.description: Activation concentrates on fragmented PAS/Schiff staining terms, Magento names, the MIME field in email headers, and code for JPEG/TIFF image-orientation handling; these contexts span medicine, code, and email.

patterns.name: PAS-staining-related medical text
patterns.context: Words related to periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) appear in descriptions of tissue sections, histological staining, or microscopy methods; activation often falls on the segmented Schiff spelling fragment.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts or methods sections

patterns.name: Magent(o) product or class name
patterns.context: The Magento name appears near class names, namespaces, or product configuration in Magento code or configuration.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, XML configuration, and documentation comments

patterns.name: MIME email header
patterns.context: Fields such as MIME-Version, email clients, or email priority appear in raw email headers; activation falls on fragments of MIME and email-related fields.

patterns.name: Image formats and orientation metadata
patterns.context: Code checks whether a file is JPEG and reads TIFF metadata to correct image orientation.

2_2329.concept: 片段化技术词与格式标记
2_2329.description: 激活集中于片段化的 PAS/Schiff 染色词、Magento 名称、邮件头中的 MIME 字段，以及 JPEG/TIFF 图像方向处理代码；这些上下文横跨医学、代码与邮件。

patterns.name: PAS 染色相关医学文本
patterns.context: 组织切片、组织学染色或显微镜方法描述中出现 periodic acid-Schiff（PAS）相关词语；激活常落在被切分的 Schiff 拼写片段上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要或方法部分

patterns.name: Magent(o) 产品或类名
patterns.context: Magento 代码或配置中，Magento 名称出现在类名、命名空间或产品配置附近。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码、XML 配置与文档注释

patterns.name: MIME 邮件头
patterns.context: 电子邮件原始头部中出现 MIME-Version、邮件客户端或邮件优先级等字段；激活落在 MIME 及邮件相关字段的片段上。

patterns.name: 图像格式与方向元数据
patterns.context: 代码判断文件是否为 JPEG，并读取 TIFF 元数据以修正图像方向。

en.description: Primarily responds to the segmented string agent: it is embedded in the name Magento or forms part of the color word magenta; the standalone brand word Agent also occurs. isf activation in the literary passage cannot be explained by these patterns.

patterns.name: magenta substring in Magento identifiers
patterns.context: The Magento brand name is split into multiple tokens and appears in code and text, including class names, namespaces, helpers, and product categories.
patterns.domain: Magento PHP, technical Q&A, and technical articles

patterns.name: magenta color word
patterns.context: The segmented word form magenta appears in color lists, print-color descriptions, or technical text; it is listed alongside colors such as cyan and yellow.

patterns.name: Agent brand word
patterns.context: agent appears as a complete word in a product name or description, rather than as a segmented form of Magento or magenta.

patterns.name: Segmented word fragment in literary text
patterns.context: The fragment appears in the word “Misfortune,” adjacent to the remaining morphemes; no clear agent, Magento, or magenta semantics are observed.

2_2329.description: 主要响应被拆分的 agent 字符串：它嵌在 Magento 名称中，或构成 magenta 颜色词；另见独立的 Agent 品牌词。文学段中的 isf 激活无法由这些模式解释。

patterns.name: Magento 标识中的 magenta 子串
patterns.context: Magento 品牌名被拆成多个 token，出现在类名、命名空间、帮助器或产品类别等代码与文字中。
patterns.domain: Magento PHP、技术问答与技术文章

patterns.name: magenta 颜色词
patterns.context: magenta 被拆分的词形，处于颜色列表、印刷色彩说明或技术文字中；与 cyan、yellow 等颜色并列。

patterns.name: Agent 品牌词
patterns.context: agent 作为完整词出现于产品名称或描述中，而非 Magento 或 magenta 的拆分词形。

patterns.name: 文学文本中的拆分词片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在 “Misfortune” 一词中，紧邻其余词素；未见清楚的 agent、Magento 或 magenta 语义。

en.description: Activation primarily occurs on the shared letter fragment in Magento class names or the color name magenta; it also appears inside Misfortune and Madam in poetry, with no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: Stem in Magento class names
patterns.context: Trigger locations are mostly PHP class names, namespaces, paths, or URLs; activation concentrates inside Magento rather than on general PHP syntax.

patterns.name: Magento 类名中的词干

en.description: All fragments activate on the internal substring agent in Magento or magenta: the former is typically M-agent-o, the latter m-agent-a. The former commonly occurs in Magento code and discussions, the latter in color lists and printing patent text.

patterns.name: agento string in the name Magento

patterns.name: Magento namespaces and class names in code

patterns.name: magenta color name

2_2329.concept: 品牌/颜色词中的 agent 子串
2_2329.description: 所有片段均激活在 Magento 或 magenta 的内部子串 agent 上：前者通常为 M-agent-o，后者为 m-agent-a。前者常见于 Magento 代码与讨论，后者见于颜色列表及印刷专利文本。

patterns.name: Magento 名称中的 agento 字符串
patterns.context: 触发点位于品牌名 Magento 的内部切分处，拼写为 M + agent + o；也出现在缩写 magenta 的拼写切分处，拼写为 m + agent + a。Magento 中强度更高。

patterns.name: 代码中的 Magento 命名空间与类名
patterns.context: 出现在 Magento PHP 类、命名空间、配置或 API 相关文本中；常邻接反斜线、标识符及代码标点。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码、StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: magenta 颜色名称
patterns.context: 作为 magenta 这一颜色词的一部分，出现在印刷四色说明或颜色列表中；周围提及 cyan、yellow、red、green、blue 等颜色。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景文本、GitHub 颜色数组

en.description: Activation mainly falls on the internal substring “agento” in Magento/Magento and the substring “magenta” in the color name magenta; the former occurs in platform code and Q&A, while the latter occurs in color lists and print text.

patterns.name: agento inside the spelling Magento/Magento
patterns.context: The triggered part is the internal substring “agento” in the string Magento/Magento, commonly found in Magento class names, paths, product descriptions, and discussions; no fixed syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Code, Q&A, and articles related to the Magento e-commerce platform

patterns.name: magenta in the English color name
patterns.context: The triggered part is the continuous substring “magenta” in the color name magenta; it appears in color lists or alongside other print colors.
patterns.domain: Color data in code, color printing/image-processing patent texts

2_2329.description: 激活主要落在 Magento/Magento 的内部子串“agento”，以及颜色名 magenta 的子串“magenta”；前者见于平台代码与问答，后者见于颜色列表和印刷文本。

patterns.name: Magento/Magento 拼写内部的 agento
patterns.context: 触发部分是字符串 Magento/Magento 的内部子串“agento”，常见于 Magento 类名、路径、产品说明和讨论；不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: Magento 电商平台相关的代码、问答和文章

patterns.name: 英语颜色名中的 magenta

patterns.domain: 代码中的颜色数据、颜色印刷/图像处理专利文本

en.description: Activation concentrates on the character fragment “agent” in “Magento”; in a few contexts, the same fragment also appears in “magenta,” referring to the color.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment in the Magento brand name
patterns.context: “agent” occurs inside the proper name Magento, commonly in Magento class names, namespaces, URLs, or Q&A topics; in the first passage, “m«agent»o” differs in capitalization
patterns.domain: Software development, Magento code and Q&A

patterns.name: Color name represented by the color abbreviation M
patterns.context: “magenta” appears as a color name or in code color lists; the second passage is a string list, while the third and fourth passages are print-color abbreviations and descriptions
patterns.domain: Code, colors and printing technology in patents

2_2329.description: 激活集中于“Magento”中的 agent 字符片段；少数上下文中同一片段也出现在“magenta”中，表示颜色名。

patterns.name: Magento 品牌词中的分词片段
patterns.trigger: «agent»，与前面的“Mag”或“m”及后面的“o”组合成“Magento”
patterns.context: “agent”位于 Magento 这个专名内部，常见形式包括 Magento 类名、命名空间、URL 或问答主题；第 1 段的“m«agent»o”大小写不同
patterns.domain: 软件开发、Magento 代码与问答

patterns.name: 颜色缩写 M 所对应的颜色名
patterns.context: “magenta”作为颜色名出现，或出现在代码颜色列表中；第 2 段为字符串列表，第 3、4 段为印刷颜色缩写与说明
patterns.domain: 代码、专利中的颜色与印刷技术

en.description: Primarily responds to the Magento brand name and fragments in its class names and namespaces; it also responds to fragments of magenta in color lists and print contexts. The two share the string fragment agent but occur in different contexts.

patterns.name: agento in Magento identifiers
patterns.context: The brand name appears in Magento/Magento 2 class names, namespaces, product descriptions, or titles; trigger locations include XML, PHP code, and Q&A text

patterns.name: magenta color name
patterns.context: When listing print or display colors, it appears near color abbreviations such as M, C, K, and Y or other color names
patterns.domain: Color processing, printing, and patent background text; color arrays in code

patterns.name: Other Magento string fragments
patterns.context: Activation may fall inside Magento class names or related identifiers, not only in the complete brand-name token

2_2329.description: 主要响应 Magento 品牌名及其类名、命名空间中的片段；也响应颜色 magenta 在颜色清单和印刷语境中的片段。两者共享字符串片段 agent，但语境不同。

patterns.name: Magento 标识符中的 agento
patterns.context: 出现在 Magento/Magento 2 类名、命名空间、产品描述或标题中的品牌名；触发位置包括 XML、PHP 代码和问答文本

patterns.name: 颜色名 magenta

patterns.domain: 颜色处理、印刷与专利背景文本；代码中的颜色数组

patterns.name: 其他 Magento 字符串片段
patterns.trigger: [1] 中的 «pers»（helpers 的一部分）以及代码中的 Magento 类路径
patterns.context: 激活可落在 Magento 类名或相关标识符内部，不限于完整的品牌名 token
patterns.domain: Magento 配置与 PHP 代码

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on agent→o in the string Magento and agent→a in the color name magenta; they also occur in Magento namespaces and product/API discussions. There are also sporadic activations on line breaks, XML tags, and word endings in auth and categories.

patterns.name: Magento/Magent(o) identifiers
patterns.context: The character fragment agent is followed by o or a; occurs in both the Magento brand/namespace and the color name magenta.
patterns.domain: Magento code, product discussions; color descriptions

patterns.name: magenta in color tables
patterns.context: Occurs in color lists or four-color printing/color-key sequences, often alongside color names such as cyan, yellow, and black.
patterns.domain: Program data, patent descriptions of color and printing

patterns.name: Magento product and API discussions
patterns.context: Q&A about Magento stores, products, categories, or APIs; not all related words themselves are marked as activations.

patterns.name: Magento PHP namespaces and object-management code
patterns.context: Magento namespace class names in PHP code, often adjacent to calls such as objectManager and create.

patterns.name: Line-leading newline markers
patterns.context: Line breaks in code, XML, or Q&A snippets; they occur in multiple passages, but many line breaks are unmarked, so they cannot independently explain the main activations.

patterns.name: xliff closing tag in XML
patterns.context: Occurs in the closing tag “</xliff>” in an XML fragment.

patterns.name: auth identifier
patterns.context: Part of a PHP property or variable name, adjacent to object creation and a Backend class.

patterns.name: Plural ending in a category word
patterns.context: Occurs in the misspelling catogories in a question title.

2_2329.concept: Magento/颜色名中的 agent 子串
2_2329.description: 强激活主要落在 Magento 字符串中的 agent→o，以及颜色名 magenta 中的 agent→a；也见于 Magento 命名空间、产品/API 讨论。另有零星换行、XML 标签和 auth、categories 词尾激活。

patterns.name: Magento/Magent(o) 标识
patterns.context: 字符片段 agent 后紧接 o 或 a；既出现在 Magento 品牌/命名空间中，也出现在颜色名 magenta 中。
patterns.domain: Magento 代码、产品讨论；颜色说明

patterns.name: 颜色表中的 magenta
patterns.context: 位于颜色列表或印刷四色/色键序列中，前后常有 cyan、yellow、black 等颜色名。
patterns.domain: 程序数据、专利中的颜色与印刷描述

patterns.name: Magento 产品与 API 讨论
patterns.trigger: Magento/Magent(o) 名称，如“Magento”“M«agent»o”，以及“simple product”“Custom API”
patterns.context: 围绕 Magento 商店、产品、分类或 API 的问答；并非所有同主题词本身都标记为激活。

patterns.name: Magento PHP 命名空间与对象管理代码
patterns.context: PHP 代码中的 Magento 命名空间类名，常与 objectManager、create 等调用相邻。

patterns.name: 行首换行标记
patterns.context: 代码、XML 或问答片段的换行位置；多段出现，但也有大量未标记换行，不能单独解释主要激活。

patterns.name: XML 中的 xliff 结束标记
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 片段的闭合标签“</xliff>”中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 XML/本地化文本

patterns.name: auth 标识
patterns.context: 作为 PHP 属性或变量名的一部分，邻近对象创建与 Backend 类。

patterns.name: 类别复数词尾
patterns.context: 出现在问题标题中的拼写变体 catogories。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on Magento/Mage strings and their code identifiers; it also falls on M/magenta in color or four-color printing lists. Both contexts contain similar Mage/magenta string fragments but serve different purposes.

patterns.name: Mage/Magento in Magento identifiers
patterns.context: In Magento class names, namespaces, object manager calls, product helper classes, or Magento-related titles and Q&A; activation concentrates inside the Mage/Magento string or its components.
patterns.domain: Magento PHP code, developer Q&A, and related links

patterns.name: M/magenta in print-color abbreviations
patterns.context: In color lists or four-color printing contexts, M stands for magenta, often listed alongside Y, C, K, or RGB colors.
patterns.domain: Patent background, image processing, and color configuration code

patterns.name: Unexplained fragment
patterns.context: In the Q&A title “Magento - Restrict some categories,” activation occurs in the word Magento; it can be grouped with the Magento pattern, but the spelling of the category name is unusual, so the specific trigger is uncertain.

2_2329.description: 激活主要落在 Magento/Mage 字符串及其代码标识符中；另在颜色或四色印刷列表里落在 M/magenta。两类语境都包含相近的 Mage/magenta 字符串片段，但用途不同。

patterns.name: Magento 标识符中的 Mage/Magento
patterns.context: 在 Magento 类名、命名空间、对象管理器调用、产品辅助类或 Magento 相关标题/问答中；激活集中在 Mage/Magento 字符串内部或其组成部分。
patterns.domain: Magento PHP 代码、开发问答与相关链接

patterns.name: 印刷颜色缩写中的 M/magenta
patterns.context: 在颜色列表或四色印刷语境中，M 表示 magenta（品红），常与 Y、C、K 或 RGB 颜色并列。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、图像处理及颜色配置代码

patterns.name: 无法解释的片段
patterns.trigger: 无清楚可分离的共同触发子串；片段中可见 «agent»，但局部语境不足以确认其功能
patterns.context: Q&A 标题“Magento - Restrict some categories”，激活出现在 Magento 字样中；可归入 Magento 模式，但类别名拼写异常，具体触发因素不确定。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on internal fragments of Magento/Mage identifiers; fragments of magenta in color sequences also activate, especially alongside cyan and yellow. The two uses share similar orthographic fragments but occur in different contexts.

patterns.name: Mage/Magento identifiers in Magento
patterns.context: Occurs in Magento namespaces, class names, API/product terms, or titles; common forms include Magento\…, Mage\…, and Mage - …. Activation is concentrated on internal fragments of the brand name and does not require a fixed syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Magento developer Q&A, PHP code, technical titles

patterns.name: Lowercase m suffix in color abbreviations
patterns.context: In RGB/printing color abbreviations or sequences of color names, adjacent to items such as cyan, yellow, and black; not in a Magento context.
patterns.domain: Code examples, patent descriptions of color and printing

2_2329.description: 激活主要落在 Magento/Mage 标识符的内部片段；另在颜色序列里的 magenta 片段也激活，尤其与 cyan、yellow 等并列时。两种用法共享相似字形片段，但语境不同。

patterns.name: Magento 中的 Mage/Magento 标识符
patterns.trigger: «M»«agent»«o»（有时开头为 «Mag»ento），以及相关的 «Catal»og、«Design» 等
patterns.context: 出现在 Magento 的命名空间、类名、API/产品术语或标题中；常见形式为 Magento\…、Mage\…、Mage - …。激活集中在品牌名的内部片段，不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: Magento 开发问答、PHP 代码、技术标题

patterns.name: 颜色缩写中的小写 m 后缀
patterns.context: 在 RGB/印刷色彩缩写或颜色名称序列中，紧邻 cyan、yellow、black 等颜色项；并非 Magento 语境。
patterns.domain: 代码示例、专利中的颜色与印刷说明

en.concept: Malta place name and sporadic high activations
en.description: The most stable pattern is the place name Malta appearing across languages and styles. Other activations are scattered across news reading, mathematical formulas, programming Q&A, and number lists, with no clear shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Place name Malta
patterns.context: The country/place name Malta appears in English or other European-language texts and activates in varied contexts, including diplomacy, sports, history, and schools.

patterns.name: Teenagers and news reading
patterns.context: Sentences discuss teenagers reading news online and its possible effects.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A minus sign and numbers appear at the end of a polynomial equation; activation is concentrated on expression symbols and numbers.

patterns.name: Buffers in code Q&A
patterns.context: A question asks how to obtain a buffer's value; the answer mentions Buffer.from(array) and array code.

patterns.name: Numeric fragments in number sequences
patterns.context: Long numbers are split into multiple tokens in comma-separated, bracketed numeric lists.

2_2729.concept: Malta 地名及零散高激活
2_2729.description: 最稳定的模式是不同语言和文体中出现地名 Malta；其余激活分散在新闻阅读、数学公式、编程问答和数字列表中，未见共同的明确语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Malta 地名
patterns.context: 英文或其他欧洲语言文本中出现国家/地名 Malta；在外交、体育、历史、学校等不同上下文中均触发

patterns.name: 青少年与新闻阅读

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与符号

patterns.name: 代码问答中的缓冲区
patterns.context: 询问如何取得 buffer 的值，答案提到 Buffer.from(array) 和数组代码

patterns.name: 数字序列中的数值片段
patterns.context: 逗号分隔的方括号数值列表中，长数字被拆分为多个 token

en.description: The most stable pattern is a strong response to the proper noun Malta across various geographical and historical contexts. Other activations occur separately in news terms, mathematical minus signs, code Q&A, and numerical sequences, with no shared semantics.

patterns.name: Place name Malta
patterns.context: Appears as a country or place name in various contexts, including country lists, EU enlargement, sporting events, naval history, and educational institutions; in paragraph 2, also appears in the fixed phrase «Knight» of «Malta».

patterns.name: News-related words
patterns.context: Appears in sentences about teenagers reading news online and crime risk.

patterns.name: Minus sign
patterns.context: Appears at the end of an expression solving a polynomial equation, in a mathematical-symbol context.

patterns.name: Sporadic tokens in code Q&A
patterns.context: A user asks how to get the value of a buffer, and the answer gives the syntax Buffer.from(array); activations are scattered across the question, Q&A markers, and code snippet.

patterns.name: Comma-separated numerical sequence
patterns.context: Appears in a long list of integers enclosed in square brackets and separated by commas, with no clear natural-language trigger.
patterns.domain: Data or code text on GitHub

2_2729.concept: 对 Malta 一词的响应
2_2729.description: 最稳定模式是对专名 Malta 的强响应，涵盖多种地理与历史语境；其余激活分别出现在新闻词、数学负号、代码问答及数值序列中，未显示共同语义。

patterns.name: 地名 Malta

patterns.name: 新闻相关词

patterns.name: 负号
patterns.context: 出现在求解多项式方程的表达式末尾，属于数学符号环境

patterns.name: 代码问答中的零散词元

patterns.name: 逗号分隔数值序列

en.description: The most stable and strongest trigger is the country name “Malta,” appearing across languages; other passages show only sporadic weak activations, possibly involving letters or common words, with no consistent context.

patterns.name: Proper-noun trigger: “Malta”
patterns.context: The country name Malta appears in English contexts, including within sentences, at sentence ends, or alongside other place names.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, historical fiction, naval history, parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Possible within-word trigger for the letter a
patterns.context: In a few non-Malta passages, activation falls on the letter a or common code/English words containing a; contextual conditions are inconsistent.

2_2729.concept: Malta 国家名
2_2729.description: 最稳定、最强的触发是国家名“Malta”，跨语言文本中均出现；其余段落只有零散弱激活，可能涉及字母或常见词，缺乏一致上下文。

patterns.name: “Malta”专名触发

patterns.name: 疑似字母 a 的词内触发
